Description
ADP is hiring a Sales Representative for our ADP Comprehensive Services® business.
ADP Comprehensive Services provides tailored HR, payroll, and benefits outsourcing, combining expert guidance with the ADP Workforce Now® technology platform. It serves as a dedicated partner to handle compliance, tax filing, talent management, and people benefits, aimed at reducing administrative burdens for small- to mid-market businesses.
As a Sales Representative, you will close new business within a defined territory and represent one of the most trusted HR brands in the world. You'll join a high-performing team, receive award-winning training, and help organizations solve real-world HR challenges -- from compliance to employee engagement -- using ADP's industry-leading solutions.
If you're motivated, consultative, competitive, and excited about uncapped earning potential, this is your opportunity.
What You'll Do: Responsibilities
Grow Our Business While Growing Your Career
Own a defined, protected territory and execute a top-down sales strategy to win new clients.
Drive the full sales cycle -- prospecting, qualifying, presenting, negotiating, and closing.
Turn Prospects into Loyal, Referring Clients
Assess business needs and recommend the right ADP solutions across HR, payroll, benefits, and talent management.
Utilize multi-channel prospecting techniques to engage decision-makers and secure qualified appointments.
Leverage the Power of the ADP Network
Collaborate with internal ADP partners to cross-sell and expand within current accounts.
Be a Trusted Advisor
Act as a consultative partner who understands client challenges and connects them to meaningful outcomes.
Represent ADP with professionalism, integrity, and solutions that improve employee experience.
What You Need to Succeed: Required Qualifications
Adaptability & Emotional Intelligence -- Ability to adjust to changing sales situations while demonstrating empathy, awareness, and rapport-building.
Critical Thinking & Business Acumen -- Understand business drivers and translate them into actionable solutions.
Strong Communication & Persuasion -- Deliver compelling, confident messaging to diverse stakeholders.
Grit & Resilience -- Stay motivated, persistent, and growth-oriented in a competitive environment.
Sales Execution & Territory Management -- Execute consistently with a structured approach to prospecting, pipeline management, and closing.
Modern Selling Skills -- Combine sales technology, AI-driven tools, and data insights to drive pipelines and revenue.
Preferred Qualifications
4+ years of full-cycle, quota carrying sales experience in a results-driven environment.
Proven success in consultative or solution-based selling.
You'll Love Working Here Because You Can:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.
Apply Now! Visit jobs.adp.com. Start your sales career with a leader in HR innovation -- and help businesses build better workplaces.

Job Description
Vill du jobba inom IT-säkerhet & har god insikt i hur datorer och nätverk fungerar? Just nu söker vi en säkerhetsanalytiker till vår SOC-verksamhet i Stockholm.  
I Accentures Security Operations Center (SOC) övervakar analytikerna i vårt Blue Team några av Sveriges viktigaste organisationers nätverk dygnet runt, året runt, för att upptäcka och reagera på misstänkt aktivitet. BlueSOC är med andra ord själva hjärtat av våra defensiva Managed Detection and Response-tjänster och utgör därmed en viktig och affärskritisk funktion. Nu söker vi en analytiker som vill ansluta till vårt starka team.  
Din roll hos oss  
Som säkerhetsanalytiker arbetar du med den senaste tekniken för att upptäcka, analysera och förhindra intrång och säkerhetsincidenter. Du kommer att arbeta i ett aktivt larmflöde och analysera data från flera källor såsom EDR, SIEM-system och IDS.  
Utöver larmhantering kommer du få möjlighet att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp med varierande uppgifter såsom, utveckling och förbättring av detektion, utveckling av verktyg som används inom SOC samt Threathunting. Det finns även möjligheter för den som gillar kundkontakt att få ett ökat ansvar och assistera våra Service Delivery Managers vid kundmöten.  
Tjänsten innefattar viss kundkontakt då du är ansvarig för att eskalera misstänkta händelser till kund enligt en incidenthanteringsplan. Då attacker kan ske när som helst är vår SOC bemannad dygnet runt, och du kommer arbeta som en del av en skiftrotation. Tjänsten är på plats på vårt kontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm.  
Nedan beskriver en av våra seniora analytiker lite mer om rollen och vad det finns för möjligheter till utveckling.  
“Som säkerhetsanalytiker ges jag möjlighet att jobba i många miljöer och plattformar, detta gör att jag får möjlighet att utvecklas och fördjupa mig i flera områden. Threathunting är ett område där jag får dra nytta av mina erfarenheter och färdigheter inom många områden. I takt med att jag utvecklas kommer jag kunna hjälpa till att detektera och förhindra nya hot mot våra kunder.”  
- Tommy Johansson, Senior Säkerhetsanalytiker 
Qualification
Är du den vi söker? 
Vi letar efter dig med ett genuint IT-säkerhetsintresse! Har du programmerat, hackat och labbat mycket självständigt på hemmaplan har du redan ett försprång. Goda kunskaper om Windows & UNIX/Linux. 
Förståelse för hur nätverk fungerar på protokollnivå. 
Programmeringskunskaper på grundläggande nivå i ett språk såsom python, bash, eller ruby. 
Flytande kunskaper i både svenska och engelska, såväl i tal som skrift. 
För den här rollen krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Anställningen är dessutom villkorad av att en säkerhetsprövning genomförs och godkänns.
Meriterande kunskaper: 
Erfarenhet eller kunskap inom IDS, SIEM och EDR. 
Erfarenhet inom SOAR-System, SecOps, CloudOps, eller Systemadministration. 
Deltagande i CTF-event.

Description
ADP is hiring a Sales Representative, Human Resources Outsourcing (HRO).
 Are you ready for your next best job where you can elevate your financial future?
 Are you looking to grow your career with a formal career path at an established, respected, global leader?
 Do you want to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.
In this role, you will close sales and win new business within a defined territory. You'll attend our award-winning training program and join a sales team that works with both new and existing clients to sell human resources solutions, making employees' lives better with high-quality benefits offerings across the hire-to-retire spectrum. Daily, you will cultivate relationships with Human Resources and executive decision-makers, set appointments, gather leads from established internal partners, and assess buyer needs to present the best ADP solutions.
You will use your ability to manage multiple sales processes at the same time through various stages in the sales process, as well as document them, sticking with the process through implementation until your new business is up and running on the solutions you sell. As you see more and more deals cross the finish line, you'll reap the rewards with industry-leading compensation, benefits, luxurious incentive trips, and awards. As you strive to grow your career, leaders will back your desire to pursue advancement and provide continual sales training.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Sales at ADP, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales_Videos
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities
Grow Our Business While Growing Yours: You will work within a defined, protected territory to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals by implementing a top-down sales strategy. 
Turn Prospects into Loyal and Referring Clients: You will close sales by recommending the right solutions to help our clients understand and solve their real business needs. Plus, you'll earn referral business by networking with existing and soon-to-be clients and forging partnerships in-person and over the phone with decision-makers.
Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family: In addition to cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cross-sell with other ADP associates to cultivate additional business within existing accounts; you will make life-long friendships here.
Collaborate Daily. You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
 Positive Self-Starter. You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection. You can manage your time well, prioritize deliverables, and multi-task with the best of them. In addition, you can present your ideas in a clear, professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone. 
Strategic Closer. You have an established network and experience carrying a quota in outside business-to-business sales. You have an impressive track record of closing sales, winning clients, and managing a territory and relationships. 
Proven Winner. You have an ambitious spirit and thrive under pressure, motivating you to not only hit sales quotas but exceed them.
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. If you don't have a college degree, other acceptable experience could include:
Three years of business-to-business sales experience (preferably field sales) within a results-driven environment.
Military experience -- skills including teamwork, resilience, negotiation, trust-building, and a never lose mentality will help you build team and client relationships, identify solutions, and achieve success.
Bonus points for these: Preferred Qualifications
Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn. Ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities for even the most insatiable learner.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impactupon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

Job Description
Shape and deliver the future of insurance
We are expanding our Financial Services team in Stockholm and are looking for a skilled Consultant to help leading Nordic insurers tackle their most important strategic and transformation challenges.
If you are passionate about both defining where organizations should go and making sure they get there - this is your chance to accelerate your consulting career.
About the role
At Accenture Industry & Enterprise Financial Services, we work with clients across the full change life cycle, from strategy development to transformation delivery. You will help insurers across all lines of business solve challenges such as:
Strategic focus
Corporate strategy and growth opportunities
Operating model design to support new business ambitions
Strategic cost management and efficiency improvement
Buy vs. build assessments to guide investment choices
Transformation focus
Designing and delivering change programs
Value management and realization
Platform and solution validation for insurance-specific needs
Business process optimization and digital enablement
Insurance expertise across all lines 
We work across the full insurance spectrum, and a genuine understanding of how insurance products work in practice is key - think customer journeys, core processes and operational realities across products such as Home, Motor, Accident, Life & Pension or Health. Experience across multiple lines is a strong plus and include:
Life & Pension – e.g., key business processes including product and proposition development, advisory-led sales and distribution, policy administration, customer servicing and retirement journey transformation
P&C / Non-life – e.g., key business processes including product and proposition development, distribution, claims excellence, customer servicing, portfolio performance and end-to-end operational transformation across personal and commercial lines
Qualification
Your profile
You have 3–6 years of experience in management consulting, insurance, or corporate strategy roles. You are passionate about both defining where organizations should go and making sure they get there, and you are comfortable working across the full change lifecycle: from shaping strategy to delivering transformation within the insurance sector.
As a person, you combine team spirit with analytical rigor. You enjoy taking initiative, solving problems collaboratively, and creating value for clients.
What you bring:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to structure both ambiguous and operational problems
Experience contributing to change initiatives or strategic analyses
Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
Master's degree with an excellent academic record
Proficiency in Swedish and English (Swedish fluency is preferred for this role)
Experience within P&C insurance, life, health or specialty insurance is meriting
What we offer
You will collaborate across Accenture and client teams, often navigating complex organizations and connecting the right competencies to drive impact. We offer a platform to grow rapidly, work on the topics that matter most to Dutch and Nordic insurers and be part of a team that takes both strategy and delivery seriously.
Work with industry-leading insurers in Sweden and across the Netherlands & Nordics market
Opportunities to work on strategy development and hands-on transformation projects
Coaching and development with a clear path for progression
A social and inclusive environment, being part of a diverse workforce where initiative and community are strong. Explore a wide range of social activities and sports groups – you are sure to find something that suits your interests!
Benefits package with competitive salary, bonus, pension, health insurance and stock savings program
A global network of inspiring colleagues and specialists

Per-Erik Wellstedt - Swedish I&E Financial Services Lead
Niclas Jävervall - Swedish Insurance Lead 
Gunnar Wijkmark – Swedish Banking Lead
Heleen Vanrenterghem – Management Consultant Financial Services

We encourage you to apply now and look forward to reviewing your application in August.

Description
WorkForce Software, an ADP company, is hiring a Functional Implementation Consultant. 
Are you looking to grow your career in an agile, dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to progress?
Are you a continuous learner who embraces ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities?
Are you looking to be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights?
 If so, this may be an opportunity for you. Read on and decide for yourself. 
 As an Implementation Consultant, you will carry the WorkForce Software relationship forward after a sale and enable the first interaction between WorkForce’s largest clients and our industry-leading HR solutions. You will build relationships with clients and seamlessly implement our technologies to ensure your clients achieve long-term success. Once WorkForce’s services are delivered, your efforts will have a direct impact on the day-to-day lives of your clients' employees.
Every day, you will partner with clients to learn and understand their business needs; analyze existing systems, interface requirements, and business processes; and guide clients towards the best WorkForce solution. You will use your deep knowledge of Human Capital Management to design and build complex solutions for our enterprise client base, including the Fortune 500. 
To thrive in this role, you have a way with clients that builds rapport, establishes trust, and shines with professionalism. Over the phone and in writing, your communication style is clear and easy for our clients to understand and take action on. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. Pace should not scare you. We also have a healthy dose of fun. Not only can you find a career here, but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion. 
A little about ADP: We are a global leader in human resources technology, offering the latest AI and machine learning-enhanced payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and much more. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive, down-to-earth culture that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition as a global Best Places to Work and a recipient of many prestigious awards for diversity, equity, and inclusion, including a DiversityInc® Top 50 Company, Best CEO and company for women, LGBTQ+, multicultural talent, and more. Learn more about DEI at ADP on our YouTube channel: http://adp.careers/DEI_Videos 
 Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now! 
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities 
What you can expect on a typical day:
Onboard Clients. You'll create exceptional onboarding experiences for each product or service implementation. You'll help clients develop the skills and confidence to use our products with ease through your expertise and relationship-building.
Implement WorkForce Software Technologies. You will analyze existing systems, interface requirements, and business processes. You will incorporate new processes, tools, and approaches when recommending and implementing the WorkForce solution.
Partner Internally. You will collaborate with associates in sales and support and exchange routine information with members of the client project team, including priorities, timeliness, and issues as they arise. 
Multi-Task & Communicate. You will work on multiple time-sensitive projects and follow-up items simultaneously. You will share essential information with clients and the teams you work with at ADP.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
You have at least 2 years of experience working in software implementations, specifically workforce management
Responsible for gathering and identifying customer business requirements from users, customers, and other stakeholders. this includes creating, maintaining business requirements documents, noticeable use cases and process diagrams.
Become familiar with aspects of labor laws as it pertains to time and attendance rules, scheduling, and leaves of absences.
You have intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills with a strong emphasis on Excel
You have experience with Waterfall or Agile methodologies
You will have the ability to travel up to 25% with the potential for international travel
You're able to work hybrid in either or Maitland, FL or Livonia, MI office

Description
Please note: the hours for this role are 9am-6:30pm MST.
ADP is hiring a Human Resources Solution Specialist.
Are you ready to join a company offering career advancement opportunities throughout your career journey?
Do you want to join a company with award-winning training and world-class service guidelines to help you achieve success, growth, and continued learning?
Are you looking for an inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
If so, this may be an opportunity for you. Read on and decide for yourself.
In this role, you'll serve as the primary point of contact for ADP's Comprehensive Human Resources clients and work on their service request tickets for ADP's WorkForce Now (WFN) Human Resources Technology solution. You carry the weight of ADP's service reputation and client satisfaction in your hands. 
The nature of what you do every day will not change -- your #1 goal is to help your clients. However, every day will be different because the questions you receive will vary, as will the solutions you provide each client. There will be no shortage of new questions, and you will partner with the assigned Resource Manager, Payroll, Benefits Solution Specialists, and third-party vendors (as applicable) to provide troubleshooting support and a seamless client experience. Our top-ranked training will help to set you up for success! 
To thrive in this role, you must be comfortable working in a metrics-driven call center environment as part of a structured day. You have a way with clients that builds rapport, establishes trust, and shines with professionalism. Over the phone and in writing, your communication style is clear and easy for our clients to understand and take action on. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. Pace should not scare you. We also have a healthy dose of fun. Not only can you find a career here but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion. 
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now! 
To learn more about Client Services at ADP, watch here: 
https://adp.careers/Client_Services_Videos 
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities 
What you can expect on a typical day: 
Be a Trusted Advisor and Problem Solver. You will take the initiative to seek answers, solutions, and positive outcomes for both the client and ADP. You'll also proactively initiate regular outbound communication to identify problems and offer solutions to improve the internal operation and administration of human resources and labor policies, practices, and procedures within the scope of our offering.
Educate and Provide Recommendations. You will leverage your ADP product and services knowledge to solve issues and questions that help clients understand our products' value. You will take client input and turn it into recommendations for your leaders on best practices and solutions training. 
Flex and Adapt. You thrive in a structured environment that requires setting priorities, organizing your day, multi-task, changing direction, and providing prompt follow-up. Adaptability, empathy, self-motivation, and organization skills are must-haves in this job. You will need to balance your workload to handle multiple inquiries while focusing on what is important and staying up-to-date on ADP and external policy changes. 
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
2+ years of client and/or service experience 
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include: 
Experience noted above, OR 
Military Experience. We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
BONUS POINTS FOR THESE: Preferred Qualifications 
Payroll Certifications including Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) 
HR Certifications including SHRM, PHR, GBA, CEBS, and/or CHRS (ACA) 
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN: 
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights. 
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups to connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences. 
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress. 
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.

Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live. 
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

Job Description:
Position Overview 
A Product Support Engineer acts as the technical bridge between customer support, product management, and core engineering teams, diagnosing complex software issues and contributing in improving product reliability. 
ACCOUNTABILITIES : 
Responsible for the training products support including their deployment (initial, evolution and upgrades) in all training domains - Cabin, Flight, Maintenance and Structure.  
Ensures integrity of Airbus training products delivered to Airbus Training Centers, Partners and Customers 
Resolving training product related support requests and incidents received from the internal and external users
Ensures transnational coordination between stakeholders of various teams like - training centers, business domains, product development, sales & marketing, quality and customers
Support development team for the delegated activities like training products validation, product communication management and consolidating the customer feedbacks 
Contributes to overall customer satisfaction of the training product by coordinating with other stakeholders and maintaining a close relationship with internal stakeholders and customers 
Act as focal point for required training product - coordinating with different domains within training organization, Airbus Digital, Skywise support teams and subcontractors 
Administration of the cloud platform to manage the various functionalities related to Airbus training products.
MAIN ACTIVITIES : 
Contributes in his / her domain of expertise to the compilation of the new training packages, delivery orders based upon customers’ and internal needs 
Contributes to the administration of online course contents and validation
Request management to support internal and external customers related to training products delivery, cloud platform access, course contents access and troubleshooting 
Provides a consistent evolutions/upgrades package to internal and external customers
Optimize tools, documents and processes for the products operation 
Anticipate risks of obsolescence of training products and manage associated actions 
Create and maintain associated documentation in line with Airbus processes. 
DELIVERABLES : 
Ensure on-time delivery of the necessary deliverables related to the training products
Create, deliver and monitor necessary KPI & targets for the smooth operation of the support and performance management in adherence with Airbus processes and rules 
Be efficient and reactive while dealing with different technologies, different tasks (project management, operation support, worldwide support, short and long-term actions), different professions (manufacturers, sub-contractors, procurement, pilots, etc...) 
Minimize customers and users disturbance following technical problems; this leads the job holder, in specific cases, to adapt working hours to the situation 
Keep regularly up to date technical knowledge (digital interfaces, software, hardware, training environment) 
REQUIRED SKILLS : 
Educational background: A degree in science or engineering especially in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Data Analytics
Work Experience: 8 years and above in technical / product support is mandatory.
Previous customer handling experience will be an added advantage
Project management, organizational skills 
Technical knowledge covering cloud platform administration, IT (Software, Hardware & Network) troubleshooting techniques and request management.
Knowledge of Training Center's operations (ATO/MTO), experience in understanding the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) processes will be an added advantage
Knowledge of any Airbus training products/solutions such as ACT Suite, Cabin Training Suite, e-training by Airbus, MATe suite, Smarter Classroom, MyTDS & Virtual Procedure Trainer is plus
Basic Knowledge of AWS and any LMS platform 
Team player, CAN DO attitude, adaptability 
Autonomy, Communication and coordination skills, mastering workshop methodologies
Language skills: English negotiation level 
Anticipation mindset, resistance to stress and flexibility. 
This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Description
ADP is hiring a Compliance Delivery Analyst. 
In this position you will gather appropriate and relevant documentation to identify and clarify actual issues and seek timely, reasonable solutions. Develop internal relationships to assist with execution and information gathering in order to ensure compliance and excellent agency relationships. Provide support to Agency Liaison Director function in order to create positive agency relationships, thought leadership, and trend analysis. Maintain a knowledge level of support areas conducive for effective analysis of solutions. Assist with management of compliance changes and gaining consensus on approach and details of systemic changes, verification and acceptance of changes. Use excellent functional technical, and project management knowledge and skills to perform assigned tasks.
At ADP we are driven by your success. We engage your unique talents and perspectives. We welcome your ideas on how to do things differently and better. In your efforts to achieve, learn and grow, we support you all the way. If success motivates you, you belong at ADP.
We strive for every interaction to be driven by our CORE values: Insightful Expertise, Integrity is Everything, Service Excellence, Inspiring Innovation, Each Person Counts, Results-Driven, & Social Responsibility.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Interact with appropriate business areas for execution of agency requirements for all sizes of development effort.
Identify through interaction with all levels of organization positive and negative trends with agency and client impact in order to provide details for strategic conversations to drive change.
Assist with analysis for compliance changes and assess system impacts.
Ensure transactions and resolution are executed timely and without impairing client service or causing financial exposure to ADP or our clients.
Performs other duties as assigned by Management.
QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:
3-5 years of directly related experience identifying, resolving and implementing system modification and enhancements. Basic working knowledge of business operations.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Preference will be given to candidates who have the following:
Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent in education and experience with a Major Area of Concentration in Business, Finance, Computer Sciences, Industry.
PMP Certification is beneficial.
Solid understanding of Electronic Transmissions.
Prior Agency Experience.
Technical and Systems Savvy.
Problem Solving.
Negotiation Skills
Excellent Verbal and Written Communication Skills
Analytical Skills
Time Management Skills

Description
ADP is hiring a Sales Executive.
 Are you ready to grow your career and lead a team at an established, respected, global company?
 Are you ready for your next best job where you can elevate your financial future?
 Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
Yes? This could be the role for you. Don't just take our word for it... read on and see for yourself!
As a Sales Executive, you'll lead a team of field-based Sales Representatives who sell ADP solutions, including payroll, tax, human resources, and benefits to new and existing clients. In this role, you will guide your team towards achieving sales objectives through coordination and communication between ADP's clients & prospects, internal support partners, and your team. Additionally, you will recruit, hire, train, and develop sales associates, providing performance feedback and coaching.
Multitasking and prioritization are essential to helping your team win. If you're able to juggle different work activities and shift attention from one task to another with ease depending on urgency, then this job is for you! As you continue to meet the needs of multiple different stakeholders (your team, your clients, your partners, your leaders, and more), you will have an opportunity to reach your goals and make a name for yourself at ADP. Once you do, doors will open for advancement opportunities and industry-leading compensation, benefits, and even luxurious incentive trips.
A little about ADP: We are a global leader in human resources technology, offering the latest AI and machine learning-enhanced payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and much more. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive, down-to-earth culture that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition as a global Best Places to Work and a recipient of many prestigious awards for diversity, equity, and inclusion, including a DiversityInc® Top 50 Company, Best CEO and company for women, LGBTQ+, multicultural talent, and more. As part of our deep DEI commitment, our CEO has joined the OneTen coalition to create one million jobs for Black Americans over the next ten years. Learn more about DEI at ADP on our YouTube channel: http://adp.careers/DEI_Videos
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Sales at ADP, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales_Videos
What you'll do: Responsibilities
Grow Our Business While Growing Your Team's. You will work with your team within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals through the effective use of planned resources. 
Lead Your Team. You will provide overall direction, motivation, and support to your sales team in a designated territory. (You'll also need to ensure that all Sales Associates utilize the Salesforce Automation System and implement an audit procedure to ensure compliance.)
Recruit, hire, and train sales associates. You will interview, identify, and motivate Sales Associates while providing continuous feedback on performance and coaching. Also, you will help to develop the careers of your team members.
Represent ADP. You will represent ADP to customers, prospects, and the public by spending time in the field, at trade shows, demonstrations, and seminars. You will stay current on ADP product technology.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications
 Sales Role Model. You have a successful track record of business-to-business sales experience (2+ years). You excel at client interactions and showcase stellar presentation skills.
People Person and Coach. You're a relationship builder who can connect and motivate people. You will not shy away from delivering performance feedback and coaching to make your team members the best that they can be.
Trusted Advisor. You live and breathe integrity and deliver on promises...every time.
Expert Planner. You manage your time well, prioritize deliverables, and are an expert at multitasking. You possess excellent planning skills, which will help you to implement successful sales strategies.
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. If you don't have a college degree, other acceptable experience could include:
 Two or more years of business-to-business sales or sales management experience with an impressive track record of closing sales, winning clients, and managing a territory, OR
Military experience -- skills including teamwork, resilience, negotiation, trust-building, and a "never lose" mentality will help you build team and client relationships, identify solutions, and achieve success.
Bonus points for these: Preferred Qualifications
 Prior experience leading teams
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
 Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
 Belong by joining one of nine Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
 Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
 Continuously learn. Ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities for even the most insatiable learner.
 Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
 Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
 Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
 Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impactupon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

Job Description:
Votre environnement de travail:
Et si VOTRE aventure avec NOUS commençait ?!
Nous vous proposons de travailler chez Airbus Atlantique, nouveau champion de dimension mondiale, n°2 des aérostructures, n°1 des sièges pilotes et dans le Top 3 des fauteuils passagers Premium. Notre site Airbus Atlantique basé à Mirabel recherche son futur : Analyste en gestion de Configuration, PLM et Nomenclature.
Sommaire du poste: :
Sous la supervision du Manager Ingénierie, L’Analyste de la Configuration PLM et Nomenclature travaille en collaboration avec les différents services internes tel que le « Manufacturing Engineering », la Qualité, la Programme sur des aérostructures équipées pour les produits Airbus A220 & Bombardier G8000. 
Responsabilités:
S’assurer que les documents d’ingénierie et de certification rencontrent les normes de contrôle qualité établies par le client et Airbus Atlantique Canada (Dataset CATIA/ENOVIA, Engineering Data Release Notice - EDRN, Non-Incorporated Engineering Order - NIEO, Modification Summary- MODSUM);
Documenter les erreurs de nomenclature et les retourner vers le Bureau d’Étude pour correction;
Supporter le Bureau d’Étude dans l’analyse des erreurs pour les enrailler (bon du 1er coup);
Interpréter et intégrer dans le système d’information interne (PLM WindChill), la documentation du client requise à l’intégration des différentes configurations et de la documentation de certification;
Suivre les règles et les requis établis entre le client et Airbus Atlantique Canada afin que le transfert du data entre les systèmes informatiques de notre client et les systèmes informatiques internes de Airbus Atlantique Canada se fassent suivant les besoins de production;
Créer des Design Solutions (DS) pour les différentes configurations générées à partir de documents de certification (NIEO et Modsum);
Maintenir l’engineering Build of Material (eBOM) dans le système informatique PLM WindChillMulti-Client d’Airbus Atlantique Canada;
Générer et soumettre pour approbation de nos clients la documentation définissant la configuration de nos livrables (Engineering Configuration Status - ECS);
Établir et diffuser les rapports périodiques et indicateurs de performance sur l’état des relâches ingénierie, du transfert et de l’intégration des données dans le PLM;
Maintenir à jour les procédures Airbus Atlantique Canada sur la Configuration PLM et Nomenclature. Etre force de proposition sur l’amélioration des processus en place.
Mission/Suivi Opérationnel:
La mission de l’analyste de la Configuration est de garantir que les éléments livrés par Airbus Atlantique Canada aux clients externe et interne sont gérés en dedans des objectifs de qualité, de délais et de couts conformément aux exigences des programmes.
Profil recherché :
Avoir 5 ans d’expérience dans l’industrie aéronautique;
Avoir des connaissances de gestion de maquette numérique (DMU) et des règles de design pour les structures de fuselage et les installations systèmes;
Connaitre des processus et méthodes BOMBARDIER et AIRBUS CANADA;
Avoir de très bonnes connaissances sur les logiciels Enovia, Catia, DataLink, SAP et Windchill;
Être bilingue français/anglais;
La connaissance des technologies de fabrication et des requis de certification aéronautique est un atout;
Avoir de bonnes aptitudes relationnelles et être capable de manifester son leadership;
Être reconnu pour sa capacité à travailler à la fois en équipe et en autonomie;
Possède de bonnes capacités relationnelles et sait adapter sa communication à l’interlocuteur concerné, que ce soit en interne ou envers le client;
De nature enthousiaste, aime travailler dans un environnement rythmé où les situations imprévues et d’urgence stimulent;
A la capacité à répondre avec calme et réactivité en fournissant un travail de qualité;
Assure une bonne connaissance de ses limites techniques et du besoin d’assistance.
Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

Job Description:
Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Senior Fatigue & Damage Tolerance Engineer to join our Engineering department based in Wichita, Kansas or Mobile, Alabama.
This position supports the development of aircraft structures as a Fatigue and Damage Tolerance analyst. Duties include performing complex F&DT analysis for metallic parts while working in close collaboration with design and static stress colleagues. Methods include the use of both classical hand calculations and computer techniques to develop high strength to weight ratio structures.
Meet the team:
Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world.
Your working environment:
Located on the Wichita State University (WSU) innovation campus is Airbus’ first dedicated engineering facility outside of Europe. Our team of 200+ support staff and engineers focus on aerostructure design including analysis of aircraft primary structures, such as wings and fuselages, for all major Airbus products across the globe.
How we care for you:
Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. 
Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.
Your challenges:
• Autonomously perform complex durability and damage tolerance analyses to verify that structural integrity requirements have been met. Team assignments may include detail part sizing, layout maturation, trade study analysis, weight reduction efforts, certification activity, or in-service support.
• Document analyses in support of trade studies or detail drawing sign-off for airframe structure.
• Liaise with Design, Static Stress and other appropriate Airbus departments to come up with optimum design solutions.
• Accept broad objectives with agreed deadlines and establish the tasks required and how they should be completed. Works independently.
• Apply extensive technical expertise and has full knowledge of other related disciplines.
• Ability to obtain Authorizer Technical Signatory. Has obtained and utilizes Approver Signatory effectively.
• Mentor and provide leadership to less experienced structural analysts.
• Lead in the preparation of complex business and technical material and presentation packages.
• Demonstrate a high level of listening and oral skills by leading discussions on issues, solutions, ideas, and status of work.
• Guide and/or lead the successful completion of projects and execute activities to achieve customer requirements.
• Key technical contact on contracts and projects. Interacts with senior external personnel on major technical matters.
Your boarding pass:
Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Engineering (Aero, Civil, Mechanical).
9 years total experience in analysis with airframe structures. Experience to include fatigue and/or damage tolerance.
Position requires in-depth knowledge of classical and numerical (Finite Element) stress analysis methods.
Capable of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment both independently and collectively.
Dependable, self-motivated and accessible.
Team player demonstrating a positive & collaborative attitude.
Able to lead teams technically to achieve agreed milestones.
Demonstrates a refined approach to communication that resolves problems, facilitates consensus, and focuses on objectives
Able to represent Engineering in presentations at any Airbus related activity
Strong computer background, including MS Excel and Google Suite application experience (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Experience in airframe design (metallic & composites), stress analysis, SRM, MRB, FAR/JAR/CS/Part21, Certification, CATIA, NASTRAN, and PATRAN, is desired.
Must be able to communicate effectively in English (verbal and written)
Authorized to Work in the US.
Physical Requirements: 
Onsite or remote:  Onsite 90% 
Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings.
Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. 
Speaking:  able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. 
Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools such as hydraulic lifts.
Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. 
Lifting:  able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs.
Pushing / Pulling:  able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools.
Sitting:  able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer. 
Squatting / Kneeling:  able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving.
Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on the production floor. 
Travel:  able to travel independently and at short notice.
Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents):  able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces.

Description
As a SA/VLM associate, you will be responsible for creating high-quality written content for videos/images and/or labeling of objects on audio, image, and/or video-file. Your primary focus will be on producing clear, concise, and informative content that meets the needs of the target audience. 
Key job responsibilities
• Performs simple annotation-related tasks in a narrow ML data process area (e.g. audio, image, and/or video-file). Uses internal tools and software provided by team. 
• May participate in data collection activities when scripts and instructions are provided. Adheres to compliance and confidentiality requirements. 
• Apply strong language skills, grammar knowledge, and linguistic rules to ensure the generated text adheres to proper grammar, syntax, and appropriate language usage.
• Maintaining high internal quality of the processes by performing quality audits/verification.
• Meets daily productivity and quality targets. Tracks queries related to annotation/data collection and share them with the relevant stakeholders to help solve them. 
• Track daily task completion status using recommended tools and provide individual status reports. 
• Adhere to confidentiality & compliance requirements to ensure zero risk to customer data and Amazon. Helps test new SOPs and ML data tools.
• Providing specific & timely feedback to streamline existing processes and help the team achieve more consistent results with high quality.
• Offering remedial instruction in tool usage and other topics as required.
Requirements:
• Strong command of the English language, including grammar, syntax, and vocabulary.
• Background in linguistics, creative writing, computational linguistics, or a related field is preferred.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate and interpret data to improve the performance of the system.
• Good familiarity with the Windows desktop environment and uses of Word, Excel, IE, Firefox etc. are required 
• Flexibility and Interest to do repetitive tasks is required.
• High level of energy and proactive nature. A sense of ownership and drive and a willingness to accept the challenge of daily deadlines is essential
• Attention to detail and ability to identify and rectify errors or inconsistencies in descriptions generated.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
• Passion for language, technology, and AI advancements.
• Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Svenska
Fullstackutvecklare med fokus på AI och integration
Sök rollen som en av våra AI-utvecklare i ett mindre konsultbolag med familjär känsla.
Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens digitala lösningar där integrationer, AI och moderna plattformar möts? På Arkido söker vi nu en bred utvecklare som vill ta en central roll i våra kundprojekt och bidra till smartare, mer uppkopplade system.
Om rollen Som utvecklare och konsult hos oss jobbar du nära både kunder och kollegor i projekt där teknikval och arkitektur spelar stor roll. Du är med från idé till leverans och arbetar med allt från backend-logik till frontendlösningar, med särskilt fokus på integrationer och datadrivna flöden. AI är en naturlig del i hur vi utvecklar lösningar och skapar värde.
Vi söker dig som:
Har erfarenhet som fullstackutvecklare
Har god kunskap inom .NET/C#
Har jobbat med Optimizely (eller liknande CMS/DP)
Är van att arbeta med integrationer och API:er
Använder AI i ditt arbete (Copilot, Claude, agenter & automatisering)
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska
Befinner dig i Stockholm med omnejd, eller har möjlighet att arbeta nära teamet där
Det är extra meriterande om du:
Har erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar som Azure, AWS, GCP.
Har jobbat med integrationsplattformar eller komplexa systemlandskap
Har ett intresse för arkitektur och tekniska helhetslösningar
Om Arkido Arkido är ett specialistbolag inom systemintegration och digitala plattformar. Vi hjälper organisationer att koppla ihop sina system, skapa effektiva flöden och bygga lösningar som håller över tid. Vi tror på långsiktiga relationer, modern teknik och att ge våra medarbetare stort inflytande i både teknikval och arbetssätt.
Hos oss får du:
Arbeta med modern teknik och spännande kunder
Möjlighet att påverka lösningar och arkitektur
En flexibel vardag där balans och utveckling är viktigt
Ett engagerat team med hög kompetens och nära samarbete
Kollektivavtal
Bra lön och bonus
Trevliga och tekniktunga kollegor
Låter det intressant? 
Hör av dig så berättar vi mer.

Är du vår nya RPG-utvecklare? Apper söker dig med passion för teknik!
9 oktober, 2024/i Apper, Jobb, Nyheter, RPG/av Helen
Vi gör varandra bättre – Framgång bygger på samarbete. På Apper skapar vi digitala möjligheter och långsiktigt värde för våra kunders verksamheter. Med strategisk skicklighet, kreativitet och passion för teknik bygger vi framtidens lösningar redan idag.
Vi är för närvarande cirka 70 digitala specialister, placerade i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg och Norge. Vi är övertygade om att ny teknik, verktyg och lösningar skapar konkurrensfördelar för våra kunder. Vi vet också att utvecklingstakten på den globala marknaden aldrig har varit högre, vilket gör kontinuerlig utveckling av affär och verksamhet avgörande för att möta våra kunders och deras kunders framtida krav och behov.
Vill du ta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med oss?
Vi söker nu RPG-utvecklare till ett av våra leveransteam i Stockholm eller Helsingborg!
Du kommer att ingå i ett team med ett agilt arbetssätt, nära samarbete och en öppen och trevlig arbetsmiljö. Våra arbetsplatser är flexibla, och du får möjlighet att styra dina dagar i högsta möjliga mån genom ansvar, frihet och stöd från dina kollegor. Din placering kan vara på något av våra kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm eller Helsingborg. Det finns även möjlighet till flexibelt distansarbete med bas på något av våra kontor.
Din profil
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har cirka 3–10 års erfarenhet av utveckling inom RPG och IBM i-miljö.
Är du lyhörd, prestigelös och har ett samarbetsinriktat arbetssätt är du helt rätt person för oss. Har du dessutom en bakgrund inom bank, finans eller försäkring är det ett extra plus. Erfarenhet av JavaScript, C# eller .Net är meriterande.
Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som är positiv och alltid sätter kunden i fokus. Du bör ha en god förståelse för IT-relaterade uppgifter och kunna snabbt ta till dig ny information.
Som person är du engagerad i ditt arbete och har en stark vilja att hålla dig uppdaterad inom teknikområdet. För att trivas hos oss bör du vara en teamplayer, nyfiken, driven och resultatinriktad. Det är också viktigt att du trivs i en miljö med högt tempo och snabba beslut. Vi värdesätter prestigelöshet eftersom vi arbetar tillsammans i hybrida team.
Du erbjuds
Som konsult hos oss får du arbeta med förädling, vidareutveckling och modernisering av våra kunders mest affärskritiska system. Vi är ett välpositionerat företag med en unik kombination av kompetens, vilket ger oss strategiska och intressanta uppdrag hos våra kunder. Hos oss får du en spännande och varierad framtid, där du i hög grad kan påverka din egen utveckling och ditt resultat.
Ansökan
Uppdraget är ett heltidsuppdrag som sträcker sig över 5–10 år med stor chans till vidare anställning. Vi erbjuder goda anställningsvillkor och förmåner. Vi värnar om kompetensen hos våra medarbetare och eftersträvar mångfald.
Har du några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:
Johanna Hasselmark
johanna.hasselmark@apper.se
031-10 70 70
Låter det här intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
Din ansökan skickar du till jobs@apper.se

Job Description:
Versão em português:
A Airbus é líder no projeto, na fabricação e na entrega de produtos, serviços e soluções aeroespaciais para clientes em todo o mundo, sendo pioneira em uma aviação sustentável para um mundo seguro e unido.
Com mais de 45 anos de presença, a Airbus vem ampliando sua atuação na América Latina, contando com cerca de 1.500 colaboradores e diversas unidades estratégicas. Como parceira fundamental do setor e com uma carteira de pedidos de 500 aeronaves, a empresa mantém um compromisso sólido com o crescimento da região a longo prazo.
A Helibras, única fabricante de helicópteros da América Latina e subsidiária da Airbus, é líder no mercado de asas rotativas nos segmentos civil, executivo e de defesa. Suas operações abrangem desde a montagem e personalização até a manutenção de alta complexidade. Como referência em engenharia aeroespacial e um ativo regional estratégico, sua infraestrutura garante uma resposta operacional rápida para missões de alta exigência.
Você quer se juntar a nós para redefinir os limites do que é possível? ✈️🚁🚀
--------------
Principais responsabilidades:
Prestar assistência direta ao cliente em questões de manutenção, resolução de problemas e questões técnicas decorrentes das operações diárias. Dar suporte à operação de equipamentos de apoio em solo, ao uso de ferramentas ou outros equipamentos. Realizar investigações de acidentes/incidentes e outras investigações técnicas. Apoiar o cliente com publicações técnicas e consultas técnicas ao centro de atendimento ao cliente do detentor da Certificação Técnica (TC). Oferecer orientação para minimizar o tempo de inatividade não programado (NFF). Realizar análises de confiabilidade. Relatar dados técnicos/operacionais. Prestar serviço de plantão. Atuar como primeiro ponto de contato em caso de AOG técnico. Apoiar a organização de logística da Airbus DS em questões relacionadas à configuração da aeronave. 
Realizar treinamento prático para o cliente.
Gerenciar a programação e o planejamento das atividades de manutenção, tanto eventos de manutenção contratados quanto atividades de manutenção de linha sob a responsabilidade do cliente. Assegurar a coordenação adequada com a organização de logística da Airbus DS. Acompanhar os eventos de manutenção para atingir as metas de oToCoQ. Atuar como ponto de contato para o cliente final, especificamente no que diz respeito a relatórios de eventos, revisão de O&A, preparação de propostas e gerenciamento de consultas. Realizar gestão de riscos. Revisar registros de manutenção.
Atuar como ponto de contato local com o cliente para atividades relacionadas à aeronavegabilidade contínua e gestão de frota. Controlar a aeronavegabilidade contínua da frota do cliente. Acompanhar a disponibilidade e o desempenho da frota. Impulsionar a melhoria contínua do Programa de Manutenção da Operadora. Analisar toda a documentação de engenharia, como ADs, SBs, VSBs, modificações, ordens de engenharia, SIL e AOT. Garantir o controle da configuração da aeronave. Controlar os registros técnicos.
Requisitos:
Candidatos internos, atentar-se a Regra de Ouro.
Graduação em Engenharia e/ou Engenheiro Licenciado com qualificação específica para A330-200/300 Trent 700. Licença EASA Categoria ‘C’ habilitada para A330.
Experiência sólida em trabalhos de manutenção e atuando como representante técnico de ligação na frota Airbus.
Nível avançado de português e inglês; espanhol é uma vantagem.
Conhecimento de regulamentações aeronáuticas, tais como EASA/EMAR Parte M, Parte 145 e a Regulamentação Nacional de Aeronavegabilidade do Cliente.
Disponibilidade para viajar com frequência.
O que nós oferecemos?
Contrato: CLT (Prazo Indeterminado).
Jornada de Trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h16.
Modelo de Atuação: Presencial no Rio de Janeiro (Galeão).
Saúde e Bem-Estar: Assistência Médica e Odontológica completas, Seguro de Vida e Wellhub (Gympass).
Conveniências do Dia a Dia: Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição.
Incentivo Financeiro e de Longo Prazo: Plano de Ações para Colaboradores Airbus (ESOP).
Junte-se a nós para alcançar o excepcional. 🚁
----------
[English Version]
Key Responsabilities:
Provide hands-off customer assistance with maintenance, troubleshooting, and technical problems arising from day-to-day operations. Support the operation of ground support equipment, the use of tools or other equipment. Conduct accident/incident and other technical investigations. Support the customer with technical publications and technical queries to the TC holder's customer care center. Provide advice to minimize NFF. Perform reliability analysis. Report technical/operational data. Provide on-call service. Act as the first point of contact in case of technical AOG. Support Airbus DS logistics organization with aircraft configuration matters. 
Perform On-the-Job Training for the customer.
Manage the scheduling and planning of maintenance activities, both contracted maintenance events and line maintenance activities under customer's responsibility. Ensure proper coordination with Airbus DS logistics organization. Follow up on maintenance events to achieve oToCoQ targets. Act as the focal point for the final customer, specifically regarding event reporting, O&A review, offer preparation, and management of queries. Perform risk management. Revise maintenance records.
Act as the local liaison with the customer for continuing airworthiness activities and fleet management. Control the continuing airworthiness of the customer fleet. Follow up on fleet availability and performance. Drive continuous improvement of the Operator Maintenance Programme. Analyze all Engineering Documentation, such as ADs, SBs, VSBs, Modifications, Engineering Orders, SIL, and AOT. Ensure aircraft configuration control. Control technical records.
Requirements:
Internal candidates, please note the Golden Rule.
Engineering University Degree and/or Licensed Engineer Typed Rated in A330-200/300 Trent 700. EASA License Category 'C' enabled for A330.
Solid experience in maintenance works and working as a technical representative liaison on Airbus Fleet.
Advanced level of Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
Knowledge of aeronautics regulations, such as EASA/EMAR Part M, Part 145, and the Customer's National Airworthiness Regulation.
Willingness to travel frequently.
What we offer:
Contract: CLT (Permanent/Indefinite-term employment contract).
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:16 PM.
Work Model: On-site in Rio de Janeiro (Galeão).
Health and Well-being: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance, life insurance, and access to Wellhub (formerly Gympass).
Daily Perks: Grocery/food vouchers. 
Incentive: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).
Join us in achieving the exceptional. 🚁

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.
Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com.
At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
About Us
Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.

Digital Associate, Ring Data Engineering Services
Job ID: 10576453 | ADCI HYD 16 SEZ - H83
Apply now
Description
As a SA/VLM associate, you will be responsible for creating high-quality written content for videos/images and/or labeling of objects on audio, image, and/or video-file. Your primary focus will be on producing clear, concise, and informative content that meets the needs of the target audience. 
Key job responsibilities
• Performs simple annotation-related tasks in a narrow ML data process area (e.g. audio, image, and/or video-file). Uses internal tools and software provided by team. 
• May participate in data collection activities when scripts and instructions are provided. Adheres to compliance and confidentiality requirements. 
• Apply strong language skills, grammar knowledge, and linguistic rules to ensure the generated text adheres to proper grammar, syntax, and appropriate language usage.
• Maintaining high internal quality of the processes by performing quality audits/verification.
• Meets daily productivity and quality targets. Tracks queries related to annotation/data collection and share them with the relevant stakeholders to help solve them. 
• Track daily task completion status using recommended tools and provide individual status reports. 
• Adhere to confidentiality & compliance requirements to ensure zero risk to customer data and Amazon. Helps test new SOPs and ML data tools.
• Providing specific & timely feedback to streamline existing processes and help the team achieve more consistent results with high quality.
• Offering remedial instruction in tool usage and other topics as required.
Requirements:
• Strong command of the English language, including grammar, syntax, and vocabulary.
• Background in linguistics, creative writing, computational linguistics, or a related field is preferred.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate and interpret data to improve the performance of the system.
• Good familiarity with the Windows desktop environment and uses of Word, Excel, IE, Firefox etc. are required 
• Flexibility and Interest to do repetitive tasks is required.
• High level of energy and proactive nature. A sense of ownership and drive and a willingness to accept the challenge of daily deadlines is essential
• Attention to detail and ability to identify and rectify errors or inconsistencies in descriptions generated.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
• Passion for language, technology, and AI advancements.
• Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

RPG-utvecklare till Apper
1 mars, 2023/i Apper, Jobb, Nyheter, RPG/av Helen
Vi gör varandra bättre – Framgång bygger på samarbete. Vi på Apper skapar digitala möjligheter och långsiktigt värde för våra kunders affärer. Med strategisk förmåga, kreativitet och passion för teknik bygger vi framtidens lösningar idag.
Vi är i dagsläget ca sjuttio digitala specialister placerade i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg och Norge som är helt övertygade om att ny teknik, nya verktyg och lösningar skapar konkurrensfördelar för våra kunder. Det vi också vet är att utvecklingstakten på den globala marknaden är högre än någonsin vilket gör att kontinuerlig utveckling av affär och verksamhet är essentiell för att lyckas möta våra kunders och deras kunders framtida krav och behov.
Vill du ta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med oss? Vi kan nu erbjuda spännande uppdrag inom RPG-utveckling hos oss där du kommer att få arbeta med hela utvecklingsprocessen, från behov till implementation. Du kommer att ingå i ett team som präglas av ett agilt arbetssätt, ett nära samarbete och ett öppet och trevligt arbetsklimat. Vi söker medarbetare till flertalet intressanta uppdrag med varierande längd och arbetsuppgifter. Våra arbetsplatser är flexibla, så du har möjlighet att styra dina dagar i största möjliga mån, genom ansvar, frihet och stöttande kollegor. Din placering kan vara på något av våra kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm och Helsingborg. Möjlighet finns också för flexibelt distansarbete med bas på något av våra kontor.
Din profil
För att lyckas i rollen så tror vi att du har ungefär 3–10 års utvecklingserfarenhet inom RPG samt IBM i-miljö. Är du lyhörd och prestigelös med ett samarbetsorienterat arbetssätt är du helt rätt person för oss. Har du dessutom en bakgrund inom bank/finans/försäkring så är det ett extra plus. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av JavaScript, C# eller .Net.
Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som är en positiv person och som alltid sätter kunden i fokus. Du bör ha en god förståelse för IT-relaterade uppgifter samt besitta egenskapen av att snabbt kunna ta in ny information.
Som person har du ett stort intresse för ditt arbete och har en vilja att hålla dig uppdaterad med vad som händer inom teknikområdet. För att trivas hos oss bör du vara en teamplayer, nyfiken och resultatinriktad. Hos oss händer det saker ständigt, så det är bra om du gillar högt tempo och snabba beslut. Utöver det tror vi du har ett stort mått av prestigelöshet.
Du erbjuds
Som konsult hos oss kommer du att få arbeta med förädling, vidareutveckling och modernisering av våra kunders mest affärskritiska system. Vi är ett väl positionerat bolag med en unik kombination av kompetens som ger oss strategiska och intressanta uppdrag hos våra kunder. Hos oss får du en spännande och varierande framtid där du själv i hög grad kan påverka din utveckling och ditt resultat.
Ansökan
Uppdraget är ett heltidsuppdrag som löper under fyra år med stor chans till vidare anställning. Vi erbjuder goda anställningsvillkor och förmåner. Vi värnar om kompetensen hos våra medarbetare och eftersträvar mångfald.
Har du några frågor angående tjänsten är du alltid välkommen att kontakta: 
Johanna Hasselmark
johanna.hasselmark@apper.se
031-10 70 70
Låter det här intressant? Skicka då in din ansökan redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
Din ansökan skickar du till jobs@apper.se

Testingenjör till Apper i Helsingborg
6 oktober, 2022/i Apper, Jobb, Nyheter, RPG/av Helen
Vi gör varandra bättre – Framgång bygger på samarbete. Vi på Apper skapar digitala möjligheter och långsiktigt värde för våra kunders affärer. Med strategisk förmåga, kreativitet och passion för teknik bygger vi framtidens lösningar idag.
Tillsammans är vi ett team på sjuttio digitala specialister placerade i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg och Norge som är helt övertygade om att ny teknik, nya verktyg och lösningar skapar konkurrensfördelar för våra kunder. Det vi också vet är att utvecklingstakten på den globala marknaden är högre än någonsin vilket gör att kontinuerlig utveckling av affär och verksamhet är essentiell för att lyckas möta våra kunders och deras kunders framtida krav och behov.
Vi är på en spännande utvecklingsresa och kommer att utöka vårt team i Helsingborg med en testare som kommer att arbeta med mjukvarutest och testautomation. Vi söker dig med relevant utbildningsbakgrund samt några års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha jobbat med mjukvarutestning och testautomatisering. Du kommer att ingå i ett team som präglas av ett agilt arbetssätt, ett nära samarbete och ett öppet och trevligt arbetsklimat. På Apper i Helsingborg jobbar du från ett modernt kontor med hög trivselfaktor och möjlighet till flexibilitet.
Din profil
Du är social, flexibel och analytisk. Du tar ansvar, är noggrann och detaljerad samt kan arbeta både självständigt och i grupp. Vi uppskattar att du är engagerad och tar egna initiativ och kommer med förslag och idéer.
Din vardag
Utvecklingsmiljön är baserad på IBM i och vi arbetar främst i RPG och PLEX. Vi arbetar i Jira för utveckling och förvaltning och strävar efter ett DevOps arbetssätt. Dina primära arbetsuppgifter kommer vara:
Arbeta nära utvecklare och beställare för att ta fram testfall för respektive ändring.
Avgöra vilka tester som bör automatiseras och ta fram testfall för dessa.
Förbättra arbetssätt och driva förändringar.
Följa upp och agera på testresultaten och hjälpa till med prioritering av defekter.
Ansvara för att planerade tester exekveras, både manuella och automatiserade.
Dokumentera testfall, testunderlag och annan testrelaterad information som kan återanvändas.
Ta fram testdata och dokumentera hur den togs fram.
Ha en dialog med utvecklarna om när leveranser ska göras till de olika testmiljöerna och att det kommuniceras till berörda.
Koordinera acceptanstester och genom att boka tid, meddela vad som går att testa, ta fram testdata och inloggningsmöjligheter.
Identifiera förbättringsområden och dela kunskap inom teamet, andra team och andra intressenter.
Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som är en positiv person och som alltid sätter kunden i fokus. Du bör ha en god förståelse för IT-relaterade uppgifter samt besitta egenskapen av att snabbt kunna ta in ny information. För att trivas hos oss bör du vara en teamplayer, nyfiken och resultatinriktad. Hos oss händer det saker ständigt, så det är bra om du gillar högt tempo och snabba beslut. Utöver det tror vi du har ett stort mått av prestigelöshet.
Du erbjuds
Vi erbjuder goda anställningsvillkor och förmåner. Vi värnar om kompetensen hos våra medarbetare och eftersträvar mångfald. Tjänsten är tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Hos oss får du en spännande och varierande framtid där du själv i hög grad kan påverka din utveckling och ditt resultat.
Ansökan
Vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan, inkluderande CV, så snart som möjligt till malin.andersson@apper.se
Har du några frågor angående tjänsten är du alltid välkommen att kontakta:
Malin Andersson | Regionchef Helsingborg | 031-10 70 70 (växel)

Tillsammans är vi ett team på sjuttio digitala specialister placerade i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg och Norge som är helt övertygade om att ny teknik, nya verktyg och lösningar skapar konkurrensfördelar för våra kunder. Vill du ta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med oss? Vi kan nu erbjuda en spännande tjänst inom RPG-utveckling hos oss i Helsingborg, där du kommer att få arbeta med hela utvecklingsprocessen, från behov till implementation. Du kommer att ingå i ett team som präglas av ett agilt arbetssätt, ett nära samarbete och ett öppet och trevligt arbetsklimat. På Apper i Helsingborg jobbar du från ett modernt kontor med hög trivselfaktor och möjlighet till flexibilitet. Tillit och ömsesidigt förtroende är en självklar utgångspunkt.
Din profil
För att lyckas i rollen så tror vi att du har ungefär 3–10 års utvecklingserfarenhet inom RPG samt IBM i-miljö. Är du lyhörd och prestigelös med ett samarbetsorienterat arbetssätt är du helt rätt person för oss. Har du dessutom en bakgrund inom bank/finans/försäkring så är det ett extra plus. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av JavaScript, C# eller .Net.
Personliga egenskaper
Vi söker dig som är en positiv person och som alltid sätter kunden i fokus. Du bör ha en god förståelse för IT-relaterade uppgifter samt besitta egenskapen av att snabbt kunna ta in ny information.
Som person har du ett stort intresse för ditt arbete och har en vilja att hålla dig uppdaterad med vad som händer inom teknikområdet. För att trivas hos oss bör du vara en teamplayer, nyfiken och resultatinriktad. Hos oss händer det saker ständigt, så det är bra om du gillar högt tempo och snabba beslut. Utöver det tror vi du har ett stort mått av prestigelöshet.

Som konsult hos oss kommer du att få arbeta med förädling, vidareutveckling och modernisering av våra kunders mest affärskritiska system. Vi är ett väl positionerat bolag med en unik kombination av kompetens som ger oss strategiska och intressanta uppdrag hos våra kunder. Hos oss får du en spännande och varierande framtid där du själv i hög grad kan påverka din utveckling och ditt resultat.
