Become part of TECHNIA’s international team in Žilina, helping customers succeed while enjoying a strong team culture and opportunities for growth.
 Apply for this job
At TECHNIA, we simplify product innovation with smart solutions that speed up time to market. Our expertize helps companies stay competitive by making processes efficient and transparent. In other words, we ensure our customers can bring smarter products to market faster.
About the role
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology and building strong client relationships? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your ambition can drive real impact? If so, we want you to join our team as a Sales Representative!
Key responsibilities
Develop new business opportunities for TECHNIA Slovakia, primarily related to consulting services in Dassault Systèmes portfolio and TECHNIA software.
Identify and approach potential customers in target industries such as Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, Industrial Equipment and Manufacturing.
Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation and qualification to proposal, negotiation and closing.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
Understand customer business and engineering challenges and translate them into relevant TECHNIA solutions together with technical experts.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, opportunities and forecasts in Salesforce.
Coordinate customer meetings, demonstrations, workshops and commercial proposals with consultants, technical sales and software teams.
Develop relationships with Dassault Systèmes and other partners to generate and progress joint opportunities.
Contribute to sales campaigns, events and other business-development activities in Slovakia and selected international markets.
Work towards agreed revenue, gross profit and new-business targets
Requirements
We believe you are a driven, results-oriented professional who is passionate about supporting customers and helping them achieve their goals. You have most probably around 1-3 years of experience in Sales or Business Development.
Understanding of SaaS and software solutions
Negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
Fluent in Slovak and English
Driving license
Why you should join us
You will join an international organization and a fantastic team based in our Žilina office. We are proud of our open, collaborative culture and the strong sense of community we have built together. In addition to working on exciting projects, we regularly come together for social events, outdoor activities, and celebrations throughout the year, creating a workplace where people genuinely enjoy spending time together. You will have a compensation package consisting of a fixed part and variable part linked to the results. The minimal fixed pay is 1800 Euro gross per month + the variable part linked to the sales results. 
TECHNIA has a Diverse and inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability, or age.
We look forward to your application!

Nova växer. Vill du växa med oss?
 Det här är något för mig
Har du god kunskap om Nova och trivs med att hjälpa andra att få ut mer av systemet? Är du pedagogisk, lösningsorienterad och nyfiken på hur teknik kan förenkla kundernas vardag? Då är rollen som Produktspecialist hos oss på Sokigo något för dig.
Vi söker nu en Produktspecialist till Nova, vårt systemstöd för ärendehantering som används av många av Sveriges kommuner, bland annat inom bygglov. Du blir en del av teamet som hjälper våra kunder att använda och utveckla Nova utifrån sina behov och arbetssätt.
Om rollen
Som Produktspecialist arbetar du nära våra kunder och hjälper dem att få största möjliga nytta av Nova. Du vägleder och utbildar användare, svarar på frågor och hjälper kunder att hitta smartare och mer effektiva sätt att arbeta i systemet.
Du håller utbildningar för såväl enskilda användare som större grupper och tar dig an mindre konsultuppdrag där du hjälper kunden att utveckla sina arbetssätt och processer. Du fungerar även som ett stöd till vår support i frågor som kräver djupare kunskap om Nova.
Rollen befinner sig i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, teknik och kund och passar dig som tycker om att förstå både hur ett system fungerar och hur det kan skapa värde i kundens vardag.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
Utbilda och vägleda kunder i användningen av Nova.
Ge råd kring hur systemet kan användas för att stödja och effektivisera kundens arbetssätt.
Genomföra mindre konsultuppdrag kopplade till kundernas processer och användning av Nova.
Vara ett stöd till supporten i mer komplexa frågor som kräver fördjupad systemkunskap.
Bidra med kunskap och erfarenheter från kunddialoger till teamets fortsatta arbete och utveckling.
Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som har mycket god förståelse för Nova och egen erfarenhet av att arbeta i systemet. Du har lätt för att sätta dig in i olika verksamheters behov och tycker om att hjälpa andra att hitta lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:
Är pedagogisk och kommunikativ och kan göra system och funktioner begripliga för olika typer av användare.
Är serviceinriktad och lösningsorienterad med ett genuint intresse för kundens behov.
Är strukturerad och tar ansvar för att driva dina uppgifter framåt.
Är nyfiken på teknik och vill förstå hur system, processer och verksamhet hänger ihop.
Är flexibel och trivs i en roll där behoven och arbetsuppgifterna kan variera.
Är relationsskapande och uppskattar att arbeta nära både kunder och kollegor.
Kvalifikationer
Mycket god kunskap om Nova, byggd på egen erfarenhet av att arbeta i systemet.
Intresse för teknik och en vilja att förstå hur olika system och lösningar hänger ihop.
Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, både i tal och skrift.
Om Sokigo
Sokigo är Sveriges största leverantör av systemlösningar för den kommunala marknaden. Vi är ett ambitiöst företag som brinner för långvariga relationer och att skapa lönsamhet för våra kunder. Som anställd hos oss får du ta del av ett brett utbud av förmåner, som generöst friskvårdsbidrag och sjukvårdsförsäkring. Du får jobba med över 250 trevliga och engagerade arbetskamrater.
Sokigo är en del av det moderna och hållbara arbetslivet – vi har en positiv inställning till hybridarbete hemifrån och kontoret, där vi möts åtminstone tre dagar per vecka.
Sokigo är en del av koncernen Addnode Group.
Bra att veta
Övrigt
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Placeringsorten för denna tjänst avser vårt kontor i Sundbyberg, men även andra orter där Sokigo har kontor kan komma i fråga för rätt person.
Urval sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan snarast.
Som rutin utför vi alltid bakgrundskontroll på tilltänkta kandidater.
För att skapa en rättvis och träffsäker rekryteringsprocess, använder vi oss utav personlighets- och kapacitetstester vid vårt urval.
Arbetsprov kan förekomma. Vi undanber oss kontakt med rekryteringsföretag.
Vill du veta mer?
Om rollen: Anna.tell@sokigo.com
Om processen: simon.weidenberg@sokigo.com

Hos oss blir du en del av ett framgångsrikt IT-produktföretag med stark laganda, korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att utvecklas. Vår produktfamilj iipax bidrar till digitalisering av samhällsviktiga verksamheter och används bland annat för säkert informationsutbyte, ärendehantering och hållbar e-arkivering.
Om rollen
Som IT Operations Specialist har du en viktig roll i att installera, konfigurera vår produkt, uppgradera och administrera iipax case för våra kunder. Du arbetar både med kunder som har SaaS-lösningar och kunder med installationer i egen miljö.
Rollen innebär att du bidrar till att de tekniska miljöerna där iipax körs är tillförlitliga, säkra och effektiva. Du arbetar nära kunder, interna team och andra tekniska specialister för att lösa problem, förbättra arbetssätt och skapa långsiktigt stabila leveranser.
Du får ett varierat arbete där du både hanterar planerade tekniska aktiviteter, felsöker vid behov och bidrar med rådgivning kring kundernas IT-drift. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du gillar att ta ansvar, arbetar strukturerat och har lätt för att samarbeta med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära roller.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
installera, uppgradera, konfigurera och optimera iipax case för våra kunder
felsöka iipax och den omgivande IT-miljön
ge teknisk support och vägledning till kunder, användare och interna team
bidra med teknisk rådgivning kring kunders IT-drift
dokumentera systemkonfigurationer, förändringar och genomförda åtgärder
samarbeta nära utvecklingsteam, plattformstjänster och andra nyckelroller
bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av arbetssätt, leveranser och tekniska miljöer.
Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som har en högskoleutbildning inom relevant område och något års arbetserfarenhet. Du har ett starkt tekniskt intresse, och trivs i en roll där du kombinerar praktiskt tekniskt arbete med kundkontakt och samarbete. Du är lösningsorienterad, kommunikativ och har förmåga att självständigt driva och koordinera dina arbetsuppgifter.
Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av eller intresse för flera av följande områden:
Erfarenhet av Linux-baserade miljöer, on-prem och/eller SaaS
IT-drift, installation, konfiguration och teknisk förvaltning
servrar, nätverk och databaser
applikationsdrift och felsökning
felsökning av integrationer och kommunikationsflöden, exempelvis e-post till och från systemet via olika e-postservrar
övervakning, backup och återställning
säkerhet och informationssäkerhet
certifikat och PKI
autentisering och behörighetslösningar
dokumentation och strukturerade arbetssätt.
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av iipax eller andra system för ärendehantering eller verksamhetskritiska lösningar inom offentlig sektor. Det är även meriterande med erfarenhet av olika tekniker så som MySQL, Oracle, MSSQL och SOLR.
Du behöver ha mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på både svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift, eftersom rollen innebär nära dialog med kunder, kollegor och andra samarbetspartners.
Du har svenskt medborgarskap, vilket krävs för att arbeta i våra säkerhetsklassade projekt.
För att lyckas i rollen är du:
strukturerad och ansvarstagande
serviceinriktad och kundorienterad
lösningsfokuserad och analytisk
trygg i att kommunicera med både kunder och kollegor
van att samarbeta, men också bekväm med att ta eget ansvar
intresserad av kontinuerlig förbättring och kvalitet i leverans
medveten om vikten av säkerhet i tekniska miljöer.
Vad vi erbjuder
Hos Ida Infront får du arbeta med produkter och lösningar som gör konkret samhällsnytta. Vi utvecklar och levererar iipax – en produktfamilj som stödjer digitala myndighetsprocesser, säker informationshantering och effektiv ärendehantering.
Du blir en del av ett värderingsstyrt företag med engagerade kollegor, stabil kundbas och stark produktkompetens. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare, kunskapsdelning och kompetensutveckling. Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och bidra till framtidens digitala samhälle.
Du kommer att tillhöra ett team där samarbete, ansvar och nyfikenhet är viktigt. Rollen kan utgå från något av våra kontor i Linköping eller Stockholm, med möjlighet till distansarbete enligt vår distansarbetspolicy.
Om Ida Infront
Vi arbetar med digitalisering av samhället så vill du vara en viktig kugge i verksamheten och arbeta med att utveckla stora samhällsviktiga system, så kan det här vara en möjlighet för dig! Vår produktfamilj iipax möjliggör bland annat ett passfritt Europa, e-deklarationer och effektiva dna-analyser.
Det finns många fördelar med att arbeta hos oss. Här blir du en del av ett framgångsrikt IT-produktföretag med platt organisation och stabil kundbas. Vi är verkligen stolta över den samhällsnytta våra system bidrar till. Vi är också ett värderingsstyrt företag med stark laganda, en familjär atmosfär och vi satsar på att ge våra medarbetare goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling.  
Ansökan 
Ida Infront anser att mångfald berikar verksamheten och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, kön, erfarenhet samt personliga egenskaper. 
Urvalet sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan. 
Vid frågor om jobbet eller oss, kontakta Marie Pilsmo, marie.pilsmo@idainfront.se

Job description:
Atom.com is seeking a Strategic Alliance Coordinator to build and scale our partner network from the ground up. This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced partnerships professional who has successfully taken a partnerships program from zero to scale and possesses the relationships and strategic instincts to replicate that success.
We are specifically seeking candidates deeply embedded in the AI startup ecosystem. You know the builders, founders, and key tools, understand how AI companies approach naming, branding, and domains, and can speak their language with authority.
What You’ll Do
Own the Partnerships Function: Drive the end-to-end strategy, outreach, negotiation, and execution of Atom’s ecosystem program.
Expand Key Networks: Identify and build strategic relationships with AI startups, developer tools, accelerators, incubators, venture funds, and founder communities.
Drive Business Impact: Architect and scale a high-yield partner program that generates measurable revenue growth and expands brand presence.
Execute Co-Marketing & Distribution: Develop multi-channel referral programs, integration opportunities, and co-marketing initiatives with key ecosystem partners.
Serve as Atom’s Ambassador: Represent Atom in relevant founder communities, industry events, and strategic conversations.
Build Scalable Infrastructure: Design the operational systems, tools, and processes required to transform standalone partnerships into a repeatable growth engine.
What We’re Looking For
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience scaling a partnerships or ecosystem program from initial concept to high-impact output.
Established AI Network: Deep, existing relationships within the AI ecosystem including founders, operators, investors, and community leaders.
Self-Starter Mindset: Proactive ability to independently open doors and create high-value opportunities rather than simply managing existing accounts.
Strong Communicator: Clear, confident communication and negotiation skills capable of representing Atom at a senior level.
Builder Orientation: Highly comfortable operating as the founding member of this function, combining strategy with hands-on execution.
Startup/Marketplace Experience: Background in a fast-paced marketplace or high-growth startup environment is strongly preferred.
About Atom
Atom.com is an AI-first domain marketplace and ICANN-accredited registrar helping entrepreneurs discover, evaluate, and secure the right domain. Atom combines millions of domains with AI-powered discovery that matches names based on meaning, positioning, style, and brand potential.
Its marketing campaigns generate more than 85 million impressions across Google, Meta, X, LinkedIn, and ChatGPT, bringing domain inventory in front of entrepreneurs searching for their next brand. For domain investors, Atom offers a curated marketplace, AI-powered appraisals, lease-to-own and rental options, and broad distribution through registrar and marketplace partners. Its MCP server also enables AI assistants and agents to discover and recommend domains directly.
Atom serves more than 100,000 startups and businesses and has been named to the Inc. 5000 list five times.

Hos Sokigo brinner vi för att ge våra kunder riktigt bra support varje dag. Nu söker vi en produktspecialist som vill vara med och utveckla kundupplevelsen ytterligare - och som drivs av att verkligen göra skillnad i vardagen.
Vem är du?
Du trivs i nära kontakt med kunder och motiveras av att se hur dina insatser skapar verklig nytta. Du har lätt att samarbeta, tar ansvar för det du åtar dig och kommunicerar tydligt med såväl kunder som kollegor. Vi tror att du är resultatorienterad, lösningsfokuserad och har en känsla för service.
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du:
Gillar felsökning, analys och problemlösning och ser det som ett detektivarbete att hitta orsaker
Är nyfiken, snabblärd och orädd för att testa dig fram
Trivs med att ha direkt kundkontakt och uttrycker dig väl på svenska i både tal och skrift
Erfarenhet av e‑tjänsteplattformar, Python och breda IT‑kunskaper eller vana från olika systemmiljöer är meriterande.
Om rollen
Som produktspecialist blir du en central del av supportteamet där du tillsammans med 29 kollegor arbetar för att leverera service i toppklass. Rollen är både teknisk och kommunikativ, och du kommer ha stort inflytande på hur våra kunder upplever stödet från Sokigo. 
Eftersom arbetet innebär både kundkontakt och utbildningsansvar behöver du kunna formulera dig obehindrat på svenska, både i tal och skrift. Därför ser vi också att din ansökan är skriven på svenska.
Dina arbetsuppgifter
I ditt arbete kommer du bland annat att:
Ge kvalificerat stöd för våra egenutvecklade lösningar, Abou och Minutprodukterna
Felsöka och lösa problem i nära dialog med kunder via telefon, ärendehanteringssystem och fjärruppkoppling
Ansluta till kunders servrar via olika typer av VPN‑lösningar för analys och problemlösning
Sätta dig in i kundernas processer och konfigurationer för att säkerställa att våra lösningar används optimalt
Arbeta i komplexa system där frågorna varierar från dag till dag
Det här är ett omväxlande och utvecklande jobb där du får lära dig något nytt nästan varje vecka.
Låter det som en roll för dig? Sök jobbet som produktspecialist hos oss på Sokigo!

Sokigo är Sveriges största leverantör av systemlösningar för den kommunala marknaden. Vi är ett ambitiöst företag som brinner för långvariga relationer och att skapa lönsamhet för våra kunder. Som anställd hos oss får du kompetensutveckling, friskvårdsbidrag och andra förmåner. Du får jobba med 250 trevliga och engagerade arbetskamrater. Sokigo är en del av koncernen Addnode Group.
Vi är en del av det moderna och hållbara arbetslivet – Sokigo har en positiv inställning till hybridarbete hemifrån och kontoret, på vilket vi möts åtminstone tre dagar per vecka.
Vi erbjuder
Hos oss får du mer än bara ett jobb – du blir en del av en kultur där samarbete, utveckling och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder korta beslutsvägar, frihet under ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och processer. Vi tror på att bra resultat skapas av team där man stöttar varandra och delar kunskap.
Övrigt
Tjänsten är en heltidsanställning med placering i Sundbyberg. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Configure, administer, and troubleshoot SQL Server Always on Availability Groups (AON AG), Distributed Availability Groups (DAGs), clustering, disaster recovery, backup, and restore solutions.
Implement and maintain least-privilege security models, user access controls, and SQL Server security best practices.
Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain Oracle databases.
Design and maintain HA/DR solutions using technologies such as Oracle RAC and Data Guard.
Configure and manage Oracle RMAN backup and recovery processes.
Apply Oracle Release Updates and security patches within organizational SLAs.
Configure proactive database monitoring and alerting. Troubleshoot database outages and production incidents.
Execute and validate automation workflows through Ansible Controller, including running and monitoring job templates.
Support cloud-hosted database environments across AWS and Azure, with the ability to identify and work with:
AWS EC2 instances
Amazon RDS databases
Azure IaaS virtual machines
Azure PaaS database services
Trigger and troubleshoot Terraform deployments, with the ability to analyze deployment failures and coordinate resolution.
Develop, enhance, debug, and test automation scripts using PowerShell and YAML.
Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to implement automation and operational improvements.
Utilize monitoring and observability platforms such as ServiceNow, SolveIT, and related operational tools for incident management, alerting, and troubleshooting.
 ##LI-DNI 
Experience supporting enterprise-scale, highly available SQL Server & Oracle environments.
Exposure to Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud automation frameworks.
Cloud certifications (AWS or Azure) and Microsoft SQL/Oracle certifications are a plus.

TECHNIA ist ein multinationaler Anbieter von digitaler Engineering Software, Dienstleistungen und Beratung. TECHNIA hat seinen Hauptsitz in Stockholm, Schweden, und beschäftigt über 600 Mitarbeiter an mehr als 30 Standorten.
Dein Aufgabenbereich
Du konzipierst, implementierst und betreust IT-Systeme und Netzwerke in einem lokalen sowie globalen Team mit Fokus auf der Netzwerk- und Firewall-Administration.
Du installierst, konfigurierst und verwaltest Hard- und Software.
Du stellst die IT- und Datensicherheit sicher, insbesondere durch die Durchführung und Überwachung von Backups.
Du bearbeitest interne IT-Service-Tickets, analysierst Fehler und sorgst für eine nachhaltige Behebung der Fehler.
Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst bestehende IT-Prozesse sowie Systemlandschaften kontinuierlich weiter.
Deine Qualifikationen
Du verfügst über eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker (w/m/d) für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Infrastruktur- oder Systemadministrationsumfeld mit.
Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in der Administration von Netzwerken und Firewalls sowie im Umgang mit Microsoft 365 und VMware.
Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert und überzeugst durch Teamgeist sowie eine hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung.
Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Unser Angebot
Es erwarten dich herausfordernde Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen in einem zukunftsorientierten IT-Umfeld.
Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben – bei uns warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle auf dich mit der Möglichkeit des Mobilen Arbeitens.
Natürlich bieten wir auch kostenlose Getränke (Tee, Kaffee, Wasser).
Wir pflegen eine offene Unternehmens- und Duz-Kultur mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
Auf dem Sommerfest und auf der Weihnachtsfeier feiern wir gemeinsam unsere Erfolge.
TECHNIA hat ein diverses und inklusives Umfeld. Wir suchen qualifizierte Bewerber/innen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Rasse, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Description
ADP is hiring a Threat Detection Engineer
 In this role, you will work with Global Security teams from Critical Incident Response Center (CIRC), Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Red Team, and AppDev, to create and drive threat detection to protect ADP assets.
You will help lead efforts to design/define/create requirements to develop prevention, detection, and response capabilities within ADP Cyber security platforms.
You will collaborate with other Detection Engineers to design, build & maintain cyber alert catalogs.
You are keen on promoting the use of innovative new technology and best practices for evolving security objectives.
You can present your ideas clearly, professionally on paper, in person, on video calls, and over the phone.
You have solid experience analyzing and defining solutions, maintaining and enhancing existing solutions, and participating in the delivery of projects.
You enjoy brainstorming new concepts and collaborating with your team members.
You can work with partners in IT, Ops, and Engineering to provide support for troubleshooting Production issues.
Our best engineers are enthusiastic creators who stay current on new ways of optimizing threat detections and processes and enhancing business intelligence automation. They are always looking for new ways to improve detection quality. 
To thrive as a threat detection engineer, you'll need to enjoy SOAR Development and coding in Python and SQL.
You'll need an understanding of leveraging APIs to pull and push data from different data sources to update records in the SOAR platform.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Here's what you can expect on a typical day in the life of a Threat Detection Engineer at ADP. 
Develop advanced alerting capabilities based on threat intelligence, post-incident findings, new threats, and vulnerabilities.
Maintain an expert-level understanding of attacks, vectors, and emergent threats.
Develop new detection for our SOAR platform based on specific requests from stakeholders, threat intelligence, threat hunting, or purple exercise.
Collaborate regularly with our CIRC and threat management to understand their requirements and needs.
Experience with creating and implementing content in EDR, NDR, and SOAR.
Stay updated with the latest threats and familiar with APT and common TTPs to integrate knowledge into new detections.
Contribute to the development and updating of SOPs.
Ability to provide content on deliverables, including written reports and technical documents, SOPs and configuration guides, and training and briefing materials.
Work closely with the CIRC, Threat management team, and engineering teams to improve and build new tailored security detections.
Analyze CIRC alert statistics and workflows to reduce false positives and properly focus engineering efforts.
Provide design support on ways to improve detection and response capabilities.
Provide backup support to the CIRC team when necessary.
Help mature CIRC playbooks, workflow automation, and use cases to protect ADP assets.
Build detection logic utilizing security logs to detect malicious activity with high fidelity across a broad set of detection cyber use cases.
Act as a subject matter expert in multiple areas: security log signals from Linux, macOS, Windows, EDR, NDR, and cloud.
Qualifications:
2 years+ experience in threat detection or threat hunting
Strong analytical skills and cross-functional knowledge across multiple security disciplines.
Strong interpersonal, verbal presentation, and written communication skills.
Strong knowledge and working experience with databases and data warehouse technologies and solutions.
Strong working experience with systems automation in a major scripting language (Python, PowerShell).
Strong experience building detection logic utilizing security logs to detect malicious activity with high fidelity across a broad set of detection use cases.
Strong project/program management experience.
Working experience with one or more cloud providers, such as Amazon Web Servicesor Microsoft Azure.
Familiar with interpreting the log output of a wide selection of network and host device classes(HIDS, NIDS, Firewalls, Proxies, Routers, Switches, WAFs, Servers, Desktop Controls, Endpoint Protection, etc.).
Functional experience with text and data representation and manipulation (XML, HTML, Regular Expressions, JSON, REST, SQL).
Packet-level behavioral familiarity with most major TCP/IP application protocols ( DNS, SMTP, HTTP, BGP, LDAP, IMAP, SSH, FTP, KRB5, DHCP, CIFS).
Experience working with SIEMand SOAR
Creative thinker that leverages unconventional and innovative ideas to solve problems.
Ability to communicate security-related concepts to a broad range of technical and non-technical staff.
Must possess a high degree of integrity, be trustworthy, and have the ability to work independently.

Examensarbete inom Autonom skogsplantering
Examensarbete inom Autonom skogsplantering
 oktober 18, 2022 
Är du i slutet av din utbildning inom datateknik, IT, inbyggda system, mekatronik, teknisk fysik eller liknande och letar efter examensarbete till våren? Leta inte längre! BIT ADDICT är ett ingenjörs- och konsultbolag med huvudkontor i Göteborg. Vi på BIT ADDICT älskar teknik och att utvecklas som problemlösare. Just nu söker vi dig som skall skriva ditt exjobb och har ett gediget intresse för mjukvaruutveckling, bildbehandling, och/eller matematik. 
Uppgiftsbeskrivning
I projektet BraSatt, som drivs av Södra Skogsägarna, utvecklas ett fordon för att autonomt plantera gran- och tallplantor som en del i framtidens hållbara skogsbruk. BIT ADDICT ansvarar för fordonets styrsystem, för autonom navigation och perception. I dagsläget sker plantering oftast i två steg: maskinell markberedning följt av manuell plantering. Den maskinella markberedningen ökar plantornas chans till överlevnad, men är energikrävande och åsamkar skogsmarken skada. Den manuella planteringsprocessen är skonsam, men förlitar sig på planterarens kompetens och tillgång till arbetskraft. I BraSatt vävs de två stegen samman till ett: en relativt liten skogsmaskin navigerar autonomt runt på ett kalhygge för att markbereda och plantera i ett kombinerat steg. De potentiella vinsterna för miljö och ekonomi är stora, men kräver teknisk innovation på många fronter för att realiseras.
Om examensarbetet:
Computer Vision för evaluering av trädplantering
Skogsmaskinen väljer en planteringspunkt med hjälp av en stereokamera och utför sedan planteringen autonomt. Från en bild på plantan och marken efter planteringstillfället vill vi undersöka huruvida det är möjligt att med Computer Vision bedöma hur väl planteringen utförts. Ett första steg är att bekräfta att en planta faktiskt planterats på den valda punkten. Vidare kan plantans orientering, analys av jorden den planteras i samt närområdets karakteristik vara intressanta parametrar att identifiera. Relevanta förkunskaper: Computer Vision och Maskininlärning.
Publik information om projektet BraSatt:

https://iskogen.se/skogsbruk/andra-chansen-for-planteringsmaskiner/

Vilka är BIT ADDICT?
BIT ADDICT är ett ingenjörs- och konsultbolag med fokus på att möjliggöra innovation åt kunder som är ledande inom sina respektive branscher. Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Göteborg. 
Vi erbjuder anpassade utvecklingsprojekt och konsulter inom följande specialistområden:
Beräkningsmjukvara
Sensorik & Styrsystem
AI & Maskininlärning
Vår specialitet är att snabbt och säkert ta oss fram i outforskad teknisk terräng. Kunderna vänder sig till oss på grund av vår förmåga att konsekvent och effektivt skapa innovativa tekniklösningar oavsett bransch, tillämpning och teknikområde.
Kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som studerar till civilingenjör inom datateknik, IT, inbyggda system, mekatronik, teknisk fysik eller liknande. 
Relevanta förkunskaper inkluderar:
God programmeringskunskap inom C#, C/C++, Python, eller liknande.
Bekväm i Linux-miljö och med Git.
Kan arbeta med sensorer, mikrokontrollers (t.ex. Arduino), etc.
Intresse för fältexperiment.
Formalia
Omfattning: Fulltakt, 30 Hp
Antal personer: 1-2 
Start: Januari 2023 eller enligt överenskommelse. 
Arvode: Ja
Ansökningsprocess
Intresserad? Skicka in en ansökan redan idag. Intervjuer sker löpande. Du kan ansöka till oss antingen individuellt eller i par. Söker ni i par vill vi gärna ha endast en ansökan med all information. Ansökan sker genom att skicka CV, personligt brev och betyg till veronica.lilja@bitaddict.se

Engineering is where we build and fine-tune the systems and technologies that keep us ahead. Join us here and you could work on anything from our network infrastructure to our software solutions, ensuring outstanding performance, reliability, and constant innovation across our tech landscape.
Explore our roles
As a Customer Support Technician, you will be working in the field day-to-day and have direct exposure to our customers. Working on customer sites every day means you’ll need to be prepared to travel around, but that’s part of the fun! You get to see our technology being used in lots of different, innovative ways, and you get to be part of it. You will attend customer sites to help with installations where engineering support is required to set-up, install, and carry out non-complex and simple repairs.
Business unit: BT Business
Location: Exeter, Plymouth, Reading and Sunbury
Duration: 18 months
Qualification: Level 3 qualification in Information Communication
On this apprenticeship you’ll be working alongside experienced engineers to help design, build and support the networks that keep the UK connected. You’ll contribute to testing, troubleshooting and improving network performance, as well as supporting the introduction of new technologies. It’s a great opportunity to see how advanced networks operate and play a part in keeping millions of people and services connected.
Business unit: Networks
Location: Ipswich
Duration: 51 months
Qualification: Level 6 Digital & Technology Solutions Professional apprenticeship with a specialism in Network Engineering
 Apply now to Engineering apprentice roles
Our application process
First, we'll ask you to tell us a bit about yourself. Just some basic information about your qualifications and so on. This stage of the process will take you around 20 minutes to complete, and we will ask for you to upload your right to work and qualification documents, so have those on hand ready!
If you think you might need support during the application process, you can let us know at this point too, and we'll be happy to make any reasonable adjustments.
For the second stage, you’ll sit an untimed online assessment which has been designed to understand your potential and approach to learning and working.
Part of this will require text responses to 5 different scenario-based and experience-based questions. You will answer the questions by typing your responses, and can amend your answers before submitted. As there are no time limits, you can make sure you are happy with your answers before pressing submit.
This assessment will also consist of 1 video-based question where you will need to record yourself. This will be focused around asking you situational and motivational questions.
You will have a total of 5 days to complete this assessment, and we expect it to take a total of 30 minutes/hours to complete.
Depending on the type of role that you’ve applied for will determine what the final application stage looks like.
For all office-based roles, you will complete an assessment event at the location you've applied to. This is likely to include a group discussion, a competency-based interview and depending on the role, a technical test.
For field-based apprenticeships i.e. Customer Support Engineers, you will complete a face-to-face or a virtual competency-based interview 
We aim to let you know whether you have been successful following the final stage of the process within 2 weeks. All applicants will be given comprehensive feedback at this stage.

You’ll work alongside experienced professionals, applying your software engineering and cloud expertise to deliver scalable and business-driven AI solutions. Deploy, monitor, and maintain ML systems in production (MLOps)
Design solutions that balance technical feasibility and business value
Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, and data platforms
What we’re looking for
3-5+ years of experience in software or data applications with an AI/ML focus
Interest or hands-on experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)
Experience in cloud development, preferably in Azure
Strong or growing skills in Python and modern software engineering practices (e.g. Git, CI/CD)
Experience with, or motivation to learn, MLOps and/or AIOps and bringing ML and AI systems into production
Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and SQL
A structured approach to problem-solving that balances technical feasibility with business needs
Fluent Finnish and English skills, written and spoken
Educational background in e.g. computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or a comparable field
Nice to have
Experience or familiarity in AI governance
Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) and containerisation for reproducible, scalable environments (e.g. Terraform, Docker)
Familiarity with PyTorch, LangChain/LlamaIndex, deep learning, and LLM evaluation frameworks
Experience working with data platforms and architectures, such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, event streams, or data warehouses
Background in structured testing methodologies to ensure solution reliability
Experience working in consulting environments, with the ability to collaborate with teams and support stakeholders
Prior leadership experience or interest in guiding others (particularly relevant at senior level)
Industry experience in sectors such as manufacturing, heavy machinery, or power generation
Why Norrin?
At Norrin, you'll join an international team of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues. 
We invest in continuous learning through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.
We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect, with psychological safety at its core. As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.
Our hybrid working model combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we offer comprehensive benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare and dental care, insurance coverage, regular massages, and culture and sports benefits. Our compensation model includes a competitive base salary, a performance-based bonus, and the opportunity to participate in an employee fund.

Explore our roles
AI is at the heart of how BT is transforming its business. On our Business Explorer: AI Expert Degree Apprenticeship, you’ll build the skills to turn data into decisions, rotating across teams working on real AI and machine learning challenges.
Location: Belfast 
Business unit: BT Business
Duration: 30 months
Qualification: Level 6 (Degree) AI/Machine Learning Engineer
 Apply now for Transformation & Delivery apprentice roles
Our application process
First, we'll ask you to tell us a bit about yourself. Just some basic information about your qualifications and so on. This stage of the process will take you around 20 minutes to complete, and we will ask for you to upload your right to work and qualification documents, so have those on hand ready!
If you think you might need support during the application process, you can let us know at this point too, and we'll be happy to make any reasonable adjustments.
For the second stage, you’ll sit an untimed online assessment which has been designed to understand your potential and approach to learning and working.
Part of this will require text responses to 5 different scenario-based and experience-based questions. You will answer the questions by typing your responses, and can amend your answers before submitted. As there are no time limits, you can make sure you are happy with your answers before pressing submit.
This assessment will also consist of 1 video-based question where you will need to record yourself. This will be focused around asking you situational and motivational questions.
You will have a total of 5 days to complete this assessment, and we expect it to take a total of 30 minutes/hours to complete.
Depending on the type of role that you’ve applied for will determine what the final application stage looks like.
For all office-based roles, you will complete an assessment event at the location you've applied to. This is likely to include a group discussion, a competency-based interview and depending on the role, a technical test.
For field-based apprenticeships i.e. Customer Support Engineers, you will complete a face-to-face or a virtual competency-based interview 
We aim to let you know whether you have been successful following the final stage of the process within 2 weeks. All applicants will be given comprehensive feedback at this stage.

Account Executive Defence & Security
Sweden (Hybrid)
We are looking for a high-performing Account Executive to drive growth within the Defence and Security domain, with a strong focus on the Swedish market.
Work with advanced, mission‑critical technology used by Swedish and international defence organisations and take a role in shaping how modern geospatial solutions support national security.
As an Account Executive at Carmenta, you will operate at the intersection of world-leading software, operational needs, and strategic defence development, engaging directly with FMV, the Swedish Armed Forces, and the Swedish defence industry.
Location: Sweden (Stockholm or Gothenburg)
Travel: Travels within Sweden and Europe
Your role
As Account Executive – Defence & Security, you will take full commercial ownership of your market. This is a new-business-driven role where you will actively identify, pursue, and win opportunities in highly competitive defence environments.
You will:
Proactively identify and close new business opportunities within Defence and Security.
Own and drive the full sales cycle: lead generation, qualification, negotiation, and contract closure.
Build and execute market and account strategies to achieve long-term growth.
Develop customer offers, proposals, and commercial agreements.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with defence authorities, system integrators, OEMs, and partners.
Represent Carmenta at defence associations, trade fairs, and industry events.
Work closely with internal technical and product teams to shape competitive, value-driven solutions.
Your profile
You are a commercially sharp and results-driven sales professional with proven experience selling software-based solutions. You understand the value that software brings to customers and are skilled at translating technical capabilities into clear business and operational benefits.
You are comfortable working in complex defence ecosystems with long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and formal procurement processes. You are confident, persistent, and motivated by winning new business in competitive markets.
We are looking for someone with a “roll-up-your-sleeves” mindset who takes full ownership of driving sales. You will have strong internal support, but you are expected to lead and execute the work.
To succeed in this role, you need following qualifications
Required qualifications:
Proven B2B software sales experience, preferably in mission-critical or complex technical environments.
Strong understanding of software value creation and how to position software solutions commercially.
Demonstrated success selling to or within the defence industry.
Strong business development capabilities.
Experience managing long sales cycles and structured procurement processes.
University degree or equivalent professional experience.
Willingness to travel within Sweden and Europe.
Meritorious qualifications:
Experience working with the Swedish Ministry of Defence, Swedish Armed Forces and FMV.
Experience from a military environment (operational, procurement, or support roles).
Established network within defence, security, or government organisations.
What we offer
You will join a highly specialised and experienced team working with cutting-edge geospatial software used by defence and security organisations worldwide.
At Carmenta, you will:
Play a key role in expanding our presence in strategic defence markets.
Work in a highly innovative, international, and collaborative environment.
Engage with world-leading system integrators, defence authorities and technology providers.
Be trusted with high ownership and influence over your market.
Enjoy competitive employment conditions and long-term growth opportunities.
Apply here!
Please send your application and CV to employment@carmenta.com.
Please note: By submitting your application, you agree that we process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Your information will be used solely for recruitment purposes.

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
How You'll Make An Impact
As an HR Business Partner, you will drive strategic HR alignment and operational execution across our Canadian workforce and select functions within the US. In this role, you will bridge global HR strategy with locally compliant, culture-forward practices. Partnering closely with executive stakeholders and cross-functional HR teams, you will serve as a trusted advisor, supporting organizational growth, employee engagement, and business performance across borders.
This is a hybrid role based in our Vancouver office, with in-office days Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
What You'll Do
Strategic Business Partnership: Serve as the dedicated HRBP for Canadian employees and designated US functions, tailoring HR strategies to meet distinct regional and functional needs.
Organizational Effectiveness: Partner with leaders on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategies to support business expansion and evolution.
Employee Relations & Performance Management: Manage complex ER matters and performance management processes; lead sensitive investigations with confidentiality, equity, and consistency.
Compliance & Policy Governance: Ensure full compliance with Canadian federal and provincial employment laws across multi-jurisdictional teams; develop and adapt regional policies as required.
Cross-Functional HR Collaboration: Work closely with other HR functions (TA, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, Payroll, etc.) to seamlessly execute global programs, rollouts, and communications locally.
Leadership Coaching: Advise, coach, and influence managers on leadership development, performance management, attendance, and employee retention strategies.
Cross-Border Program Management: Lead the regional rollout of corporate HR initiatives, ensuring consistent execution across distributed and remote teams.
Special Projects: Contribute to global HR transformation initiatives and strategic projects as assigned.
Support broader HR team projects as needed
The Experience You Bring
Experience: 5+ years of progressive HR Business Partnering experience in a fast-paced environment, with a strong focus on employee relations, investigations, and manager coaching.
Canadian & US Employment Law: Comprehensive working knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial labor laws across multiple provinces; foundational knowledge of US employment law basics.
Sales / Revenue Support: Demonstrated experience supporting Go-To-Market or Sales teams, with familiarity around commission structure dynamics, performance management, and quota-driven environments.
Multi-Jurisdictional Scope: Proven track record of managing distributed, remote, or hybrid workforces across multiple regions simultaneously.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Bonus Points If You Have 
Professional HR certifications (CPHR, SHRM-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR).
Prior HRBP experience within the Enterprise Software, SaaS, or iPaaS sectors
Advanced degree (Master’s in HR, IR, or MBA).
Key Competencies
Strategic Influence: Ability to build credibility quickly and influence senior leaders, particularly in remote or matrixed environments.
Agility & Ambiguity: Comfort navigating complex, cross-border matrix environments with high autonomy and self-direction.
Prioritization: Strong organizational skills to manage competing priorities across a broad geographic footprint.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to deliver clear, empathetic, and compliant guidance.

Stockholm, Stockholms län, Sweden

Job description
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.
We are now looking for a Integration Engineer to strengthen our team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integration solutions that connect cloud services, enterprise systems, and business-critical applications. You will work closely with customers and internal delivery teams to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, and scalable.
The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for contributing to and shaping integration architectures that support long-term business needs. You will take an active role across the full lifecycle of integration projects, from solution design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.
In this role, you will
Design and implement API based and event driven integration solutions
Design integration solutions following Azure best practices and cloud native patterns
Build integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
Develop and maintain integrations using C# and the .NET ecosystem
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform
Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security using OAuth and best practices
Collaborate with architects, developers, and customers to design end to end integration solutions
Support deployments, monitoring, and continuous improvement of integration platforms, ensuring reliability and observability in production environments
What we’re looking for
3+ years of experience in API and integration development
Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code (tools such as Terraform)
Good understanding of OAuth authentication and API security best practices
Ability to take ownership of integration solutions and make technical decisions in customer projects
Experience with C# programming and the .NET ecosystem, particularly when building Azure Functions or custom integration components
Fluency in both Swedish and English
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
Nice to have
Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Expertise in BizTalk
Previous experience delivering or managing integrations in large organizations
Broader data engineering development experience to contribute to both integration and data projects
Why Norrin?
At Norrin, you'll join an international team of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.
We invest in continuous learning through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.
We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect, with psychological safety at its core. As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.
Could this be your next opportunity?
We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

Data & AI
Our Data & AI team turns data and artificial intelligence into powerful tools for innovation and efficiency. Dive into this field and you’ll create cutting-edge analytics solutions, machine learning models, and data insights that sharpen our decision-making and spark new growth opportunities.
Explore our roles
AI is at the heart of how BT is transforming its business. On our Business Explorer: AI Expert Degree Apprenticeship, you’ll build the skills to turn data into decisions, rotating across teams working on real AI and machine learning challenges.
Location: Belfast 
Business unit: BT Business
Duration: 30 months
Qualification: Level 6 (Degree) AI/Machine Learning Engineer
 Apply to our Data & AI roles
Our application process
First, we'll ask you to tell us a bit about yourself. Just some basic information about your qualifications and so on. This stage of the process will take you around 20 minutes to complete, and we will ask for you to upload your right to work and qualification documents, so have those on hand ready!
If you think you might need support during the application process, you can let us know at this point too, and we'll be happy to make any reasonable adjustments.
For the second stage, you’ll sit an untimed online assessment which has been designed to understand your potential and approach to learning and working.
Part of this will require text responses to 5 different scenario-based and experience-based questions. You will answer the questions by typing your responses, and can amend your answers before submitted. As there are no time limits, you can make sure you are happy with your answers before pressing submit.
This assessment will also consist of 1 video-based question where you will need to record yourself. This will be focused around asking you situational and motivational questions.
You will have a total of 5 days to complete this assessment, and we expect it to take a total of 30 minutes/hours to complete.
Depending on the type of role that you’ve applied for will determine what the final application stage looks like.

Around 2-5 years of experience in data engineering or analytics development

Understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, and integrations
Good collaboration skills and a customer-oriented mindset
Curiosity and initiative to keep learning new things and stay up to date
Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly, also to non-technical stakeholders

Your technical toolbox
Strong skills in SQL and Python/PySpark
Experience in building data pipelines and ETL processes (Databricks, Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse or similar)
Solid understanding of data security and privacy principles
Experience with dimensional modelling
Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD principles
Nice to have

Power BI reporting
Cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake
Certifications in Databricks, Azure or Microsoft Fabric

With colleagues and customers across Europe, the US, and APAC, you'll work in a truly global environment where English is the primary working language. Job Information 
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
We're looking for Cloud Engineers to join a fast-paced, constantly evolving engineering team delivering world-class secure cloud solutions that make a genuine difference to our customers.
Whether you are developing your cloud engineering career or already operating at a more experienced specialist level, you'll help build, automate and support secure cloud environments that are designed for resilience, scalability and security from day one.
Working as part of multidisciplinary delivery teams, you will contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of secure cloud platforms, automation frameworks and operational tooling. You'll collaborate closely with customers, engineers, security specialists and architects to deliver solutions that enable critical missions and support important national services.
This role offers opportunities to work across the full lifecycle of cloud delivery whilst developing expertise in cloud-native technologies, platform engineering, infrastructure-as-code, DevSecOps and secure cloud operations.
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Depending on your skills, interests and experience, you may:
•    Design, build and support secure cloud platforms and services using modern engineering and automation practices. 
•    Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code, configuration management and deployment automation to improve consistency, scalability and delivery speed. 
•    Collaborate with customers, architects, security specialists and engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver secure cloud solutions. 
•    Support the operation, monitoring and continual improvement of cloud platforms, ensuring high levels of availability, resilience and performance. 
•    Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment and operational issues, helping to identify and resolve complex technical challenges. 
•    Contribute to cloud security, risk management and compliance activities, ensuring solutions are secure by design. 
•    Share knowledge, support peer reviews and contribute to engineering standards, best practice and technical communities. 
•    Mentor and support less experienced engineers whilst contributing to the development of team capability. 
•    Evaluate emerging tools, technologies and engineering approaches that improve platform capabilities and customer outcomes.
Essential Skills / Experience
We recognise that great candidates won't necessarily meet every requirement listed below. If you're excited by the opportunity and have relevant experience in secure cloud engineering, we'd encourage you to apply.
•    Experience working with cloud platforms, particularly Amazon Web Services (AWS).
•    Experience designing, deploying, supporting or improving cloud-based infrastructure and services.
•    Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code approaches and automation tooling.
•    Understanding of cloud networking, security and operational best practices.
•    Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues within modern infrastructure environments.
•    Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
•    Strong problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset.
•    Effective communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences.
Desirable Skills / Experience
•    Experience with container technologies and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
•    Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps or DevSecOps delivery practices.
•    Knowledge of cloud security controls, compliance frameworks and secure-by-design principles.
•    Experience supporting highly available or mission-critical services.
•    Experience developing automation solutions using scripting or software development languages.
•    AWS certifications or equivalent cloud qualifications.
•    Experience mentoring colleagues or providing technical leadership within engineering teams.
•    Experience working within secure, regulated or government environments.

A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people
Competitive DV market aligned salaries
Tiered role based DV allowance of up to £5k per annum paid annually 
World-class training and development opportunities 
Jobs across multiple compass points and multiple customer frameworks giving huge potential to rotate, grow and drive your career

Equal family leave: receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It's for all parents, no matter how your family is made up. 
Enhanced women's health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more
BT pension scheme, minimum 5% employee contribution, BT contribution 10% 
New FTSE 100 standard working environments at strategic locations 
Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave 
On-call allowance (depending on role requirements) 
Access to 100's of retail discounts including the BT shop 
24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues 
25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
2 weeks paid carer's leave
Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
Enhanced life assurances of up to ten times base salary

Job description
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location.
As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll be at the heart of how our DACH customers experience Tellent. You’ll help customers get the most out of our Talent Management Suite by solving problems, answering questions, investigating issues and turning customer feedback into opportunities to improve our products and how we support them.
You’ll become a trusted expert across our products Tellent Recruitee and Tellent HR Manage, combining strong product and technical knowledge with empathy, critical thinking and AI-powered support tools. Beyond resolving individual customer questions, you’ll help us identify patterns, improve our knowledge and processes, and contribute to making Support better for both our customers and our teams.
Your 12-Month Journey
During the first 3 months: You’ll learn the Tellent products, our customers, Support processes and tools, while building confidence in handling customer conversations independently. You’ll start resolving customer questions and issues with support from your teammates and identify your first opportunities to improve how we work.
Within 6 months: You’ll work with increasing autonomy across your assigned product areas and become a trusted point of contact for our DACH customers. You’ll take ownership of more complex problems, use AI and other support tools effectively, contribute to knowledge sharing and take part in a project or improvement initiative beyond your day-to-day customer work.
After 1 year: You’ll have developed strong product and technical expertise and be able to confidently investigate and resolve a broad range of customer problems. You’ll actively share your knowledge with peers, recognise recurring customer and product patterns, and contribute to improvements across Support and the wider organisation.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own customer conversations: Provide friendly, precise and personalised support across our support channels, taking ownership of customer questions from first contact through to resolution.
Investigate & resolve problems: Use your product knowledge, technical skills, context and available tools to understand what is really happening, troubleshoot issues and identify the right resolution before escalating when needed.
Become a product expert: Build deep knowledge of Tellent’s products and use that expertise to educate customers, explain complex topics clearly and act as a voice of the customer internally.
Use AI effectively: Work with AI-powered support tools to resolve customer questions efficiently while critically reviewing AI-generated information for accuracy, relevance and customer impact. Know when AI is appropriate, when human judgement is needed and when an issue requires escalation.
Improve how we work: Identify recurring questions, product issues and opportunities for improvement. Contribute to our Help Center, internal knowledge base, AI knowledge and Support processes to make information more useful for customers, colleagues and AI.
Create impact beyond tickets: Take ownership of side projects and improvement initiatives that help develop yourself, the Support team and the wider company.
Collaboration: Work closely with fellow Support Specialists, Team Leads and our Tech Support team, as well as Product, Engineering, Customer Success and other customer-facing teams to solve problems and turn customer insights into meaningful improvements.
What You Bring
Customer support experience: Entry-level experience in customer support, customer care or another client-facing role where you’ve been responsible for solving problems, explaining technical concepts clearly and delivering a great customer experience.
Language skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills in German (minimum C1 level or higher) and English (minimum B2 level or higher).
Critical Thinking & AI: Context-driven problem solver who uses data, curiosity, and modern AI tools to find accurate solutions.
Ownership & Collaboration: Adaptable, reliable, receptive to feedback, and eager to contribute to team success.
What We Offer
Remote or hybrid working across Netherlands, Germany, and Poland
Diverse and international team environment
€1,500 annual learning budget + internal learning opportunities
Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement
28 paid holiday days + 2 wellbeing days in 2026
Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year
Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed
€200 home office budget

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).
With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.
AI in our recruitment process
We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.

Job Information
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
Passionate in cyber security, technology and solving complex problems? We'd love to hear from you.
Cyber security is constantly evolving. New technologies emerge, adversaries adapt, and the ways organisations defend themselves change continuously. That's why we're not simply looking for people to fill a single, narrowly-defined role—we're looking for curious minds who want to build their future in cyber.
Whether you're an early-career candidate exploring where your interests fit, or an experienced professional looking for your next challenge, you'll have the opportunity to develop skills across multiple cyber disciplines. You might find yourself analysing data, building software, developing investigative tradecraft, researching adversary behaviour, automating workflows, or creating new capabilities that help protect the UK's most critical organisations. 
Unlike many cyber roles that focus on a single specialism, our team bring together elements of cyber analysis, software engineering, data science, threat research and capability development. The result is varied, meaningful work that continues to evolve alongside both technology and the threat landscape. 
If you've ever been fascinated by how technology works, how cyber threats are uncovered, or how innovative tools can help solve difficult problems, there's a good chance you'll find a home here.
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Depending on your skills, interests and experience, you may:
•    Build tools and platforms that help cyber teams work more effectively.
•    Explore large and complex datasets to uncover valuable insights.
•    Develop automation and software that improves cyber operations.
•    Research emerging technologies, threats and analytical techniques.
•    Support investigations into sophisticated cyber activity.
•    Create new capabilities that help defend the UK's critical infrastructure and government organisations.
•    Collaborate with engineers, analysts, researchers and cyber specialists to solve challenging problems.
•    Continuously learn and adapt as technologies, threats and opportunities evolve. 
No two careers in this space look identical —and that's part of what makes it interesting.
You might be a good fit if you've ever found yourself asking questions like:
•    How do cyber teams actually uncover threats?
•    How do the tools behind modern cyber investigations really work?
•    How do you build the technology that powers cyber investigations at scale?
•    How do software, data and cyber security all fit together?
•    How can we stay ahead of constantly evolving threats?
•    How can I turn curiosity into real-world impact?
•    How can I bring all my previous experience together into one impactful role?
•    How will cyber teams evolve and adapt to the AI-revolution?
You don't need to have all the answers already. We're looking for people with curiosity, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn.
Essential Skills / Experience
You don't need to be an expert in every area—we're looking for people who bring curiosity, potential and a genuine enthusiasm for technology and cyber security.
•    A strong interest in cyber security, technology and solving complex problems.
•    An analytical mindset with the ability to think logically and approach challenges in a structured way.
•    A willingness to learn new tools, technologies and ways of working across cyber, software and data disciplines.
•    Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
•    A proactive approach to learning, continuous improvement and personal development.
•    An interest in understanding how technology, data and security can be used together to create meaningful outcomes.
•    A growth mindset and enthusiasm for tackling unfamiliar challenges.
•    Ability to obtain and maintain UK Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance.
Desirable Skills / Experience
These skills and experiences are helpful, but not required.
•    Experience with programming, scripting or software development through work, education or personal projects.
•    Familiarity with data analysis, data visualisation or working with large and complex datasets.
•    Exposure to cyber security concepts such as security operations, threat detection, incident response, risk management or vulnerability management.
•    Experience using automation to improve processes, increase efficiency or solve technical problems.
•    Familiarity with Linux, cloud platforms, databases, APIs or modern development practices.
•    An interest in emerging technologies, data science, artificial intelligence or machine learning.
•    Practical security experience gained through personal projects, home labs, hackathons, open-source contributions or self-directed learning.
•    A desire to contribute to capabilities that help protect organisations, services and infrastructure at scale. 
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
•    A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
•    Competitive DV market aligned salaries
•    Tiered role based DV allowance
•    World-class training and development opportunities
•    10% on target bonus 
•    Equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
•    Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
•    BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
•    New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
•    Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
•    On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
•    Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
•    24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
•    Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
•    25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
•    2 weeks paid carer’s leave 
•    Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
•    Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary

 Job Description
The Basware Customer Success team is a global organization ensuring high-quality delivery and customer experience. Our Customer Success team works closely with our customers creating joint success plans, offering practical guidance to help customers achieve their goals, and allowing them to drive their business outcomes.
The team helps to demonstrate the return on investment and acts as a trusted advisor. It's not simply about making the customers content with our products or services, it's about ensuring they are delighted and getting the most out of what we offer.
The Customer Success team monitors adoption and health and focuses on helping customers use our products and services effectively. This approach is essential for retaining customers, increasing the value they get over time, and expanding their usage of our solutions. In a nutshell our Customer Success team ensures a healthy and mutually beneficial customer relationship.
Role Overview
As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a critical role in managing large, strategic, and global accounts, driving measurable business outcomes, and delivering exceptional customer value.
You will act as a trusted advisor at a strategic level, working proactively with customers to define and execute success plans, demonstrate ROI, and maximize the value of Basware solutions. The focus is not only on satisfaction but on ensuring customers are highly successful, deeply adopted, and continuously expanding their usage.
Role Purpose
Own the success of strategic, high-value global customers, ensuring adoption and realization of business outcomes.
Act as a senior individual contributor, independently managing complex customer landscapes and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Drive customer retention, renewals, expansion, and long-term partnerships through proactive engagement.
Serve as a thought leader and subject matter expert in SaaS, AP, and P2P processes.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Customer Success Leadership
Develop and execute comprehensive success strategies for large, complex global accounts.
Create and manage high-impact success plans with clear business outcomes, KPIs, and measurable value.
Use Customer 360 data, health metrics, AI-driven insights, and playbooks to drive proactive actions.
2. Proactive Account Ownership (Strategic Accounts)
Act as the primary point of ownership for strategic accounts, ensuring alignment with executive stakeholders.
Build and maintain C-level relationships, influencing decision-making and long-term roadmap alignment.
Identify risks early and implement mitigation strategies proactively.
3. Adoption & Value Realization
Define and implement advanced adoption strategies tied to business value and ROI.
Continuously track adoption, usage trends, and ROI realization using data and dashboards.
Work closely with product, implementation, and support teams to optimize customer outcomes.
4. Customer Health Management
Own and evolve customer health scoring frameworks for strategic customers.
Use analytics, AI insights, and playbooks to drive continuous health improvement.
Provide data-driven recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders.
5. Renewal & Growth Leadership
