Job description
As a Digital Customer Success Manager for the Benelux market, you will partner closely with another Digital CSM to co-manage and retain a critical segment of roughly 1,300 small-to-mid market customers in the Benelux region. Instead of traditional 1:1 management, you will leverage product data, AI, automation, and localized multi-channel outreach to drive product adoption and directly impact Gross Revenue Retention (GRR). This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity for an operations-minded self-starter to test, roll out, and iterate digital initiatives in a dynamic growth-stage SaaS environment.
Your 12-Month Journey
During the first 3 months: You will get to know the team, the products, and our customer dynamics. You'll join customer calls, master Tellent's digital CS tools, and manage select, high-value reactive customer requests to build baseline product empathy, always with the goal of translating these patterns into scalable, automated solutions.
Within 6 months: Spearhead the end-to-end design, localization, and rollout of a critical digital program (such as onboarding or churn-prevention) in Benelux market. You will partner actively with Account Managers to translate data-driven usage trends into concrete renewal and upsell opportunities.
After 1 year: You have truly left your mark on our digital customer journey! By building and scaling programs that measurably increase product adoption, you have turned your ideas into standard operating processes and established yourself as a key driver of Tellent's long-term retention.
What You’ll Be Doing
Customer Success at Scale: Proactively guide and safeguard the segment using scalable, one-to-many communication rather than traditional relationship-heavy 1:1 management.
Drive Digital Adoption & Retention Programs: Develop, roll out, and iterate on digital programs utilizing channels such as email, in-app banners, chats, videos, and webinars, primarily tailored for our Benelux audience.
Analyze Customer Data & Insights: Regularly monitor Benelux segment retention, adoption, and engagement metrics to proactively identify patterns, target silent or low-engagement accounts, and measure campaign effectiveness.
Surface Growth & Expansion Signals: Monitor regional usage signals to identify and qualify upsell or cross-sell opportunities, passing these actionable leads directly to the local AM team.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with your peer Benelux Digital CSM, local Account Management, Support, Ops, Product Marketing, and Product to scale customer outcomes and launch seamless digital workflows.
What You Bring
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch (minimum C1 level or higher) and English (minimum B2 level or higher).
Confident Customer Engagement: Experience in customer-facing roles with a proven ability to drive outcomes through your interactions. You have no stage fright, genuinely enjoy engaging with strangers, and feel right at home presenting a webinar in both Dutch and English.
A Systems Mindset: Natural process-oriented thinking; you enjoy organizing chaotic workflows, look for ways to scale your work, and are comfortable working with data, dashboards (like Metabase), and pattern-spotting. Experience with systems like Planhat, HubSpot, and Intercom is highly valued.
Self-Starter: An entrepreneurial mindset with a natural drive to innovate. You proactively seek out answers independently, experiment with solutions, and don't wait for a manual to make processes run better.
Adaptability: You thrive in an environment that is not heavily predefined and are excited by the opportunity to help design and build new processes from scratch.
What We Offer
Hybrid working from our canal-side Amsterdam office
Diverse and international team environment
€1,500 annual learning budget + 2 dedicated learning days
Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement
28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days in 2026
Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year
Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed
€200 home office budget + work-from-home allowance

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).
With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.
AI in our recruitment process
We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.
If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

Kickstart your consulting career where technology and business meet. Do you have a passion for IT and business? 
As an ITPDM Consultant at Valcon, you will help clients achieve their strategic goals through innovative IT solutions and lead the way in digital transformation.
Experience
A curious and eager-to-learn mindset; you look beyond the obvious.
2 to 8 years of relevant work experience in roles such as business analysis, IT consultancy, or project management.
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Information Management, or Computer Science).
Affinity with IT and technology, such as application development or low-/high-code solutions.
Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with various stakeholders.
Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
Experience with agile working is a plus.
What will you do?
At Valcon, we don’t just implement technology. We redefine how businesses operate with it. As part of our IT Project & Delivery Management (ITPDM) capability, you will create and deliver applications, processes, insights, and automation solutions that leverage modern cloud platforms. By aligning business and IT, you will help our clients achieve their strategic objectives and drive meaningful change.
Your week as an ITPDM Consultant is dynamic and varied. You might spend one day at the client’s office, running workshops to align business needs with IT solutions. Another day, you could be analysing data and collaborating with your team at Valcon HQ or working from home to prepare reports and refine solution designs. Every few weeks, you join a collaboration day at the Valcon office to connect with colleagues, share updates, and learn from each other. Throughout the week, you’ll engage with stakeholders, contribute to project deliverables, and help drive impactful IT strategies.
Your responsibilites will include (but not be limited to):
Transforming business needs into innovative IT solutions by crafting user stories and intuitive designs.
Analysing and improving business processes to drive digital transformation.
Supporting the delivery and implementation of IT solutions, from concept to completion.
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure successful project outcomes.
Managing IT delivery projects in agile, hybrid, or traditional environments.
Each project brings unique challenges, giving you the opportunity to develop a broad skill set and make a real impact. Whether you’re facilitating workshops, aligning business and IT, or optimising processes, your work will contribute to achieving the client’s strategic goals.
What do we offer you?
Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.
Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.
Additionally, we offer:
Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus of up to 4 months’ salary (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95.
A company car or mobility budget.
A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.
Ready to apply?
Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?
Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ([email protected]) to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

About the role
BT Group is developing a connected leadership development ecosystem spanning multiple leadership identities. Together, these programmes support senior leaders, future enterprise leaders and people managers with a shared leadership language, while providing experiences tailored to the needs of each audience.
This is a high-profile portfolio at the heart of BT’s leadership and culture ambitions. As the programmes move from design and mobilisation into delivery and business-as-usual operation, the focus is on turning the roadmap into consistent, high-quality experiences that are well coordinated across programme teams, business units, partners and participant populations.
We are looking for a Programme Specialist to support the Senior Manager for Leadership in the delivery and ongoing management of BT’s flagship leadership experiences.
In this role, you will translate agreed programme design and content into a high-quality participant experience, coordinate delivery across the full programme journey, and own relevant programme processes, reporting and continuous improvement activity.
This is an opportunity to play a central role in delivering leadership development at scale, supporting experiences that build leadership capability and embed BT’s leadership expectations across the organisation.
What you’ll be doing
•Coordinate end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring agreed designs are translated into high-quality participant experiences.
•Manage programme schedules, communications, launches, retreats, coaching, exchanges and other participant activities across the programme lifecycle.
•Work with sponsors, subject matter experts and delivery partners to coordinate effective delivery plans and participant journeys.
•Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, People & Culture colleagues, suppliers and external partners to support successful programme delivery.
•Coordinate activity across internal and external stakeholders, managing priorities, milestones, dependencies and participant touchpoints.
•Identify and escalate delivery risks and issues, providing clear options and recommendations for resolution.
•Maintain programme plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and documentation, ensuring effective governance and delivery oversight.
•Support budget tracking, resource coordination and operational readiness across the programme lifecycle.
•Gather and analyse participant and programme data to monitor outcomes, identify insights and recommend improvements.
•Support the evaluation and ongoing improvement of leadership programmes, using participant feedback, data and external insight to enhance delivery and impact.
Essential Skills / Experience
•Strong project management experience in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the ability to coordinate delivery across multiple teams and partners.
•Proven ability to manage integrated plans, dependencies, risks and governance, keeping delivery on track in a fast-paced environment.
•Confident stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships, influence effectively and drive accountability across teams and partners.
Desirable Skills / Experience
•Ability to coordinate multiple programmes or workstreams, managing shared resources, priorities and milestones.
•Comfortable working effectively within a large, complex or matrixed organisation.
•Strong organisational skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a proactive approach to delivery and follow-through.
•Knowledge of leadership development, learning, talent, organisational development or wider People & Culture programmes.
•Background in coordinating participant-facing programmes, virtual events or blended learning experiences.
•Skilled in working with external suppliers, managing programme budgets and coordinating programme logistics.
•Familiarity with Agile, hybrid or other structured programme delivery approaches.
•Understanding of programme evaluation, data collection, reporting and measurement of programme impact.
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
• 10% on target annual bonus
• Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
• Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
• Equalised maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
• Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
• Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
• Holiday purchase scheme
You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
Sales Development Representative (Future Opportunities)
How You'll Make An Impact
Boomi is looking for a talented, high-energy, professional with a business-oriented mindset and a natural sales instinct to join our growing Business Development organization, part of the AMER Inside Sales Team. The ideal candidate will work in collaboration with the Sales Team and contribute to developing the Boomi business by executing the planned sales strategy.
Boomi offers a fast-paced, international, and innovative environment where you will have the opportunity to bring your ideas, have full responsibility for your activities, and use the right tools, resources, and outstanding management to sell business application solutions and take your career to the next level!
What You'll Do
Using the Hoffman methodology, you will be creating your own conversations with our target personas about their integration needs and challenges, introduce them to Boomi, and position the value of our solution
Create, plan & execute outbound campaigns, from initial touchpoint to sales-qualified lead conversions
Partner with our experienced Account Executives to increase the opportunity pipeline and receive coaching
Offer a first great first impression of Boomi solutions to our prospects and customers and conduct them to the next sales stage
Achieve monthly quotas of sourced qualified opportunities
This is a hybrid role in the Vancouver office.
The Experience You Bring
2-3 years of corporate experience, outside of undergraduate graduation
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Fluency in written and verbal English
 Bonus Points If You Have
Bachelor’s degree in economics is preferred
Aspiration to develop your career in technology sales
Experience with the latest technologies and best practices in inbound/outbound sales tools like Salesforce (or other relevant CRMs)
Prior inside sales experience, selling software solutions is a plus
Entrepreneurial mindset
High energy and positive attitude
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and international environment
Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!
Compensation
Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The On Target Earnings (OTE) is $85,000- $95,000 CAD annually (inclusive of commission). Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.
Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  
Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

Job Information 
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
As a Data Science and AI Engineer, you'll help unlock the value hidden within some of the UK's most diverse and complex datasets.
Working alongside experienced technical specialists, you'll apply data science, advanced analytics, machine learning and emerging AI techniques to solve real-world challenges that have genuine operational and societal impact.
You'll work across a broad range of customer and business problems, helping transform data into actionable insight, supporting evidence-based decision making and contributing to innovative solutions that create measurable value.
No two assignments are likely to be the same. You could find yourself evaluating emerging AI technologies, developing classification models, exploring opportunities for automation, building analytical solutions or helping stakeholders understand complex information through clear and meaningful insight.
This is an opportunity to apply your expertise to problems that are often unique in their scale, complexity and importance while contributing to the responsible adoption of AI across secure and mission-focused environments.
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Depending on your skills, interests and experience, you may:
•    Apply Data Science, Machine Learning and AI techniques to transform complex data into actionable insight and measurable outcomes.
•    Develop, evaluate and continuously improve analytical models, predictive capabilities and AI-driven solutions.
•    Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to solve challenging operational, business and customer problems.
•    Communicate complex findings through clear visualisations, storytelling and stakeholder engagement.
•    Explore, test and evaluate emerging AI technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and adoption.
•    Contribute to responsible AI practices, helping ensure solutions are secure, transparent and appropriately governed.
•    Support the growth of the wider Data Science and AI community through collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
Essential Skills / Experience
We recognise that no candidate is likely to match every requirement listed below. If you're excited by the opportunity and believe you can contribute, we'd encourage you to apply. We're interested in your skills, potential and passion for solving meaningful problems, not simply whether you've worked with a specific technology before.
•    Experience applying Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or Advanced Analytics to solve practical challenges.
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into meaningful insight.
•    Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
•    Experience working collaboratively to deliver outcomes within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Curiosity, adaptability and a desire to continuously learn and embrace new technologies.
•    Ability to obtain and maintain UK Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance.
Desirable Skills / Experience
•    Experience developing, evaluating or operationalising AI or machine learning solutions.
•    Knowledge of Generative AI, modern data platforms or cloud technologies.
•    Experience presenting insights through visualisation, dashboards or decision-support tools.
•    Understanding of responsible AI principles, model assurance or governance frameworks.
•    Experience working with large-scale data, cloud platforms or distributed processing environments.
•    Experience operating within regulated or security-sensitive environments.
•    Experience supporting, coaching or mentoring others.
Tools & Technologies:
Below are some of the relevant tools & technologies for Data Science in BT, don’t worry if this doesn’t match your previous experience
•    Python 
•    Spark 
•    Scala
•    Databricks 
•    AWS
•    SQL
•    Azure 
•    Snowflake 
•    MLflow 
•    GitHub
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
•    A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
•    Competitive DV market aligned salaries
•    Tiered role based DV allowance
•    World-class training and development opportunities
•    10% on target bonus 
•    Equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
•    Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
•    BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
•    New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
•    Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
•    On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
•    Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
•    24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
•    Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
•    25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
•    2 weeks paid carer’s leave 
•    Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
•    Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary

Job Information
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
Platform Engineers are at the heart of our mission.
They design, build, operate and continually improve the platforms that underpin critical services. Working across infrastructure, automation, operations and security, they ensure our environments remain resilient, scalable and secure.
This role provides the opportunity to work on complex engineering challenges within large-scale environments where reliability, security and performance are essential.
Whether supporting existing platforms or helping shape future capability, you'll play a key role in delivering technology that matters
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Design, build, support and continuously improve infrastructure platforms that enable critical services. 
Contribute to the automation of operational processes, reducing manual effort and increasing platform reliability.
Support the delivery of platform modernisation and transformation initiatives.
Collaborate with architecture, security and software engineering teams to implement effective technical solutions.
Monitor platform health, identify opportunities for optimisation and drive continuous improvement.
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and contribute to long-term resolution strategies.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards and reusable engineering practices.
Share knowledge and contribute positively to the engineering community through collaboration and mentoring.
Essential Skills / Experience
We expect our Platform Engineers to:
Demonstrate a passion for technology and solving meaningful engineering challenges.
Take ownership of problems and work independently where appropriate.
Apply logical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills to complex situations.
Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously learn and remain curious about emerging technologies and industry trends.
Champion secure, reliable and maintainable engineering practices.
Desirable Skills / Experience
We welcome candidates from a broad range of infrastructure and platform engineering backgrounds.
Experience in some of the following areas would be advantageous:
Linux and/or Windows enterprise operating systems.
Infrastructure and platform operations.
Cloud and/or on-premises environments.
Automation and Infrastructure as Code.
Scripting and software development.Virtualisation and container-based platforms.
Networking and platform security concepts.
Monitoring, observability and operational tooling.
DevOps, Platform Engineering or Site Reliability Engineering practices.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD).
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.

Job Information
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
Join a team helping to assure the quality, resilience and reliability of services that matter to the UK.
As a QA Engineer working on Mission Critical Services, you'll contribute to the delivery of high-quality technology solutions across complex operational environments. Working alongside software engineers, solution architects and operational stakeholders, you'll help ensure that solutions, platforms and services meet demanding standards before reaching customers and users.
We believe quality is built into products from the start rather than added at the end, and our QA Engineers play an active role throughout the engineering lifecycle.
This role offers exposure to a broad range of technologies, testing approaches and engineering challenges. Whether executing tests, improving quality processes, supporting automation initiatives or helping diagnose complex issues, you'll play an important role in maintaining the integrity of critical systems.
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Depending on your skills, interests and experience, you may:
Design, develop and execute testing activities that support the delivery of high-quality products and services.
Create, maintain and improve test environments, test cases, test data and quality assurance processes across a range of technology environments.
Identify, investigate and help resolve defects, working collaboratively with engineering and delivery teams.
Support integration, regression, functional and non-functional testing activities throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality, efficiency and delivery confidence.
Assess risks to quality and service performance, helping teams understand impacts and appropriate mitigations.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders regarding testing outcomes, quality concerns and recommendations.
Share knowledge, promote engineering best practice and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
No two careers in this space look identical —and that's part of what makes it interesting.
You might be a good fit if you're naturally curious about questions such as:
How do you build confidence in technology that simply cannot fail? 
How do you prove a complex service is ready for the real world? 
What hidden risks exist inside large-scale technology environments? 
How do engineering teams balance quality, reliability and delivery speed? 
How can automation and human insight work together to improve outcomes? 
How do you turn curiosity and problem-solving into meaningful impact? 
How can I keep developing my skills while working on technology that truly matters? 
What does great quality engineering look like in the age of AI? You don't need to have all the answers already. We're looking for people with curiosity, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn.
Essential Skills / Experience
You don't need to be an expert in every area—we're looking for people who bring curiosity, potential and a genuine enthusiasm for technology and assurance.
Experience working within software and/or system integration testing, quality engineering or assurance environments.
Understanding of testing principles, methodologies and quality assurance practices.
Experience identifying, documenting and managing defects through to resolution.
Ability to analyse problems, investigate issues and communicate findings effectively.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver quality outcomes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Commitment to continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain DV security clearance.
Desirable Skills / Experience
These skills and experiences are helpful, but not required.
Experience supporting automated testing approaches.
Exposure to complex, large-scale or mission-critical technology environments.
Understanding of integration and end-to-end testing practices.
Experience contributing to process improvement initiatives.
Knowledge of secure, regulated or highly assured delivery environments.
Experience mentoring colleagues or supporting capability development.

Early careers
Technology
Netherlands
Apply now
Are you passionate about IT and technology, with a drive to deliver high-quality solutions together in a multidisciplinary team?
At Valcon, you work together with business consultants, professional developers and technical specialists. We like to go the extra mile for a good result and high quality. This results in solutions that make the difference and result in satisfied clients and happy end-users. For this, we are looking for top performing people with a passion for IT and technology with good communicative and analytical skills.
Experience
A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in areas such as: Psysics, Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Economics or Mathematics.
Affinity with IT and willingness to learn new technologies.
Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills.
Experience as application developer is an advantage.
Experience with one of the following methods is an advantage: model-driven software engineering, Rapid Application Development, Agile, Scrum, DevOps, application-architecture, information-architecture, integration-architecture.
Fluent in Dutch and English.
What will you do?
As PowerApps Developer you combine the role of IT consultant with that of an application developer. You use your technical expertise, platform knowledge and development experience in a multidisciplinary project or a DevOps team to deliver, implement and control high-quality IT solutions. Such solutions include mobile applications, business applications and workflow systems. As PowerApps Developer, you will specialize in the technology and applications of these platforms, in addition you will support pre-sales and delivery trajectories.
Your responsibilities will include (but not be limited to):
Designing, developing and testing innovative PowerApps solutions in an agile way.
Coordinating with clients and end-users about product specifications, design and the end-product.
Testing of new functionalities, validating with end-users and implementing improvements.
Executing DevOps activities for clients.
What do we offer you?
Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. 
An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. 
Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.
Additionally, we offer:
Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
A company car or mobility budget.
A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.
Ready to apply?
Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?
Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ([email protected]) to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

Are you a recent graduate and eager to kickstart your career in data and become a future-ready Data Specialist through hands-on training and expert coaching?
Join our Data Academy starting on 1 February 2027: four weeks of hands-on training and coaching, focused on building the skills you need to start your career as a data specialist at one of our clients.
At Valcon, we help organizations turn data into real business value. We combine deep expertise in data and technology with a strong understanding of business processes to help our clients solve complex challenges and make lasting improvements.
For ambitious graduates, we have developed our Data Academy. During this four-week program, you will be trained and coached by experienced Valcon specialists. Rather than following a one-size-fits-all program, the Academy is designed around the skills and knowledge needed for selected client assignments. This allows you to develop relevant, practical skills while building a strong foundation for your future career in data.
After four weeks, you will start working on your first client project, while continuing to learn from and be supported by experienced colleagues.
Experience
You have completed, or are about to complete, a Master’s degree from a research university (WO) in a technical, data-driven field, such as Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science, Engineering or a related STEM discipline.
You have a strong interest in data and enjoy understanding how it connects to business processes and real-world challenges.
You are analytical, curious and eager to learn.
You are a real team player with strong communication skills and enjoy working with both colleagues and clients.
You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to have: You have shown initiative and an entrepreneurial mindset alongside your studies, for example through a relevant side job, internship, active involvement in a study association or other extracurricular activities.[
Nice to have: Experience with Python or another high-level programming language.
What will you do?
As part of Valcon, you will work at the intersection of data, technology and business. We’re doers who think: we help our clients turn their ambitions and strategies into solutions that work in practice. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, learn how to solve real client challenges and gradually take on more responsibility as you develop.
During the Data Academy, you will build a strong foundation in the key areas of our data practice. The Academy will primarily focus on three areas that are central to many of our client projects:
Data & AI Engineering
Data Platform Engineering
Data Modeling
Alongside these core areas, you will gain broader exposure to other aspects of data and consultancy, such as data science, data migration, data visualization, business analysis and consulting skills. The exact content may vary depending on the focus of the Academy and relevant client projects.
After completing the Academy, you will put your newly developed skills into practice on your first client project. Your development does not stop there: you will continue to receive guidance and coaching from experienced Valcon colleagues as you grow into a well-rounded data specialist.
What do we offer you?
Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, and mentoring by experienced colleagues. We also highly value your mental health and offer professional and confidential support through OpenUp.
An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and strategy.
Immediate impact: at Valcon, you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one.
Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth.
Additionally, we offer:
Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowances.
A company car or mobility budget.
A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance.
A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.
Ready to apply?
Are you ready to kick-start your career in an innovative and impactful environment? Do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you? Our recruitment team would love to hear from you. We would be happy to receive your application.

Valcon | Utrecht (Leidsche Rijn) | Part-time / Full-time
Are you someone who keeps an overview when calendars fill up, switches effortlessly between priorities and anticipates what is needed before being asked? For Valcon in Utrecht, we are looking for an experienced and independent Management Assistant who will support multiple senior stakeholders and ensure everything behind the scenes runs smoothly.
Experience
Have experience as a Management Assistant, Executive Assistant, Secretary or in a comparable support role;
Have experience managing complex calendars;
Support with office- and event management;
Work independently, accurately and in a structured manner;
Are proactive and naturally think several steps ahead;
Communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels of an organisation;
Are flexible when circumstances or schedules change;
Enjoy working in a professional and fast-moving environment;
Have strong communication skills in both Dutch and English.
Experience within consulting or another professional services/corporate environment is an advantage.
What will you do? 
As Management Assistant, you will support multiple senior stakeholders within Valcon. You will play an important role in keeping their day-to-day activities organised, enabling them to focus on their clients, teams and the continued development of the business.
A key part of your role is complex calendar management. You will coordinate appointments, manage competing priorities and ensure internal and external meetings are scheduled effectively. This requires more than simply finding an available time slot: you understand priorities, anticipate potential conflicts and are confident making decisions when needed.
Your responsibilities will include:
Managing and coordinating complex calendars;
Scheduling and organising board, management and other internal and external meetings;
Preparing and coordinating meetings and appointments;
Providing administrative and organisational support;
Monitoring actions, appointments and deadlines;
Liaising with colleagues, clients and other internal and external stakeholders.
Handling confidential and sensitive information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.
You will be given a high level of trust and responsibility. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, acts independently and thinks ahead rather than waiting for instructions.
What do we offer you?
Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.
Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.
Additionally, we offer:
Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
A company car or mobility budget.
A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.
What do you bring to the table?
You are an experienced support professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. You are comfortable dealing with different stakeholders and personalities and know when to be flexible and when to take control.
You are service-oriented without being reactive. If a calendar could be organised more efficiently, you notice it and take action. When priorities suddenly change, you remain calm and quickly find a practical solution.
Why join Valcon?
This is not a role where you simply manage calendars and schedule meetings. You will have the opportunity to take real ownership of the support you provide to senior stakeholders.
Valcon’s dynamic consulting environment requires you to understand priorities, anticipate what is coming next and act independently. You will work close to the business and interact with a wide variety of people, both internally and externally.
This makes the role particularly suited to someone who enjoys enabling others to perform at their best while taking ownership of their own responsibilities.
Ready to apply?
Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?
Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ([email protected]) to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

 Job Description
Ready to join the clear market leader and help pioneer the future of Invoice Lifecycle Management?
At Basware, we didn’t just create the electronic invoice—we revolutionized how the world’s largest organizations manage, automate, and control their Accounts Payable operations. With over USD $10 trillion in invoices processed globally, Basware ensures compliance, eliminates errors, and prevents fraud across jurisdictions. Recognized by Gartner, Forrester, and IDC as the #1 solution in our category, we’re trusted by 6,000+ customers worldwide.
As governments mandate e-invoicing and compliance across more countries, the market is hotter than ever—and Basware is leading the charge. Now, we’re scaling fast and expanding our reach. This is your opportunity to join a global leader and shape the future of enterprise finance transformation.
We are looking for an Inside Sales Executive to drive expansion revenue across an existing customer portfolio by identifying growth opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and managing sales opportunities from discovery through to close. In this role, you will help Basware grow within its existing customer base while delivering a seamless and professional customer experience.
About the team
The Inside Sales / Account Development team helps Basware grow within its existing customer base. We identify white-space, cross-sell and upsell opportunities, provide consistent commercial support and work closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives and specialist teams to create an easy buying experience for customers.
What you will do
Own and develop a defined portfolio of existing Basware customers and deliver expansion revenue.
Identify opportunities through account research, customer conversations, inbound enquiries and targeted outbound activity.
Lead discovery calls, understand business needs and position relevant Basware solutions and customer value.
Manage appropriate opportunities through the full sales cycle, including demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and close.
Qualify larger or more complex opportunities and collaborate with the appropriate Account Executive and specialists.
Build strong relationships with customers and work closely with Customer Success, Marketing, Deal Desk, Professional Services and other teams.
Maintain accurate customer activity, pipeline, next steps and forecasts in Salesforce.
 Work with great people
Hanna Ikonen
VP, Customer Success
 "I feel that I can make a difference, drive improvements & take controlled risks, and all this is supported by the company."
Kevin Kamau
Senior Product Manager
 "Basware is a global company that values people as a crucial driver for success."
Mika Peurala
Principal Solution Architect
 "Absolutely the best colleagues and line managers in the world!"
Jaakko Jutila
VP, Customer Support
 "At Basware you have the freedom to identify and start different development activities across the organization without getting approvals from above."
Namrata Checker
Team Lead, Digital Transformation and Excellence
 "What I love most about my job is the people that I work with, the freedom of putting forward my ideas, thoughts and feedback but also the freedom of creating the way of working that works best for me."
Siddhartha Bhatia
Senior Cloud Developer
 "I am honored to have worked with the leaders of tomorrow. The organization is absolutely people centric with its prime focus always on employee engagement, loyalty and satisfaction."
 Skills & Requirements
What we are looking for
This role could suit an Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative or Inside Sales professional who is ready to grow into greater commercial and full sales-cycle responsibility.
Experience in a customer-facing sales, account management, customer success or business development role.
Fluent Finnish and/or Swedish, with good professional English.
Based in, or able to work from, the Helsinki metropolitan area.
Strong communication, discovery, relationship-building and organisational skills.
A proactive, resilient and commercially curious approach, with the confidence to create opportunities and take ownership of results.
Comfort using CRM systems and managing multiple customers or opportunities.
Experience in SaaS, FinTech, enterprise software, Accounts Payable or financial technology is beneficial, but not essential.
Interest in learning new products and using AI and digital tools responsibly to improve productivity and customer engagement.
What success looks like
Success means building a healthy and accurate pipeline, creating measurable growth from the customer portfolio, progressing opportunities efficiently and delivering a clear, professional customer experience. You will be supported to build Basware product knowledge and develop into a confident consultative seller.Awareness of artificial intelligence concepts, tools, or applications is considered a strong asset. We highly value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, a proactive mindset and a willingness to explore and incorporate AI-driven technologies into their work. We support continuous learning in this area.
Why Basware
Basware is the global leader in Invoice Lifecycle Management, trusted by the world’s largest and most sophisticated organizations. With 40 years of innovation, a world-class partner ecosystem, and unmatched automation capabilities, Basware empowers companies to build AI-powered, future-proof AP operations that work at enterprise scale.
Our culture blends openness with global ambition where voices are heard, ideas matter, and people support each other. You will join a team that cares deeply about the craft of presales and celebrates creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
Basware offers
Financial stability of a global company with $230 million in revenue and a track record of profitability for 30 years, owned by AKKR since 2022
Leading edge software products in the enterprise accounts payable and invoice automation market
Strong brand, global reach, and an installed base of 3,000+ customers and over a million enterprise users in 100 countries
A unique company culture where Baswareans collaborate; the true ‘We’ glues everything together and creates a feeling of inclusion and generates genuine passion to succeed and celebrate achievements together. We are all Baswareans no matter what our background. We Drive Customer Value, We Take Ownership and We Are Bold
Award-Winning Culture
At Basware, we are proud of our people-first culture and our commitment to creating a great workplace around the world. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work® in India and have received Best Places to Work and Best and Brightest Companies to Work For recognitions in both the US and Romania.
As a global team, we combine local expertise with international collaboration, giving our employees the opportunity to work with colleagues, customers, and partners across multiple regions and markets.
You'll also have the opportunity to build your experience working with a diverse customer base that includes some of the world's leading organizations.
To learn more about life at Basware, visit basware.com.
To apply: Please upload your resume together with your salary expectations.
 Great Place to Work

 About the company
 Basware is how the world’s best finance teams gain complete control of every invoice, every time. Our Intelligent Invoice Lifecycle Management Platform ensures end-to-end efficiency, compliance and control for all invoice transactions. Powered by the world’s most sophisticated invoice-centric AI – trained on over 2 billion invoices – Basware's Intelligent Automation drives real ROI by transforming finance operations. We serve 6,500+ customers globally and are trusted by industry leaders including DHL, Heineken and Sony. Fueled by 40 years of specialized expertise with $10+ trillion in total spend handled, we are pioneering the next era of finance. 
Joining Basware means you’ll join a team filled with innovators, passionate about their work and enthusiastic about the industry we’ve pioneered. You’ll work alongside highly motivated, capable, and friendly individuals who collaborate to deliver world-class solutions and services. A critical part of our culture is the high amount of trust we put into our employees—we want everyone to make a difference, so we offer flexibility in how you work, giving you the freedom and support to deliver your best results. We truly live our values where:
We Drive Customer Value, We Take Ownership and We Are Bold in everything we do, to make it all just happen for our customers.

We are seeking an AI Solutions Consultant to join Valcon’s advisory team, helping clients move from AI ambition to practical, governed and scalable delivery.
This is a hands-on advisory and delivery role for someone who can work with senior stakeholders to understand business problems, identify high-value AI opportunities, shape solution approaches and guide multidisciplinary teams through implementation. You will help clients cut through hype, make informed decisions about emerging AI technologies and build solutions that are useful, reliable and aligned to real business outcomes.
The role sits at the intersection of consulting, data and technology. You will combine strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with practical AI solution experience across Large Language Models, Retrieval Augmented Generation, context engineering, prompt-as-code, evaluation frameworks, workflow automation and agentic patterns where appropriate.
Experience
Experience designing and delivering AI-enabled solutions that solve real business problems, from discovery and requirements gathering through implementation and adoption.
Demonstrable experience delivering client-facing AI strategies and use cases, shaping recommendations and influencing client decision-making.
Strong understanding of modern AI technologies and patterns including Large Language Models, Retrieval Augmented Generation, AI agents, evaluation frameworks and model orchestration patterns.
Practical experience applying techniques including context engineering, prompt-as-code and versioning practices, retrieval strategies, grounding approaches, memory patterns and evaluation methodologies to improve AI solution quality, reliability and performance in a production enterprise environment.
Ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured requirements, user stories, solution designs and delivery backlogs.
Strong consulting and stakeholder engagement skills with a track record of building trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders.
Ability to communicate and translate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, operational and technical audiences.
Experience analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation, augmentation and transformation using AI technologies.
Understanding of considerations around responsible and ethical AI usage including governance, security, regulatory landscape, and enterprise risk management practices.
Experience working within agile delivery environments and multidisciplinary teams spanning business, data, technology and change functions.
Working alongside clients, architects, engineers, data specialists and delivery teams, you’ll help define use cases, shape requirements, design AI-enabled experiences, improve output quality and support adoption into live enterprise environments.
This role is ideal for someone who wants to be more than a technologist or advisor alone: someone who can shape the conversation, challenge thinking, build confidence and help clients turn emerging AI capability into meaningful transformation.
Key Responsibilities:
Work with client stakeholders to understand business challenges, strategic objectives and opportunities for AI-enabled transformation.
Facilitate workshops, discovery activities and design sessions to identify, assess and prioritise AI use cases based on business value, feasibility and organisational readiness.
Translate complex business requirements into structured user stories, solution designs, delivery backlogs and implementation roadmaps.
Advise clients on emerging AI technologies, industry trends and practical adoption approaches, helping them make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.
Design AI-enabled solutions using modern approaches including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), workflow automation, agentic patterns, knowledge retrieval and AI-assisted user experiences.
Apply context engineering, prompt-as-code and evaluation-led development practices to improve the accuracy, reliability, performance and maintainability of AI solutions.
Collaborate with architects, engineers, data specialists and delivery teams to ensure solutions are robust, commercially viable and aligned to client objectives.
Analyse business processes and operating models to identify opportunities for automation, augmentation and productivity improvement through AI technologies.
Define and monitor success criteria, evaluation frameworks and performance metrics to ensure AI solutions deliver measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
Support clients in establishing appropriate governance, risk management and responsible AI controls, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant and trustworthy.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders across business and technology functions, acting as a credible advisor throughout the lifecycle of an engagement.
Contribute to Valcon’s advisory practice through proposition development, thought leadership, business development activities and the sharing of best practice.
Support proposal development and innovation initiatives, helping shape new opportunities across technology, data and AI transformation engagements.

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
Boomi is looking for a talented, high-energy, professional with a business-oriented mindset and a natural sales instinct to join our growing Enterprise Business Development organization, part of the EMEA Inside Sales Team. The ideal candidate will work in collaboration with the Sales Team and contribute to developing the Boomi business by generating pipeline and executing the planned sales strategy.
This is your opportunity to kick-off your Sales career with a Leader in the Software, AI industry.
This is a 3-day-a-week position based at our buzzing office in Barcelona, located in Poble Nou!
Your Responsibilities
Generate Sales pipeline for a specific territory (language dependent) by applying your outbound sales methodology to contact Enterprise companies.
Account mapping, Contacts research and Account base selling.
Using the MEDDPICC (MEDDICC) methodology, you will be creating your own conversations with our target personas about their integration needs and challenges, introduce them to Boomi, and position the value of our solution
Create, plan & execute outbound campaigns, from initial touchpoint to sales-qualified lead conversions
Partner with our experienced Account Executives to increase the opportunity pipeline and receive coaching
Offer a first great first impression of Boomi solutions to our prospects and customers and conduct them to the next sales stage
Achieve monthly quotas of sourced qualified opportunities
Qualifications
2+ years of corporate experience, outside of undergraduate graduation
Full work proficiency language skills in English plus one of: French, Arabic, German, Dutch, Norwegian, Danish, Swedish, Finnish, Italian.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Aspiration to develop your career in technology sales
Curiosity and interest in Artificial Intelligence and Integration Software platform
Even better if you have...
Bachelor’s or Master's degree in business administration, marketing, economics related field
Experience with the latest technologies and best practices in inbound/outbound sales tools like Salesforce (or other relevant CRMs)
Prior inside sales experience, selling software solutions is a plus
Entrepreneurial mindset
High energy and positive attitude
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and international business environment
This role is a perfect launchpad for you to kickstart your highly rewarding tech sales career, with one of the world's leading software companies. If you believe you have the skills we are looking for, let's connect asap!!

We are seeking a Generative AI Consultant to join Valcon’s advisory team, helping clients move from AI ambition to practical, governed and scalable delivery
This is a hands-on advisory and delivery role for someone who can work with stakeholders to understand business problems and turn them into reliable AI solutions. You will focus on designing, testing and refining prompts, context patterns and retrieval approaches that help commercial AI models produce outputs that are useful, repeatable and aligned to real business needs.
The role sits at the intersection of consulting, data and technology, with a particular focus on how Generative AI solutions are shaped through prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval design and evaluation-led iteration. You will combine strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with practical experience of adapting commercial Large Language Models for enterprise use cases.
Experience
Experience designing and delivering AI-enabled solutions that solve real business problems, from discovery and requirements gathering through implementation and adoption.
Strong understanding of modern AI technologies and patterns including Large Language Models, Retrieval Augmented Generation, AI agents, evaluation frameworks and model orchestration patterns.
Practical experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt-as-code and versioning practices, retrieval strategies, grounding approaches and evaluation methodologies to improve AI solution quality, reliability and performance.
Ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured requirements, user stories, solution designs and delivery backlogs.
Ability to take a leading role in workshops to understand user needs and shape problems and solutions.
Ability to communicate and translate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, operational and technical audiences.
Experience analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation, augmentation and transformation using AI technologies.
Understanding of considerations around responsible and ethical AI usage including governance, security, regulatory landscape, and enterprise risk management practices.
Experience working within agile delivery environments and multidisciplinary teams spanning business, data, technology and change functions.
Working alongside clients, architects, engineers, data specialists and delivery teams, you’ll help define use cases, shape requirements, design AI-enabled experiences, improve output quality and support adoption into live enterprise environments.
This role is ideal for someone who is already hands-on with Generative AI and wants to grow into broader AI solution consulting; someone who enjoys experimenting with LLM-based solutions, can learn quickly from model behaviour, and wants to help clients turn emerging AI capability into meaningful business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:
Work with client stakeholders to understand business challenges, strategic objectives and opportunities for AI-enabled transformation.
Analyse business processes and operating models to identify opportunities for automation, augmentation and productivity improvement through AI technologies.
Experiment with prompting techniques, context design, grounding approaches and model configuration to adapt commercial Generative AI models for enterprise applications and improve the consistency, accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.
Design AI-enabled solutions using modern approaches including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), workflow automation,  knowledge retrieval and AI-assisted user experiences.
Apply prompt-as-code, prompt testing and evaluation-led development practices to improve the accuracy, reliability, consistency and maintainability of Generative AI outputs.
Collaborate with architects, engineers, data specialists and delivery teams to ensure solutions are robust, commercially viable and aligned to client objectives, putting forward your own ideas for creative solutions.
Define and monitor success criteria, evaluation frameworks and performance metrics to ensure AI solutions deliver measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
Support clients in establishing appropriate governance, risk management and responsible AI controls, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant and trustworthy.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders across business and technology functions through delivering high quality outcomes.
Share lessons learned, reusable patterns, evaluation approaches and practical delivery insights with colleagues to help improve Valcon’s AI delivery capability.

As a Data Specialist at Valcon, you’ll be the technical authority that both clients and colleagues turn to for guidance. You’ll look beyond individual projects to see the bigger picture: how can we help financial institutions in realising their ambitions by providing in-depth knowledge and support on data-related topics.
Data & AI Strategy: The “European Powerhouse”
In 2025, Valcon sharpened its focus to become a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation. Unlike traditional firms that treat data as a byproduct, Valcon places it at the center of every client engagement.
Experience
You have a completed master’s degree.
You have at least 8 years of working experience, of which 4+ years within Finance or Risk departments or related data-teams of a bank, insurer or credit institution.
You have hands-on experience in data-delivery for Finance, Risk and/or regulatory reporting contexts, e.g. through building and managing data warehousing or data lake solutions.
You have strong knowledge of Python and SQL.
You have experience with data solutions for (credit) modelling or financial/risk reporting in a regulated context, from requirements gathering to data collection to actual report or model development.
You are familiar with BCBS-239, Basel, IFRS9 or Solvency regulation and principles
You have experience in leading projects and talking to director/C-level stakeholders.
You have experience leading complex data projects and know how to manage diverse stakeholders (business, data, technical).
You have strong communication skills: you can persuasively advise on data architecture, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and provide substantive support.
You communicate effectively in both Dutch and English.
Please note: You already reside in the Netherlands and hold a valid work permit.
What will you do?
In this role, you combine deep technical expertise with a solid understanding of data challenges and solutions in the financial services industry. You are responsible for maintaining highest quality standards for data solutions Valcon develops and you guide clients in their journeys to becoming fully data-driven organisations.
Guiding & Connecting: You’ll design complex, scalable data solutions that enable seamless risk and finance modelling and reporting. By connecting business requirements with technical implementation, you’ll create maximum value for clients while following industry best practices in data warehousing, quality, and governance.
Innovation & Standardization: You’ll stay ahead of market developments in analytics tools and methodologies, translating them into new approaches and standards for Valcon. You’ll shape how we build analytics solutions and ensure we maintain our technical leadership in the analytics space.
Inspiring Mentorship: You’ll mentor senior specialists and specialists, actively contributing to knowledge sharing through expert training and coaching. Your guidance will help colleagues grow professionally and technically in the data domain of financial services organisations.
Trusted Advisor: Clients see you as the expert. You’ll join strategic sessions, guide architectural discussions, help frame data requirements, and identify opportunities where data solutions create business value.
What do we offer you?
We believe top experts need space. Space to innovate, but also space for a private life.
Impact: A key role where you have direct influence on Valcon’s data strategy.
Flexibility & Balance: A culture that respects your work-life balance, including options for a sabbatical or extra leave.
Community: A network of peers to spar with, plus access to sports facilities and social events.
Additionally, we offer:
Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus of up to 4 months’ salary (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95.
A company car or mobility budget.
A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.
Who are you? 
You are a recognized expert in your field who easily switches between technology and business. You enjoy sharing your knowledge, for example by speaking at events or writing publications.
In addition, we would like to see the following experience:
Ready to apply?
Do you recognize yourself in our values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, Integrity – and do you want to make an impact at the highest level?
Apply directly or contact our recruitment team ([email protected]) for a coffee meeting with one of our partners or directors.
Your application will consist of three consecutive interviews including a technical, online assessment after the first interview.

Dynamics 365 Specialist F&SCM – Göteborg
Dynamics 365
Specialist: F&SCM
 Open positions 
 Gothenburg office 
 Hybrid 
Vi befinner oss på en snabb tillväxtresa och söker nu fler Dynamics 365 Specialists inom Finance & Supply Chain Management till vårt kontor i Göteborg.
Utveckla din karriär och arbeta med spännande globala uppdrag tillsammans med seniora konsulter!
 Ansök här
Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Hos oss jobbar du som en del av ett team med seniora experter och arbetar 100% fokuserat i ett projekt – tillsammans. Vi jobbar med stora kunder som har huvudsäte i Sverige, men som är aktiva på den globala marknaden.
Våra främsta områden är Manufacturing, Retail, och Professional Services och vi fokuserar på globala utrullningar, där vi jobbar med hela D365 plattformen och end to end processer (full omnichannel, från e-handel till kassor). Vi har också färdiga projekt att ansluta till, vilket ger dig en smidig start när du börjar hos oss.
 Vi söker dig som:
Har flerårig erfarenhet Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM. 
Har erfarenhet av någon/några end-to-end processer inom Microsoft Dynamics.
Har erfarenhet av att förbereda och driva workshops och kravinsamling.
Är flytande i svenska och engelska (både tal och skrift).
Meriterande kvalifikationer:
Erfarenhet inom retail och/eller manufacturing.
Kunskap om agila principer och Azure DevOps.
Kompetens inom Power Platform och/eller Azure.
Vårt team
Vi har ett starkt anseende för att leverera hög kvalitet och vårt team består av de allra bästa i branschen. 
Du kommer alltid att arbeta i nära samarbete tillsammans med seniora konsulter, som är experter inom sitt område. Hos oss jobbar du också tillsammans med Sveriges enda ”FastTrack Recognized”- lösnings arkitekter och Microsoft MVPs inom Dynamics Finance and Supply Chain, vilket ger dig ett stort utrymme att utvecklas ihop med dina kollegor.
Utvecklas med oss
Vi erbjuder även möjligheten att ta nästa steg i din karriär. Engage Group är ett kunskapshus där vi regelbundet genomför kompetensutveckling, webinars och mentorskapsprogram och du har möjlighet att bli lösningsarkitekt eller domänexpert. 
För att stödja dig i din utveckling, har du alltid stöttning av erfarna kollegor och chefer genom hela processen, allt för att du ska trivas och känna dig trygg med din arbetsinsats.
Engage Group är ett ”Great Place to Work”
Vi är stolta över att vara Great Place to Work Certified™. Certifieringen baseras helt på vad våra medarbetare säger om att arbeta hos oss, och 98 % av vårt team uppger att Engage Group är ett ”Great Place To Work”. 
Utöver certifieringen är vi utnämda till en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser 2026!
Varje år uppmärksammar Great Place to Work Sweden organisationer där medarbetarna själva har gett sina arbetsgivare de högsta betygen. Det vi alla har gemensamt är en mycket hög nivå av förtroende mellan ledare och medarbetare.
Vår kultur
Vi är familjära experter. Vi stöttar varandra och möter kunders utmaningar tillsammans – något som genomsyrar hela vår kultur.
Vi främjar tätt samarbete och vi arrangerar regelbundet sociala aktiviteter som AW:s och sportaktiviteter. För att fira våra gemensamma framgångar, så har vi årligen en större konferens utomlands, för att stärka banden internt också utanför ordinarie arbetstid.
Vi erbjuder en hybrid arbetsplats där work-life balance är i fokus och du har alltid nära till ett av våra kontor runtom i Sverige (Jönköping, Kalmar, Malmö, Göteborg, Stockholm).
Läs mer om vår kultur på karriärsidan. 
 Vad tycker dina framtida kollegor?
Hör från blivande kollegor om varför de valde Engage Group:
“Jag valde Engage för deras omfattande erfarenhet och kompetens inom Dynamics-plattformen. Att arbeta med några av de bästa inom området kommer att ge mig möjlighet att fortsätta lära mig samtidigt som jag bidrar till spännande projekt världen över, både nu och i framtiden.”
“Jag valde att börja på Engage Group eftersom jag vill arbeta med några av de bästa inom mitt område. Jag blev imponerad av de andra specialisterna och kompetensen inom företaget och vill gärna vara en del av det, samt vara en del av ett nytt och modernt företag som snabbt expanderar. Jag ser fram emot framtiden på Engage och hoppas kunna lära mig och dela mycket kunskap här.”
“Jag valde Engage för att arbeta med spännande projekt världen över tillsammans med några av de bästa experterna inom Dynamics 365. Med en informell och entreprenöriell företagskultur, korta beslutsvägar och en samarbetsinriktad kultur är Engage en perfekt match för mig.”
Engage Group
Engage är ett expertkonsultföretag inom Microsoft Dynamics 365. Våra medarbetare är branschledande specialister inom Dynamics-ekosystemet och fokuserar på toppmoderna lösningar. Våra kunder är baserade i Sverige men har en global närvaro och vår verksamhet är internationell.
Vi har 100+ anställda på kontor i Stockholm (HQ), Göteborg, Malmö, Jönköping och Kalmar. Engage har en långsiktig tillväxtplan och du kommer att bli en del av ett företag som växer snabbt på en mycket intressant marknad.
Ansök här!
Skicka in din ansökan till John Klingvall: jon.klingvall@engagegroup.se
Vill du veta mer om oss eller har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta oss på contact@engagenow.com eller läs mer på vår karriärsida.

 Jon Klingvall 
 Business Unit Manager West 
 jon.klingvall@engagegroup.se
