 Deal Pricing Analyst
 Job id: 
 36767
 Job location: 
 JP
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
What you will do
The Deal Pricing Analyst plays a key role in supporting customer opportunities across the APAC region by providing financial analysis, pricing guidance, and commercial support to the Sales team.
Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Finance teams, you will evaluate deal profitability, assess customer requirements, and develop commercial solutions that balance customer needs with business objectives. Your insights and recommendations will directly contribute to successful deal outcomes and support the company's growth and performance.
We are looking for a proactive and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex situations, solving business challenges, and adapting to a fast-paced, evolving environment. The ideal candidate is a continuous learner who thrives in cross-functional collaboration and is passionate about driving impactful business decisions.
What we're looking for
Job Description
Drive, Provide commercial support for Colt products including but not limited to Optical, Ethernet, IPVPN, IP Access, and Managed Services.
Act as trusted adviser to Sales on pricing, product configuration, and business terms to support the sales effort.
Work with Sales Team, Engineers, Product Managers, Finance or Vendors to come up with lowest cost solutions that best fit customer requirements.
Utilize various tools such as Excel and other internal systems to structure the deals.
Understand technical, financial and commercial requirements and translate them into pricing outcomes.
Identify issues, assess options and recommend practical solutions.
Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with internal processes and approval requirements.
Continuously develop knowledge of products, services, technologies and commercial models.
Role Requirements
Strong analytical and numerical capability
Ability to interpret financial information and assess commercial impacts
Logical thinker with strong problem-solving skills
Strong relationship building skills to quickly establish credibility and rapport with sales and key stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and apply new knowledge effectively
Advanced Excel modelling skills
Business-level English and Japanese communication skills
Other preferences
Proactive, independent with strong sense of ownership
Deploy high degrees of diplomacy and cultural awareness
Ability to think and act internationally and cross functionally
Ability to work under multi-task, pressure and tight deadlines
Experience in deal pricing, deal desk, commercial finance, business analysis, sales, bid support or related fields
Logical thinking
Team player
Customer Oriented
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

 Account Executive - Enterprise Growth & Strategic Development
 Job id: 
 36567
 Job location: 
 London, GB
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
As an Account Executive in our Large Enterprise Account Development team, your mission is to manage some key accounts and revive, grow, and transform Colt’s footprint across dormant, dim, and low-spend enterprise customers. You will spearhead the creation of tailored account strategies, develop C-suite relationships, and enable multi-disciplinary virtual teams to deliver business outcomes through Colt’s innovative portfolio.
What you will do
Strategic Business Development
•    Enable the development of growth strategies across a defined portfolio of dormant, low-engagement, or dark enterprise accounts.
•    Re-energize and expand relationships within multi-site, complex organisations to re-establish Colt as a trusted partner.
•    Identify whitespace opportunities and engage stakeholders at all levels with a consultative approach.
Executive-Level Engagement
•    Build and sustain relationships with senior stakeholders, including CxO-level, aligning Colt’s solutions to evolving customer outcomes.
•    Drive strategic account planning and executive briefings to strengthen long-term partnerships.
Data-Led Sales Execution
•    Use insights to prioritize opportunities, develop value propositions, and shape winning strategies.
•    Own and manage pipeline and forecasting accuracy using modern sales methodologies (e.g. Challenger, MEDDPICC, SPIN).
Revenue Generation & Cross-Sell
•    Drive incremental revenue by expanding Colt’s footprint within existing underperforming enterprise accounts.
•    Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Colt’s portfolio including cloud connectivity, SD-WAN, security, and voice.
Internal Collaboration
•    Orchestrate virtual teams across Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Delivery to drive pre-sales and post-sales execution.
•    Act as a trusted advisor and mentor to less experienced account executives and support peer enablement.
What we're looking for
•    Recent and relevant enterprise sales experience in B2B environments, ideally within digital infrastructure, telco, IT services, or SaaS.
•    Demonstrated ability to revive dormant accounts, activate whitespace, and consistently exceed growth targets.
•    Proven track record managing complex, multi-divisional enterprise accounts with international presence.
•    Deep experience in executive stakeholder management and strategic opportunity creation.
•    Exceptional commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and the ability to balance long-term vision with short-term execution.
•    Ability to translate customer outcomes into commercially viable solutions across networking, cloud, and digital transformation domains.
•    Self-directed, entrepreneurial, and motivated by outcomes – not activity.
•    Strong command of pipeline discipline, forecasting accuracy, and CRM hygiene (e.g., Salesforce).
•    Proficiency in consultative and insight-led selling methodologies.
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.
Job Segment: 
 Data Center, Work from Home, Network, CRM, Technology, Contract

Veeva Vault Technical Consultant
As a Veeva Vault Technical Consultant, you will make an impact by leading the design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of Veeva Vault solutions that support compliant and scalable business processes. You will be a valued member of the technology team, partnering with business stakeholders, product owners, functional teams, and cross-functional partners to deliver high-quality solutions that support research and development programs.
In this role, you will:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of Veeva Vault Promomats solutions supporting content lifecycle management, review and approval workflows, and compliant content distribution.
Develop and maintain Veeva Vault Platform configurations, including data models, workflows, metadata structures, security settings, and integrations that support business processes.
Execute end-to-end Veeva Vault migration activities, including data mapping, transformation, validation, testing, deployment, and data quality assurance.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development and support teams while promoting best practices and ensuring high-quality solution delivery.
Drive solution development, testing, deployment, production support, and platform optimization initiatives to improve reliability, scalability, and user experience.
Work model:
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
What you need to have to be considered
Strong experience in Veeva Vault technologies with strong expertise in Veeva Vault Promomats, Vault Platform, Vault Migrations, and Vault CRM.
Experience designing, configuring, and implementing Veeva Vault solutions supporting regulated business processes.
Strong experience with Vault Platform configuration, including data models, workflows, metadata structures, security models, and integrations.
Proven experience executing end-to-end Veeva Vault migration projects, including data mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and deployment activities.
Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze processes, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Hands-on experience supporting solution development, testing, deployment, production support, and issue resolution.
Strong understanding of governance, security controls, validation processes, and compliance-oriented system configurations.
Experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and guiding solution design and delivery.
These will help you stand out
Experience improving scientific and operational workflows through Veeva platform capabilities.
Strong expertise in system performance monitoring, optimization, and scalability improvements.
Experience leading functional, system, integration, and user acceptance testing activities.
Demonstrated success troubleshooting complex production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions.
Experience preparing technical documentation, including design specifications, migration strategies, release notes, and support procedures.
Experience evaluating and adopting new platform features and industry best practices to improve business outcomes.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Applications will be accepted until 10/30/2026
Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future.
Salary and Other Compensation
The annual salary for this position is between $83,000pa - $145,000pa depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans.
Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:
Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.
#LI-SS2
Additional employment information
Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.
Applicants may be required to attend interviews in person or by video conference. In addition, candidates may be required to present their current state or government issued ID during each interview.
Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
Applicants for US based positions must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States. The company is unable to provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for US based positions.
If you have a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening or submit an application, please email CareersNA2@cognizant.com for roles based in the Americas or CareersIndia2@cognizant.com for roles based in India.

Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization’s unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. Benefits that help you thrive and grow
Our benefits program is built with you in mind—so you can enjoy a fulfilling, balanced and healthy life.
Financial wellbeing
We regularly review market data to ensure compensation reflects the value you bring. Your benefits extend beyond pay and may include retirement plans, financial education, etc.
Physical and mental health
We empower you to prioritize your wellbeing through paid time off, flexible working where possible, healthcare plans, counselling, our Mental Health Allyship program and more. 
Your career, your way
With 350,000+ roles at Cognizant, you’ll have opportunities explore new technologies, industries and locations—and build the skills you need to grow your career.
Real-world impact
Think about the biggest brands you rely on. Chances are, they rely on us to help strengthen their business. Here, you’ll turn bold ideas into solutions that improve lives everywhere.
Your path to Cognizant
Here’s what you can expect from our hiring process. Please keep in mind that it may vary by role and location. Explore our FAQs to learn more.
Step 1: Apply to the right opportunity
Find an open role that matches your skills and career goals and show us why you’re the person for the job. Don’t see the right opportunity? Consider joining our Talent Community.
Step 2: Connect with your recruiter
If one of our recruiters sees a fit, they’ll set up a short intro call to learn more about you and how your experiences and skills match the role.
Step 3: Show off your skills
If you and our team would like to continue the process, you’ll interview with our hiring team. Some roles may also require technical assessments and/or client interviews.
Step 4: Decision time
Our team will then review each candidates’ potential to succeed in the role. This step may take some time because we want to find the right fit for both you and us—but you can count on us to keep you updated.

 Account executive professional services major accounts
 Job id: 
 36614
 Job location: 
 London, GB
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
As an account manager in our UK professional services team, you’ll be responsible for driving strategic growth across Colt’s key large professional services customers. This role is centred on deepening existing relationships through consultative upsell and cross-sell of Colt’s solutions
What you will do
Lead strategic growth initiatives across Colt’s largest UK professional services customers.
Develop and execute tailored account strategies aligned with the business priorities of professional services institutions.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across complex, multi-site professional services organisations.
Use data and insights to prioritise accounts and shape high-impact strategies.
Drive revenue growth through consultative upsell and cross-sell across Colt’s portfolio (cloud, SD-WAN, security, voice).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution from pre-sales through to delivery.
What we're looking for
Recent and relevant B2B enterprise sales experience, ideally in digital infrastructure, telco, IT services, or SaaS.
Experience working with or selling into large professional services organisations is highly desirable.
A proven track record of growing strategic accounts and reviving dormant relationships.
Experience managing complex enterprise clients with a consultative, outcome-based approach.
Strong commercial acumen and familiarity with sales methodologies like Challenger, MEDDPICC, or SPIN.
A self-starter mindset with a passion for strategic selling and long-term client success.
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
This is a Remote Opportunity based in New York/New Jersey
How You'll Make An Impact:
As a key contributor to our sales team, you will play a pivotal role in formulating and executing a comprehensive sales strategy within your assigned region. Your primary responsibility will be to carry the quota for the entire Boomi suite of products, driving revenue growth within the existing customer base. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will closely collaborate with current customers to deeply understand their company challenges and goals.
Your role will extend to consulting with customers on the Boomi Platform, advocating solutions that align with their business objectives and pave the way for innovation within their organizations. Operating in a fast-paced, collaborative, and enjoyable atmosphere, you will be an integral part of our sales community, actively contributing to our business growth.
What You Will Do:
Formulate and execute a sales strategy within an assigned region.
Carry quota for the entire Boomi suite of products and drive revenue growth within your existing customer base.  
Work closely with current customers as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique company challenges and goals. 
Consult with customers on the Boomi Platform to evangelize solutions that will help them reach their business goals and blaze new trails within their organizations. 
Contribute to our business growth in a fast-paced, collaborative, and fun atmosphere, as a valued member of our sales community.
Participate in the development and management of local field events
The Experience You Bring:
 5+ years of Enterprise sales experience in technology field sales. 
Data Integration or similar domain experience required.
SaaS experience required.
5+ years of experience creating and implementing long-term transformational account strategies in a customer-facing role.
Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations.
Cross-functional selling experience (Architect, CTO, VP Ecommerce, Professional Services) and selling with GSI/SI.
Experience selling technical platform solutions and aligning technical solutions to business initiatives.
Experience using Salesforce, Clari, and MEDPPIC model preferred

 Sales Specialist
 Job id: 
 36783
 Job location: 
 JP
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
As a Senior (Partner) Account Executive, you will be responsible for managing and growing an existing portfolio of enterprise customers and/or business partners (System Integrators), while also identifying new growth opportunities within your assigned territory.
This position is a backfill role, and therefore requires someone who can take ownership of existing accounts, maintain trusted customer relationships, and ensure business continuity, while gradually expanding and developing the territory.
Although “Senior” is the job title, this is not a management role. Instead, it requires a high level of independence, ownership, and initiative, as sales professionals at Colt are expected to proactively drive opportunities forward in a lean, fast-moving environment. 
Why This Role Is Attractive
Immediate responsibility for existing customers and ongoing business
Significant autonomy in how you manage accounts and prioritize opportunities
Ability to proactively raise your hand for customers or territories where you can add the most value
Exposure to global deals leveraging Colt’s strong European and international footprint
Rare opportunity to work for a foreign-owned company operating its own fiber network in Japan
Broad solution portfolio spanning network, cloud connectivity, security and managed services
What you will do
Manage and further develop an existing portfolio of enterprise customers and/or business partners
Drive new bookings and revenue in line with personal and company sales targets
Own the full sales cycle, including:
Opportunity identification
Solution design and proposal creation
Pricing, negotiation, and contract closing
Post-sales customer engagement
Work closely with Solution Engineers to design and propose solutions that address customers’ business and technical requirements
Propose and sell Colt’s services, including:
WAN / MAN
Cloud Connectivity
Internet Access
Managed Services, ISP, and Professional Services
Build and maintain strong relationships with customer executives and key stakeholders
Develop and execute account and territory plans based on business priorities
Maintain accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management in line with internal processes
Collaborate with global teams, solution partners, and offshore resources as required
*Comprehensive product and solution training will be provided upon joining.
What we're looking for
5+ years of experience in B2B IT or technology-related sales
Business level in Japanese and English
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
Experience managing existing customer relationships and complex sales cycles
Practical understanding of the SI business model and how system integrators work with end users（direct SI experience is not mandatory, but real-world exposure is expected）
Ability to operate independently and proactively in an environment with limited hand-holding
Experience selling network, cloud, data center, or telecommunications services
Experience working with system integrators or channel partners
Experience selling to enterprise customers (financial service experience is a plus)
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

 Work from Home, Telecom, Telecommunications, Network, Data Center, Contract, Technology

Dynamics 365 Specialist: CE utvecklare (Stockholm)
JOB OPENINGS
Vi befinner oss på en snabb tillväxtresa med många nya projekt som startar och vi söker nu fler Dynamics 365 CE utvecklare som vill utvecklas i sin karriär och arbeta med spännande uppdrag.
Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Hos oss jobbar du som en del av ett team med seniora experter och jobbar 100% fokuserat i ett projekt, tillsammans. Vi jobbar med stora kunder som har huvudsäte i Sverige, men som är aktiva på den globala marknaden. Våra främsta områden är Manufacturing, Retail, och Professional Services och vi fokuserar på globala utrullningar, där vi jobbar med hela D365 plattformen och end to end processer (full omnichannel, från e-handel till kassor osv). Vi har också färdiga projekt att ansluta till, vilket ger dig en smidig start när du börjar hos oss.
Utvecklas med oss
Vi erbjuder även möjligheten att ta nästa steg i din karriär. Engage Group är ett kunskapshus där vi regelbundet genomför kompetensutveckling, webinars och mentorskapsprogram, och du har möjlighet att bli lösningsarkitekt eller domän expert. För att stödja dig i din utveckling, har du alltid stöttning av erfarna kollegor och en stöttande chef genom hela processen, allt för att du skall trivas och känna dig trygg med din arbetsinsats.
Vårt team
Vi har ett starkt anseende för att leverera hög kvalitet och vårt team består av de allra bästa i branschen. Du kommer alltid att arbeta i nära samarbete tillsammans med seniora konsulter, som är experter inom sitt område. Hos oss jobbar du också tillsammans med Sveriges enda FastTrack Recognized lösnings arkitekter och MVPer inom Dynamics Finance and Supplychain, vilket ger dig ett stort utrymme att utvecklas ihop med dina kollegor.
Vår kultur
Vi är stolta över att att kalla oss familjära experter, då vi stöttar varandra och möter kunders utmaningar tillsammans, något som genomsyrar hela vår kultur. Vi främjar tätt samarbete och vi arrangerar regelbundet sociala aktiviteter som AW:s och deltagande på sportaktiviteter. För att fira våra gemensamma framgångar, så har vi årligen en större konferens (oftast utanför Sverige), för att stärka banden internt också utanför ordinarie arbetstid. Tillsammans med vår informella och entreprenöriella företagskultur och korta beslutsvägar gör detta Engage till en perfekt match för dig som vill ta nästa steg.
Vi erbjuder en hybrid arbetsplats där work-life balance är i fokus och du har alltid nära till ett av våra kontor runtom i Sverige (Jönköping, Kalmar, Malmö, Göteborg, Stockholm).
Varför valde du Engage?
Hör från blivande kollegor om varför de valde just Engage Group:
”Jag valde Engage för deras omfattande erfarenhet och kompetens inom Dynamics-plattformen. Att arbeta med några av de bästa inom området kommer att ge mig möjlighet att fortsätta lära mig samtidigt som jag bidrar till spännande projekt världen över, både nu och i framtiden.”
”Jag valde att börja på Engage Group eftersom jag vill arbeta med några av de bästa inom mitt område. Jag blev imponerad av de andra specialisterna och kompetensen inom företaget och vill gärna vara en del av det, samt vara en del av ett nytt och modernt företag som snabbt expanderar. Jag ser fram emot framtiden på Engage och hoppas kunna lära mig och dela mycket kunskap här.”
”Jag valde Engage för att arbeta med spännande projekt världen över tillsammans med några av de bästa experterna inom Dynamics 365. Med en informell och entreprenöriell företagskultur, korta beslutsvägar och en samarbetsinriktad kultur är Engage en perfekt match för mig.”
Vill du bli en del av vårt team? Vi söker dig som:
Har gedigen erfarenhet av utveckling, anpassning och implementation inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE
Kunskap inom C#, .NET och JavaScript
Förmåga att felsöka och lösa tekniska problem
God förståelse för affärsprocesser och CRM-best practices
Mycket god kommunikations- och dokumentationsförmåga
Kandidatexamen inom datavetenskap, IT eller motsvarande område
Är flytande i svenska och engelska.
Meriterande kvalifikationer:
Relevanta certifieringar inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE ses som en fördel
Erfarenhet av Power Platform, Azure och andra Microsoft-teknologier 
Om rollen
Detta är en heltidstjänst i hybrid form för en Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE – Utvecklare. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm med möjlighet till delvis distansarbete. 
I rollen ingår att utveckla, anpassa och implementera lösningar i Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE utifrån kundernas behov. Dina dagliga uppgifter innefattar kodning, felsökning och hantering av tekniska problem, samt samarbete med kollegor och kunder för att säkerställa framgångsrika projektleveranser. 
Rollen innebär även att ta fram dokumentation, ge användarstöd och hålla sig uppdaterad kring nyheter och best practices inom Dynamics 365.
Om Engage Group
Engage är ett expertkonsultföretag inom Microsoft Dynamics. Våra medarbetare är branschledande specialister inom Dynamics-ekosystemet och fokuserar på toppmoderna lösningar för Dynamics-miljön. Våra kunder är baserade i Sverige men har en global närvaro och vår verksamhet är internationell.
Vi har 100+ anställda på kontor i Jönköping, Göteborg, Malmö, Kalmar och Stockholm. Engage har en långsiktig tillväxtplan och du kommer att bli en del av ett företag som växer snabbt på en mycket intressant marknad.
Intresseanmälan:
Vi ser fram emot att arbeta med dig. Känner du likadant för oss? Om du vill veta mer, kontakta oss på contact@engagenow.com eller läs mer på vår karriärsida. För frågor kontakta Jonathan Bucht (Business Unit Manager) på jonathan.bucht@engagegroup.se.

Job Title: SQL Server Database Administrator
Job Location: Remote, USA.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA) to join our enterprise infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the administration, performance optimization, security, availability, and modernization of mission-critical Microsoft SQL Server environments. This role requires deep expertise in SQL Server administration, High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) technologies, performance tuning, automation, and cloud-based database services.
The successful candidate will support large-scale production environments, collaborate with development and infrastructure teams, and drive database modernization initiatives within a highly available, enterprise-grade ecosystem.
Salary and Other Compensation:
The annual salary for this position is between $99,000 to $115,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.
In this role, you will
Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server environments across production, development, test, and disaster recovery platforms.
Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity while performing proactive tuning of queries, stored procedures, indexes, statistics, and execution plans.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex database issues including performance bottlenecks, blocking, locking, deadlocks, and system outages.
Design, implement, and support High Availability and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) solutions including Always On Availability Groups, Clustering, Replication, Mirroring, and Log Shipping.
Develop, test, and maintain backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery strategies to ensure data integrity and availability.
Support application development teams by creating, optimizing, and troubleshooting T-SQL code, stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers.
Participate in database architecture reviews, migration projects, upgrades, and modernization initiatives to improve scalability and performance.
Automate routine DBA tasks using SQL Server Agent, PowerShell, and enterprise automation tools to enhance operational efficiency.
Implement and maintain database monitoring solutions, dashboards, operational documentation, standards, and runbooks.
Administer and support Azure-based database platforms, including Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs, and Azure Storage services.
Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to support incidents, audits, deployments, compliance requirements, and enterprise projects.
Provide expert production support, participate in on-call rotations, and serve as a trusted advisor for database performance, security, availability, and operational excellence.
What you’ll need to succeed (required skills)
8+ years of SQL Server Database Administration experience
SQL Server 2012/2014/2016/2017/2019+
HA/DR technologies (Always On, Clustering, Replication, Mirroring, Log Shipping)
Performance Tuning & Query Optimization
Backup & Recovery Administration
T-SQL Development and Troubleshooting
Production Support Experience
Windows Server Administration
Preferred Skills
Azure SQL Database and Azure Managed Instance
PowerShell Automation
Idera, Redgate, SQL Sentry, or SolarWinds DPA
Jenkins and CI/CD integrations
SSIS, SSRS, Oracle GoldenGate
Insurance, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Claims Management domain experience
Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:
Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Work model:
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote role in USA.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
You will own a portfolio of existing enterprise customers and also bringing new logos. Working primarily by phone and email, you will protect and grow our base across Colt Solutions while hunting for new logos in your territory.
What you will do
Own and manage a portfolio of existing customers, with ownership of retention, renewals and revenue growth
Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Colt solutions.
Proactively prospect, qualify and convert new customers through outbound calls, emails and social selling.
Generate and qualify leads to support Existing Account Executives, handing over warm opportunities with clear context
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, with accurate forecasting and CRM hygiene
Act as the day-to-day commercial contact for assigned customers: quotes, contract renewals, queries and escalations
Work with Existing Account Executives, Sales Engineers, CRM, Service Delivery to close opportunities and ensure customers satisfaction.
Meet or exceed annual targets for revenue and bookings- retention and new business
What we're looking for
Fluent in written and spoken English and Mandarin. Fluent Cantonese will be an plus.
Minimum 2 years of working experience
Experience in inside sales or sales support in the technology or telecommunications industry is highly preferred
Independent self-starter who works well with minimal supervision
Strong drive to retain and grow an existing customer base
A hunter's mindset, with genuine enjoyment of speaking to customers and prospects by phone and email
Excellent communication, negotiation and follow-up discipline
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment
Experience with using Salesforce and related sales support systems.
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Utløpt
Group Controller
Documaster AS
For å kunne se fremover må du forstå historien din. Det er derfor vi er så opptatt av dokumenthåndtering. Ved å bruke ny teknologi og fokusere på å gjøre det enkelt, har vi laget et verktøy som sikrer verdifull dokumentasjon for institusjoner og offentlig forvaltning.
Vi er 125 kollegaer med kontorer i Sofia, Stockholm, London,  Ålesund, Trondheim og Oslo.  Det som kjennetegner oss er at vi er alle opptatt av faget vårt. Våre kunder sier at vi er hyggelig å være sammen med, vi er genuint opptatt av å få til en best mulig løsning, og vi er nerder innenfor vårt fag. Det tar vi som et kompliment.
Documaster er et ungt og spennende gründerselskap med sterk vekst. Økonomiteamet preges av dyp regnskapsforståelse og høy gjennomføringsevne. Vi har en sterk kultur som kjennetegnes av mennesker som liker høyt tempo, tør å ta avgjørelser, og som støtter hverandre.
På vegne av Documaster søker vi en faglig sterk og ambisiøs Group Controller med overordnet ansvar for konsernregnskap og konsolidering. Documaster er et ledende IT-selskap innenfor digital arkivering som har mangedoblet omsetningen de siste årene. Selskapet er PE-eid og har klare ambisjoner om kraftig vekst videre, både organisk og gjennom gjennom oppkjøp. I stillingen vil du være ansvarlig for utarbeidelse av konsernregnskapet som per dags dato består av 7 selskaper, kvalitetssikre regnskapet og ha tett dialog med regnskapsbyrå, utarbeide finansiell rapportering, samt bistå ved oppkjøp og finansiell due diligence av oppkjøpskandidater, integrering av oppkjøpte selskaper og ERP-implementering. Du vil være en faglig støtte for CFO og øvrige på økonomifunksjonen. Dette er en sentral og synlig rolle med bred kontaktflate i konsernet. 
Vi ser etter deg som med revisorbakgrunn eller noen års operativ erfaring fra financial controlling/regnskap, og som kan tenke deg å være med på en spennende reise. Har du erfaring med transaksjoner er det en fordel. Du må være sulten, ambisiøs og trives med å jobbe i et selskap med høyt tempo. Du er sterk i Excel og har god systemforståelse. Stillingen rapporterer til CFO og er lokalisert i flotte og moderne lokaler på Skøyen. 
Ansvarsområder
Konsolidering og utarbeidelse av konsernregnskap i henhold til NGAAP 
Kvalitetssikre regnskapet til det norske selskapet og følge opp regnskapsbyrå
Følge opp og være en faglig støtte på regnskap for datterselskaper
Utarbeide måneds- og kvartalsrapportering 
Bygge effektive strukturer for konsolidering og rapportering
Bistå med budsjett og prognoser 
Bistå ved prosesser knyttet til oppkjøp og DD
Bistå med integrering av oppkjøpte selskaper
Kontakt med revisor og regnskapsbyrå
Bidra med prosessforbedringer og effektiviseringsprosesser
Bidra med systemimplementering
Kvalifikasjoner
Høyere økonomisk utdannelse på masternivå med gode akademiske resultater
Minimum 3-5  års relevant erfaring fra revisjon, regnskap eller controlling
Gode ferdigheter i Excel og økonomisystemer
Beherske norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig
Personlige egenskaper
Du trives med utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver og høyt tempo
Strukturert, fremoverlent og løsningsorientert
Analytisk tankesett med øye for detaljer
Lagspiller med gode kommunikasjonsevner
Selvgående med evne til å strukturere eget arbeid og driver prosjekter fremover
Vi tilbyr
En variert og faglig utfordrende rolle i et PE-eid selskap i sterk vekst 
Gode utviklingsmuligheter
Kompetent, uformelt og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø
Moderne lokaler og sentral beliggenhet på Skøyen
Konkurransedyktige betingelser. Muligheter til å kjøpe eierandeler 
Søkere bes registrere seg med CV, vitnemål fra høyere utdanning og arbeidsattester.

Nødvendig
Nødvendige informasjonskapsler er helt avgjørende for at nettstedet skal fungere som det skal og være sikkert å bruke. Vi bruker tre informasjonskapsler som beskytter informasjonen din, holder deg innlogget og sørger for en smidig og god brukeropplevelse. Uten disse tre informasjonskapslene måtte du logget inn flere ganger, og mange funksjoner ville ikke fungert som de skal. Vi bruker disse kapslene for å forstå hvilke sider som er populære, hvordan brukere navigerer på nettstedet, og hvilket innhold som engasjerer mest. Denne innsikten hjelper oss å forbedre ytelsen og skape en bedre brukeropplevelse. Informasjonen er anonym og brukes kun til analyseformål. Uten disse kapslene ville vi hatt begrenset innsikt i hvordan vi kan gjøre nettstedet bedre og mer brukervennlig.

Veeva Vault Technical Consultant
As a Veeva Vault Technical Consultant, you will make an impact by leading the design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of Veeva Vault solutions that support compliant and scalable business processes. You will be a valued member of the technology team, partnering with business stakeholders, product owners, functional teams, and cross-functional partners to deliver high-quality solutions that support research and development programs.
In this role, you will:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of Veeva Vault Promomats solutions supporting content lifecycle management, review and approval workflows, and compliant content distribution.
Develop and maintain Veeva Vault Platform configurations, including data models, workflows, metadata structures, security settings, and integrations that support business processes.
Execute end-to-end Veeva Vault migration activities, including data mapping, transformation, validation, testing, deployment, and data quality assurance.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development and support teams while promoting best practices and ensuring high-quality solution delivery.
Drive solution development, testing, deployment, production support, and platform optimization initiatives to improve reliability, scalability, and user experience.
Work model:
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
What you need to have to be considered
Strong experience in Veeva Vault technologies with strong expertise in Veeva Vault Promomats, Vault Platform, Vault Migrations, and Vault CRM.
Experience designing, configuring, and implementing Veeva Vault solutions supporting regulated business processes.
Strong experience with Vault Platform configuration, including data models, workflows, metadata structures, security models, and integrations.
Proven experience executing end-to-end Veeva Vault migration projects, including data mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and deployment activities.
Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze processes, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Hands-on experience supporting solution development, testing, deployment, production support, and issue resolution.
Strong understanding of governance, security controls, validation processes, and compliance-oriented system configurations.
Experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and guiding solution design and delivery.
These will help you stand out
Experience improving scientific and operational workflows through Veeva platform capabilities.
Strong expertise in system performance monitoring, optimization, and scalability improvements.
Experience leading functional, system, integration, and user acceptance testing activities.
Demonstrated success troubleshooting complex production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions.
Experience preparing technical documentation, including design specifications, migration strategies, release notes, and support procedures.
Experience evaluating and adopting new platform features and industry best practices to improve business outcomes.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Applications will be accepted until 10/30/2026
Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future.
Salary and Other Compensation
The annual salary for this position is between $83,000pa - $145,000pa depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans.

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions

Employee Stock Purchase Plan

 Job id: 
 36503
 Job location: 
 Bangalore, IN
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure. 
Specialist, IT Infrastructure Engineer
Job ID: 36503
Job Level: S2 Core
Job Location: Gurugram / Bangalore
Function:Digital & Information Office (DIO)
Employment Type:  Full time
Working pattern: Hybrid
Why we need this role
The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (M365, Azure, GCP & Identity) is responsible for the engineering, implementation, and operational support of Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and enterprise identity (AD/Entra).
The role delivers secure, standardised, and automated solutions, translating architectural designs, standards, and roadmaps into robust, scalable platform implementations and operational services.
Working as a senior technical expert within the engineering team, the role collaborates with Architecture, Security, Development, and Operations teams to ensure solutions are delivered, integrated, and operated effectively.
It embeds security, resilience, automation, and operability by implementation, driving consistency and optimisation across M365, Azure, GCP, and Identity platforms. Through engineering excellence, the role reduces risk, complexity, and manual effort, improves resilience and service stability, and supports cost-efficient platform operations.
What you will do
Engineers and supports solutions across M365, Azure, GCP, and Identity, ensuring platforms, tooling, interfaces, and configurations are secure, resilient, automated, and operationally effective.
Microsoft 365 Platforms: Implementation, configuration, and support of collaboration and productivity services (inc. Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune), including governance controls, security settings, and lifecycle activities
Azure Cloud: Deployment and support of landing zones, subscriptions, connectivity, platform services, and governance controls aligned to architectural standards
Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Implementation and operational support of project structures, networking, workload environments, and security configurations
Identity & Access: Engineering and operation of Active Directory and Entra ID, including authentication, Conditional Access, privileged access, identity governance, and directory integration
Cloud Security & Compliance: Implementation and maintenance of secure configurations, monitoring, logging, encryption, and policy enforcement across cloud and identity platforms
Delivers and supports standardisation, automation, tooling, and consistency across cloud, workplace, and identity platforms
What we're looking for
 1. Solution Engineering & Operation
Implement and operate infrastructure and platform solutions aligned to architectures, standards, and patterns
Build, configure, and operate end-to-end cloud, M365, and identity solutions
Act as senior escalation point for engineering and operational issues
2. Security, Resilience & Operability
Implement and operate secure-by-design configurations
Ensure resilience, recoverability, monitoring, and operational readiness are delivered and sustained
3. Roadmap Execution
Deliver and operate roadmap initiatives and platform improvements
Support planning and execution of engineering and operational changes
4. Cross-Domain Collaboration
Work with Architecture, Security, Development, and Infrastructure teams to deliver integrated solutions
Ensure solutions are tested, transitioned, and fully operational
5. Vendor & Technology Engagement
Work with vendors to support implementation, operation, and issue resolution
Contribute to platform, tooling, and operational improvements
6. Operational Governance & Support
Ensure solutions align to standards and are maintained through BAU lifecycle
Support incident, problem, and continuous service improvement activities
7. Automation, Standardisation & Optimisation
Implement and operate automation-first solutions
Reduce manual effort, technical debt, and complexity
Improve stability, consistency, and operational efficiency at scale
Operational Support
Participate in an on-call rota for priority incident support
Leadership & Behavioural Expectations
Operates as a senior engineer with strong ownership, accountability, and delivery focus.
Ownership & Execution: Delivers reliable, secure solutions end-to-end, translating design into high-quality implementation
Technical Leadership: Acts as SME across cloud, M365, and identity, resolving complex technical challenges
Collaboration & Influence: Works effectively across teams, contributing to design decisions and stakeholder outcomes
Adaptability & Improvement: Responds to challenges while driving automation, optimisation, and clear communication
Qualification
Extensive experience in engineering and supporting cloud, workplace, and identity platforms
Strong expertise across:
Microsoft 365 configuration, administration, and security
Azure cloud engineering (deployments, governance, connectivity)
GCP engineering (projects, networking, security, operations)
Identity and access (Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication, access control)
Security configuration and resilience practices
Automation and operational tooling (PowerShell, scripts, IaC concepts)
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capability
Experience working in enterprise-scale environments
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Join an international Business Intelligence team supporting the Finance organization of a leading digital business. You'll work with large-scale transactional and behavioral datasets, helping Finance teams gain visibility into revenue, customer activity, player behavior, performance metrics, and business trends through modern reporting and analytics solutions.
We're looking for a Business Intelligence Developer with strong Power BI and SQL skills who enjoys building scalable reporting solutions, working closely with Finance stakeholders, and turning complex data into meaningful business insights.
What you'll do:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions for Finance and business stakeholders
Build and optimize Power BI semantic models and datasets for financial and operational reporting
Analyze large volumes of transactional and player behavior data to identify trends, anomalies, and business opportunities
Develop SQL-based datasets, reporting structures, and analytical models that support Finance processes and decision-making
Work closely with Finance teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable BI solutions
Support financial reporting, planning, forecasting, reconciliation, and ad hoc analysis
Ensure data quality through validation, monitoring, and reconciliation processes
Collaborate with BI colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders to continuously improve reporting and analytics capabilities
What you bring:
Experience working as a BI Developer, Power BI Developer, or similar role
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including dashboards, semantic models, and DAX
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets
Experience working with relational databases such as MSSQL, MySQL, or similar
Experience translating business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills and fluent English
Nice to have:
Experience supporting Finance, Controlling, FP&A, or similar business functions
Experience with ETL processes and data warehousing
Experience with SSRS, SSIS, or SSAS
Knowledge of DAX, T-SQL, MDX, Python, or C#
Experience working with high-volume transactional, gaming, e-commerce, fintech, or digital platform data
Why join:
Work with large-scale datasets and millions of transactions
Gain unique insights into customer and player behavior
Build business-critical Power BI solutions used by the Finance organization
Join an international and collaborative BI team
Work with modern analytics and reporting technologies
Help transform complex data into better financial and business decisions
If you enjoy Power BI, SQL, large datasets, and delivering insights that drive financial performance and business growth — this role is for you.
For the right candidate, we are pleased to offer a competitive compensation and a generous benefits package. Our employees have five weeks of paid vacation per year and health insurances. We support recurring training programs, arrange staff events and have an employees' investment fund. Working for us means a high degree of involvement and we strive for having an open and positive working environment.
If you find our proposal interesting and you meet the above requirements for the position, please send your CV and cover letter in English.
All applications will be treated strictly confidential.

Over the past few years, we’ve experienced substantial growth, and we’re excited to continue expanding our operations. If you’re looking to join an international organization with a Scandinavian-inspired business culture, Comstream is the perfect place for you. We prioritize your professional growth and foster an environment where you can succeed. At Comstream, teamwork is at the heart of everything we do, and we promote a culture where every voice is heard and respected. Our core principles are rooted in collaboration, empowerment, and freedom, creating a workplace where you can truly make an impact.
For more information, please visit our corporate website at www.comstream.eu.

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
The Technical Infrastructure Site Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of Colt’s network infrastructure across France. Responsible for the operational management of mechanical and electrical systems at Colt node sites, long-distance network repeater facilities, and associated offices, this role ensures business continuity through proactive maintenance, robust health and safety practices, and effective management of third-party providers.
Working closely with internal stakeholders, landlords, suppliers, and project teams, you will drive operational excellence, optimise site performance and energy efficiency, manage site operating budgets, and support infrastructure upgrades, expansions, and end-of-life replacement programmes that enable Colt’s network to grow and evolve securely and sustainably
What you will do
Infrastructure and Cost Efficiency:
Ensuring effective management of building services (through third party contractors)
Ensuring site cleanliness (through third party contractors)
Installation of mechanical & electrical infrastructures for the sites assigned to you
Supporting successful compliance of ISO14001 (Environmental), ISO27001 (Information Security Management System),  ISO9001/20000 (Quality & Service Management System)
Business As Usual, day to day operational running of your sites
Maintenance and repair of existing infrastructure
Monitoring of all infrastructure (ensuring all remote & local BMS monitoring is fully functional)
Completing capacity reports when requested
Monitoring of energy efficiency and proactively drive & record savings
Managing maintenance costs
Writing of standard and emergency operations procedures and training of operatives staff
Available for out of hours planned and reactive support, which can involve switching of HV & MV systems and supporting any generating routine testing.
Liaise with Landlord representatives 
Keeping the JCAD risk register up to date with current operational risks
Identifying internal and third-party team technical and professional development and training.
Rack/footprint availability reporting
Small works requests, Capacity Reporting
Site Opex cost controlling (including PO raising and receipting)
Supporting the End Of Life infrastructure equipment and associated Capex forecasting
Energy Efficiency (Targeted Opex cost savings)
Site plant performance trending
.
Managing Risk, Health, Safety and Environmentals:
Managing a safe system of working across all works
Ensuring a ‘Permits To Work ’regime is in place and a PTW’s are issued for all works including Prevention Plan
Undertaking Health & Safety audits and completing supporting checklists
Completing Health & Safety and/or Accident reporting
Influencing safe use of the technical areas by all visitors and contractors (Other dept. sub contractors)
Managing Third-party contractors whilst onsite
Complying with ‘Change Control’ processes
Risk assessment creation and updating method statements to be site and task specific
Ensuring all Health & Safety compliance is in place onsite at all times
Projects:
All projects, i.e. battery replacements, gas bottle replacements, LV/MV breakers, etc.
Infrastructure End Of Life (EOL) replacement works
New Node or container site builds
Node exits
Energy efficiency initiatives and projects
Commercial Support:
M&E contract negotiation and management 
Providing power and environmental solutions to site needs
Assists legal teams in regard to contract negotiation & projects
Delivering site tours if necessary
What we're looking for
Essential
Experience of working with medium/large mission critical Mechanical & Electrical infrastructures in a Supervisory / technical / engineering capacity.
Technical competence in electrical, mechanical and/or cooling disciplines including  transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, DC Systems, ATS/STS units, PDU units, chillers, air handling units, RCU/CRAC units.   
Experience working with controls, security monitoring systems, fire safety systems and working understanding of start-up/commissioning processes.
Strong familiarity with EU safety regulations and controls.
Demonstrated skills in requirements gathering, resource organization, task prioritization, scheduling. 
Demonstration of effective delivery of objectives and assigned tasks
Great attitude with internal and external customers and external parties, and able to address any issues. 
Previous experience in motivating, leading and creating an effective team environment
Effective scheduling and management of third-party technical resources
Excellent inter-personnel skills and ability to work in an international team 
Ability to manage high work volumes and work well under pressure particularly during management of critical infrastructure incidents
Experience of switching HV and/or MV systems
Willingness to travel between sites if required
Fluent in French and English (written and spoken), other language is a plus
Desirable
Experience in Critical Infrastructures operations, design and project management
Able to lead Infrastructure projects
Qualifications
Degree level in Electrical or Mechanical engineering, or equivalent level of job experience
Membership of relevant professional body (desirable)
Full driving licence
Qualified with an Authorised Persons accreditation
Other
Based in Lyon or Marseille with travel to LDN sites if required and occasionally travel to Paris
Requirement to work flexible hours to support business objectives and if a major incident has occurred
Availability to join 24/7/365 On Call rota
Be aware of Colt Information security, business continuity, quality and other ISO or equivalent policies/ industry standards and discharge duties against them as appropriate.
Identify risks related to process and information security and treat/ mitigate the same as appropriate
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Dynamics 365 Specialist: F&SCM (Stockholm)
JOB OPENINGS
Vi befinner oss på en snabb tillväxtresa med många nya projekt som startar och vi söker nu fler Dynamics 365 F&SCM specialister som vill utvecklas i sin karriär och arbeta med spännande uppdrag.
Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Hos oss jobbar du som en del av ett team med seniora experter och jobbar 100% fokuserat i ett projekt, tillsammans. Vi jobbar med stora kunder som har huvudsäte i Sverige, men som är aktiva på den globala marknaden. Våra främsta områden är Manufacturing, Retail, och Professional Services och vi fokuserar på globala utrullningar, där vi jobbar med hela D365 plattformen och end to end processer (full omnichannel, från e-handel till kassor osv). Vi har också färdiga projekt att ansluta till, vilket ger dig en smidig start när du börjar hos oss.
Utvecklas med oss
Vi erbjuder även möjligheten att ta nästa steg i din karriär. Engage Group är ett kunskapshus där vi regelbundet genomför kompetensutveckling, webinars och mentorskapsprogram, och du har möjlighet att bli lösningsarkitekt eller domän expert. För att stödja dig i din utveckling, har du alltid stöttning av erfarna kollegor och en stöttande chef genom hela processen, allt för att du skall trivas och känna dig trygg med din arbetsinsats.
Vårt team
Vi har ett starkt anseende för att leverera hög kvalitet och vårt team består av de allra bästa i branschen. Du kommer alltid att arbeta i nära samarbete tillsammans med seniora konsulter, som är experter inom sitt område. Hos oss jobbar du också tillsammans med Sveriges enda FastTrack Recognized lösnings arkitekter och MVPer inom Dynamics Finance and Supplychain, vilket ger dig ett stort utrymme att utvecklas ihop med dina kollegor.
Vår kultur
Vi är stolta över att att kalla oss familjära experter, då vi stöttar varandra och möter kunders utmaningar tillsammans, något som genomsyrar hela vår kultur. Vi främjar tätt samarbete och vi arrangerar regelbundet sociala aktiviteter som AW:s och deltagande på sportaktiviteter. För att fira våra gemensamma framgångar, så har vi årligen en större konferens (oftast utanför Sverige), för att stärka banden internt också utanför ordinarie arbetstid. Tillsammans med vår informella och entreprenöriella företagskultur och korta beslutsvägar gör detta Engage till en perfekt match för dig som vill ta nästa steg.
Vi erbjuder en hybrid arbetsplats där work-life balance är i fokus och du har alltid nära till ett av våra kontor runtom i Sverige (Jönköping, Kalmar, Malmö, Göteborg, Stockholm).
Varför valde du Engage?
Hör från blivande kollegor om varför de valde just Engage Group:
”Jag valde Engage för deras omfattande erfarenhet och kompetens inom Dynamics-plattformen. Att arbeta med några av de bästa inom området kommer att ge mig möjlighet att fortsätta lära mig samtidigt som jag bidrar till spännande projekt världen över, både nu och i framtiden.”
”Jag valde att börja på Engage Group eftersom jag vill arbeta med några av de bästa inom mitt område. Jag blev imponerad av de andra specialisterna och kompetensen inom företaget och vill gärna vara en del av det, samt vara en del av ett nytt och modernt företag som snabbt expanderar. Jag ser fram emot framtiden på Engage och hoppas kunna lära mig och dela mycket kunskap här.”
”Jag valde Engage för att arbeta med spännande projekt världen över tillsammans med några av de bästa experterna inom Dynamics 365. Med en informell och entreprenöriell företagskultur, korta beslutsvägar och en samarbetsinriktad kultur är Engage en perfekt match för mig.”
Vill du bli en del av vårt team? Vi söker dig som:
Har flerårig erfarenhet av ERP
Erfarenhet av end-to-end Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM
Kan förbereda och driva workshops och kravinsamling.
Är flytande i svenska och engelska.
Meriterande kvalifikationer:
Erfarenhet inom retail och/eller manufacturing.
Kunskap om agila principer och Azure DevOps.
Kompetens inom Power Platform och/eller Azure.
Om Engage Group
Engage är ett expertkonsultföretag inom Microsoft Dynamics. Våra medarbetare är branschledande specialister inom Dynamics-ekosystemet och fokuserar på toppmoderna lösningar för Dynamics-miljön. Våra kunder är baserade i Sverige men har en global närvaro och vår verksamhet är internationell.
Vi har 100+ anställda på kontor i Jönköping, Göteborg, Malmö, Kalmar och Stockholm. Engage har en långsiktig tillväxtplan och du kommer att bli en del av ett företag som växer snabbt på en mycket intressant marknad.
Intresseanmälan:
Vi ser fram emot att arbeta med dig. Känner du likadant för oss? Om du vill veta mer, kontakta oss på contact@engagenow.com eller läs mer på vår karriärsida. För frågor kontakta Jonathan Bucht (Business Unit Manager) på jonathan.bucht@engagegroup.se.
