AI Forward Deployed Engineer
00069909621
 Date published
 Oct 13 2026
 Location
 New York, NY-550 W 34th St / United States
 Job category
 Digital
 Work model
 Work from Home
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will make an impact by partnering directly with clients to rapidly design, build, and deploy innovative AI, data, cloud, and digital solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Consulting team and work collaboratively with clients, business stakeholders, architects, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams.
In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping organizations accelerate digital transformation initiatives through modern cloud architectures, enterprise integrations, and next-generation AI solutions.
In This Role, You Will
Partner directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and technical requirements while serving as a trusted technical advisor.
Lead discovery workshops, technical assessments, and solution envisioning sessions to translate business needs into scalable solution architectures and implementation roadmaps.
Design, develop, and deploy cloud-native applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations that accelerate time-to-value.
Build and implement Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including AI copilots, intelligent workflows, and autonomous agents.
Own technical delivery across client-facing initiatives, driving rapid iteration, production readiness, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
Work Model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Occasional travel may be required to client sites, Cognizant offices, workshops, solution design sessions, and project-related meetings.
Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What You Need to Have to Be Considered
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, customer-facing engineering, or similar roles.
Strong programming expertise in one or more languages such as Python, Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go.
Experience developing cloud-native solutions on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform, including APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of software architecture, enterprise integrations, stakeholder management, and client-facing consulting engagements.
Experience translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and driving projects from concept through production deployment.
These Will Help You Stand Out
Experience deploying Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics solutions in enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.
Experience with AI frameworks and orchestration platforms including LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, and knowledge graph solutions.
Experience building AI copilots, intelligent automation solutions, RAG architectures, and enterprise knowledge management platforms.
Experience working directly with clients in consulting, solution engineering, customer engineering, or forward deployed engineering capacities.
Experience delivering technology solutions across industries such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, Manufacturing, or Logistics.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Salary and Other Compensation
The annual salary for this position is anticipated to be between $130,000 and $150,000, depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, and other job-related factors.
This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans.
Benefits
Cognizant offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our associates and their families, including:
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
401(k) plan and company contributions
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Paid holidays and paid time off (PTO)
Paid parental leave and fertility assistance programs
Learning and development programs, certifications, and career advancement opportunities
Wellness and mental health resources
Career growth and internal mobility opportunities
Benefits may vary by location and employment status and are subject to change.
Application Deadline
Applications will be accepted until November 30, 2026.
Cognizant reserves the right to close this posting earlier based on application volume, business needs, or hiring timelines.
About Cognizant: 
Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, bridging the gap between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for our clients. Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization’s unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. See how at cognizant.ai or @cognizant.
Additional employment information
Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.
Applicants may be required to attend interviews in person or by video conference. In addition, candidates may be required to present their current state or government issued ID during each interview.
Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Our benefits program is built with you in mind—so you can enjoy a fulfilling, balanced and healthy life.
Financial wellbeing

Physical and mental health
We empower you to prioritize your wellbeing through paid time off, flexible working where possible, healthcare plans, counselling, our Mental Health Allyship program and more. 
Your career, your way
With 350,000+ roles at Cognizant, you’ll have opportunities explore new technologies, industries and locations—and build the skills you need to grow your career.
Real-world impact
Think about the biggest brands you rely on. Chances are, they rely on us to help strengthen their business. Here, you’ll turn bold ideas into solutions that improve lives everywhere.
Your path to Cognizant
Here’s what you can expect from our hiring process. Please keep in mind that it may vary by role and location. Explore our FAQs to learn more.
Step 1: Apply to the right opportunity
Find an open role that matches your skills and career goals and show us why you’re the person for the job. Don’t see the right opportunity? Consider joining our Talent Community.
Step 2: Connect with your recruiter
If one of our recruiters sees a fit, they’ll set up a short intro call to learn more about you and how your experiences and skills match the role.
Step 3: Show off your skills
If you and our team would like to continue the process, you’ll interview with our hiring team. Some roles may also require technical assessments and/or client interviews.
Step 4: Decision time
Our team will then review each candidates’ potential to succeed in the role. This step may take some time because we want to find the right fit for both you and us—but you can count on us to keep you updated.

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
How You'll Make An Impact
In this role, you will focus on growing revenue within an existing book of client accounts spanning the Emerging Growth and Mid Market segments. You will work closely with banking and financial services customers in complex business environments to identify expansion opportunities, deepen platform adoption, and deliver innovative solutions that address evolving business process and data management challenges — driving upsell and cross-sell across their organizations.
This role is open to East Coast US and Vancouver, BC.
What You'll Do 
Act as a trusted business advisor to C-level business audiences as you use your in-depth knowledge of Boomi technology, products, and services to help customers formulate strategy and direction
Utilize strategic probing to identify, evaluate, design, and propose business solutions
Design appropriate post-sale implementation plans
Analyze multiple market factors to both anticipate and identify customer problems/needs and recommends appropriate solution
Engage cross-functional resources in order to achieve goals and meet customer needs
Develop and implement account plans that drive the attainment of critical business objectives
Earn prospective customer’s confidence by demonstrating expertise, professionalism, and reliability throughout sales engagement
The Experience You Bring
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
5+ years experience in complex relationship selling
MEDDPICC sales methodology experience preferred
Accurately forecast future sales
Execute on pipeline and bookings growth strategies
Track & report on critical sales and account metrics
Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!
Compensation and Benefits
Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The On Target Earnings (OTE) for this role are 50% base and 50% commission.
Total Compensation begins at $160,000 and is determined by various factors including geographic location and the candidate's knowledge, skills, and experience. An overview of our benefits can be found here.

If you are interested in building scalable high-transactional solutions using modern technologies, we have a unique opportunity for you. Experience in Angular or in another modern JavaScript based framework

 Account manager
 Job id: 
 36001
 Job location: 
 Malakoff, FR
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role plays a key strategic part in shaping and driving the global sales strategy across a portfolio of multinational enterprise accounts.
You’ll use your commercial acumen, strong market insight, and ability to influence at executive level to partner with Sales, Service, and Sales Engineering teams ensuring sustainable account growth and exceptional customer satisfaction.
As an Account Manager, you will take full ownership of your prospect and customer portfolio, leading the global account strategy, building robust account plans, and coordinating the wider account team to deliver results.
What you will do
Responsible for managing business development activities for high-profile global accounts that lead to the expansion and growth of new business. Develop existing business and executive-level client relationships, cultivate new relationships to uncover new opportunities, develop solutions, and sell strategic Colt services.
Build strong relationships and structured contact plans across all three levels of the customer organisation (operational, management, and executive) in all regions.
Develop global account management plans based on industry trends and customer analysis, including executive profiles and continuous study of assigned accounts, their industry, business, and emerging trends.
Use strong engagement and influencing skills to establish account strategy with key stakeholders (focus of power, focus of receptivity, and focus of dissatisfaction) within each account.
Demonstrate a solid understanding of Colt’s full product suite and position solutions effectively.
Create customer-facing versions of global account plans to gather input and foster a sense of shared ownership of long-term strategy.
Prepare sales forecasts, account status reports, and recommendations to enhance account growth and maximise revenue potential.
Manage the financial and operational performance of global and regional accounts and participate in contract negotiations as required.
Build a strong internal network across geographies to ensure a coordinated and collaborative approach to managing global accounts.
Key performance indicators (financial and non-financial) 
Results-based Performance: Responsible for global target performance, managing the global pipeline in Colt tools
Account Planning Quality: Create and maintain a quality strategic global Account Plan with inputs from global account team. Account Plan assessed during the Quality Account Review Meeting
Client Engagement Quality: Client Governance Committees Management
Relationships and key contacts
Lead a team that plans, develops, designs, negotiates and delivers high value, bandwidth services which contribute to the clients strategic business development
Provides high level reporting to Colt Exec on regional plans to secure high value business development
Ownership of a range of global clients
What we’re looking for
Skills & Experience
Experience successfully selling strategic international solutions to large customers within the Telecommunications and/or IT Systems Integration industries, or a related discipline
Experience leading global contractual, financial, and commercial discussions
Familiarity with account strategy and global account management governance
Experience leading and managing multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously
In‑depth knowledge of the latest trends in technology sales methodologies and approaches
Person Specification
A proven track record in consultative solution selling, supported by broad industry knowledge and relevant expertise
Exceptional relationship‑management skills at C‑level
Existing relationships with large multinational clients
Willingness to travel internationally as required
Ability to work effectively in a highly ambiguous, agile environment
Proven ability to balance competing demands and priorities, and to operate independently while building a successful sales pipeline
Professional‑level English language skills
Skills

What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

As a Client Relationship Manager, you will make an impact by leading strategic client engagement, driving account growth, and strengthening long-term partnerships across a global business environment. You will be a valued member of the Client Relationship Management team and work collaboratively with sales, marketing, delivery, and cross-functional teams across Cognizant's service lines.
In this role, you will
Lead account management and client relationship development, including proposal and solution management, executive client presentations, delivery escalations, and new logo acquisition.
Drive strategic account planning, identify growth opportunities, develop value propositions, and expand long-term client relationships to support account growth and retention.
Lead CRM sales adoption through accurate opportunity management, pipeline visibility, forecasting, sales governance, and performance reporting.
Analyze sales funnel metrics, win/loss trends, customer feedback, and renewal data to improve sales effectiveness and client satisfaction.
Negotiate pricing, service levels, contract terms, and commercial arrangements while mentoring team members on client engagement and sales best practices.
Work model
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Dallas, TX. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you need to have to be considered
15+ years of experience in account mining, account management, client relationship management, and strategic sales, ideally within the Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality industries.
Proven sales experience across Application Development, QEA, Package Implementation, Infrastructure/Cloud, and BPO services (F&A and Contact Center), with strong solutioning and client presentation skills.
Strong expertise in CRM sales processes, opportunity management, pipeline administration, forecasting, and business reporting.
Demonstrated ability to develop strategic account plans, execute growth initiatives, manage complex client portfolios, and negotiate commercial agreements, pricing models, and service levels.
Excellent stakeholder management, presentation, communication, and consulting skills, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
These will help you stand out
Sales Management, CRM, or other relevant professional certifications in sales, account management, and customer engagement.
Experience supporting global client accounts and multinational business operations.
Demonstrated success working across diverse markets, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Vill du bli en del av ett engagerat ekonomiteam i ett bolag som växer snabbt?
Vi söker nu för extern uppdragsgivare, som är verksamma inom konsultmäkleri främst inom IT och teknik, en ekonomiassistent till kontor i centrala Stockholm.
Bolaget arbetar med många stora ramavtal och hjälper sina kunder att hitta och leverera rätt konsultkompetens. Just nu befinner de sig i en stark expansionsfas och har bland annat vunnit ett större ramavtal, vilket gör att de behöver förstärka ekonomiavdelningen.
Om rollen
Som ekonomiassistent blir du en del av ett tight team som idag består av fem personer. Teamet arbetar nära varandra och hjälps åt, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att ta ansvar för dina egna arbetsuppgifter och utvecklas i rollen.
Arbetet är varierat och innefattar bland annat:
Kund- och leverantörsreskontra
Fakturering och hantering av stora fakturavolymer
Registrering av affärer
Löpande bokföring
Betalning och hantering av leverantörsfakturor
Reskontrabevakning
Krav- och påminnelsehantering
Statistik- och ekonomisk uppföljning
Avstämningar och övriga löpande ekonomiadministrativa uppgifter
Assistera vid månads- och årsbokslut
Eftersom bolaget är i en stark tillväxt förändras och utvecklas deras arbetssätt hela tiden. Därför kommer du också att få möjlighet att vara med och identifiera förbättringar, effektiviseringar och smartare sätt att arbeta. Det är därför viktigt att du kan prioritera, arbeta strukturerat och behålla kvaliteten även när det är mycket att göra.
Vem är du?
Vår sammarbetspartner söker framför allt rätt person för deras team.
Vi söker dig som är trygg i hela reskontraflödet och som motiveras av att arbeta med stora volymer och automatiserade processer.
Eftersom vår externa uppdragsgivare verkar främst inom IT så ser vi gärna att du är digitalt driven och nyfiken på nya digitala verktyg och systemmiljöer.
För att trivas tror vi att du:
Är strukturerad och tycker om ordning och reda
Har ett intresse för redovisning och ekonomi
Är analytisk, kommunikativ i både svenska och engelska
Är prestigelös och tycker om att samarbeta
Är ansvarstagande och vågar ta egna initiativ
Trivs i ett tillväxtorienterat bolag där tempot är högt och där kravet på flexibilitet och noggrannhet är stort
Har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya arbetssätt och system
Kan arbeta självständigt men samtidigt uppskattar att vara en del av ett team
Kan hantera stora volymer av fakturor och ekonomiadministration utan att tappa noggrannheten
Här får du
Du blir en del av ett tight, glatt och prestigelöst team där vi ställer höga krav på kvalitet, struktur och ansvar men där det också ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet.
De erbjuder bland annat:
En varierad roll i ett bolag i stark tillväxt
Möjlighet att utvecklas inom ekonomi och redovisning
Ett team med mycket erfarenhet och nära samarbete
Högt i tak och korta beslutsvägar
Stor möjlighet att påverka och komma med egna idéer
Flexibel arbetsplats (hybridmodell)
Ett fint kontor i centrala Stockholm med en kultur som präglas av innovation och laganda
Anställning
Gärna start omgående eller kring årsskiftet, eller enligt överenskommelse.
Placeringsort: Stockholm med möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån
Omfattning: Heltid
Anställningsform: Visstidsanställning 6 månader, med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning
Din kompetens
Aktuell erfarenhet av arbete inom administration och ekonomi under minst 1-2 år
Mycket goda kunskaper inom Microsoft Office, Excel och Teams
Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift, både på svenska och engelska
Meriterande
Ekonomisk utbildning på minst gymnasial nivå eller motsvarande 
Erfarenhet av Fortnox är meriterande

 Specialist, Enterprise Infrastructure Services & Cloud
 Job id: 
 36521
 Job location: 
 Gurugram, IN
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure. 
Short Description
Job Location:Gurgaon & Bangalore
Function:DIO
Job Level:S2 Core
Employment Type:Full Time
Why we need this role
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) to provide deep technical expertise across Enterprise Infrastructure Services. This role focuses on Windows Server, VDI, Citrix, Microsoft 365, and cloud platforms (Azure and GCP). The SME will act as a trusted advisor and hands-on technical authority, ensuring secure architecture, operational excellence, and driving automation and standardization initiatives to optimize cost and efficiency. The successful candidate will take ownership of technical solutions and assume responsibility for delivering outcomes that meet business objectives. While not directly responsible for virtualization, storage, and networking, the role requires a strong working knowledge of these areas to ensure seamless integration.
What you will do
Technical Leadership
•    Serve as the go-to technical expert for Windows Server, Citrix, VDI, Microsoft 365, and cloud platforms (Azure & GCP).
•    Provide advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution for complex incidents.
•    Define and enforce best practices for infrastructure design, security, and governance.
•    Drive automation and Infrastructure-as-Code initiatives for repeatable, secure deployments.
•    Take ownership of technical deliverables and ensure successful implementation of solutions.
Infrastructure Operations Support
•    Ensure operational stability and performance of Windows servers, Citrix environments, VDI platforms, and Microsoft 365 services.
•    Maintain strong security posture and compliance across Azure and GCP environments.
•    Collaborate with virtualization, storage, and networking teams to ensure integrated solutions.
•    Assume responsibility for delivering outcomes aligned with business and security requirements.
Project & Architecture Contribution
•    Contribute to infrastructure projects from design through implementation.
•    Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
•    Provide technical input for strategic roadmaps and architecture decisions.
On-call 
•    Participate in the Infrastructure Operations on-call rota to provide out-of-hours support for priority incidents. 
What we're looking for
Required Technical Skills
Windows & VDI
•    Advanced administration and troubleshooting of Windows Server (2016/2019/2022).
•    Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and PKI.
•    Strong knowledge of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops architecture and VDI solutions.
Microsoft 365
•    Deep understanding of M365 services, security, and compliance features.
•    Experience with identity management (Azure AD), conditional access, and MFA.
Cloud Platforms
•    Hands-on experience with Azure and GCP architecture, governance, and cost optimization.
•    Familiarity with automation tools (PowerShell, Terraform) and DevOps principles.
Virtualization, Storage & Networking (Working Knowledge)
•    Understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi architecture and clustering concepts.
•    Familiarity with enterprise storage technologies (e.g., Pure Storage, HPE) and SAN/NAS fundamentals.
•    Solid grasp of networking principles (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing) and security best practices.
Automation & Cost Optimization
•    Proven experience in automating infrastructure operations (e.g., patching, provisioning, monitoring).
•    Ability to design and implement standardized processes to reduce complexity and cost.
Linux (Desirable)
•    Basic to intermediate experience with Linux systems (RHEL, Ubuntu, SUSE).
•    Some familiarity with Linux administration and troubleshooting
Leadership & Behavioural Skills
•    Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for delivering outcomes and driving technical excellence.
•    Leadership: Ability to influence, guide, and collaborate across teams without direct authority.
•    Outcome-Driven: Focused on delivering measurable results aligned with business objectives.
•    Strategic Thinking: Aligns technical decisions with broader IT and business strategy.
•    Communication: Clear and concise communication for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
•    Collaboration: Builds strong relationships across architecture, security, and operations teams.
•    Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
•    Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities for optimization and innovation.
Qualifications
•    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
•    Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Citrix Certified Expert, VMware VCP, Google Cloud Professional Architect) preferred.
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Specialist, IT Infrastructure (Database)
Job ID: 36969
Job Level: S2 Core
Job Location: Gurugram / Bangalore
Function:Digital Information Office (DIO)
Employment Type: Full time
Working pattern: Hybrid
Why we need this role
We are seeking a Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer with deep technical expertise in Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server platforms. This role is a hands-on Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for designing, optimising, securing, and supporting business-critical database services across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments.
The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring resilient, secure, compliant, and cost-efficient database solutions are designed and delivered. They will contribute to technology roadmaps, driving automation, and supporting strategic initiatives such as upgrades, migrations, consolidation, high availability, disaster recovery, and cloud modernisation.
What you will do
Act as a technical SME for Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server platforms.
Design, implement, and support database solutions for business-critical workloads across Production, Development, Test, and Disaster Recovery environments.
Own and provide technical direction for Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, and Enterprise Manager solutions.
Own and provide technical direction for SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication, log shipping, backup, recovery, and monitoring solutions.
Deliver against database platform strategy and roadmap, including upgrades, migrations, consolidation, modernisation, and remediation of end-of-life or end-of-support platforms.
Drive platform stability, performance, capacity, availability, and resilience, ensuring database services meet operational and business requirements.
Lead complex performance tuning, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of major incidents and recurring problems.
Develop and maintain robust backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities, including regular validation and failover testing.
Identify and deliver cost optimisation opportunities across database licensing, infrastructure utilisation, consolidation, storage, and support models.
Develop automation and standardisation using Ansible, PowerShell, Shell scripting, Python, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Ensure database security through patching, vulnerability remediation, privileged access controls, hardening, encryption, auditing, and compliance evidence.
Collaborate closely with application owners, operating system teams, cloud engineering teams, architecture, security, network, storage, vendors, and wider Infrastructure & Operations teams.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation, including platform designs, standards, build guides, runbooks, operational procedures, capacity reports, and audit artefacts.
Provide technical leadership for major changes and projects, including planning, risk assessment, implementation, validation, and rollback.
Participate in the on-call rota to support critical incidents.
What we're looking for
Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise-scale Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
Deep Oracle expertise covering RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
Deep SQL Server expertise covering Always On Availability Groups, clustering, replication, log shipping, backup and recovery, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
Proven experience supporting highly available, business-critical production database services.
Experience leading database upgrades, migrations, consolidations, platform refreshes, and disaster recovery implementations.
Strong knowledge of database monitoring, capacity management, alerting, incident management, and proactive problem prevention.
Experience working in hybrid environments, integrating on-premises database platforms with Azure, OCI, AWS, or GCP services.
Solid knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, compute, storage, networking, clustering, and virtualisation fundamentals.
Strong troubleshooting capability across complex, multi-layered database and infrastructure environments.
Experience with automation tools such as Ansible and scripting technologies such as PowerShell, Shell, or Python.
Working knowledge of ITIL processes, change governance, audit controls, security compliance, and vulnerability remediation.
Technical Competencies
 Deep technical expertise and recognition as a go-to SME for Oracle and SQL Server platforms.
 Ability to independently lead technical delivery of complex database changes, migrations, upgrades, and recovery activities.
Strong understanding of high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery design.
Advanced database performance analysis, optimisation, capacity planning, and root cause analysis skills.
Experience with automation, standardisation, optimisation, and platform engineering practices.
Ability to define database standards, reference architectures, operational controls, and lifecycle roadmaps.
Ability to contribute to design and technology decisions in partnership with architecture, security, cloud, and application teams.
 Behavioural & Professional Skills
Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for database platform stability, security, and technical outcomes.
Technical Leadership: Influences engineering direction and mentors colleagues without requiring direct line management responsibility.
Outcome-Driven: Focuses on measurable improvements in availability, performance, cost, security, and resilience.
Collaboration: Works effectively across infrastructure, cloud, security, architecture, application, and supplier teams.
Communication: Clearly articulates complex database concepts, risks, options, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities for automation, optimisation, simplification, and service improvement.
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. You will work with both prospective and existing customers in complex business environments, serving as a trusted advisor who identifies and pursues new opportunities while deepening relationships within your current portfolio.
Whether engaging net-new prospects or expanding within established accounts, you will develop a deep understanding of each customer's business processes and data management challenges, devising innovative, consultative solutions that drive immediate value and support long-term success.  HSE Country Business Partner (20h/week)
 Job id: 
 36456
 Job location: 
 Lisbon, PT
Short Description
Function: General Counsel 
Reports to: Health, Safety and Environment Manager  
Set up: Hybrid 
Location: Lisbon, Portugal
Why we need this role
Reporting to the South-East Region Business Partner Lead the HSE Country Business Partner, and supported by the HSE Regional Business Partner (ES, PT, IT), is responsible for the day‑to‑day delivery of Health, Safety and Environmental activities within one assigned country.
The role focuses on local implementation, coordination and compliance, ensuring that Colt’s HSE policies, procedures and management systems are effectively applied at country level, in line with local legal requirements and Group standards.
This is a hands‑on, operational role, supporting employees, local management and external providers to maintain a safe, healthy and compliant working environment.
What you will do
Governance, Compliance & Assurance (Country scope only)
Support the local implementation of Colt’s HSE governance framework within the assigned country, in line with Group and Regional standards.
Support ongoing country compliance with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, contributing to audit preparation and follow‑up activities.
Undertake country‑specific HSE legal compliance assessments, maintaining accurate records of applicable legislation and obligations in line with Group methodology.
Support corrective action tracking and follow‑up through the central HSE action management tool.
Support maintenance of country‑specific HSE documentation in line with local legislation and the Group HSE Management System.
Operational HSE Support
Provide day‑to‑day HSE advisory support to employees and managers within the assigned country.
Support the implementation and maintenance of country risk assessment processes, including coordination with external HSE providers where applicable.
Support emergency preparedness activities within the country, including maintaining emergency plans, coordinating testing and exercises, and supporting emergency team training.
Support implementation of Group HSE initiatives and minimum requirements at country level.
Audits, Inspections & Incident Management
Coordinate and support country HSE inspections and audit activities, including preparation, follow‑up and action closure.
Support internal and external audits conducted within the country.
Support and participate in HSE incident investigations, promoting a positive reporting culture and ensuring investigations and corrective actions are completed in line with Group processes.
Training, Culture & Communication
Support delivery and monitoring of mandatory HSE training and e‑learning for the assigned country.
Contribute to HSE communications, awareness campaigns and content relevant to local needs.
Support local HSE culture and engagement initiatives in line with Group priorities.
Stakeholder & Provider Coordination
Act as a local HSE interface with:
Regional and Group HSE colleagues
Employees and managers within the assigned country
External HSE and facilities service providers
Relevant local authorities and regulators (where applicable)
Employee representatives and H&S Committees, in line with local regulations
Budget & Administration 
Provide input to country HSE budget planning and support tracking of agreed expenditure.
Ensure HSE records, documentation and reporting for the country are accurate, complete and maintained on time.
What we look for
Skills & Experience
Practical, customer‑focused approach with strong attention to detail
Ability to work independently within a defined scope and follow established processes
Comfortable operating in a matrix organisation and multicultural environment
Willingness to travel within the assigned country as required
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Methodical, reliable and comfortable working with procedures and records
Person specification
Holds the locally required H&S qualification as H&S technician (Técnico Superior de Segurança no Trabalho (TSST)).
1–2 years’ experience in a Health & Safety and/or Environmental role, either in‑house or with an external provider
Knowledge or experience of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems
Proficient in English (written and spoken)
Confident user of Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, SharePoint)
Job Segment: 
 Compliance, Sharepoint, Developer, Legal, Technology

Nätverkskonsult – Stockholm
Vill du utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens främsta specialister?
Vi söker nu en Nätverkskonsult med cirka fyra års erfarenhet som vill fortsätta utvecklas inom nätverk, säkerhet och modern IT-infrastruktur. Hos oss blir du en del av ett specialistbolag där teknisk kompetens, kvalitet i leveransen och långsiktiga kundrelationer står i centrum.
Vi bygger cybersäkerhet från grunden. Det betyder att vi designar, implementerar och förvaltar infrastrukturen som verksamheter bygger sina system och digitala tjänster på – med säkerhet integrerat i arkitektur, drift och vardag.
Vår verksamhet är uppbyggd kring tre specialistområden:
Datacenter – modern infrastruktur, virtualisering, automation och hybridmoln
Kommunikation – enterprise networking, trådlösa nätverk och SD-WAN
Security Operations – säkerhetsövervakning, incidenthantering och cybersäkerhet
Vi arbetar med några av Sveriges mest spännande organisationer och hjälper dem att skapa stabila, säkra och framtidssäkra IT-miljöer – där vi alltid utgår från förmågan att skydda, upptäcka och hantera hot.
Om rollen
Som Nätverkskonsult arbetar du i varierande kunduppdrag där du hjälper våra kunder att utveckla, implementera och förvalta moderna nätverkslösningar. Du jobbar nära seniora specialister och får möjlighet att successivt ta större ansvar, både i projekt och i förvaltning.
I rollen är du med och stärker kundernas grundförmåga inom cybersäkerhet:
Skydda genom robust nätverksdesign, segmentering och säkra anslutningar som gör det svårare att ta sig in och röra sig vidare i miljön.
Upptäcka genom att bidra till bättre visibilitet, övervakning och analys av nätverkstrafik och avvikelser.
Hantera genom tydlig dokumentation, ordning i förändringar och arkitektur som gör incidenter lättare att avgränsa och åtgärda när något väl händer.
Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
Installation och konfiguration av nätverksutrustning
Drift, övervakning och felsökning av nätverksmiljöer
Deltagande i projekt för nätverksuppgraderingar och migreringar
Implementering av trådlösa nätverk och SD-WAN-lösningar
Dokumentation och teknisk rådgivning
Samarbete med specialister inom Datacenter och SecOps
Bidra till att förbättra kundernas säkerhet och nätverksarkitektur
Vi söker dig som har
Erfarenhet:
Cirka 4 års erfarenhet av arbete med nätverk
Erfarenhet av drift, felsökning och implementation i företagsmiljöer
Förmåga att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du trivs i team
Kompetens inom flera av följande områden:
Routing och switching
TCP/IP och nätverksprotokoll
OSPF och BGP
Trådlösa nätverk
VLAN och nätverkssegmentering
Brandväggar och grundläggande säkerhet
VPN-lösningar
Nätverksövervakning och analys
Meriterande:
Erfarenhet av Fortinet, Cisco, Juniper, Aruba eller liknande plattformar
Erfarenhet av automation eller scripting
Erfarenhet av molnintegration och hybridmiljöer
God kommunikativ förmåga, både på svenska och engelska. 
Certifieringar såsom:
CCNA eller CCNP
FCP – Network Security
JNICA eller JNCIS
Aruba ACMP
Andra relevanta nätverks- eller säkerhetscertifieringar
Vem är du?
Vi tror att du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att förstå hur saker hänger ihop – och hur de kan göras bättre och säkrare. Du är nyfiken, gillar att felsöka och lösa problem metodiskt, och du tar ansvar för dina leveranser med en tydlig vilja att göra ett riktigt bra jobb.
Eftersom du trivs i konsultrollen är du också bekväm i dialogen med kund: du kan förklara tekniska vägval på ett tydligt sätt, fånga behov och omsätta dem i konkreta lösningar. Samtidigt vill du fortsätta bygga specialistkompetens inom nätverk och säkerhet och uppskattar att göra den resan tillsammans med andra erfarna specialister.
Därför ska du välja Cuebid
Hos oss får du växa i ett specialistbolag där vi kombinerar djup teknisk kompetens med ett strukturerat arbetssätt och starkt fokus på kvalitet. Du arbetar nära erfarna kollegor inom kommunikation, datacenter och säkerhet och blir en del av en kultur där vi delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och bygger långsiktiga relationer – både internt och med våra kunder.
Vi ger dig en tydlig plan för kompetensutveckling, med utbildningar och certifieringar, och vi skapar utrymme för att du stegvis kan växa mot roller som specialist, arkitekt eller med tydligare säkerhetsfokus. Samtidigt tror vi på frihet under ansvar, konkurrenskraftiga villkor och förmåner – och på att du ska ha rätt förutsättningar för att leverera bra, hållbart och med stolthet.
Placeringsort
Stockholm
(hybridarbete möjligt)
Ansökan
Vill du fortsätta utvecklas inom nätverk och säkerhet – och samtidigt vara med och bygga cybersäkerhet från grunden tillsammans med ett specialistbolag som satsar på både människor och teknik?
Skicka din ansökan till kenneth.steinholtz@cuebid.se och märk ämnesraden med “ Nätverkskonsult – Stockholm”. Bifoga gärna CV och skriv några rader om varför rollen passar dig. Urval sker löpande.
Välkommen att bli en del av vårt team!
Behöver ni hjälp med att STÄRKA ER CYBERSÄKERHET?
Vi förstår. Det är mycket att hålla koll på – hoten förändras ständigt, regelverken likaså, och tiden räcker sällan till. Cybersäkerhet kan kännas överväldigande, men ni behöver inte lösa allt själva. 
Vi hjälper er att ta första steget.

SecOps-konsult – Stockholm
Vill du utvecklas inom cybersäkerhet tillsammans med några av branschens främsta specialister?
Vi söker nu en SecOps-konsult med cirka fyra års erfarenhet inom IT-säkerhet, säkerhetsövervakning och/eller incidenthantering som vill ta nästa steg i sin karriär. Hos oss blir du en del av ett specialistbolag som bygger cybersäkerhet från grunden – genom att skapa säkra, robusta och moderna IT-miljöer där säkerhet är integrerat i arkitektur, drift och vardag.
Vår verksamhet är uppbyggd kring tre specialistområden:
Datacenter – modern infrastruktur, virtualisering, automation och hybridmoln
Kommunikation – enterprise networking, trådlösa nätverk och SD-WAN
Security Operations – säkerhetsövervakning, hotdetektion, incidenthantering och cyberförsvar
Vi arbetar med kunder som ställer höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och kompetens. Det betyder att du får arbeta i miljöer där det vi gör får direkt effekt – både för verksamheten och för människorna som är beroende av att systemen fungerar.
Om rollen
Som SecOps-konsult arbetar du med att stärka kundernas säkerhetsförmåga över tid – inte bara genom att reagera på larm, utan genom att bidra till ett strukturerat förbättringsarbete.
I praktiken innebär det att du är med och bygger och utvecklar kundens förmåga att:
Skydda genom att minska attackytan, identifiera svagheter och föreslå konkreta åtgärder som gör det svårare för angripare att ta sig in och röra sig vidare.
Upptäcka genom att förbättra detektion, analys och prioritering, så att hot och avvikelser upptäcks tidigt och kan hanteras innan de får stor påverkan.
Hantera genom att utreda incidenter, bidra med beslutsunderlag och stödja en effektiv respons som återtar kontrollen snabbt och metodiskt.
Du arbetar både operativt och projektbaserat, i nära samarbete med våra specialister inom kommunikation, datacenter och cybersäkerhet.
Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
Säkerhetsövervakning och analys av säkerhetshändelser
Hantering och utredning av incidenter
Utveckling och förbättring av detektionsregler och use cases
Analys av loggar och säkerhetsdata
Threat hunting och proaktiv säkerhetsanalys
Implementering och konfigurering av säkerhetsplattformar
Säkerhetsrådgivning och förbättringsarbete hos kund
Dokumentation och rapportering av säkerhetshändelser
Vi söker dig som har
Erfarenhet:
Cirka 4 års erfarenhet inom IT-säkerhet, SOC eller SecOps
Erfarenhet av säkerhetsövervakning och/eller incidenthantering
God förståelse för moderna IT-miljöer och aktuella säkerhetsutmaningar
Erfarenhet av arbete i kundmiljö eller större IT-verksamhet är meriterande
Kompetens inom flera av följande områden:
SIEM-plattformar
EDR- och XDR-lösningar
Logghantering och säkerhetsanalys
Incidenthantering
Threat hunting
Nätverkssäkerhet
Windows- och Linux-säkerhet
Identitet och åtkomsthantering
Molnsäkerhet i Azure och/eller AWS
Erfarenhet av produkter som:
Microsoft Sentinel
Microsoft Defender XDR
Splunk
Elastic Security
IBM QRadar
CrowdStrike

Microsoft Security Suite
Meriterande:
Erfarenhet av automatisering och scripting
Erfarenhet av MITRE ATT&CK
Erfarenhet av säkerhetsutredningar och forensik
Erfarenhet av säkerhetsarbete i molnmiljöer
Erfarenhet av regulatoriska ramverk såsom NIS2 eller ISO 27001
Certifieringar såsom:
SC-200, SC-300, SC-900
Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GCIH
Fortinet FCP Security Operations
Splunk Core Certified User eller Power User
Vem är du?
Vi tror att du är nyfiken och har ett genuint intresse för cybersäkerhet – inte bara för tekniken, utan för hur den faktiskt används av angripare och hur vi bäst kan upptäcka och stoppa dem. Du tycker om att analysera, se mönster och lösa komplexa problem, och du trivs både när du får arbeta självständigt och när du får samarbeta tätt med andra specialister.
Du arbetar strukturerat, har en god analytisk förmåga och uppskattar att göra saker ordentligt: från att utreda en händelse till att dokumentera lärdomar och föreslå förbättringar. Eftersom du trivs i konsultrollen är du också bekväm med kundkontakt och kan kommunicera både läget och vägen framåt på ett tydligt sätt. Samtidigt vill du fortsätta utvecklas mot specialist- eller seniorroller inom cybersäkerhet.
Därför ska du välja Cuebid
Hos oss får du arbeta tillsammans med några av marknadens mest erfarna säkerhetsspecialister i ett bolag där expertis och kvalitet är kärnan i det vi levererar. Du blir en del av en kultur där vi delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och bygger långsiktiga relationer – med integritet och förtroende som grund.
Du får en tydlig kompetensutvecklingsplan med utbildningar och certifieringar och möjligheten att växa mot roller som senior SecOps-konsult, Incident Responder, Detection Engineer eller Security Architect. Vi arbetar i moderna säkerhetsplattformar och avancerade kundmiljöer, vilket ger dig rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas snabbt – samtidigt som du har stor frihet under ansvar, konkurrenskraftiga villkor och attraktiva förmåner.

Ansökan
Vill du vara med och hjälpa organisationer att upptäcka, analysera och hantera morgondagens cyberhot – och samtidigt utvecklas i ett specialistbolag som satsar på både människor och teknik?
Skicka din ansökan till kenneth.steinholtz@cuebid.se och märk ämnesraden med “SecOps-konsult – Stockholm”. Bifoga gärna CV och skriv några rader om varför rollen passar dig. Urval sker löpande.
Välkommen att bli en del av vårt team!
Behöver ni hjälp med att STÄRKA ER CYBERSÄKERHET?
Vi förstår. Det är mycket att hålla koll på – hoten förändras ständigt, regelverken likaså, och tiden räcker sällan till. Cybersäkerhet kan kännas överväldigande, men ni behöver inte lösa allt själva. 
Vi hjälper er att ta första steget.

Job Title: Systems Engineer
Job Location: Onsite- Gallatin, TN, USA
About the Role
We are seeking a customer-focused and technically proficient Systems Engineer / Deskside Support Engineer to provide frontline IT support services to end users. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for technical support requests, delivering exceptional customer service while troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and AV-related issues. This role requires hands-on experience supporting enterprise IT environments, managing technology assets, and ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
In this role, you will
Serve as the primary point of contact for IT support requests through walk-up, phone, email, chat, and remote support channels, ensuring a high-quality customer experience and timely issue resolution.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve end-user hardware, software, operating system, application, mobile device, and peripheral-related issues within established service level agreements (SLAs).
Manage and prioritize multiple incidents, service requests, and user inquiries simultaneously while adhering to defined SOPs, support processes, and IT service management best practices.
Provide technical guidance and user education on IT products, services, systems, and tools, enabling users to effectively utilize technology resources.
Escalate complex or unresolved technical issues to appropriate support teams, vendors, or engineering groups, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of incidents, requests, troubleshooting activities, asset records, customer communications, and resolution outcomes within ticketing systems.
Support the complete IT asset lifecycle, including device deployment, desk setup and collection, inventory tracking, shipping and receiving, audits, asset reconciliation, smart lockers, IT vending machines, and printer support.
Deliver Level 1 Audio-Visual (AV) support for conference rooms, collaboration spaces, video conferencing solutions, and event technologies, including setup, troubleshooting, and user assistance.
Perform end-user network troubleshooting for wired and wireless connectivity issues using standard diagnostic tools and established support methodologies, escalating infrastructure-related issues when required.
Manage operational and logistics activities, including supply ordering, storage management, inventory audits, helpdesk operations, and continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance service efficiency and customer satisfaction.
What you’ll need to succeed (required skills)
2+ years of experience in Deskside Support, IT Service Desk, or End User Computing Support.
Hands-on experience supporting Windows operating systems and desktop/laptop hardware.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network issues.
Experience working with ITSM tools and ticket management systems.
Knowledge of incident, request, and escalation management processes.
Experience with asset management, inventory control, and logistics support.
Familiarity with printer setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of Audio Visual (AV) and video conferencing technologies.
Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VPN, DNS, and wireless connectivity.
Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience supporting Mac OS devices.
Mobile Device Management (MDM) experience.
Experience supporting enterprise collaboration platforms and conferencing technologies.
Familiarity with Salesforce or similar service management platforms.
Knowledge of ITIL Service Management best practices.
Experience in large enterprise or managed services environments.

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite role requiring 5 days a week at client site in Gallatin, TN, USA.

Short Description
Title: Health, Safety & Environment Country Business Partner
Function: General Counsel 
Reports to: Health, Safety and Environment Manager  
Set up: Hybrid
This is a part-time role (20h/week)
Why we need this role
Reporting to the South-East Region Business Partner Lead the HSE Country Business Partner is responsible for the day‑to‑day delivery of Health, Safety and Environmental activities within Italy country.
The role focuses on local implementation, coordination and compliance, ensuring that Colt’s HSE policies, procedures and management systems are effectively applied at country level, in line with local legal requirements and Group standards.
This is a hands‑on, operational role, supporting employees, local management and external providers to maintain a safe, healthy and compliant working environment.
What you will do
Governance, Compliance & Assurance (Country scope only)
Support the local implementation of Colt’s HSE governance framework within the assigned country, in line with Group and Regional standards.
Support ongoing country compliance with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, contributing to audit preparation and follow‑up activities.
Undertake country‑specific HSE legal compliance assessments, maintaining accurate records of applicable legislation and obligations in line with Group methodology.
Support corrective action tracking and follow‑up through the central HSE action management tool.
Support maintenance of country‑specific HSE documentation in line with local legislation and the Group HSE Management System.
Operational HSE Support
Provide day‑to‑day HSE advisory support to employees and managers within the assigned country.
Support the implementation and maintenance of country risk assessment processes, including coordination with external HSE providers where applicable.
Support emergency preparedness activities within the country, including maintaining emergency plans, coordinating testing and exercises, and supporting emergency team training.
Support implementation of Group HSE initiatives and minimum requirements at country level.
Audits, Inspections & Incident Management
Coordinate and support country HSE inspections and audit activities, including preparation, follow‑up and action closure.
Support internal and external audits conducted within the country.
Support and participate in HSE incident investigations, promoting a positive reporting culture and ensuring investigations and corrective actions are completed in line with Group processes.
Training, Culture & Communication
Support delivery and monitoring of mandatory HSE training and e‑learning for the assigned country.
Contribute to HSE communications, awareness campaigns and content relevant to local needs.
Support local HSE culture and engagement initiatives in line with Group priorities.
Stakeholder & Provider Coordination
Act as a local HSE interface with:
Regional and Group HSE colleagues
Employees and managers within the assigned country
External HSE and facilities service providers
Relevant local authorities and regulators (where applicable)
Employee representatives and H&S Committees, in line with local regulations
Budget & Administration 
Provide input to country HSE budget planning and support tracking of agreed expenditure.
Ensure HSE records, documentation and reporting for the country are accurate, complete and maintained on time.
What we're looking for
Skills & Experience
Holds the locally required H&S qualification or certification to act as an H&S technician or employer’s representative (RSPP - Responsabile del servizio di prevenzione e protezione)
1–2 years’ experience in a Health & Safety and/or Environmental role, either in‑house or with an external provider
Preferred with experience in waste management, environmental permits and communications and qualifications as ADR
Knowledge or experience of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems
Proficient in English (written and spoken)
Confident user of Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, SharePoint)
Person specification
Practical, customer‑focused approach with strong attention to detail
Ability to work independently within a defined scope and follow established processes
Comfortable operating in a matrix organisation and multicultural environment
Willingness to travel within the assigned country as required
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Methodical, reliable and comfortable working with procedures and records

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
How You'll Make An Impact
In this role, you will focus on acquiring new customers in the Mid Market segment. You will work with new and prospective customers in complex business environments to devise new and innovative solutions to address their business processes and data management challenges.
This role is fully remote and open to candidates residing in Fort Lauderdale-Miami area, which serves as the primary sales territory for this position.
What You'll Do 
Act as a trusted business advisor to C-level business audiences as you use your in-depth knowledge of Boomi technology, products, and services to help customers formulate strategy and direction
Utilize strategic probing to identify, evaluate, design, and propose business solutions
Design appropriate post-sale implementation plans
Analyze multiple market factors to both anticipate and identify customer problems/needs and recommends appropriate solution
Engage cross-functional resources in order to achieve goals and meet customer needs
Develop and implement account plans that drive the attainment of critical business objectives
Earn prospective customer’s confidence by demonstrating expertise, professionalism, and reliability throughout sales engagement
The Experience You Bring
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
5+ years experience in complex relationship selling
MEDDPICC sales methodology experience preferred
Accurately forecast future sales
Execute on pipeline and bookings growth strategies
Track & report on critical sales and account metrics
Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!

Total Compensation begins at $165,000 and is determined by various factors including geographic location and the candidate's knowledge, skills, and experience. An overview of our benefits can be found here.

Veeva Vault Technical Consultant
As a Veeva Vault Technical Consultant, you will make an impact by leading the design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of Veeva Vault solutions that support compliant and scalable business processes. Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of Veeva Vault Promomats solutions supporting content lifecycle management, review and approval workflows, and compliant content distribution.
Develop and maintain Veeva Vault Platform configurations, including data models, workflows, metadata structures, security settings, and integrations that support business processes.
Execute end-to-end Veeva Vault migration activities, including data mapping, transformation, validation, testing, deployment, and data quality assurance.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development and support teams while promoting best practices and ensuring high-quality solution delivery.
Drive solution development, testing, deployment, production support, and platform optimization initiatives to improve reliability, scalability, and user experience.
Work model:
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
What you need to have to be considered
Strong experience in Veeva Vault technologies with strong expertise in Veeva Vault Promomats, Vault Platform, Vault Migrations, and Vault CRM.
Experience designing, configuring, and implementing Veeva Vault solutions supporting regulated business processes.
Strong experience with Vault Platform configuration, including data models, workflows, metadata structures, security models, and integrations.
Proven experience executing end-to-end Veeva Vault migration projects, including data mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and deployment activities.
Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze processes, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Hands-on experience supporting solution development, testing, deployment, production support, and issue resolution.
Strong understanding of governance, security controls, validation processes, and compliance-oriented system configurations.
Experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and guiding solution design and delivery.
These will help you stand out
Experience improving scientific and operational workflows through Veeva platform capabilities.
Strong expertise in system performance monitoring, optimization, and scalability improvements.
Experience leading functional, system, integration, and user acceptance testing activities.
Demonstrated success troubleshooting complex production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions.
Experience preparing technical documentation, including design specifications, migration strategies, release notes, and support procedures.
Experience evaluating and adopting new platform features and industry best practices to improve business outcomes.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Applications will be accepted until 10/30/2026
Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future.
Salary and Other Compensation
The annual salary for this position is between $83,000pa - $145,000pa depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans.

Job Description
Combine technical problem-solving with collaboration and user support across enterprise SaaS and workplace platforms. You will investigate complex issues, assess new platform capabilities and help the team determine how to adopt them. The role connects system operations, integrations and access management with secure use of AI tools and company data.
You bring substantial experience in SaaS administration, systems engineering or operations, including hands-on work with at least one major collaboration platform such as Google Workspace or Slack. Extensive API and integration experience is important, alongside strong troubleshooting skills and understanding of identity, security and permissions. You have practical AI-tool experience and awareness of GDPR and data residency considerations. Clear documentation and collaboration with security, legal and other teams are central to the role.
Additional experience with SCIM provisioning, Workday or other enterprise-system integrations, and ServiceNow or ITSM is valuable.

Take ownership of a live Kotlin Android app and advance its modernization from XML to Jetpack Compose. Following a structured handover, you will own releases, stability and performance while evolving the native UI. A key technical challenge is integrating native ad rendering with Compose’s lifecycle. Kotlin Multiplatform experience is also required.
The assignment includes documenting key areas and preparing a structured handover to a permanent team member.

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. How You'll Make An Impact
In this role, you will focus on acquiring new customers in the Mid Market segment. You will work with new and prospective customers in complex business environments to devise new and innovative solutions to address their business processes and data management challenges.
This role is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the New Jersey area, which serves as the primary sales territory for this position.

Earn prospective customer’s confidence by demonstrating expertise, professionalism, and reliability throughout sales engagement
The Experience You Bring

5+ years experience in complex relationship selling
MEDDPICC sales methodology experience preferred
Accurately forecast future sales
Execute on pipeline and bookings growth strategies
Track & report on critical sales and account metrics

Job Description
Validate the electrical and functional performance of new IC products against demanding quality standards and customer expectations. You will contribute to silicon bring-up, perform initial manual debugging and investigations, and develop validation plans for new devices. The work includes adapting test scripts and programs, specifying test board requirements, and carrying out measurements across process, voltage and temperature conditions.
The role calls for capability in electrical and functional validation, power correlation and performance testing. You will troubleshoot technical issues, provide expert customer support when needed, and turn findings into improvements in product quality and validation methods.
Alongside practical validation work, you will coordinate collaboration within a global ASIC validation team and contribute to continuous improvements in processes. The assignment is based entirely on-site in Lund

I rollen som Data Scientist hos Consid i Stockholm får du möjlighet att utveckla både dina idéer och dig själv. Tillsammans med våra kunder arbetar du med avancerad analys, maskininlärning och AI för att lösa affärsutmaningar och skapa verkligt värde. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper och tror att du trivs med att arbeta kundnära där du får kombinera teknik, analys och verksamhetsförståelse. Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, analytisk och drivs av att hitta insikter i komplex data.
Inom Consids affärsområde Data, AI och Analys hjälper vi våra kunder att bli verkligt datadrivna genom moderna dataplattformar, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar. I Stockholm är vi idag över 30 specialister inom dataområdet och nationellt är vi 115 kollegor som samarbetar tätt över hela landet. Efterfrågan på vår kompetens fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu fler Data Scientists som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens AI- och analyslösningar tillsammans med oss.
Är detta något för dig?
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
Din kompetens
Minst 4 års erfarenhet som Data Scientist eller inom avancerad analys
Erfarenhet av maskininlärning, statistisk modellering och prediktiv analys
Goda kunskaper i Python och relevanta bibliotek för data science
Erfarenhet av att bygga, utvärdera och produktionssätta modeller
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar såsom Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
Förmåga att kommunicera resultat och insikter till både tekniska och affärsmässiga intressenter
Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift
Meriterande
