DevOps Engineer
Apply now 
 Comstream AB
 Sofia, Bulgaria
 Freelancing
 Remote
We offer a unique opportunity to work remotely, like a freelancer, while contributing to cutting-edge technology projects for some of the most innovative companies in Northern Europe. With over 200 clients across a wide range of industries, you’ll gain hands-on experience building and optimizing modern cloud-based infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
About the role
We’re looking for skilled DevOps Engineers with passion for automation, scalability, and cloud technologies. If you’re a communicative and self-driven professional who enjoys building reliable CI/CD pipelines and working across modern cloud platforms, this could be your ideal next step.
Examples of tasks you might work on:
Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to streamline development workflows and ensure consistent deployments
Automating infrastructure provisioning and monitoring using Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi
Managing and optimizing environments on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Implementing containerized solutions using Docker and orchestrating them with Kubernetes
Monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or Cloud-native alternatives
Collaborating with development and operations teams to enforce best practices for security, reliability, and scalability
We believe you bring the following qualifications:
Solid hands-on experience with DevOps principles, automation, and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, CircleCI)
Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider—AWS, Azure, or GCP—and familiarity with multi-cloud environments
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Go for automation and tooling
Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Helm
Familiarity with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments
University-level education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal
You work from wherever you are and we offer competitive hourly rates. The projects we mediate normally have longer durations and bigger scopes. You should expect to be available on full-time basis. You don't need to have your own company as we are partnering with a leading freelancing platform.
If you find our proposal interesting and you meet the above requirements for the position, please send your CV and cover letter in English.
All applications will be treated strictly confidential.
About Comstream:
Comstream is a thriving organization with about 80 employees and offices in Sweden and Bulgaria. We specialize in connecting IT talent to growth companies and delivering exceptional customer support to a wide range of businesses. Additionally, we are proud to offer and continually enhance our proprietary SaaS platform, Jobshark, for tech recruitment and freelancing.
Over the past few years, we’ve experienced substantial growth, and we’re excited to continue expanding our operations. If you’re looking to join an international organization with a Scandinavian-inspired business culture, Comstream is the perfect place for you. We prioritize your professional growth and foster an environment where you can succeed. At Comstream, teamwork is at the heart of everything we do, and we promote a culture where every voice is heard and respected. Our core principles are rooted in collaboration, empowerment, and freedom, creating a workplace where you can truly make an impact.
For more information, please visit our corporate website at www.comstream.eu.

Job Description
Turn gaps in SOC capabilities into practical engineering improvements. This assignment focuses on strengthening security platforms, operational processes and analyst workflows, including environments where SOC capabilities are still developing. You will improve security telemetry, integrations and detection coverage while supporting the ongoing operation and evolution of the security platforms.
You bring strong practical experience in SOC or Cyber Defense Engineering, including assessing existing environments and implementing improvements. Hands-on production experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR is essential, covering configuration, monitoring, integrations and operational use. You also need experience in SIEM engineering, telemetry onboarding, log pipelines and developing and tuning detections. The role requires experience establishing engineering processes for service ownership, lifecycle management, change control, documentation, risk tracking and technical roadmaps.
Experience with SOAR and/or MSSP integrations and security platform lifecycle management is highly desirable. MS Office, documentation and presentation skills are advantageous.

Job Description:
【职责描述】
1. 信息收集与整理：
负责项目主列表、子任务、进度更新等信息的收集；
将零散的项目状态、问题、风险进行归纳汇总；
协助维护项目文档结构。
2. 需求沟通与文档管理：
会议预定，会议纪要整理，需求沟通，记录要点、决议、Action list 与 Owner；
协助项目全生命周期文档管理：版本号、归档、过期文件清理；
协助跟进 Action list 闭环。
3. 模板制作与报告编写：
制作周报、风险汇报、上线邮件、检查清单等模板；
根据 PM 提供的信息编写周报、月报、专题汇报；协助整理工作会议背景材料（项目分析图表、对比表）；
对现有文档进行版式、格式、命名规范化。
4. Leader交办的其他事务。 
【职位要求 】
1、必须项：
本科及以上在校生（专业不限）；每周 ≥4 天，实习期 ≥3 个月；
熟练使用Microsoft Office（Word/Excel/PPT），尤其是 Exce基础公式；
中文写作扎实，能把口语化表达整理成规范书面语；做事细致有条理，能在 SOP / 模板下稳定输出。
2. 熟悉 Confluence / SharePoint / ServiceNow / 企业IM 等协作工具；
3. 有项目助理、PMO 实习或大型活动/项目组织管理经验；
4. 会使用 Python/ VBA 做 Excel 自动化优先；
5. 了解基础 IT 项目开发流程（敏捷、迭代、上线）；有基础 PPT 设计能力；会使用AI工具辅助工作提效。
6. 软实力：执行力强（任务交付及时，遇阻塞主动同步）；沟通清晰（IM/邮件/会议都能高效沟通）；学习力强（快速理解项目流程、术语、规则）；细致度高（命名、版本号、数字核对不出错）；主动性强（不等指挥也会主动想"还有什么需要做"）；抗压性稳（截止节点前能稳定输出）；
7、具备良好的英文读写能力；
8、计算机相关或管理、英语相关专业，硕士学历优先。
At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available here.

Job Description
Bidra med informationssäkerhetskompetens i arbetet med digital infrastruktur för data inom hälsa, vård och omsorg. I rollen som Data Engineer hos Consid i norra Norrland får du möjlighet att utveckla både dina idéer och dig själv, du utgår antingen från vårt kontor i Umeå eller Luleå. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar ni hos kunder i branschens framkant. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper och tror att du trivs med att arbeta kundnära för att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar. Som person tror vi att du är engagerad, nyfiken och drivs av problemlösning.
Inom Consids affärsområde Data, AI och Analys hjälper vi våra kunder att bli verkligt datadrivna genom moderna dataplattformar, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar. Nationellt är vi idag 115 kollegor som samarbetar tätt över hela landet. Efterfrågan på vår kompetens fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu fler Data Engineers som vill vara med och bygga framtidens datalösningar tillsammans med oss.
Är detta något för dig?
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
Din kompetens
Minst 4 års erfarenhet av arbete som Data Engineer eller motsvarande roll
Goda kunskaper inom dataintegration, ETL/ELT och pipelineutveckling
Erfarenhet av SQL och databaser
Erfarenhet av verktyg som Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric eller motsvarande
Erfarenhet av att bygga och förvalta moderna datapipelines
Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av lakehouse-arkitektur och moderna dataplattformar
Erfarenhet av streaming och realtidsdata
Erfarenhet av DataOps och CI/CD
Kunskaper inom Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform eller Bicep
Certifieringar inom Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
Fördelar hos Consid
Centralt kontor
Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser.
Fantastiska kollegor
Du får världens duktigaste, trevligaste och mest hjälpsamma kollegor.
Utvecklas
Hos oss finns möjlighet att testa det som du är intresserad av och utveckla din roll i den riktning du vill.
Aktiviteter för alla
Det anordnas ständigt roliga aktiviteter anpassat för kollegor, vänner och familj på våra kontor runt om i landet.
Vi erbjuder
Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv.

Job Application for Presales Solution Engineer – Commercial at Boomi 
Presales Solution Engineer – Commercial
Singapore
Apply
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
Why Boomi?
Boomi empowers organizations to move with agility, connect systems and people, and drive business innovation. As a Leader in Gartner’s Enterprise iPaaS Magic Quadrant for 12 consecutive years, and one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Boomi is a global integration and automation leader with over 30,000 customers.
We’re now accelerating our platform’s impact by:
Launching Boomi AgentStudio to enable AI-powered automation and governance
Enhancing data integration and pipeline orchestration with the Rivery acquisition
Expanding our offering to include Managed File Transfer (MFT) via the Thru acquisition
Acquiring Lunar.dev to provide an essential AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway
At Boomi, we’re bold thinkers who are passionate about solving big challenges. If you’re excited to be part of a company shaping the future of integration, data management, API management and AI, we’d love to hear from you.
The Role
Our commercial sales professionals of Account Executives and Account Managers rely on proactive technical support during the sales process, and our expert Presales Solution Engineering team is there to assist. Our Boomi SEs follow a prescriptive technical sales cycle and engagement model, focused on effectiveness and efficiency. The SE team is viewed as far more than a technical resource; our SEs are valued partners throughout the sales journey and help build trust with our stakeholders and prospects.
As a Presales Solution Engineer, you will provide pre-sales technical support to our field sales teams throughout the sales process. This includes account and prospect research, collaborative discovery and needs analysis, formulating a technical strategy and win-team, executing on that strategy, and ultimately securing the technical win.
What You’ll Do
Lead technical discovery and consultative pre-sales engagements with prospective customers.
Design solution strategies across Boomi’s portfolio of integration, data management, API management and AI.
Qualify opportunities by understanding customer technical requirements, decision-making processes and underlying demand drivers.
Deliver tailored product demonstrations and technical presentations to both technical and business audiences.
Partner with Account Executives and Solution Architects to craft compelling proposals that highlight business value and ROI.
Support RFIs / RFPs and Proof-of-Concept activities, and provide technical guidance that ensures a smooth transition from presales to implementation.
Understand the competitive landscape and position Boomi’s solutions effectively against alternatives.
Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle, and support trade shows, webinars and workshops.
Work with Boomi’s Partners to help them position the Boomi platform to their customers.
Coach and mentor fellow team members, sharing knowledge across the wider SE team.
Stay current on AI trends, LLM-based tooling, competitive offerings, Boomi platform innovations, and general customer and industry trends.
Required Skills and Experience
Essential
Strong business acumen, with the ability to relate technical features to business impact and value.
Technical aptitude and a problem-solving mindset, ideally with exposure to integration, data management, API management and AI platforms.
Exceptional presentation and communication skills in English; comfortable engaging executives, developers and non-technical stakeholders alike.
A natural curiosity and a passion for creative problem-solving – a genuine interest in understanding how things work.
A self-starter who thrives in collaborative, cross-functional teams and dynamic environments, and is comfortable switching between independent and collaborative work.
A commitment to continuous learning, alongside a willingness to coach and mentor others.
Preferred
Above all, a deep, hands-on grounding in integration or iPaaS technology. That might come from a presales or sales engineering role, but it’s just as likely to come from professional services, implementation, solution architecture or partner and SI delivery. If you know the technology, we can teach you the craft of presales.
5–15 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in SaaS or iPaaS domains.
A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Science or a related scientific field.
Familiarity with several of the following: integration patterns, messaging queues and middleware concepts; APIs and API Management, including Federated API Management; data pipeline and orchestration tools; Managed File Transfer (MFT) protocols and use cases; AI and LLM-based applications such as prompt engineering, RAG, vector search or agent-based automation.
A track record of successful projects in enterprise accounts.
Experience in value-based selling methodologies, and in carrying quota and supporting sales planning such as forecasting, account planning and go-to-market strategy.
Integration experience with enterprise applications such as SAP, Oracle EBS, Fusion, NetSuite, MS Dynamics, ServiceNow, Salesforce or IFS.
Exposure to basic scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, JavaScript or Groovy).
Location
Must be located in Singapore.
A valid Singapore work visa is required, if applicable.
Why Now?
At Boomi, you won’t just showcase technology – you’ll help customers accelerate AI adoption, unlock data value and build resilient digital ecosystems. It’s an exciting time to be part of a company driving innovation at scale.
If you’re passionate about technology, thrive in a customer-facing role, and are excited by what’s next in integration, data and AI, we’d love to hear from you.

Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  
Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

Job Description:
DXC Technology is a Fortune 500 global IT services leader. Our more than 130,000 people in 70- plus countries are entrusted by our customers to deliver what matters most. We use the power of technology to deliver mission-critical IT services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive business impact. DXC is an employer of choice with strong values, and fosters a culture of inclusion, belonging and corporate citizenship.
Start your career with a company that is passionate about developing and nurturing talent in a high-performance culture.
About the Role
We are inviting enthusiastic students to join our Network Engineering team as Interns. This is a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world experience in managing and supporting enterprise network infrastructure across data center and enterprise environments.
As a Network Engineering Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers and be exposed to network design, troubleshooting, monitoring, and infrastructure projects.
Key Responsibilities
A Level 1 Technician is responsible for the workflow and escalations of assigned tickets and problems.
Some of the primary duties include:
•      Event Verification / Initial Triage
•      Incident Record Opening
•      Answer phone Calls
•      Create / troubleshoot incident tickets
•      Engage the vendor & field services as needed
•      Create RCA's
•      Execute RMA process
•      Investigate, diagnose and validate incidents upon contact
Skillset:
Cisco devices
HPN devices (H3C / Procurve / 3com/Aruba ) – optional
F5 Load Balancer
Cloud Networking
Eligibility :
Must be currently enrolled in a degree or Diploma program (Any computer related program) at College or University 
Intake:2026 / 2027                                       
Duration: 6 months
Eligibility: Malaysian citizen    
At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

 Comstream OOD
 Sofia, Bulgaria
 Employment
 Hybrid
If you want to join a team developing a SaaS based solution with the purpose of making construction sites safer this can be your next challenge. The platform provides modern web and mobile based interfaces for the people working at the constructions sites. Our customer is headquartered in Sweden and is part of a bigger software company group.
In the role as Android Developer, you are joining a skilled international team and you will be focused on building native Android applications in Kotlin.
We believe that you have the following profile:
Solid experience in Android app development in Kotlin
Proficiency in Android SDK and GitHub
Proficiency in working with remote data via gRPC, REST, JSON, etc
Experience with using third-party libraries and APIs
Working knowledge of the general mobile landscape, architectures, latest trends, and emerging technologies
Strong understanding of the full mobile development life cycle
Good English skills verbally and in writing
For the right candidate, we are pleased to offer a competitive compensation and a generous benefits package. Our employees have five weeks of paid vacation per year and health insurances. We support recurring training programs, arrange staff events and have an employees' investment fund. Working for us means a high degree of involvement and we strive for having an open and positive working environment.
We have a top-modern office in Mladost 4 in Sofia and the team is following a hybrid based working model.
If you find our proposal interesting and you meet the above requirements for the position, please send your CV and cover letter in English.
All applications will be treated strictly confidential.
About Comstream:
Comstream is a company group with more than 80 employees and offices in Sweden and Bulgaria. Over the last years we have experienced a strong growth and we are now expanding our business further. We are developing top-notch products and providing high-level customer support for many interesting companies. Comstream is also offering and developing a own SaaS platform for recruiting.
If you want to become member of an international organization with a Scandinavian-influenced business culture, Comstream is the place for you. For us it is important that you can grow in your professional role and with us you are in the right environment for this. We work in teams where everyone are seen and heard and our values are based upon involvement and freedom.
Please visit our corporate website www.comstream.eu for further information about us.

Job Description:
DXC Technology is a Fortune 500 global IT services leader. Our more than 130,000 people in 70- plus countries are entrusted by our customers to deliver what matters most. We use the power of technology to deliver mission-critical IT services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive business impact. DXC is an employer of choice with strong values, and fosters a culture of inclusion, belonging and corporate citizenship.
Start your career with a company that is passionate about developing and nurturing talent in a high-performance culture.
About the Role
We are looking for passionate Interns to assist our Delivery team in resolving common day-to-day challenges in Enterprise Cloud and ITO Infrastructure (Active Directory, Servers, Storage, Backup, Database, Middleware, Networks etc) services. The Intern would need to be eager to explore new things including elements of AI in helping us improve our services delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in research and documentation related to AI technologies and their applications in enterprise environments.
Support infrastructure-related tasks such as monitoring systems, basic troubleshooting, and configuration under supervision.
Help with endpoint device management (Windows, macOS, mobile devices), including inventory checks and basic setup.
Participate in testing and validation of AI-driven tools and automation workflows.
Prepare reports and presentations on findings and progress.
Required Skills & Knowledge
(Since these are students, focus on foundational skills and willingness to learn)
Basic understanding of AI concepts (e.g., machine learning, chatbots, automation).
Knowledge of IT infrastructure fundamentals (Servers, Database, Backups Networks, Middleware and cloud basics).
Familiarity with multiple OS platform (Windows, Unix, Linux, macOS, mobile platforms).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn quickly and work in a team environment.
Preferred (Nice-to-Have)
Exposure to scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) or interest in learning.
Awareness of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Understanding of cybersecurity basics.
Eligibility
Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related fields.
Strong interest in AI and modern workplace technologies.
Eager to explore new technologies and improve the company delivery.
Eligibility :
Must be currently enrolled in a degree or Diploma program (Any computer related program) at College or University 
Intake:2026 / 2027                                     
Duration: 6 months
Eligibility: Malaysian citizen

About the Job
Data Talks is revolutionizing fan engagement for sports clubs through our innovative Fan Engagement Platform. We empower sports organizations to establish meaningful, daily connections with their supporter base, creating more personalized and dynamic relationships between teams and fans.
Some of the Sports Organizations that trust us are: VfL Bochum, Football Association of Ireland, Partizan, Crvena Zvezda, PAOK FC, Ferencváros, and AIK Stockholm.
The Role
We're building the first AI-powered Fan Engagement Platform, and we're looking for a skilled AI/Fullstack Engineer to join us. In this role, you'll architect intelligent systems, power our platform with AI, and build scalable backend services that deliver real impact to millions of fans worldwide.
What You'll Do at Data Talks
•Collaborate with dev teams and product managers to design AI-powered solutions
•Build and maintain robust server-side architecture, databases, and design APIs and implement RAG systems, agentic assistants, and context engineering strategies
•Optimize latency, cost, and performance for production AI systems
•Integrate vector databases into existing pipelines
•Establish evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for AI performance
•Test, debug, and upgrade backend services for responsiveness and efficiency
•Write technical documentation and contribute to frontend solutions when needed (bonus!)
What We're Looking For
•Strong background in fullstack development, design, and architecture
•Proficiency in C# and .NET Core
•Experience with any major cloud provider (AWS preferred)
•Experience with Relational and NoSQL Databases (Postgres, NoSQL)
•Practical knowledge of RAG and information retrieval (dense/sparse embeddings)
•Prompt/context engineering best practices
•Clear grasp of pre-training, fine-tuning, and RAG trade-offs
•High-level understanding of transformer models
•Experience with AI evaluation, benchmarking, and balancing performance trade-offs
•Built agentic systems/chatbots using libraries (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.)
•Familiarity with agentic patterns (tool/function calling/planning)
Bonus Points
•Experience with Semantic Kernel
•Fine-tuning or distilling LLMs
•Recommendation systems
•Frontend skills (HTML, JavaScript, Blazor WASM)
•Curiosity for emerging AI technologies in enterprise
•Hands-on experience with vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, PgVector, etc.)
Location & Employment Format
Location: Offices are located in Stockholm, but we are open for fully-remote work in an EU timezone.
Employment Format: This is a B2B Contract role, with no fixed end date.
Apply for this position

I rollen som Data Engineer hos Consid i Stockholm får du möjlighet att utveckla både dina idéer och dig själv. Tillsammans med dina kollegor bygger ni moderna dataplattformar, integrationslösningar och datapipelines hos kunder i branschens framkant. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper och tror att du trivs med att arbeta kundnära för att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar. Som person tror vi att du är engagerad, nyfiken och drivs av problemlösning.
Inom Consids affärsområde Data, AI och Analys hjälper vi våra kunder att bli verkligt datadrivna genom moderna dataplattformar, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar. I Stockholm är vi idag över 30 specialister inom dataområdet och nationellt är vi 115 kollegor som samarbetar tätt över hela landet. Efterfrågan på vår kompetens fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu fler Data Engineers som vill vara med och bygga framtidens datalösningar tillsammans med oss.
Är detta något för dig?
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
Din kompetens
Minst 3 års erfarenhet av arbete som Data Engineer eller motsvarande roll
Goda kunskaper inom dataintegration, ETL/ELT och pipelineutveckling
Erfarenhet av SQL och databaser
Erfarenhet av verktyg som Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric eller motsvarande
Erfarenhet av att bygga och förvalta moderna datapipelines
Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av lakehouse-arkitektur och moderna dataplattformar
Erfarenhet av streaming och realtidsdata
Kunskaper inom Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform eller Bicep
Erfarenhet av DataOps och CI/CD
Certifieringar inom Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
Fördelar hos Consid
Centralt kontor
Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser.
Kompetenshubbar
Med kontors- och landsövergripande kompetenshubbar finns ständigt möjlighet till kompetensutbyte.
Fantastiska kollegor
Du får världens duktigaste, trevligaste och mest hjälpsamma kollegor.
Engagerade ledare
Ledare som engagerar, pushar och lyfter sina medarbetare och som dessutom jobbar nära sin team.
Vi erbjuder
Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv.

Do you want to join a fast-growing tech company and our continued journey building an online platform where IT professionals meet their future employers? Our service is unique and we have gained a great reputation amongst IT professionals, giving us a solid foundation to bring this business to the next level.
In this role, you will be involved in projects related to our external websites, our SaaS platform and different marketing campaigns. You will work closely together with our team that consists of developers, content writers and product owners.
For this role, it's important that you like to come up with creative ideas combined with an ability to understand the value of what we are offering and who we are targeting. And needless to say, you are an awesome web designer with an ability to create catchy and explanatory designs for both marketing and UX purposes.
We believe that you have the following qualifications:
5+ years of relevant working experience
Proven experience as a web designer with solid experience in both UI and UX design
Experience with both B2B and B2C digital marketing
Knowledge in HTML/CSS is an advantage
Fluent in written and spoken English
University studies in Marketing or similar
This is a part-time role very suitable for a remote freelancer.
If you find our proposal interesting and you meet the above requirements for the position, please don't hesitate to apply. Don't forget to include a link to your professional portfolio in the application.
All applications will be treated strictly confidential.
About Comstream:
Comstream is a company group with more than 80 employees and offices in Sweden and Bulgaria. Over the last years we have experienced a strong growth and we are now expanding our business further. We are developing top-notch products and providing high-level customer support for many interesting companies. Comstream is also offering and developing a own SaaS platform for recruiting.
If you want to become member of an international organization with a Scandinavian-influenced business culture, Comstream is the place for you. For us it is important that you can grow in your professional role and with us you are in the right environment for this. We work in teams where everyone are seen and heard and our values are based upon involvement and freedom. Please visit our corporate website www.comstream.eu for further information about us.

Job Description:
【职责描述】
1. 信息收集与整理：
负责项目主列表、子任务、进度更新等信息的收集；
将零散的项目状态、问题、风险进行归纳汇总；
协助维护项目文档结构。
2. 需求沟通与文档管理：
会议预定，会议纪要整理，需求沟通，记录要点、决议、Action list 与 Owner；
协助项目全生命周期文档管理：版本号、归档、过期文件清理；
协助跟进 Action list 闭环。
3. 模板制作与报告编写：
制作周报、风险汇报、上线邮件、检查清单等模板；
根据 PM 提供的信息编写周报、月报、专题汇报；协助整理工作会议背景材料（项目分析图表、对比表）；
对现有文档进行版式、格式、命名规范化。
4. Leader交办的其他事务。 
【职位要求 】
1、必须项：
本科及以上在校生（专业不限）；每周 ≥4 天，实习期 ≥3 个月；
熟练使用Microsoft Office（Word/Excel/PPT），尤其是 Exce基础公式；
中文写作扎实，能把口语化表达整理成规范书面语；做事细致有条理，能在 SOP / 模板下稳定输出。
2. 熟悉 Confluence / SharePoint / ServiceNow / 企业IM 等协作工具；
3. 有项目助理、PMO 实习或大型活动/项目组织管理经验；
4. 会使用 Python/ VBA 做 Excel 自动化优先；
5. 了解基础 IT 项目开发流程（敏捷、迭代、上线）；有基础 PPT 设计能力；会使用AI工具辅助工作提效。
6. 软实力：执行力强（任务交付及时，遇阻塞主动同步）；沟通清晰（IM/邮件/会议都能高效沟通）；学习力强（快速理解项目流程、术语、规则）；细致度高（命名、版本号、数字核对不出错）；主动性强（不等指挥也会主动想"还有什么需要做"）；抗压性稳（截止节点前能稳定输出）；
7、具备良好的英文读写能力；
8、计算机相关或管理、英语相关专业，硕士学历优先。

This is a high-impact, new business-focused role where you'd develop and execute strategic sales plans to win new enterprise customers, leveraging our market-leading SaaS solutions. Leading the full sales cycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and closure.
Partnering with internal teams, including marketing and pre-sales, to drive high-quality pipeline generation.
Developing joint go-to-market strategies with partners to unlock new opportunities.
Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to expand market reach.
What We'll Be Looking For
Proven success in enterprise SaaS sales, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition.
Many years of enterprise software field sales experience, ideally in data integration, data management, AI or a related technology domain.
Strong track record of hunting, closing new business, and exceeding quota in enterprise sales.
Fluency in English required; proficiency in a relevant local language (German, French, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Finnish, Spanish, or Arabic) is a plus depending on territory.
Ability to engage and influence C-level executives and key decision-makers.
Experience with complex, consultative sales cycles and selling technical platform solutions.
Proficiency in Salesforce, Clari, and MEDDPICC methodology.
Passionate about winning new business—a true sales hunter!

Job Description:
DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com.
Role Summary
This 6‑month internship provides hands-on exposure to cybersecurity operations across Security Operations (SOC), infrastructure security, identity management, and GRC. You will work on real operational tasks with mentor guidance, following a structured plan with clear deliverables and measurable outcomes.
Key Responsibilities & Work Environment
Triage security alerts under supervision, validate findings, and determine closure or escalation.
Gather, analyze, and document evidence from logs, endpoints, and network sources with clear case notes.
Follow established runbooks consistently and propose practical improvements to strengthen processes.
Support infrastructure security activities, including system hardening, vulnerability tracking, and remediation verification.
Identify monitoring gaps and contribute to detection improvement ideas with consideration of false positives.
Apply identity and access management principles, including least privilege and role-based access.
Support access reviews and prepare audit-ready evidence on user access and approvals.
Assist in maintaining privileged access controls and ensuring proper documentation.
Contribute to GRC activities, including control-to-evidence mapping, basic risk documentation, and audit traceability.
Produce weekly deliverables such as triage write-ups, runbook improvements, verification reports, and access review documentation.
Maintain a structured repository of notes, templates, and finalized artifacts.
Deliver a final capstone project that provides practical value to the team (e.g., detection improvement or runbook enhancement).
Work in a live operational environment with supervision, defined escalation paths, and possible SOC shift exposure.
Adhere strictly to confidentiality, approved tools, and data handling requirements.
Requirements & Preferred Profile
Currently enrolled in a degree/diploma in IT, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Basic understanding of networking (IP, DNS, HTTP) and operating systems (Windows or Linux).
Strong written communication and ability to produce clear, structured documentation.
Ability to follow processes consistently and apply feedback.
Exposure to security concepts such as monitoring, vulnerability management, identity controls, or basic scripting is advantageous.
Interest in operational work requiring accuracy, consistency, and evidence-based thinking.
Eligibility:
Intake: November 2026 onwards 
Internship Duration: Minimum and maximum of 6 months
Eligibility: Malaysian citizens only, final‑year students
Work arrangement: Hybrid (1-2 days on site), 8.30 am to 5.30 pm
Work location: DXC office,10A, Jalan Bersatu 13/4, PJS 13, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. In this role, you will be responsible for our Fluoride Reduction Process which includes neutralizing high levels of fluorides that are acceptable with our discharge permit.

You will also gain experience on recovering and recycling process waste using multimedia and carbon filters along with reverse osmosis systems to help us meet our sustainability goals.

Knowledge or experience working with water system, wastewater, manufacturing, or mechanical equipment.
Knowledge or experience in the following areas: plumbing, pump repair, plant operations, or maintenance.
Perform calibrations and validations of sensors including pH and conductivity meters.
Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Ability to work in a noisy, dusty, industrial/manufacturing environment, and exposed to non-toxic fumes, gases, chemicals, or grease and oil.
Must possess a valid US driver’s license and ability to operate motor vehicles
Must be able to climb ladders, and scaffolding at heights, work in confined spaces, and must be able to work in non-climate-controlled environments.
Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs., frequently lift up to 40 lbs., consistently lift up to 25 lbs, and have the ability to complete repetitive motions while applying pressure involving fingers, hands, and wrists.
Exposure to recurring bending, crouching, stooping, kneeling, sitting, climbing, stretching, or similar activities.
The work requires some physical exertion such as long periods of standing or walking over hard concrete surface.
Must possess a high school degree or GED.
This position requires the lawful ability to access technical data, information, and areas controlled by United States export control laws and regulations

Position Overview:
EPI-USE has partnered with ADP to deploy Lyric, a next-generation, cloud-based HR platform. We have experienced strong growth over the last few years and are wanting to expand at junior and mid-levels. As a Lyric consultant you will support clients using a next-generation, cloud-based HCM platform. You will also collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to troubleshoot issues, support implementations, and ensure seamless system performance. Learn more about Lyric by visiting https://www.adp.com/what-we-offer/products/lyric.aspx
Key Responsibilities
As a Lyric consultant you should be able to demonstrate an initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and purposeful approach to problem-solving in a fast-paced consulting environment. This includes consultation and implementation of projects by:
Functioning as a client-facing consultant by gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into Lyric solutions.
Applying knowledge of current HR policies, practices, and emerging trends to align system processes with business needs.
Supporting configuration, testing, training, data migration, and change management of the Lyric solution during implementations.
Collaborating effectively with internal teams and clients, communicating clearly both verbally and in writing.
Managing multiple initiatives concurrently while meeting deadlines.
Share knowledge with clients.
Requirements
Tertiary qualification in either a Bachelor’s in informatics (BCom INF), Bachelor of Information Science (BIS), Bachelor in Computer Science (BSc), or related field.
Experience in either SAP, SuccessFactors, Workday, PaySpace, Sage, Workforce Software, Workday exposure is advantageous.
Strong analytical thinking, communication, and critical thinking skills.
Proficiency in Office and MS Teams. Additional software capabilities in Jira and Notion would be advantageous.

Full-time.
Office access available in Pretoria and Stellenbosch (preferred proximity). (Further details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates)

Market-related remuneration.
Global exposure.
Meaningful career development.
Collaborative culture. (Further details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates)

About Boomi and What Makes Us Special
Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
How You'll Make An Impact
Drive revenue growth by optimizing and creating Presales programs and initiatives to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of the technical sales process. 
Ensure that Presales teams are equipped with the knowledge and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences through enablement content and reusable assets sourced from the field. 
Identify and implement process improvements, tools and best practices to assist in streamlining Presales workflows and operations. 
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between Presales, sales, marketing, product management, and other teams to break down silos, foster a culture of collaboration and teamwork and drive collective success and business growth.
Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, to drive innovation within the Presales organization.
Assist the Director of Global Presales Strategies in creating data-driven insights to identify areas for improvement and optimization, in order to continuously refine strategies and initiatives to drive better results.
What You'll Do
Manage change requests for Presales technologies by working with stakeholders to understand requirements, implement, and track to resolution ensuring that any changes adhere to established governance standards, policies, and procedures.
Provide project management support for projects relating to new Presales programs, demo tools and improvement processes. (e.g. develop playbooks, process documentation, new product subject matter expert program maintenance, presentations, written communications).
Facilitate knowledge sharing through weekly webinars and curated, field sourced content to share best practices and reusable assets across Presales teams globally to drive consistency and excellence.
Create and maintain database of relevant materials and work with assigned SMEs on a scheduled basis to ensure accuracy
Create, maintain and socialize “Tiger Team” programs focused on the identification, socialization and continual education for field SMEs across different technologies.
Manage programs centered around collection of feedback from win/loss reviews, customer stories and lessons learned from a technical perspective
Socialize and improve current demo up level programs including enforcing standard demo methodologies using vetted content and focus on improvement of related soft skills.
Manage global skills matrix across Boomi core products, common competitors, commonly used apps/systems and coding including verification method improvements
Creation and maintenance of rotational programs for security, professional services, solution architecture, etc.  to improve technical knowledge of our field sellers
Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Presales management, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
The Experience You Bring
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, business, or related field.
5+ years of experience in Project Management with a track record of developing and implementing successful strategies.
Demonstrated operational rigor and effective maximization of resources while paying attention to the details.
Hybrid analytical/creative mindset with the ability to leverage data and metrics to drive decision-making and continuous improvement using creative solutions.
Ability to collect and analyze data to prioritize properly and report on metrics to track progress and identify areas of improvement.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
Training and certifications in Project Management (PMP, MPM, PgMP or equivalent) Agile/Scrum, ITIL, Salesforce.com, Java, Power BI and/or AWS are a plus.
This is a US Based Remote role with preferred location in Philadelphia, Dallas, or Denver.
Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!

Job Description:
A DXC Technology ajuda empresas globais em seus sistemas e operações de missão crítica modernizando TI, otimizando arquiteturas de dados e garantindo segurança e escalabilidade em nuvem pública, privada e híbrida. As maiores empresas e organizações de setor público confiam na DXC para implantar serviços para impulsionar novos níveis de desempenho, competitividade e experiência do cliente em suas propriedades de TI. Saiba mais sobre como entregamos excelência para nossos clientes e colegas em DXC.com.
Sobre a área
Os serviços de Cibersegurança da DXC ajudam os clientes a avaliar riscos e a lidar proativamente com todos os aspectos do seu ambiente de segurança, de inteligência de ameaças a conformidade. Utilizamos metodologias comprovadas, automação inteligente e parceiros líderes do setor para adaptar soluções de segurança às necessidades específicas de cada cliente.
Funções essenciais do cargo
Apoiar os processos de Gestão de Identidade e Acessos (IAM), contribuindo para o controle adequado de acessos e identidades digitais.
Executar atividades relacionadas ao ciclo de vida de usuários, incluindo suporte aos processos de concessão, alteração e remoção de acessos.
Apoiar a gestão de perfis e permissões de usuários nos ambientes e sistemas sob responsabilidade da equipe.
Contribuir com atividades de governança de acessos e atendimento aos requisitos e políticas corporativas de Segurança da Informação.
Apoiar controles e atividades relacionados à conformidade de segurança.
Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Segurança da Informação no suporte às demandas de Gestão de Identidade e Acessos.
Qualificações básicas
Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
Conhecimentos básicos em Segurança da Informação.
Conhecimentos básicos de Active Directory e Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
Conhecimentos sobre controle de acessos, permissões e perfis de usuários.
Conhecimentos básicos de sistemas operacionais Windows.
Conhecimentos do Pacote Microsoft Office.
Qualificações desejáveis
Cursos ou certificações relacionados à Segurança da Informação.
Conhecimento em processos de Governança, Risco e Compliance (GRC).
Inglês intermediário para leitura e compreensão de documentação técnica.
Vivência, estágio ou experiência prévia em áreas como Service Desk, Suporte Técnico, Administração de Usuários, TI, Segurança da Informação ou Gestão de Acessos.
Diversidade e Inclusão
Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência.
O que estamos oferecendo?
Vários benefícios, salário competitivo e nossos valores fazem da DXC uma das mais importantes e atraentes empresas para se trabalhar no mundo. Na DXC nosso objetivo é proporcionar equidade de oportunidades, respeitando as individualidades, afim de construir um equilíbrio entre vida profissional / pessoal e oportunidade constante de evolução de carreira.

Payroll & Tax Consultant
Responsibilities:
Serves as multi-functional Subject Matter Expert in Payroll, Tax, and Garnishments Assists EMS with inquiries and responses
Engages with identification of system issues and requirement setting for enhancements and regulatory changes
Works closely with EMS Internal Partners, Tax Authorities, and Third Parties to identify and consult on regulatory and/or compliance issues
Oversees implementation of SAP Notes, BSI TaxFactory upgrades, and HRSPs with participation in Test planning and execution
Assists with full cycle Quarter End and Year End processes
Conducts research and provides accurate responses to all communications via case management system
Provides research, analysis, and necessary reconciliation to respond to and resolve tax agency notices and amendments within established service level agreements (SLAs)
Prioritizes work in order to minimize liability exposure to both client and EMS
Work on special projects and additional duties as assigned
Skills:
Required: SAP© Payroll
Required: Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook
Preferred: ADP MasterTax
Experience:
Minimum of five years' experience with Canada and U.S. complex, multi-state payrolls and tax filings
Minimum three to five years' testing experience
Working knowledge of payroll procedures and Federal/State/Local employment tax laws
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to maintain cooperative working relationships with all levels of management, clients, and colleagues
Ability to plan, organize, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Education:
Four-year degree and US or Canada Payroll Certification preferred
Schedule:
This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday 8:00AM-5:00PM EST. Additional hours and weekends may be required during necessary periods to meet deadlines or when EMS is dealing with unpredictable increases in workload.

Vi erbjuder
Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv.

Om ECIT
ECIT Services AB (556658-0410) är en ledande leverantör inom outsourcing av ekonomi- och lönefunktioner samt affärssystem. ECIT Services administrativa tjänster bildar ett koncept som ger kunder tillgång till en helt eller delvis outsourcad ekonomifunktion. ECIT Services erbjuder ett webbaserat affärssystem som effektivt tar hand om kunders ekonomi- och affärsprocesser inom handel, logistik och projekthantering. 
ECIT Services huvudägare är norska ECIT AS. ECIT Group består av mellanstora redovisnings- och IT-företag. Antal anställda är ca 3 000 i huvudsak fördelade i 11 länder. Företagets ledningsgrupp har en betydande meritlista och erfarenhet av att bygga upp liknande verksamheter. SAP SuccessFactors Consultant
Position Overview:
EPI-USE Canada is urgently hiring for SAP SuccessFactors Consultant with expertise in Recruiting, Onboarding 2.0 (ONB 2.0), and Employee Central (EC).
Roles and Responsibilities:
Configure, implement, and support SuccessFactors Recruiting, Onboarding 2.0 (ONB 2.0), and Employee Central (EC) solutions.
Provide expertise in LMS and Performance & Goal Management (PMGM), ensuring seamless integration and system optimization.
Collaborate with HR and IT teams to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
Perform system configurations, customizations, and enhancements to meet business requirements.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SuccessFactors modules, ensuring system stability and efficiency.
Provide end-user training and documentation to ensure effective utilization of the platform.
Closely work with stakeholders to continuously improve HR processes and system functionalities.
Stay updated on SAP SuccessFactors best practices, new features, and industry trends to drive continuous improvement.
Requirements:
SAP SuccessFactors certification(s) in Recruiting, EC, ONB 2.0.
Proven experience as a SuccessFactors Consultant with a strong focus on Recruiting, ONB 2.0, and Employee Central (EC).
Hands-on expertise in Learning Management System (LMS) and Performance & Goal Management (PMGM).
Strong knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors configuration, implementation, and support.
Ability to analyze business processes, design workflows, and provide system recommendations.
Experience in integrations with other HR systems and third-party tools.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
About EPI-USE
EPI-USE is part of Group Elephant, which employs more than 4,200 people worldwide. Best known as the world's largest and most experienced independent SAP HR/Payroll specialist, designing, building, and implementing Cloud-based, hybrid and on-premises HR/Payroll systems for large, complex multinational corporations, EPI-USE has recently emerged as a leader in deploying SAP's S/4HANA Finance applications across several industries, with the proprietary 'S/4 FastTrack' program designed for Higher Education institutions in the USA.

As an Applications Engineer for Advanced Packaging, you will provide pre- and post-sales technical support to customers integrating Wolfspeed SiC substrates into 2.5D and 3D packaging architectures for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI data center applications. Building on Wolfspeed's 35+ years of SiC materials leadership and an established portfolio of proven use cases, you will act as the technical bridge between our materials expertise and the customer's package design — showing customers exactly where and why SiC delivers value across heat spreaders and carriers, passive and active interposers, and package substrates. Beyond supporting today's use cases, you are expected to generate your own ideas for new SiC applications and to engage closely with partners, customers, and foundries to co-design next-generation architectures. With a defined product roadmap and active foundry, OSAT, and hyperscaler engagements already underway, you will guide customers with authority through use-case identification, material selection, design validation, and qualification. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation in semiconductor packaging, thermal simulation, and process integration.
Key responsibilities:
Guide customer packaging engineers, foundries, and OSATs in selecting the optimal SiC use case (heat spreader, carrier, passive/active interposer, or package substrate) and incorporating Wolfspeed SiC wafers and substrates into advanced packaging architectures (2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration, CoWoS-style platforms). Provide remote and on-site technical support.
Proactively identify and propose new SiC use cases, and partner closely with customers, foundries, OSATs, and ecosystem players to co-design novel packaging architectures that extend SiC beyond today's applications.
Lead the design, development, and documentation of reference demonstrations for SiC interposer, heat-spreader, and substrate applications, including thermal performance benchmarks that quantify SiC's operating-temperature, hot-spot, and thermal-cross-talk advantages over silicon, glass, and ceramic.
Supply customers with validated SiC material characteristics — including anisotropic/directional thermal conductivity and bond-interface data — to drive accurate package-level thermal modeling.
Develop and present technical materials at packaging industry conferences and tradeshows and ecosystem partner workshops.
Support new product and PDK launches, including training for Wolfspeed sales teams, foundry partners, and EDA ecosystem players (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys) on SiC design rules, process windows, and integration guidelines.
Provide product managers with consolidated customer requirements and use-case prioritization to define new SiC packaging products, interposer specifications, and PDK enhancements.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or equivalent with relevant experience.
Deep industry know-how— an insider's understanding of how hyperscalers, foundries, and OSATs specify advanced packages, and the ability to translate their thermal, power-density, warpage, cost, and reliability requirements into SiC material and product specifications.
Understanding of advanced packaging architectures including 2.5D/3D integration, interposer structures, TSV/TSiCV fabrication, and chiplet design.
Experience with thermal simulation tools (e.g., ANSYS Icepak, FloTHERM) for package-level thermal analysis; ability to model and communicate SiC's thermal advantages in high-power-density scenarios (AI chips approaching 250+ W/cm² by 2030).
Familiarity with packaging process flows: wafer thinning, via etching (RIE), metallization, micro-bump/hybrid bonding, and CTE mismatch considerations for SiC integration.
Experience with EDA or simulation environments relevant to packaging (e.g., Cadence Sigrity, Synopsys) is a plus.
Strong oral and written communication and presentation skills.
The ideal candidate will be located at our headquarter in Durham, North Carolina.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Wolfspeed is a powerhouse semiconductor company focused on silicon carbide and GaN technologies.
After more than thirty years of forging new technology adoption and transformation, our Wolfspeed® power and radio frequency (RF) semiconductors are leading the industry through unrivaled expertise and capacity.

Summer Internship at Visma!
Join our 2027 summer internship program and make your mark at Europe's leading cloud software company.
 Apply for this job
Imagine spending your summer working alongside some of the brightest minds in the tech industry, where your ideas are not only welcomed but encouraged. The Visma summer internship program is your ticket to gain hands-on experience, drive innovation, and develop valuable skills - whether your passion lies in software- or business development. Join us and set the stage for a meaningful and impactful career in tech.
A little bit about us
Visma is a collective of 150+ business software companies operating across 28 markets. With 2.5 million customers and counting, we're on a mission to make business administration effortlessly simple for small businesses, large enterprises, and local governments alike.
What you can expect
Based on your background and preferences, you’ll join one of our business units to work on a project in key areas such as Business development, Software Engineering or AI development. From day one, you’ll be an essential member of your assigned team, contributing to strategically important projects to drive our company forward. You'll gain an inside look at how advanced technology solves real business problems and creates significant value for society.
When you apply, we ask you to choose the area you prefer to work in. Here’s a brief overview.
Business Development. You have a strong passion for the intersection of business and technology. Analysing a complex dataset, exploring a new market, or rethinking how a product reaches its customers: you're the kind of person who rolls up their sleeves and dives in.
You're comfortable working with data, love a good challenge, and know how to bring people along with you. Communicating across teams comes naturally, and you're always looking for smarter ways to do things.
Software Engineering. You'll work closely with our team on features that actually matter for mission-critical products. Depending on the project and your interests, you’ll gain hands-on experience in backend and/or frontend development, cloud technology, UX and product development, supercharged by agentic development.
You'll also work across different teams and disciplines, giving you valuable insights into how technology functions in practice and how what you've learned from Computer Science translates into practical, impactful solutions.
AI Development. Your technical responsibilities will center on the development of our AI products, where you'll contribute to algorithms, machine learning techniques, and innovative solutions. You’ll design prototypes and proof-of-concepts for real-world applications, such as anomaly detection in payroll and agentic AI. You're motivated by technological innovation and seeing it translate into real commercial impact.
Curious to see what previous interns have been up to? Follow us on Instagram!
Who we’re looking for
If you’re a student in the third or fourth year of your studies and are ready to gain real-world experience at one of Europe’s largest software companies, we want to meet you! Perhaps you have an undiscovered developer inside you and are motivated by programming and finding new solutions. Or maybe you have ambitions to work strategically with technology and lead future technology projects. You are studying IT, computer science, communication technology, informatics, or industrial economics or economics.
Either way, you should be ready to:
Challenge the status quo
Use critical thinking skills to solve complex problems
Be a self-starter who also works well in a team
Demonstrate great written and verbal communication (in both Swedishh and English)
Sounds like you? Apply today!
Internship details
The internship is paid and runs over 8 weeks from the middle of June until the first week of August. You’ll have two weeks off in July for a holiday break.
During your internship, you’ll work on real projects, so the goal is for us to continue your work after the summer is over. You’ll work in international teams and be given a high level of responsibility while being supported by experienced colleagues. We’ll do our best to put you on a project that aligns with your competence and interests.
Why choose Visma?
At Visma, we go beyond competitive terms and employee benefits. Here’s what makes us stand out.
We invest in your development. Personal and career growth are priorities here. With support from a dedicated programme leader, a project leader, and a buddy from our current or former trainees, you'll build a solid network to rely on for guidance and development.
Experience a variety of responsibilities. One of the biggest advantages of doing your internship at Visma? You're not joining just one company, you're joining a network of 150+ companies, each with their own products and projects. That means plenty of options when it comes to finding a summer project that genuinely interests you.
We’re more than just colleagues. Enjoy a warm, social work culture with social activities for everyone. We invite you to a cabin trip together with the other interns, so you can all get to know each other really well and share some good memories. Your buddies will also make sure you have a blast, with fun activities planned after work!
Application process
Instead of a traditional cover letter, we want to know: what do you hope to gain from a Summer Internship at Visma, and an example of how you utilise AI. Share your thoughts in a paragraph or two, approximately 100-150 words. Don't forget to upload your CV and higher education grade reports; screenshots of grades are okay if official reports aren't available.
We'll review applications on an ongoing basis, and you may be asked to complete an ability- and personality assessment as part of your application. If we believe we're a great match, you'll be invited to a digital interview. For candidates progressing to the next stage, the final interview will also be digital and include a case assignment. Everyone who applies will hear from us, so keep an eye on your inbox (and your spam folder, just in case!)
Remember to apply before the deadline, 15th of November 2026 - we can't wait to hear from you!
Questions? Reach out to vendela.hafstrom@visma.com.

Söker du nya utmaningar? Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Consids nysatsning inom Engineering-området.
Consid söker nu erfarna mekanikingenjörer till uppdrag där du blir en nyckelperson i utvecklingen av framtidens tekniska system. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i komplexa och teknikintensiva miljöer, där uppdragen ofta är kopplade till säkerhetskritiska verksamheter. Många av våra uppdrag är säkerhetsklassade, vilket innebär att du får möjlighet att arbeta med teknik där höga krav ställs på kvalitet och säkerhet.
Rollen
Som mekanikingenjör kommer du att arbeta med konstruktion och utveckling av mekaniska lösningar för krävande produkter och system. Du kan exempelvis arbeta med avancerad produktutveckling inom försvar, industri eller annan högteknologisk verksamhet.
Dina arbetsuppgifter
Konstruktion och utveckling av mekaniska komponenter och system.
Modellering och ritningsframtagning i till exempel Siemens NX, Catia V5 eller Creo.
Samverkan med elkonstruktörer, systemingenjörer och andra teknikområden.
Arbete enligt branschens aktuella standarder och krav.
Din kompetens
Civilingenjör eller högskoleingenjör inom maskinteknik, mekatronik eller motsvarande område.
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion i industriella projekt.
Mycket goda kunskaper i CAD.
God förmåga att arbeta strukturerat med kravhantering.
Flytande i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Meriterande
Tidigare erfarenhet från försvar-, fordon- eller annan komplex industri.
Tidigare erfarenhet av rollen som konsult.
Fördelar hos Consid
Centralt kontor
Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser.
Aktiviteter för alla
Det anordnas ständigt roliga aktiviteter anpassat för kollegor, vänner och familj på våra kontor runt om i landet.
Bred kompetens
Med över 40 kontor runt om i Europa finns mycket kunskap och kompetens inom många olika områden.
Stora men familjära
Kan man vara ett världsledande bolag men behålla känslan av att vara ett mindre familjärt bolag? Svaret är Consid.
Vi erbjuder
Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv.

Essential Job Functions:
 Design, develop, and implement automated testing solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of software applications.  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in an Agile development environment
 • Familiarity with software development life cycles, including waterfall, Agile, and DevOps methodologies
 • Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, as well as experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, or TestComplete.

Om jobbet
Är nu noggrann och strukturerad? Har du en gedigen erfarenhet av att jobba med dokumentation inom teknik/IT? Vill du hjälpa våra kunder med att skapa en dokumentation som är lätt att hitta, lätt att förstå och lätt att använda?
Vi växer och söker fler fantastiska kollegor!
Vi har spännande uppdrag på gång hos våra kunder och nu söker vi dig med en mycket god IT-kunskap som vill jobba som teknisk skribent och utvecklas som konsult. Placering för tjänsten är Stockholm. Vårt eget kontor ligger på Skeppsholmen i Stockholm.
Som konsulter är våra kunders dokumentation vår kärnverksamhet. Vi hjälper kunderna att analysera, skriva och organisera deras dokumentation. Teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet är viktigt likaväl som lyhördhet, nyfikenhet samt ett intresse för kundens behov. Våra kunder finns i många olika branscher och om du har erfarenhet från IT, telekom, industri, finans, försvar eller mjukvaruutveckling är det meriterande. Det viktigaste är att du har mångårig erfarenhet av att arbeta med teknisk dokumentation i olika tekniska exempelvis inom områden som utveckling, infrastruktur, IT/mjukvara eller IT-säkerhet.
Dokumentera är ett konsultföretag som växer och utvecklas med sina anställda. Som medarbetare hos oss har du marknadens bästa tekniska skribenter och dokumentationsspecialister som kollegor. Du jobbar med intressanta uppdrag hos våra framgångsrika kunder. Vi har korta beslutsvägar, högt i tak och är öppna för att utvecklas med dina idéer.
Vi söker dig som har:
Mångårig erfarenhet av att jobba som teknisk skribent. 
Goda IT-kunskaper och erfarenhet av IT-dokumentation.
God systemvana samt erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika CMS:er.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.  
God social kompetens.
Goda kunskaper i Officepaketet.
Meriterande men inget krav:
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i rollen som teknisk skribent.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt i utvecklingsteam.
Akademisk examen inom teknik/IT.
Goda kunskaper i flera dokumenthanteringssystem, t ex Sharepoint. 
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i XML-baserade system.
Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Skicka in din ansökan genom att fylla i formuläret. Skriv in ditt personliga brev i avsett fält eller bifoga ett brev tillsammans med ditt cv. Gör det redan idag! Har du frågor? Slå en signal till Emelie Sandström 070 951 42 90. Vi rekryterar löpande.
Fler lediga tjänster
Som konsult på Dokumentera hjälper du våra kunder att bli mer effektiva och framgångsrika med professionell information och dokumentation.

Launch your career as a Management Trainee at Visma!
Five projects, a global network and a guaranteed job at the end
 Apply today
Are you a final-year student with big ambitions and a drive to make things happen? Are you looking for diverse learning opportunities, a variety of projects to dive into, and a close-knit community of fellow trainees? Oh, and a job guarantee? We've got that too. Welcome to the Visma Management Trainee program!
We're opening up a limited number of Management Trainee positions starting autumn 2027. This one-year program is designed to help you grow, explore your strengths, and find your place in an international, thriving company.
A little about us
Visma is a collective of 150+ business software companies operating across 28 markets. With 2.7 million customers and counting, we're on a mission to make business administration effortlessly simple for small businesses, large enterprises, and local governments alike.
The Management Trainee experience
As a Management Trainee, you'll work on five strategic projects across Visma's companies over one year. You'll have the chance to really contribute to Visma’s deliveries and work in various European locations, like Oslo or Amsterdam.
Read more about the program here.
This international program connects you with fellow trainees from Norway, Sweden, and the Netherlands. It all kicks off with an introduction week at our HQ in Oslo, followed by joint gatherings across Europe throughout the year. This gives you plenty of time to build connections that last well beyond the program.
Once you complete the year, you're guaranteed a permanent role within Visma. Together we'll help you land in the right place, and the five projects you lead are the perfect way to figure out where that is. Three former trainees are currently in top management, and previous trainees hold roles like Finance Director, AI Director, M&A Manager, Product Owner or Business Developer, to name just a few.
Want to see what life as a trainee actually looks like? Follow along on our Instagram.
Who we’re looking for
Our Management Trainees come from diverse backgrounds, each bringing unique skills and personalities. What they all have in common is their curious mindset, proactive approach to innovation, and strong collaboration skills. They are critical thinkers, love to ask questions, thrive on responsibility and tend to have leadership ambitions. Proficiency in both Danish and English communication is crucial.
If this sounds like you, and you’re finishing up a Master’s degree within business, management, finance, technology or IT by August 2027, we’d love to get to know you!
Why choose Visma?
At Visma, we go beyond the standard package. Here’s what makes us stand out.
We invest in your development. Personal and career growth are priorities here. From day one, you'll have a senior leader in Visma as your mentor, a dedicated program coordinator, and a former trainee as your buddy. You'll build a solid network to rely on for guidance and development.
Real responsibility. All the projects you will take lead on are strategic and business critical to Visma where you will leave your mark and bring us forward. We'll trust you to experiment and make decisions. That’s how you learn and grow.
A network of 150+ companies to explore. One of the biggest advantages of the program? You get to move across different companies, products, and roles, so by the end of the year, you'll know exactly where you want to take your career.
More than just colleagues. We have a warm, social culture with something for everyone: from yoga to monthly Friday Bars and international gatherings with your fellow trainees. We like to connect.
And the perks aren't bad either. Pension and health insurance, and a new and sustainable office in Carlsberg Byen where you can experience our great lunch, barista coffee, fitness center and much more – and access to company apartments in Chamonix and Marbella.
Application process
Applying is really easy!
Instead of a traditional cover letter, we want you to share your motivation for becoming a Management Trainee at Visma, and an example of how you utilise AI. Share your thoughts in a paragraph or two, approximately 100-150 words. Don't forget to upload your CV and higher education grade reports; screenshots of grades are okay if official reports aren't available.
We'll review applications right after the deadline and make sure to give feedback to everyone. Keep an eye on your spam folder, just in case!
Once you apply, you'll be invited to complete an online ability test and a personality assessment. If we think we are a great match, we'll invite you to a digital interview. For the final interview, we will invite you to visit our office in Copenhagen, which will include a case study.
Remember to apply before the deadline: Tuesday 1st of December 2026. 
Questions? Reach out to benedikte.lyngbo@visma.com
We can't wait to hear from you!

Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor.
