IT-tekniker till Forss IT AB i Katrineholm
Har du relevant utbildning eller gedigen arbetslivserfarenhet som IT-tekniker och vill arbeta på ett innovativt, familjärt företag där du får möjlighet att utveckla dig själv samtidigt som du får vara en del av företagets utveckling och även kunna påverka och utveckla lösningar mot våra kunder?
 Vi ser stor potential att fortsätta växa i regionen.
Därför förstärker vi nu ett redan framgångsrikt team för att fortsätta ge våra kunder bästa möjliga service. 
 Christian Wallinder, VD Forss IT
Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med fokus på hög service och nöjda kunder.
Det kommer att finnas stora möjligheter att kunna vara med och påverka beslut tillsammans med din närmsta chef och resterande medarbetare. Vi ser att du är en lagspelare som bidrar och delar med dig till teamet. Vi är en mindre organisation med korta beslutsvägar där dina tankar och idéer blir en del av vår framgång.
Om tjänsten
I rollen som IT-tekniker är du företagets ansikte och röst utåt och har mycket kontakt med våra kunder och deras användare. Du har ansvar för vissa av våra kunder och arbetar ofta på plats hos kund eller via fjärrstyrning från vårt kontor. Din insats kommer att bidra till både vår och våra kunders fortsatta framgång. Vi söker därför dig som kan hjälpa kunden rent tekniskt, men som också kan få kunden att känna sig väl bemött. Du hjälper kunden såväl på plats hos kund som via fjärrstyrning från kontoret. Personliga besök hos kunder förekommer.
Vi söker dig som
Har erfarenhet av installation och administration av datorer
Har erfarenhet av Windows, klient och server
Har erfarenhet av Microsoft 365 samt Cloud-lösningar
Har erfarenhet av uppsättning och underhåll av företagsnätverk
Har en relevant utbildning alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet inom området
Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, såväl i tal som i skrift
Har god arbetsvana inom ett strukturerat arbetssätt med dokumentation och ärendehantering
Har en god lyhördhet, lösningsorienterad och naturlig social förmåga. Stimuleras av lagarbete och tydliga affärsmål
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av virtualisering t.ex. VMWare eller Hyper-V
Erfarenheter inom IT-säkerhet
Om företaget
Forss IT AB är ett starkt lokalt företag som erbjuder helhetslösningar inom IT. Sedan starten 1998 finns merparten av våra kunder i närregionen – där vi erbjuder datorer, service, drift, molntjänster, webb och bredband

IT-tekniker till Forss IT AB i Norrköping
Har du relevant utbildning eller gedigen arbetslivserfarenhet som IT-tekniker och vill arbeta på ett innovativt, familjärt företag där du får möjlighet att utveckla dig själv samtidigt som du får vara en del av företagets utveckling och även kunna påverka och utveckla lösningar mot våra kunder?
 Vi ser stor potential att fortsätta växa i regionen.
Därför förstärker vi nu ett redan framgångsrikt team för att fortsätta ge våra kunder bästa möjliga service. 
 Christian Wallinder, VD Forss IT
Du kommer att ingå i ett härligt arbetslag som drivs av att leverera service i världsklass.
Det kommer att finnas stora möjligheter att kunna vara med och påverka beslut tillsammans med din närmsta chef och resterande medarbetare. Vi ser att du är en lagspelare som bidrar och delar med dig till teamet. Vi är en mindre organisation med korta beslutsvägar där dina tankar och idéer blir en del av vår framgång.
Om tjänsten
I rollen som IT-tekniker är du företagets ansikte och röst utåt och har mycket kontakt med våra kunder och deras användare. Du har ansvar för vissa av våra kunder och arbetar ofta på plats hos kund eller via fjärrstyrning från vårt kontor. Din insats kommer att bidra till både vår och våra kunders fortsatta framgång. Vi söker därför dig som kan hjälpa kunden rent tekniskt, men som också kan få kunden att känna sig väl bemött. Du hjälper kunden såväl på plats hos kund som via fjärrstyrning från kontoret. Personliga besök hos kunder förekommer.
Vi söker dig som
Har erfarenhet av installation och administration av datorer
Har erfarenhet av Windows, klient och server
Har erfarenhet av Microsoft 365 samt Cloud-lösningar
Har erfarenhet av uppsättning och underhåll av företagsnätverk
Har en relevant utbildning alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet inom området
Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, såväl i tal som i skrift
Har god arbetsvana inom ett strukturerat arbetssätt med dokumentation och ärendehantering
Har en god lyhördhet, lösningsorienterad och naturlig social förmåga. Stimuleras av lagarbete och tydliga affärsmål
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av virtualisering t.ex. VMWare eller Hyper-V
Erfarenheter inom IT-säkerhet
Om företaget
Forss IT AB är ett starkt lokalt företag som erbjuder helhetslösningar inom IT. Sedan starten 1998 finns merparten av våra kunder i närregionen – där vi erbjuder datorer, service, drift, molntjänster, webb och bredband

Silverfin - Solution Developer - Accounting
Solution Developer - Accounting
Gouda
Business Solutions /
Payroll /
Hybrid
apply for this job
Silverfin is a cutting-edge cloud software solution built by accountants, for accountants.
Founded in 2013, Silverfin was created to solve the frustrations of manual, error-prone processes in analysing financial data and compliance. From day one, we’ve been a cloud-first platform with an open API architecture, leveraging structured data to transform how accountants work.
Our mission is simple: to enhance and support the accountancy profession through AI and automation, ensuring accountants remain relevant and respected in the future of finance.
In 2023, Silverfin became part of the Visma Group, joining one of Europe’s leading providers of cloud software. This partnership strengthens our ability to innovate and expand our impact within the accountancy industry.
Today, Silverfin is trusted by over 1000+ firms across 19 countries. Our clients include all of the Big 4 accounting firms, as well as leading global networks like BDO, PKF, Baker Tilly, Grant Thornton, and Moore.
Headquartered in Ghent, with offices in London, Luxembourg, Gouda (NL), and a 2nd office in South of Belgium (Mont-Saint-Guibert), we’re a team of over 200 people - including a diverse remote engineering team working across multiple time zones - all working together to drive innovation in accounting.
How would you support our success?
Your role
Because of our continued growth in the Netherlands, we’re looking for a Solution Developer to join our NL Business Solutions team. You’ll combine your accounting expertise with technology to build and improve solutions on Silverfin’s accounting platform, helping accounting firms work more efficiently, consistently and at scale.
You might be a qualified accountant, or you may have several years of experience working in an accounting firm and be ready for a different kind of challenge. You don’t need a coding background: we’ll teach you how to build and develop the templates our clients use every day.
What matters most is your judgement. As we evolve how solutions are built and delivered at Silverfin, your focus will increasingly be on understanding what needs to be built, assessing whether it works for the firms using it, and continuously improving it. The role is becoming less about writing everything from scratch and more about specifying, reviewing and improving solutions.
How we use AI
AI is part of the everyday way we work, rather than an occasional add-on. As a Solution Developer, you’ll use AI-assisted development and review tools to help write and refactor code, generate tests, debug issues and review changes before they are released.
Used well, these tools take away some of the more repetitive work and create more space for the accounting judgement, problem-solving and understanding of our clients that make our solutions valuable. You remain responsible for critically reviewing and validating what AI produces, ensuring that every solution meets our standards for accuracy and quality.
What would you do to drive our success?
Your responsibilities
Translate accounting workflows, client needs and market requirements into scalable templates and solutions within the Silverfin’s accounting platform.
Build, maintain and improve templates using our development framework, with training provided and the technologies you need for the role.
Use AI-assisted tools throughout the development and review process.
Bring your accounting knowledge into the product, helping ensure our solutions reflect the real day-to-day needs of accounting firms.
Work closely with Product, colleagues and clients to understand requirements and turn them into intuitive, effective solutions.
Contribute to a smooth customer experience by ensuring templates are logical, reliable and easy to use.
Keep your knowledge of the Dutch accounting market, relevant regulations and emerging technology up to date.
What would success look like?
Your performance & accountability
You consistently deliver high-quality templates and improvements in line with agreed sprint priorities and timelines.
The solutions you build are accurate, reliable and intuitive, resulting in a positive experience for our clients.
Within your first few months, you’re comfortable reading and assessing existing code and starting to make smaller changes yourself, even if you’re not yet writing much from scratch.
You use AI and other development tools effectively to work more efficiently, solve problems and continuously improve the quality of your work.
Product, colleagues and clients see you as a trusted partner who understands both the accounting challenge and how to translate it into a technical solution.
Over time, you develop deep knowledge of our Dutch solution portfolio and become a recognised point of contact within the team for questions related to it.
You keep track of how the solutions you build are being adopted and take action where uptake is lower than expected.
What will support your success?
You have several years of experience working in an accounting firm. A recognised accounting qualification is welcome, but not required.
You’re curious about AI and motivated to learn how to build solutions within our development framework; previous experience with AI tools or coding is a plus, but not required( Vue, TypeScript, or JavaScrip).
You communicate clearly and can work effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
You’re customer-oriented, follow through on your commitments and keep stakeholders informed.
You have an eye for detail and care about the accuracy and quality of your work.
Knowledge of the Silverfin platform is a plus; the motivation to understand our software in depth is essential.
€54,825 - €74,175 a year
Please note:
Most candidates start at the lower to mid part of the range, depending on experience and how their profile compares to our existing team. The higher end of the range is typically offered to individuals with a track record of strong impact and deep expertise in similar roles. We run annual compensation reviews, so there is clear opportunity for growth as you progress in the role.
How we work
At Silverfin, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We're committed to elevating talent by creating an environment where we can all thrive together.
We have a unique culture with our values ​​as the backbone:
Who we are - Authentically human
How we think - With a growth mindset
How we act - Bravely,  side by side
How we win - By doing what we love
At Silverfin we make our own way. We are constantly looking for new and innovative ways to move forward. Continuous learning and development is encouraged to support your personal and professional growth. 
At the same time, this opens up many new opportunities that allow our people to grow with Silverfin, and often faster than with other companies. So many ambitious team members have already found their way to a new challenge within Silverfin.
We want you to reach your full potential. To get you there, we don't want to think in boxes and over-structure things. So your options are not limited to 1 team or 1 career track. Your talent, motivation and potential play a crucial role in evolving across the teams into new roles.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Traineeprogram inom IT för dig som vill bli konsult
Under sex månader kombinerar du utbildning med arbete i riktiga kundprojekt. Du får stöd av en mentor, lär känna våra system och utvecklar de färdigheter du behöver för att växa i konsultrollen. Programmet startar i januari och augusti och genomförs tillsammans med andra traineer från våra kontor i Norden.
 Ansök till traineeprogrammet
 Prenumerera på karriärnyheter 
Om traineeprogrammet
Exsitecs traineeprogram vänder sig till dig som är nyexaminerad eller har några års arbetslivserfarenhet och vill utvecklas som IT-konsult. Under sex månader får du utbildning, praktisk erfarenhet och stöd av en mentor och erfarna kollegor.
Programmet inleds med utbildning i våra system, arbetssätt och konsultrollen. Du får kunskaper inom bland annat affärssystem, kravhantering, konfiguration, utveckling och integration. Du får också lära dig hur Exsitec använder AI och automation för att utveckla arbetssätt och skapa värde i kundernas verksamheter.
Utbildningen varvas successivt med arbete i riktiga kundprojekt. Tillsammans med din mentor och dina kollegor får du omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken och ta ett större ansvar i takt med att du utvecklas.
Du genomför programmet tillsammans med andra traineer och blir en del av en miljö där samarbete och kunskapsdelning står i centrum. Under programmet bygger du ett nätverk både på ditt lokala kontor och i övriga Norden. Efter traineeperioden fortsätter du att utvecklas på Exsitec med en stark grund inom både IT och konsultrollen.
 Ansök till traineeprogrammet
Så är traineeprogrammet upplagt
Traineeprogrammet kombinerar gemensamma utbildningar och aktiviteter med praktiskt arbete i kundprojekt. Du börjar med en introduktion till Exsitec, våra system och konsultrollen. Därefter får du stegvis omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken tillsammans med din mentor och ditt team.
Kickoff
 Lär känna de andra traineerna och få en gemensam introduktion till Exsitec.
Utbildningar
 Bygg kunskap om våra system och arbetssätt genom utbildningar hos Exsitec och våra samarbetspartner.
Konsult
Lär dig att förstå kundens behov, samarbeta med kunder och planera och genomföra projekt.

Använd dina nya kunskaper för att lösa en verklighetsnära uppgift tillsammans med andra traineer.

Traineegala
 Fira avslutningen på traineeprogrammet tillsammans med andra traineer och kollegor från hela Norden. Vi summerar tiden tillsammans och blickar framåt mot nästa steg på Exsitec.
Är traineeprogrammet rätt för dig?
Programmet passar dig som är nyexaminerad vid programstart eller har några års arbetslivserfarenhet och vill ta steget in i IT-branschen. Många av våra traineer är ingenjörer, systemvetare eller ekonomer, men även andra bakgrunder är relevanta. Erfarenhet av exempelvis försäljning, programmering, kundservice, ekonomi eller logistik är meriterande.
Du är nyfiken på kunders verksamheter och vill använda IT för att lösa deras behov. Du trivs med kundkontakt och samarbete, arbetar analytiskt och lösningsorienterat och kan se både detaljer och helhet.
Du arbetar från något av våra kontor tillsammans med ditt team och din mentor, i stället för att vara placerad hos en enskild kund. Det ger dig nära till stöd, kunskapsutbyte och gemenskap. Du behöver kunna kommunicera professionellt på svenska i tal och skrift.
 Ansök till traineeprogrammet
Börja din karriär på en prisad arbetsplats
Exsitec har under flera år uppmärksammats som en attraktiv arbetsgivare. För oss är utmärkelserna ett kvitto på vårt långsiktiga arbete med att skapa en arbetsplats där människor trivs, utvecklas och bygger sin karriär. Vi arbetar aktivt för ökad jämställdhet och mångfald. År 2026 tilldelades Exsitec Cinodes utmärkelse Jämställt konsultbolag.
Vi är ett tillväxtbolag, och vi brukar prata om tre saker som gör det möjligt: vi vågar prova, vi blir bättre tillsammans och hos oss finns möjligheten att växa över tid. Som trainee märker du det genom att få prova nya saker, dela kunskap med andra och successivt ta större ansvar.

Data Analytics Engineer
Join a team driving data strategy for one of Europe's largest software groups, working on platforms like VSIL (Visma Shared Intelligence Layer) and Visma Data Foundation.
 Apply here
 We usually respond within three days
Visma is not just your average company – we're a leading Norwegian player in the mission-critical business software scene, making a real impact. Picture us as the folks who find, build, and deliver software that genuinely makes life better for millions of people worldwide.
Our software? It's the magic wand that simplifies and automates those tricky work processes, giving folks the freedom to enjoy their everyday lives a bit more. Now, here's the cool part – Visma isn't just a company; it's a dynamic network of go-getters, each running their show with that startup flair, unique personality, and strong leadership.
What sets us apart? Well, each of our companies gets to do its thing – we call it business autonomy. It's like a secret sauce that keeps our growth game strong. Our mission is simple but powerful: we want to empower people by making complex tasks easy. Looking forward, we're not just tech enthusiasts; we're on a mission to shape the future of society through our tech wizardry.
About the Role
We're looking for a Data Analytics Engineer to join our Group Data & Analytics team and help shape how data gets modeled, tested, and delivered across Visma. You'll work hands-on across the full analytics stack — from modelling and transformation to dashboards and stakeholder-facing analysis — turning raw, Group-wide data into trusted, well-governed models that power decision-making across the organisation.
This is an AI-heavy role: you'll be expected to use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow — not just for writing SQL faster, but for documentation, testing, code review, data modeling design discussions, and increasingly, building AI-assisted or agentic data workflows. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how AI changes the way analytics engineering gets done, with a habit of experimenting and bringing learnings back to the team — not just someone who tolerates it.
What we expect from you:
Data modelling and transformation
Design, build, and maintain robust dimensional data models and transformation pipelines using SQL and dbt in BigQuery
Profile, clean, and verify data before publishing; write and maintain dbt tests to guarantee quality
Contribute to the design and adoption of a semantic/metrics layer for consistent, governed self-service analytics
Monitor pipeline observability and alerts, troubleshoot failures, and actively reduce technical debt
Analysis and insight
Build and maintain trustworthy, user-friendly dashboards in Data Studio
Perform descriptive, diagnostic, and statistical analyses to surface patterns, operational bottlenecks, and strategic opportunities
Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders across the group to define consistent metrics and reusable data models
Advise colleagues on analytics best practices
AI-assisted development and analytics
Use Claude and other AI tools extensively — for code generation, review, documentation, debugging, and testing
Explore and pilot AI-driven approaches to analysis, such as natural-language querying over the semantic layer, and agentic data workflows
Help shape responsible AI adoption in the team: evaluate tools, share what works, and ensure AI-generated code and outputs meet the same quality, security, and governance standards as everything else
Exercise sound judgment about AI-generated output — verify rather than trust, and keep data privacy and confidentiality front of mind
Ways of working
Work as a developer in a Scrum team, using Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD workflows
Refine user stories and requirements with the Data Product Manager into technical specifications and deliverables
Maintain technical documentation and release traceability; log bugs and improvement ideas in Jira
Contribute to continual process improvement
Governance and security
Ensure data models and transformations follow established data governance standards, with strict separation of development, test, and production environments
Apply access control, data classification, and data handling protocols, including proper treatment of personal data (PII) and confidential financial and operational records in line with GDPR
What you bring to the table:
Experience working as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, or in a similar role focused on data modelling and visualisation.
Advanced SQL knowledge and solid, hands-on experience with dbt.
Practical experience with a major cloud platform (GCP) and a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery).
Experience with Data Studio or similar BI visualisation tools.
Comfort with Git/GitHub workflows (branching, PRs, code review).
Analytical and statistical skills for data profiling, verification, and problem solving.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dbt projects — models, tests, documentation, and macros — in a production environment.
Genuine, active experience using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) in a technical workflow — able to speak concretely about how you use them, not just that you have.
High attention to detail, a proactive approach to risk, and a commitment to data security.
Adaptability to changing demands and expectations.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Bonus Points (Nice to Have):
Experience in a large, multi-product organization with distributed data ownership
Familiarity with data governance, data contracts, or semantic/metrics layer tooling
Interest in exploring agentic AI workflows for data engineering tasks
Experience with Python for auxiliary tooling or automation
What you can expect from us:
In our nordic-inspired work environment, we appreciate flexibility, autonomy, and a collaborative spirit. If you're someone who enjoys getting hands-on, work/life balance, values learning and finds joy in sharing experiences with colleagues.. you're in the right place!
We love that you bring your ideas to the table: You will be part of a culture that favours experiments and value initiative, so it’s easy to get your ideas heard.
Make an impact from day 1: We want you to experience meaning as much as you experience mastery through creating value that impacts people's everyday lives. And you get to influence how to go about creating that value with full autonomy of your work.
Flexibility at all stages of life: Work is an important part of life. Yet, we know that you are much more than your job. We make room for people at all stages of life.
We invest in your competence: When you step into Visma, opportunities from A-Z awaits. You will be met by engaged leaders that care for and support you, and take part in competence sharing and learning networks across Visma within.
We embrace diversity and foster an inclusive environment: Our team thrives on different backgrounds, experiences, and ideas, creating a welcoming space where everyone belongs and can contribute their best.
Above all, we are a team: Team spirit is key for us to deliver on our promises to people and society, but most importantly; to form a culture where people support and care for each other as much as we have tons of fun together
Total compensation: 30k - 45k EUR (annual)
We celebrate a culture where everyone's uniqueness contributes to our collective success. Feel free to share a bit about yourself, your interests and what makes you thrive both at work and in life. We're looking forward to learning more about you!
*To comply with local employment laws, this position is open only to individuals who have the legal right to work in Portugal. Candidates must have a valid work permit or authorization to work in Portugal without employer-sponsored visas.

 Fira avslutningen på Sales Talent Programme tillsammans med andra kollegor från hela Norden. Vi summerar tiden tillsammans och blickar framåt mot nästa steg på Exsitec.
Är Sales Talent Programme rätt för dig?
Programmet passar dig som är nyexaminerad eller har några års arbetslivserfarenhet och vill utvecklas inom B2B-försäljning, affärer och IT.
Du är nyfiken på kunders verksamheter och motiveras av att förstå deras behov, skapa affärsnytta och bygga långsiktiga relationer. Du trivs med kundkontakt och kan kommunicera komplexa lösningar på ett tydligt och engagerande sätt.
Vi tror att du tar initiativ, arbetar strukturerat och är bekväm med att förutsättningar kan förändras. Du vill ta ett allt större ansvar och utvecklas tillsammans med andra i en växande organisation.
Du behöver kunna kommunicera professionellt på svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
Möt en av våra kollegor
Hur är det att gå från ny i försäljning till att driva egna säljprocesser? Marie Paus deltog i Sales Talent Programme 2024 och arbetar i dag som säljare på Exsitec. Hör henne berätta om programmet, utvecklingen under de första sex månaderna och vardagen i säljrollen.
 Redo att skicka in din ansökan?
Utvecklas inom försäljning på en prisad arbetsplats
Exsitec har under flera år uppmärksammats som en attraktiv arbetsgivare. För oss är utmärkelserna ett kvitto på vårt långsiktiga arbete med att skapa en arbetsplats där människor trivs, utvecklas och bygger sin karriär. Vi arbetar också aktivt för ökad jämställdhet och mångfald. År 2026 tilldelades Exsitec Cinodes utmärkelse Jämställt konsultbolag.
Vi är ett tillväxtbolag och brukar lyfta fram tre saker som gör vår utveckling möjlig: vi vågar prova, vi blir bättre tillsammans och hos oss finns möjligheten att växa över tid. Som deltagare i Sales Talent Programme märker du det genom att få testa nya idéer, lära av erfarna säljare och successivt ta större ansvar i kunddialoger och säljprocesser.

Som säljare på Exsitec får du arbeta med ett brett erbjudande och över 7 000 kunder i många olika branscher. Det ger dig varierande kunddialoger och möjlighet att bygga förståelse för olika verksamheter, behov och affärsutmaningar.
Du har din bas på något av våra kontor och arbetar nära andra säljare, konsulter och specialister. Tillsammans tar ni fram lösningar som skapar konkret nytta för kunden. Det ger dig både ett starkt stöd i säljprocessen och möjlighet att lära av kollegor med olika kompetenser.

Junior utvecklare - Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Vill du bli en del av ett sammansvetsat team med hög teknisk kompetens och stort stöd från kollegor? Har du grundläggande erfarenhet av AL-programmering och vill växa inom Microsoft Dynamics-världen? Då är detta en chans du inte vill missa!
Om rollen
Vi söker dig som är i början av din utvecklarkarriär och som vill jobba med AL-programmering i Microsoft Dynamics NAV och Business Central. Som en del av vår tillväxtresa finns nu möjligheten att stärka upp teamet samtidigt som du får förutsättningarna att fortsätta stärka din egen tekniska kompetens. I stora drag innefattar rollen:
Utveckling i AL med Visual Studio Code
Anpassning och vidareutveckling av affärssystemet Business Central
Nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor där vi aktivt diskuterar lösningar och hjälper varandra framåt
Du kommer att ingå i ett kundteam som tillsammans jobbar med våra kunder i en balanserad mix av nyinstallationer, vidareutveckling, support och förvaltning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bli specialist inom ditt område, samtidigt som du arbetar i nära samarbete med teamet för att leverera framgångsrika lösningar till våra kunder. Parallellt med kundteamen är du en del av ett specialistområde, där du regelbundet möter kollegor med samma inriktning från andra leveransteam för att dela kompetens och lösa gemensamma utmaningar. Tillsammans med en specialistledare säkerställer ni kunskap, kvalitet och riktning.
Du kommer att arbeta med några av Nordens mest snabbväxande och innovativa varumärken – däribland Royal Design, CAIA Cosmetics, Efva Attling, Care of Carl, LES DEUX och aim’n. Gemensamt för våra kunder är en stark tillväxtresa, höga ambitioner och en vilja att ligga i absolut teknisk framkant. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för välkända e-handels- och retailbolag med högt tempo och stort fokus på framtiden
Vi söker dig som
Har minst 1–2 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling
Har erfarenhet av AL-programmering och Visual Studio Code
Gillar att arbeta i en föränderlig och omväxlande miljö där du får möjligheten att snabbt utvecklas och ta mycket ansvar.
Det är extra meriterande om du har erfarenhet av GIT och versionshantering samt kunskap inom CI/CD och DevOps är önskvärt. Om du har erfarenhet av andra programmeringsspråk, gärna C#, ser vi det som positivt och som en bra grund för att lära dig AL-programmering.
Du kommer i rollen ha stor nytta av förståelse för ekonomisystem och affärsprocesser. Vi värderar därför den erfarenheten högt i urvalsprocessen.
Om Exsitec
Exsitec grundades 2000 i Linköping, med målet att hjälpa medelstora bolag att få en enklare och effektivare vardag med systemstöd som sömlöst integreras samman. Idag är Exsitec en nordisk koncern med 700 anställda på över 20 kontor i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och Finland och hjälper över 4000 bolagskunder.
Exsitecs kultur präglas av affärsmässighet, framåtanda, glädje och enkelhet. En kultur vi värnar om och som genomsyrar hela organisationen.
På Exsitec älskar vi IT och förstår kraften i digitala lösningar för skapa förändring och uppnå mål. Genom att kombinera utvalda system och tjänster till en fungerande helhet som gör skillnad hos våra kunder – på riktigt.

Digital Studentambassadör
 Skicka ansökan
Var med och bygg Exsitecs varumärke mot studenter
På Exsitec brinner vi för att skapa möjligheter för framtidens talanger. Som en del i vårt långsiktiga arbete med employer branding vill vi samarbeta med studenter som vill vara med och stärka vår närvaro på universitet och i sociala medier. Rollen som digital studentambassadör är för dig som vill kombinera studier med ett kreativt och kommunikativt extrajobb – där du får representera Exsitec och sprida kännedom om vårt traineeprogram och våra karriärmöjligheter.
Om rollen
Som digital studentambassadör är du en viktig länk mellan Exsitec och studenter på ditt universitet. Uppdraget innebär att:
Skapa och dela innehåll om Exsitec i dina egna sociala kanaler
Uppmärksamma vårt traineeprogram och studentaktiviteter
Bidra med idéer kring hur vi kan nå fler studenter digitalt
Fokus ligger på att på ett autentiskt och trovärdigt sätt visa hur det är att arbeta på Exsitec och varför vårt traineeprogram är en spännande möjlighet.
Vem vi tror att du är
Vi tror att du:
Studerar på universitet eller högskola (år 1–5) inom industriell ekonomi, systemvetenskap / informatik, eller ekonomi / affärssystem.
Är aktiv i sociala medier och trivs med att skapa innehåll
Är kommunikativ och relationsskapande
Har intresse för IT, verksamhetsutveckling eller teknik
Gillar att ta eget ansvar och komma med idéer
Det är meriterande om du är engagerad i studentlivet eller har erfarenhet av kommunikation, marknadsföring eller försäljning.
Om anställningen
Tidsbegränsad anställning
Omfattning: cirka 8–15 timmar per månad
Start enligt överenskommelse
Arbetet planeras månadsvis tillsammans med ansvarig på Exsitec och kombineras smidigt med dina studier.
Intresserad?
Skicka in din ansökan och berätta om dig själv, dina studier och varför du skulle passa som digital studentambassadör för Exsitec. Vi kontaktar dig oavsett om du går vidare eller inte i processen.

SDR / Mötesbokare B2B
På Exsitec hjälper vi företag att förenkla sin arbetsvardag och bli mer framgångsrika genom smarta IT-lösningar – från affärssystem och beslutsstöd till skräddarsydda applikationer. I rollen som SDR/Mötesbokare hos oss blir du en viktig kugge i vårt sälj- och marknadsteams ambitiösa planer om fortsatt kundtillväxt. 
Om Rollen
Hos oss ingår du i ett mindre team av SDRer/Mötesbokare som med hjälp av de senaste digitala leadsverktygen strukturerat bearbetar marknaden med Exsitecs breda portfölj av IT-lösningar. Du jobbar med prospektering, vilket är kunduppsökande aktiviteter, via främst telefon och mail. Du förväntas löpande logga alla kundinteraktioner i vårt CRM-system (Hubspot) och levererar på daglig basis bokade möten med kvalificerade potentiella kunder till våra säljare. 
I rollen ingår också eventuppföljning i samband med fysiska eller digitala kundevent som marknad anordnar, samt återkoppling till potentiella kunder som besöker vår hemsida eller laddar ned digitalt material ifrån oss. Du är också den som koordinerar bokade möten med potentiella kunder och säljarna hos oss. 
Vem är du
Som person tror vi att du är positiv, orädd och nyfiken, samt har en stark kommunikativ förmåga i både tal och skrift. Du är en lagspelare med stark vilja att nå uppsatta mål och sätter strategier för att ta dig dit. 
Eftersom du i många fall är Exsitecs första kontakt med nya potentiella kunder förväntar vi oss också en hög grad av professionalism och vilja att successivt lära dig mer om potentiella kunders utmaningar kopplade till systemstöd och digitalisering. Tidigare erfarenhet av mötesbokning eller service/försäljningsyrken är meriterande.
Hos oss får du:
En bred för förståelse för Exsitecs produktportfölj och vilka utmaningar potentiella kunder står inför i sin digitaliseringsresa
Arbeta nära både sälj- och marknadsteam i ett spännande bolag inom IT-branschen med försäljning B2B
Härliga kollegor i inspirerande kontorsmiljöer där du jobbar med de senaste digitala verktygen för leadsgenerering.
Vi tror på att växa tillsammans och vi är många som kan stötta i att bli lyckosam i rollen som SDR/Mötesbokare på Exsitec. Provision erbjuds, i tillägg till den fasta lönen.

Silverfin - Global Campaign Marketing Executive
Global Campaign Marketing Executive
Ghent
Marketing /
Payroll /
Hybrid
apply for this job
Who we are?
Silverfin is a cutting-edge cloud software solution built by accountants, for accountants.
Founded in 2013, Silverfin was created to solve the frustrations of manual, error-prone processes in analysing financial data and compliance. From day one, we’ve been a cloud-first platform with an open API architecture, leveraging structured data to transform how accountants work.
Our mission is simple: to enhance and support the accountancy profession through AI and automation, ensuring accountants remain relevant and respected in the future of finance.
In 2023, Silverfin became part of the Visma Group, joining one of Europe’s leading providers of cloud software. This partnership strengthens our ability to innovate and expand our impact within the accountancy industry.
Today, Silverfin is trusted by over 1000+ firms across 19 countries. Our clients include all of the Big 4 accounting firms, as well as leading global networks like BDO, PKF, Baker Tilly, Grant Thornton, and Moore.
Headquartered in Ghent, with offices in London, Luxembourg, Gouda (NL), and a 2nd office in South of Belgium (Mont-Saint-Guibert), we’re a team of over 200 people - including a diverse remote engineering team working across multiple time zones - all working together to drive innovation in accounting.
How would you support our success?
Your role
In 2026 Silverfin moved its whole marketing approach from leads to accounts. Marketing Qualified Leads became Marketing Qualified Accounts, our target market is now a finite, tiered list of accounting firms per business unit, and our campaigns are built once, centrally, then localised across every region. That model is in place. What it needs now is someone to run it.
As our Global Campaign Marketing Executive, you are the operational owner of our global integrated campaigns and the engine room of our ABM programme. 
Together with our Product Marketer and the field marketers, you help define which campaigns we should build. You then hold the campaign calendar and define the campaign flow in collaboration with field and digital marketers.
You chair the cross-functional campaigns and content task force that brings content, demand generation and field marketing around one table, following up  decisions and a single source of truth. And you run the ABM programme day to day, so that the accounts on our tiered lists are reached, engaged and handed to sales at the moment they are ready.
Both halves of the role exist to serve the business units' go-to-market plans, and both are measured against what the BUs are held to: integrated campaigns deliver the MQAs each BU needs to hit target, and ABM programmes deepen account engagement and penetration in the tiers each BU has chosen.
Roughly 40% of your time sits on integrated campaigns, but it would be mostly concentrated in sprints,  and 60% on the ABM programs along the year. This is a hands-on role in an international team: you will coordinate specialists, and you will build the things you coordinate. You’ll work from the office at least three days a week, with the option to work remotely for the other two.
What would you do to drive our success?
Your responsibilities
Integrated campaigns (≈ 40%)
Define, with our Product Marketer and the field marketers, which campaigns should be built: start from each business unit's go-to-market plan and tier focus, weigh it against product positioning and the MQA gap per market, and agree a campaign portfolio that earns its place.
Build every campaign to serve the business units it is for — sized against the MQA volume that BU needs to reach target — and keep that line of sight visible to BU leads from brief through to results.
Own the global integrated campaign calendar across all business units — UKI, Flanders, Wallonia, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Denmark and Platform — sequencing go-live and rotation dates so regions launch together, and so we finish what we start before boarding the next campaign train.
Lead  the bi-weekly campaigns and content task force. Convert discussion into owned, dated actions; keep a decision log so calls on gating, scheduling and messaging stop being re-litigated; make sure everyone can see the current state of every campaign in every market.
The campaign build would likely occupy most of your time for a quarter, the rest of year would be ensuring the execution and optimisation so that it delivers the required MQAs. 
Define the campaign flow end to end — assets, gating, forms, nurture, retargeting and exclusion logic per market — as a living artefact, not a lost Miro board. Nothing gets dropped; nothing gets ungated by accident.
Ensure a nurture track is live from day one of every campaign rather than retro-fitted weeks later, and that contacts entering one flow are correctly excluded from the others.
Run the localisation chain with field marketers, translation and design partners: an agreed definition of “reviewed”, named native-language sign-offs per market, and a realistic read on what regional teams can absorb alongside their own events.
Own campaign taxonomy and attribution hygiene across HubSpot and Salesforce — naming conventions, programme sync, primary campaign source — and deliver a per-campaign performance view into the monthly KPI pack.
Brief and manage delivery with our paid media, content, PR and design partners, keeping regional adaptation fast and cheap (modular, Canva-ready assets over bespoke rebuilds).
Close the loop on lead quality: test syndication, paid and webinar leads against the ICP per market, and correct targeting where they miss.
ABM programme (≈ 60%)
Run the ABM programme day to day across business units: maintain the tiered target account lists, keep each market’s tier focus current with sales, and work with Revenue Operations on the account scoring model and MQA triggers.
Build each ABM program around a business unit's go-to-market plan, with account engagement and penetration as the deliverable that programme is answerable for — agreed with the BU lead up front, reported against every month. Collaborate with field BU marketers for the execution. 
Translate the ABM framework into activity — 1:1 and 1:few plays for Tier 1 and 2 key accounts, programmatic ABM for Tier 3 and 4 — and build the tier-level messaging matrix so we stop serving identical content to every account.
Grow account reach and penetration: engaged contacts per account per tier, buying-group coverage, and the gap between marketing reach and sales relationships. Report it as the programme’s headline metric alongside MQA volume and quality.
Turn intent and website signals into prospecting the sales team actually works — not reports nobody opens. Own the handoff mechanism with Revenue Operations. Coordinate the usage of it with the field marketers.
Partner with sales and field  on account planning: joint account plans, MQA follow-up discipline within SLA, and enablement assets and playbooks that field teams use because they are useful.
Support the FY27 step from account-based targeting to account-based planning with sales, including the January 2027 kick-off.
Use AI deliberately to scale a small team across many markets: localisation and content variants, account research, competitive and intent listening, campaign reporting.
What would success look like?
Your performance & accountability
Every global campaign live and complete in every opted-in market on the agreed date. No campaign left at 70%.
MQA volume and quality on target per business unit and per tier — with sales accepting what marketing qualifies, and rejection reasons trending down.
Every campaign in the portfolio traceable to a business unit's go-to-market plan, agreed with the Product Marketer and field marketers before build starts.
Each BU's ABM programme delivering the account engagement and penetration it committed to, so BUs reach their targets with marketing's contribution visible in the numbers.
Measurable growth in account reach and penetration in each market’s key tiers, closing the gap between marketing reach and sales relationships.
Cost per lead and cost per MQA trending down as campaigns are properly sequenced and audiences correctly sized.
A nurture track is live at launch for 100% of campaigns, with working exclusion logic between flows.
Complete attribution: every opportunity carries a primary campaign source, and each campaign has its own reportable view.
A campaign flow, decision log and programme documentation that are current and usable by anyone in the team — the programme does not live in one person’s head.
Field marketers and BU leads report that global campaigns reduce their workload rather than add to it.
What will support your success?
Experience and qualifications
5+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 2 running integrated, multi-channel campaigns end to end in a SaaS or technology business.
Demonstrable ABM experience: building and running 1:1, 1:few and programmatic programmes against a defined target account list, with pipeline to show for it.
Experience marketing across several countries and languages, with localisation and regional field teams in the mix.
Experience shaping a campaign portfolio alongside product marketing and regional teams — contributing to what gets built and what gets dropped, rather than only executing briefs handed over.
A track record of coordinating specialists you do not line-manage, across functions, countries and time zones.
Experience working shoulder to shoulder with sales on target accounts, account plans and qualified-account follow-up.
Skills and knowledge
Hands-on HubSpot: campaigns and programmes, forms, workflows, lead and account scoring, progressive profiling, landing pages, intent data.
Basic working knowledge of Salesforce as the account and opportunity system of record — campaign objects, reports and attribution. You can build your own report rather than queue for one.
LinkedIn Campaign Manager for account-based paid media: company list upload and match rates, company engagement reporting, CRM connector, and honest audience sizing.
Comfortable with account data and enrichment tooling (e.g. Lead Forensics, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, local professional-body and market data sources) — and with the reality that sources disagree and someone has to reconcile them.
Fluent in funnel and account metrics: reach, penetration, engagement, MQA, conversion, velocity, cost per acquisition. You can read the report  and change the plan because of it.
Strong programme and project management: calendars, dependencies, sign-off gates, documentation. You leave things findable by the next person.
Campaign craft — briefing content writer, translator  and designer, judging whether messaging lands in a given market, knowing when an asset is genuinely ready to go live.
Practical, everyday use of AI tools for content, translation, research and reporting at scale.
Fluent English. Dutch and/or French a strong advantage for reviewing localised content.
Understanding of the accountancy profession — or a proven record of learning a technical B2B market fast enough to hold your own in a positioning argument with the people who sell it.
Attitude and personality-related traits
A finisher. You would rather ship three campaigns completely than seven at 70%.
Takes ownership when something slips, including when the cause sits with someone else. No blame-shifting, no waiting to be unblocked.
Comfortable holding a line with stakeholders — telling a field marketer that their region waits its turn — and doing it in a way that keeps the relationship.
Organised by instinct: you document, you close loops, you chase.
Curious about the data and the messaging before the creative.
Low ego, high initiative — happy to build the spreadsheet, write the brief and run the meeting in the same afternoon.
We care for you
Be part of something bigger – Join a growing SaaS company that’s now proudly part of Visma, Europe’s leader in mission-critical cloud software.
A connected team – Take part in regular team activities, retreats, and offsites to keep our culture thriving.
Grow with us – Take advantage of career development opportunities and a personal training allowance to support your growth.
Time to recharge – Enjoy our company-wide Wellbeing Days off each month (reviewed annually).
Fair compensation – Receive a competitive rewards package with benefits tailored to your role.
€53,550 - €72,450 a year
Please note:
Most candidates start at the lower to mid part of the range, depending on experience and how their profile compares to our existing team. The higher end of the range is typically offered to individuals with a track record of strong impact and deep expertise in similar roles. We run annual compensation reviews, so there is clear opportunity for growth as you progress in the role.
How we work
At Silverfin, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We're committed to elevating talent by creating an environment where we can all thrive together.
We have a unique culture with our values as the backbone:
Who we are - Authentically human
How we think - With a growth mindset
How we act - Bravely, side by side
How we win - By doing what we love
At Silverfin we make our own way. We are constantly looking for new and innovative ways to move forward. Continuous learning and development is encouraged to support your personal and professional growth.
At the same time, this opens up many new opportunities that allow our people to grow with Silverfin, and often faster than with other companies. So many ambitious team members have already found their way to a new challenge within Silverfin.
We want you to reach your full potential. To get you there, we don't want to think in boxes and over-structure things. So your options are not limited to 1 team or 1 career track. Your talent, motivation and potential play a crucial role in evolving across the teams into new roles.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Konsult inom Microsoft Business Central
Vi söker nya kollegor till flera av våra områden inom Business Central, så som ekonomi, koncerninterna flöden, logistik, e-handel, service/projekt och K3 Pebblestone. Vi arbetar i teknikens frontlinje och baserar vår utveckling och rutiner på agentbaserade arbetssätt där proaktivitet och intelligenta flöden är en naturlig del av lösningarna.
Vi är på en spännande tillväxtresa och kommer att expandera vår verksamhet ytterligare. Vi söker därför konsulter som vill arbeta med framtidens metoder och som har god verksamhetsförståelse för våra kunders affärsflöden och kunskap inom Business Central. Du blir en del av Exsitec och arbetar inom varumärket Brightcom, som är en del av Exsitec-koncernen.
Om rollen
Du kommer att vara en del av en växande satsning inom Business Central, där vi bygger upp ett nytt team tillsammans med engagerade kollegor och skapar framtidens arbetssätt för våra kunder. Tillsammans ansvarar teamet för leveransen till omkring 20–30 kunder, med en balanserad mix av nyinstallationer, vidareutveckling och support/förvaltning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bli specialist inom ditt område, samtidigt som du arbetar i nära samarbete med teamet för att leverera framgångsrika lösningar till våra kunder. Parallellt med kundteamen är du en del av ett specialistområde, där du regelbundet möter kollegor med samma inriktning från andra leveransteam för att dela kompetens och lösa gemensamma utmaningar. Tillsammans med en specialistledare säkerställer ni kunskap, kvalitet och riktning.
Du kommer att arbeta med några av Nordens mest snabbväxande och innovativa varumärken – däribland Royal Design, CAIA Cosmetics, Efva Attling, Care of Carl, LES DEUX och aim’n. Gemensamt för våra kunder är en stark tillväxtresa, höga ambitioner och en vilja att ligga i absolut teknisk framkant. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för välkända e-handels- och retailbolag med högt tempo och stort fokus på framtiden.
Hos oss får du
● Fördjupa dig inom Business Central med fokus på ditt specialistområde
● Arbeta med lösningar som skapar verkligt kundvärde
● Kombinera verksamhetsförståelse med modern teknik
Vi söker dig som
● Har tidigare erfarenhet av Business Central, gärna som konsult.
● Har erfarenhet från verksamheter inom inköp, logistik, försäljning, ekonomi eller e-handel.
● Vill arbeta med moderna arbetssätt och den senaste utvecklingen inom mjukvarumetodik.
Vi planerar att utöka teamet med flera personer och söker därför olika typer av erfarenheter av kompetenser. Vill du bidra med din kunskap och hjälpa våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sina verksamheter? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

IT-tekniker
Vill du ta ett brett tekniskt ansvar i ett av Sveriges snabbast växande IT-bolag?
På Exsitec är vi ungefär 750 personer som hjälper kunder att bli bättre med hjälp av affärssystem, beslutsstöd och integrationer. Det kräver en välskött intern IT-miljö – och det är där du kommer in.
Vi söker en IT-tekniker som trivs med att vara den person kollegor litar på när det gäller. Du ska ha ett genuint teknikintresse, en känsla för god service och förmågan att omsätta det tekniska till något begripligt för alla.
Det här kommer du att jobba med
Installation och konfiguration av datorer, telefoner, skrivare och annan utrustning
Felsökning och användarsupport – på plats och via fjärrsupport
Administration av Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 och Azure
Nätverk och brandväggar – drift och felsökning på våra kontor runt om i Sverige
Säkerhetsuppdateringar och underhåll av enheter enligt fastlagda rutiner
Dokumentation av utrustning, installationer och ärenden
Onboarding – säkerställa att nya kollegor är igång från dag ett
Vi tror att du
Har 1–5 års praktisk erfarenhet av IT-support och till det tillhörande arbetsuppgifter, alternativt en utbildning inom IT.
Är kommunikativ och serviceinriktad – du gillar att prata med folk och kan förklara teknik på ett pedagogiskt sätt
Har gedigen förståelse för datorer, operativsystem och nätverk
Talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat
Vad vi erbjuder
En roll där du arbetar självständigt men tillsammans med kollegor över breda arbetsområden, i ett bolag som tror på att växa tillsammans. Hos oss finns utrymme att ta mer ansvar över tid och forma din roll i takt med att du utvecklas. Vi har ett starkt internt nätverk och kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap.
Tjänsten är tillsvidareanställning på heltid och utgår från Stockholm, Linköping eller Göteborg.

At Wolfspeed, we do amazing things in a human way. 
We know that the achievements of our organization are due to the passion, hard work and creativity of our employees. We celebrate different perspectives to foster excellence across our organization, and our goal is to make diversity a foundation of what we do. We are proudly building an environment where you can bring your authentic self to work. 
Enjoy doing things that people say can’t be done? Innovation is at the center of everything we do. 
Hate red tape? We remove roadblocks instead of creating them. 
Student? We offer continuing education assistance. 
Looking for community? There are many ways to get involved, from Employee Resource Groups to local outreach.  
Here’s the Gist:  
You will lead the integration of next generation Silicon Carbide based Power electronic products and technologies being introduced into our state of the art production facilities.  This role will be responsible for new product life cycle from initial setup to product optimization and lastly yield improvements. You will work with R&D, Process Engineering, and Operations teams to ensure new products and technologies are optimized and characterized for both product performance and manufacturability.  This role will also need to perform process windowing using DOE, validate specs, assess new product Cpk, and compile a process manual for each new technology that is introduced into Production.   
The Day-to-Day  
Responsible for new product and new technology introduction – build plans working across the integration and process teams to achieve first pass qualification success 
Utilize your experience and knowledge in fab processing to fully window new processes in development and understand tuning knobs.  
Engage with the Process Engineering teams early to set them up for success by ensuring process knowledge is shared and process interactions are defined and documented. 
Work closely with the R&D team to assess manufacturability of new design specs and integration. 
Analyze data using sound statistical methodology to drive process, efficiency, and quality improvements. 
Establish relationships across various departments to drive cohesive learning and cross functional problem solving. 
Responsible for documentation and training in the transfer of new processes to manufacturing including capacity planning, characterization work, OCAP’s, FMEA’s, and process control plans and limits.  
This Job is Right for You if You Have (Minimum Requirements): 
Seeking mid-level+ Semiconductor Process / Device Integration Engineer with experience in:
Demonstrated knowledge of semiconductor power (MOSFET, JFET) device physics
Expereince and or working knowledge of SiC materials and devices a strong +
5+ years experience in process engineering with demonstrated deep expertise in 2 or more areas Litho, implant, thin films, etch, epitaxy, device testing
Device integration OR Yield Engineering experience with Si, SiC or GaN power devices
Strong knowledge and practitioner of statistics, SPC and DOE methodologies
Semiconductor equipment knowledge a strong + but not required
Familiar with the working of semiconductor fab operations a strong +
Project management experience with evidence of making decisions with ambiguous data
Team player capable of working in a cross functional environment
Must be willing to work onsite in Marcy, NY 5 days per week. (Relocation assistance is provided for candidates 60 miles outside of this location)
This role may require additional duties and/or assignments as designated by management.

Uppdraget:
NCP2 (National Contact Point for secondary use) är den nationella kontaktpunkt som kopplar Sverige till EU:s gemensamma infrastruktur HealthData@EU för sekundäranvändning av hälsodata. Genom NCP2 synkroniseras den nationella metadatakatalogen med EU:s centrala katalog och ansökningar från EU:s centrala portal tas emot.
Konsulten ska i ett första steg genomföra en PoC (proof of concept, koncepttest) som omfattar att:
Sätta upp den öppna källkod som EU-kommissionen släppt för NCP2, inklusive accesspunkt enligt AS4 (eDeliverys meddelandeprofil för säkert och spårbart utbyte), i Socialstyrelsens testmiljö.
Registrera HDAB mot EU:s testbädd ITB (Interoperability Test Bed, kommissionens miljö för konformanstestning) och genomföra grundläggande konformanstester.
Etablera fungerande testkommunikation mot EU:s centrala tjänster, inklusive certifikathantering mot EU:s tillitskedja.
Skapa mock-API:er (simulerade gränssnitt) för NCP2:s flöden så att övriga HDAB-team kan börja testa sina integrationer innan riktiga flöden finns.
Avropet innehåller en option på att därefter utveckla och driftsätta den kompletta NCP2 lösningen.
SKA-Krav
Kompetensnivå Nivå 4 (minst 5 års erfarenhet inom området, arbetar självständigt).
Roll i uppdraget: Genomför PoC:n enligt uppdragsbeskrivningen och ansvarar för dokumentation, testresultat och rekommendation inför driftsättningsbeslut.
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemintegration, varav dokumenterad erfarenhet av eDelivery AS4, exempelvis via referensimplementationen Domibus, eller av motsvarande meddelandeprofiler (ebMS3/AS4).
Java
Erfarenhet av SOAP- och REST-baserade integrationer samt certifikatbaserad autentisering.
Erfarenhet av att bygga mock-tjänster och teststubbar.
Erfarenhet av Docker och grundläggande Kubernetes.
Flytande engelska (EU-dokumentation och support sker på engelska) samt svenska i tal och skrift.
Omfattning: 100% eller 3400 timmar
Placeringsort:  Primärt onsite på myndigheten (t.ex. Stockholm), viss distans enligt policy. Arbetet sker på plats med möjlighet till hybrid- eller distansarbete enligt överenskommelse med uppdragsgivaren.
Avtalstid: 2026-10-08 - 2026-12-31 med möjlighet att som option förlänga uppdraget med sex månaders intervaller, t. o.m. 2028-12-22.

 I’m proud of what we do:
We provide security solutions for over 145 central banks worldwide.
Electromechanical Field Service Technician III
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
The whole world trusts us when it comes to physical or digital currencies. We increase the security and efficiency of the cash cycle in collaboration with central banks and the entire currency industry.  As the market leader in advanced currency management, would you like to join us in shaping the future of payments?
Summary
A Level III Field Service Technician will utilize their technical expertise and independent judgment to provide on-site servicing, installation, and repair of complex electromechanical equipment. This role is crucial in maintaining high customer satisfaction through data-driven tools, proactive attention to customer needs, and positive interactions. Responsibilities include supporting customers with operational or maintenance issues, addressing escalated technical and service-related concerns, diagnosing failures in mechanical, hardware, software, and systems, implementing effective repairs to minimize downtime, and preparing reports for analyzing product failure trends and serviceability issues. Additionally, this role will also assist with the on-site training and development of less experienced field service technicians and acts as a key communication link between technical support, management, and the customer on technical matters and projects. Flexibility for long hours and travel is required.
Duties/Responsibilities
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Apply company policies and procedures to complete routine tasks effectively.
Respond promptly to service calls, perform equipment maintenance at customer sites, and assist operators with operational issues.
Represent the company professionally at all times.
Handle administrative tasks, including record-keeping, reporting, and inventory management, with accuracy and timeliness.
Develop and maintain technical competence through formal training programs, on-site training, and hands-on experience.
Comply with company policies regarding confidentiality and customer procedures, including Custody and Control Procedures.
Manage parts inventory, coordinate shipments for repair and replenishment, and oversee the inventory of tools and test equipment.
Record maintenance activities using approved methods and procedures.
Follow escalation procedures to resolve issues promptly and ensure timely communication with designated company personnel and customer management.
Promote high customer satisfaction by maintaining open communication and providing proactive attention to customer needs.
Assist with the on-site training of less experienced field service technicians.
Show flexibility to travel as required to support business needs, including providing coverage for other Field Engineers during vacations or illnesses. Travel may be within the home territory or to other areas.
Perform all activities safely and adhere to company safety policies and procedures.
Complete other duties as assigned.
Required Skills/Knowledge
Hands-on experience with electromechanical equipment is preferred.
Proficiency in electromechanical troubleshooting, understanding electronic principles, and working knowledge of computer systems, PCs, and networking is required.
Experience with solenoids, belts, rollers, bearings, pneumatics, and guides is a plus.
Strong oral and written communication skills are essential.
Ability to use a laptop/tablet for administrative and diagnostic tasks.
Willingness to provide personal information and obtain Gaming Licenses in required jurisdictions (for Commercial Field Service Technicians).
Work may be home office-based or customer site-based.
Personal vehicle use may be required depending on business needs.
Potential responsibility for a company fleet vehicle may be required depending on business needs.
Shift work may be required.
Required Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED required.
An Associate degree or trade/technical school certificate/diploma preferred.
Minimum of four (4) years of relevant work experience, including at least two years in a field service environment.
Hands-on experience with electromechanical equipment is essential.
Previous experience in customer-facing roles is require
Salary
$68,000-$75,000
Shift
2:00 PM- 10:00 PM
Other Duties

 I’m proud of what we do:
My team is shaping the future of IoT security.
Office Manager
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
At Payment Technology, our mission is to be at the start of every transaction and to make it secure and simple. We also create contemporary payment and banking solutions for our digital age. As a one-stop shop, we produce and personalise hundreds of millions of payment cards every year and store their "digital twins" - mobile and digital. Would you like to actively shape the digital transformation with us?
At Giesecke+Devrient (G+D), we’re driven by a mission to create trust in the digital age. With over 170 years of innovation, we design and develop secure technologies that protect identities, payments, connectivity, and digital infrastructures worldwide. Giesecke+Devrient (G+D) specializes in securing mobile connections, legal identities, and digital infrastructures. When it comes to digital security, we serve as the trusted partner for governments, public authorities, and enterprises globally. We safeguard and manage confidential systems, networks, data, and identities in physical, digital and mobile environments. Be the heartbeat of our workplace Some people manage offices, others create environments where people thrive. We're looking for an Office Manager who sees opportunities where others see routines.This is far more than a traditional Office Manager role. As the face of our Stockholm office, you'll play a key role in shaping both the first impression and the everyday experience of G+D. From welcoming customers and visitors at reception to driving workplace improvements, sustainability initiatives, business operations, and employee engagement, you'll have a visible impact across the entire organization. If you thrive in a role with broad responsibility, significant autonomy, and the opportunity to influence how people experience their workplace every day, we'd love to hear from you. About the role: You will play a key role in ensuring a smooth, professional and engaging workplace experience. Acting as the central point of coordination for office operations, administration, employee services facilities and internal communication, you will help create an environment where people can do their best work every day. In this role you will: 
Be the face of our office and create an exceptional workplace experience, taking ownership of our reception area and ensuring employees, customers, visitors and partners are always welcomed into a professional and engaging environment.
Drive operational excellence across the business, overseeing office operations, facilities, suppliers, budgets, contracts, expense management, travel administration, and key administrative processes.
Shape how employees experience G+D, driving onboarding, internal communication, events, work environment initiatives and continuous improvements that make our workplace more efficient, engaging, and future focused
Take the lead in coordinating the local Health & Safety agenda, ensuring that annual work environment reviews are conducted, risks are identified and addressed, action plans are followed through, and our office remains a safe, healthy, and compliant workplace.
 Required skills & experience We're looking for a proactive and resourceful person who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. You thrive in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same, and you have the ability to balance operational excellence with a strong service mindset. With a natural talent for building relationships and creating structure, you ensure that people, processes, and the workplace run smoothly. You are equally comfortable welcoming customers, visitors and colleagues to our office as you are managing operational processes, supporting leadership, and driving continuous improvements across the workplace. To succeed in this role, you bring: 
Several years of experience in Office Management, Workplace Management, Executive/Business Administration, Facilities Management, or a similar broad operational role.
Experience coordinating multiple areas of responsibility, such as office operations, vendors, contracts, budgets, workplace services, internal communications, or employee engagement activities.
Strong administrative and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Experience coordinating Health & Safety activities, conducting workplace reviews, following up on action plans, and collaborating with managers and stakeholders to create a safe working environment.
Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders, including contract administration and service follow-up.
Good financial understanding and experience working with budgets, invoice handling, expense management, and cost control.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
 It would be great if you also have: 
Experience working in an international or matrix organization
Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems
 Given the responsibilities for reception and office operations, this role requires a strong on-site presence, with the majority of working time spent in the office. Why G+D?At G+D, you’re not just joining a company, you’re joining a diverse, supportive, and purpose‑driven community. In this role you will have the opportunity to work with talented people in an international and innovative environment. G+D is a well-established family-owned company at the forefront of the market. Besides a dynamic and evolving industry, we offer you: 
A culture that values trust, innovation, and continuous learning
Personal and professional development with a wide range of training and learning opportunities
Competitive compensation and benefits
The chance to make a real impact on secure digital ecosystems

R&D / Engineering
Student
Nivelles, Belgique
Student
October 10, 2026
Hybrid
Internship duration : minimum 3 months / maximum 1 year
If you are a curious, motivated student who enjoys learning, solving real problems, and collaborating with others, then you’ll feel at home in our Cloud development team.
If you like taking initiative, exploring new technologies, and contributing to meaningful industrial IoT projects, this internship will give you the space to grow, experiment, and make an impact.
About the internship:
You will join a cross‑functional development team working on Ewon Cloud, a large‑scale SaaS platform used worldwide.
Depending on your profile, you will contribute as a full‑stack developer or as a test automation engineer.
You will collaborate with Product Owners, developers, testers, DevOps engineers, and managers to turn business needs into clear, actionable, and high‑quality software.
YOUR MISSION
As part of the development team, you will contribute to ongoing projects and support the team in their daily activities.
Software Development (Developer Track)
You work with Product Owners and developers to understand functional requirements.
You translate user stories into working software components.
You contribute to the implementation of UIs, APIs, cloud services, or platform features.
You ensure compatibility and integration with existing platform components.﻿
Testing & Quality (Automating Test Track)
You develop unit tests and integration tests to ensure software quality.
You contribute to debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving technical issues.
You participate in code reviews and apply feedback from senior developers.
You help maintain the reliability and stability of the platform.
Agile Team Collaboration
You participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
You collaborate with developers, testers, DevOps engineers, and Product Owners.
You follow development workflows using tools such as GitLab, Jira, and Confluence.
You contribute to team discussions and technical problem‑solving.
SKILLS / METHOLOGY
Expected methodology:
You work using structured and professional methodologies such as Kanban and/or Scrum.
Skills you will develop:
Analytical and problem‑solving skills.
Hands‑on experience with agile product development in a SaaS environment.
Practical skills in backlog management, requirement analysis, and user story writing.
Exposure to real‑world cloud technologies and industrial IoT use cases.
Collaboration within an international and cross‑functional team.
Use of tools like Jira, Confluence, GitLab.
Technologies you may work with:
Developer track: Java, Spring, Angular, TypeScript
Tester track: Robot Framework, Python
YOUR PROFILE
You are a student in Computer Science.
You have an analytical mindset with strong problem‑solving and organizational skills.
You have an interest in SaaS, IoT, and digital product development.
You have good communication skills in English (French is a plus).
WHO WE ARE
The HMS Networks Group, which employs more than 1100 people in 20 countries, is an internationally leading provider in the field of Industrial Information & Communication Technology (Industrial ICT).  
Driven by a strong customer-centric approach and dynamic growth, HMS has unparalleled expertise in Industrial Data and IIoT—from secure remote connectivity to real-time data visualization and advanced diagnostics. 
With a comprehensive industrial vision, HMS delivers solutions that connect machines and devices to the cloud, enable local operational control, and provide clear, actionable data insights. Security and reliability are at the core of every offering, with robust technologies built to meet the demands of harsh industrial environments. 
HMS is also a driver of innovation and expansion, following the recent integration of Red Lion® and PEAK-System®, and the launch of Ewon Cloud and Ewon Edge in early 2025. 
We also like to say that we put Heart, Mind and Soul into our work. That's how we create our shared culture, and it's a pretty good acronym for that too. 
At HMS, we believe that equal treatment and equal opportunity shall apply to everyone, regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or other belief, political opinion, social origin, disability, age or any other status protected by applicable laws. 
We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives working together in a respectful, balanced environment. 
Our culture is built on trust, empathy, and collaboration, where everyone feels safe to grow, share ideas, and find meaning in their work. 
Whether you're seeking innovation, development, or a healthy work-life balance, you’ll find a place where you can truly thrive. 
We value listening, mentoring, and supportive leadership, and our working conditions are designed to reflect the realities of life, because success looks different for everyone. 
This commitment applies throughout the employee journey, across all HMS locations.
Welcome to HMS!

Compensation: $18.20/hour with applicable shift premium plus up to 3% bonus capped at 150%
Shift: Afternoon - Monday to Friday 3-11pm
Job Summary:
 The Machine Operator processes jobs daily which involves the production of plastics, follows a detailed schedule for jobs to be personalized in a pre-determined time frame, and for the quality check of all plastic cards. 
Responsibilities:
Set-up machine to change over from job to job as per customer requirement
Startup/Shut down and load daily files from the G&D network server to the machine
Select correct file, split file by 500 up, and run file. Examine the first four cards through machine for each start up.
Work on machines to produce high quality products in a timely manner with least scrap and maximum productivity
Responsible for selection of data as per daily production schedule ensuring correct card and carrier specification are adhered to
Count and balance cards before and after starting card personalization. 
Record the machine meter reads prior to startup and at the end of shift.
Change supplies as required. (Coloured ribbon, Duragard, Cleaning tape).
Record Document Control Number (DCN) checks.
Accuracy for all quality checks and to ensure conformance to company standards
Ensure plastics and carriers match as required
Reload file for remakes and select correct embossing sequences and run remakes
Maintain machinery and work area in a clean and orderly condition at all times
Complete a report of daily production
Assist in other production related duties assigned
Acts as backup to any machine in Card Personalization as required
Works on special projects as assigned by Card Personalization management
Close jobs on SAP & BOWE 1.
Other duties as assigned.
Comply with G&D Environmental, Health & Safety policies, procedures and report any Environmental, Health & Safety hazards, incidents and concerns to the immediate supervisor/manager. Management will ensure employees are provided with job specific Environmental, Health & Safety information, training and also ensure employees follow workplace Health & Safety policies and procedures. 
Qualifications, Experience and Educational Requirements:
1 – 3 years of experience working with machinery in a manufacturing environment is an asset.
Skills and Competencies:
Strong verbal, written communication and organizational skillsWork under pressure in a fast paced environment
Attention to detail and hand eye co-ordination
Able to work independently or as a member of team
Ability to multi-task
Basic mathematical skills are required (ability to balance a job)
Basic knowledge with computers
 Education: 
Completed High School Diploma or some post education is preferred
Working Conditions:
Safety shoes and smock required on the production floor
Able to work overtime when needed
Flexible with switching shifts when required
Work area may require ear protection at times.
Physical Requirements:
Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs
Must be able to stand for a long periods of time
Lengthy periods of time looking at computer screen.
Extensive periods of time examining verbiage on cards.
