 Job Description
Service Desk Technician - Network
Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.
What you need to succeed
Relevant education in IT/ networking.
Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.
Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.
Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.
About the role and the team
You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.
The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.
The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shifts, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.
The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.
What you’ll be working on
Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.
Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.
Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.
Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.
Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.
Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed.
Who we are looking for
You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.
Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage.
Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Medarbetare till vårt Support/Driftsättningsteam
Vi på HiCore hjälper företag inom handelsbranschen att öka sin lönsamhet och effektivisera sin verksamhet genom vår affärslösning och branschkunskap. Vi jobbar nära våra kunder och deras verksamhet och vill vara en bidragande del till
 att deras företag utvecklas.
Nu söker vi dig som vill blir en del av vårt Support/Driftsättningsteam på HiCore.
Är du den vi letar efter?
Om tjänsten 
I tjänsten kommer du främst hjälpa våra nya kunder inom handelsbranschen i deras uppstart med någon av våra produkter HiCore Retail eller HiCore Business.
Våra kunder är främst butiker, grossister och e-handlare som använder funktioner i våra system som exempelvis kassa, order, lager, inköp och fakturering.
I rollen kommer du att:
• Vara en del av vårt team för onboarding.
-Du kommer vara med och hjälpa nya kunder komma i gång med våra lösningar genom till exempel tekniska installationer och utbildningar.
• Planera och utföra konsultationer och utbildningar
-Du kommer utföra utbildningar och konsultationer för våra befintliga kunder. Dessa kan utföras enligt kundens önskemål på distans/digitalt eller på plats ute hos kund. 
• Vara med och bemanna vår kundsupport
– Vi hjälper främst våra kunder via telefon och kopplar ofta upp oss digitalt för att ge bästa service.
• Samarbeta med vårt utvecklingsteam
-Vi utför noggranna tester av nya funktioner och du kommer vara med och utföra testning av dessa regelbundet. 
Om dig 
Vi söker dig som vill bli en del av ett företag med stor entreprenörsanda och som ger dig möjligheter att samtidigt utvecklas som person. Vi ser gärna att du är lösningsorienterad, har ett tekniskt intresse, är driven och gillar att
 ta eget ansvar. Du är lyhörd, kommer gärna med egna idéer och tycker om att lära dig nya saker.
Vi ser gärna att du har utbildning eller erfarenhet av systemlösningar och integrationer och att driva projekt inom dessa områden. En annan fördel är också om du tidigare arbetat inom handelsbranschen. Du är serviceminded och sätter
 alltid kunden i fokus.
Körkort och tillgång till egen bil är ett krav då det kan förekomma konsultation på plats ute hos kund.
Kunskaper vi ser som meriterande:
·        Microsoft SQL
·        Excel
·        Rest-API
·        Powershell
Om HiCore 
HiCore utvecklar, säljer och supporterar molnbaserade affärslösningar för företag inom handelsbranschen. Tillsammans med noga utvalda partners erbjuder vi en helhetslösning med ekonomisystem, e-handelsplattform och flexibla betalmetoder.
Viktigaste av allt är våra kunder och vår support är något både vi och våra kunder värderar högt!
Vårt kontor är centralt beläget i den äldre och charmiga delen av Kungälv, ca 2 mil norr om Göteborg. Kungälv har bra förbindelser med både bil och kollektivtrafik. Här finns fina promenadstråk på gamla kullerstensgatan eller varför
 inte utmana kollegor i VR på kontoret på lunchen?

 Job Description
Ready to turn strategy into execution?
As Executive Strategic Advisor to our Executive Vice President, B2B, you’ll work close to commercial priorities and help turn strategy into action. You’ll bring clarity to what matters, connect teams and follow priorities through to delivery.
What we’re looking for
Relevant higher education on Master’s level.
4+ years of experience in strategy or management consulting, transformation, a leadership office, or a comparable role in a complex business.
Well-developed analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to convert complex business information into clear insights and recommendations.
Experience taking a strategy, workstream or cross-functional initiative from problem definition into coordinated execution.
About the role and team
B2B is focused on growth, customer outcomes, operational performance and simplification. You’ll work closely with the Executive Vice President, B2B and collaborate with leaders and initiative owners across business units and functions. You’ll help create a clear view of priorities, progress, risks and decisions needed, while enabling business leaders to retain ownership of delivery.
What you’ll do
Translate B2B priorities into coordinated plans with clear outcomes, owners, milestones, measures and dependencies.
Strengthen the leadership operating rhythm by planning meetings, preparing materials, capturing decisions and following up on actions. This includes tracking progress and surface risks, delays and decisions needed early. 
Coordinate across teams, clarify hand-offs and help resolve barriers to delivery.
Prepare concise briefings and recommendations for the Executive Vice President, B2B, and constructively challenge plans when needed.
Support selected strategic change and improvement initiatives through to follow-through.
What you’ll bring
You’ll combine analytical thinking with a practical commercial mindset. You can connect information across teams, make complex issues clear for senior leaders and use data to understand progress. You’re comfortable getting buy-in without formal authority and can keep priorities moving with tact and persistence.
You’ll bring integrity, discretion and a low-ego approach to the role. Experience from strategy or management consultancy is an advantage, particularly if you’ve helped put recommendations into practice. Experience with commercial, customer, technology or operational transformation is also valuable.
Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.
Our recruitment process
Screening interview with Anna from Talent Acquisition 
First interview with the hiring team
Logical and personality assessments, followed by a feedback conversation with Anna from TA
Case interview with the hiring team
Reference checks, extended background check and final alignment. Please note that an extended background check is a requirement to be able to start in the role.
Practical information
The role is based in Stockholm with a hybrid setup and at least three days per week in the office. Regular travel and responsiveness at key moments are expected. GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.
No need for a personal letter. Just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

HMS | Commercial Controller – Pricing and Profitability
Commercial Controller – Pricing and Profitability
Halmstad
HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.
What you'll do
Take ownership of pricing and profitability analysis within the IDS Division, combining operational pricing work with business controlling and working with direct visibility to divisional leadership. You will split your time roughly equally between pricing management and business controlling: keeping prices accurate and following their development on one side, and turning order, sales and cost data into clear insights on profitability and performance on the other. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to make sure pricing and commercial decisions support growth and profitability. 
Key Responsibilities: 
Develop and maintain price lists, including list prices, regional adjustments, and discount structures 
Run the annual price adjustment process and conduct ongoing pricing reviews with product management and sales leadership 
Contribute to business and pricing model development by evaluating how we structure pricing across segments, regions, and product lines 
Analyze market, margin, and competitive data to generate pricing insights and recommendations 
Ensure pricing data accuracy across business systems and manage related administrative tasks 
Perform profitability analysis by product, customer, segment, and region, and identify the drivers behind margin development 
Carry out data-driven analyses of order and sales transactions, as well as cost to uncover trends, deviations, and opportunities 
Support the budgeting and forecasting process by preparing data, analyses, and commentary, with the opportunity to take over ownership of the process over time 
Manage KPIs by building, maintaining, and further developing reports and dashboards in Power BI 
Drive process improvements and automation in pricing and controlling workflows 
Collaborate closely with sales, product management, and finance to gather input and align decisions 
What you'll bring
You are analytical and structured, and you enjoy turning complex data into clear business decisions. You bring a hands-on, get-things-done attitude, a results-driven mindset, and a solution-oriented approach to driving the business forward. You are comfortable working across functions and know how to translate numbers into recommendations that stick with commercial stakeholders. You bring experience from controlling, commercial finance, pricing, or similar roles, ideally in a B2B or industrial environment. 
A university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field 
Applicable experience in controlling, pricing, commercial finance or a similar role, and experience from working in a global manufacturing organization 
Experience working in an international context, collaborating across locations and cultures 
Strong communication skills in English 
Strong analytical skills and a track record of turning data into actionable insights 
Advanced Excel skills and comfort with large datasets 
Experience with Power BI for reporting and KPI management, and with financial planning and reporting tools 
Experience with structured pricing models or price management tools is an advantage 
The confidence to influence, challenge, and support decision-makers at all levels 
About us
At HMS, we put Heart, Mind & Soul into everything we do. These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success.
We are an innovative growth company headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden, with approximately 1,100 employees in more than 20 countries. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning.
HMS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered.
Visit hms-networks.com and learn more about life at HMS in our Working at HMS video.

DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Understand job ticket information to determine quantity, special work instructions and any other special customer requirements
Locate and inspect the printing material to assure conformance to the specified requirements
Proof plates to assure correct graphics before production
Set rollers, hang plates, apply ink, set fountain settings and perform all related machine operation to operate press machine
Run make ready sheets and line up for proper position and layout
Demonstrate the ability to start up and operate the press efficiently
Bring process colors and/or special colors into register
Measure registration using registration marks and dot alignment with and without a loupe
Achieve ink and water balance
Set and adjust inks to achieve required colors matching specified requirements
Maintain and adjust ink levels during production to match specified requirements
Achieve and monitor UV lighting levels to assure proper curing rate to prevent offset and delamination
Examine press sheets during production for normal and special variation
Set up job and maintain color control by using the Intellitrax system
Clean the press according to the press manual
Perform preventive maintenance
Demonstrate the ability to use the shop floor data collection terminals and display consistency and accuracy
Perform other related job duties as assigned
OTHER FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with applicable Federal and State laws.
All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

Must possess a high standard of personal integrity
Ability to interact with all levels of the organization

Ability to work independently with high attention to detail
Ability to work overtime as needed
Ability to communicate orally and in writing in the English language
Must have basic math skills including addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
Must have a positive attitude and good teamwork skills
Must be able to pass a drug screen and criminal background check prior to hire
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT
Requires standing for 8 or more hours per day
Requires visual acuity to operate a computer, read a computer screen, read policies and manuals
Requires manual dexterity to operate a computer, phone, fax, scanner

 Job Description
Do you want a front-row seat to how a business is led?
As Executive Advisor to our EVP B2C, you'll work at the centre of GlobalConnect's Swedish B2C business. Working closely with the EVP and the B2C Sweden Leadership Team, you'll help shape priorities, prepare key decisions, and make sure they are translated into action across the organisation.
This position is well suited to someone at the start of their career who wants to grow rapidly, own meaningful work, and gain a wide-ranging view of how an organization operates.
If you're interested in a role that offers immediate responsibility, close work with experienced leaders, and faster growth than a standard career path, we'd like to hear from you.
To do well in this role, you should likely have
2–4 years of experience from management consulting, strategy, business operations, an Executive Office, or another environment where you've solved complex business problems and worked closely with senior stakeholders.
A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Communication, or another relevant field.
Skilled in structured problem-solving and Excel, with the ability to translate complex data into concise, practical recommendations.
Skilled in PowerPoint and storytelling, with a background in creating presentations and decision documents for executive-level audiences.
Fluent in both Swedish and English, with well-developed written and spoken communication skills.
About the role
You'll join the PMO and Executive Office team, working closely with our EVP B2C and the B2C Sweden Leadership Team—a group of experienced leaders from across the business that have work together for several years. The team works well together, with open communication throughout and an environment that values initiative.
As Executive Advisor, you'll become a trusted partner to both the EVP and the leadership team. You'll be working on topics that span commercial performance, organisational development, customer experience, and leadership priorities.
No two days are the same. One week you might help prepare a board discussion or facilitate a leadership workshop. The next week, you could guide a cross-functional initiative, align stakeholders across the business, or help define how an important change is rolled out for lasting impact.
The common denominator is simple: you'll work where important decisions are made—and help ensure they turn into results.
What you'll be working on
Partner with the EVP and the B2C Sweden Leadership Team, helping set, facilitate and follow up on the leadership agenda while ensuring priorities are translated into action across the organisation.
Turn complex business topics into clear, decision-ready material for board meetings, leadership forums and executive discussions, coordinating senior stakeholder input along the way.
Lead projects and processes from beginning to end by building structure, coordinating key contributors, following up on action items, and turning ideas into concrete outcomes.
Track how the organisation is absorbing change, including workload, capacity and readiness, and use those insights to help shape how initiatives are prioritised, communicated and implemented.
Improve ways of working within the PMO and Executive Office by bringing structure, clarity and efficiency to leadership processes.
Coordinate executive planning, calendar, meetings and travel, ensuring the EVP is well prepared and able to focus on the highest-value priorities.
Who we're looking for
You like exploring complex business issues and finding solutions, and you stay engaged after the presentation wraps up. You're a pragmatic problem solver who can take action who enjoys carrying projects forward.
You're as comfortable structuring a board discussion as you are picking up the practical task that makes it happen. No task is too big or too small if it helps move the business forward.
You build trust easily, navigate organisations with confidence, and quickly understand who needs to be involved to create progress. You’re comfortable collaborating with people at every level, leading discussions, coordinating across teams, and taking your work from concept to completion on your own initiative.
Although you're still early in your career, you operate with maturity, sound judgement and professionalism beyond your years. You step up when priorities shift and consistently deliver work you can be proud of.
Why join GlobalConnect?
Few roles offer this combination of responsibility, visibility and development so early in your career.
You'll work side by side with senior leaders, gain insight into how a large business is led, and contribute to decisions that shape one of GlobalConnect's most important business areas. Along the way, you'll build experience and capabilities that will stay with you throughout your career.
GlobalConnect is a company on the move. It is a place where people and ideas can grow, and where change is welcomed. I you want to work in telco, you want to work at GC.
 Great Place to Work

 "I work with dedicated and very competent colleagues who have a strong will to move forward and have lots of fun on the way. In this culture, I get the opportunity to take a lot of responsibility and the chance to widen my competence and go outside my comfort zone."

Senior Project Manager IT

We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.
We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Machine Operator (Perso)
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
At Payment Technology, our mission is to be at the start of every transaction and to make it secure and simple. We also create contemporary payment and banking solutions for our digital age. As a one-stop shop, we produce and personalise hundreds of millions of payment cards every year and store their "digital twins" - mobile and digital. Would you like to actively shape the digital transformation with us?
Compensation: $18.20/hour with applicable shift premium plus up to 3% bonus capped at 150%
Shift: Night - Sunday to Thursday 11pm-7am
Job Summary:
 The Machine Operator processes jobs daily which involves the production of plastics, follows a detailed schedule for jobs to be personalized in a pre-determined time frame, and for the quality check of all plastic cards. 
Responsibilities:
Set-up machine to change over from job to job as per customer requirement
Startup/Shut down and load daily files from the G&D network server to the machine
Select correct file, split file by 500 up, and run file. Examine the first four cards through machine for each start up.
Work on machines to produce high quality products in a timely manner with least scrap and maximum productivity
Responsible for selection of data as per daily production schedule ensuring correct card and carrier specification are adhered to
Count and balance cards before and after starting card personalization. 
Record the machine meter reads prior to startup and at the end of shift.
Change supplies as required. (Coloured ribbon, Duragard, Cleaning tape).
Record Document Control Number (DCN) checks.
Accuracy for all quality checks and to ensure conformance to company standards
Ensure plastics and carriers match as required
Reload file for remakes and select correct embossing sequences and run remakes
Maintain machinery and work area in a clean and orderly condition at all times
Complete a report of daily production
Assist in other production related duties assigned
Acts as backup to any machine in Card Personalization as required
Works on special projects as assigned by Card Personalization management
Close jobs on SAP & BOWE 1.
Other duties as assigned.
Comply with G&D Environmental, Health & Safety policies, procedures and report any Environmental, Health & Safety hazards, incidents and concerns to the immediate supervisor/manager. Management will ensure employees are provided with job specific Environmental, Health & Safety information, training and also ensure employees follow workplace Health & Safety policies and procedures. 
Qualifications, Experience and Educational Requirements:
1 – 3 years of experience working with machinery in a manufacturing environment is an asset.
Skills and Competencies:
Strong verbal, written communication and organizational skillsWork under pressure in a fast paced environment
Attention to detail and hand eye co-ordination
Able to work independently or as a member of team
Ability to multi-task
Basic mathematical skills are required (ability to balance a job)
Basic knowledge with computers
 Education: 
Completed High School Diploma or some post education is preferred
Working Conditions:
Safety shoes and smock required on the production floor
Able to work overtime when needed
Flexible with switching shifts when required
Work area may require ear protection at times.
Physical Requirements:
Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs
Must be able to stand for a long periods of time
Lengthy periods of time looking at computer screen.
Extensive periods of time examining verbiage on cards.
Additional Information:
This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. The candidate hired will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by the supervisor. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties as needed. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment. Giesecke+Devrient ePayments Canada, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce, encouraging applications from all qualified individuals. Upon request by the applicant, accommodation will be provided in all parts of the hiring process. By applying to this position you are confirming you possess either a Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or valid work permit. Please note: Reference Checks and Credit, Criminal Background Checks will be administered on suitably qualified candidates.This posting is for an existing vacancy.

 Job openings

Software Engineer
 Location
 Delft, The Netherlands 
 Department
 Development
 Apply by
 2026-10-04
At HMS Industrial Networks, we value the dedicated contributions of our employees, and we recognize that it is our people that make HMS successful. We work hard to maintain our vibrant, innovative, and welcoming culture, and we strive to support our staff as they grow and develop both personally and professionally.
About the Team
You'll join a dynamic agile software development team at HMS Delft, The Netherlands, where we develop innovative software solutions for industrial diagnostics and cloud products. Our mission is to design, implement, and maintain reliable software that helps customers monitor, diagnose, and optimize their industrial operations.
Working in an international environment, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across different HMS locations and product teams. Our team develops both embedded software for industrial devices for diagnostics and cloud-based solutions for remote access. As HMS continues to expand its Cloud platform, built on AWS and leveraging technologies such as Java, Spring, and Angular, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to software that connects industrial edge devices with modern cloud services.
Role and Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of software for our industrial diagnostics products and cloud-connected solutions. You will be involved throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and implementation to testing and maintenance.
Your responsibilities include:
Designing, developing, and maintaining embedded software for industrial diagnostics products.
Contributing to the development of cloud-based applications and services on the Ewon Cloud platform using Java, Spring, and Angular.
Implementing and executing unit, integration, and E2E tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
Collaborating with product owners, architects, and fellow engineers to define and deliver new features.
Writing clean, maintainable code following software engineering best practices.
Participating in code reviews and technical discussions to continuously improve the quality of our products.
Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues across embedded and cloud-based systems.
Contributing to the design and evolution of software architectures for both embedded and cloud solutions.
Expanding the use of AI in our development processes.
About You
You are a software engineer with a strong problem-solving mindset and a passion for developing reliable, high-quality software. You enjoy working on technical challenges across different domains and are motivated by delivering solutions that create value for customers.
You combine solid technical skills with a pragmatic and collaborative approach. You are eager to learn, take ownership of your work, and contribute to a team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are valued.
Only candidates currently based in the Netherlands will be considered.
Required Experience
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or equivalent experience.
Several years of experience in software development.
Strong proficiency in Java development & in-depth experience with the Spring framework.
Knowledge of software design principles, testing methodologies, and debugging techniques.
Experience with version control systems such as Git, ideally with GitLab.
Familiarity with networking concepts and communication protocols.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative international environment.
Nice to have
Experience with Angular is a huge plus.
Experience with AI agentic workflows.
Knowledge of Cloud Infrastructure & Services (e.g., AWS concepts like EC2, S3, Docker, Kubernetes) to understand deployment environments.
Experience with testing frameworks (e.g. Robot for E2E testing, JUnit, Mockito for Java; Jasmine, Karma, Jest for Angular).
Experience with RabbitMQ or other messaging queues.
Experience developing REST APIs and distributed systems.
Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.
Experience with embedded software development using C++.
Understanding of software architecture and system design principles.
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols and connectivity solutions (Profinet, Ethernet/IP and Profibus).

Myra Veltkamp

Functional Safety Engineer
Vill du vara med och jobba för att göra vår vardag säkrare?
 Till ansökan
Funktionell säkerhet inom fordon, industrier, transportsektorn, medicinteknik m.m. blir allt vanligare i samband med att stora system blir mer autonoma med mer avancerad hård- och mjukvara. Det är en otroligt spännande utveckling vi ser framför oss med teknik som kommer att underlätta och göra vår vardag säkrare. Det ställer dock högre och högre krav på våra system att de är säkra och att vi undviker att människor blir skadade genom att identifiera och minska risker. Vi behöver därför bli fler som jobbar inom vårt erbjudande för säkerhetskritiska system!
Väcker det ett intresse hos dig? Då kanske det är dig vi söker!
I denna spännande roll kommer du att arbeta med utvecklingen av säkerhetskritiska mjukvarusystem. Du kommer att spela en nyckelroll i att säkerställa att våra kunders produkter möter högsta säkerhetsstandarder inom branscher som fordonsteknik och industriell automation. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till att skydda liv genom innovativa lösningar.
Vi lägger stor vikt i att du har din tyngd inom tekniken men det är nästan ännu viktigare att du är en person som sprider energi och bryr dig om personer i din omgivning. Som konsult hos oss kommer du jobba i ett kompetent team bestående av HiQ-kollegor eller i team hos våra kunder. Du kommer garanterat utveckla dina befintliga kunskaper inom mjukvaruutveckling och säkerhetskritiska system. På HiQ gillar vi att inspirera och att inspireras, och vi känner en stor stolthet i det vi gör.
Som FuSa Engineer på HiQ får du:
Utveckla, implementera och verifiera mjukvara enligt relevant säkerhetsstandard
Säkerställa att säkerhetskrav uppfylls genom hela mjukvarans livscykel
Utföra säkerhetsanalyser och riskbedömningar
Utveckla och underhålla säkerhetsrelaterad dokumentation.
Du får vara en del av ett växande område hos både våra kunder och HiQ. Vi ser både ett stort nuvarande och framtida behov inom flera industrier där du kommer vara en nyckelspelare. Utöver arbete tillsammans med kund finns det möjlighet för dig att involvera dig i våra forum för säkerhetskritiska system.
Vi sätter stor tilltro till dig som vill vara med i vår satsning! Utöver att vi ger dig den utbildningen du behöver så stöttar vi dig i ditt uppdrag genom att tillhandahålla våra forum och våra erfarna kollegor inom området som hjälper dig på din resa mot att bli expert inom funktionell säkerhet. Oavsett om området är nytt för dig eller om du vill göra en förändring från en bransch till en annan.
Vem är du?
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:
En relevant högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, elektronik eller liknande.
Minst 3 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling med fokus på funktionell säkerhet.
Kännedom om standarder så som, ISO 13849, ISO 26262, IEC 61508 eller likande för säkerhetskritiska system
Erfarenhet av inbyggda system och C eller C++ programmering.
Förmåga att kommunicera effektivt på både svenska och engelska.
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av ASPICE
Erfarenhet av maskindirektivet
Om HiQ:
HiQ är mer än ett techföretag – vi är ett nätverk av techhubbar där skarpa hjärnor och ambitiösa kunder delar tron på att tekniken formar framtiden. Vårt mindset "Headquarters of Tech" präglar oss oavsett plats eller projekt, och bygger på djup teknisk expertis, kreativt tänkande och leveranser som gör verklig skillnad.
Vi tror på kunskapsdelning och kontinuerligt lärande, vilket gör oss till en långsiktig partner för dem som vill ligga steget före i techlandskapet. Våra konsulter och team brinner för innovation och att hitta de smartaste lösningarna. På HiQ är vi engagerade i att skapa varaktig påverkan genom teknik och samtidigt ha kul på vägen.
Vi välkomnar alla typer av människor, huvudsaken är att du drivs av utmaningar och är lagspelare. Hos oss finns en mix av kompetenser och personligheter – från utvecklare och arkitekter till UX/UI-designers och cyberspecialister. Tillsammans bygger vi det bolag vi själva vill arbeta på.
Läs gärna mer om oss på vår Karriärssida HiQ West samt kika in på vårt instagramkonto. Hoppas vi ses snart! 🥳

VARFÖR JOBBA PÅ HIQ?
Utvecklande och inspirerande uppdrag
Vill du jobba med kunder som är ute efter techlösningar som förenklar vardagen och formar vår framtid? På HiQ förenas riktigt duktiga konsulter med målinriktade kunder. I din roll kommer du att samarbeta med fantastiska människor från en rad branscher. Visst kommer det vara dagar av vardaglig konsultverksamhet. Men det kommer också vara magiska stunder där nya möjligheter öppnas upp med kunder som är ivriga att leda utvecklingen inom sin bransch.
Personlig och professionell utveckling 
Vi vet att även de bästa konsulterna behöver utmanande projekt och ständig utbildning för att behålla sin spetskompetens. På HiQ är din utveckling en viktig del av vår framgång. Marknaden förändras hela tiden, och därför investerar vi i intern utveckling genom kompetensgrupper där konsulter lär sig av varandra. Vi uppmuntrar till kurser, certifieringar och att man är med på våra interna föreläsningar för att stärka din roll som konsult hos oss.
Nära ledarskap
Som konsult hos oss är du aldrig ensam. Våra engagerade konsultchefer stöttar dig och matchar din profil med rätt uppdrag, alltid med fokus på din utveckling. Vi vill att HiQ ska kännas som hemma, oavsett var du är placerad. Du är en del av ett konsultteam inom ditt expertområde och har regelbunden kontakt med kollegor och chefer för stöd och som bollplank under din konsultresa.
Bra lön och förmånspaket
Vi förstår att det finns mycket att överväga när man väljer ett konsultbolag. Uppdrag, kollegor och utvecklingsmöjligheter är viktiga, men det är även ersättning och välmående. Därför ser vi regelbundet över vårt förmånspaket för att säkerställa att de bästa konsulterna väljer HiQ. Hos oss har du fast lön, övertidsersättning och flexibla arbetstider. Vi erbjuder också tjänstepension, föräldralön, hälsoersättning och tillgång till ett brett utbud av försäkringar och hälsovårdstjänster.
Unik kultur och gemenskap
När man väljer jobb är kulturen på arbetsplatsen viktig för att man ska trivas och kunna utvecklas. En bra kultur skapar gemenskap och gör att man känner sig motiverad och sedd. På HiQ är kulturen något alldeles speciellt – här möts en brokig skara tech-experter i gemenskapen om att alla är välkomna precis som dom är. På HiQ bejakar vi våra intressen, både professionellt och vid sidan av - alltid med målet att utvecklas och ha roligt på vägen.
Ett starkt varumärke
Med 30 års historia av att leverera banbrytande lösningar i alla branscher har HiQ utvecklat ett starkt, omtyckt och välkänt varumärke. Varumärket utgörs av de 2000 fantastiska medarbetarna som tillsammans skapat bolaget de alltid velat jobba på. En unik, inkluderande kultur och stora möjligheter till utveckling har i sin tur bidragit till HiQ's starka arbetsgivarvarumärke.

Want to work with modern business systems that keep global supply chains running smoothly? Apply today – and let’s find out together if this could be the right next step for you.
HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.
What you'll do
Group IT is looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Application Specialist with focus on Supply Chain Management.
In this role, you will ensure that our Dynamics 365 Supply Chain solutions support and continuously improve procurement, production, logistics, and global supply chain processes. You will work at the intersection of IT and Supply Chain, translating business needs into scalable and stable system solutions.
You will also contribute to keeping our solutions robust over time, ensuring they work as the business evolves and requirements change.
At HMS, you will deepen your expertise in Dynamics 365, gain a broad understanding of global supply chain processes, and contribute to digital transformation in an international environment.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Implementing, configuring, and maintaining Dynamics 365,including integrations (EDI, logistics, MES etc.) with a focus on Supply Chain.
Together with ERP team supporting and troubleshooting Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations in general.
Ensuring system stability, performance, and continuous improvement
Working with process improvements across supply chain areas together with the business
Defining requirements and collaborating with developers on changes and enhancements
Supporting documentation, training, and system quality
Managing user roles, access, and licence optimisation
Staying updated on Dynamics 365 and driving improvements
About you
You enjoy working at the intersection of business and IT and have a strong understanding of how supply chain processes are supported within ERP systems.
You are proactive and solution-oriented, with a mindset focused on driving improvements and taking initiative. You collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders and communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences.
You build strong working relationships and contribute to effective collaboration between IT and the business. You are structured in your way of working, value teamwork and knowledge sharing, and thrive in an environment where you continuously learn and develop.
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, along with a solid understanding of supply chain processes in a manufacturing environment
Hands-on experience with system configuration and implementation, and the ability to translate business needs into effective system solutions
Ability and willingness to work on site in Halmstad a few days per week for close collaboration with the team
English required as working language
Nice to have:
Knowledge of related supply chain systems such as EDI integrations, MES systems, logistics solutions, or labelling/documentation systems
Experience in data migration
Experience from working in a global organisation
Swedish language skills
About us
At HMS, we put Heart, Mind & Soul into everything we do. These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success.
We are an innovative growth company headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden, with approximately 1,100 employees in more than 20 countries. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning.
HMS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered.

 privacy policy
At HMS Industrial Networks we place great importance on the protection of your personal data and want to be transparent regarding how personal data is collected, processed and shared by us.
Personally Identifiable Information refers to any data that can be related to you as a person and processing refers to all our handling, including the use of it, storage and possible 3 rd party transfer.
This privacy policy covers our recruitment process managed from Sweden. The policy may be updated from time to time and you will always find the latest version on our recruiting web site.
Information we collect and process about you 
To be able to evaluate you as a candidate for a job we need to process some information about you. This information is only used for the recruitment process and no other purposes. We base all processing during recruitment on your consent allowing us to handle the data, you have the right to recall this consent at any time.
 At the time you apply for a job 
We process the following information that is submitted by yourself or a recruiter, in case we use an external partner, during the recruitment process.
Name and contact information (Mail, Address, Phone numbers etc.)
Information in personal letter and CV that you provide
Your personal data will be kept in confidence and we will hold it as long as necessary for the recruitment process and for a period not exceeding 2 years thereafter. We store the information for 2 years referring to the Swedish law of negation order (förhandlingsordningen).
If you are selected for an interview
If you are selected for an interview we may, for some positions, perform tests that are computer-based, like personality tests or testing of skills. You always get information about the test before you are invited. The results from these tests are stored for maximum one year after the recruitment process ends.
External data processors 
We use external data processors to provide us with different services, including:
IT service providers (Hosting, back-up, cloud solutions etc.)
Companies providing testing services
Recruitment companies (specific positions)
These service providers are only allowed to process information on behalf of HMS and as specifically instructed by us.
Protection of your data 
For us it is important that your data is safe. We use up-to-date data protection mechanisms and has a good security posture.
HMS Industrial Network entities ensure due care and take appropriate organizational and technical measures to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the personal data and communication data provided, collected and/or stored on our systems and shall not retain it any longer than permitted in order to perform its services or as required under relevant legislation.
Your personal data can only be accessed by authorized employees of HMS Industrial Network that need to have access to this data in order to be able to fulfil their given duties.
Data storage and location 
Your application is stored on servers within the EU/EEA.
When performing tests during recruitment, the test service provider may store data outside EU/EEA. Such transfer is only made if the recipient of the data is located in a country which provides an adequate level of protection following a European Commission adequacy decision or if appropriate safeguards as within the EU have been provided by executing standard contractual clauses.
Your data – your rights 
You have the right to know what information we process about you and the right to have your information corrected or deleted unless we have a legal duty to keep it. You can withdraw your consent for processing at any time and we will delete the data. If you want to exercise one of your rights, please contact us using the contact information below.

Är du en utvecklare med passion för att bygga säkra lösningar? 
Säkerhet har aldrig varit viktigare för oss och våra kunder! Nu söker vi dig som tillsammans med oss vill ta på sig ledartröjan i säker systemutveckling! Säkerhet måste byggas från grunden och vi har ambitionen att leda arbetet från start till mål! 
Vi tror följande beskrivning passar in på dig: 
Förstår vikten av att beakta risk tidigt i utvecklingsprocessen genom att delta i eller leda workshops i hotmodellering
Har kunskap om tekniska verktyg för automatisering och säkerhetstestning, tex. Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
Har kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet att använda OWASP som guide och ramverk för säker utveckling
Har erfarenhet eller intresse av penetrationstestning och sårbarhetsskanning
Älskar att dela med dig av din kunskap till övriga i teamet
Kommunicerar flytande i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
HiQ då?
Vi gillar att bygga saker.
Man kan skriva mycket om att förbättra världen och saker som att “forma framtiden genom skapandet av produkter som engagerar, förundrar och som användare blir förälskade i"… men i slutändan handlar det om en sak:
Det är svårt att slå känslan av att skapa något som gör nytta, som gör någons vardag bättre än vad den var igår.
Hos oss kommer du ha möjlighet att bygga saker för både stora och små kunder och projekt. Så oavsett om du drömmer om att vara med och skapa stora projekt som når en bred publik, eller om du brinner för att bygga små specialiserade lösningar så kommer du hitta sådana möjligheter hos oss.
Dessutom så är det viktigt för oss att “Bygga företaget du alltid velat jobba på”. HiQ har en väldigt flexibel företagskultur, även mellan våra olika kontor. Vi är en produkt av individerna som jobbar här och är stolta över att vara en arbetsplats där man känner att man kan vara sig själv.

I din roll kommer du att samarbeta med fantastiska människor från en rad branscher. Visst kommer det vara dagar av vardaglig konsultverksamhet. Men det kommer också vara magiska stunder där nya möjligheter öppnas upp med kunder som är ivriga att leda utvecklingen inom sin bransch.
Personlig och professionell utveckling 
Vi vet att även de bästa konsulterna behöver utmanande projekt och ständig utbildning för att behålla sin spetskompetens. På HiQ är din utveckling en viktig del av vår framgång. Marknaden förändras hela tiden, och därför investerar vi i intern utveckling genom kompetensgrupper där konsulter lär sig av varandra. Vi uppmuntrar till kurser, certifieringar och att man är med på våra interna föreläsningar för att stärka din roll som konsult hos oss.
Nära ledarskap
Som konsult hos oss är du aldrig ensam. Våra engagerade konsultchefer stöttar dig och matchar din profil med rätt uppdrag, alltid med fokus på din utveckling. Vi vill att HiQ ska kännas som hemma, oavsett var du är placerad. Du är en del av ett konsultteam inom ditt expertområde och har regelbunden kontakt med kollegor och chefer för stöd och som bollplank under din konsultresa.

Vi förstår att det finns mycket att överväga när man väljer ett konsultbolag. Uppdrag, kollegor och utvecklingsmöjligheter är viktiga, men det är även ersättning och välmående. Därför ser vi regelbundet över vårt förmånspaket för att säkerställa att de bästa konsulterna väljer HiQ. Hos oss har du fast lön, övertidsersättning och flexibla arbetstider. Vi erbjuder också tjänstepension, föräldralön, hälsoersättning och tillgång till ett brett utbud av försäkringar och hälsovårdstjänster.
Unik kultur och gemenskap
När man väljer jobb är kulturen på arbetsplatsen viktig för att man ska trivas och kunna utvecklas. En bra kultur skapar gemenskap och gör att man känner sig motiverad och sedd. På HiQ är kulturen något alldeles speciellt – här möts en brokig skara tech-experter i gemenskapen om att alla är välkomna precis som dom är. På HiQ bejakar vi våra intressen, både professionellt och vid sidan av - alltid med målet att utvecklas och ha roligt på vägen.
Ett starkt varumärke
Med 30 års historia av att leverera banbrytande lösningar i alla branscher har HiQ utvecklat ett starkt, omtyckt och välkänt varumärke. Varumärket utgörs av de 2000 fantastiska medarbetarna som tillsammans skapat bolaget de alltid velat jobba på. En unik, inkluderande kultur och stora möjligheter till utveckling har i sin tur bidragit till HiQ's starka arbetsgivarvarumärke.

 Ansök nu
DevOps Engineers – dags att få saker att hända! 
På HiQ vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med erfarna DevOps Engineers och CI/CD-specialister som är nyfikna på nya möjligheter tillsammans med oss. 
Vi är övertygade om att teknik ska vara rolig, enkel och mänsklig. På HiQ kombinerar vi spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns plats för nyfikenhet, samarbete och lekfullhet. Här får du bidra med din expertis och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för att skapa verkligt värde med hjälp av modern teknik, smart automation och välfungerande utvecklingsflöden.
Så här kan du bidra
Beroende på din profil och kommande uppdrag kan du få arbeta med praktisk DevOps nära utvecklingsteam och verksamhet. Det kan handla om att vidareutveckla och förbättra CI/CD-flöden, bygga struktur i pipelines, stärka testautomation och bidra till säkrare och mer effektiva releaseprocesser.
Du kan även få arbeta med exempelvis SBOM, vulnerability checks, bygg- och deployflöden samt att hjälpa utvecklingsorganisationer att få bättre framdrift, kvalitet och kontroll i sin leverans. Rollen passar dig som gillar att omsätta idéer till fungerande lösningar, driva saker i mål och skapa förutsättningar för andra att lyckas.
Vi letar efter dig som…
Har relevant erfarenhet inom DevOps, CI/CD eller liknande roller.
Har praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga, förbättra och underhålla pipelines.
Har erfarenhet av testautomation kopplat till CI/CD-flöden.
Har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps.
Gärna har erfarenhet av TeamCity.
Har förståelse för säkerhet i utvecklingsflöden, exempelvis SBOM, vulnerability checks eller liknande.
Trivs i en roll där du både kan arbeta hands-on och stötta andra team.
Är kommunikativ, självgående och lösningsorienterad.
Gillar att skapa struktur, driva framåt och få saker att hända.
Behärskar svenska och/eller engelska i tal och skrift.
Vi ser positivt på erfarenhet från miljöer där DevOps är en viktig möjliggörare för flera team eller en större utvecklingsorganisation. Som person är du nyfiken, prestigelös och trygg i att samarbeta med olika roller – samtidigt som du har förmågan att ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt.
Varför HiQ?
Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos några av regionens mest intressanta kunder. Vi satsar på kompetensutveckling genom utbildningar, certifieringar och intern kunskapsdelning – och erbjuder en kultur där vi stöttar varandra, firar framgångar och har riktigt roligt längs vägen. Tillsammans bygger vi det bolag vi själva vill arbeta på! 🥳
Nyfiken på nya möjligheter?
I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona, och vi samarbetar med kunder runt om i regionen. Just nu är vi särskilt nyfikna på dig som är tillgänglig inom kort och som trivs i uppdrag där samarbete på plats är en viktig del av vardagen.
Vi vill gärna komma i kontakt med dig som är nyfiken på HiQ och öppen för nya utmaningar. Genom att lära känna dig, din kompetens och dina drivkrafter kan vi tillsammans hitta ett sammanhang där du kan utvecklas och göra skillnad.
👉 Skicka in din ansökan och berätta mer om dig själv. När din kompetens möter rätt uppdrag kan det bli starten på något riktigt bra!

På HiQ bejakar vi våra intressen, både professionellt och vid sidan av - alltid med målet att utvecklas och ha roligt på vägen.

Med 30 års historia av att leverera banbrytande lösningar i alla branscher har HiQ utvecklat ett starkt, omtyckt och välkänt varumärke. Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som har ett starkt driv och på ett effektivt sätt kan lösa problem professionellt. Du har förmodligen en eller flera lösningsförslag klara om du ska presentera en utmaning för din motpart. • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
• B-körkort.
• Arbetslivserfarenhet inom brandvägg, nätverk och/eller IT-säkerhet ses som starkt meriterande
• Arbetslivserfarenhet av Office365, Vmware, Hyper-V samt Microsoft Azure är starkt meriterande. 
Det är meriterande om du har certifieringar inom områdena ovan (eller intilliggande). Du behärskar svenska och engelska väl i tal och skrift och innehar B-körkort.

Som konsult på Hägg & Kristiansson Office Solutions  är du en del av ett professionellt team. Vi erbjuder en dynamisk och kul arbetsplats där det för rätt person finns stora möjligheter att växa och utvecklas. Vi har ett stort kundfokus.
Vidareutveckling Utbildning & Certifiering inom våra produktområden är en självklarhet hos oss.

DevOps Engineer – Industri / Embedded
HiQ Västerås söker just nu en DevOps Engineer till en teknisk miljö med fokus på industriella och embedded-nära system. Rollen innebär arbete med automatisering, CI/CD och infrastruktur i miljöer där mjukvara är nära kopplad till hårdvara och där säkerhet och stabil drift är centralt.
Om rollen
Du arbetar med att utveckla och förvalta CI/CD-flöden, bygga och underhålla containerbaserade miljöer samt stödja utvecklingsteam i att effektivisera bygg-, test- och deployprocesser. Arbetet sker i Linux-baserade miljöer och kan inkludera on-prem-lösningar, air-gappade system samt integration mot embedded-plattformar.

Utveckla och underhålla CI/CD-pipelines
Automatisera bygg-, test- och releaseprocesser
Hantera containerplattformar och orkestrering (t.ex. Kubernetes)
Arbeta med Infrastructure as Code och konfigurationshantering
Stötta utvecklingsteam inom embedded och systemnära mjukvara
Säkerställa spårbarhet, reproducerbara byggen och stabil drift
Arbeta med säkerhetsaspekter i utvecklings- och leveransflöden
Kvalifikationer
Erfarenhet av DevOps-arbete i Linux-miljö
Kunskap inom CI/CD-verktyg (t.ex. GitLab, Jenkins)
Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes
Erfarenhet av scripting (t.ex. Bash eller Python)
Förståelse för nätverk, systemintegration och versionshantering (Git)
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av embedded-system eller hårdvarunära utveckling
Erfarenhet av arbete i industriella miljöer
Kunskap om säkerhetskritiska system eller air-gappade miljöer
Erfarenhet av realtidssystem eller cross-compilation
Förståelse för DevSecOps
Övrigt
Rollen kan innebära arbete i miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet, dokumentation och kvalitet. Samarbete sker med utvecklare, testingenjörer och systemarkitekter.

Test & Manufacturing Software Specialist (M/F/X) – HMS Industrial Networks SA
Skip to main content
Test & Manufacturing Software Specialist (M/F/X)
Supply / Industrialization / Production / Quality
Permanent contract
Nivelles, Belgique
Experienced Professional
October 22, 2026
Hybrid
If you have experience in software development and enjoy solving real-world challenges at the intersection of software, electronics, and manufacturing, this role could be a great fit.
You will join an established and collaborative team that already delivers valuable solutions to our manufacturing operations. We are looking for someone who is curious, hands-on, and eager to develop their skills while directly contributing to our products.
ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
As part of the Supply Chain organization, you join the Industrialization team and support all HMS divisions in the mass manufacturing of Industrial IoT products, mainly through external manufacturing partners.
Your focus is to develop, deploy, and maintain software-driven test solutions for PCBAs and final products while contributing your experience to strengthen the team's software engineering practices.
Working alongside skilled colleagues, you will serve as a technical point of reference for complex topics, helping to ensure that test solutions remain reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with manufacturing needs.
The role combines long-term development, operational support, technical problem-solving, and continuous improvement within an Agile environment where collaboration and knowledge sharing are key.﻿
Test Solution Development & Reliability
Design, develop, and maintain software applications for manufacturing test benches used for PCBAs and final products.
Translate product and manufacturing requirements into clear and effective test specifications.
Ensure test solutions are reliable, maintainable, traceable, and aligned with HMS production test guidelines.
Monitor test system performance and support high availability across manufacturing environments.
Implement validation mechanisms such as self-tests, regression testing, and automated verification.
Support deployment and integration of test solutions within production facilities.
Contribute to the standardization and reuse of test frameworks, architectures, and methodologies.
Technical Expertise & Continuous Improvement
Serve as a technical contributor and trusted point of reference for complex software and software-hardware integration challenges.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of software development practices, including version control, testing, code reviews, and release management.
Support technical decision-making by balancing operational needs, software quality, maintainability, and long-term sustainability.
Share knowledge and collaborate with colleagues to solve challenging technical issues.
Identify opportunities to improve development efficiency, solution robustness, and system reliability.
Contribute to the evolution of testing tools, automation capabilities, and data utilization, including AI-driven opportunities where relevant.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with Design, R&D, Quality, IT, Manufacturing, and external partners to ensure alignment across disciplines.
Support manufacturing operations through effective troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives.
Help ensure a smooth transition from product development to industrial production.
Contribute to a collaborative team culture built on knowledge sharing, mutual support, and operational excellence.
YOUR PROFILE
You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software or Hardware/Electronics, with at least 3-4 years of hands-on experience in industrial, embedded, manufacturing, or software-intensive environments. You enjoy staying close to the product and want a role where you can keep developing your technical skills.
You will likely recognize yourself in several of the following:
Strong Python development skills.
Experience developing software that interacts with electronic hardware.
Familiarity with manufacturing, test systems, industrial environments, or embedded technologies.
Comfortable working with Linux, scripting, APIs, backend services, and version control tools such as Git.
Knowledge of NI TestStand and/or LabVIEW is a strong asset.
Ability to troubleshoot across software, hardware, and production environments.
Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership.
Enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and contributing to continuous improvement.
What we value most
Beyond technical expertise, we are looking for someone who:
Brings sound judgement and a structured approach to problem-solving.
Enjoys working collaboratively and building trust across teams.
Can remain effective when facing complex or operationally critical situations.
Combines technical depth with a practical, business-oriented mindset.
Is motivated by creating reliable solutions that deliver long-term value.
Why join HMS?
Play a key technical role in a growing international technology company
Work on real-world industrial challenges where software, electronics, and manufacturing meet
Be part of a collaborative team where experience and expertise are genuinely valued
Enjoy the stability of a successful global organization combined with the agility of innovative technology teams
Continue learning and developing through challenging projects and ongoing training opportunities
Benefit from a competitive compensation package, company car, flexible working arrangements, and a healthy work-life balance
Help shape the future of Industrial IoT and Industry 4.0
A rewarding package
Competitive salary and attractive fringe benefits
Company car
2 days homeworking per week
Permanent contract
Modern office facilities in Nivelles
Supportive and collaborative working environment
WHO WE ARE
The HMS Networks Group, employing more than 1,100 people across 20 countries, is a leading international provider of Industrial Information and Communication Technology (Industrial ICT).
With a comprehensive industrial vision, HMS delivers solutions that connect machines and devices to the cloud, enable local operational control, and provide actionable data insights. Security and reliability are at the core of everything we do.
Following the integration of Red Lion® and PEAK-System®, and the launch of Ewon Cloud and Ewon Edge, HMS continues to drive innovation and growth across the industrial connectivity landscape.
At HMS, we put Heart, Mind and Soul into our work. We believe that diverse perspectives fuel better ideas, stronger teams, and greater innovation. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, respect, and continuous learning.
Whether you're looking for technical challenges, professional growth, or a healthy work-life balance, you'll find an environment where you can make a real impact while remaining yourself.
Welcome to HMS!

Bli en del av HiQ Mälardalen – utmanande uppdrag och tydlig utveckling!
 Skicka ansökan
Vill du arbeta med industriell digitalisering och uppkopplad produktion?
Hos HiQ i Mälardalen får du arbeta i tekniskt avancerade uppdrag där automation, mjukvara och produktion möts på riktigt. Våra uppdrag handlar om att skapa moderna lösningar för uppkopplad industri – där data från produktionens tillverkningslinjer samlas in, visualiseras och används för att fatta bättre beslut.
Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan automation, IT och verksamhet, där målet är att skapa mer effektiva, transparenta och datadrivna produktionsmiljöer.
En central del i flera av våra uppdrag är utveckling i Ignition, en modern plattform för SCADA, MES och industriella applikationer. Du behöver inte ha arbetat med Ignition tidigare – men erfarenhet från liknande plattformar är meriterande.
Vad du kommer arbeta med
I rollen arbetar du nära produktion, användare och tekniska system för att utveckla lösningar som förbättrar hur data används i verksamheten.
Du arbetar exempelvis med:
Utveckling och konfigurering av lösningar i SCADA- och MES-system
Visualisering av produktionsdata och operatörsgränssnitt
Datainsamling från produktionsutrustning och tillverkningslinjer
Integration mellan styrsystem, produktionsutrustning och överordnade system
Analys och uppföljning av produktion för att skapa bättre beslutsstöd

Industriella kommunikationsprotokoll som OPC UA, MQTT och Modbus

har en bakgrund som automationsingenjör, systemingenjör eller liknande
har minst 4 års erfarenhet inom industriell automation eller produktionsnära system
har arbetat med system kopplade till tillverkningslinjer eller producerande verksamhet

tycker om att förstå verksamheten och omvandla behov till tekniska lösningar

VARFÖR JOBBA PÅ HIQ?
Utvecklande och inspirerande uppdrag
Vill du jobba med kunder som är ute efter techlösningar som förenklar vardagen och formar vår framtid? På HiQ förenas riktigt duktiga konsulter med målinriktade kunder. I din roll kommer du att samarbeta med fantastiska människor från en rad branscher. Visst kommer det vara dagar av vardaglig konsultverksamhet. Men det kommer också vara magiska stunder där nya möjligheter öppnas upp med kunder som är ivriga att leda utvecklingen inom sin bransch.
Personlig och professionell utveckling 
Vi vet att även de bästa konsulterna behöver utmanande projekt och ständig utbildning för att behålla sin spetskompetens. På HiQ är din utveckling en viktig del av vår framgång. Marknaden förändras hela tiden, och därför investerar vi i intern utveckling genom kompetensgrupper där konsulter lär sig av varandra. Vi uppmuntrar till kurser, certifieringar och att man är med på våra interna föreläsningar för att stärka din roll som konsult hos oss.
Nära ledarskap
Som konsult hos oss är du aldrig ensam. Våra engagerade konsultchefer stöttar dig och matchar din profil med rätt uppdrag, alltid med fokus på din utveckling. Vi vill att HiQ ska kännas som hemma, oavsett var du är placerad. Du är en del av ett konsultteam inom ditt expertområde och har regelbunden kontakt med kollegor och chefer för stöd och som bollplank under din konsultresa.
Bra lön och förmånspaket
Vi förstår att det finns mycket att överväga när man väljer ett konsultbolag. Uppdrag, kollegor och utvecklingsmöjligheter är viktiga, men det är även ersättning och välmående. Därför ser vi regelbundet över vårt förmånspaket för att säkerställa att de bästa konsulterna väljer HiQ. Hos oss har du fast lön, övertidsersättning och flexibla arbetstider. Vi erbjuder också tjänstepension, föräldralön, hälsoersättning och tillgång till ett brett utbud av försäkringar och hälsovårdstjänster.
Unik kultur och gemenskap
När man väljer jobb är kulturen på arbetsplatsen viktig för att man ska trivas och kunna utvecklas. En bra kultur skapar gemenskap och gör att man känner sig motiverad och sedd. På HiQ är kulturen något alldeles speciellt – här möts en brokig skara tech-experter i gemenskapen om att alla är välkomna precis som dom är. På HiQ bejakar vi våra intressen, både professionellt och vid sidan av - alltid med målet att utvecklas och ha roligt på vägen.
Ett starkt varumärke
Med 30 års historia av att leverera banbrytande lösningar i alla branscher har HiQ utvecklat ett starkt, omtyckt och välkänt varumärke. Varumärket utgörs av de 2000 fantastiska medarbetarna som tillsammans skapat bolaget de alltid velat jobba på. En unik, inkluderande kultur och stora möjligheter till utveckling har i sin tur bidragit till HiQ's starka arbetsgivarvarumärke.

G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We are the reliable partner for all challenges resulting from the Internet of Things. We offer a complete connectivity portfolio for mobile network operators, automotive manufacturers, technology companies such as chip and module manufacturers as well as transport and logistics providers. Our portfolio includes highly secure solutions in the area of connectivity & IoT, from classic SIM, eSIM and iSIM, to the associated embedded operating systems and life cycle management, through to services for global connectivity and IoT solutions. Do you want to actively shape the digital transformation with us?
Job Summary:
 G+D Mobile Security is seeking a Data Engineer with the ability to work in a fast, dynamic, and technical environment with strong attention to detail. The Data Engineer’s job is a technical job to manage day-to-day profile generation in the Mobile Security (MS) data center. This includes supervise, support and follow-up on issues related to daily business around data generation; mange service requests, changes, incident and problem resolutions; and facilitation of second line support as needed.The Data Engineer’s main responsibilities are to provide the adequate data in the right formats to corresponding G+D stakeholders and ensure accurate execution of the data generation processes.On a daily basis, the Data Engineer will utilize the Identity Service Platform (IDSP) application developed in house for profile generation and monitoring orders status for telecom clients and Mobile Network Operator (MNO) clients. Additionally the Data Engineer may be expected to manage production data translation and send to client via EDI\GenTran\Systline system. 
Qualifications:
Education and Experience
University degree in Computer Science, IT or related technical/engineering field and 2+ years of experience in similar position (or equivalent combination of education and experience) 
Technical experience in data generation or similar experience
Experience in MS Office programs
Knowledge of database systems, such as MS SQL Server, preferably Oracle
Firsthand experience in Splunk, with knowledge of Splunk query language is an asset.
Experience in Docker with hands on knowledge of creating, updating and scaling docker and microservices applications is an asset.
Experience in Kubernetes clusters at Enterprise level is an asset.
Experience with Infor SyteLine EDI ERP system and GENTRAN translator is an asset
Experience in incident and problem resolution as well as changes is preferred
Experience in installation, configuration, troubleshooting and integration of software solutions is preferred
Preferably Telecommunications industry experience
Preferably experience with working across diverse cultures
Preferably some experience with file transfer systems like SFTP\MFT
Preferably experience in working with automation/scripting related to software application.
Knowledge Skills and Abilities
Knowledge in usage of system software for data generation
Knowledge of relevant market technologies in secure environments is preferable
Service specific knowledge related to telecommunication and OEM solutions is preferable
Knowledge of ITIL processes and Service Management preferable
Ability to work under pressure and flexible to changes
Highly organized and quality conscious
Analytical thinking and problem-solving mentality
Being an excellent team player
Drive for self-learning and improvement
Ability to follow given processes, procedures and work instructions
Fluent written and spoken English
Ability to work flexible hours and occasional weekends to support business needs.
Minimum 3 days per week in the office with ability to extend to 5 days as business requires
Essential Functions:
Accurate execution of the data generation processes
Provide data in the right formats to the corresponding G+D stakeholders
Utilize G+D software to generate, process, manage and transfer data for release sample and personalization.
Follow Mobile Security global policies, procedures and tools
Take accountability and responsibility towards assigned process roles
Project engagement
Time objective: Spend of budgeted time on planned tasks plus timely and accurate time reporting
First level support and troubleshooting of issues related to the daily business in data generation
Coordinate activities between customers and internal resolver groups as well as external parties.
Resolve incidents with support from Profile Engineers and Application Engineers
Documentation (project specific and internal) of end-to-end solution
Support Profile Generation Manager with information to be used in capacity planning.
Meet SLA targets and profile generation KPIs
Use Splunk dashboards to track orders and troubleshooting on daily bases.
Identify and address day to day continuous improvement activities towards Regional Service Quality Manager and/or supervisor for further action, related to tools, procedures and compliance fulfilment
Other potential duties
Utilize Infor SyteLine EDI interface with Sterling's GENTRAN translator to send and receive EDI communication, including PO Acknowledgments, EDI advance shipment notices, requesting IF via EDI.
Translate client response data generated by profile generation tools to Infor Syteline EDI messages and sending to ERP (SAP) system.
Trouble shooting EDI Inbound and outbound transmission Errors
 Compensation: The salary range for this position is CAD $75,000 to $95,000 annually and is eligible for an annual bonus of up to 2.5% of base salary, based on company performance.Ontario Employment Standards Act Disclosures: Artificial intelligence (AI) may be used to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position.  Identity Security Developer 
ID North offers products and services in the entire field of identity security (IAM, IGA, PAM), which is a central part of IT security. We are the leading company in Sweden and intend to further distance ourselves from the competition. We are on an exciting growth journey, which is why we are now looking for more solution developers who want to join our team and develop tomorrow’s identity security solutions for our customers.
Your mission
As a Developer, you will implement advanced solutions based on the customer’s needs and requirements, such as secure login, integration for automatic account creation, and management of administrator rights. The assignments are technically exciting and challenging, and those who are passionate about developing technical breadth are in the right place. Working together in a project team with a project manager, solution architect, and solution developer, you will be involved in delivering top-notch identity security solutions within Project Delivery and/or Service Delivery Organization!
In your role, you will need to:
Have an interest in configuring technically broad solutions in complex environments using market-leading products tailored to the customer’s needs.
Be able to integrate systems for secure login and information flows for identities, accounts, and permissions.
Work with customers and help them understand the solution being built.
It is a merit to have worked with IAM, IGA, and/or PAM solutions.
Knowledge of Active Directory/LDAP, Web Services, and standards such as SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SCIM is advantageous.
It is also a merit to have knowledge and experience with Linux and Windows environments, MySQL and MSSQL databases, Java and Tomcat, Apache httpd, certificate management/SSL/TLS/PKI.
Version control and release management with tools like Subversion or Git, as well as Ant or Maven, are advantageous.
Experience with identity security products from SailPoint, MicroFocus/Opentext, Okta, Nexus, CyberArk, Microsoft is a plus.
There may be business trips in the role. We have offices in Stockholm, Borås, Gothenburg, and Helsinki, so your location can be flexible based on your needs.
Your competence
We are looking for someone with an IT technical background. Experience and knowledge in identity security are highly valued but not a requirement. We prefer if you have worked in teams/projects with customers and are unafraid to take on new technical challenges. Understanding of information flows, system integration, and basic programming skills are advantageous. You can communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
Your qualities
You enjoy working in teams with colleagues and customers, and you like to develop advanced technical solutions that require a broad technical understanding. We prefer that you are solution-oriented and interested in learning how to implement solutions with new products. We value your personal qualities and are looking for someone who is attentive, has good social skills, and is easy to collaborate with others.
We offer
A strong and pleasant company at the forefront of our field, where our expertise and experience give us a competitive position. We offer development opportunities, and you will be surrounded by specialists! At ID North, you have good employment benefits, and you will become a key person for us. We enjoy each other’s company and take the opportunity to go on trips, adventures, and have fun on our journey to the top.
Does this sound like a position for you? We have an immediate need, so you should not hesitate to apply via Easy Apply or send your application to Chief Human Resources Officer Linda Öhlin at linda.ohlin@id-north.com.
