Shipping and Receiving Clerk
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
At Payment Technology, our mission is to be at the start of every transaction and to make it secure and simple. We also create contemporary payment and banking solutions for our digital age. As a one-stop shop, we produce and personalise hundreds of millions of payment cards every year and store their "digital twins" - mobile and digital. Would you like to actively shape the digital transformation with us?
JOB SUMMARY 
 The Shipping and Receiving Clerk will be responsible for coordinating overall shipping and receiving duties for an assigned location. 
DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 
Conduct shipping/receiving for shipping, including picking product, labeling, packaging product, and facilitating scheduling shipment using the routing guidelines
Load and unload trucks, vans or other transportation vehicles with boxes or materials
Ensure compliance with customer specific requirements, including product identification, packaging, carriers, routing and billing requirements
Ensure the appropriate work environment organization, housekeeping and cleanliness
Maintain inventory management and assist with physical inventory
Perform related job duties as assigned
OTHER FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
 This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with applicable Federal and State laws. All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees. 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
High School diploma or equivalent is required
Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in shipping/receiving in a manufacturing or distribution environment
Prior experience with forklift, issuing material, sheet destruction and vault issuance of materials
Strong oral and written communication skills
Positive attitude and teamwork mentality
Understanding and willingness to follow safety and quality control procedures
Willingness to work at least 40 hours per week plus occasional overtime as needed
Reliable transportation to and from work
Strong planning, organizational and counting skills along with flexibility and the ability to make decisions
Willingness to take part in our background check and drug test process
Ability to lift up to 50 pound boxes 
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT 
Requires sitting at a desk in front of a computer screen for 8 or more hours per day
Requires visual acuity to operate a computer, read a computer screen, read policies and manuals
Requires manual dexterity to operate a computer, phone, fax, scanner 
 Pay ranges from $18–$20/hour, based on the role, level, and shift. This position offers annual bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, paid time off and holidays, 401(k) with match, disability and life insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits, education assistance, pet insurance, legal services, and more.

Cloud DevOps Engineer
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
At Payment Technology, our mission is to be at the start of every transaction and to make it secure and simple. We also create contemporary payment and banking solutions for our digital age. As a one-stop shop, we produce and personalise hundreds of millions of payment cards every year and store their "digital twins" - mobile and digital. Would you like to actively shape the digital transformation with us?
Together with the Business Cloud Services (BCS) team, the Cloud DevOps Engineer will design, automate, and operate our enterprise-grade cloud platform on Microsoft Azure. Operating within an international Scrum setup across multiple countries, you will play a key role in driving an automation-first culture using modular Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. You will collaborate closely with Cloud Architects and Engineering teams to deliver secure, highly available, and scalable workloads for mission-critical services worldwide.
Key Responsibilities
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Standardization: Design, build, and maintain production-grade, reusable Terraform modules to automate the entire lifecycle of Azure core infrastructure, enforcing architectural standards and operational best practices.
CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Maintain scalable, multi-stage Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for automated infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, quality gates, and automated security/compliance scanning.
Azure & Private Networking Integration: Deploy and manage secure Azure solutions (such as Azure App Services, Event Hubs, Azure Virtual Desktop, Databricks, and AKS), ensuring seamless integration with central Hub-and-Spoke network topologies, Private Endpoints, User-Defined Routes (UDRs), and Azure Key Vault.
Containerization & DevOps Practices: Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized workloads, including container image management, private registries, deployment pipelines, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational best practices. Knowledge of Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, or GitOps methodologies is a nice to have.
Code Quality & Security Guardrails: Conduct rigorous peer code reviews for Terraform modules and pipeline definitions. Embed security guardrails into CI/CD workflows, ensuring proper secret management and adherence to enterprise compliance standards.
Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Work closely with Cloud Architects, Developers, and Operations teams to resolve technical escalations, refine runbooks, optimize cloud cost efficiency, and drive platform reliability (SRE principles).
Required Skills
Excellent communication skills in English (Spanish would be a plus).
5+ years relevant experience.
Experience & Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field with 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Cloud DevOps / Platform Engineer operating production environments in Azure.
Advanced Terraform Mastery: Extensive experience developing, structuring, and maintaining modular Terraform code for complex enterprise Azure environments.
Azure DevOps Expertise: Deep experience designing multi-stage YAML pipelines, reusable pipeline templates, deployment strategies, environment gates, and integration with Azure Key Vault and Managed Identities.
Azure Enterprise Platform Knowledge: Solid understanding of Azure PaaS services, Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC governance, and private networking concepts (Hub-and-Spoke, Private Endpoints, NSGs).
Communication & Agile: Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, with experience collaborating effectively in distributed international Scrum teams.
Self-Starter Mentality: We are looking for someone who does not simply execute tasks, but actively identifies problems, proposes solutions, and drives improvements. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions when required, and taking ownership of both successes and failures while collaborating effectively with the wider team.
Nice to Have / Preferred
Relevant Microsoft certifications: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) or Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
Knowledge of security and compliance standards relevant to financial services or regulated environments (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC2).
Familiarity with Spanish is a plus.
What We Offer
Culture and Diversity: Join a people oriented environment with different nationalities and a great team spirit, flat hierarchies (everyone speaks to everyone). Equal Opportunity Employer and LGBT+ friendly.
Global Collaboration: Enjoy collaborative work in Agile/SCRUM teams and with stakeholders around the globe.
Open working space with Best-in-class equipment: High-performance PC with huge monitors.
Innovative Products: Design and develop business processes and IT solutions for innovative products and digital solutions.
Career Development: Continuous training and coaching, talent program.
Social Benefits: flexible compensation (transport tickets, childcare vouchers, training, private insurance) and in-house parking.
Flexible work time and remote work: M-Th 8.30 – 17.30 and Fri 8.30 – 15.30, hybrid model.
Own Canteen: Take a break with our breakfast and lunch service: Choose between a big range of menus, salad desk and sandwich service. Fruit packages.
Location: El Prat de Llobregat. Easy communication by public transport (Bus 88 and 110, Metro L10 Riu Vell from Barcelona, PR4 from El Prat) o private transport.

At IMPACT, we consider our interns our new stars. Therefore, we offer you the opportunity for a versatile internship, providing you the chance to use your academic learnings in a professional setting, developing an important set of hard and soft skills.
We're looking for a recent graduate to join our People & Culture team as an HR Intern at IMPACT Commerce Portugal. You'll get exposure to the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment to onboarding, HR administration, and culture initiatives, with real ownership of tasks and projects from early on, and a structured 6-month plan to guide your development.

Support end-to-end recruitment when needed: drafting and posting job ads, screening CVs, search and scheduling;
Support onboarding of new hires in Portugal (when applicable) and collaborate on shared onboarding practices;
Assist with HR administration: documentation and HR systems/tools;
Contribute to employee engagement and internal culture initiatives in the Portuguese unit;
Help produce HR reporting;
Collaborate cross-country and cross-culturally on shared People & Culture projects;
Lead a small independent improvement project during the internship.

A recent graduate in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Organizational Behavior, or a related field;
Fluent in English; 
Based in Évora;
Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and working autonomously;

A clear communicator with strong attention to detail and discretion when handling confidential information;

About this role
IST utvecklar digitala lösningar för framtidens lärande. Vi förenar teknik och innovation med vår erfarenhet från utbildningssektorn och hjälper skolor och kommuner att skapa bättre förutsättningar för elever, lärare och ledare. Våra lösningar förenklar administrationen, stärker verksamheterna och frigör tid för det viktigaste: lärandet!
Vill du hjälpa skolan att ta nästa digitala steg?
Som konsult är du en nyckelperson för våra kunder. Genom rådgivning, utbildning, implementation och support hjälper du dem att få ut full nytta av våra lösningar, att utveckla verksamheten och att arbeta smartare under den digitala omställningen i skolan.
AI och smarta verktyg blir en allt större del av skolans vardag. Hos oss får du ligga i framkant och hjälpa kunderna att använda den nya tekniken på ett sätt som gör skillnad redan idag.
Din roll
Du arbetar i ett konsultteam nära våra kunder och är länken mellan dem och IST. Med starkt kundfokus och förståelse för verksamhetens behov hjälper du kunderna att utveckla arbetssätt, effektivisera processer och använda våra system fullt ut.
Rollen är både operativ och strategisk. Du bidrar med expertkunskap, leder utbildningar och implementeringsprojekt och stöttar kunderna i deras digitala utveckling. En allt viktigare del är att hjälpa dem förstå och dra nytta av AI-baserade verktyg och nya arbetssätt.
Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsomården 
I rollen kommer du bland annat att: 
Planera och genomföra onboarding- och implementeringsprojekt. 
Leverera utbildningar, administrationstjänster och konsultinsatser till kunder. 
Stötta kunder i tekniska och funktionella frågor på ett professionellt och lösningsorienterat sätt. 
Skapa, utveckla och underhålla utbildningsmaterial och dokumentation. 
Bygga långsiktiga och förtroendefulla kundrelationer. 
Identifiera förbättringsområden och möjligheter att utveckla kundernas användning av våra lösningar. 
Bidra med kundinsikter till produktutvecklingen. 
Identifiera och driva merförsäljningsmöjligheter av tjänster och moduler. 
Främja användningen av AI-baserade verktyg och vägleda kunder i deras digitala utvecklingsresa. 
Säkerställa leverans enligt interna processer, SLA:er och tidrapportering.  
Din profil 
För att trivas i rollen är du kommunikativ, relationsskapande och drivs av att hjälpa kunder att nå sina mål. Du har ett konsultativt förhållningssätt, är lösningsorienterad och tar gärna eget ansvar.
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:  
Akademisk examen i systemvetenskap eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig. 
Erfarenhet av konsultarbete, kundsupport eller tjänsteleverans. 
God kännedom kring olika typer av integrationslösningar, gärna inom utbildningssektorn. 
Erfarenhet av SaaS-lösningar och digitala system. 
God förmåga att förstå kunders behov och omsätta dem till praktiska lösningar. 
Erfarenhet av utbildning, förändringsledning eller implementeringsarbete är meriterande. 
Erfarenhet av IST:s produkter eller liknande system är meriterande. 
Ett intresse för digitalisering, AI och hur ny teknik kan skapa värde i verksamheter. 
 Erfarenhet från skola, kommunal verksamhet, administration eller liknande verksamhetsområden är meriterande.  
Kunskap i SQL, XML samt filintegrationer till ekonomisystem är meriterande. 
Om IST 
IST är ett av de ledande EdTech-företagen inom digitala lösningar för utbildning. Vår mission är att skapa smarta verktyg som förenklar vardagen, effektiviserar arbetet och stärker lärandet för elever, lärare, skolledare och vårdnadshavare. 
Hos oss blir du en del av ett innovativt och engagerat bolag där våra användare står i centrum för allt vi gör. Vi utvecklar lösningar som används varje dag av skolor och kommuner, och som gör verklig skillnad i människors vardag. Samtidigt får du stora möjligheter att påverka både din egen utveckling och våra kunders framgång i en kultur präglad av samarbete, kundfokus och nytänkande. 
Vill du vara med och skapa bättre förutsättningar för framtidens lärande? Då är IST rätt plats för dig. 
Detta är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering i Stockholm eller Växjö.  
På IST tillämpar vi en Office- First policy, eftersom vi tror att fysisk närvaro främjar samarbete, innovation och en stark teamkänsla. Samtidigt värdesätter vi flexibilitet och för dig som bor längre från kontoret kan en hybridlösning med tre dagar i veckan på plats vara möjlig. 
I Skandinavien finns våra kontor i Växjö, Stockholm, Roskilde och Oslo. 
Din ansökan  
Låter detta som nästa steg i din karriär? 
Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan via vårt rekryteringssystem. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att söka. 
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Jenny Jidkvist, jenny.jidkvist@ist.com eller HR på hr@ist.com.  
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

MARKETING | IMPACT COMMERCE
ABOUT THE JOB
Great content earns attention. The best content earns influence.
At IMPACT Commerce, we believe great content should do more than generate attention. To us, content makes complex ideas matter, gives expertise a distinct voice, and strengthens our position in the market conversations about the next era of commerce. Ultimately, creating IMPACT for our audience, our clients, and our business.
And that takes more than great writing. This is where you come in.
We are looking for an experienced Content & Campaign Lead who can turn marketing strategy, specialist expertise and commercial priorities into compelling stories, thought leadership and campaigns that not only capture attention, but sparks conversations, drive action and earns influence.
In this role, you will have both access and influence. Access to clients, senior leaders and some of Europe’s leading digital commerce specialists. And influence over what we talk about, how we talk about it and how those ideas travel across channels and markets.
Content creation will be at the heart of your role, and exceptional writing is a given. But just as important is your editorial instinct: your ability to spot the story, angle or perspective worth pursuing before it ever becomes a finished brief. In other words, your job is to find the ones worth telling. Our audience includes senior decisionmakers across digital, commerce, marketing and technology, so understanding their world, and knowing how to turn complex expertise into something relevant, sharp and worth their time and attention, is key.
But finding the story is only the beginning. Strong content creates more value when it is activated effectively. You will therefore play an important role in translating our marketing and go-to-market priorities into campaigns that generate awareness, engagement, and demand.
More specifically, you will:
Own stories from first idea to final activation, spotting relevant topics and perspectives, interviewing clients and experts, and turning their knowledge into thought leadership, articles, customer cases, and other editorial content.
Turn commercial priorities into campaigns, developing concepts, messaging and content that connect our go-to-market agenda with the audiences we want to reach.
Bring content to life across channels. Make ideas travel from website, email and LinkedIn to paid social, video, landing pages and sales enablement, adapting the story without losing the idea behind it.
Create content that supports demand, developing lead-generating content, journeys and campaign assets that move audiences from interest towards action.
Get close to the business, working directly with clients, Sales, senior leaders and subject-matter experts to uncover insights, challenge perspectives, find the stories others might miss, understand our audiences and ensure what we create is commercially relevant.
Shape IMPACT’s editorial voice, strengthening how we show up across markets and contributing to our new website, Omnichannel Index 2028 and broader thought leadership agenda.
Keep raising the bar. Learn what works and make it better, using performance, audience insights and learnings to continuously sharpen both our content and how we activate it.
You will report to our Senior Marketing Manager and become part of a Nordic Marketing team working closely with IMPACT’s commercial organisation across markets.
YOUR PROFILE
You know a good story when you see one, and how to find one when it is not immediately obvious.
You are an exceptional writer with the curiosity to dig beneath the surface, ask the right questions, and make complex topics feel clear, relevant, and worth reading. But you also think beyond the words themselves. You understand who you are trying to reach, what matters to your audience, and what you want them to think, feel, or do next.
Just as important as the quality of writing is the ability to make things happen. Thus, you are equally comfortable creating as you are driving. In other words, you take ownership, bring structure to ideas, and move forward without waiting for a perfectly packaged brief. You know when to challenge an angle, when to sharpen it, and when to get it out into the world.
Additionally, imagine that you:
Have 2–3 years of experience in content, campaigns or B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows the quality of your thinking as well as your writing.
Have a proven ability to create high-quality long-form content, from thought leadership and articles to customer cases and commercially focused content.
Write exceptional English and communicate confidently with clients, specialists and senior stakeholders.
Understand B2B marketing and customer journeys, and how content and campaigns can support commercial objectives, create demand and move audiences towards action.
Know the world we operate in, with relevant experience or insight from e-commerce, omnichannel, retail and/or brands, and a genuine curiosity about the technologies, trends and commercial challenges shaping it.
Can take a content or campaign project from first idea to final execution, bringing the right people with you across Sales, clients and subject-matter experts.
Are proactive and structured, with the judgement to challenge a brief rather than simply execute it when you see a stronger way forward.
Use AI as a natural part of how you work – whether for research, ideation, content development or finding smarter ways to get things done.
Experience from digital commerce, retail, brands, technology or consultancy will be highly relevant. Experience with PR and media relations, HubSpot or Webflow is a plus, but not a prerequisite.
LIFE AT IMPACT
Commerce has never stood still. Neither have we. For more than 25 years, we have helped ambitious businesses turn change into growth by taking the time to understand what truly moves their business. What started in Aarhus, Denmark has grown into a European powerhouse with offices across the world.
From strategy and experience to technology, data, and execution, every capability sits under one roof. That’s how we move faster, align better, and build solutions that hold over time. We work close by. We think long-term. And we take responsibility for bringing technology, strategy, and execution together - helping brands grow with clarity and confidence in the next era of commerce.

 Strategy & Growth | IMPACT AARHUS
The consultants who win pitches five years from now won't just know CRM, Martech and loyalty. They will be running an AI exo-skeleton or AI as a second brain around it. Do you want to help build that, from the inside, while you're still studying?
ABOUT THE JOB
As an Agentic Marketing Assistant, you will join the Strategy & Growth department, reporting to our Senior Manager, Customer Loyalty. This is not a traditional student assistant role. We are looking for what we call a "next-gen consultant", someone who treats AI not as a tool bolted onto the work, but as part of how the work gets done such as flows built in N8N, Claude used as a genuine thinking partner, prompts engineered rather than typed once and forgotten. However, you are not expected to arrive as an expert. What matters is curiosity, a genuine appetite for making AI part of how you work, and a willingness to explore how it can strengthen both your own consultancy and the value we create with our clients.
You will work across two connected worlds: learn how to establish a craft of loyalty concepts and design, personalisation tactics, CRM strategy and Martech advisory alongside the emerging discipline of agentic marketing, where CRM segmentation, lifecycle automation and personalization are increasingly run by autonomous agent workflows under human oversight. Your daily assignments will span:
Core CRM, loyalty & martech
Hands-on support on building brand loyalty in whatever form fits the client such as customer clubs, personalisation tactics, sign-up mechanics, value exchange models and beyond
Customer journey mappings & 1:1 channel flow schematics
Data collection, segmentation support and insight-gathering across CRM and CDP platforms
Supporting workshops, client presentations and market research
Agentic marketing, the new layer
Helping map current CRM, CDP and lifecycle workflows to spot manual handoffs and bottlenecks worth automating.
Assisting in structuring customer data, segmentation logic and lifecycle rules so marketing automation platforms can act on them with less manual intervention.
Supporting the drafting of instructions, guardrails and escalation logic for CRM and automation agent setups (think: an agent that adjusts send times, content or offers within rules a human has set).
Helping track and report on agent output such as flagging anomalies, quality drift or anything that needs a human to step in.
Bringing a fresh, structured perspective as our consultants build human-in-the-loop governance models for AI driven CRM and lifecycle journeys.
The position is 15 hours a week with the possibility of more. You will get a genuine mix of hands-on craft and exposure to where the industry is going next, with a large degree of freedom under responsibility, and real sparring from experienced consultants along the way.
YOUR PROFILE
You have some degree of experience within Martech, Marketing, Data or a related field, from a prior student job or from your current education. You are someone who reads about a new AI marketing tool, builds your own agentic workflows and wants to understand how it actually gets implemented, not just what it promises.
Additionally, we expect you to
Be a student pursuing a degree in IT & Kommunikation (ITKO), Datalogi/Data Science, Digital Konceptudvikling, Business Intelligence, HA(it.)/cand.merc.(it.), or a related field where tech and communication meet.
Be genuinely curious about customer experience, CRM, Martech, loyalty and how AI is reshaping how brands operate with an eagerness to learn the mechanics behind it, not just the buzzwords.
Have excellent English written and verbal communication skills.
Be comfortable moving between a workflow diagram and concepting initiatives with an equally interest in the logic behind a system and the idea that makes a customer feel valued Have some familiarity with analytical tools (GA4, etc.) - appreciated, not required.
Have interest or hands on experience with N8N, Make, prompt engineering or similar a valuable asset.
Be comfortable with ambiguity, agentic marketing is a moving target, and we are figuring parts of it out together with our clients.
LIFE AT IMPACT
Commerce has never stood still. Neither have we. For more than 25 years, we have helped ambitious businesses turn change into growth by taking the time to understand what truly moves their business. What started in Aarhus, Denmark has grown into a European powerhouse with offices across the world.
From strategy and experience to technology, data, and execution, every capability sits under one roof. That’s how we move faster, align better, and build solutions that hold over time. We work close by. We think long-term. And we take responsibility for bringing technology, strategy, and execution together - helping brands grow with clarity and confidence in the next era of commerce.
IMPACT is built by specialists who care deeply about what they do, and take responsibility for what they deliver. Wherever commerce happens, we show up with the same standards, the same accountability, and the same ambition. Because consistency is what builds trust, across borders and over time.
CONTACT
Send your CV via the link below. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis, as the position is to be filled as soon as possible.
We are looking forward to hearing from you!

About this role
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens digitala lösningar för utbildning? 
På IST utvecklar vi mer än digitala lösningar. Vi skapar förutsättningar för bättre lärande. Med över fem miljoner användare och kontor runt om i Europa är vi stolta över att vara ett av Nordens ledande EdTech-bolag. Våra lösningar hjälper skolor, kommuner, lärare, elever och vårdnadshavare att fokusera mer på lärande och mindre på administration.  
Nu söker vi en Produktägare som vill vara med och forma framtidens utbildningslösningar och samtidigt bidra till vår resa där AI blir en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar produkter, fattar beslut och arbetar tillsammans. 
Om IST 
Vi är det ledande EdTech-bolaget i Skandinavien med över fem miljoner användare. Varje dag arbetar vi med lösningar som påverkar samhället positivt genom att hjälpa lärare, elever och vårdnadshavare att fokusera mer på lärande och mindre på administration. Vi kombinerar djup teknisk expertis med verklig erfarenhet från skolvärlden för att skapa verktyg som verkligen gör skillnad. 
Om rollen 
Som Produktägare på IST har du en central roll i att omsätta produktvision och strategi till konkreta lösningar som skapar värde för våra användare. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, UX-designers, produktchefer och andra intressenter för att säkerställa att rätt funktionalitet utvecklas vid rätt tidpunkt. 
Du ansvarar för att bryta ner affärsbehov till tydliga krav, user stories och acceptanskriterier samt för att prioritera teamets backlog utifrån produktvision, roadmap och kundvärde. Du är utvecklingsteamets främsta kontaktpunkt i krav- och prioriteringsfrågor och skapar tydlighet genom hela utvecklingsprocessen. 
Vi befinner oss samtidigt på en spännande utvecklingsresa där AI blir en allt viktigare del av vårt arbetssätt. Som Produktägare förväntas du vara nyfiken på nya verktyg och aktivt utforska hur AI kan bidra till bättre analyser, effektivare arbetsflöden, snabbare beslutsfattande och ännu större kundvärde 
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter 
Bryta ner teman och initiativ till epics, user stories och tydliga acceptanskriterier. 
Säkerställa att utvecklingsteamet har väl definierade, prioriterade och utvecklingsbara krav. 
Äga, prioritera och underhålla produktens backlog. 
Vara utvecklingsteamets främsta kontaktperson för kravförtydliganden och prioriteringar. 
Säkerställa att leveranser stödjer produktvision, roadmap och affärsmål. 
Delta i release- och förvaltningsarbete tillsammans med relevanta intressenter. 
Samarbeta nära kunder, användare och interna intressenter för att förstå behov och skapa värde. 
Bidra till utvecklingen av nya arbetssätt där AI och modern teknik används för att stärka produktutvecklingen. 
Om dig 
Vi söker dig som har ett starkt driv, god struktur och förmåga att skapa tydlighet i komplexa sammanhang. Du trivs i samarbetet mellan verksamhet och utveckling och motiveras av att omsätta behov till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för användarna. 
För att lyckas i rollen:  
Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, mjukvaruutveckling, informatik, industriell ekonomi eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. 
Erfarenhet av kravanalys, verksamhetsanalys, systemanalys eller produktutveckling inom IT. 
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila utvecklingsmiljöer. 
God förståelse för mjukvaruutveckling och digitala produkter. 
Förmåga att prioritera, fatta beslut och skapa fokus kring det som skapar störst värde. 
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska. 
Ett stort eget ansvarstagande och förmåga att driva arbete framåt. 
Ett starkt intresse för AI och ny teknik. 
Nyfikenhet kring hur AI-verktyg kan användas för att effektivisera analys, kravhantering, dokumentation och beslutsfattande. 
Vilja att bidra till IST:s fortsatta utveckling där AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar och skapar värde för våra kunder. 
Det är meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som Produktägare, Business Analyst, Kravanalytiker eller i en liknande roll. 
Ansök 
Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering på vårt huvudkontor i Växjö. På IST tillämpar vi en office-first-policy, vilket innebär att vi i första hand arbetar från kontoret eftersom vi tror att fysisk närvaro främjar samarbete, innovation och en stark teamkänsla. Samtidigt värdesätter vi flexibilitet. För dig som har längre pendlingsavstånd kan det finnas möjlighet att arbeta från kontoret tre dagar i veckan och på distans resterande tid. 
Låter detta som rätt utmaning för dig? Skicka då in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då vi arbetar med löpande urval. 
För mer information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta Olof Bergvall, olof.bergvall@ist.com. Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta HR, via HR@ist.com. 
Bakgrundskontroll kan komma att genomföras som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. 
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

 I’m proud of what we do:
Cutting-edge technology for secure payment and connectivity.
Client Service Representative I
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
At Payment Technology, our mission is to be at the start of every transaction and to make it secure and simple. We also create contemporary payment and banking solutions for our digital age. As a one-stop shop, we produce and personalise hundreds of millions of payment cards every year and store their "digital twins" - mobile and digital. Would you like to actively shape the digital transformation with us?
JOB SUMMARY
 The Client Service Representative will ensure client orders and requests and handled in a satisfactory manner according to client specifications. Will interact daily with clients via phone and email to review new orders, existing orders, order changes, and overall order specs. May also participate in face-to-face client meetings to review orders and client needs related to G+D’s products and services.
DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Process incoming sales orders including order confirmation or follow-up when additional information is needed.
Follow departmental procedures and protocols for interpreting client needs by transforming client requests into company production orders.
Enter information into corporate data system using automated tools for accurate and efficient processing.
Process internal orders for testing, R&D, or sample production.
Use departmental procedures and system tools to notify/request material procurement, scheduling, design/data services, printing, production, shipping, billing, etc.
Work with multiple internal departments including Sales professionals, Accounting, Operations, and Production teams to ensure that corporate and business protocols are followed and met. 
Attend daily meetings with coordinating departments as instructed, providing client, order, or other department input.
Follow written Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), documented training guidelines, or workflows during daily business functions and processes.
Review system entries to meet quality input standards with attention to detail.
Self-review work product against written SOPs.
Track progress of client orders within the plant and communicate with account teams regarding any production questions, changes, or delays.
Submit changes to Prepress or Production Department if client requests changes to their ordered product (proofs) during the order or fulfillment process.
Enter data from packing slips or other lists into corporate data system when requested.
Print reports from corporate data system and distribute per department procedures and protocols.
File business documents per department procedures, protocols, and/or general business practices.
Provide general office assistance for paper handling, online documentation storage, scanning, labeling, and/or management assistance.
Participate in client conference calls and prepare client report updates, as requested.
Coordinate or request shipping services from the Shipping Department. Provide follow-up to gain tracking information for client records and/or billing.
Work with the Quality team to ensure timely responses to client complaints and appropriate resolution. Send communication back to client about the resolution.
Provide necessary back-up support during heavy work periods or absence of co-workers.
Interface with clients on their visits to the facility (e.g., press checks, tours, etc.)
Coordinate client visits with security.
Provide office reception back-up upon request. 
Perform related job duties as assigned and required.
OTHER FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with applicable Federal and State laws. All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
High School diploma required; college coursework preferred.
Client service and office support experience.
MS-Office experience including Outlook, Word and Excel. 
MS-Windows experience including file navigation, document handling, and network printing.
Experienced use of equipment such as copier, scanner, and printer
Strong attendance record or ability to work consistent schedule with prescribed breaks.
Strong communication skills including writing (email), phone and in-person. 
Proactive approach to problem-solving and meeting client expectations.
Dedication to responding to internal and external client inquiries resulting in strong response rates, while demonstrating courtesy and helpfulness.
Strong attention to detail.
Strong organization skills to balance in-process orders with incoming requests to meet desired response times.
Ability to work with minimal amount of supervision.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree
Experience in the plastic card industry
Manufacturing and/or printing industry experience.
Experience using an order entry system to enter client orders
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT
Requires visual acuity to operate a computer for up to 8 hours a day.
Requires sitting at a desk for up to 8 hours a day.
Requires speaking on the telephone and listening to people talk on the phone.
May have to occasionally lift boxes of office supplies or FedEx/UPS delivery boxes.
 The pay range for this position is $45,000-$50,000 and is eligible for an annual bonus. Benefits offered to eligible employees include, medical (PPO and HDHP with HSA), dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K w/ employer match, short/long term disability, life insurance, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending, EAP, commuter benefits, education assistance, pet insurance, legal, and more.

Idus AB är ett bolag som ständigt växer, nu söker vi en systemutvecklare till Idus utvecklingsavdelning. Här kommer du bli en del av ett trevligt och drivet team som ser fram emot tillökning och att du ska bli en del av det.

Du kommer att bli en viktig del i arbetet framåt och du kommer få introduktion och support för att du på ett så bra sätt som möjligt ska komma in i arbetsuppgifterna. Du har både enskilda uppgifter och gemensamma med andra i ditt team beroende på projektens form.
Din profil
I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår:
Systemutveckling

IGT, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale! We’ve recently leveled up—IGT Gaming and Digital have joined forces with Everi, creating a powerhouse in the world of gaming, digital experiences, and fintech solutions. From the casino floor to your mobile screen, we’re all about delivering thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or powering secure payments, we bring the fun—backed by serious tech, deep player insights, and a passion for innovation. With a team of over 7,000 and a presence in 100+ countries, we’re not just global—we’re locally legendary. Our teams work closely with regulators, governments, and partners to ensure we play by the rules while pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team that’s shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here.  For more information, please visit www.igt.com or www.everi.com
Overview
At IGT, we design and build casino games played by millions of players worldwide. We’re always open to connect with talented QA Engineers based in Serbia who are passionate about launching games that meet the highest quality standards.
This is a proactive opportunity to join our talent pipeline for future roles. While there may not be an immediate opening, selected candidates will be among the first to be considered as new opportunities arise.
What Will You Do
As a QA Engineer you will collaborate closely with Game Designers, Developers, Artists, Mathematicians, Product Owners, to spot issues before players do and to help launch games that are both bug-free and regulation-ready.
•    Manual testing slot games to ensure they meet technical, functional, regulatory and customer requirements
•    Executing both scripted and exploratory test cases
•    Reviewing documentation and test packages for compliance
•    Detecting, logging, and tracking bugs using tools such as Jira/Xray
•    Validating the correct implementation of game math and mechanics
•    Executing automation scripts to ensure consistent and efficient test coverage
What We're Looking For
•    Strong attention to detail and problem-solving mindset
•    Experience in testing games or gambling software
•    Knowledge of PC components, networking, or embedded systems
•    Basic understanding of computer hardware and troubleshooting
By Applying You Will
•    You will be contacted by a recruiter to discuss our projects, your interests, and potential opportunities to collaborate.
•    Become part of IGT’s global QA Engineer talent pipeline and be considered for future openings that match your skills and experience.
•    Proactively connected with our hiring and leadership teams.
Gain the opportunity to contribute to innovative gaming products played by millions worldwide

Quality Inspector Production
Veridos provides secure and innovative identity solutions to governments worldwide. We help ensure every citizen has access to a trusted legal identity – enabling participation in society and access to essential services. From passports and ID cards to mobile IDs and border control systems, we deliver end-to-end identity solutions tailored to national needs. Join our multicultural workforce to create innovative solutions that make a worldwide impact.
As a joint venture of Giesecke+Devrient, a global SecurityTech company and Bundesdruckerei, the German state printing service, we are always looking for talented and motivated colleagues who share our vision and want to shape the future of identities with us.
JOB SUMMARY
The Quality Inspector will assist with quality control inspection efforts for product coming off the personalization line in our secure personalization facility working 2nd shift Monday - Friday 2:00pm - 10:00pm. 
DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Assist with In-Process quality control (QC), concentrate on product coming off the lines.
Continuously audit work areas for identification of the acceptable/rejection of product within the process.
Advise production supervisors of any observed non-conformity.
Maintaining lot control traceability documentation during personalization process.
Use quality control equipment to measure quality of product coming off the lines.
Perform related job duties as required and assigned.
OTHER FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with applicable Federal and State laws. All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees. 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
High School diploma or GED required.
At least 1 year of related experience in a manufacturing setting is required.
Willingness to spend 75% of the workday standing or walking.
Requires eyesight correctable to 20/20 to visually inspect materials. Visual acuity adequate to perform job duties, including reading information from printed sources and computer screens. Requires normal color perception.
Strong verbal and written communication. Ability to keep detailed and accurate records.
Ability to focus and perform precision hand movements when operating a machine.
Must be able to lift 50 pounds regularly, able to work around machinery.
Ability to work independently with high attention to detail. Reason through problems involving set-up and operation.
Able to perform basic math calculations, including addition and subtraction of decimals. Ability to perform data entry operations with accuracy.
Ability to pass a criminal background check and drug screen prior to employment.
Willingness to work overtime as needed.
 The pay range for this position starts at $20.00 per hour and offers are made based on skill and experience is eligible for an annual bonus. Benefits offered to eligible employees include, medical (PPO and HDHP with HSA), dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K w/ employer match, short/long term disability, life insurance, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending, EAP, commuter benefits, education assistance, pet insurance, legal, and more.Don't miss the opportunity to be part of a team that continues to contribute to innovative identity solutions!

At IGT PlayDigital, we design and build mobile and web casino games played by millions of players worldwide. We’re searching for a talented Animator based in Warsaw who are passionate about gaming and ensuring seamless player experiences.
Our studio in Warsaw, Poland is at the heart of exciting projects within a dynamic and fast-growing environment. We offer flexibility, embrace diversity, and create an international workplace where innovation and collaboration thrive.
What You Will Do
As Animator, you will create dynamic 2D animations for characters, environments, and special effects, bringing games to life with engaging visual storytelling. You will collaborate closely with the art and design teams to ensure animations match the game’s style and vision, while continuously refining and polishing your work to achieve the highest quality.
-    Create high-quality 2D animations using Spine and Adobe Creative Cloud, ensuring they match the game’s style and vision.
-    Organize and optimize source files for efficiency, balancing image quality, file size, and resource use.
-    Collaborate with illustrators, developers, and the team to solve creative or technical challenges.
-    Keep work updated in the repository and track progress in the task management system.
-    Incorporate feedback, provide realistic time estimates, and attend team meetings to stay aligned with project goals.
What We're Looking For
-    Bachelor Degree in relevant field (e.g., Computer Graphics, Animation) and strong knowledge of Adobe Suite.
-    3+ years of experience as a 2D animator in Spine, with a strong creative passion for games.
-    Team player with clear communication skills, able to integrate feedback and follow guidelines.
Benefits and Culture
-    Permanent employment contract and a competitive salary.
-    Private health insurance for you and your family.
-    Flexible working hours, including a hybrid work model, along with various initiatives that support wellbeing and work-life balance.
-    Opportunity to learn and continuously improve your skills through collaboration with e-learning platforms.
-    Clear career development path with well-defined growth opportunities.
-    A vibrant and stimulating work environment within Class-A office space.

Please include a link to your portfolio featuring slot / casino artwork (casino realism, symbols, UI, key art). Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

Electromechanical Field Service Technician III
G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co-operation within G+D.
The whole world trusts us when it comes to physical or digital currencies. We increase the security and efficiency of the cash cycle in collaboration with central banks and the entire currency industry.  As the market leader in advanced currency management, would you like to join us in shaping the future of payments?
Summary
A Level III Field Service Technician will utilize their technical expertise and independent judgment to provide on-site servicing, installation, and repair of complex electromechanical equipment. This role is crucial in maintaining high customer satisfaction through data-driven tools, proactive attention to customer needs, and positive interactions. Responsibilities include supporting customers with operational or maintenance issues, addressing escalated technical and service-related concerns, diagnosing failures in mechanical, hardware, software, and systems, implementing effective repairs to minimize downtime, and preparing reports for analyzing product failure trends and serviceability issues. Additionally, this role will also assist with the on-site training and development of less experienced field service technicians and acts as a key communication link between technical support, management, and the customer on technical matters and projects. Flexibility for long hours and travel is required.
Duties/Responsibilities
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Apply company policies and procedures to complete routine tasks effectively.
Respond promptly to service calls, perform equipment maintenance at customer sites, and assist operators with operational issues.
Represent the company professionally at all times.
Handle administrative tasks, including record-keeping, reporting, and inventory management, with accuracy and timeliness.
Develop and maintain technical competence through formal training programs, on-site training, and hands-on experience.
Comply with company policies regarding confidentiality and customer procedures, including Custody and Control Procedures.
Manage parts inventory, coordinate shipments for repair and replenishment, and oversee the inventory of tools and test equipment.
Record maintenance activities using approved methods and procedures.
Follow escalation procedures to resolve issues promptly and ensure timely communication with designated company personnel and customer management.
Promote high customer satisfaction by maintaining open communication and providing proactive attention to customer needs.
Assist with the on-site training of less experienced field service technicians.
Show flexibility to travel as required to support business needs, including providing coverage for other Field Engineers during vacations or illnesses. Travel may be within the home territory or to other areas.
Perform all activities safely and adhere to company safety policies and procedures.
Complete other duties as assigned.
Required Skills/Knowledge
Hands-on experience with electromechanical equipment is preferred.
Proficiency in electromechanical troubleshooting, understanding electronic principles, and working knowledge of computer systems, PCs, and networking is required.
Experience with solenoids, belts, rollers, bearings, pneumatics, and guides is a plus.
Strong oral and written communication skills are essential.
Ability to use a laptop/tablet for administrative and diagnostic tasks.
Willingness to provide personal information and obtain Gaming Licenses in required jurisdictions (for Commercial Field Service Technicians).
Work may be home office-based or customer site-based.
Personal vehicle use may be required depending on business needs.
Potential responsibility for a company fleet vehicle may be required depending on business needs.
Shift work may be required.
Required Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED required.
An Associate degree or trade/technical school certificate/diploma preferred.
Minimum of four (4) years of relevant work experience, including at least two years in a field service environment.
Hands-on experience with electromechanical equipment is essential.
Previous experience in customer-facing roles is required.
Salary
$68,000-$75,000
Other duties

Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. Responsibilities
This role owns day-to-day leadership of our main manufacturing floor and may also carry supervisory responsibility across Sub-Assembly, Silk Screen, and SW Manufacturing areas. We're looking for a hands-on leader with a strong track record supervising teams in a high-volume, high-configurability production environment — someone who can keep a fast-moving, high-mix floor running safely, on schedule, and on quality.
Directly supervise production leads and operators on the main manufacturing floor, with oversight potentially extending to Sub-Assembly, Silk Screen, and SW Manufacturing
Drive daily schedule attainment across shifts; partner with Materials/Master Scheduling to resolve shortages or constraints threatening the line
Own staffing, shift coverage, and cross-training plans so headcount can flex with changing product mix and configuration demands
Enforce safety standards on the floor; lead incident investigation and corrective action
Monitor quality metrics (first-pass yield, scrap, rework) and partner with Quality on root-cause analysis and corrective actions
Manage team performance: coaching, one-on-ones, performance documentation (PIPs, letters of expectation), and development of leads/operators
Lead daily tier meetings/floor walks and communicate production status, risks, and blockers to Operations leadership
Drive continuous improvement and lean initiatives to increase throughput and reduce changeover time on high-mix, configurable lines
Partner with Engineering on New Product Introduction (NPI) ramps to ensure the floor is ready for new builds and configurations
Ensure the floor can absorb rapid configuration changeovers driven by build-to-order demand and high SKU variation
Manage attendance, timekeeping, and adherence to labor and workplace policies
Escalate material, equipment, or staffing constraints that put schedule attainment at risk
Qualifications
5+ years of supervisory experience in a manufacturing/production environment, preferably in a high-volume, high-configurability (build-to-order/high-mix) setting
High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
Experience with ERP/MES systems (SAP preferred) for production scheduling and tracking
Strong people-leadership skills: coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution
Lean manufacturing/continuous improvement experience (5S, Kaizen, Six Sigma) preferred
Ability to lead multiple production areas or teams simultaneously across differing processes
Strong communication skills across all levels; comfortable presenting floor metrics and status to leadership
Flexibility to support multiple shifts as production needs require
Technical background in software duplication and technical systems to perform work desired.

Var med och forma framtidens informationsarkitektur
Är du en erfaren och driven informationsarkitekt? IRM söker dig som konsultmässigt kombinerar gedigen kompetens med förmågan att se informationsstrukturer i ett större sammanhang. Är du dessutom nyfiken, vill bidra till utvecklingen av området och uppskattar att samarbeta för att skapa affärsnytta – då kan du vara den vi söker.
Om rollen
Som informationsarkitekt hos oss kommer du bland annat få möjlighet att:
arbeta som konsult i uppdrag hos våra kunder, ofta i komplexa organisationer.
modellera verksamhet och information med informationsmodeller samt verksamhetskartor.
bidra till utvecklingen av våra utbildningar, seminarier och event.
Vi tror att du
har erfarenhet av informationsmodellering och gärna verksamhetsarkitektur.
gillar att förklara och inspirera
är nyfiken, drivande och vill växa tillsammans med oss.
Om IRM
Sedan 1982 har IRM hjälpt företag och organisationer att utveckla och framtidssäkra sin verksamhet genom informations- och verksamhetsarkitektur, systemutveckling och kompetensutveckling.
Vi är ett konsultbolag med seniora specialister – från informationsarkitekter, verksamhetsarkitekter och verksamhetsutvecklare till lösningsarkitekter, utvecklare och förändringsledare. Tillsammans skapar vi struktur och överblick i komplexa it-landskap, kartlägger informationsflöden och förmågor, och gör det möjligt för våra kunder att fatta välgrundade strategiska beslut.
Vår kultur präglas av kunskapsdelning, öppenhet och engagemang. Som informationsarkitekt på IRM blir du en del av ett team som tror på att information rätt hanterad är en resurs som frigör verksamhetens fulla potential. Hos oss blir du en del av en kultur där kunskap delas, idéer prövas och där vi tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.

 Location: 
 Chicago, IL, US, 60661

IGT, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale!  From the casino floor to your mobile screen, we deliver thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences—powered by world‑class content, strong technical and commercial capabilities and nurtured by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and ownership.
Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. With a team of over 6,000 employees across 30+ countries and products delivered in more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide, we operate at scale while staying closely connected to customers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here - www.igt.com.
Overview
The IT Support Specialist II provides frontline technical support to internal customers, resolving hardware and software issues and maintaining secure, reliable employee workstations. The role supports onboarding and offboarding, manages IT assets and documentation, and collaborates with internal teams and third-party providers on support requests, infrastructure projects, and company events. It also maintains user account integrity and workstation security in accordance with internal controls and external audit requirements.
Responsibilities
Provide frontline support to internal customers, including hardware troubleshooting and maintenance.
Maintain user account integrity and workstation security standards in compliance with external audit controls, including SOX, PCI, and SOC 2, and internal company controls.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to facilitate employee onboarding and offboarding.
Use technology to image, configure, deploy, and track employee workstations across the enterprise.
Maintain the knowledge base by creating new documents, updating existing documents, and archiving outdated documents.
Analyze support request trends, identify broader problems within the environment, and escalate issues to management as needed.
Coordinate with employees and third-party providers to deliver advanced support.
Participate in an on-call rotation to assist internal customers outside regular business hours.
Manage the physical location of employee assets and IT inventory, including during major facility relocations.
Maintain local conference room configurations and provide emergency support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on information technology and infrastructure projects.
Receive and process purchase requests.
Plan, coordinate, and provide IT support for company and customer-facing events.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Qualifications
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering, or a combination of education and work experience in a related field.
2–5 years of experience in an IT support role within a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated experience supporting on-site and remote customers.
Ability to work independently and apply analytical problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical subjects to nontechnical audiences.
Ability to resolve users’ problems while demonstrating professional telephone etiquette and customer service.
Technical Skills
Advanced troubleshooting experience with Microsoft Office applications and other software.
Advanced proficiency and in-depth knowledge of computer operating systems.
Ability to absorb and apply technical knowledge.
Ability to implement knowledge and processes related to new technical developments.
Ability to understand and use the Windows command-line interface (CLI) to perform job functions.
Core Competencies and Professional Skills
Communication, analytical thinking, learning agility, service focus, collaboration and teamwork, compliance, adaptability, and accountability.
Ability to work accurately and efficiently, maintain attention to detail, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
High integrity, trustworthiness, and strict confidentiality, with a positive, respectful, and professional approach to clients, colleagues, management, and external organizations.
Ability to adapt to changing processes, performance standards, goals, and budget requirements, balance competing priorities, and make sound decisions.
Ability to remain professional and courteous when handling challenging customer interactions and to mediate conflict politely and professionally.
Ability to work autonomously under general direction while adhering to and enforcing department and company policies and procedures.
Travel Work Location and Physical Requirements
Ability to travel approximately 0–10%, or as business needs require, with valid travel documentation and reliable transportation.
Ability to work from the assigned location, which may be an Everi office, a home office, or another location based on company needs and approval, and support direct communication and collaboration as required.
Ability to remain seated at a computer for extended periods in a limited workspace and perform repetitive keyboard, mouse, and telephone tasks.
Ability to bend, reach, twist, squat, and occasionally lift up to 30 pounds.
Ability to work in a smoke-free office with low to moderate noise, with potential exposure to smoke and loud noise at customer sites.

Base pay is one component of IGT’s total rewards program. Depending on the role, employees may be eligible for bonus or commission opportunities. IGT also offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include a 401(k) savings plan with company contributions, medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and other wellness programs, subject to eligibility requirements.

Vill du jobba som verksamhetsarkitekt?
Tycker du om att förstå hur verksamheter hänger ihop – på riktigt. Gillar du att skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang och hjälpa organisationer att realisera sin målsättning? Då är du kanske den vi söker.  
Vi söker dig som vill arbeta konsultativt som verksamhetsarkitekt – en brobyggare mellan verksamhet och it. Om du har några års erfarenhet av verksamhetsarkitektur, verksamhetsmodellering eller närliggande område och trivs i skärningspunkten mellan affären, it-strategi, informationsflöden och processer. Då kan tjänsten som verksamhetsarkitekt på IRM vara helt rätt för dig. 
Hur är det att jobba som verksamhetsarkitektskonsult från IRM?
Som verksamhetsarkitekt hos oss arbetar du i uppdrag hos våra kunder, ofta stora och komplexa organisationer. Uppdragen kan vara inom många olika branscher. Du hjälper till att få koll på helheten, reda ut samband och beroenden för att göra det möjligt att omsätta affärsstrategier till praktik på ett effektivt sätt. 
Det kan till exempel handla om att: 
ta fram verksamhetsförmågekartor, processmodeller, informationsmodeller och andra modeller som skapar samsyn och riktning 
facilitera dialoger och workshops med chefer, specialister och verksamhetsnära roller 
fungera som länken mellan ledning, verksamhet och IT 
bidra till våra utbildningar, seminarier och kunskapsdelning – internt och externt 
skriva, föreläsa eller på andra sätt dela med dig av dina erfarenheter. 
Läs mer om vad en verksamhetsarkitekt gör här.  
Vem vi tror att du är
För att trivas i konsultrollen tror vi att du har några års erfarenhet av verksamhetsarkitektur, verksamhetsanalys eller verksamhetsmodellering i olika former och känner dig trygg i att ta en rådgivande roll. Du gillar att förklara komplexa saker på ett enkelt sätt och trivs med att växla mellan helikopterperspektiv och detaljer. 
Vi tror också att du: 
tycker om att samarbeta och bygga relationer 
har lätt för att förklara, lyssna och skapa engagemang 
vill fortsätta utvecklas och bidra till att utveckla andra 
uppskattar variationen, ansvaret och friheten som konsultrollen ger.

Vi är ett konsultbolag med seniora specialister – från informationsarkitekter, verksamhetsarkitekter och verksamhetsutvecklare till lösningsarkitekter, utvecklare och förändringsledare. Vår kultur präglas av kunskapsdelning, öppenhet och engagemang. Som verksamhetsarkitekt på IRM blir du en del av ett team som tror på att information rätt hanterad är en resurs som frigör verksamhetens fulla potential. Compensation: $17.95 per hour plus shift premium Shift: Night, Sun-Thurs - 11pm-7:00am
Job Summary:
The Vault Custodian is responsible for receiving and issuing all plastics. Coordinates with all departments and clients for plastics requirements. Ensure card inventory is always balanced. 
Responsibilities:
Issue plastics for production and remakes
Check system for available plastics – pull cards
Count cards required for jobs as per job sheets
Update system for cards issued for production
Update inventory sheet for card box
Receive cards into the vault from manufacturing
Log cards into the vault
Ensure count is accurate vs docket
Update the system, batch ticket and control sheet
Re-pack, label and seal card boxes and file boxes
Receive products for external sources- cards, holograms and signature panels etc.
Log in to vault
Audit product - Verify counts
Label, seal and stock product as required
Advise appropriate parties that the product has been received
Update System as required
Process customer requests for cards
Check system for available plastics – pull cards
Count cards required for job as per email
Update system for cards requested
Update inventory sheet for card box
Inform appropriate parties that request is completed
Complete shipping/mailing instructions as per customer request
Responsible for scrap
Match plastic to SAP report
Count and balance
Initial and shred
Issue and receive returns from Chip room
Respond to queries from customer service
Quality check all requests before distribution
Conduct monthly inventories of all card stock
Audit cards as required
Respond to customer requests for audits
Advise Customer service regarding low quantities, low usage
Make recommendations for destruction
Responsible for the organization, cleanliness for their work area
Maintain and adhere to all workplace safety procedures
Other duties as required
Qualifications, Experience and Educational Requirements:
Excellent computer skills
Must be able to multi-task
Good math skills
Excellent organizational skills
Good attention to detail
Physical Requirements:
Able to lift upto 20 lbs
Lifting above head
Climb ladders
Push racks
Use a hand pump

 Las Vegas, NV, US, 89113
 Austin, TX, US, 78727

 19648
IGT, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale!  From the casino floor to your mobile screen, we deliver thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences—powered by world‑class content, strong technical and commercial capabilities and nurtured by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and ownership.
Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. With a team of over 6,000 employees across 30+ countries and products delivered in more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide, we operate at scale while staying closely connected to customers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here - www.igt.com.
Overview
The Data Engineer II builds and maintains scalable, cloud-native data solutions within the Global Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting enterprise analytics, reporting, and emerging AI initiatives. The role uses Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, and AWS to develop reliable data pipelines and curated datasets. Working with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and fellow engineers, the position translates business requirements into high-quality, production-ready data solutions while solving complex data challenges and continuously learning new technologies.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ELT/ETL pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, SQL, and Python.
Build and maintain reliable, high-quality datasets that support enterprise analytics, operational reporting, and AI use cases.
Develop data transformations using Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture best practices.
Integrate data from enterprise applications, APIs, databases, files, and other internal and external sources.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and product teams to understand data requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize production data pipelines for reliability, scalability, and performance.
Participate in migrating and modernizing legacy data processes to cloud-native architectures.
Improve data quality through validation, testing, monitoring, and automation.
Contribute to engineering best practices through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
Support continuous improvement of the enterprise data platform by identifying opportunities for automation, optimization, and simplification.
Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a related technical role.
Strong SQL development skills.
Strong Python programming experience.
Experience building data pipelines using Apache Spark and Databricks (or similar distributed data processing platforms).
Experience developing modern ETL/ELT pipelines.
Understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.
Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, preferably AWS.
Familiarity with Delta Lake or similar modern data storage technologies.
Experience using Git and collaborative software development practices.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred
Experience with AWS data services such as Amazon S3, IAM, Lambda, Glue, or related technologies.
Experience working with Databricks on AWS.
Experience with Delta Lake and Medallion/Lakehouse architecture.
Experience with orchestration tools such as Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, or similar workflow orchestration platforms.
Experience consuming and developing REST APIs.
Experience working with semi-structured data, including JSON and Excel-based data ingestion.
Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data engineering.
Exposure to AI/ML workflows or data preparation for machine learning and generative AI applications.
Experience working in gaming, hospitality, financial services, or other data-intensive industries.
IGT is committed to sustaining a workforce that reflects the diversity of the global customers and communities we serve and to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and engaged. IGT is an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We thank all applicants for their for applying; however, only those selected to interview will be contacted. 
Base pay is one component of IGT’s total rewards program. Depending on the role, employees may be eligible for bonus or commission opportunities. IGT also offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include a 401(k) savings plan with company contributions, medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and other wellness programs, subject to eligibility requirements. 
IGT is the global leader in gaming. For more information, please visit www.igt.com.

Pick parts using RF equipment.
Process parts returned for credit.
Put away parts using RF equipment.
Support Production with kit deliveries, HOT requests, reject pickups, and related material handling tasks.
Sort parts and remove trash and packaging for Production.
Pick cabinets, remove trash and packaging, and palletize them.

Operate warehouse equipment, including forklifts, turrets, pickers, and pallet jacks.
Complete assigned annual information security training, as applicable.
Qualifications

Ability to perform basic inventory control math.

Compensation: $25 per hour plus applicable shift premium Shift: Afternoon, Monday - Friday: 3pm - 11pm
Job Summary
The Operator is responsible for ensuring that the product received from Digital Printing is folded as per job requirements. This person follows all procedures specific to each job by checking sample books and instructions provided. The operator is responsible for performing all quality checks and adhering to all security policies and procedures.
Responsibilities
Follow a detailed schedule to retreive correct orders and output
Fold the output following job specifications
Ensure VIP’s take priority
Quality Control checking to ensure jobs are correct, in right sequencial order and balanced
Ensure all blanks and headers are pulled from jobs
Responsible for filling out colour-coded tags as required
Responsible for machine setup, minor adjustments and clean machines
Sign and scan out jobs and notify Traffic when complete
Escalate to lead as required on quality or production issues
Fill out daily worksheets with correct totals 
Adhere to all Health and Safety, Environment and Security policies and procedures
Placing service calls and filling out service call sheets when needed
Keep the work area neat and clean, emptying garbage at the end of each shift
Assist in other production-related duties as assigned
Cross-train in other job functions as assigned
Attend DP Communication meetings
Comply with G+D Environmental, Health & Safety policies, procedures and report any Environmental, Health & Safety hazards, incidents and concerns to the immediate supervisor
Qualifications, Experience and Educational Requirements
Work Experience:
Experience in operating MBO, BAUM folders an asset
Experience in working within a digital print environment is preferred
Skills and Competencies:
Strong verbal, written communication and organizational skills
Work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Attention to detail and hand-eye coordination
Able to work independently or as a member of team
Ability to multi-task
Mathematical ability e.g. addition, subtraction, problem-solving
Basic knowledge of computers
Education:
Completed high school diploma or some post-education is preferred
Working Conditions
In loud environment, hearing protection is required
Safety work shoes are required
Some weekend overtime may be required
Ability to occasionally stay late to meet client requirements is preferred
Physical Requirements
Ability to lift up to 40 lbs
Required to stand for long periods of time

At IGT, we design and build casino games played by millions of players worldwide. We’re always open to connect with talented Game Artists based in Serbia who are passionate about crafting high-quality visuals.

As a Game Artist you will work closely with the Producers & Game Team to develop the visuals for the games. 
Creating production art which includes characters, backgrounds, environments, animations and UI elements for working titles 
Collaborating with other designers, artists, developers and product managers to generate effective design solutions and receive feedback 
Producing content quickly without sacrificing quality.

Excellent knowledge of Adobe package (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects)

A strong Portfolio

Vi söker skicklig utvecklare av Dynamics CRM
Du vill leda spännande utvecklingsprojekt och inspirera andra i vårt ambitiösa team. Ett team som har flest certifierade Microsoft Dynamics CRM konsulter i Sverige. Du kommer som konsult vara placerad i Stockholm och ingå i ett team CRM-konsulter. I denna tjänst ges möjligheter för rätt person att arbeta brett – från specificering och design till implementering och vidareutveckling av lösningar åt våra kunder. Du skall ha ett intresse av att arbeta i både stora och små projekt men framför allt kunna medverka i projekten som både lösningsarkitekt och utvecklare.
Som person är du positiv, engagerad och har lätt för att samarbeta och trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter. Du har en stark vilja att ständigt söka ny kunskap kring relevanta produkter och lösningar. Vidare är du ödmjuk, verksamhetsnära, tänker gärna i processer, drivs av förändringsarbete och triggas av problemlösning.
Ett krav är erfarenhet och goda kunskaper i Microsoft .Net plattformen. Utöver detta har du mycket goda kunskaper inom några av följande områden: C#, JavaScript, SQL Server, Silverlight, ASP.NET samt erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsmetoder som Scrum. Ett plus är om du redan har erfarenhet av Dynamics CRM, SharePoint, Reporting Services samt BizTalk eller andra integrationsplattformar. Du har minst 5 års erfarenhet, gärna som konsult.
