Dela jobbet
Build modern Lakehouse solutions with real impact
Are you a Data engineer or architect with a passion for Databricks and modern data platforms? Join Knowit in Malmö and help shape scalable, secure, and future ready Lakehouse solutions for leading organizations.
Databricks Specialist at Knowit
As a Databricks Specialist, you will design and build modern data platforms using Databricks and Lakehouse architecture. You will work across the full data lifecycle, from ingestion to advanced analytics, with a strong focus on performance, governance, and scalability.
You will be part of Knowit Solutions Lakehouse, our national initiative across Malmö, Gothenburg, and Stockholm, where we bring together top expertise in Databricks and modern data architecture to deliver strategically important solutions for our clients.
Your main responsibilities include:
Designing and implementing Databricks based Lakehouse solutions
Building and optimizing data pipelines for both batch and streaming data
Structuring data for analytics, AI, and ML use cases
Implementing and managing Unity Catalog for data governance
Collaborating with cross functional teams and client stakeholders
Contributing to architecture decisions and best practices in Data engineering
Our tech stack, tools and ways of working
Databricks, Azure, AWS
Python, SQL, Apache Spark
Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog
DBT, Airflow
CI and CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code
We value continuous learning and encourage you to grow within the Databricks ecosystem.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with experience in Data engineering, from mid level Data engineers to senior architects.
You have:
Hands on experience with Databricks and cloud platforms
Solid skills in Python and SQL
A curious mindset and a collaborative approach
Experience with AI and ML is a plus.
What does Knowit Lakehouse offer in Malmö?
Knowit is a Databricks partner and we collaborate closely on competence development, initiatives, and client engagements. You will work both in project deliveries and on site with clients, combining long term ownership with hands on experience in complex environments.
As part of Knowit Solutions Lakehouse, you will contribute to a growing national capability and work with some of Sweden’s most technology driven organizations.
Your closest manager will be COO Emil Raue, an experienced leader in data and consulting, known for his clear and technically grounded leadership and strong employee feedback.
We offer a flexible work environment, a strong knowledge sharing culture, and great opportunities to grow within Databricks, Lakehouse, and modern Data engineering.
Ready to take the next step?
Join Knowit in Malmö and be part of building the next generation of data driven solutions with Databricks and Lakehouse. We look forward to your application!
Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.
We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.
We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

Dela jobbet
Är du intresserad av att bidra till ett tryggt och säkert samhälle? Är du nyfiken på försvarssektorn och vill utveckla din kunskap inom försvarsteknik? Vi på Knowit Defence Technology söker studenter för examensarbete våren 2027 inom försvarsområdet, en unik möjlighet för dig som läser på universitetet att få inblick i en spännande bransch och omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiken. Här får du chansen att utföra ditt examensarbete i nära anknytning till försvarsindustrin och skapa värdefull erfarenhet för framtiden.
Förslag på examensarbeten
Vi erbjuder inriktningar för examensarbeten (samtliga med omfattningen 30 hp) och välkomnar även egna idéer inom vårt verksamhetsområde. Plats ("Stockholm", "Göteborg" och "Stockholm eller Göteborg") för examensarbete nämns i respektive förslags rubrik.
1. Systemsäkerhet - Best-Practice (Stockholm eller Göteborg)
Detta examensarbete syftar till att ta fram en best practice-strategi inom systemsäkerhet för ett specifikt tekniskt system. Du kommer att undersöka hur man på bästa sätt kan utforma och analysera ett system ur ett systemsäkerhetsperspektiv (se H SystSäk 2022), samt dokumentera en processbeskrivning för detta arbete. Målet är att bidra till en och skapa en best-practice metod som kan användas för framtida systemsäkerhetsprojekt.
2. Robusta underhållsstrategier för tekniska system (Stockholm)
Ett tidigare examensarbete har undersökt beslutsstödsystem för arméns underhåll och ett tidigare har utvecklat en simuleringsmodell för att jämföra underhållsstrategier. Detta examensarbete syftar till att vidareutveckla och förena resultaten till ett mer praktiskt tillämpbart beslutsstödsystem i form av en applikation eller program. Arbetet kan omfatta modellering av felutfall, reparationstider, reservdelstillgång och transportstörningar samt utveckling och utvärdering av en prototyp.
3. Från innovationsförmedling till affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling (Stockholm)
Ett tidigare examensarbete har identifierat barriärer för mindre bolag att nå försvarsmarknaden och utvecklat ett ramverk för hur en aktör kan facilitera samarbetet mellan potentiella försvarsleverantörer och upphandlande myndigheter. Detta examensarbete syftar till att vidareutveckla och omsätta ramverket till ett praktiskt arbetssätt. Arbetet kan omfatta intervjuer, marknadsanalys och fallstudier för att undersöka hur aktörer sammanföras och tekniska lösningar utvecklas till relevanta erbjudanden för försvarssektorn.
4. Informations- och cybersäkerhet (Göteborg)
Hos Knowit Defence Technology i Göteborg finns möjlighet att genomföra examensarbete inom informations- och cybersäkerhet med koppling till försvarssektorn.
Exempel på intressanta områden är framtida cyberhot, säker systemintegration, riskhantering, informationssäkerhet samt säker användning av AI och automatisering. Även cybersäkerhet kopplat till tekniska systems livscykel och internationella leverantörsberoenden är relevanta områden.
5. Samband och marina ledningssystem (Göteborg)
Hos Knowit Defence Technology i Göteborg finns möjlighet att genomföra examensarbete inom marina samband och ledningssystem samt angränsande försvarstekniska områden.
Exempel på intressanta områden är kommunikationssystem, systemintegration, interoperabilitet, sensorsystem och framtidens marina teknik. Även integrerat logistikstöd (ILS), teknisk systemförvaltning och satellitbaserad kommunikation är relevanta områden.
6. Eget förslag (Göteborg eller Stockholm)
Har du en egen idé inom försvarsområdet? Vi välkomnar gärna ditt eget förslag på examensarbete, exempel på områden som intresserar oss är:
Marknadsundersökningar
Verksamhetsutveckling
Samband- och ledningssystem (C2-system)
Farkostteknik och autonoma system
Beslutsstödsystem för försvarsapplikationer
Simulering och modellering av militära scenarion
Sensorsystem
Telekrig
Artificiell intelligens/Maskininlärning
Signalbehandling
Vem söker vi?
Vi välkomnar ansökningar från masterstudenter inom exempelvis farkostteknik, maskinteknik, industriell ekonomi, systemvetenskap, datateknik eller liknande utbildningar. Du som söker bör ha ett genuint intresse för försvar- och säkerhetssektorn och vilja utforska hur teknik kan bidra till samhällets säkerhet. Du planerar att genomföra ditt examensarbete under vårterminen 2027 som en avslutning på din utbildning.
Övrigt
Det finns möjligheter till distansarbete men vi ser dock gärna att du kan vara på plats i Stockholm vid möten och avstämningar för att få ut det mesta av din tid hos oss.
Det är möjligt att ansöka och skriva exjobbet i par.
Observera att svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav och vi ser att du behärskar svenska språket. Själva examensarbetet, uppsats och presentation, kan dock utföras på engelska. Vi kommer att välja ut kandidater baserat på motivering, erfarenheter, helhetsbedömning av anställningsbarhet efter examen, personliga egenskaper och övriga meriter. 
För specifika frågor som inte besvaras i annonsen, kontakta Eric Schadewitz på eric.schadewitz@knowit.se.
Ansökan
Låter detta intressant? Skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida. Bifoga följande dokument:
Ditt val av examensarbete (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 eller eget förslag), en kort motivering inklusive reflektion kring ämnet och hur du skulle vilja angripa det (ca ½ sida).
Ett kort personligt brev som berättar om dig själv och vad du vill uppnå med examensarbetet.
CV
Utdrag från Ladok av betyg/transcript från din pågående utbildning.
Sista ansökningsdag: 30 november 2026. 
Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och kan komma att tillsätta exjobbplatser innan sista ansökningsdatum, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.
Välkommen med din ansökan till ett spännande examensarbete inom försvarssektorn! Vi ser fram emot att få veta mer om dig och dina idéer.
Hos oss blir du en del av ett team av experter med fokus på systemteknik, ILS, verksamhetsutveckling och systemsäkerhet inom försvarsområdet. Vi är verksamma inom några av Sveriges mest komplexa och utmanande projekt, med målet att säkerställa att Försvarsmaktens mark- och sjöstridskrafter har tillgång till rätt medel vid rätt tidpunkt. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande kultur där gemenskap, professionell utveckling och balans mellan arbete och fritid är centrala värden. Hos oss får du möjlighet att forma din egen utveckling och påverka både ditt arbete och företagets framtid.
Om Knowit
Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.

Dela jobbet
Knowit Gävleborg AB utdelar årligen ett stipendium på max 34 100 kr till studerande vid Högskolan i Gävle. Stipendiets syfte är att premiera och stimulera idérika personer att vidareutveckla sina idéer. Knowit vill främja ett innovativt tänkande för att möjliggöra utvecklandet av något originellt och principiellt nytt av betydelse inom en verksamhet eller ett område.
Stipendiet utgör en belöning för en god studieprestation där särskild hänsyn ska tas till ett innovativt examensarbete - inom vilket ämnesområde som helst. Stipendiet kan delas mellan flera examensarbeten. Om flera studeranden gemensamt utfört ett examensarbete, kan dock stipendiet delas mellan dem.
Stipendieansökan värderas i två steg. I första steget sker en granskning utifrån de akademiska meriterna. I andra steget sker en granskning utifrån de innovativa kvaliteterna. Denna granskning görs av donatorer och beaktar fyra olika dimensioner:
Innovativ höjd - grad av nyhetsvärde
Strategisk höjd - grad av framåtriktning
Realistisk höjd - grad av genomförbarhet
Värdeskapande höjd - grad av ekonomiskt, kulturellt, socialt, kvalitativt värde
Dessa fyra perspektiv graderas vid rangordningen i skalan 1-5. Skalan tolkas enligt följande:
Mycket låg höjd
Låg höjd
Viss höjd
Hög höjd
Mycket hög höjd
Till ansökan ska bifogas
- godkänt examensarbete på lägst kandidatnivå. Examensarbetet får inte vara äldre än 18 månader räknat från sista ansökningsdag.
- Ladok-utdrag där betyg för avslutade kurser samt på examensarbetet framgår.
Studenten ska även bifoga ett personligt brev på max 2 A4 som motiverar graden av de olika kriterierna samt ge en kort sammanfattning av examensarbetet.
Motivera grad av nyhetsvärde i examensarbetet.
Motivera grad av framåtriktning i examensarbetet.
Motivera grad av genomförande i examensarbetet.
Motivera grad av ekonomiskt, kulturellt, socialt och kvalitativt värde i examensarbetet.
Kort sammanfattning av examensarbetet.

AB Västerås Larm & Säkerhet har funnits sedan 2003 och är en oberoende säkerhetsleverantör med kontor i Västerås. Vi utför installationer inom en 10 mils radie från Västerås. Vi utför mycket kundspecifika säkerhetslösningar med specialområden som inbrottslarm, brandlarm, passersystem samt kameraövervakning. 
Vi installerar försäkringsgodkända inbrottslarm av larmklass 1 och 2 i exempelvis villor, kontor, butiker, verkstäder och industrier, sjukhus med flera.
Svenskt medborgarskap är ett villkor för tjänsten. Registerkontroll kommer att genomföras i enlighet med bestämmelser för certifierad anläggarfirma för inbrottslarm. Sekretessavtal kommer att behöva skrivas på. 
Dina arbetsuppgifter

Din kompetens och erfarenhet

Vi tror också att följande stämmer in på dig:
Du:
– Har några års erfarenhet inom säkerhetsbranshen.
– Har grundläggande kunskap om el lära och teknik.
– Har grundläggande kunskap inom nätverk och datorer.
– Har en positiv attityd.
– Är lösningsorienterad.
– Har god social kompetens och van att bemöta kunder.
Tjänsten är på heltid och placerad i Västerås.
Dina personliga egenskaper
Vi söker efter personer med stor egen drivkraft, som tycker att det är roligt att arbeta med varierade uppgifter.
Du har god samarbetsförmåga, en inneboende drivkraft att lösa uppgifter och visar omtanke om dina arbetskamrater. Vi ser också att du är noggrann, ordningsam och strukturerad.
AB Västerås Larm & Säkerhet är en kreativ och stimulerande arbetsplats med intressanta arbetsuppgifter. Vi strävar efter att våra medarbetare ska känna stolthet över att arbeta hos oss.
Placering
Arbetet sker primärt i Västerås med omnejd med dagliga besök ute hos kund.

Gör ditt exjobb inom AI, signalbehandling eller systemutveckling och utveckla teknik för intelligenta beslutsstöd, sensoranalys och framtidens försvars- och säkerhetslösningar.
Dela jobbet
Studerar du på masternivå inom AI, signalbehandling, dataanalys eller systemutveckling? Här omsätter du din kunskap i ett tekniskt avancerat examensarbete med stöd av erfarna specialister.
Som examensarbetare blir du en del av ett team med kompetens inom AI, mjukvaruutveckling, systemarkitektur, cybersäkerhet och försvarsteknik. Tillsammans utforskar, utvärderar eller utvecklar ni teknik för försvar, övervakning, sensorintegration och intelligenta beslutsstöd. Du får handledning av erfarna ingenjörer och kan diskutera idéer med kollegor som utvecklar både kundlösningar och egna produkter.
Examensarbetet kan vara forskningsnära eller mer tillämpat, beroende på ämne och frågeställning. Vi är särskilt intresserade av egna idéer och välkomnar förslag inom:
AI och maskininlärning
signal- och sensoranalys
autonoma och intelligenta system
generativ AI och beslutsstöd
kommunikations- och ledningssystem
Även andra förslag som kan bidra till försvars- och säkerhetslösningar är välkomna.
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
pågående studier på master-, civilingenjörs- eller motsvarande nivå
kompetens inom exempelvis datateknik, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik, AI eller signalbehandling
ett intresse för att utforska nya tekniska lösningar
förmåga att kombinera teori och analys med praktisk tillämpning
Vad får du hos oss?
Du får arbeta med verkliga problemställningar i en kunskapsintensiv och inkluderande miljö. Examensarbetets inriktning och upplägg utformar vi tillsammans, vilket ger dig möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom ett område som intresserar dig och samtidigt bidra med resultat som kan användas i vår fortsatta produktutveckling.
Ansökan
Välkommen med din ansökan. Beskriv gärna ditt förslag på examensarbete, vilken frågeställning du vill undersöka och hur ämnet knyter an till våra teknikområden.
Sista ansökningsdag: 30 november 2026. 
Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och kan komma att tillsätta exjobbplatser innan sista ansökningsdatum, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.
Vi ser fram emot att få veta mer om dig och dina idéer.
Om Knowit
Du gör ditt exjobb i Knowits dotterbolag ”Knowit Dataunit”, som bland annat driver arbetet framåt med vår lösning ”Yggdrasil för AI-baserad realtidsanalys och integrerad övervakning av kritisk infrastruktur”. Tillsammans med våra kollegor i andra dotterbolag ingår vi i affärsområdet Knowit Products där vi erbjuder digitala IP-produkter i kombination med kundspecifika konsulttjänster inom försvar, informationssäkerhet, mobilitet, finans och försäkring.
Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.
We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

Responsibilities
We are looking for an Industrial Electrician to support our Advanced Materials & Chemicals Division in Rochester, NY.   
As an Industrial Electrician you will:
• Provide electrical support for chemical processing equipment, machinery, and facilities. vices, heat tracing, lighting, etc.
• Work includes equipment repairs, maintenance, and equipment upgrades.
• Candidate expected to become electrical systems and equipment expert in area of responsibility.
• High level of expertise needed to effectively troubleshoot and repair equipment.
• Implement established preventive maintenance program.
• Installation of conduit, wiring, switches, relays, lighting, circuit breakers using power tools and hand tools.
• Calibrations using test equipment.
• Process controls experience a plus, including pneumatic controls. 
Qualifications Include:
• Strong electrical training and/or demonstrated skills/experience.
• Experience with explosion proof and intrinsically safe electrical systems up to 480V.
• Understanding of electrical codes for hazardous environments (flammable liquids).
• Able to read electrical and instrument drawings.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and maintenance software.
• Excellent safety record – places safety as top priority in all work.
• Good team player.
• Work effectively with other trades and with changing priorities.
• Dependable, good attendance.
• Significant walking, standing, climbing stairs, ladders, etc.
• Able to work off ladders, scaffolding, manlifts, etc.
• Indoor and outdoor work.
• Use of appropriate personal protective equipment.
Minimum Education Level and Experience:
• High school diploma.
• Electrical apprentice program and/or equivalent plus demonstrated work experience.
Work Hours:
• Monday – Friday, 8-hour days (40 hours/week)
• Willing to work some overtime, as needed, to support production and capital projects

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Role Overview
Eastman Kodak is seeking a Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Specialist to support its wide-roll film manufacturing operations onsite in Rochester, New York. In this role, you will help the division meet health, safety, and environmental compliance requirements while supporting the production of the world's highest-quality light-sensitive coated products. The position involves working closely with management, operations, engineering, and maintenance staff to identify and control hazards, manage waste and comply with air permit conditions associated with Kodak's unique coating equipment and highly engineered processes used to prepare and manufacture chemical materials.
This position will report to the Rochester Operations HSE Manager and will be required to be on-site daily in Rochester, NY.  
Responsibilities:
1.    Oversee health and safety programs including process safety management, respiratory protection, hearing conservation, personal protective equipment, hazard communication, laser safety, ionizing radiation, Control of Hazardous Energy (LO/TO), electrical safety, machine/web conveyance safeguarding, fall protection, confined space, & contractor safety reviews.
2.    Oversee environmental compliance programs and reporting obligations required the U.S. EPA. 
3.    Participate in incident and near miss investigations, review and analyze data, identify trends and improvement opportunities to prevent/reduce incidents.
4.    Participate in management of change reviews and job hazard analyses to identify/evaluate hazards and recommend controls.
5.    Provide HSE training to employees.
6.    Conduct audits to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and prevailing professional standards and practices.
7.    Provide HSE support for new product development/product change management. 
8.    Provide technical guidance to management on a large variety of workplace HSE issues. 
9.    Provide recommendations for goals and metrics to improve the HSE program and reduce work-place injuries.  
Requirements:
•    Knowledge of chemical manufacturing processes. Previous direct experience with Process Safety Management (PSM) regulated operations preferred.
•    Working knowledge of Federal, state, local health, safety and environment requirements (OSHA, EPA, air, water, waste)
•    Knowledge and experience with ISO management systems (e.g. ISO 14001, ISO 45001)
•    Self-starter able to work without daily supervision
•    Previous experience applying a risk-based approach to environmental management
•    Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional manner and build relationships.
•    Able to organize and coordinate multiple requirements/projects/processes simultaneously.
•    Able to complete responsibilities in a timely, professional, and quality manner.
•    Able to analyze complex problems, search out relevant information and gauge its importance when making decisions.
•    Effective written and oral communication skills; able to express oneself clearly and in technical and non-technical terms.
•    Excellent computer skills including advanced MS Excel (macros, pivot tables & formulas). Knowledge of Power BI and cloud-based HSE management software systems (e.g. VelocityEHS, Benchmark Gensuite) preferred.
Education and Experience:
•    Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety and Health, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related field.
•    3- 5 years+ of relevant experience in a chemical manufacturing environment.

Date: Oct 8, 2026

 Rochester, NY, US, 14652
 Company: 
 Kodak
Role Overview
Kodak is looking for Coating Operators to join our team in Kodak’s Advanced Materials and Chemicals Division in Rochester, NY. 
Operators work in a variety of roles, all of which are involved in manufacturing the highest-quality light-sensitive coated products in the world. Depending on qualifications and experience, operator candidates will be assigned a role in one of these three teams. 
Coating: Our unique and massive coating machines create the PET film base as well as coat light-sensitive materials onto the film base. Operators are responsible for ensuring that the coating machines run smoothly and that the coated products are free from imperfections.
Chemical: Our world-class coated products rely upon the interplay of multiple extremely thin chemical layers. Operators use precisely engineered processes to prepare all materials used in coating, including solvents, dyes, and light-sensitive emulsions. Experience dealing with large quantities of chemicals and understanding chemical Safety Data Sheets is helpful.
Quality: Our coated products are of the highest quality in the world. Operators inspect freshly coated film products for imperfections in structure or sensitivity that would affect their functionality and salability. A background in science may be helpful.
As an operator, you will potentially: 
•    Work in both light and dark room conditions.
•    Work 11-hour days or 12-hour rotating shifts.
•    Work overnights and possibly weekends.
Required skills and experience for all operators:
•    Must be a detail-orientated team player.

Eastman Kodak Company is committed to supporting the health and wellbeing of its workforce, and we are seeking a Nurse Case Manager/RN to guide employees through the medical leave process, promote full recovery, and facilitate a smooth return to work. This role also partners closely with employees managing chronic health conditions to help them maintain their health and perform their jobs without restrictions.
This is a hybrid role that will require 3 days a week onsite in Rochester, New York after a training period.
Responsibilities:
• Deliver excellent customer service to Kodak employees while advocating for their full recovery and timely return to work.
• Assist in facilitating appropriate and timely medical care with the goal of returning the employee to their pre-injury or illness state.
• Provide support to employees during absences, while emphasizing Kodak’s commitment to keeping its employees healthy and active.
• Work with supervisors to assess their ability to accommodate employee restrictions.
• Ongoing medical management of work-related injury and non-work-related medical absences and documentation of case updates, diagnoses, prognosis, and projected return to work goals in the electronic medical record.
• Creating an employee centered care plan for absences and documenting thorough assessments, nursing diagnosis, plan and evaluation of care plan goals and interventions.
• Referrals to community agencies and company benefits for facilitating employee recovery
• Receipt and review of documentation to support employee absences and ensure compliance with Kodak’s policies and state and federal regulations.
• Ongoing and regular communication with employees, medical providers, supervisors, Human Resources, and other members of the occupational health team to ensure that all parties are aligned and informed.
• Work closely with the workers’ compensation third party administrator to ensure swift treatment authorizations and appropriate care.
• Collaborate with the workers’ compensation third party administrator to determine when an independent medical exam or functional capacity assessment is appropriate.
• Participation in webinars, seminars, etc. to keep abreast of new OSHA regulations and other state or federal laws impacting Kodak’s occupational health program and employee absences.
• Perform all job functions in accordance with local, state, and federal laws as well as Kodak’s policies. Comply with national case management standards and nursing code of conduct.
• Evaluation of job functions to assess ergonomic improvements and preventative programs.
• Testimony in the event of legal proceedings arising from an employee absence or injury, as needed.
• Participation in Challenging Case meetings with the Kodak Medical and HR teams to discuss complicated cases and ensure alignment when developing a resolution plan.
• Participation in Morning Market calls pertaining to workplace injuries, as needed.
• Assist with other Kodak-sponsored health and wellness activities such as wellness fairs and flu shot clinics.
Skills and Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Nursing with an active Registered Nurse License in NY
• 5+ years of clinical nursing experience
• 2+ years of experience in telephonic nurse case management experience, with occupational health case management preferred
• Working knowledge of general workers’ compensation, disability, FMLA, and ADA laws
• Strong customer service and interpersonal skills for dealing with different types of internal and external clients and conflict resolution
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Fluency in operating Microsoft Office suite programs
• Time management and multitasking skills to balance oversight of multiple projects and unique situations arising unexpectedly
• Advanced organizational skills and attention to detail
Physical Requirements: 
• Ability to report to Rochester, NY office 5 days/week during training and then 3 days per week upon completion of training
• Lifting up to 10 lbs. occasionally
• This is primarily a sedentary role, however there are times when climbing up to 2 flights of stairs, carrying items, and walking is required during Kodak-sponsored activities
• Ability to use keyboard, phone, and computer for up to 8 hours per day

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.
The Role
We are seeking highly motivated, creative and strategic-minded individuals to join our team of summer interns – and work as part of the Kyndryl Marketing organization. In this role, you will learn how a modern marketing organization works across all its disciplines, work as an intern team on a strategic project, partner with an early professional in the organization on an individual assignment and receive professional development and guidance. 
Through our program, you’ll learn from leaders, be exposed and contribute to how work gets done, and gain new experiences that will contribute to your resume and personal growth.
Program Overview:
The internship will be on-site at our New York City location.  Internship Dates: June 8 - July 28 summer 2027.
Interns in this program can expect:
Opportunities to learn from senior leaders, while building a network of peers
Professional networking & personal brand development
To work side by side with full-time employees on real work
Mentorship opportunities
Workshops and access to industry accredited education & certifications
FUN!
Your individual assignment referenced above will be focused on Marketing Analytics. As part of this assignment, you will apply data and analytics to real business questions that help Kyndryl understand and improve the performance of our marketing investments.
You will work as part of the Marketing Analytics team, partnering with other interns, analysts and marketing teams to evaluate performance across areas such as digital marketing, paid media, events, campaigns and the marketing funnel. Your work will help answer questions such as: Which marketing activities are generating the strongest results? Where are there opportunities to improve performance? How should marketing teams use data to make better investment and growth decisions?
Throughout the internship, you will serve as the analytics focal within a broader intern team, taking ownership of defined analyses and helping translate data into insights and recommendations. You may analyze campaign or channel performance, evaluate marketing investments, identify trends and opportunities, or help develop reporting and dashboards used to manage the business.
This is a hands-on opportunity to gain experience applying analytics in a global B2B marketing organization. You will build on your Excel and analytical skills while gaining exposure to tools and technologies such as SQL and Power BI, as well as marketing, CRM and business data.
What You'll Do
Analyze marketing performance across channels such as digital, paid media, events and campaigns
Use data to identify trends, performance drivers and opportunities for growth or optimization
Evaluate marketing investments and help determine where teams can improve effectiveness and ROI
Develop analyses, reports and visualizations that make complex data easier to understand
Support dashboards and recurring performance reporting using tools such as Excel and Power BI
Gain exposure to SQL and large marketing and business datasets
Translate analytical findings into clear business insights and recommendations
Partner with marketing teams to understand business questions and determine how data can help answer them
Serve as analytics focal within a broader intern team, bringing a data-driven perspective to team projects
Present findings and recommendations to analytics, marketing and business stakeholders
Who You Are
Job Qualifications
Required Education:
Rising Senior working towards a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Analytics, Data Science, Business, Economics, Marketing, Statistics or a related field.
Required Professional Expertise:
Please exhibit entry level abilities in the following areas:
Creativity, Content Creation and Writing Skills 
Verbal Communication Skills
Result-oriented and creative collaborator
Project and program management skills
Research and analytical skills
Problem solving skills
Attention to detail
Dedication, sincerity, passion, and the right attitude towards work
Strategic mindset, ready to work in a start-up
Additional Preferred Qualifications:
Experience working with datasets through coursework, projects, internships, or student organizations
Ability to organize, analyze and interpret data to identify trends and insights
Experience creating charts, dashboards, or visual presentations to communicate findings
Familiarity with business intelligence, analytics, database, or reporting tools is a plus
What We're Looking For
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
Demonstrated curiosity about how businesses measure success and use data to make decisions
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with data
Interest in learning or developing skills in SQL, Power BI and business intelligence tools
Ability to take a business question, analyze relevant data and communicate what the data means
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Curiosity and an interest in understanding what drives business and marketing performance
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively across a team while taking ownership of assigned work
Eagerness to learn, receive feedback to develop new analytical and business skills
Compensation:
The pay range for the position will be $30/hour based on a full-time schedule working 40 hours a week.  
What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.
Get Referred!
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
Who You Are
Required skills and experience 
•Currently enrolled in a university or educational institution, or recently completed a qualification  
•Ability to apply basic analytical and critical thinking skills to assess information, identify patterns or issues, and propose practical, well-reasoned solutions 
•Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document work, share updates, and ask clarifying questions when needed 
•Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment 
•Ability to follow structured processes, tools, and guidelines while delivering accurate, timely, and high-quality outputs 
•Basic proficiency with common digital tools and technologies (e.g., spreadsheets, collaboration platforms, or relevant technical tools), with willingness to learn new systems 
•Demonstrated learning agility and growth mindset, including willingness to seek feedback, learn from experience, and continuously build skills in a professional environment
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred!

Role Overview
Eastman Kodak Company is looking for a Control Technician to join our team in Rochester, NY. We are seeking an individual with the background to be successful supporting our ESTAR Manufacturing Operations located within Eastman Business Park in Rochester, NY.
Responsibilities: 
•    Provide technical support for the operation, maintenance and continuous improvement of manufacturing instrumentation and process control systems. 
•    Work closely with operations, process engineers, and maintenance to understand the business and user needs and priorities. 
•    Provide full life cycle support of control systems in the area, including developing requirements, programming support, commissioning, and ongoing hardware and software maintenance.  
•    Support upgrade projects for existing Reliance Automax Machine Coordinated Drive Control Systems including identifying system hardware and software architecture improvement opportunities.
•    Provide hardware and integration support for Ethernet based control systems in the plant IT environment. 
•    Work with maintenance to develop data driven reliability improvement opportunities, as well as troubleshoot system hardware, resolve software malfunctions, and assist in system improvements and software upgrades.
•    Implement improvements in systems capabilities that will increase the ability to meet customer requirements, including safe and reliable operations, and improve business competitiveness. 
Qualifications:
•    Associates degree in Electrical Engineering or Electro-Mechanical Technology (Mechatronics) or Equivalent Experience

Role Overview
We are looking for a Pipefitter to join our Advanced Materials & Chemicals department in Rochester, NY 
As a Pipefitter you will perform the following duties:
• Pipefitter to provide multi-discipline capability to repair, maintain, install and make improvements on chemical processing equipment and building services (includes process piping, building service piping, pneumatics, and hydraulics)
• Ability to work with variety of materials and piping system components (stainless steel, steel, glass-lined, plastic, copper, fiber cast, etc.)

• Execute preventive and predictive maintenance programs. 
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and maintenance software tools.
• Flexibility to change based on priorities
• Some experience or expertise in mechanical, HVAC equipment and process controls would be a plus.
• Welding certification a plus.

• Dependable, maintain good attendance
• Maintain a clean work area and operate in a safe manner at all times.
• Must demonstrate effective analytical troubleshooting skills
• Able to read pipe and machine drawings

• Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision
• Excellent safety record – places safety and environment as top priority in all work
• Knowledge of Lock Out / Tag Out
• Good communication skills – daily communications with leaders, maintenance planner, technical staff, engineering and operations as needed.
• Team player – willing to be flexible, often work in other areas and with other trades as needed to support maintenance team.
• Significant walking, climbing stairs or other means of mobility.
• Ability to reach, bend, stoop, push and/or pull, and frequently lift up to 30 pounds and occasionally lift/move 40 pounds.
• Ability to work off of ladders or scaffolding, and in awkward positions
• Indoor and outdoor work assignments
• Wear protective clothing and/or Personal Protective Equipment required by the work environment or governmental regulations.

• HS diploma

Role Overview
Kodak is looking for Coating Operators to join our team in Kodak’s Advanced Materials and Chemicals Division in Rochester, NY. 
Operators work in a variety of roles, all of which are involved in manufacturing the highest-quality light-sensitive coated products in the world. Depending on qualifications and experience, operator candidates will be assigned a role in one of these three teams. 
Coating: Our unique and massive coating machines create the PET film base as well as coat light-sensitive materials onto the film base. Operators are responsible for ensuring that the coating machines run smoothly and that the coated products are free from imperfections.
Chemical: Our world-class coated products rely upon the interplay of multiple extremely thin chemical layers. Operators use precisely engineered processes to prepare all materials used in coating, including solvents, dyes, and light-sensitive emulsions. Experience dealing with large quantities of chemicals and understanding chemical Safety Data Sheets is helpful.
Quality: Our coated products are of the highest quality in the world. Operators inspect freshly coated film products for imperfections in structure or sensitivity that would affect their functionality and salability. A background in science may be helpful.
As an operator, you will potentially: 
•    Work in both light and dark room conditions.
•    Work 11-hour days or 12-hour rotating shifts.
•    Work overnights and possibly weekends.
Required skills and experience for all operators:
•    Must be a detail-orientated team player.
•    Must have the ability to be flexible between multiple positions, sometimes multi-tasking or moving within a shift.
•    Must work effectively with minimal supervision.
•    Ability to prioritize work to meet business needs.
•    Ability to express oneself communicate clearly, both written and verbal, and comprehend a variety of work requests
•    Willing to work overtime or adjust work schedule for business needs.
•    Must be willing and able to lift and move objects up to 50 pounds.
•    Ability to obtain Power Industrial Truck (fork truck) license at Kodak.
•    Positions require walking, standing, and frequent lifting, carrying, pulling, pushing, and occasional awkward positions.
•    Must maintain a clean work area.
•    Must maintain strict adherence to safety procedures and quality standards.
•    Computer proficiency including navigating screens and data entry.
•    Responsibility for specific manufacturing processes, inputs, outputs, and troubleshooting.
•    Be involved in product quality and process improvement activities.
•    Interact with engineers, technicians, and maintenance personnel.
Additional skills and experience preferred: 
•    At least 2 years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. 
•    Understanding of film photography.
•    Understanding of thin-film coating processes.
•    Strong problem solving, data analysis, and computer abilities (Excel, Word, etc.).
•    Knowledge of Outlook, One-LIMS, Felix, and the SAP system.

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.
The Role
We are seeking highly motivated, creative and strategic-minded individuals to join our team of summer interns – and work as part of the Kyndryl Marketing organization. In this role, you will learn how a modern marketing organization works across all its disciplines, work as an intern team on a strategic project, partner with an early professional in the organization on an individual assignment and receive professional development and guidance. 
Through our program, you’ll learn from leaders, be exposed and contribute to how work gets done, and gain new experiences that will contribute to your resume and personal growth.
Program Overview:
The internship will be on-site at our New York City location.  Internship Dates: June 8 - July 28 summer 2027.
Interns in this program can expect:
Opportunities to learn from senior leaders, while building a network of peers
Professional networking & personal brand development
To work side by side with full-time employees on real work
Mentorship opportunities
Workshops and access to industry accredited education & certifications
FUN!

Verbal Communication Skills
Result-oriented and creative collaborator
Project and program management skills

Strategic mindset, ready to work in a start-up

Interest in learning or developing skills
Strong attention to detail
Curiosity and an interest in understanding what drives business and marketing

Ability to work collaboratively across a team while taking ownership of assigned work
Eagerness to learn, receive feedback to develop new business skills

Microsoft Suite, including CoPilot
Compensation:
The pay range for the position will be $30/hour based on a full-time schedule working 40 hours a week.

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

 Burnaby, British Columbia, CA, V5G 4P5

Role Overview
The Product Specialist is responsible for supporting customer escalations from regional service teams and acting as the escalation focal point for customer and internal service escalations into Product Development and Product Management. Through their domain knowledge and technical product knowledge evaluates and tests customer problems and either provides solutions or escalates through the Problem Report process to Product Development. The Product Specialist works closely with Product Support Management to identify problem trends, perform root cause analysis, and provides input for prioritizing fixes for future releases. In addition, the Product Specialist collaborates and provides user domain knowledge in support of Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, and Product Development, including R&D and QA. The Product Specialist participates in the product service commercialization process, including helping prepare the regional service organizations to support upcoming product releases.
Responsibilities and Expectations:
•    Able up to travel with short notice (up to 10% of time on average)
•    Acts as primary point of contact for beta sites and conduct beta for specific releases
•    Collaborate with PD team on troubleshooting and solving technical problems
•    Completes expense, time tracking, and customer call logging reports using systems and processes identified by Kodak
•    Develops and maintains advanced technical expertise with Kodak products, systems and/or solutions
•    Develops, reviews, and updates technical training material for ease of understanding and completeness 
•    Documents problem resolutions for regional escalation case closure, ongoing support and learning
•    In partnership with Product Management uses domain expertise to assist in translating customer feature requests into stories and/or modifications to existing features for input to Product Management
•    In partnership with Product Support Management, uses domain expertise to identify problems, problem trends, and product performance data to prioritize bugs for Product Development
•    Leads or participates in periodic technical “Checkpoint” meetings with regional teams
•    Participates on special projects and company initiatives as needed
•    Provides Product Development with precise problem descriptions, test cases, customer files and potential root causes and adheres to established SLA’s between escalation functions
•    Provides remote assistance to regional service teams as required
•    Provides technical mentorship to the regional service teams and issues relevant technical bulletins and support alerts
•    Report technical escalation troubleshooting results and findings to Product Development using the Problem Report process
•    Responds to regional sales organization technical questions that have been escalated through regional resources
•    Review new feature use cases and performs new feature release testing as required to gain in-dept knowledge of feature functionality and provides feedback to Product Development
•    Supports regional technical services teams for customer escalations and as necessary works directly with customers for problem resolution
Education and Work Experience:
•    Undergraduate degree in engineering, graphic arts, or a technical curriculum is preferred
•    Work experience in graphic arts is recommended
Experience:
•    At least 5 years graphic arts or printing industry experience in a customer service environment is required
•    Minimum 3 years of product support experience
Personal Attributes:
•    A history of personal and professional credibility with peers, leadership and customers
•    Ability to adapt to a fast-changing environment and work well under pressure
•    Ability to work within a collaborative team environment
•    Able to convey customer and Kodak business value related to escalations and feature requests
•    Able to handle an unpredictable workload (including the willingness and ability to occasionally provide support outside of normal working hours, when required)
•    Able to work cooperatively and collaboratively within a team environment
•    Able to simplify complex support issues for various audiences
•    Excellent interpersonal skills, including teamwork, respect, courtesy, tact and discretion
•    Strong mentorship skills
•    Excellent written & verbal communication and technical documentation skills

Role Overview
Kodak is looking for Coating Operators to join our team in Kodak’s Advanced Materials and Chemicals Division in Rochester, NY. 
Operators work in a variety of roles, all of which are involved in manufacturing the highest-quality light-sensitive coated products in the world. Depending on qualifications and experience, operator candidates will be assigned a role in one of these three teams. 
Coating: Our unique and massive coating machines create the PET film base as well as coat light-sensitive materials onto the film base. Operators are responsible for ensuring that the coating machines run smoothly and that the coated products are free from imperfections.
Chemical: Our world-class coated products rely upon the interplay of multiple extremely thin chemical layers. Operators use precisely engineered processes to prepare all materials used in coating, including solvents, dyes, and light-sensitive emulsions. Experience dealing with large quantities of chemicals and understanding chemical Safety Data Sheets is helpful.
Quality: Our coated products are of the highest quality in the world. Operators inspect freshly coated film products for imperfections in structure or sensitivity that would affect their functionality and salability. A background in science may be helpful.
As an operator, you will potentially: 
•    Work in both light and dark room conditions.
•    Work 11-hour days or 12-hour rotating shifts.
•    Work overnights and possibly weekends.
Required skills and experience for all operators:
•    Must be a detail-orientated team player.
•    Must have the ability to be flexible between multiple positions, sometimes multi-tasking or moving within a shift.
•    Must work effectively with minimal supervision.
•    Ability to prioritize work to meet business needs.
•    Ability to express oneself communicate clearly, both written and verbal, and comprehend a variety of work requests
•    Willing to work overtime or adjust work schedule for business needs.
•    Must be willing and able to lift and move objects up to 50 pounds.
•    Ability to obtain Power Industrial Truck (fork truck) license at Kodak.
•    Positions require walking, standing, and frequent lifting, carrying, pulling, pushing, and occasional awkward positions.
•    Must maintain a clean work area.
•    Must maintain strict adherence to safety procedures and quality standards.
•    Computer proficiency including navigating screens and data entry.
•    Responsibility for specific manufacturing processes, inputs, outputs, and troubleshooting.
•    Be involved in product quality and process improvement activities.
•    Interact with engineers, technicians, and maintenance personnel.
Additional skills and experience preferred: 
•    At least 2 years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. 
•    Understanding of film photography.
•    Understanding of thin-film coating processes.
•    Strong problem solving, data analysis, and computer abilities (Excel, Word, etc.).
•    Knowledge of Outlook, One-LIMS, Felix, and the SAP system.

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
As a Sales Operations Associate in our Early Career Consult Program, you’ll help sales teams make informed decisions by turning business data into clear, useful insights.
You’ll be building practical experience across sales reporting, forecasting, data quality and business operations. Working alongside colleagues in sales, finance and operations, you’ll help teams understand pipeline, bookings, revenue and productivity. Your contributions will support accurate planning and help sales teams focus on the right actions.
This role will combine structured data analysis with collaborative operational support. Some of your time will be spent independently updating reports, reviewing data and investigating variances. You’ll also work with teammates to understand reporting needs, resolve data questions and improve processes.
You do not need to arrive knowing every sales process or platform. Through the Early Career Consult Program, you’ll be strengthening your business, technology and consulting skills while learning from experienced colleagues. You’ll gain hands-on experience with enterprise reporting and customer relationship management tools and develop the confidence to communicate data clearly to different audiences.
Your work will have a visible outcome: reliable information that helps teams plan, forecast and measure progress. As your capabilities grow, you’ll have opportunities to contribute ideas, take ownership of recurring activities and explore career paths across sales operations, business analytics and consulting.
What you will do
Turn data into useful insights
Prepare reports that show pipeline, bookings, revenue and seller productivity
Review sales results to identify trends, changes and potential data issues
Summarize findings so sales teams can understand what the data means
Compare actual results with forecasts and highlight important differences
Support planning and forecasting
Help maintain information used for sales planning and forecasting
Collect and organize data from agreed systems and business sources
Support budgeting, expense tracking and financial variance reviews
Complete recurring reporting activities accurately and by agreed deadlines
Maintain reliable sales information
Update dashboards, reports and trackers used by sales teams
Review CRM records and work with colleagues to resolve data gaps
Follow documented data standards and reporting processes
Test report updates and confirm that information displays as expected
Qualifying inbound and marketing-generated leads.
Conducting discovery conversations with prospects.
Managing lead follow-up and nurturing activities.
Partnering with account teams to convert MQLs to sales-ready opportunities.
Researching target accounts and contacts.
Booking meetings for sellers and supporting pipeline creation.
Maintaining CRM hygiene and tracking progression through the funnel.
Providing feedback to marketing on lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
Collaborate and improve
Work with sales, finance and operations teams to understand reporting needs
Document recurring processes so information is clear and easy to follow
Gather feedback and suggest practical improvements to reports and workflows
Use collaboration and AI-enabled productivity tools responsibly to organize and analyze information
Learn and grow
Build knowledge of sales operations, business analytics and consulting practices
Learn from experienced colleagues through coaching and hands-on assignments
Strengthen your skills in data analysis, reporting and business communication
Take on greater responsibility as your knowledge and confidence develop
Who You Are
Why Kyndryl:
We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.
Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
Required skills and experience
Bachelor’s degree, associate degree or equivalent practical experience completed recently or before the start date
Academic, internship, co-op, military, volunteer or project experience working with business data
Ability to organize data and identify patterns, differences or missing information
Experience using spreadsheets to sort, compare, calculate or present information
Ability to explain analytical findings clearly in writing, presentations or discussions
Demonstrated ability to complete structured tasks accurately and meet agreed deadlines
Ability to collaborate with teammates while managing assigned work independently
Interest in sales operations, business analytics, consulting or revenue management
Preferred skills and experience
Exposure to CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or similar tools
Experience with Power BI, Tableau or another reporting and visualization platform
Familiarity with pipeline, bookings, revenue, forecasting or budgeting concepts
Experience creating dashboards, reports or data presentations through coursework or projects
Experience using AI-enabled productivity tools for research, analysis or content development
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction now, and in the future. The company will not sponsor employment visas for this role. You must also be able to work at our Frisco office 5 days per week."
The compensation for this position is $77,000 based on a full-time schedule. The pay or salary range is not below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. 
This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off.  Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

 Projektledare
Vi på Materna har ett fokus på det vi kallar Next Generation Service Management där syftet är att koppla ihop systemstödet, processerna och människorna för att skapa mesta möjliga värde, nytta och effekt. Vi ser att Next Generation Service Management är en förutsättning för en effektiv digitalisering.
Vår verksamhet i Sverige expanderar och vi söker nu fler duktiga medarbetare med kompetens och erfarenhet inom projekt och programledning.
Vill du medverka till att utveckla våra kunders framtid och hjälpa deras verksamheter att bli bättre på det dom gör? Har du erfarenhet av projekt och programledning och djupgående insikt i hur verksamheter på ett strukturerat och tryggt sätt kan transformeras? Då är du den vi söker.
I din roll som projektledare kommer du att vara en del av Maternas växande projektorganisation och arbeta nära våra kunders verksamheter med rådgivning, styrning och transformation. Du kommer att leda projekt, genomföra projekteringar, leda förändringsarbete, genomföra riskanalyser och ta fram projektplaner mm i syfte att genomföra förändringar på ett professionellt sätt med tydliggjorda mål i fokus. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med vår arkitektorganisation i syfte att säkerställa helheten och motverka ”stuprörstänkande”. På Materna är kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning, personligt initiativ och engagemang viktiga komponenter. Vi erbjuder dig en möjlighet att medverka till organisationens tillväxt och framgång, i kombination med personlig och professionell utveckling.
Vi ser gärna att du dessutom har:
arbetat som projektledare eller motsvarande +4 år.
erfarenhet av att genomföra förstudier och proof-of-concept
god erfarenhet av att agera på samt eskalera risker och avvikelser
kompetens i att analysera och presentera konsekvenser på avvikelser från plan
lång erfarenhet av arbete som IT-konsult.
grundläggande förståelse för IT-infrastruktur, molnbaserade lösningar och integration.
grundläggande förståelse för systemarkitektur och integration.
erfarenhet av att genomföra analyser och förstudier.
grundläggande förståelse för drift och förvaltning
god presentationsförmåga och erfarenhet av att hålla workshops samt kunna uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
ledaregenskaper och stor vana att arbeta med ledningsgrupper och verksamhetschefer.
god förmåga att arbeta i lösningsteam tillsammans med kunder, partners och kollegor.
vilja och ambition att utvecklas vidare och dela din kunskap med andra.
lätt för att samarbeta i grupp
Materna Sverige ingår i Maternagruppen, ett av Europas ledande konsultbolag inom IT Service Management, med över 3500 anställda. Genom att kombinera vår expertkunskap med produkter och lösningar från marknadens ledande leverantörer har vi levererat framgångsrika IT- och förändringsprojekt till våra kunder under mer än 35 år.
På Materna får du möjlighet att jobba i teknikens framkant och vi erbjuder ett utmanande och omväxlande arbete, med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter och fördelaktiga anställningsvillkor.
Välkommen med din ansökan idag!
Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Kista, men det finns goda möjligheter för distansarbete. Vi intervjuar löpande för tjänsten, så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Om du har några frågor eller funderingar kring tjänsten tveka inte att höra av dig till Thobias Arnesson, Executive Vice President, via [email protected] eller telefon (070-836 42 05).
