I’m Nerijus Šarnas, Head of IT Service Management at Telia Lietuva, and I’m looking for an Infrastructure Services Automation Lead to help us make automation a core capability across ITSM.
Bring your engineering expertise. Shape the architecture. Set the technical direction for infrastructure automation.
You understand what it takes to turn manual processes into reliable automation. Now, use that experience to design scalable solutions, explore ideas through prototyping, and guide engineering teams from concept to implementation. Ready to shape how infrastructure services are automated at Telia?
What you’ll do:
You’ll own the ITSM automation function—from identifying opportunities and setting priorities to delivering reliable solutions through your team.
Lead and develop a team of automation engineers, setting clear direction, building their capabilities, and supporting delivery.
Turn operational challenges into automation opportunities, working with ITSM team leads and stakeholders to understand processes and define practical solutions.
Design, build, and maintain automation solutions, including runbook automation, operational workflows, and end-to-end process automation.
Shape our engineering approach, defining and evolving automation standards, tooling, and practices.
Own the automation roadmap, prioritizing initiatives and guiding them from idea to implementation.
Make the impact visible, measuring time and capacity saved, errors reduced, and improvements in service quality.
Scale automation across ITSM, helping teams reduce manual effort and adopt better ways of working.
What will help you thrive in this role:
You’re an engineer who has built automation that works in the real world—and you’re ready to help others do the same. You can go deep technically, understand the wider context, and bring people together around a clear outcome.
Hands-on IT automation experience: you’ve written code, built pipelines, and supported solutions running in production.
Practical knowledge of AWX / Ansible and Python, alongside relevant IT operations automation tools and frameworks.
The ability to transform a manual IT process into an automated workflow, understanding it end to end before designing the solution.
Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders, gathering requirements, agreeing on scope, and delivering solutions to real problems.
Curiosity and sound judgment: you ask useful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore the details when they matter.
Ownership and follow-through: you define success, drive delivery, and check whether the solution achieved its purpose.
Readiness to lead and develop others, alongside your own technical contribution.
Fluency in Lithuanian and English.
Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet
At Telia, we're a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Leading Telecommunications Operator, we drive long‑term progress through large‑scale, impactful projects in an inclusive environment.
Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive environment. Whether you're taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.
What we offer
At Telia, we care about your well-being, growth, and sense of belonging:
Additional health insurance and pension plans
Workation: work from anywhere in the EU for up to 30 days per year
Extra vacation days based on tenure (up to 5 additional days)
Discounts on Telia services, including free home internet
Partner offers and discounts (SPA, cafes, events)
Telia Kids Club: summer camps for employees' children
Company-supported sports activities (yoga, basketball, running)
Internal training, leadership programs and job shadowing to explore new roles
…and more.
Monthly salary range for this position 6160 Eur – 8500 Eur (gross) + annual performance. Although it may vary depending on your skills and experience.
Ready to make better happen?
If you're selected for the next stage, you'll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.
Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Nerijus Šarnas at nerijus.sarnas@telia.lt.
Equal opportunities
At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual's needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we're dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.
Join us and let’s make better happen – together!

CNC-operatör till Staffanstorp
Vi på TopWork söker nu erfarna CNC-operatörer till en kund i Staffanstorp. Här får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett stabilt team i en modern verkstad med fokus på kvalitet, precision och noggrannhet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter
Som CNC-operatör kommer du att arbeta med att ställa och köra CNC-maskiner samt följa produktionen från start till färdig detalj. Du kommer bland annat att läsa ritningar, mäta och kontrollera detaljer samt säkerställa att produktionen håller rätt kvalitet. I arbetet ingår även daglig tillsyn av maskinerna och enklare underhåll.
Programmeringskunskaper är meriterande, men det viktigaste är att du har en god praktisk erfarenhet av CNC och känner dig trygg i maskinerna.
Vi söker dig som
Har tidigare erfarenhet av CNC-bearbetning och är van vid att arbeta noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet. Du har god ritningsläsningsförmåga och erfarenhet av mätteknik. Som person är du ansvarstagande, tekniskt intresserad och trivs med att samarbeta med andra.
Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt, ta ansvar för ditt arbete och samtidigt vara en lagspelare i produktionen.

Key Account Manager
Join our mission towards a safe digital future
 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization. 
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference. 
The Role
At Truesec Denmark, we’re on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also: 
• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today. 
• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met. 
• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general. 
• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling. 
• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations. 
• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team. 
• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.  
Your Potential Background
To succeed in this role, we believe that you
• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.
• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.
• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.
• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.
• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.
• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Job Description
About TMEIC Europe
TMEIC drives industry around the world through a comprehensive offering of unique systems solutions including variable frequency drives, motors, generators, flywheels, photovoltaic inverters, BESS inverters and advanced automation systems for a wide range of industrial and energy applications. TMEIC was established in 2003 through the integration of the industrial systems divisions of Toshiba Corporation and Mitsubishi Electric Corporation.
General Role Description
This role is responsible for supporting the employee lifecycle across Europe, including payroll administration, HR operations, compensation and benefits, GDPR compliance, training activities, and people-related processes that contribute to the achievement of the Company’s Mid-Range Plan (MRP) objectives.
Role Accountabilities
Payroll
Manage the time and attendance system and coordinate with external payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing across European locations.
Handle payroll-related documentation and monthly HR data preparation
Administer employee benefits and welfare programs
Prepare and analyse HR reports and KPIs (e.g., absenteeism, overtime, headcount, labour cost and total employment cost).
HR policies and procedures
Maintain and update HR policies, procedures, and employee documentation to ensure compliance with local legislation and Company values.
HRIS 
Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of HR Information Systems (HRIS).
Training and Development
Support the HR Manager EMEA in the annual Performance and Development Review process, including goal setting, compensation review activities, and training planning.
Support the implementation of trainings
GDPR Regulation
Ensure compliance with GDPR requirements and maintain HR processes and documentation aligned with data privacy regulations.
General Employee Accountabilities
Bring full effort to bear on tasks assigned by manager
Notify the manager promptly when work cannot be delivered as specified.
Collaborate with peers and interact cross-organizationally as specified by manager
Exemplify Company Core Values: Teamwork and Accountability, Client Focus, Driving Progress and Integrity
Comply with all Company policies, practices, and procedures and all regulations and laws
Recommend viable improvements proactively
Ensure effective utilization of business tools and processes
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
Around 3 years of experience HR function, in particular in payroll and administration to achieve business goals
Good understanding of European labour laws, GDPR, and employment regulations
Demonstrated use of keen business acumen to develop effective HR strategies and priorities for improved business results
Demonstrated ability to manage tasks with hands-on, tactical work
Demonstrated success implementing, measuring, and improving HR programs
Demonstrated successful working relationships with clients, suppliers, and other internal and external contacts
Demonstrated successful and positive interpersonal, organizational, administrative, and communication skills
Demonstrated continuous improvement in areas of responsibility
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
German native speaker and fluency in English language, Italian knowledge will be a plus
Availability to travel, domestically and internationally, less than 20%, sometimes with limited notice
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
Multi-functional project management experience or management experience in a business function in addition to HR
Demonstrated success collaborating cross-functionally in a global, multicultural organization (preferably Japanese)
Proficiency in HRIS (HR Information Systems)
Experience supporting diverse employee base spanning multiple geographic locations, domestically and internationally
Proficiency in an additional European Languages (e.g. Polish, Spanish)

 Arbetsuppgifter
Vill du utvecklas inom försäljning i en miljö där gemenskap, driv och möjligheter står i fokus? 💫
Vi söker nu en ny kollega på deltid till vår butik i Kristianstad.
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 får du chansen att växa inom professionell rådgivning och försäljning. Du får en roll där du både utmanas och har riktigt roligt på jobbet, samtidigt som du utvecklas varje dag.
Det här får du hos oss
Hos oss får du mer än ett jobb - du får en miljö där du kan utvecklas, prestera och trivas på riktigt.
Fast lön + provision: En trygg grundlön kombinerat med en rörlig del som belönar dina resultat.
Utbildning och coachning: Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - hos oss får du en gedigen introduktion och det stöd du behöver för att utvecklas och lyckas i rollen.
Teamkultur med energi: Ett team där vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och firar framgångar tillsammans.
Tävlingar och gemensamma aktiviteter: Vi skapar energi i vardagen genom roliga tävlingar, aktiviteter och gemensamma firanden.
Karriärmöjligheter: Möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken.
Det här kommer du att göra
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 är du aktiv på butiksgolvet - du skapar själv möjligheter genom möten, initiativ och kundkontakt. Du spelar en viktig roll i att skapa både positiva kundupplevelser och framgångsrika affärer.
I rollen kommer du att:
Möta våra kunder i butik och hjälpa dem hitta rätt helhetslösningar.
Ta kontakt med både nya och befintliga kunder i butik och via telefon.
Arbeta rådgivande genom att förstå kundens behov och guida dem till rätt beslut.
Arbeta mot både individuella och gemensamma mål tillsammans med teamet.
Bidra till butikens dagliga drift, kampanjer och kundupplevelse.
Bidra till en positiv och energifylld arbetsmiljö.
Hur det är att jobba hos oss
Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de trivs, känner stöd och får möjlighet att lyckas tillsammans med andra. Därför har vi byggt butiker där gemenskap, energi och utveckling är centralt i det vi gör. Dagen börjar ofta tillsammans med teamet där vi går igenom dagens mål & fokus, delar erfarenheter och peppar varandra inför dagen. Under dagen varierar arbetet mellan kundmöten i butik, telefonsamtal med kunder och egna initiativ för att skapa affärsmöjligheter. Det som gör våra butiker speciella är människorna - både våra fantastiska kunder och kollegor. Här hjälper vi varandra, delar kunskap, firar framgångar och bidrar till en miljö där det är riktigt roligt att gå till jobbet. 💫
 Vi har riktigt bra förmåner
Tjänstepension
Möjlighet till interna karriärvägar och utveckling
Rabatter på Tele2s produkter och tjänster
Inkluderande arbetskultur
Lön och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
Stora utbildningsmöjligheter
 Kvalifikationer
För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är…
Vi tror att rätt inställning och personliga kompetenser är viktigare än en lång meritlista. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - det viktigaste är att du är driven och vill utvecklas.
Relationsskapande: Du trivs i mötet med människor, är nyfiken på kundens behov och bygger förtroende genom ett tryggt och professionellt bemötande.
Målmedveten: Du motiveras av att arbeta mot mål och tycker det är roligt att se resultat av ditt arbete.
Initiativtagande: Du tar ansvar, är proaktiv i ditt arbete och tar egna initiativ till att bidra och skapa resultat.
Driven: Du gillar att utvecklas, tar till dig feedback och vill bli bättre över tid.
Samarbetsinriktad: Du trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.
Flexibel: Du anpassar dig till nya situationer och har en positiv inställning till förändring och nya arbetssätt.
Kvalifikationer
Fullständig gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande.
Du har fyllt 18 år. (Enligt AFS 2023:2 5 kap. 7 § och 6 kap 8 § krävs det att du är 18 år för att kunna arbeta hos oss).
Flytande kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.
Godkänd bakgrundskontroll.
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av kundkontakt.
Erfarenhet av försäljning via exempelvis butik, telefon, mässor eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot uppsatta mål.
Goda kunskaper i engelska, ytterligare språkkunskaper är ett plus.
Vill du vara med? Tveka inte att söka redan idag! 💫
Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande, och som ett steg i rekryteringsprocessen utför Tele2 en bakgrundskontroll på aktuella slutkandidater. Eftersom vi eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning ser vi gärna kvinnliga sökande till den här tjänsten.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! För att säkerställa en inkluderande och rättvis rekryteringsprocess fokuserar vi på dina erfarenheter och kompetenser. Därför har Tele2 valt att inte använda personliga brev och vi ber dig istället besvara de urvalsfrågor som ingår i ansökningsformuläret.
 Några av våra medarbetare
Paulin
Butikssäljare Asecs Jönköping
 "Det är en inkluderande och fartfylld miljö med genuint fokus på kundens bästa.​"
Afroza
Butikschef Mobila Malmö
 "Fantastiskt att få kunna ge våra kunder service i världsklass!"
 Om företaget
Tele2 är en nordisk och baltisk telekomoperatör byggd på en stark utmanarkultur. Sedan 1993 har Tele2 utmanat etablerade normer i telekombranschen genom att göra uppkoppling enklare, smartare och mer kostnadseffektiv för våra kunder. Tele2 erbjuder mobila och fasta tjänster, TV och streaming samt IoT‑lösningar till konsumenter och företag i Norden och Baltikum.
Hållbarhet är en integrerad del av hur vi arbetar. Tele2 har uppmärksammats som Europas klimatledare av Financial Times och utsetts till Sveriges mest hållbara bolag, vilket speglar vårt långsiktiga engagemang för att minska vår miljöpåverkan och driva cirkulära lösningar tillsammans med våra kunder.
Våra värderingar – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple och Act Cost-efficiently – vägleder vår kultur, hur vi samarbetar och hur vi omsätter idéer till handling.

företagslösningar, både fysiskt och via mobil, för att ge bästa möjliga service.

mobilen, klockan uppkopplad eller skärmskyddet monterat.
 -Vi strävar efter att våra team ska spegla våra kunder i ålder, kön och bakgrund och
jobbar aktivt med mångfald och inkludering i allt vi gör.
 -Många börjar sin karriär hos oss i butik, men vägarna framåt är många. Våra tidigare

We are looking for a Hybrid Cloud Technician to join us at Telia Cygate.
Would you like to support and operate Cloud and Hybrid IT solutions in a collaborative environment that values continuous learning and diverse perspectives? Whether you bring extensive experience or are ready to take the next step in your career, this could be the opportunity for you.
My name is Daniel Jastér, and I lead the Hybrid IT & Cloud team at Telia Cygate. We are looking for a new colleague to join us as a Hybrid Cloud Technician. In this role, you will apply your expertise, develop alongside experienced colleagues, and contribute to shaping the future of digital infrastructure.
What you’ll do:
As a Hybrid Cloud Technician, you will help our customers maintain stable, secure, and reliable IT environments. Your responsibilities will include resolving incidents and service requests, performing maintenance and development activities, and working with specialist and support teams to address more complex issues. The role covers configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting, with a particular focus on Cloud and Hybrid IT. 
You will not only work with today’s technology but also help shape the solutions of tomorrow. As part of our AI initiative, you will have the opportunity to explore emerging solutions, strengthen your expertise, and contribute ideas on how AI can create value for both customers and employees.
You are not expected to know everything from day one. You will be supported by experienced colleagues and given opportunities to continuously develop your skills.
Your responsibilities may include:
Microsoft 365 environments: Maintenance, monitoring, security configuration, administration, and troubleshooting.
Windows Servers and Active Directory Domain Services: Server configuration, Group Policies, domain controller management, and Certificate Services (PKI) administration.
Microsoft Defender and security solutions: Administration, monitoring, and configuration of Microsoft Defender and Advanced Threat Protection.
VMware platforms: Management, monitoring, and troubleshooting of virtual environments. Snapshots, backups, and restoration of virtual machines.
Linux, Kubernetes, and containers: Management, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Veeam backup management: Configuration, monitoring, scheduling, and troubleshooting.
Troubleshooting through log analysis: Analysis of server and client logs.
Collaboration: Supporting the Service Desk and other support teams with technical challenges and incidents.
What will help you thrive in this role:
You are motivated by solving problems, building trust, and helping customers overcome technical challenges. You collaborate effectively, share knowledge openly, and value constructive feedback. We place equal importance on curiosity, a structured approach, and a willingness to develop as we do on having all the answers from the outset.
You have relevant IT experience gained through employment, education, or another setting in which you have developed equivalent expertise.
Experience in several of the following areas is considered an advantage: Windows Server, Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Defender, Active Directory Domain Services, Linux, container platforms, Kubernetes, and Backup & Restore.
General understanding of IT infrastructure, operating systems, networking, and end-user environments is considered an advantage.
Excellent communication skills, with fluency in Swedish (native or near-native) and good English. 
Additional requirements
Telia is part of critical infrastructure and parts of our operations are subject to security protection. Depending on the role, vetting activities may be required prior to employment. In some cases, additional eligibility requirements, including specific citizenship requirements, may apply.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification. If the role interests you and you believe you can make a valuable contribution, we would be pleased to hear from you.
Why Telia Cygate? 
At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun! As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile. Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.
Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.
Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!
Telia Cygate is proud to be certificated as Great Place to Work! 
With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.
What we offer 
When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.
Interested? Apply!
We look forward to receiving your application by 2026-11-01. Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!
Location: Solna or Gothenburg. This position offers a hybrid working arrangement.
If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. 
Background and reference checks will be part of the process.
Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Daniel Jastér at daniel.jaster@cygate.se.
We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.
Equal opportunities
At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager for our commercial organization. 
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.
The Role
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Key Account Manager to join our Truesec team and play a pivotal role in accelerating growth across the Finish market.
As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for new businesses and managing relationships, also develop a portfolio of strategic customers. By acting as a trusted advisor and business partner to senior stakeholders, your mission is to identify opportunities, create long-term value, and drive sustainable revenue growth by aligning our services with our customers’ business objectives.
This is not a transactional sales role. We are looking for someone who thrives on building executive relationships, uncovering strategic opportunities, navigating complex organisations, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
What you will do: 
• Initiate and drive new business acquisitions.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with major Enterprise clients, ensuring their needs are met and they are satisfied with Truesec’s services.
• Serve as the main point of contact for client inquiries, concerns, and feedback, providing timely and effective solutions.
• Gain a deep understanding of clients’ business objectives and cybersecurity needs.
• Identify and capitalize on opportunities to upsell and cross-sell Truesec’s products and services.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to client needs.
• Monitor and report on account performance, client satisfaction, and market trends. 
• Prepare and present regular account reviews and reports to both clients and Truesec’s management.
• Handle any client issues or complaints with professionalism and efficiency.
• Stay informed about industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive landscape to provide clients with the best possible advice and solutions.
Your Potential Background
Too succeed in this role, we believe that you 
• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.
• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.
• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.
• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted partnerships and creating value for customers.
• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.
• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.
• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Finish and English.
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Finnish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Finnish work permit. 
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Job Description
Would you like to work for an internationally renowned Company, who can provide internal training support and development as well as a great benefits package and the opportunity to grow within the business? Our Service division are looking for a dedicated problem solver to work within our field-based team; to provide support and proactive maintenance for our customers.
We are part of the IT and Document Solutions segment of Toshiba and cover the whole of the UK. To find out more about us, please visit www.toshibatec.co.uk.
What to Expect
Once trained on our products, you will be out in the field relatively quickly, utilising your current knowledge of MFPs and/ or Printers.
You will be responsible for providing post-sales/ implementation and technical support services to customers including installation, troubleshooting, problem resolution and maintenance.
You will be required to respond to customer questions regarding operation and malfunctions and advise customers on preventative maintenance and configuration adjustments to improve product performance and customer satisfaction.
As part of your role, you will cover the Sheffield and surrounding areas, with the expectation that on occasion you may be required to travel slightly further afield including Wales to cover holidays or other absences.
Responsibilities and Duties
Installing, maintaining and diagnosis of machine faults as per Company Guidelines and SLA’s on specified Toshiba MFP equipment.
Escalating issues to a Senior Technician / Manager when required.
Work proactively to achieve individual, team and Company SLAs and productivity levels.
Monitor and maintain adequate stock levels.
Regular contact with call centre to maintain accurate reporting.
Develop and maintain a good rapport with the call centre, making regular contact with established call opening and closing procedures with accurately reported work/travel times.
Ensure all relevant paperwork is completed and submitted in a timely manner.
Training customers to be proficient in the use of their equipment.
To observe and maintain a professional company approach to all customers in developing and building a good rapport.
Develop and maintain a high level of product knowledge and skills.
Comply with Group Policies, Procedures and Objectives.
Perform other such reasonable tasks and responsibilities which may from time to time be required.
Qualifications and Skills Required
A full UK driver’s licence and the flexibility to travel with the role.
Professional written and verbal communication skills across all levels.
Strong customer service skills.
Ability to display tact and diplomacy when dealing with difficult situations and people.
Good working knowledge of Health & Safety procedures both within Toshiba and customer premises.
Effective workload scheduling and prioritising.
Proven Electromechanical Skills.
Ability to support department with networking of machines to client systems.
Good time management and organising skills.
Computer literacy (Microsoft Office).
The ideal candidate will have past experience of supporting MFDs in a comparable role and any Toshiba product knowledge would of course be ideal, however, we are open to considering individuals who can demonstrate experience of supporting MFDs as part of a wider IT support role, and/ or candidates who have supported a comparable hardware product, with transferrable skills.
For those candidates with more to learn technically, we will invest in the necessary training and development opportunities, provided they demonstrate suitable attributes to take on the role, including the drive and motivation to learn and succeed.
We operate Monday to Friday and our engineers are on customer sites attending calls during business hours. There may be occasional overtime.
Your region will cover the North of the UK, and will vary depending on the needs of the business, customer locations and at times, covering absences/ holidays in the team. It would suit someone in the Sheffield area, but will cover a wider region depending on the needs of the business,.

Digital Forensic Incident Responder (DFIR)
Join our mission towards a safe digital future
 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Digital Forensic Incident Responder to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response business unit.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Digital Forensic Incident Responder (DFIR) who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.
CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)
Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in Sweden and worldwide. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber-attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.
The Role
You will be part of our dedicated, global Incident Response Team, assisting customers that are affected by cyber-attacks, by collecting file-, memory-, and network-related information and logfiles, connecting the dots and backtracking exactly what a threat actor has done in the environment to locate possible backdoors, data exfiltration, or proof of other malicious activity.
Your Potential Background
We believe that you have a background in penetration testing, red teaming, or enterprise security. You possess a thorough, analytic, and organized mindset with a good understanding of how a corporate enterprise IT environment works, and how threat actors operate when gaining access. You, as a person, actively seek solutions
and like to work as part of a team with members that collaborate, help, and support each other.
Required Skills:
Analytic mindset
Scripting skills
Enterprise IT understanding
Report writing
Bonus Skills:
Memory and disk analytics
Linux/AWS/Google Cloud.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Är du elektriker och gillar när arbetsdagarna innehåller mer än bara rutin?
Vi söker en underhållselektriker till en industriverksamhet i Ronneby där produktionen är tekniskt avancerad och till stor del automatiserad. Här får du en varierad roll där du arbetar nära både maskiner och produktion – med allt från felsökning och reparationer till förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar.
Det här är en tjänst för dig som tycker om att hitta felet, förstå problemet och få utrustningen att fungera igen.
Om tjänsten:
Ingen dag behöver vara den andra lik. Du kommer att arbeta med elektriska system och produktionsutrustning, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att bredda dina kunskaper inom automation.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
Felsöka och åtgärda elektriska problem i produktionsutrustning
Arbeta med förebyggande underhåll för att minska driftstörningar
Hantera akuta fel när produktionen behöver snabb hjälp
Delta i förbättringar av maskiner och tekniska lösningar
Medverka vid installation och uppstart av ny utrustning
Arbeta med komponenter och system inom exempelvis PLC, motorer, givare och servodrifter
Samarbeta med produktion och andra tekniska funktioner
Vara med och utveckla arbetssätt inom underhåll och digitalisering
Vi söker dig som:
Du har en bakgrund inom el och har erfarenhet av att arbeta praktiskt med felsökning och underhåll i industrimiljö.
Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Viktigare är att du är tekniskt nyfiken, gillar att lösa problem och har viljan att utvecklas.
Vi ser gärna att du har:
Elteknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet
Erfarenhet från industri, gärna inom underhåll
God förståelse för elektriska system
Vana av att arbeta med dator och teknisk dokumentation
Erfarenhet av PLC, automation eller servoteknik är meriterande
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
Har B-körkort
Som person är du nyfiken, noggrann och lösningsorienterad. Du kan arbeta självständigt när situationen kräver det, men trivs också med att lösa problem tillsammans med andra.
Du blir en del av ett tekniskt team där ditt arbete har direkt betydelse för produktionens tillgänglighet och utveckling.

Į Šiauliuose dirbančią Telia Service Desk komandą ieškome IT Specialisto (-ės), kuri(s) sustiprintų ją savo talentu. Aš esu Alvyda Prižgintienė, vadovaujanti Verslo klientų IT pagalbos komandai. Tai savo srities profesionalai, kurie padės tau augti.
Kaip IT specialistas (-ė) tu…
Pasirūpinsi klientų poreikiais, patarsi bei padėsi išspręsti IT problemas. Nors bendraujant su klientais daug laiko dirbsi savarankiškai, draugiška komanda tau padės. Esi pasiruošęs (-usi) žengti kitą savo karjeros žingsnį? Tuomet kviečiu pas mus.
Ko mes ieškome
Komunikabilaus ir geranoriško žmogaus, kuris myli technologijas bei mėgaujasi tiek individualiu, tiek komandiniu darbu. O taip pat nori nuolat atrasti kažką naujo ir tobulėti.
Kas tau padės augti šioje pozicijoje:
Privalumu laikytume IT problemų šalinimo bei konsultavimo dirbant su verslo/privačiais klientais patirtį.
Aukštasis išsilavinimas (gali būti paskutinių kursų studentas (-ė)).
Geri anglų kalbos (žodžiu ir raštu) įgūdžiai.
Prisijunk prie mūsų ir kurk išmanesnį rytojų žmonėms, verslui ir planetai
Prisijunk prie daugiau nei 15 000 Telia kolegų Skandinavijos ir Baltijos šalyse - čia kuriame technologinius sprendimus, kurie keičia kasdienybę. Esame pripažinti inovacijų ir tvarumo lyderiai, dirbame su pažangiausiomis technologijomis, o svarbiausia – vertiname žmones. Mūsų komandoje jausiesi laukiamas, įvertintas ir turėsi visas galimybes augti bei kurti prasmingus pokyčius. Nesvarbu, ar tai tavo pirmas darbas, ar naujas karjeros etapas - Telia yra vieta, kur būti verta.
Ką siūlome:
Nuolat investuojame į darbuotojų gerovę – nuo profesinio tobulėjimo iki emocinės sveikatos stiprinimo:
Papildomas sveikatos draudimas ir pensijų kaupimo planai.
Papildomos atostogų dienos pagal darbo stažą (iki 5 papildomų dienų).
Nuolaidos Telia paslaugoms, įskaitant nemokamą namų internetą.
Partnerių pasiūlymai ir nuolaidos (SPA, kavinės, renginiai).
„Telia vaikų klubas“: vasaros stovyklos darbuotojų vaikams.
Įmonės finansuojama sporto veikla (joga, krepšinis, bėgimas).
Vidiniai mokymai, lyderystės programos ir kolegų darbo stebėjimo galimybės norint keisti karjeros kryptį.
...ir dar daugiau www.telia.lt/karjera/kodel-verta-dirbti-telia.
Šiai pozicijai siūlomas mėnesinis atlygis - 1500-2300 Eur gross (neatskaičius mokesčių).
Ready to make better happen?
Laukiame tavo CV iki 2026-11-12. Atkreipk dėmesį – atranka gali baigtis anksčiau, jei rasime tinkamą kandidatą, tad nedelsk.
Jei būsi pakviestas(-a) į kitą etapą, su tavimi susisieksime asmeniškai. Finaliniams kandidatams bus atliekama saugumo ir rekomendacijų patikra.
Nori sužinoti daugiau? Susisiek su manimi alvyda.prizgintiene@telia.lt.
Lygios galimybės visiems
Telia vertiname žmones pagal jų kompetencijas ir augimo potencialą. Skatiname įvairovę ir užtikriname, kad kiekvienas jaustųsi saugiai, nepriklausomai nuo negalios, lyties, amžiaus, tautybės, seksualinės orientacijos ar socialinio statuso. Kartu kuriame įtraukią darbo aplinką, kur tavo unikalumas yra mūsų stiprybė.
Join us and let’s make better happen - together!

Job Description
Business Development Manager – London
Are you a successful salesperson looking to build your career with a business built on years of outstanding reputation?
Whether you're an experienced BDM looking for a new opportunity, or at the start of your sales career looking to step into a role with more responsibility, we have a training and development path in place for you to develop a successful future with us and we are open to applications at a range of levels.
We’re seeking individuals with a natural ability to win and develop new business, gained through a telesales, recruitment, estate agency or similar background.
The Role: 
Identify and develop new business opportunities and promote and sell Toshiba’s MFP print hardware products and services
Undertake lead generation activities via high volume cold calling (250+ per week)
Develop new business opportunities from making initial calls, to booking discovery meetings
Handle the full sales process, from outreach to retention
Work closely with clients, establishing and developing relationships
Present products and services effectively to prospective clients, ensuring clear communication of value propositions
Serve as a link of communication between key customers and internal teams, liaising with operations and other stakeholders to ensure excellent level of customer service
Report and forecast regional sales pipeline/achievements to the Head of Direct Sales
Be visible and interactive with new and existing customers
Remain up to date with market changes and competitor activity while delivering sales initiative and campaigns
What you will have to succeed:
Proven experience in a high-volume sales role
B2B sales experience
A proactive approach with a high level of self-motivation and resilience in a competitive environment
A proven track record generating new business
The ability to offer tailored solutions that meet the specific needs of clients
This is an excellent opportunity to take the next step in your sales career, where you will have the opportunity to build long-term relationships with the customers you bring in, stepping out of the office to meet clients and spotting opportunities to develop your accounts further through networking, cross-selling and up-selling.
The basic salary will depend upon your experience up to £35k, with realistic year 1 OTE of £60k, plus £5100 travel allowance and other benefits.
You will be based in our Monument office, with an expectation that some of your time will be spent meeting with customers and some flexibility around hybrid working.

Digital Forensic Incident Responder (DFIR)
Join our mission towards a safe digital future
 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Digital Forensic Incident Responder to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response business unit.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Digital Forensic Incident Responder (DFIR) who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.
CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)
Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in Sweden and worldwide. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber-attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.
The Role
You will be part of our dedicated, global Incident Response Team, assisting customers that are affected by cyber-attacks, by collecting file-, memory-, and network-related information and logfiles, connecting the dots and backtracking exactly what a threat actor has done in the environment to locate possible backdoors, data exfiltration, or proof of other malicious activity.
Your Potential Background
We believe that you have a background in penetration testing, red teaming, or enterprise security. You possess a thorough, analytic, and organized mindset with a good understanding of how a corporate enterprise IT environment works, and how threat actors operate when gaining access. You, as a person, actively seek solutions and like to work as part of a team with members that collaborate, help, and support each other.
Required Skills:
Analytic mindset
Scripting skills
Enterprise IT understanding
Report writing
Bonus Skills:
Memory and disk analytics
Linux/AWS/Google Cloud.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

 Job Description
Are you passionate about APIs, thrive on bringing structure and efficiency to team workflows, and ready to shape the future of API management? Join us to work with cutting-edge technology, drive innovation, and take your skills to the next level!
Join our dynamic team at Tele2, where Digital Capabilities & Technology (DCT) is the engine behind our products and services. As the essential enabler of our commercial ambitions, DCT brings automation and simplicity to the telecommunications industry, revolutionizing the way we connect and communicate. Within our organization, you’ll find everything from the backbone infrastructure of technology and IT systems, serving both our external & internal customers, to advanced analytics, AI creation, and frontend development. Our team plays a vital role in ensuring reliable and premium services through delivering exceptional experiences to our end customers, both Consumer and Enterprises, all the while supporting our colleagues within Tele2.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You will be an integral part of the API Team, enabling customers to access Tele2 services via APIs from various frontend channels. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional experience for both consumer and business customers by providing the necessary data they need. We offer services that allow data to be consumed by other applications and systems, managing these services from start to finish. Beyond just technical delivery, you'll also be instrumental in helping us refine our processes, ensure our work is well-organized, and contribute to the overall efficiency of the team. Our team operates within the Microsoft stack, fostering a culture where teamwork and inclusion are paramount.
Your tasks and responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):
· Developing and maintaining APIs built in .NET
· Managing and maintaining Azure API Management
· Communicating and supporting numerous stakeholders as a central component
· Providing specialist support across the organization for API management
· Sharing your expertise with the team and learning new skills from others
· Adhering to patterns that promote robust services and continuously improving the team’s capabilities
· Actively contributing to and refining team processes, workflows, and best practices to enhance clarity and efficiency.
· Helping to organize and prioritize team initiatives, ensuring a structured approach to problem-solving and delivery.
What we look for:
We are a collaborative team that works closely with other backend and frontend teams to coordinate our efforts. Maintaining strong relationships with architects and being able to navigate unclear information to create our own requirements is crucial. Beyond technical prowess, you possess a keen eye for detail and a drive to bring structure and clarity to complex problems and workflows. You are comfortable taking initiative in organizing team activities and ensuring that projects progress in a well-planned manner.
To be successful in this role and a good fit for our team, you should have a strong ambition to develop new functionalities while managing and maintaining existing solutions.
To thrive in this role, we believe that you have:
· At least some years of experience in API development using .NET
· Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms
· Knowledge of Docker, deploy pipelines, and Kubernetes terminology
· Some experience with JavaScript/React for working with Backstage
· Basic knowledge of security concepts (encryption with keys, SSL/TLS, HTTPS)
· A proactive, curious and organization-minded approach to problem-solving and team collaboration
· Demonstrated ability to contribute to process improvement, workflow optimization, or team organization within a software development context.

A culture of natural born challengers – At Tele2 we don’t just do things the traditional way. We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to create smarter and more valuable solutions for our customers. You will be part of a culture that values curiosity, initiative and collaboration, where new ideas are welcomed and everyone’s contribution matters. 
Inclusive and supportive environment – We believe in fostering a creative and flexible workplace where people can bring their whole selves to work. Diversity and inclusion are important to us, and we strive to create an environment where people feel welcome, respected and supported in growing both personally and professionally. 
 A sustainability challenger – We are proud that Tele2 has been recognised as Europe’s Climate Leader by the Financial Times and named as Sweden’s most sustainable company by Time Magazine and Statista, reflecting our strong commitment to reduce emissions, transparency and long-term climate goals. Our efforts focus on three areas where we can make the biggest difference: advancing a circular economy, combating climate change, and protecting children online. By embedding these focus areas into how we operate and innovate, we aim to create positive impact for people, planet and profit.

Identity Engineer – Sailpoint
Join our mission towards a safe digital future
 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Identity Engineers with a focus on Sailpoint to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Identity & Access Management domain.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond and Recover.
Today, we employ more than 400 employees – and as the demand for cybersecurity grows, we need to grow too. We are looking for Identity Engineers – Sailpoint to join our Identity & Access Management (IAM) team operating in Denmark and Sweden.
So, if you want to become an expert in a growing security discipline within one of the leading technologies, alongside a dynamic, ambitious, and welcoming team of specialists, then you might be what we are looking for.
Identity Security team
Our team of experts includes professionals with diverse skill sets: engineers, consultants, architects, process specialists, and strategists. Together, we support our customers to prepare, initiate, develop and mature their IAM programs.
As a dedicated SailPoint partner in the Nordics, we take pride in contributing to the security and management of over 40,000 identities.
Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. You will be surrounded by experts who support and challenge each other to grow, whether through knowledge-sharing, hands-on problem-solving, or staying ahead of the latest identity threats. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger, which is why we value team members from different backgrounds, industries, and walks of life.
The Role you can own if you join the team
As a Identity Engineer – Sailpoint, you will join a dedicated and supportive team of identity experts, working together to help our customers implement and maintain cutting-edge SailPoint technologies. You’ll collaborate closely with architects and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into robust identity solutions. Whether you’re configuring connectors, designing rules and workflows, or developing custom provisioning logic, you’ll play a key role in delivering secure and efficient identity management for our clients.
Typical tasks could be:
Work with architects and stakeholders to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Configure and maintain SailPoint connectors, design rules, and Life Cycle Management (LCM) workflows.
Develop and maintain provisioning solutions tailored to customer application landscapes.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues within SailPoint IdentityIQ environments.
Document processes, configurations, and solutions to ensure knowledge sharing and compliance.
Support the integration of SailPoint with various platforms and applications.
Participate in test and release management for identity solutions.
Your Potential Background
You might come from a variety of backgrounds, such as system administration or consulting, with hands-on experience in implementing SailPoint technologies. Whether you have worked on new projects or maintained existing installations, your technical curiosity and structured approach set you apart. If you enjoy working collaboratively, taking responsibility, and seeing projects through from start to finish, we would love to hear from you. 
What would we like to see from you? 
Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud. 
Proficiency in Java and Beanshell scripting. 
Experience with PowerShell and Log4j2.
Familiarity with on-prem environments and the underlying infrastructure required to operate SailPoint solutions. 
Ability to communicate clearly in English, both orally and in writing. 
A strong desire to learn and grow within the identity space. 
You get bonus points if you tick one or more of these boxes: 
While the following skills and experiences are a plus, they are not required—if you are motivated to learn and grow, we encourage you to apply! 
Previous experience with Active Directory & Entra ID. 
Knowledge of Azure IaaS & PaaS, Microsoft Graph, and Apache Tomcat. 
Familiarity with databases and SQL. Experience with SAML, OAuth, LDAP, and authentication protocols. 
Knowledge of Windows/Linux Server environments. 
Understanding of REST/SOAP web services, JSON, and SCIM 2.0. 
SailPoint certifications are highly appreciated.
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Kontaktinformation: Karin Lantz
Sista ansökningdag: 2026-11-01
Är du i början av din IT-karriär och har grundläggande förståelse för lösningar inom traditionella IT-miljöer/OnPrem, såsom: servrar, backup/lagring, nätverk eller applikationer? Då vill jag lära känna dig! Jag heter Karin Lantz, Konsultchef för en driftgruppering i Växjö. Nu söker jag dig som vill starta din karriär med oss och att leverera säkra och stabila IT lösningar till våra kunder.  
Vad du kommer att göra i rollen
Konsultrollen på Telia Cygate är bred och det finns stora möjligheter för dig att utveckla dina färdigheter i flera olika riktningar beroende på vad du är intresserad av. Du kommer tillhöra en växande organisation som uppmuntrar dig på din egna utvecklingsresa och vill du certifiera dig på något område så uppmuntrar vi det.  
För att lyckas i rollen
Som person är du social och har lätt för att kommunicera med både kunder och kollegor. Du är en problemlösare som gillar att hjälpa och är inte rädd för att ge dig på ny teknik och nya utmaningar. Vidare har du ett brinnande intresse för IT och vill utvecklas vidare i din roll. Du har lätt för att lära dig nya saker och drivs av att arbeta med kunden i fokus. Du tycker troligtvis att det är roligt med merförsäljning och har ett sinne för att vända teknik till affärsnytta.
Din personlighet:
Du är initiativtagande
Du vill lyckas tillsammans med andra
Du förhåller dig positiv och konstruktiv även vid misslyckanden
Varför Telia Cygate?
På Telia Cygate är vi inte bara experter på nätverk, säkerhet och olika slags moln – vi är också ett gäng som tycker att det ska vara kul att gå till jobbet! Som en del av Telia Company har vi styrkan att skapa verklig påverkan i stor skala, bidra till samhällsnytta och hjälpa våra kunder att navigera i digitaliseringens värld. Vi gör det alltid med värme, omtanke och ett leende. Här är det idéerna och våra olika perspektiv som gör oss starka, och tillsammans ser vi till att teknikens värld blir en plats där alla trivs – och där du hör hemma. 
Hos oss är din utveckling viktig. Vi uppmuntrar till kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och ser till att just du och dina intressen är i fokus. Vi vet att det är människorna som utgör vårt företag, och därför värdesätter vi glädje, kreativitet och olika perspektiv i allt vi gör.  
Välkommen att växa tillsammans med oss, där vi gör teknik mänsklig och skapar verklig påverkan! 
Vad vi erbjuder 
När du börjar hos oss får du ett omfattande förmånspaket anpassat efter din lokala marknad, möjlighet till hybridarbete och mer. Du har också chans att få bonus baserat på din prestation och Telias resultat.  
Låter det intressant? 
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast 2026-11-01. Rollen kan komma att stängas tidigare om vi hittar rätt kandidat – så vänta inte för länge! 
Placeringsort: Växjö, Norrköping, Jönköping
Om du går vidare i processen kommer du att kontaktas av vår Talent Acquisition Partner. Bakgrund- och referenskontroller ingår i processen. 
Vill du veta mer om rollen? Kontakta gärna Karin Lantz på karin.lantz@cygate.se eller via LinkedIn.
Lika möjligheter för alla 
På Telia värderar vi kompetens och utvecklingspotential. Vi främjar mångfald och ser till att varje individs behov tillgodoses, oavsett funktionsvariation, kön, ålder, nationalitet, sexuell läggning eller social bakgrund. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där din unikhet är vår styrka. 
Välkommen till Telia Cygate – Home of Experts

Teamkultur med energi: Ett team där vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och firar framgångar tillsammans.
Tävlingar och gemensamma aktiviteter: Vi skapar energi i vardagen genom roliga tävlingar, aktiviteter och gemensamma firanden.
Karriärmöjligheter: Möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken.
Det här kommer du att göra
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 är du aktiv på butiksgolvet - du skapar själv möjligheter genom möten, initiativ och kundkontakt. Du spelar en viktig roll i att skapa både positiva kundupplevelser och framgångsrika affärer.
I rollen kommer du att:
Möta våra kunder i butik och hjälpa dem hitta rätt helhetslösningar.
Ta kontakt med både nya och befintliga kunder i butik och via telefon.
Arbeta rådgivande genom att förstå kundens behov och guida dem till rätt beslut.
Arbeta mot både individuella och gemensamma mål tillsammans med teamet.
Bidra till butikens dagliga drift, kampanjer och kundupplevelse.
Bidra till en positiv och energifylld arbetsmiljö.
Hur det är att jobba hos oss
Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de trivs, känner stöd och får möjlighet att lyckas tillsammans med andra. Därför har vi byggt butiker där gemenskap, energi och utveckling är centralt i det vi gör. Dagen börjar ofta tillsammans med teamet där vi går igenom dagens mål & fokus, delar erfarenheter och peppar varandra inför dagen. Under dagen varierar arbetet mellan kundmöten i butik, telefonsamtal med kunder och egna initiativ för att skapa affärsmöjligheter. Det som gör våra butiker speciella är människorna - både våra fantastiska kunder och kollegor. Här hjälper vi varandra, delar kunskap, firar framgångar och bidrar till en miljö där det är riktigt roligt att gå till jobbet. 💫
 Vi har riktigt bra förmåner
Tjänstepension
Möjlighet till interna karriärvägar och utveckling
Rabatter på Tele2s produkter och tjänster
Inkluderande arbetskultur
Lön och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
Stora utbildningsmöjligheter
 Kvalifikationer
För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är…
Vi tror att rätt inställning och personliga kompetenser är viktigare än en lång meritlista. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - det viktigaste är att du är driven och vill utvecklas.
Relationsskapande: Du trivs i mötet med människor, är nyfiken på kundens behov och bygger förtroende genom ett tryggt och professionellt bemötande.
Målmedveten: Du motiveras av att arbeta mot mål och tycker det är roligt att se resultat av ditt arbete.
Initiativtagande: Du tar ansvar, är proaktiv i ditt arbete och tar egna initiativ till att bidra och skapa resultat.
Driven: Du gillar att utvecklas, tar till dig feedback och vill bli bättre över tid.
Samarbetsinriktad: Du trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.
Flexibel: Du anpassar dig till nya situationer och har en positiv inställning till förändring och nya arbetssätt.
Kvalifikationer
Fullständig gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande.
Du har fyllt 18 år. (Enligt AFS 2023:2 5 kap. 7 § och 6 kap 8 § krävs det att du är 18 år för att kunna arbeta hos oss).
Flytande kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.
Godkänd bakgrundskontroll.
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av kundkontakt.
Erfarenhet av försäljning via exempelvis butik, telefon, mässor eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot uppsatta mål.
Goda kunskaper i engelska, ytterligare språkkunskaper är ett plus.
Vill du vara med? Tveka inte att söka redan idag! 💫
Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande, och som ett steg i rekryteringsprocessen utför Tele2 en bakgrundskontroll på aktuella slutkandidater. Eftersom vi eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning ser vi gärna kvinnliga sökande till den här tjänsten.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! För att säkerställa en inkluderande och rättvis rekryteringsprocess fokuserar vi på dina erfarenheter och kompetenser. Därför har Tele2 valt att inte använda personliga brev och vi ber dig istället besvara de urvalsfrågor som ingår i ansökningsformuläret.
 Några av våra medarbetare
Paulin
Butikssäljare Asecs Jönköping
 "Det är en inkluderande och fartfylld miljö med genuint fokus på kundens bästa.​"
Afroza
Butikschef Mobila Malmö
 "Fantastiskt att få kunna ge våra kunder service i världsklass!"
 Om företaget
Tele2 är en nordisk och baltisk telekomoperatör byggd på en stark utmanarkultur. Sedan 1993 har Tele2 utmanat etablerade normer i telekombranschen genom att göra uppkoppling enklare, smartare och mer kostnadseffektiv för våra kunder. Tele2 erbjuder mobila och fasta tjänster, TV och streaming samt IoT‑lösningar till konsumenter och företag i Norden och Baltikum.
Hållbarhet är en integrerad del av hur vi arbetar. Tele2 har uppmärksammats som Europas klimatledare av Financial Times och utsetts till Sveriges mest hållbara bolag, vilket speglar vårt långsiktiga engagemang för att minska vår miljöpåverkan och driva cirkulära lösningar tillsammans med våra kunder.
Våra värderingar – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple och Act Cost-efficiently – vägleder vår kultur, hur vi samarbetar och hur vi omsätter idéer till handling.

företagslösningar, både fysiskt och via mobil, för att ge bästa möjliga service.
 -Vi bjuder våra kunder på det som många andra tar betalt för, t.ex. att få mejlen i
mobilen, klockan uppkopplad eller skärmskyddet monterat.
 -Vi strävar efter att våra team ska spegla våra kunder i ålder, kön och bakgrund och
jobbar aktivt med mångfald och inkludering i allt vi gör.
 -Många börjar sin karriär hos oss i butik, men vägarna framåt är många. Våra tidigare
medarbetare har bl.a. utvecklats till roller som Butikschef, Business Specialist och
Key Account Manager.

Data Security Consultant
Join our mission towards a safe digital future
 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Data Security Consultant to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Secure Infrastructure domain.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact. 
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover. 
Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Data Security Specialist who wants to guide our clients through their data security efforts in our Secure Infrastructure team. 
Secure Infrastructure
Looking at the actual threat landscape today, it’s more important than ever to design and build infrastructure solutions that incorporate correct and relevant security features. The team works closely together using their combined knowledge and experience gathered from different projects and Incident Response cases to help our customers stay ahead of the threat actors. We continuously help customers improve their security posture within cloud, data center, endpoint management, identity, M365, networking and now Data Security.
The Role
As the digital landscape continues to evolve, we see data security emerging as a critical business area within cybersecurity. With the exponential growth of sensitive data being generated, shared, and stored across different platforms, organizations face unprecedented challenges in protecting their most valuable asset: their information. 
As a Data Security Consultant at Truesec, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients protect their most valuable information. You will take ownership in configuring and optimising Microsoft Purview solutions and policies, managing data security configurations within Microsoft Information Protection, and deploying policies to protect critical assets across tools like Data Loss Prevention and Insider Risk Management. This role combines strategic planning with hands-on implementation, ensuring your contributions directly strengthen our clients’ data security posture and support the delivery of robust security solutions. 
Your Potential Background
Experience in Microsoft Purview, including configuration of policies in various Purview tools (such as Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Insider Risk Management)
An understanding of information protection strategies and tools, including encryption, rights management, and data classification solutions
Experience working with Azure services (e.g., M365, Defender)
Ability to deliver training and workshops, empowering clients and colleagues with practical knowledge of data security best practices
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 or similar data protection regulations. 
Desired Skills
Knowledge of data security frameworks and ability to develop security baselines for data security projects
Technical acumen for implementing and troubleshooting data security systems
Relevant certifications (e.g., Information Security Administrator Associate)
Understanding of AI technologies and the specific security risks they present, with experience implementing protective measures with Azure tools
Experience integrating security into development and operational workflows
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field. 
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Kontaktinformation: Karin Lantz
Sista ansökningdag: 2026-11-01
Är du en lagspelare som gillar att jobba i en dynamisk och flexibel miljö? Drivs du av att få jobba med stora och komplexa IT-miljöer där just ditt jobb gör skillnad? Då kan rollen som Cloud Konsult vara din nästa möjlighet! 
Mitt namn är Karin Lantz och jag arbetar som affärsområdesansvarig i region mellan. Vi söker dig som vill bli en del av vårt härliga konsultgäng och få fokusera på resan upp i molnet.
Är det här din nästa möjlighet? 
I rollen som Cloud Konsult vägleder du våra kunder kring lämpliga molnlösningar och säkerställer en hållbar transformation från OnPrem till molnet med hänsyn till framtida anpassningar, utveckling och automation.  
Du blir ett naturligt bollplank när kundens kompetens inte räcker till och arbetar i hela leveransen med teknisk design, implementation och migrering av lösningar. Hos oss på Telia Cygate finns det många möjligheter för dig att utveckla dina färdigheter i flera olika riktningar, och du får även arbeta med koncept, strategi och ramverk kring molnresan. 
Exempel på vad rollen innefattar: 
Automation av Cloud Foundation och Landing Zones 
Vidareutveckla automation och CI/CD-pipelines 
Arbeta i utvecklingsverktyg med olika programmerings- och scriptspråk 
Samleverans av Cloud Adoption Framework och paketerade erbjudanden tillsammans Advisors, Architects och Engineers inom Telia Cygate Cloud Division 
Telia Cygate Cloud Division 
Vi är en nationell gruppering av engagerade Cloud-specialister som gärna djupdyker i ämnen såsom DevOps-metodik, automation, containers, scripting, IaC och CI/CD-processer. Inom Telia Cygate arbetar vi tillsammans med att implementera lösningar baserade på Azure, AWS eller GCP och ta till oss nya kunskaper för att i sin tur utveckla våra erbjudanden inom publika moln. Samtidigt säkerställer vi att Telia Cygate är ligger rätt i tiden med fokus på lösningar som är hållbara och skalbara. 
Är det här du?  
Som person är du lösningsorienterad och trivs bra i kunddialoger. Du trivs i en miljö där du får ge utlopp för dina tankar och idéer. Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas och arbeta i en varierande roll, där vi värdesätter våra kollegor och har roligt på jobbet. 
Din erfarenhet: 
Tidigare erfarenhet inom molnplattformar 
Kunskap inom tekniker för automation och Infrastructure as code 
Svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift 
Varför Telia Cygate?
På Telia Cygate är vi inte bara experter på nätverk, säkerhet och olika slags moln – vi är också ett gäng som tycker att det ska vara kul att gå till jobbet! Som en del av Telia Company har vi styrkan att skapa verklig påverkan i stor skala, bidra till samhällsnytta och hjälpa våra kunder att navigera i digitaliseringens värld. Vi gör det alltid med värme, omtanke och ett leende. Här är det idéerna och våra olika perspektiv som gör oss starka, och tillsammans ser vi till att teknikens värld blir en plats där alla trivs – och där du hör hemma.
Hos oss är din utveckling viktig. Vi uppmuntrar till kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och ser till att just du och dina intressen är i fokus. Vi vet att det är människorna som utgör vårt företag, och därför värdesätter vi glädje, kreativitet och olika perspektiv i allt vi gör.
Välkommen att växa tillsammans med oss, där vi gör teknik mänsklig och skapar verklig påverkan!
Vad vi erbjuder
När du börjar hos oss får du ett omfattande förmånspaket anpassat efter din lokala marknad, möjlighet till hybridarbete och mer. Du har också chans att få bonus baserat på din prestation och Telias resultat.
Låter det intressant?
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast 2026-11-01. Rollen kan komma att stängas tidigare om vi hittar rätt kandidat – så vänta inte för länge!
Placeringsort: Norrköping, Jönköping, Växjö
Om du går vidare i processen kommer du att kontaktas av vår Talent Acquisition Partner. Bakgrund- och referenskontroller ingår i processen.
Vill du veta mer om rollen? Kontakta gärna karin.lantz@cygate.se alternativt på LinkedIn.
Lika möjligheter för alla
På Telia värderar vi kompetens och utvecklingspotential. Vi främjar mångfald och ser till att varje individs behov tillgodoses, oavsett funktionsvariation, kön, ålder, nationalitet, sexuell läggning eller social bakgrund. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där din unikhet är vår styrka.
