 Job Description
Do you enjoy working with Linux, infrastructure and business-critical platforms where reliability really matters? Join Infrastructure Applications within Mobile Core Network and become part of a team responsible for central infrastructure services supporting Tele2's network and organization.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Infrastructure Applications is a team of seven engineers responsible for central infrastructure services and platforms within Tele2. We operate and develop business-critical systems used across the organization and are part of Mobile Core Network, responsible for ensuring stable and secure operation and development of Tele2's mobile network.
Your responsibilities will include:
·Operating, maintaining and developing Linux-based systems and infrastructure services
·Troubleshooting and problem solving in complex technical environments
·Automating recurring operational tasks and improving existing ways of working
·Lifecycle management, including patching, upgrades and platform maintenance
·Working with central services within areas such as DNS, logging and observability
·Participating in technical projects and contributing to knowledge sharing within the team
Who are you?
To thrive and succeed in this role, we believe that you are technically curious, enjoy solving complex problems and continuously look for opportunities to improve and automate operational work.
You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team and enjoy an environment where multiple systems, platforms and technical dependencies interact.
We believe you have:
·Strong experience working with and operating Linux environments
·Experience from large-scale virtual and physical server environments
·Good understanding of networking and IT infrastructure
·Experience with scripting and automation
·Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, Go and/or C
·Understanding of lifecycle management, patching and system upgrades
·Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Preferred Qualifications
It is an advantage if you have experience or knowledge within one or more of the following areas:
·DNS infrastructure
·Elasticsearch 
·Logging and observability
·Infrastructure within telecommunications
·Infrastructure automation 
·Experience from highly available and business-critical infrastructure environments
We do not expect you to know everything from day one. Technical curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn and develop are just as important to us as experience with a specific product or technology. We place great importance on who you are as a person. You enjoy sharing knowledge, helping colleagues and contributing to a collaborative environment. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your work while knowing when to involve the rest of the team.
 Great Place to Work
Pension and health care
Hybrid and flexible work life balance
Career opportunities
Parental benefit
Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
Inclusive workplace
 Skills & Requirements
A few words from the manager
Infrastructure Applications is a team with broad technical responsibility and a lot of knowledge. We operate platforms that are important to many parts of Tele2, which means that what we do genuinely matters.
As a manager, I value trust, openness and collaboration. I want people in the team to have the freedom to take ownership, challenge existing ways of working and develop in the technical areas that interest them. We have a strong team culture where we help each other, share knowledge and solve problems together.
If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving challenging technical problems and want the opportunity to develop across several infrastructure areas rather than being limited to a single technology, I think you will enjoy working with us.
Why Tele2
A culture of natural born challengers – At Tele2 we don’t just do things the traditional way. We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to create smarter and more valuable solutions for our customers. You will be part of a culture that values curiosity, initiative and collaboration, where new ideas are welcomed and everyone’s contribution matters. 
Inclusive and supportive environment – We believe in fostering a creative and flexible workplace where people can bring their whole selves to work. Diversity and inclusion are important to us, and we strive to create an environment where people feel welcome, respected and supported in growing both personally and professionally. 
 A sustainability challenger – We are proud that Tele2 has been recognised as Europe’s Climate Leader by the Financial Times and named as Sweden’s most sustainable company by Time Magazine and Statista, reflecting our strong commitment to reduce emissions, transparency and long-term climate goals. Our efforts focus on three areas where we can make the biggest difference: advancing a circular economy, combating climate change, and protecting children online. By embedding these focus areas into how we operate and innovate, we aim to create positive impact for people, planet and profit.
Interest and application
Would you like to be a part of the Tele2s value-driven and including culture? Then hit the “apply now” button and let’s find out if we’re a match! 
Please note that in compliance with personal data management regulations (GDPR), we are unable to accept CVs via email. 
As a step in the recruitment process, Tele2 performs a background check on final candidates.

At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT. 
Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.

Software Developer
Are you a software developer that enjoys variety and the opportunity to work with different types of challenges? Then Viskan could be a good match for you! We are both a high performing company in the exciting world of e-com, but we are also on a transformation journey where we currently are changing technique in our backoffice application. With other words, this is an awesome opportunity to join! 
Description of the role
As a software developer at Viskan, you will mostly work in the Backend part of our e-commerce platform where the main mission is to maintain and develop new functionality. You will be a part of an agile development team where you together have the responsibility to solve the tasks that have been planned in the sprint: in order to keep delivering a premium e-commerce platform to our customers such as Engelsons, Vildland and Sportshopen. 
Common technologies that we use:
NodeJS, TypeScript, Next.js (React)
Java, Spring Boot
SQL server, Elasticsearch, Apache Kafka
Docker, Kubernetes
The role also includes tasks within Cyber Security, DevOps and API-development, and for the right person with the right interest, there is an opportunity to specialize more in these areas. 
Your profile
To fit the role as a Software Developer, you have a genuine interest in technology. Our Backend is mostly written in Java and SQL but further on NodeJS and Typescript will be more common in the future. You should have knowledge in developing and maintaining APIs as well as database modeling. If you have ever been in touch with Cyber Security or DevOps-related tasks, it is a big plus. 
As a person, you are a helpful and prestigeless teamplayer that also enjoys working independently and having responsibility. We don’t expect everyone to be experts in everything, but it is important that you have a willingness to learn. Since we have colleagues in different countries, you need to be fluent in English. We place significant importance on personal characteristics. 
Our offer:
A company with a culture where work life-balance, personal development and responsibility is at focus. At Viskan you will be challenged either if you are junior or senior. You will work with engaged, competent and including colleagues that together have fun at work. We trust our employees which means that they have a great flexibility regarding both their work and their working hours. 
See more about what it means to work with us here.
About us
Viskan is a provider of an e-com platform for brands, retail B2B and subscription. We deliver world-class performance and help our customers build e-com with smart solutions and the best customer experience. All development of the platform takes place in-house, giving us the opportunity to act swiftly and to continuously respond to market demands. With us as a partner, companies can grow friction-free and focus entirely on their sales and customer relations.
The company consists of more than 60 colleagues with the headquarters in Borås and offices in Gothenburg, Helsinki and Riga. Viskan is a part of Visma Group and has a large exchange of knowledge within the group, which gives access to support that only one of Europe’s largest software providers can offer.

Arbetsbeskrivning
Facilities Officer
Location: Cambridge Science Park (Primarily on-site)
Hours: Approximately 21 hours per week, with flexibility around working pattern and times to meet operational requirements.
Role Purpose
To support the safe, compliant and efficient operation of the Cambridge laboratory and office facilities. The role is responsible for facilities coordination, contractor management, workplace compliance and health and safety administration.
Key Responsibilities
Facilities & Contractor Management – 45%
Coordinate maintenance, repairs and servicing across office, laboratory and external areas.
Manage day-to-day relationships with contractors and facilities service providers.
Monitor building services and ensure facilities issues are resolved promptly.
Maintain facilities and contractor records.
Health, Safety & Compliance – 40%
Support site health and safety activities, including workplace inspections, laboratory patrols and compliance checks.
Maintain risk assessments, COSHH documentation and statutory compliance records.
Coordinate contractor compliance, RAMS reviews and inductions.
Support fire safety and emergency preparedness activities.
Act as a designated Fire Warden and First Aider (training provided if required).
Reporting & Events – 15%
Prepare facilities, compliance and H&S reports.
Support annual and half-yearly reporting requirements.
Coordinate company and employee events, including Summer Events and Kick-off Meetings.
Essential Skills & Experience
Previous facilities, workplace or building operations experience.
Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with contractors and service providers.
Ability to work independently and proactively resolve issues.
Good administration and record-keeping skills.
Desirable
Experience supporting H&S activities and compliance.
Knowledge of risk assessments, COSHH, RAMS and contractor management.
First Aid and/or Fire Warden qualification.
IOSH Working Safely or equivalent H&S training.

Customer Insight Analyst
Customer Insight Analyst
Postat 1 dag sedan
Ansök
Dela
Företag: Telia Norge AS
Plats: Norway
Job ID: 63042
Kontaktinformation: Anna Moen
Sista ansökningdag: 2026-10-28
Vi ser etter en Customer Insight Analyst som vil bli en del av Telia Norge.
Jeg heter Anna Moen og er Head of Analytics. Nå ser jeg etter en nysgjerrig og forretningsorientert analytiker som ønsker å lære, bidra og skape resultater sammen med oss.
I Telia Norge bruker vi data, analyse og maskinlæring for å forstå kundene våre bedre, forbedre forretningsresultatene og legge til rette for smartere beslutninger i hele organisasjonen. Du blir en del av Analytics-teamet, som leverer innsikt, rapportering, avanserte analyser og datadrevne anbefalinger på tvers av ulike forretningsområder.
Vi samarbeider tett med Commercial, Customer Value Management, Marketing, MarTech, IT og andre team. I denne rollen vil du jobbe tett med forretningen og sammen med erfarne analytikere, data scientists og interessenter for å hjelpe team med å forstå kundeatferd, forretningsresultater og hva som driver kommersielle resultater. 
Dette vil du jobbe med:
Du vil bygge bro mellom teknologi og forretning ved å kombinere kundeanalyse, statistisk metode, analytisk tenkning og tydelig kommunikasjon. Målet er å omsette data og modellresultater til beslutningsgrunnlag og innsikt som kan omsettes til handling:
Analysere kunde adferd for å identifisere de viktigste driverne bak kundeaktivitet, salg, churn, bruk, verdi og andre resultater.
Omsette forretningsspørsmål til strukturerte analyser, tydelige anbefalinger og beslutningsstøtte, både gjennom ad hoc-analyser og regelmessig innsiktsarbeid.
Utvikle maskinlæringsmodeller som støtter kundeinnsikt, målretting, personalisering og forretningsprioriteringer.
Bidra til at løsningene tas i bruk ved å sikre at analytisk innsikt og modeller blir forstått, brukt og fulgt opp i relevante prosesser og kanaler.
Måle effekten av initiativer, modeller og kundetiltak gjennom strukturerte analyser, testdesign og A/B-testing der det er relevant.
Formidle innsikt på en tydelig og engasjerende måte gjennom presentasjoner, grafer og dashboards tilpasset ulike målgrupper.
Presentere funn ved å forklare hva som er viktig, hvorfor det er viktig og hvilke tiltak som bør vurderes, samtidig som du bidrar i diskusjoner om forretningsmessige konsekvenser.
Samarbeide på tvers av forretning og teknologi for å forstå interessentenes behov, prioriteringer, tilgjengelige data, definisjoner og begrensninger.
Gjøre innsikt handlingsrettet ved å koble forretningskontekst og analytiske metoder og bidra til en datadrevet kultur også for ikke-tekniske målgrupper.
Dette vil hjelpe deg med å lykkes i rollen:
Vi ser etter en nysgjerrig og forretningsorientert analytiker med noen års erfaring innen analyse eller data science, et sterkt ønske om å lære og motivasjon til å utvikle seg videre.
Et par års erfaring innen analyse, kundeinnsikt, data science eller lignende arbeid.
Gode analytiske ferdigheter og evne til å strukturere komplekse problemstillinger og løse forretningsutfordringer.
Erfaring med eller stor interesse for maskinlæring og bruk av statistisk metode på forretningsproblemstillinger.
Forståelse for hvordan modeller og innsikt skaper målbar effekt i kanaler og forretningsprosesser.
Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner slik at du kan presentere funn og jobbe tett med interessenter i forretningen.
Interesse for kundeatferd, kommersielle resultater og forretningsdrivere.
Erfaring som vil være verdifull:
Relevant høyere utdanning innen data science, statistikk, økonomi, business analytics, matematikk, informatikk eller et annet kvantitativt fagområde.
Analyse- og rapporteringsverktøy som SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Qlik Sense eller Tableau.
Relevant analyseerfaring innen kunde-, markeds-, salgs-, churn-, produkt- eller finansanalyse.
Erfaring med statistikk og modellering, for eksempel segmentering, prediktiv modellering, eksperimentering, A/B-testing og effektmåling.
Erfaring med maskinlæring og utvikling, evaluering eller operasjonalisering av modeller er en fordel.
Bransjeerfaring fra telekom, abonnementsvirksomhet, digitale tjenester eller kundeanalyse er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Bli med og skap en smartere hverdag for mennesker, bedrifter og planeten
I Telia er vi 15 000 kolleger i Norden og Baltikum med en felles lidenskap for teknologi og konnektivitet. Som en ledende teleoperatør og klimaleder driver vi endring gjennom store prosjekter med reell betydning, samtidig som vi bygger en bærekraftig og inkluderende verden. 
Hos oss kan du utvikle kompetansen din, lede meningsfulle prosjekter og trives i et støttende og mangfoldig miljø. Enten du tar ditt første eller neste steg, er Telia et sted der du kan vokse, høre til og gjøre en reell forskjell.
Dette tilbyr vi
Når du blir en del av Telia, får du en omfattende fordelspakke tilpasset det lokale markedet, mulighet for fjernarbeid og mer. Du får også mulighet til å oppnå bonus basert på dine prestasjoner og Telias resultater.
Klar for å skape bedre løsninger?
Vi ser frem til å motta søknaden din innen 28. oktober 2026. Vær oppmerksom på at vi kan avslutte prosessen tidligere dersom vi finner den rette kandidaten, så ikke vent for lenge med å søke!
Hvis du går videre til neste steg, blir du kontaktet av vår Talent Acquisition Partner. Bakgrunns- og referansesjekk vil være en del av prosessen.
Vil du vite mer om rollen? Ta gjerne kontakt med Anna Moen, Head of Analytics, på anna.moen@telia.no.
Like muligheter
I Telia anerkjenner vi talent basert på faglig kompetanse og utviklingspotensial. Vi verdsetter mangfold og arbeider for at den enkeltes behov blir ivaretatt, uavhengig av funksjonsevne, kjønn, alder, nasjonalitet, seksuell orientering eller sosial status. Sammen skaper vi et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø der det som gjør deg unik, er vår styrke.
Bli med oss – sammen skaper vi bedre løsninger!

Som maskinoperatör kommer du att arbeta med maskiner för bearbetning av rör i. Arbetet innebär bland annat att förbereda material, ställa och köra maskiner, utföra efterbearbetning samt kontrollera att produkterna håller rätt kvalitet.

Arbetsbeskrivning
Department: Administration
Location: Cambridge Science park
Employment Type: Full-time
Role Purpose
The Facilities and Administration Officer is responsible for supporting the efficient, safe and effective day-to-day operation of the Cambridge laboratory.
Acting as a key point of contact for employees, visitors, suppliers and contractors, the postholder will ensure that operational requirements are managed efficiently, appropriate records and compliance standards are maintained, and employees are provided with a professional and well-organised working environment.
The role requires someone who is highly organised, proactive and able to manage a varied workload, balancing routine responsibilities with unexpected operational requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Office & Administrative Support – 30%
Provide front-of-house support, including answering incoming calls, welcoming visitors and managing visitor access.
Coordinate taxis, post, couriers, deliveries and shipping requirements. 
Maintain appropriate stocks of office, kitchen and workplace supplies.
Process administrative requests and maintain accurate records and documentation.
Provide general administrative and operational support across the business.
Purchasing & Supplier Coordination – 25%
Review and authorise purchase orders, check details for accuracy, issue approved orders to suppliers, and process goods receipts and associated GR records within Sage.
Liaise with suppliers and researchers to resolve queries and monitor outstanding orders.
Maintain accurate purchasing records
Facilities & Contractor Management – 15%
Coordinate maintenance, repairs and servicing across office, laboratory and external areas.
Manage day-to-day relationships with contractors and facilities service providers.
Monitor building services and ensure facilities issues are identified and resolved promptly.
Maintain relevant facilities and contractor records.
Health, Safety & Compliance – 20%
Support site health and safety activities, including workplace inspections, laboratory patrols and compliance checks.
Maintain key H&S documentation, including risk assessments, COSHH records and statutory records.
Coordinate fire safety, emergency preparedness and contractor compliance, including RAMS and inductions.
Act as a designated Fire Warden and First Aider.
Reporting & Events – 10%
Prepare and maintain facilities, H&S, compliance and operational reports.
Support Annual and Half-Yearly reporting requirements.
Coordinate company and employee events, including Summer Events and Kick-off Meetings.
Skills and Experience
Essential
The successful candidate will ideally demonstrate:
Previous experience within a facilities, office administration, operations or similar role.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Experience of working with suppliers, contractors and service providers.
Good administrative skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Confidence in dealing with employees, visitors and external suppliers at all levels.
Ability to work independently, use initiative and take ownership of issues through to resolution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
Desirable
Previous experience supporting workplace health and safety activities.
Experience using Sage or a similar finance/purchasing system.
Experience working within a laboratory, scientific, technical or regulated environment.
Knowledge of risk assessments, COSHH, RAMS and contractor management.
First Aid and/or Fire Warden training.

Vill du utvecklas inom försäljning i en miljö där gemenskap, driv och möjligheter står i fokus? 💫
Vi söker nu en ny kollega på heltid till vår butik i Bromma. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 3 månader med god chans till förlängning.
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 får du chansen att växa inom professionell rådgivning och försäljning. Du får en roll där du både utmanas och har riktigt roligt på jobbet, samtidigt som du utvecklas varje dag.
Det här får du hos oss
Hos oss får du mer än ett jobb - du får en miljö där du kan utvecklas, prestera och trivas på riktigt.
Fast lön + provision: En trygg grundlön kombinerat med en rörlig del som belönar dina resultat.
Utbildning och coachning: Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - hos oss får du en gedigen introduktion och det stöd du behöver för att utvecklas och lyckas i rollen.
Teamkultur med energi: Ett team där vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och firar framgångar tillsammans.
Tävlingar och gemensamma aktiviteter: Vi skapar energi i vardagen genom roliga tävlingar, aktiviteter och gemensamma firanden.
Karriärmöjligheter: Möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken.
Det här kommer du att göra
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 är du aktiv på butiksgolvet - du skapar själv möjligheter genom möten, initiativ och kundkontakt. Du spelar en viktig roll i att skapa både positiva kundupplevelser och framgångsrika affärer.
I rollen kommer du att:
Möta våra kunder i butik och hjälpa dem hitta rätt helhetslösningar.
Ta kontakt med både nya och befintliga kunder i butik och via telefon.
Arbeta rådgivande genom att förstå kundens behov och guida dem till rätt beslut.
Arbeta mot både individuella och gemensamma mål tillsammans med teamet.
Bidra till butikens dagliga drift, kampanjer och kundupplevelse.
Bidra till en positiv och energifylld arbetsmiljö.
Hur det är att jobba hos oss
Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de trivs, känner stöd och får möjlighet att lyckas tillsammans med andra. Därför har vi byggt butiker där gemenskap, energi och utveckling är centralt i det vi gör. Dagen börjar ofta tillsammans med teamet där vi går igenom dagens mål & fokus, delar erfarenheter och peppar varandra inför dagen. Under dagen varierar arbetet mellan kundmöten i butik, telefonsamtal med kunder och egna initiativ för att skapa affärsmöjligheter. Det som gör våra butiker speciella är människorna - både våra fantastiska kunder och kollegor. Här hjälper vi varandra, delar kunskap, firar framgångar och bidrar till en miljö där det är riktigt roligt att gå till jobbet. 💫
 Vi har riktigt bra förmåner
Tjänstepension
Möjlighet till interna karriärvägar och utveckling
Rabatter på Tele2s produkter och tjänster
Inkluderande arbetskultur
Lön och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
Stora utbildningsmöjligheter
 Kvalifikationer
För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är…
Vi tror att rätt inställning och personliga kompetenser är viktigare än en lång meritlista. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - det viktigaste är att du är driven och vill utvecklas.
Relationsskapande: Du trivs i mötet med människor, är nyfiken på kundens behov och bygger förtroende genom ett tryggt och professionellt bemötande.
Målmedveten: Du motiveras av att arbeta mot mål och tycker det är roligt att se resultat av ditt arbete.
Initiativtagande: Du tar ansvar, är proaktiv i ditt arbete och tar egna initiativ till att bidra och skapa resultat.
Driven: Du gillar att utvecklas, tar till dig feedback och vill bli bättre över tid.
Samarbetsinriktad: Du trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.
Flexibel: Du anpassar dig till nya situationer och har en positiv inställning till förändring och nya arbetssätt.
Kvalifikationer
Fullständig gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande.
Du har fyllt 18 år. (Enligt AFS 2023:2 5 kap. 7 § och 6 kap 8 § krävs det att du är 18 år för att kunna arbeta hos oss).
Flytande kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.
Godkänd bakgrundskontroll.
Meriterande
Erfarenhet av kundkontakt.
Erfarenhet av försäljning via exempelvis butik, telefon, mässor eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot uppsatta mål.
Goda kunskaper i engelska, ytterligare språkkunskaper är ett plus.
Vill du vara med? Tveka inte att söka redan idag! 💫
Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande, och som ett steg i rekryteringsprocessen utför Tele2 en bakgrundskontroll på aktuella slutkandidater. Eftersom vi eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning ser vi gärna kvinnliga sökande till den här tjänsten.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! För att säkerställa en inkluderande och rättvis rekryteringsprocess fokuserar vi på dina erfarenheter och kompetenser. Därför har Tele2 valt att inte använda personliga brev och vi ber dig istället besvara de urvalsfrågor som ingår i ansökningsformuläret.

Paulin
Butikssäljare Asecs Jönköping
 "Det är en inkluderande och fartfylld miljö med genuint fokus på kundens bästa.​"
Afroza
Butikschef Mobila Malmö
 "Fantastiskt att få kunna ge våra kunder service i världsklass!"
 Om företaget
Tele2 är en nordisk och baltisk telekomoperatör byggd på en stark utmanarkultur. Sedan 1993 har Tele2 utmanat etablerade normer i telekombranschen genom att göra uppkoppling enklare, smartare och mer kostnadseffektiv för våra kunder. Tele2 erbjuder mobila och fasta tjänster, TV och streaming samt IoT‑lösningar till konsumenter och företag i Norden och Baltikum.
Hållbarhet är en integrerad del av hur vi arbetar. Tele2 har uppmärksammats som Europas klimatledare av Financial Times och utsetts till Sveriges mest hållbara bolag, vilket speglar vårt långsiktiga engagemang för att minska vår miljöpåverkan och driva cirkulära lösningar tillsammans med våra kunder.
Våra värderingar – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple och Act Cost-efficiently – vägleder vår kultur, hur vi samarbetar och hur vi omsätter idéer till handling.

Role Purpose
To provide reception, administrative and purchasing support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the Cambridge office and laboratory. The role acts as the first point of contact for employees, visitors, suppliers and contractors and is critical in maintaining efficient administrative processes and purchasing activities.

Office & Administrative Support – 50%

Process administrative requests and maintain accurate records and documentation.

Purchasing & Supplier Coordination – 40%

Issue approved purchase orders to suppliers.
Process goods receipts and maintain associated GR records within Sage.
Liaise with suppliers and researchers to resolve purchasing queries.
Monitor outstanding orders and follow up where required.
Reporting & Administrative Support – 10%

Support company events and employee activities as required.

Previous administration, office coordinator, purchasing or similar experience.
Strong organisational and communication skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Competent user of Microsoft Office.
Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
Desirable
Experience using Sage or similar purchasing systems.
Experience supporting a scientific, technical or laboratory environment.

Arbetsbeskrivning
Customer Fulfillment Specialist
Location: Almere or Utrecht, NL | Reports to: Team Leader, Customer Fulfilment
Why Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions?
At Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, Inc., we’re not just enabling the retail industry—we’re transforming it. Recognized globally as the market share leader in retail store technology, we work with many of the world’s top retailers to deliver innovative, integrated solutions that connect in-store and digital experiences.
Every day, we help our customers to solve complex, real-world challenges and create more engaging, efficient and meaningful shopping experiences through cutting-edge technology. From advanced Point-of-Sale systems to next-generation in-store innovations, our end-to-end solutions keep retailers ahead in a rapidly evolving market.
Guided by our "Together Commerce" philosophy, we collaborate closely with clients to drive meaningful results—with insight, integrity, and impact. As part of Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, you'll be an integral partner to the success of our customers. If you're driven by innovation, inspired by transformation, and ready to shape the future of global commerce, you’ll find your place here.
What's 'In-Store'? - Role Overview
As a Customer Fulfilment Specialist, you'll play an important role in supporting the order-to-delivery process for some of Europe's leading retail customers. Working as part of our European Supply Chain team, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries to ensure orders are processed accurately and customers receive an excellent service experience.
This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in customer service, administration, sales support, logistics, or order management who is looking to grow their career within an international business. You'll gain exposure to customer fulfilment, supply chain operations, and stakeholder management while learning from experienced colleagues in a supportive team environment.
We're looking for someone who is organised, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and eager to learn. Occasional flexibility may be required during month-end and quarter-end periods.
Language Requirements
Fluent English and Dutch.
Professional working proficiency in either German or French.
You Will Be Responsibile For:
Process and manage customer orders accurately using internal systems.
Support customers and business partners with enquiries relating to orders, deliveries, and contracts.
Work closely with Supply Chain and Logistics teams to monitor deliveries and resolve issues.
Investigate billing queries and partner with Finance to ensure timely resolution.
Maintain accurate records and documentation.
Support forecasting, reporting, budgeting, and audit activities.
Identify opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.
What We're Looking For
Experience in customer service, administration, sales support, order management, logistics, or a similar operational role.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A customer-focused mindset and excellent communication skills.
Confidence using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive, collaborative approach and willingness to learn.
Why Join Us?
Join a diverse European team supporting customers across multiple markets.
Work with some of the world's leading retail brands.
Develop valuable experience in customer fulfilment, supply chain, and commercial operations.
Benefit from ongoing training and development opportunities.
Build a strong foundation for long-term career growth within a global technology business.
EEO
Toshiba is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer that evaluates qualified applicants without regard to protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
Individuals who may require reasonable adjustments because of a disability for any part of the employment process should email pollyanna.hilton@toshibagcs.com to inform of any requests.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
We at Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions firmly believe that our people are an integral part to the success of our customers. Furthermore, we’re committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion for all our people as highlighted by our 5 Core Principles (Create Outreach, Foster Belonging, Unleash Opportunity, Diverse Cultural Engagement and Culture of Transparency).
With over 50+ years of commitment to retail, we are RETAIL. Our RETAIL values (respect, empowerment, teamwork, adaptability, leadership) characterize what our employees and clients can expect when they work with us every time and all the time. We’re passionate about our customers the retail industry and becoming a more responsible company as we help create a brighter future.

 Pardavimų vadybininkas skambučiu Kaune
Šiuo metu ieškome pardavimų vadybininko, kuris prisijungtų prie telemarketingo komandos. Būsi Tele2 veidas ir išmanių idėjų skleidėjas - žmogus, nuo kurio tiesiogiai priklausys kompanijos rezultatai ir klientų pasitenkinimo jausmas. Turėsi puikią erdvę parodyti esantis kiečiausiu pardavėju ir gilinti žinias apie mobiliųjų technologijų tendencijas. Veiksmo pas mus daug, pažadam - nuobodu nebus!
Tikimės, kad Tau bus įdomu:
parduoti Tele2 paslaugas ir produktus esamiems klientams telefonu pagal Pardavimų standartus;
edukuoti klientus ir rūpintis, kad jie žengtų koja kojon su telekomunikacijų naujovėmis;
įgyvendinti iškeltus pardavimų ir klientų aptarnavimo kokybės tikslus.
Tam, kad tau sektųsi, prireiks:
gebėjimo planuotis laiką ir dirbti savarankiškai;
komunikabilumo bei gebėjimo atremti klientų prieštaravimus;
entuziazmo ir kūrybiškumo sprendžiant įvairias situacijas su klientais;
motyvacijos siekiant asmeninių bei komandinių tikslų;
puikių lietuvių kalbos įgūdžių (žodžiu ir raštu).
Darbo grafikas - geriau nerasi!
Darbo laikas I-V nuo 8:30 val. iki 17:30 val. Savaitgaliai ir šventinės dienos laisvi!
Atlyginimas:
Pirmus 3 mėn. garantuojame ne mažesnį negu 1500 Eur (neatskaičius mokesčių) atlyginimą (1300 Eur bazinis atlygis plius 200 Eur naujoko pagalvė, neatskaičius mokesčių). Vėliau - 1300 Eur bazinis atlygis (neatskaičius mokesčių) plius bonusai už pardavimo rezultatus. Dirbantys iš peties uždirba 3000 Eur (neatskaičius mokesčių) ir daugiau. 
Taip pat kiekvienam darbuotojui esame parengę papildomų naudų krepšelį, kurį sudaro:
pasiekus sutartus tikslus - galimybė dirbti nuotoliniu būdu;
sveikatos draudimas;
nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimas 24/7;
įmonės organizuojami mokymai;
komandinės veiklos ir renginiai;
mobilus telefonas ir neribotų pokalbių bei interneto planas;
modemas su neribotu internetu namams;
planai šeimos nariams;
GO3 televizija;
nuolaidos Tele2 parduodamoms prekėms;
Perks.lt partnerių pasiūlymai ir nuolaidos.
Jei turi klausimų, į juos mielai atsakys Telemarketingo komandos vadovė Aurelija tel.: +37060984203

Arbetsbeskrivning
Would you like to work for an internationally renowned Company, who can provide internal training support and development as well as a great benefits package and the opportunity to grow within the business? Our Service division are looking for a dedicated problem solver to work within our field-based team; to provide support and proactive maintenance for our customers.
We are part of the IT and Document Solutions segment of Toshiba and cover the whole of the UK. To find out more about us, please visit www.toshibatec.co.uk.
What to Expect
Once trained on our products, you will be out in the field relatively quickly, utilising your current knowledge of MFPs and/ or Printers.
You will be responsible for providing post-sales/ implementation and technical support services to customers including installation, troubleshooting, problem resolution and maintenance.
You will be required to respond to customer questions regarding operation and malfunctions and advise customers on preventative maintenance and configuration adjustments to improve product performance and customer satisfaction.
As part of your role, you will primarily cover customers in the Midlands, with the expectation that on occasion you may be required to travel slightly further afield to cover holidays or other absences.
Responsibilities and Duties
Installing, maintaining and diagnosis of machine faults as per Company Guidelines and SLA’s on specified Toshiba MFP equipment.
Escalating issues to a Senior Technician / Manager when required.
Work proactively to achieve individual, team and Company SLAs and productivity levels.
Monitor and maintain adequate stock levels.
Regular contact with call centre to maintain accurate reporting.
Develop and maintain a good rapport with the call centre, making regular contact with established call opening and closing procedures with accurately reported work/travel times.
Ensure all relevant paperwork is completed and submitted in a timely manner.
Training customers to be proficient in the use of their equipment.
To observe and maintain a professional company approach to all customers in developing and building a good rapport.
Develop and maintain a high level of product knowledge and skills.
Comply with Group Policies, Procedures and Objectives.
Perform other such reasonable tasks and responsibilities which may from time to time be required.
Qualifications and Skills Required
A full UK driver’s licence and the flexibility to travel with the role.
Professional written and verbal communication skills across all levels.
Strong customer service skills.
Ability to display tact and diplomacy when dealing with difficult situations and people.
Good working knowledge of Health & Safety procedures both within Toshiba and customer premises.
Effective workload scheduling and prioritising.
Proven Electromechanical Skills.
Ability to support department with networking of machines to client systems.
Good time management and organising skills.
Computer literacy (Microsoft Office).
The ideal candidate will have past experience of supporting MFDs in a comparable role and any Toshiba product knowledge would of course be ideal, however, we are open to considering individuals who can demonstrate experience of supporting MFDs as part of a wider IT support role, and/ or candidates who have supported a comparable hardware product, with transferrable skills.
We operate Monday to Friday and our engineers are on customer sites attending calls during business hours. There may be occasional overtime.
Your region will cover the Midlands, and will vary depending on the needs of the business, customer locations and at times, covering absences/ holidays in the wider team. It would suit someone in the Stoke area, covering Derby/ Nottingham but potentially further South to Birmingham, across to Wales.

Arbetsbeskrivning
Toshiba Europe Ltd has been at the forefront of quantum technology research, particularly in quantum communications and semiconductor quantum devices, for the past two decades. During this time, the company has achieved numerous breakthroughs, including the development of the world's first single-photon and entangled-photon LEDs, as well as the first GHz-operation 1550 nm single-photon avalanche diodes.
We are seeking a Research Scientist to join our team in developing entanglement-based quantum communication systems for future quantum networks. The successful candidate will contribute to the implementation and characterisation of experimental systems for the generation and distribution of entanglement over optical fibre networks. The role will involve quantum light source characterisation, quantum communication experiments, and the integration of advanced photonic and electronic systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in quantum optics, quantum communications, or experimental quantum information science.
Responsibilities:
Development and characterisation of entanglement-based quantum communication systems
Design and implementation of entanglement-distribution experiments
Integration of optical, electronic, and control subsystems for advanced experimental platforms
Development of software for experimental control, automation, and data analysis
Analyse and interpret experimental results, and contribute to the development of new concepts and protocols
Engagement with academic and industrial partners, and dissemination through scientific publications
Essential requirements:
PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline 
Proven hands-on experience in quantum optics, quantum communication, or experimental quantum information science
Strong understanding of entanglement, quantum networking, or photonic quantum systems
Experience in assembly, integration, and operation of complex experimental systems
Experience with fibre optic systems
Good knowledge of computer control and data analysis programming environments, e.g., Python, LabVIEW, or equivalent
Track record of high-quality scientific research and publications
Capability of both creative, independent work and working within an interactive team
Desirable requirements:
Experience with entangled photon sources and their characterisation
Experience with solid-state quantum emitters
Knowledge of quantum communication protocols, quantum repeater architectures, quantum memories, or distributed quantum computing concepts
Experience with imaging, microscopy, spectroscopy
Experience with field trial experiments or proof of concept prototypes

 Job Description
Reshape how millions of people buy and sell vehicles at FINN.no, Blocket.se and Vend’s other Nordic marketplace. 
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL
You? A curious, hands-on iOS developer who loves a real challenge. You aren't looking to just tweak edge cases, you want to take ownership of a product, overhaul a demanding user experience, and turn it into something excellent.
Role? You’ll take ownership of native iOS experiences across our vehicle transaction flows. Working in a cross-functional team alongside Android, Product, and UX, you'll contribute directly to product discovery, drive mobile best practices, and help simplify complex car transactions into smooth, step-by-step app journeys. 
Tech stack? Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, SPM, Combine
Company? Vend, home to Northern Europe's most iconic marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen. Millions of people connect on our platforms every day to make life-changing decisions: buying a home, finding a job, or purchasing their next car.
Location? Join us in either our Oslo or Stockholm office with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week: your choice, your balance.
Why us?
Buying or selling a car can be confusing and complicated. We’re changing that by offering a simple, step-by-step transaction flow for private sales across FINN, Blocket, and Vend’s Nordic marketplaces. 
Our team consists of 8 skilled individuals who work agile and dynamically towards concrete goals. We collaborate closely with an extended product team. As a valued member of our team, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact, contribute with your unique expertise, and grow both personally and professionally.
Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
WHO ARE YOU?
Experienced iOS developer with at least 3 years of hands-on experience
Fluent in English. Clear communication is key in our international, cross-functional team.
Proactive and responsible, someone who steps up when needed and takes ownership of their work.
Team player who loves to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from others.
Quality-focused, taking pride in writing clean code and testing thoroughly to ensure smooth user experiences.
Product minded with a keen eye for great mobile UX. You enjoy sitting with product managers and designers during discovery to prototype and shape the end product. 
Outspoken, comfortable challenging ideas and contributing to open, honest discussions.
WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?
Day-to-day work & projects cooking
Day-to-day tasks involve experimenting, developing features to enhance user experience, and improving the quality and functionality of the overall product. We work on several areas of the transaction journey, and as a team member you’ll be a key collaborator with product UX by participating in the discovery process and help come up with the best solutions.
Not everything is cotton candy clouds, so here’s the main opportunity to improve
Sometimes we run into obstacles and we might need to reprioritise, which is why it’s important that you as an individual are able to adapt to a fast paced environment, and provide input when you identify areas of the product that can be improved.
On the other hand, this brings along a great opportunity to leave your fingerprint on how the product is drafted! Is your curious mind asking for this kind of adventure?
GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!
If this sounds exciting, please send us your application. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
QUESTIONS?
Engineering Manager Andre Martins is happy to answer any question you may have about the role, and can be reached at andre.martins@vend.com.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.
Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.
At Vend, your time matters. 
We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

About TMEIC Europe
TMEIC drives industry around the world through a comprehensive offering of unique systems solutions including variable frequency drives, motors, generators, flywheels, photovoltaic inverters, BESS inverters and advanced automation systems for a wide range of industrial and energy applications. TMEIC was established in 2003 through the integration of the industrial systems divisions of Toshiba Corporation and Mitsubishi Electric Corporation.
General Role Description
This role is responsible for supporting the employee lifecycle across Europe, including payroll administration, HR operations, compensation and benefits, GDPR compliance, training activities, and people-related processes that contribute to the achievement of the Company’s Mid-Range Plan (MRP) objectives.
Role Accountabilities
Payroll
Manage the time and attendance system and coordinate with external payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing across European locations.
Handle payroll-related documentation and monthly HR data preparation
Administer employee benefits and welfare programs
Prepare and analyse HR reports and KPIs (e.g., absenteeism, overtime, headcount, labour cost and total employment cost).
HR policies and procedures
Maintain and update HR policies, procedures, and employee documentation to ensure compliance with local legislation and Company values.
HRIS 
Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of HR Information Systems (HRIS).
Training and Development
Support the HR Manager EMEA in the annual Performance and Development Review process, including goal setting, compensation review activities, and training planning.
Support the implementation of trainings
GDPR Regulation
Ensure compliance with GDPR requirements and maintain HR processes and documentation aligned with data privacy regulations.
General Employee Accountabilities
Bring full effort to bear on tasks assigned by manager
Notify the manager promptly when work cannot be delivered as specified.
Collaborate with peers and interact cross-organizationally as specified by manager
Exemplify Company Core Values: Teamwork and Accountability, Client Focus, Driving Progress and Integrity
Comply with all Company policies, practices, and procedures and all regulations and laws
Recommend viable improvements proactively
Ensure effective utilization of business tools and processes
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
Around 3 years of experience HR function, in particular in payroll and administration to achieve business goals
Good understanding of European labour laws, GDPR, and employment regulations
Demonstrated use of keen business acumen to develop effective HR strategies and priorities for improved business results
Demonstrated ability to manage tasks with hands-on, tactical work
Demonstrated success implementing, measuring, and improving HR programs
Demonstrated successful working relationships with clients, suppliers, and other internal and external contacts
Demonstrated successful and positive interpersonal, organizational, administrative, and communication skills
Demonstrated continuous improvement in areas of responsibility
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
German native speaker and fluency in English language, Italian knowledge will be a plus
Availability to travel, domestically and internationally, less than 20%, sometimes with limited notice
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
Multi-functional project management experience or management experience in a business function in addition to HR
Demonstrated success collaborating cross-functionally in a global, multicultural organization (preferably Japanese)
Proficiency in HRIS (HR Information Systems)
Experience supporting diverse employee base spanning multiple geographic locations, domestically and internationally
Proficiency in an additional European Languages (e.g. Polish, Spanish)

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Valence, France
Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Notre savoir-faire technologique
Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
Votre quotidien
En nous rejoignant à Valence, vous intégrez le centre de gravité mondial de nos activités avioniques hélicoptères. Il abrite également nos activités de services numériques.
Vous intégrez le Centre de Compétence Software Avionics Function (SAF) et rejoignez l'équipe Platform and sensor Application Function (PAF).
Dans un contexte d'adoption de l'IA agentique, l’objectif de ce stage est d’adapter nos pratiques de développement afin d'en tirer des gains concrets. Vous collaborez en environnement multi-projets, favorisant l’échange entre équipes et le retour d’expérience pour améliorer continuellement les pratiques.
Dans ce contexte, vous :
Adoptez les pratiques de développement adaptées à l’IA agentique dans le cadre strict de la norme DO178 ;
Participez à la mise en place des méthodes et compétences réutilisables pour les équipes pour faciliter le partage et la documentation ;
Développez et améliorez des outils intégrés à l’intégration continue, notamment pour l’aide au développement et la pré-analyse des défaillances ;
Mesurez les gains et coûts en termes de temps, budget et productivité ;
Identifiez, préparez et suivez des projets pilotes, comme Minos, pour valider les compétences développées.
Votre profil
Votre priorité est de rejoindre un grand groupe industriel ?
Vous avez l’ambition de participer à des projets novateurs ?
Vous avez envie de découvrir le domaine du systèmes embarqué ?
Vous préparez un BAC+5 en Informatique et avez des connaissances en :
IA : agentique, prompting, LLM...
Développement logiciel : cycle de vie, qualité, bonnes pratiques,
Création et mise en place d'outils et automatisations, CI/CD,
Scripting et développement d'outils : Python, Bash.
Curiosité, travail en équipe, rigueur et agilité sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait?
Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Le mot de l'équipe
"Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif, où l’échange avec les différentes équipes est essentiel pour avancer efficacement. Nous valorisons la rigueur, l’autonomie et la capacité à poser des questions, afin de progresser vite et bien."
Frédéric
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

 Job Description
THE OPPORTUNITY
Shape the future of People Operations at Vend.
Vend is the home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA, and Bilbasen—where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start. 
Are you ready to be a key player in our Nordic People Operations Hub? We are looking for a People Operations Specialist who enjoys solving problems and is curious about how AI and technology can create simpler, faster, and more intuitive experiences.
As part of our team, you will resolve operational needs across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Finland. You will combine hands-on delivery with opportunities to improve digital workflows, make trusted information easier to find, and enable effective self-service. Working closely with People Business Partners, Specialists, and Product owners - using modern platforms and our AI front door - you will turn everyday insights into improvements that reduce effort and elevate the employee and manager experience.
Connect and collaborate in our central, modern Oslo or Stockholm office, complemented by flexible work options!
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Resolve Operational Needs: Resolve employee and manager inquiries across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Finland - handling data changes and lifecycle events with high data integrity.
Enable Knowledge, Self-Service & AI: Guide employees and managers towards digital services, trusted information and self-service. Work with accountable content owners to keep knowledge clear, usable and AI-ready, identifying gaps and opportunities for automation.
Improve How Services Work: Use cases, data and feedback to identify friction and improve Hub workflows. Collaborate with product owners and specialists on broader process improvements, and contribute to cross-functional initiatives, automation and AI development.
WHAT YOU BRING
Relevant Experience: Approximately 2–4 years in People Operations or HR administration, ideally in a multi-country or fast-moving environment.
Education: Higher or vocational education within HR or another relevant field.
Digital Confidence: Hands-on experience with modern HR platforms and confidence using AI tools, digital assistants and data to make work easier.
Ownership & Judgement: You follow requests through, handle sensitive information carefully and recognise when to involve others.
Problem-Solving & Improvement: You use data and feedback to understand employee and manager needs, simplify workflows and create clear, useful guidance.
Communication & Collaboration: You work well across teams and countries, communicate clearly and bring fluency in English, and it’s an advantage if you have working proficiency in Norwegian or Swedish.
GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!
Make sure to apply by the 18th of October; we’re looking forward to hearing from you!
Elke Wangen, Head of People Experience & Operations, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. Elke is best reached by email (elke.wangen@vend.com).
If you have any questions about the recruitment process or our company culture, Cecilia Bergerståhl, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, is here for you! Contact info can be found at the bottom of the ad.

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Gennevilliers, France
Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Notre savoir-faire technologique
Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
Votre quotidien
Le Campus de Gennevilliers est le cœur des activités de conception, de développement et de soutien des grands systèmes de défense : radiocommunications, réseaux et systèmes d’infrastructure résilients, communications par satellite, combat collaboratif et cybersécurité. Situé au nord de Paris, il est rapidement accessible en transports en commun.
Au sein du centre de compétence HTE (Hardware technologies, Tools & Engineering), vous intégrerez une équipe du service TCP (Traitement, Capteurs & Propagation) en charge de la définition et de la conception de solutions algorithmiques, modules logiciels et démonstrateurs dans les domaines des communications, du traitement du signal, du traitement de données, de la guerre électronique, de la radionavigation, de l’acoustique aérienne et de la conception de systèmes d'antennes dédiés à ces domaines.
Vos missions
Ce stage de 6 mois porte sur la goniométrie qui a pour objectif l’estimation des directions d’arrivée d’émetteurs radioélectriques à partir des signaux reçus sur un réseau d’antennes.
Outre les méthodes de goniométrie classiques telles que le beamforming et MUSIC développées entre les années 60 et 80, de nouvelles méthodes sont apparues au début des années 2000 : les méthodes de goniométrie parcimonieuse. Ces méthodes présentent des performances supérieures en comparaison aux méthodes classiques. Elles permettent notamment d’estimer plus de sources que d’antennes. Ces méthodes estiment les directions d’arrivée des sources en exploitant la parcimonie en angles du modèle d’observation. Ce stage prendra la suite des travaux issus de deux thèses effectuées au sein du service [A. Delmer 2021 & T. Aussaguès 2026].
La mission proposée consistera à prendre en compte l’incertitude autour de la réponse du réseau d’antennes dans les algorithmes de goniométrie parcimonieuse. Cette incertitude est appelée erreur de modèle et a plusieurs origines : erreur sur les positions des antennes, déphasage additionnel, couplage mutuel etc. En présence d’erreurs de modèle, les performances des méthodes de goniométrie parcimonieuses se dégradent.
Vous contribuerez à l’analyse et l’amélioration d’un traitement de goniométrie parcimonieuse en présence d’erreurs de modèle. Spécifiquement, vous aborderez les points suivants :
Adapter et améliorer l’algorithme développé dans les thèses [A. Delmer 2021 et T. Aussaguès 2026] en présence d’erreurs de modèle. Spécifiquement, l’étape de blanchiment de l’erreur d’estimation sur l’observation devra être adaptée ;
Analyser les performances statistiques de la méthode proposée.
Les objectifs du stage seront :
1 - de mettre au point les réseaux de neurones correspondants à différents algorithmes itératifs parcimonieux
2 - d'évaluer l'apport des méthodes de dépliement des algorithmes parcimonieux en goniométrie en présence d'erreurs de modèles
3 - d'évaluer l'apport de ces méthodes pour la diminution de la complexité.
Votre profil
De formation Bac+5 (ingénieur ou équivalent), vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois pour finir votre cursus. Vous justifiez d’une première expérience en traitement du signal, manifestez un intérêt marqué pour l’intelligence artificielle et êtes passionné par les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité.
Maîtrisez-vous l’algèbre linéaire appliquée au traitement d’antennes, notamment le calcul matriciel et la décomposition en éléments propres ?
Avez-vous des connaissances en optimisation numérique, comme les algorithmes de minimisation, la descente de gradient ou l’estimation parcimonieuse ?
Êtes-vous à l’aise avec la programmation en MATLAB et Python ?
Disposez-vous de connaissances en statistique et estimation paramétrique, par exemple le maximum de vraisemblance ou les problèmes inverses ?
Connaissez-vous le traitement d’antennes et la propagation des ondes électromagnétiques ?
Possédez-vous un esprit d’analyse aiguisé et faites-vous preuve de rigueur dans votre travail ?
Si c'est le cas, ne laissez pas passer cette belle opportunité !
Mot de l'équipe
Rejoignez une équipe de passionnés et d’experts, à taille humaine, avec 40 ans d’innovation algorithmique à son actif en traitement d’antennes. Ce stage est pour vous l’opportunité d’apprendre et d’évoluer au sein d’une équipe de haut niveau dans un contexte de recherche et développement industriel.
Anne et Thomas

Location: Singapore, Singapore
In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. The IS Administrator will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, and support of the Business Applications systems, and application components. Plan and coordinate testing changes, upgrades, and new services, ensuring systems will operate correctly in current and future environments.
Prepare user training document for business applications and associated processes with business departments

Able to start as soon as possible
Fresh Graduate and Diploma in Information System or Computer Science related majors are welcome
Microsoft VBA/VB Script programming Experience

Smart and willing to learn new things
Good communication skills

Jobbeskrivning
Tietos verksamhet inom Data/AI söker nu en Data Architect eller en Data Engineer med fokus på Databricks som vill bidra till vår och våra kunders utveckling.
Har du praktisk erfarenhet av att migrera traditionella BI-lösningar till moderna plattformar med Databricks? Vill du både designa arkitekturen och själv bygga pipelines, modeller och transformationer? Då kanske du är vår nästa kollega!
Vi söker dig som vill leda och driva utvecklingen av moderna dataplattformar – från förstudie och arkitektur till implementering och förvaltning. Du kommer spela en central roll i transformationen från äldre lösningar som Azure Synapse och SSIS till ett framtidssäkrat Lakehouse baserat på Databricks, Apache Spark och dbt.
Din roll som data engineer/data architect inom Databricks på Tieto Tech Consulting 
Som arkitekt hos oss får du en central roll i att designa och implementera moderna. dataplattformar – ofta med Databricks som nav. Du arbetar nära kundens verksamhet, tar ansvar för skalbarhet, säkerhet och prestanda, och bidrar till en datadriven kultur både hos kund och internt. Du jobbar i uppdrag som ofta sträcker sig över 1–2 år, antingen som en del av ett större team eller som specialist.
Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat inkludera:
Design och implementering av skalbara plattformar med fokus på Databricks.
Migrering från traditionella miljöer som Azure Synapse.
Kodning i Python och hantering av CI/CD i Azure DevOps.
Strukturera Medallion-arkitektur och säkra kvalitet i olika datalager.
Rådgivning kring molnarkitektur (Azure, GCP eller AWS).
Bidra till kompetensutveckling internt genom t.ex. workshops eller mentorroller.
Vi söker dig som:
Har lång erfarenhet inom data & analytics och en stark teknisk grund inom moderna plattformar.
Cirka 10 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, varav åtta år inom data och analytics – med fokus på arkitektur och lösningsdesign.
Mycket god erfarenhet av Databricks och Python.
Erfarenhet av CI/CD och arbete i Azure DevOps.
Förståelse för skalbar, säker molnarkitektur – gärna i Azure.
Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska både skriftligt och muntligt. 
Vi tror att du är självgående, nyfiken och van att jobba i konsultnära uppdrag där du både bygger och förklarar.
Det är mycket meriterande om du har:
Certifiering inom Databricks.
Erfarenhet av verktyg som DBT, Airflow eller Spark.
Vana att arbeta med analytics-verktyg och datamodellering.
Vi erbjuder 
Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats för professionell utveckling, meningsfulla projekt, en öppen kultur och en möjlighet för kompetensutveckling i ett spännande område där det konstant händer nya saker.
Låter det intressant?
Är du redo att forma framtidens dataplattformar? Bifoga ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil så kontaktar vi dig. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande, så vi uppmuntrar dig att ansöka redan idag

Votre quotidien
En nous rejoignant à Montbonnot, vous intégrez un site à proximité de Grenoble localisé dans la technopole Inovallée au pied des montagnes, regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.
Au sein d'une équipe projet, vous développerez  des outils d’automatisation et d’analyse des résultats de tests au sein d’un centre de services. L’équipe de 50 personnes conçoit des applications pour exploiter les données de test et pourrait créer un connecteur entre simulateur et plateforme.

Développer des applications pour extraire et formaliser les données de test depuis une base de données ;

Concevoir un connecteur entre un simulateur et une plateforme de tests automatisés ;
Intégrer les outils développés dans le workflow de l’équipe projet ;
S’initier au métier de testeur en collaborant avec l’équipe dédiée ;
Tester, documenter et améliorer les développements pour en garantir la robustesse.

Vous avez l’ambition de développer de nouvelles compétences au sein d'un grand groupe international ?
Vous avez envie de découvrir un métier riche et varié ?
Autonomie, rigueur et travail en équipe sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnaît ?
Vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études en informatique de 6 mois dès février 2027 ?
Vous maîtrisez :
Les tests, si possible automatisés.
C'est un plus si vous avez des connaissances en :
Qualité logicielle ;
Bases de données (SQL) ;
Développement d'applications (Python, Java ou Rust).

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Charleroi, Belgium
Acteur spatial mondialement reconnu dans les domaines des télécommunications, de la navigation, de l’observation de la terre, de l’exploration et de la réalisation d’infrastructures orbitales, Thales Alenia Space est une Joint-Venture entre les groupes Thales (67%) et Leonardo (33%).
Thales Alenia Space Belgium est expert dans plusieurs domaines de hautes technologies. En effet, Thales Alenia Space Belgium est le leader mondial en conditionnement et distribution d’énergie à bord des satellites et le plus important fournisseur d’électronique pour Ariane 5. Thales Alenia Space Belgium est implanté sur 3 sites, un à Charleroi, un à Leuven et le dernier sur Hasselt (assemblage des cellules photovoltaïques pour panneaux solaires des satellites). Nous vous offrons : l’opportunité de travailler au sein d’une entreprise mondialement reconnue pour la qualité de ses produits, des opportunités de carrière au sein d’une entreprise en constante évolution, un domaine d’activités attractif à la pointe de la technologie.
À pourvoir dès que possible. Ce stage a une durée de 6 mois.
Un travail de fin d’étude n’est pas envisageable dans ce stage.
Dans le cadre des activités du département Finance, le stagiaire participera au suivi de la performance économique de l'entreprise et contribuera à l'élaboration des outils d'aide à la décision destinés aux équipes opérationnelles et financières.
Les missions couvrent notamment les activités suivantes :
Participation au suivi budgétaire.
Élaboration et mise à jour des tableaux de bord.
Analyse des écarts entre le réalisé et le budget.
Participation aux clôtures mensuelles.
Préparation de reportings financiers.
Contribution à l'amélioration des outils de pilotage et des indicateurs de performance.
En relation directe avec les collaborateurs du département Contrôle de gestion, votre mission principale consistera à analyser les données financières, participer au suivi des indicateurs de performance et accompagner les équipes dans le pilotage économique de leurs activités.
Plus précisément, au quotidien, vous :
Participerez à la préparation des reportings financiers.
Contribuerez au suivi des budgets et à l'analyse des écarts.
Participerez à la création et à l'amélioration des tableaux de bord.
Réaliserez des analyses économiques afin de soutenir la prise de décision.
Participerez à l'optimisation des outils et des processus de contrôle de gestion.
Le profil que nous recherchons :
Langues requises : Très bon français à l'oral comme à l'écrit, anglais intermédiaire.
Formation scolaire requise : Contrôle de gestion, finance, comptabilité ou école de commerce.
Niveau d'étude requis : Bac +4 à Bac +5 (Master 1 ou Master 2).
Compétences requises : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel, Pack Office, esprit d'analyse, rigueur, autonomie et appétence pour l'analyse de données financières.
Nous vous offrons :
L’opportunité de contribuer à des projets d’envergure internationale au cœur du domaine spatial
Une fonction au sein de notre équipe R&D au départ de notre site de … au sein d’une société technologique internationale porteuse de sens, aux valeurs fortes et aux perspectives de carrière larges
Un dédommagement de 6€ par jour presté pour votre repas de midi si vous résidez en Belgique et si vous êtes un étudiant étranger, vous bénéficierez en plus d’un dédomagement de 6€ pour votre repas du soir.
Vos trajets en transport en commun entre votre lieu de résidence de votre stage et notre entreprise pris en charge à 100%
Si vous présentez un fort intérêt pour le secteur spatial et le contrôle de gestion, que vous possédez les compétences requises et que vous souhaitez faire partie d'une équipe passionnée, n'hésitez pas à nous envoyer votre CV !
Merci de préciser dans votre candidature quelle période vous convient et si vous avez besoin de réaliser votre TFE chez nous.

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Toulouse, France
Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Notre savoir-faire technologique
Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
Votre quotidien
Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.
Sur le site de Toulouse, vous rejoignez la Direction Financière dans le cadre de la construction et du déploiement de nouvelles BI. Ce stage vise à apporter un support aux Data Scientists.
En nous rejoignant vos missions sont : 
Accompagnement des équipes métiers dans l’identification des besoins, co-construction des solutions adaptées, et contribution à la mise en œuvre de projets numériques,
Réalisation de Dashboard pour le suivi des indicateurs clés,
Rédaction de notes, analyse des résultats et proposition d’améliorations.
Votre profil : 
Vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 3 à 6 mois? 
Vous préparez une formation de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 à dominante Data et vous avez des connaissances sur : 
Outils d'aide à la décision (SIAD),
Business process et modeling, 
Programmation, Data structure et Algorithmes,
Base de données, Programmation web et open data
Votre rigueur, votre esprit d’équipe, votre capacité d’analyse et votre adaptabilité sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait? 
Alors ce poste est fait pour vous!
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Toulouse, France
Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Notre savoir-faire technologique
Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
Votre quotidien
En rejoignant le site de Toulouse, vous intégrez un site regroupant nos solutions de cyberdéfense souveraines pour faire face aux menaces informatiques croissantes et nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée.
Dans un centre de calcul haute performance (HPC), l’optimisation de code améliore l’efficacité et réduit les coûts de calcul. L’IA, notamment les modèles de langage à grand contexte, permet d’automatiser cette optimisation pour des bases de code complètes et multi-langages. Le stage vise à définir et mettre en œuvre un système IA capable d’analyser automatiquement un code source, puis de générer des suggestions d’optimisation à deux niveaux : une première analyse et des améliorations plus poussées incluant des pistes de parallélisation. Le système exécute ce processus sous forme de jobs SLURM pouvant durer plusieurs heures, en particulier sur GPU. Il s’intègre aussi à un monitoring multi-agents qui teste et valide les optimisations proposées. Le travail consiste à structurer un pipeline complet IA (analyse + génération), mettre en place un environnement local compatible grand contexte (plus de 20k tokens), assurer l’orchestration SLURM en période creuse, puis explorer un monitoring éventuel avec exécution et validation “live”.
Votre profil
Votre priorité est d'effectuer un stage de 6 mois ?
Vous avez l’ambition de perfectionner vos connaissances en informatique et en IA ?
Vous souhaitez découvrir l'IA générative et les outils de monitoring ?
Vous préparez un diplôme d'Ingénieur ou un équivalent bac +5 et vous avez de l'expérience sur :
le développement en Python, C/C++ ou Java
la gestion des jobs HPC (SLURM),
l'optimisation de code.
Votre curiosité, votre proactivité, votre prise d'initiative et votre rigueur sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !
