 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Charleroi, Belgium
Acteur spatial mondialement reconnu dans les domaines des télécommunications, de la navigation, de l’observation de la terre, de l’exploration et de la réalisation d’infrastructures orbitales, Thales Alenia Space est une Joint-Venture entre les groupes Thales (67%) et Leonardo (33%).
Thales Alenia Space Belgium est expert dans plusieurs domaines de hautes technologies. En effet, Thales Alenia Space Belgium est le leader mondial en conditionnement et distribution d’énergie à bord des satellites et le plus important fournisseur d’électronique pour Ariane 5. Thales Alenia Space Belgium est implanté sur 3 sites, un à Charleroi, un à Leuven et le dernier sur Hasselt (assemblage des cellules photovoltaïques pour panneaux solaires des satellites). Nous vous offrons : l’opportunité de travailler au sein d’une entreprise mondialement reconnue pour la qualité de ses produits, des opportunités de carrière au sein d’une entreprise en constante évolution, un domaine d’activités attractif à la pointe de la technologie.
À pourvoir dès que possible. Ce stage à une durée de 6 mois.
Un travail de fin d’étude n’est pas envisageable dans ce stage.
Dans le cadre des activités du département Finance, le stagiaire participera aux différentes missions liées à la comptabilité générale et analytique afin de contribuer au bon fonctionnement des processus financiers de l'entreprise.
Les missions couvrent notamment les activités suivantes :
Saisie et contrôle des écritures comptables.
Rapprochements bancaires.
Suivi des factures fournisseurs et clients.
Participation aux clôtures mensuelles.
Classement et archivage des pièces comptables.
Participation à l'amélioration des procédures comptables.
En relation directe avec les collaborateurs du département Finance, votre mission principale consistera à assister l'équipe comptable dans la gestion quotidienne des opérations financières et à veiller à la fiabilité des données comptables
Plus précisément, au quotidien, vous :
Participerez à l'enregistrement des opérations comptables.
Contrôlerez les justificatifs et la conformité des pièces comptables.
Contribuerez aux travaux de clôture mensuelle.
Participerez au suivi des règlements et au rapprochement des comptes.
Apporterez votre soutien à l'amélioration des outils et des procédures du service.
Le profil que nous recherchons :
Langues requises : Très bon français à l'oral comme à l'écrit, anglais intermédiaire.
Formation scolaire requise : Comptabilité, finance ou gestion.
Niveau d'étude requis : Bac +3 à Bac +5 (Licence 3, Master 1 ou Master 2).
Compétences requises : Maîtrise du Pack Office (notamment Excel), connaissances en comptabilité générale, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'analyse.
Nous vous offrons :
L’opportunité de contribuer à des projets d’envergure internationale au cœur du domaine spatial
Une fonction au sein de notre équipe R&D au départ de notre site de … au sein d’une société technologique internationale porteuse de sens, aux valeurs fortes et aux perspectives de carrière larges
Un dédommagement de 6€ par jour presté pour votre repas de midi si vous résidez en Belgique et si vous êtes un étudiant étranger, vous bénéficierez en plus d’un dédomagement de 6€ pour votre repas du soir.
Vos trajets en transport en commun entre votre lieu de résidence de votre stage et notre entreprise pris en charge à 100%
Si vous présentez un fort intérêt pour le secteur spatial et la comptabilité, que vous possédez les compétences requises et que vous souhaitez faire partie d'une équipe passionnée, n'hésitez pas à nous envoyer votre CV !
Merci de préciser dans votre candidature quelle période vous convient et si vous avez besoin de réaliser votre TFE chez nous.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Cholet, France
Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Notre savoir-faire technologique
Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
Votre quotidien
Entre Nantes et Angers, proche de la côte Atlantique, notre site de Cholet à dominante R&D et à forte empreinte industrielle, est spécialisé dans les radiocommunications de défense, les systèmes de communications par satellites et les solutions de cybersécurité.
Au sein de l'entité Secure Communications & Information System (SIX), le secteur SSC fournit des services de confiance pour la préparation et la conduite de missions critiques.
Le Centre de compétence PSD assure les activités de soutien Hardware (réparations, rechanges, mises à jour et assistance technique) des équipements livrés par la GBU afin de garantir leur disponibilité chez les clients. PSD réalise environ 11 000 réparations par an et produit de nombreux rechanges. L’équipe E-nov accompagne la transformation digitale et l’optimisation des processus de PSD.
Vos missions :
Déployer auprès des techniciens réparation un chatbot d’aide au diagnostic exploitant les données disponibles : historiques de pannes, études de fiabilité et documentations de maintenance.
Accompagner l’adoption de cet outil destiné à faciliter les opérations de dépannage.
Collaborer avec les datascientists de la Direction Technique pour améliorer les performances du chatbot.
Formuler des recommandations favorisant une meilleure capitalisation et exploitation des données.
Votre profil :
Vous avez l’ambition de contribuer à la transformation digitale d’un environnement industriel en combinant exploitation de la donnée, intelligence artificielle et pilotage de projet ?
Vous avez envie de découvrir les enjeux du soutien Hardware, de collaborer avec des équipes expertes et de participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de maintenance ?
Vous préparez un Bac+5 en école d’ingénieur ou en Master, dans le domaine de la data science, de l’informatique, de l’intelligence artificielle ou équivalent, dans le cadre d’un stage de fin d’études, et avez des connaissances en :
• Intelligence artificielle et prompt engineering
• Exploitation de la donnée et data science
• Management de projet
Esprit de synthèse, rigueur, prise d’initiative, curiosité et adaptabilité sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.
En tant que spécialiste des procédés de traitement de surface et peinture, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l’amélioration de la maîtrise des procédés spéciaux, la définition du standard Groupe, la performance industrielle des sites de production (internes et fournisseurs) et le déploiement des bonnes pratiques industrielles.

Vous assurez une veille technologique et industrielle pour identifier les ruptures et établir la roadmap des années à venir
Vous animez un réseau d’expert au sein du Groupe

En tant qu’industriel spécialiste des procédés de fabrication mécaniques, vous justifiez de 10-15 années d’expérience dans un environnement industriel similaire et :
Vous maîtrisez les procédés de traitement de surface et peinture et les contrôles associés
Vous avez spécifié et qualifié des procédés et des moyens industriels et maîtrisez les méthodologies associées (définition de cahier des charge équipement, réception, qualification, capabilité, …)
Vous avez une expérience dans l’industrialisation de pièces mécaniques, en particulier pour les aspects traitement de surface et peinture et dans l’automatisation de ces procédés
Vous maîtrisez la corrosion et les matériaux métalliques utilisés pour l’aéronautique et la défense
​

Vous connaissez les réglementations associées à l’implémentation des procédés de traitement de surface et peinture (REACH, …)
Vous avez une expérience dans l’implémentation de pratiques associées à l’Industrie 4.0 : digitalisation, automatisation, …
Vous avez une expérience dans la métallisation des composites/polymères ou dans les techniques de métallisation sous vide
Vous avez une travaillé avec des équipes ou fournisseurs hors Europe
Compétences comportementales

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Lieu : Vélizy-Villacoublay, France
Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
Un package de rémunération attractif
Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
Votre quotidien
Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.
L'outil TCIS (Thales Component Information System) référence l'ensemble des composants (matériels, produits chimiques, outils logiciels) utilisés par le groupe Thales pour définir et développer ses produits.
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Software Solution Engineer expérimenté pour maintenir en condition opérationnelle cet outil et participer au développement de son écosystème.
Vos principales missions seront :
Effectuer le Support (redémarrage application / serveur ...) de cette application dans le respect des directives, processus et pratiques standardisés de la discipline
Développer et livrer des packs correctifs de cette application
Contribuer de manière active à l'intégration de cette application dans son écosystème en développant des passerelles entre TCIS et les différents outils de son écosystème.
Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour implémenter et exécuter des tests d'intégration
Participer et contribuer aux évènements de disciplines qui promeuvent l'amélioration continue.
Participer activement aux différentes cérémonies agiles
Votre profil :
Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 5 ans dans le développement d'application d'applications logiciel en tant que développeur Full stack et en particulier sur du maintien en condition opérationnelle.
Vous maitrisez le développement JAVA en particulier la version 1.6
Vous avez des connaissances solides en scripting Shell
Vous avez des connaissances solides en Oracle - SQL/PLSQL
Par ailleurs :
Vous avez des connaissances de l’OS linux (Red Hat )
Vous avez des connaissances sur un Cloud provider en particulier Azure
Vous vous intéressez aux technologies d'IA, en particulier l'IA générative
Vous avez une forte appétence pour le Software craftmanship et ses principes
Vous êtes doté(e) de fort esprit d’analyse, vous avez l’esprit d’équipe et êtes autonome.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Exjobb på 3bits med möjlighet till anställning
Sedan 2008 har vi på 3bits hjälpt e-handlare och företag att leverera framgångsrika lösningar som Mölnlycke Health Care, Ragn-Sells, Lindex och Unident. Vi är över 25 personer som tillsammans med våra kunder utvecklar e-handelslösningar och användarvänliga kundportaler.
Vi är ett teknikfokuserat företag som gillar innovation med Hackatondagar och R&D-tänk för att fortsätta att driva utvecklingen av e-handel framåt. Hos oss arbetar systemutvecklare, testare, affärsutvecklare och lösningsarkitekter i team som delar med sig av kunskap och hjälper varandra. Vi arbetar in house på vårt kontor nära Centralstationen i Göteborg eftersom vi vet hur viktig närheten till teamet är både för gemenskap och effektivitet.
Vi erbjuder Exjobb med möjlighet till anställning
Vi letar nu efter exjobbare med möjlighet till anställning efter examen. Har du något projekt får du gärna berätta mer om det. Vi har ett spännande projekt inom e-handel och AI som vi skulle vilja ha hjälp att genomföra som vi tror är en del av hur vi kommer handla i framtiden. Vill du vara med på den resan och sedan fortsätta den som anställd på 3bits som systemutvecklare så ska du skicka in din ansökan till jobb@3bits.se.
Chattbot för e-handlare
De senaste åren har användandet av meddelandetjänster som Facebook Messenger, Whatsapp, Slack, Kik, Skype, Telegram ökat exponentiellt. Faktum är att Internetanvändarna nu spenderar mer tid i olika meddelandetjänster än de gör i t ex sociala medier.
För en e-handlare är det naturligtvis viktigt att finnas där kunderna finns. Meddelandetjänsterna skiljer sig dock ganska radikalt från övriga kanaler genom att användarna förväntar sig en tvåvägskommunikation och möjligheten att få personlig rådgivning i olika frågor. En nyhet under 2016 var att i princip samtliga av de stora meddelandetjänsterna öppnade upp för chattbottar i sina nätverk. Detta ger e-handlare en unik möjlighet att ständigt finnas på plats och inte bara nå ut med sina erbjudanden utan också att lära känna sina kunder bättre. Företag som H&M och Sephora har varit tidigt ute med att lansera botar som undersöker vad kunderna gillar och utifrån det tar fram individuella produktrekommendationer.
På 3bits jobbar vi med flera intressanta företag, där vi i samband med tidigare examensarbeten tagit fram AI-baserade metoder för produktrekommendationer och klassificering av kunder utifrån köp- och klickhistorik, samt metoder för klassificering och sökning av produkter utifrån visuella likheter. Vi är nu intresserade av att hitta en eller flera exjobbare som vill vidareutveckla dessa metoder och den chattbot som påbörjats i tidigare examensarbeten för att dra nytta av kundernas feedback och ge dem mervärde i form av mer relevanta produktrekommendationer.
Vi har även fler intressanta projekt på gång och är självklart även intresserade av dina egna idéer till exjobb som du vill genomföra tillsammans med oss.

Thesis Work at 3bits with Opportunity to Employment
Since 2008, we at 3bits have helped e-retailers and companies to deliver successful solutions such as Mölnlycke Health Care, Ragn-Sells, Lindex and Unident. We are more than 25 people who together with our customers develop e-commerce solutions and user-friendly customer portals.
We are a technology-focused company that likes innovation with Hackathon Days and R&D thinking to continue to drive the development of e-commerce forward. We have co-workers who work as System Developers, Testers, Business Developers, and Solution Architects in teams who share their knowledge, and assist eachother. We work in-house at our office near the Central Station in Gothenburg, since we know that being close to your team is important both for efficiency and feeling connected.
We Offer Thesis Work with the Opportunity to Employment
We are now looking for thesis workers with the possibility of employment after graduation. If you have a project, tell us more about it. We have an exiting project in e-commerce and AI that we would like help with. If you want to be a part of this journey, and later continue it as a System Developer at 3bits, send your application to work@3bits.se.
Chatbot for e-retailers
During the last years, the use of messaging services as Facebook Messenger, Whatsapp, Slack, Kik, Skype, and Telegram has increased exponentially. The fact is that the Internet users now spend more time in different messaging services than in for example social media.
For an e-retailer it is of course important to be present where the customers are. The messaging services differ from other channels quite radically, since the users expect a two way communication, and the possibility of personal guidance in different questions. A new thing in 2016 was that basically all of the large messaging services opened up for chatbots in their networks. This provides the e-retailers a unique possibility to always be present, and not only reach out with offers, but also getting to know their customers better. Companies like H&M and Sephora, have been early to launch bots that examines what the customers like, and from that present individual product recommendations.
At 3bits we work with several interesting companies, where we in earlier thesis works have come up with AI based methods for product recommendations, and classifications of customers from order and click history, and methods for classification and search for products with visual similarities. We are now interested in finding one or more thesis workers that want to further develop these methods, and the chatbot that is started in previous thesis works, to learn from the customers’ feedback, and adding value in more relevant product recommendations.
We also have more interesting projects in the works and are of course also interested in your own ideas for thesis projects that you would like to carry out together with us.

We demonstrate how AI-driven development works in practice. From idea to a working prototype of something your business actually needs in a short amount of time. You'll gain a clear understanding of the solution's potential, technical feasibility, and the next steps before investing in a larger project.

From take-off to landing, Thales offers the most complete range of solutions to provide dynamic Air Traffic Services to support today's growing domestic and international travel requirements. Utilising this knowledge and experience Thales Australia will deliver a harmonised Civil/Military Air Traffic Management System (OneSKY) in Australia to Airservices Australia and Defence.

Your role
The role of ATM Operational Specialist is a key role for the TopSky-One project and as part of the AOS team, help to define and deliver a fit for purpose data solution to the end user.
Some key accountabilities include
Understanding all the aspects of TopSky-One subsystems (ATM, BYPASS and SIM)
Identify and evaluate the actual process in place and improve co-engineering( tools, way of working, …)
Work with the team on improvement of the process & methods to be able to handle all design and development tactivities
Participate in solution design and work closely with Product Owners and System Engineers
Attend to Sprint and Product increment Demo in order to give feedback on deliveries.
Fully work inside the AOS OPS Team to provide Air Traffic Management experience for CMATS
Populate the dataset for CMATS and be fully part of the Operational Dataset creation for CMATS T&E activities
On day one you will come with: 
Experience in Air Traffic Control management
Experience in Dataset preparation for an ATM System
Havea knowledge of Australian ATM Domain and Air Traffic Management standards eg. ICAO, Eurocontrol, AID
High level of understanding on dataset / adaptation data goals and impacts.
Capability to work with various stakeholders having different objectives
Capability to work in a multi-cultural environment and with variety of international customers.
A Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.
Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol.  JOB DESCRIPTION
Location: Templecombe, United Kingdom
Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.
2027 Procurement Apprentice – Level 3 Business Admin and Level 4 Procurement and Supply Apprenticeship
Start Date: 6 September 2027
Salary: £24,000 per annum
Employee type: Permanent
Location: Templecombe
Working Schedule: Monday – Friday, 37 hours a week (8 hours Monday – Thursday, 5 hours Friday)
Transform your curiosity into a rewarding career. If you’re passionate about procurement and supply chain, interested in developing skills in negotiation and supplier relationship management, and eager to learn, this apprenticeship is perfect for you. Combining academic study with hands-on, practical experience, it offers a fantastic opportunity to grow and thrive. We’d love to hear from you!
Benefits of the programme:
Earn a salary while studying for your apprenticeship
Gain hands-on experience in a real-life working environment
Receive job-specific training and development
Achieve a recognised procurement qualification
Secure a permanent role from the start of your apprenticeship
Tuition fees for the approved training providers are fully covered
About the Role
As a Procurement Apprentice, you will become a valued member of our UK centralised procurement team, working at the very heart of supply chain operations
Your responsibilities may include:
Hands-on experience in tactical buying and procurement
Opportunity to support cost-saving initiatives and efficient purchasing decisions
Exposure to supplier management and maintaining positive supplier relationships
Training in core procurement processes and procedures
Experience in purchase order creation and management
Developing customer service skills by supporting internal stakeholders
Building confidence in problem-solving within supply chain operations
Experience in contract administration and the basics of procurement law
Collaboration with a centralised UK team on supply chain activities
Support in developing skills in responsible and sustainable procurement
Introduction to risk identification and management in the procurement context
Real prospects for growth and development within the procurement profession
What You Will Learn
Throughout your apprenticeship, you will develop knowledge and skills in:
Tactical buying, negotiation, and supplier relationship management to ensure value and compliance for the business 
Learn to create and manage purchase orders efficiently 
Solve day-to-day supply chain challenges 
Deliver excellent service to internal customers 
Work closely with colleagues across functions to collaborate effectively 
Develop skills in contract administration and risk awareness 
Promote ethical and sustainable procurement practices 
Acquire practical experience and build a strong foundation for a career in procurement 
Access opportunities for progression and professional growth within the procurement profession 
Apprenticeship Programme
You will study towards a Level 3 Business Administration Apprenticeship, before progressing onto a Level 4 Procurement and Supply Apprenticeship with The Apprentice Academy.
The programme is delivered through a virtual delivery model, combining:
Live taught lessons
Online learning resources
Self-directed learning activities
Programme structure:
As a Procurement Apprentice you will enrol onto a 3-year programme, which will include two parts:
Years 1
Complete a Level 3 in Business Administration with the Apprentice Academy. Delivered via a virtual learning module, this part of the programme will introduce you to the business in the context of procurement.
Years 2 and 3
Progress onto a Level 4 Procurement and Supply Apprenticeship with the same training provider. Upon completion you will hold both the Level 3 and 4 apprenticeship qualification, plus your CIPS Level 4.
You will be based in our centralised procurement team in the UK, working alongside experienced professionals. Throughout the programme, you will receive on-the-job training, coaching, and support to develop your capabilities as a Tactical Buyer. Thales will support your professional qualifications as part of your development, and you’ll have access to a range of learning and development resources.
Entry Requirements
To apply you will need: 
2 A Levels or equivalent Grade C or above in any subject or equivalent Level 3 qualification such as BTEC Diploma or T Level
5 GCSEs Grade 9-4 (A-C) including Maths and English
Please note that applicants who already hold a relevant degree will not be eligible for this programme.
Benefits
·       Competitive salary of £24,000 per annum
·       Performance-related pay uplifts
·       Holiday entitlement of 201 hours a year (plus a company day and bank holidays)
·       Contributory Company Pension
·       Health Care Cash Plan
·       Hybrid/flexible working options
·       Employee assistance programme
·       Learning and development support
·       Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives
·       Life Cover
·       80 Hours Volunteering per year (first two years)
Thales Apprentice Recruitment Process
1.      Apply Online - submit your application online to register your interest.  You only need to register for one role as you will have the opportunity to apply for additional roles at the full application stage.
2.      Upload Your CV
3.      Check your emails for the invitation to apply – this will come from recruiting@jobalerts.thalesgroup.com
4.      Complete Your Application – follow the link provided in the email to complete your application.  You can apply for one primary role and up to 3 additional roles.
5.      Complete Online Tests - undertake the online assessments designed to evaluate your  suitability for the role.
6.      Virtual Assessment Centre - candidates who progress from the online assessment stage will attend a virtual assessment centre, which will include group exercises, and competency-based interviews.
7.      Job Offer – successful candidates who perform well throughout the recruitment process will receive a job offer from Thales.
For further information about our Future Talent recruitment process, including hints and tips, or to connect with a member of the Future Talent Team, a Graduate, or an Apprentice, please visit Thales Future Talent - Connectr.
Please note, assessment centres for shortlisted candidates will be held between February - May 2027.  Induction week for all Graduate and Apprentices will take place from Monday 6 September - Friday 10 September 2027.
Closing date: Our applications will close at 11.59pm on Wednesday 17 February 2027, this is the only time we will be accepting applications this year. Please note, we will be in contact by the end of February 2027 with details of next steps.
PLEASE NOTE THAT ROLES MAY CLOSE EARLIER THAN THE ADVERTISED DEADLINE IF WE RECEIVE A HIGH NUMER OF APPLICATIONS.  WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO AVOID MISSING OUT ON THIS OPPORTUNITY.
Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements.
To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.
To be eligible for SC clearance, you will typically need to have lived in the UK continuously for the last five years. As part of the vetting process, you will be asked to provide evidence of your identity, right to work in the UK, any time spent overseas during the last five years, and your employment and/or education history.
For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please follow this link - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels

Du arbetar med installation, konfigurering och felsökning av datorer, mobila enheter och annan IT-utrustning samt användarkonton och behörigheter i moderna Microsoft-miljöer. Du bidrar även i tekniska projekt och utvecklingsinitiativ som förbättrar IT-upplevelsen för hela verksamheten.

samarbeta med bland annat Infrastruktur, Kommunikation och Facility Management 
ha en varierad roll med både tekniska utmaningar och nära kontakt med verksamheten

göra verklig skillnad genom att hjälpa och stötta medarbetare i deras vardag

Gruppchef

Digital projektledare
 "Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"

Utvecklare

Du har en bred teknisk förståelse och grundläggande kunskaper inom nätverk och nätverksfelsökning. Erfarenhet av macOS och Microsoft-certifiering är meriterande. 
Vi söker en person som tar ägarskap, driver arbetet framåt och vågar fatta beslut utifrån sin erfarenhet och kompetens. Du är trygg i dina bedömningar och står för dina rekommendationer, samtidigt som du är prestigelös och lyhörd för andra perspektiv. Du har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt och förmågan att omsätta behov och idéer till konkreta lösningar som du också driver hela vägen till implementation. 
En viktig del av rollen är att kunna göra teknik begriplig. Du är pedagogisk och kommunikativ och kan förklara tekniska problem och lösningar på ett enkelt och tydligt sätt, även för användare utan teknisk bakgrund. Du anpassar din kommunikation efter mottagaren och skapar trygghet även när problemen är komplexa.

Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har professionella kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift. B-körkort är ett krav då arbetet kan innebära insatser på olika platser i verksamheten.

When you join Verizon
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
What you’ll be doing
With your sales experience, ability to efficiently manage your time, excellent customer relations skills, and excitement for technology, you'll deliver outstanding and innovative business solutions that support our technology evolution and the way businesses connect. Whether you're continuously hunting and prospecting for new business or growing existing accounts, you'll consult with customers to identify their business challenges and recommend tailored solutions to solve them and ultimately deliver a powerful return for customers while improving their business and growing our revenue.
Developing and qualifying leads within respective territory to drive additional sales opportunities through cold-calling, partner-selling, lead-generation campaigns and modern social selling techniques.
Gaining new business and incremental revenue to meet sales targets.
Retaining, managing and growing the existing customer base.
Educating and exciting customers while leveraging innovative business solutions.
Building relationships with key decision makers.
Presenting and creating multi-product solution opportunities.
Understanding and selling groundbreaking integrated software solutions including Cloud, Security, ISP, VoIP and Google platforms.
Tracking and reporting progress through sales force automation tools.
Drive sales, increase service revenue and manage relationships for accounts in the 1–19 Employee Segment
Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned sales professional, join today and earn a competitive lucrative salary, which includes base pay and target individual-based commission. Planning to go above and beyond? Our commission program allows unlimited opportunity which could allow top earners to exceed compensation plans and compete for various sales incentives. Compensation varies by geography and performance and experience.
Our comprehensive benefits (starting day one) and perks are designed to help you move forward in your career and in your life outside of Verizon. From health and well-being benefits to investment in your education and career, we've got you covered!
Best in class medical, dental and vision
Verizon 401(k) plan with matching contributions up to 6% of eligible participant contributions to the plan, qualified student loan repayments, or a combination of both.
Engage your clients with Verizon's Velocity Selling methodology. Using AI and advanced CRM tools, the Velocity Selling methodology boosts efficiency, productivity, and decision-making through automation, predictive analysis, and personalized customer approach. Providing you with a competitive edge and leverage to boost your own success and career growth.
Sales recognition programs that have, in the past, awarded top performers with all inclusive travel to domestic and international destinations, gifts, and other incentives
Lucrative paid time off, five weeks of paid time off (vacation, holidays, and personal days)
8 weeks of paid parental leave for eligible new parents (when paired with short-term disability, this benefit may provide up to 16 weeks of paid time off for the birthing parent)
Up to $8k per year in tuition assistance
Expand your knowledge through various industry certifications through Verizon’s Get Certified program
Discounts up to 50% off on Verizon products and services, Fios, high-speed home internet solutions to accessories and exclusive Verizon features, including 50% off Verizon wireless calling plans and much more. 
From Employee discounts to pet insurance, we offer additional perks to ensure V-teamers and their loved ones are supported holistically
Too good to be true? Come see for yourself! From our in-person new hire experience and award-winning training programs to our inclusive culture of learning and amazing benefits, you'll be able to apply your skills while elevating your career.
What we’re looking for...
You’re a self-motivated person who thrives on crafting the right solution to solve a client’s problems. And you are great at explaining how complex technology can solve everyday business problems in a language people understand. Cold-calling feels like a sport to you because meeting new people and discovering their needs is what you enjoy. People seek you out for advice and counsel. You seek to win and take the initiative to close deals and help others around you. You act with integrity. You know that when the team wins, we all win.
You’ll need to have:
Bachelor’s degree or three or more years of work experience.
Three or more years of relevant work experience.
Willingness to work in a mobile working model with travel within your assigned geographic sales territory. Expected travel may be up to approximately 50% of the time.
Valid driver’s license.
Even better if you have one or more of the following:
A degree - Associates or Bachelor's Degree or related certifications/college courses.
Two or more years of business-to-business or outside sales experience, including business acquisition and prospecting/cold calling.
Technology sales and educational experience i.e. SaaS sales experience, CRM, SalesForce or other client management tools, social media, etc.
Strong presentation skills in a face to face and virtual environment. .
Experience building and maintaining strong business relationships with all levels of client organizations.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, self-directed, entrepreneurial environment. 
Ability of managing time and prioritizing tasks to accomplish goals.
Ability to implement feedback and tailor your approach for success.
This position will support Southlake TX and the surrounding areas. 
Where you’ll be working
In this mobile role, you'll primarily work from customer or field location(s), with occasional visits to a Verizon location for in-person training and meetings.

40
Equal Employment Opportunity 
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.
The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is a commission based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

When you join Verizon
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
What you’ll be doing...
As a full-time Verizon Retail Sales Associate, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career with a team focused on unlocking your full potential and sales success within one of our retail stores. Here's what you can expect: 
Generate retail sales by using your passion for cutting-edge technology, and exceptional customer service to expand the Verizon network.
Learn and uncover customers' needs by creating connections and asking the right questions.
Position product insights and solution recommendations to provide customers with a complete top-down sales solution.
Close sales by using phenomenal communication skills to fulfill customer needs with simple and intuitive tech solutions. 
Continuously develop yourself through ongoing training and up-skill in operational functions across merchandising and inventory.
Potential to grow your customer base by placing outbound calls and sending text messages to current Verizon customers who are interested in our products and services.
Opportunities to engage with the community outside of the store to expand your loyal customer base, including at off-site Verizon sponsored events.
We’re hiring immediately! This isn't your typical entry-level retail position. Whether you're just starting out or have years of sales experience, you can earn $16.00 to $21.00 per hour in base pay, plus up to $18,000 a year in individual-based commissions if you hit all your sales goals. Planning to go above and beyond? With our commission program, the opportunities are unlimited for employees who exceed their sales goals. Top performers could make an extra $14,500 or more in individual-based commissions, giving you the chance to earn a total of $65,000+ to $75,500+ annually. Compensation varies by geography, hours worked, and performance.
Our comprehensive benefits (starting day one) and perks are designed to help you move forward in your career and in your life outside of Verizon. From health and well-being benefits to investment in your education and career, we've got you covered!
Best in class medical, dental, and vision
Verizon 401(k) plan with matching contributions up to 6% of eligible participant contributions to the plan, qualified student loan repayments, or a combination of both
Sales recognition programs that have, in the past, awarded top performers with all inclusive travel to domestic and international destinations, gifts, and other incentives
Five weeks of paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal days)
8 weeks of paid parental leave for eligible new parents (when paired with short-term disability, this benefit may provide up to 16 weeks of paid time off for the birthing parent)
Up to $8K per year in tuition assistance
Discounts up to 50% off on Verizon products and services
Additional employee discounts on attractions, automotive, travel and more.
This position is a great way to jumpstart your career! Too good to be true? Hear from our Verizon Retail team members on what it's like to be part of a team that invests in you. From our in-person new hire experience and award-winning training programs to our culture of learning and amazing benefits, you’ll be able to apply your skills while elevating your career.

High school diploma or GED.
One or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays (you'll know your schedule four weeks in advance).
Openness to pick up additional shifts and earn more income, typically during the summer months, November through December, and/or during peak vacation periods. 
Even better if you have one or more of the following: 
Experience working in a commission-based environment.
Demonstrated sales experience communicating with customers to find solutions. 
Customer service experience.
If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

 Arbetsuppgifter
Vill du vara med och skapa smartare kreditbeslut hos en av Sveriges mest innovativa telekomoperatörer? På Tre spelar kreditanalys en viktig roll i vår tillväxt resa. Nu söker vi en analytisk och affärsdriven Credit Analyst som vill vara med och utveckla hur vi arbetar med kreditrisk, från kreditmodeller och strategier, till smartare beslutsprocesser. Kanske är det just dig vi letar efter! 
Om rollen 
Som en del av vårt team inom Revenue Assurance & Credit Management (RACM) får du en central roll i att hitta rätt balans mellan tillväxt, lönsamhet och kundupplevelse. Här får du använda din analytiska förmåga för att påverka beslut som gör skillnad på riktigt. 
I rollen ansvarar du för att inom ditt affärsområde analyser och följa upp kreditrisker, identifiera trender och utveckla datadrivna lösningar som stärker våra kreditbeslut. Du nöjer dig inte bara med att göra analysen, utan du vill förstå vad den faktiskt betyder för affären och kan skapa konkreta insikter och affärsmässiga beslut som skapar mervärde. 
Hos oss handlar kreditrisk inte om att minimera risk till varje pris. Det handlar om att förstå och balansera risk, försäljning och kundupplevelse för att hitta rätt nivå av kalkylerad risk, en risk som kan skapa möjligheter, driva försäljning och bidra till lönsam tillväxt. Du behöver därför kunna lyfta blicken från analysen och ställa frågan: Vad betyder det här för affären och vad kan vi göra annorlunda utifrån det? 
Du kan se fram emot att 
 Ta fram analyser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag för ledning och styrgrupper samt omsätta insikter till konkreta rekommendationer och förbättringar. 
Driva och bidra till utvecklingsinitiativ tillsammans med interna och externa intressenter, inklusive regulatoriska initiativ och säkerställande av efterlevnad av nya regelverk. 
Vara en del av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work samt att vi är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar 
Såhär beskriver rekryterande chef Solomon sitt ledarskap: 
"Jag tror på förtroende, respekt och frihet under ansvar. Som ledare vill jag skapa en trygg och utvecklande miljö där människor vågar ta initiativ, utmana sig själva och växa. Arbetsglädje, samarbete och en stark lagkänsla är grunden för att skapa både trivsel och resultat."
 Några av våra medarbetare
Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
 "Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
 "Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
 "The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."

Du är van vid att hantera stora datamängder och framför allt att omsätta dina insikter till tydliga affärsrekommendationer. Du har en akademisk utbildning inom ett relevant område, exempelvis ekonomi.

Eftersom vi verkar i en internationell miljö behöver du kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Goda kunskaper i Excel är ett måste, och erfarenhet av SQL, Power BI, Python eller SAS ser vi som meriterande.

Opportunity
Test Developer - TRATON
 Södertälje, Sweden Project-based consultant Onsite 
About the role
We are looking for a Test Developer to join the Motion Control Testing team and support testing activities for TRATON powertrain solutions. The assignment focuses on software testing of new functionalities, including requirement analysis, development of test cases and test scripts, and low-level software testing in HIL and bench environments. You will work closely with function developers to support and secure software quality throughout the development process. The work is performed in an agile environment according to the SAFe framework and includes planning and coordinating test activities within agile sprints.
Responsibilities
Analyze requirements for new functionalities.
Develop test cases and test scripts based on requirements.
Perform low-level software testing in HIL and bench environments.
Collaborate closely with function developers to secure software quality.
Plan and coordinate test activities within agile sprints.
Work according to the SAFe agile framework.
Contribute to testing activities for TRATON powertrain solutions.
Required skills
Experience relevant to software testing and/or test development.
Ability to work with requirement analysis, test cases, and test scripts.
Ability to collaborate closely with function developers and other technical stakeholders.
Ability to plan and coordinate own test activities within agile sprints.
Structured and quality-focused approach to testing.
Comfortable working collaboratively in an agile development environment.
Technical profile
Master's degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or another relevant field.
Understanding of software testing and test development.
Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into test cases and test scripts.
Knowledge relevant to HIL and bench-based software testing.
Fluent English.
Nice to have

Experience with functional safety standards such as ISO 26262.
Good coding skills.
Experience with Python, particularly in relation to test automation or Python-based test frameworks.
Swedish language skills.
C and/or CE driver's license.
Who you are
You are a structured and collaborative Test Developer with an interest in software quality and vehicle technology. You have an analytical approach and are comfortable working with requirements, test cases, and test activities. You enjoy collaborating closely with developers and contributing to the quality of new software functionalities. You are comfortable planning your work within an agile environment and taking responsibility for your assigned testing activities while working closely with the wider development team.

 Stockholm
 Arbetsuppgifter
Vill du vara med och utveckla hur kunder hittar, köper och använder Tres digitala tjänster? Som Digital Growth Specialist får du en central roll i att utveckla Tres digitala affär med fokus på försäljning, konvertering, självservice, retention och kundupplevelse. 
Du blir en drivande kraft i vårt arbete med att identifiera, prioritera och genomföra förbättringar som skapar mätbar affärsnytta. Med hjälp av data, kundinsikter och experimentering utvecklar du våra digitala kundresor och hittar nya möjligheter att öka konvertering och kundvärde. 
Om rollen 
I rollen äger och driver du teamets growth- och selfservice-backlog. Du planerar och genomför CRO-initiativ, A/B-tester och andra förbättringar för att optimera köpflöden, landningssidor och digitala kundresor. Du följer upp resultaten, fångar lärdomar och omsätter dem till nya förbättringar. 
Du arbetar nära Content, UX, Product, IT, Analytics, Marknad, CVM och Marketing Automation för att säkerställa att trafik, innehåll, erbjudanden och kundkommunikation hänger ihop genom hela kundresan – från första besök till genomfört köp eller serviceärende. 
En viktig del av rollen är också att utveckla Tres förmåga inom SEO, GEO och AI-drivna arbetssätt. Tillsammans med våra Content och SEO/GEO Specialister identifierar och driver du initiativ som stärker vår organiska synlighet och digitala tillväxt. Du får även möjlighet att utforska och implementera AI-drivna verktyg och arbetssätt som kan förbättra både kundupplevelsen och vårt interna arbete. 
Rollen är särskilt spännande eftersom Tre befinner sig i en pågående transformation med utvecklingen av ett nytt tre.se och ett nytt Mitt3. Det ger dig möjlighet att vara med och påverka framtidens digitala kundupplevelse och hur vi skapar tillväxt i våra digitala kanaler. 
Du kan se fram emot att 
Vara en del av Tre:s Online-team med produktägare, product designers, analytiker och content specialister 
Arbeta hands-on och genomför själv mindre förbättringar av innehåll, erbjudanden och landningssidor i exempelvis Contentful, samtidigt som du driver större initiativ tillsammans med andra team. 
Vara med och utveckla Tres digitala affär – från dagens optimeringar till framtidens sätt att skapa tillväxt, service och kundvärde. 
Vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work

Gruppchef

Digital projektledare
 "Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"

Utvecklare

 Kvalifikationer
Så här beskriver rekryterande chef Åsa sitt ledarskap: 
Jag strävar efter att vara en närvarande och tydlig ledare som skapar förutsättningar för människor att lyckas. Jag tror på att ge ansvar, visa förtroende och skapa tydlighet kring mål, prioriteringar och förväntningar. 
Det är viktigt för mig att bygga ett team där vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och känner oss trygga med att testa nya idéer. Jag uppskattar personer som är nyfikna, tar initiativ och vill vara med och utveckla både arbetssätt och verksamhet. 
Vem är du? 
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av digital tillväxt, CRO eller eCommerce och som självständigt kan identifiera, prioritera och genomföra optimeringsinitiativ baserat på data och kundinsikter. Du har erfarenhet av A/B-testning, experimentering och datadrivet förbättringsarbete och är van att arbeta med digitala kundresor, försäljningsflöden eller självservice. 
Du har god förståelse för digital försäljning, e-handel och kundresor samt mycket god kunskap inom konverteringsoptimering och datadrivet förbättringsarbete. Du är bekväm med att analysera data i exempelvis Google Analytics och omsätta insikter till konkreta rekommendationer och aktiviteter. Erfarenhet av SEO, GEO eller organisk tillväxt är viktigt, liksom en förståelse för CRM, Marketing Automation och kundkommunikation. 
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AI-drivna verktyg, personalisering eller retentionarbete, särskilt inom abonnemangsaffärer. 
Som person är du analytisk, resultatorienterad och nyfiken. Du tar eget ansvar, driver dina initiativ framåt och trivs med att testa, lära och förbättra. Samtidigt är du en stark samarbetspartner som kan skapa samsyn mellan olika kompetenser och få idéer och insikter att bli verkliga lösningar. 
Välkommen med din ansökan! 
Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och kommer hålla intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar CV och svarar på de frågor vi ställt nedan i samband med att du söker. Vi använder tester för att säkra objektiva bedömningar i samband med urval. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll görs på slutkandidat. 
För mer information om tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Åsa Arnarp, asa.arnarp@tre.se

Vi står nu med öppna armar, redo att välkomna vår nästa buddy till 3Butiken Halmstad. 3Butikerna är en av Tres viktigaste kanaler när det kommer till att skapa nöjda och lojala kunder. Detta gör vi genom vårt servicefokus, vår kunskap och vårt engagemang!
En dag som Säljare i vår 3Butik
Det är starten på en ny dag. Du ser till att göra butiken i ordning för dagen, ser till att butiken är städad och fin, kollar försäljningsresultat och sätter därefter mål för dagen. Du läser på om vår senaste produktlansering och om våra pågående kampanjer. Snart öppnar du butiken och är redo för dagens första kundmöte.  
Under dagen kommer du och din chef att gå igenom försäljning, kundnöjdhet, daglig drift och du kommer att få regelbunden coachning. Du håller dig uppdaterad vad gäller utbildningar, nya produkter, kampanjer och tjänster. Tillsammans med dina kollegor strävar du efter att nå butikens budget och leverera kundmöten med hög kvalitet.

Du behöver också vara minst 18 år och kunna svenska och engelska.

Låter det här som något för dig? Vad roligt, vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Dein Aufgabenbereich
Du verantwortest die Vision, Strategie und den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg der Softwarelösung CAVA auf dem internationalen Markt.
Du analysierst Kunden- und Marktanforderungen und leitest daraus die Produktstrategie sowie die Roadmap für CAVA ab.
Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Entwicklung, Vertrieb sowie mit Kunden, OEMs und Partnern zusammen und bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für fachliche und technische Fragestellungen.

Du hast Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, im CAD-/PLM-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Position gesammelt.
Du überzeugst durch eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Teamgeist.

Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben – bei uns warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle auf dich mit der Möglichkeit des Mobilen Arbeitens.
Natürlich bieten wir auch kostenlose Getränke (Tee, Kaffee, Wasser).

Open positions with Addnode Group parent company
Below we present current open positions with the parent company of Addnode Group AB. 
Group Controller Addnode Group
The Jobdescription below is only available in Swedish.
Om rollen
I rollen som Group Controller hos oss på Addnode Group kommer du att ansvara för analys och finansiell rapportering till styrelse och ledning. Du kommer att arbeta i en dynamisk miljö där du har stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla processer och rutiner samt driva projekt inom ditt område.
I rollen kommer du huvudsakligen att hantera följande arbetsuppgifter:
Forecasting & Planning
Cash Forecasting & Liquidity Management
Board & Executive Reporting
Financial Analysis & Performance Management
Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management
Systems, Data & Process Improvement
Controls, Compliance & Listed-Company Governance
Risk, Scenario & Investment Support
Du rapporterar till Head of Group Controlling & Compliance. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt huvudkontor vid Torsplan, Stockholm.
Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?
Addnode Group tillhandahåller digitala lösningar. Vi är idag en koncern som bedrivs i ett 20-tal dotterbolag i 19 länder globalt, organiserade i 3 olika divisioner. Addnode Groups B-aktie är noterad på Nasdaq Stockholm, Large Cap.
Du kommer att få en viktig roll i arbetet med bland annat prognoser, kassaflödesanalyser och styrelserapportering. Det är en bred roll där du kommer att få möjlighet att utvecklas i en internationell och dynamisk koncern tillsammans med ett engagerat och professionellt team. Rollen rapporterar till Head of Group Controlling & Compliance och är placerad på vårt huvudkontor på Torsplan i centrala Stockholm.
Din profil?
Vi söker dig som har relevant akademisk utbildning och tidigare erfarenhet som Controller i internationell miljö antingen på noterat bolag eller liknande större privat koncern. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha hög analytisk förmåga samt erfarenhet av att leverera rapporter och projektresultat med hög kvalitet i rätt tid. Du är van vid att arbeta i olika typer av ERP-system och BI-verktyg och är gärna delaktig i olika typer av projekt för att utveckla processer, rutiner, rapporter samt driva förändringar. Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom revision kompletterad med operativ erfarenhet.
Du arbetar noggrant och strategiskt och har god analytisk förmåga. För att lyckas i denna roll behöver du ha förmåga att skapa och bibehålla goda relationer. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med divisionerna. I denna rekrytering fäster vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
Har vi väckt din nyfikenhet?
I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Addnode Group med MPYA Finance. Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Helén Lissäng helen.lissang@mpya.se eller Elin Allskog elin.allskog@mpya.se. Skicka gärna in ditt CV så snart som möjligt då vi hanterar ansökningar löpande. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

 Enterprise Systems 
 The Consultant Role 
 Customer Focus 
Learn IFS or NetSuite from a consultant’s perspective. Take part of an extended introduction and onboarding into the system’s modules, as well as knowledge sharing with Addovation’s skilled colleagues and network. You will participate in either NetSuite’s or IFS’s partner training sessions.
You will receive training through Addovation’s Consulting Academy, created by our consultants, for our consultants. The training is based on best practices and research. This includes both how to act as a consultant and the commercial aspects. Additionally, you will have an individual mentor to guide you through your development journey.
Our goal is for you to build strong customer relationships early on, applying theoretical knowledge alongside practical experience from customer projects. In these projects, you will gain an understanding of the customer’s unique needs.
Throughout the program, you will gain knowledge of IFS or NetSuite and have the opportunity to specialize in a relevant module area, such as Finance, Manufacturing, Service & Asset, Supply Chain, or others.
You will also learn more about Addovation, our journey, values, and how we work together.
What happens after the program?
During the program, you will gradually transition into your role. After completing the program – which serves as an extended introduction – you will have a good foundation to fully step into the position.
As an IFS Business Consultant, you will focus on improving and streamlining business processes within your area of expertise, using either NetSuite or IFS Cloud.  What will you be doing? You work closely with the customer to understand how their operations function (depending on your area, such as purchasing, production, finance, and service) and identify areas where improvements can be made. This often involves holding workshops, gathering requirements, and aligning with key stakeholders.
Based on this understanding, you design solutions using the ERP system’s capabilities. You configure the system to fit the customer’s needs, sometimes working together with developers.
You’re involved throughout the entire project lifecycle—from initial analysis to implementation and go-live. You also support upgrades, rollouts to new regions or companies, and ongoing improvements. Along the way, you train users, create documentation, and ensure everything runs smoothly.
In your role, you act as the bridge between business and IT—working with technical teams, performing tests, and making sure the system truly supports the customer’s goals. Common tasks include leading workshops, configuring the system, writing documentation, offering advice on best practices, and supporting during go-live.
Who you are
We are looking for individuals who is curious about the role as consultant and have a strong interest in digitalization and business processes. The program is for those with a few years of relevant work experience who wish to switch career paths to the IT and enterprise systems industry.
You have a university or similar education in economics, technology, IT, or similar, and experience as a user of enterprise systems or practical experience in a role within one of our customer’s business areas. For example, you may have worked as an accountant, controller, logistics coordinator, production planner, or similar.
Experience with enterprise systems such as IFS, NetSuite, or other ERP systems is a plus but not a requirement – we will provide you with the tools you need to succeed!
Why Addovation
 Development Opportunities 
 Varied Workdays 
 Community and Collaboration 
 Flexibility 
 Benefits 
We offer continuous professional development and certification opportunities within IFS and NetSuite. Over time, you will also have the chance to progress internally into roles such as Solution Architect, Project Manager, or Lead Consultant in your area of expertise.
You will work with customers from various industries, each with unique challenges, providing you with an exciting and varied work environment. This means constant opportunities to develop your skills and tailor solutions to each client’s specific needs.
We place great emphasis on creating a positive and supportive work environment where you become part of an engaged and dynamic team. Here, you will have the chance to work with some of the best consultants in the industry, who are ready to share their knowledge.
We offer what we call flexible work – you can choose where you work to fit your everyday life, whether it’s from the office, at home, or at the customer site. While you will primarily be based at your local office, the role also includes travel and customer visits.
Great benefits from day one, as well as the opportunity for bonus. At Addovation, we are grounded in a strong sense of togetherness, and we highly value teamwork. To encourage collaboration and avoid internal competition, we’ve made the decision not to use individual bonus models. Instead, we believe in succeeding as a team, which is why our bonus structure is based on collective achievements
Meet two of our Addovation Program Alumni
“As a former participant in the Addovation consultant program, I can say that it was a great start of my IT career. I had little experience of the IT industry and ERP systems, but the support and guidance I received from my colleagues made it a lot easier to get into the system and consultant role. I am now part of implementation and upgrade projects within Supply Chain and Manufacturing – I have also been part of creating Addovation Academy.”
Emy Anspach
IFS Business Consultant
“I’m really glad I applied to the consultant program—it has been a fun and learning experience. I’ve had the opportunity to apply my finance knowledge while gaining new insights into IFS, which has been a great combination. The work environment is fantastic, with supportive and friendly colleagues who are always willing to help when needed. I’ve also had the privilege of working with two excellent mentors throughout my time at Addovation, both during the program and beyond!”
Vilma Hill
IFS Business Consultant

 When does the program start? 
The application period for our Consultant Program in Norway/Finland is now open until May 9th, with the program starting in the end of august/beginning of September 2025.
The start depends on which ERP system you will focus.
 Length of the Program 
Approximately 4 months combined with practical experience within projects.
 Where is it located? 
This year, this extended introduction/program is hosted in Sweden, Norway, or Finland. In Sweden, it’s held in either Gothenburg or Jönköping, while in Norway, it takes place in Drammen or Oslo.
In Finland, the program is only available for NetSuite Consultants and is located in Helsinki.
 What kind of background is relevant for this role? 
You could come from various backgrounds, depending on which focus area of the ERP system you’re interested in.
As a Finance Consultant, you might bring a few years of experience in financial operations, including ongoing accounting tasks, accounts receivable and payable, invoice processing and payments, VAT reporting, and financial closing activities. A background in finance will allow you to leverage your expertise while working with ERP systems to streamline financial processes.
For Supply Chain, you could come from roles such as a Logistics Coordinator, Procurement Specialist/Buyer, Demand Planner, or similar positions. Experience in supply chain management, inventory control, logistics, and procurement will equip you to optimize supply chain functions within the ERP system, ensuring seamless operations from procurement to delivery.
In Manufacturing, you might have a background in production planning, maintenance, or related fields. Experience in managing production schedules, equipment maintenance, or lean manufacturing processes would enable you to support ERP implementations focused on improving production efficiency, resource planning, and overall manufacturing workflows.
For the Project Management area (it’s not to be mixed up with being a project manager – yes, we know it’s a bit confusing 😊) you may come from a project-driven environment such as construction, telecommunications, manufacturing, or oil and gas. You might have worked as a process owner, or in a role where you were responsible for planning, executing, and reporting on projects. Your deep understanding of project processes such as resource procurement, project planning, financial reporting, and tracking will be valuable in optimizing project management workflows within the ERP system.
In Maintenance/Service, you may have experience working in service-oriented roles like a service coordinator, maintenance planner, field technician, or service/maintenance technician. Your expertise in managing day-to-day service or maintenance operations will be instrumental in improving how businesses utilize ERP systems to streamline their service and asset management processes.
Each of these areas offers unique opportunities to apply your expertise while contributing to the successful implementation and optimization of ERP solutions.
 What is an ERP system? 
An Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system is a software used by organizations to manage various functions such as finance, manufacturing, project management, and human resources. By integrating these areas into a single system, an ERP provides a comprehensive view of the entire organization, while also allowing users to easily focus on specific parts when needed.
 Business Area IFS 
Addovation has been working with IFS and their ERP solutions since 2008. Today, we are a Regional System Integrator, which means we implement, upgrade, support, and create innovative add-ons and integrations for IFS Applications and IFS Cloud. We have many successful projects behind us and have one of the largest consultant teams in the Nordics within IFS ERP.
IFS is an ERP system designed to help businesses manage key operations like finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and project management. It offers a flexible and integrated platform, enabling organizations to optimize processes, improve efficiency, and make data-driven decisions. IFS is known for its user-friendly interface and strong capabilities in industries such as manufacturing, aerospace, and energy.
 Business Area NetSuite 
Addovation has been an Oracle Alliance Partner since 2019 and has since delivered several successful NetSuite solutions. We have certified consultants in the Nordics who can quickly implement, support, and integrate NetSuite solutions.
We also offer our own products that benefit NetSuite users.
NetSuite is a cloud-based ERP system that helps businesses manage financials, CRM, e-commerce, inventory, and more. It provides real-time insights, automates processes, and supports growth by integrating various functions into one platform. NetSuite is widely used across industries like retail, manufacturing, and professional services.
 Other 
The program’s content and schedule are partly flexible, as the customer projects you become involved in may influence the structure. However, we can guarantee that you will acquire all the necessary knowledge and tools to build a solid foundation in your consulting role.

Description
Application deadline: Oct 14, 2026
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. We are growing quickly and dynamically, including in our global data center footprint. This role is part of the Infrastructure Global Expansion team, which is responsible for our strategy for data center expansion for edge infrastructure.
In this role, you will develop the strategy for growth in key locations for interconnect capacity. You will develop both the business partnerships and technical approach to improve our resiliency, scalability, cost, and performance on behalf of our customers. You will deal with reviewing and selecting data center architectures as well as new network designs. Your key deliverables will be action plans to fix both short-term constraints in a cost-efficient and timely way as well as kicking off long-lead work to enable longer term growth and to optimize our network to achieve cost savings.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include:
- Setting the future strategies and roadmap for the team across new products
 - Identifying priority locations to re-architect existing infrastructure approaches
 - Managing cross-functional input to inform potential partnerships and build solutions
 - Developing plans of record for scaling and growing infrastructure in different metro areas
 - Setting schedules for infrastructure migrations and re-designs
 - Working with external customers to identify requirements and prospective partnerships to enable new infrastructure launches
 - Improving cost structures for preferred infrastructure architecture
A day in the life
Technical Infrastructure Program Managers in the Internet Edge organization have a wide range of responsibilities; We evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms
and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our technical infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that
capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish this, our Technical Infrastructure Program Managers work with a diverse range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Technical Infrastructure Program Managers for the internet edge make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon's products.
About the team
Within AWS Networking, the Internet Edge organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an internet-connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for customers’ needs. Our team provides high-performing internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more. 
Working at AWS the GCNA Team - Meet Robert, VP: https://youtu.be/8v5i42FL02w 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
