Description
AWS Global Network Delivery Services keeps the cloud running. We deliver and operate all AWS global infrastructure: every data center, every server, and every cable that gives hundreds of millions of customers uninterrupted access to the services they depend on. We work on some of the hardest supply chain and infrastructure problems in the world, with thousands of variables in play, and we're looking for people who want to help solve them.
You'll join a diverse, cross-functional team of Product managers, TIPMs, network engineers, planners, builders, and operations leaders around the world. Together we work across AWS to deliver the highest standards of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost. Our culture is inclusive, welcomes new ideas, and gives you room to own your work from start to finish.
We're looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer who is curious, learns quickly, and wants to grow by working on real, high-impact problems. You'll build the datasets, metrics, and dashboards that show how infrastructure delivery is performing, from intake through deployment to decommission. You'll work alongside senior BI Engineers, Data Engineers, and business partners to turn business questions into reliable, well-documented data.
What makes this role exciting? Your work won't sit unused. The datasets and dashboards you build will be used every week by planners, operators, and leaders to track delivery milestones and decide what to do next. You'll learn how a global infrastructure business runs, get hands-on with AWS data tools and AI-assisted analytics, and grow your skills through code reviews and mentorship from experienced engineers.
Key job responsibilities
- Work with business stakeholders, TIPMs, and senior team members to gather requirements for well-defined reporting and analysis needs, then translate them into queries, data models, and dashboards.
- Build and maintain datasets, ETL pipelines, and dashboards using SQL, Python, and AWS tools such as Redshift, S3, and QuickSight
- Follow team standards for code reviews, data quality checks, documentation, and monitoring so your work is reliable and reusable
- Run pipeline health checks, investigate data issues, and find the root cause, escalating to the right owners when needed
- Analyze data to answer business questions and clearly explain what you found, including caveats, to stakeholders and your team
- Use metric definitions and the team's data contracts consistently, and point out gaps or inconsistencies you find in source data
- Try out AI tools and new approaches that make analysis faster or more insightful
- Keep learning from code reviews, feedback, and senior teammates, and share what you learn with the team.
A day in the life
A day in the life Your morning starts with dashboard pipeline health checks and a look at new intake requests. Then you dig into your current project: learning the source data, asking what decision a metric will support, and confirming requirements with your stakeholder before you write code. In the afternoon, you might build or update a dataset, refactor part of a legacy pipeline with guidance from a senior engineer, or walk a stakeholder through a draft dashboard. You finish the day by documenting what you learned and submitting your code for review. You'll be expected to understand a problem before building, and to be open about what you're unsure of.
About the team
 We're the PAX Data and Analytics team, a small group of BI Engineers and Data Engineers inside one of the world's largest and fastest-growing data center organizations. We started less than a year ago with one mandate: turn operational complexity into decision-ready clarity.
We do more than build dashboards. We build context that helps leaders act with confidence and helps operators catch problems before they become incidents. Our work covers the full data lifecycle: sourcing raw operational data, building reliable pipelines, and delivering self-service tools that hundreds of people use every day. Every pipeline we ship and every standard we define becomes the foundation for what comes next. We're young, we're scrappy, and we're building something that will outlast us. It's a great place to learn and grow your career.
Basic Qualifications
- 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hardware Engineering team creates compute and storage server designs for Amazon’s web services. We work in an environment that fosters innovation and creativity. We encourage and invest in new directions and new ideas that will serve our customers better. Description
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is looking for an Applied Scientist to join their team. CXBT's mission is to create best-in-class AI agents that seamlessly integrate multimodal inputs, enabling natural, empathetic, and adaptive interactions. We leverage advanced architectures, cross-modal learning, interpretability, and responsible AI techniques to provide coherent, context-aware responses augmented by real-time knowledge retrieval.
As part of CXBT, we have a vision to revolutionize how we understand, test, and optimize customer experiences at scale. Where traditional testing approaches fall short, we create AI-powered solutions that enable rapid experimentation, de-risk product launches, and generate actionable insights, all before a single real customer is impacted.
Be a part of our agentic initiative and shape how Amazon leverages artificial intelligence to run tests at scale and improve customer experience.
As an applied scientist, you will research state-of-the-art techniques in agent-based modeling, and lead scientific innovation building foundational agentic simulation capabilities.
If you are passionate about the intersection of AI and human behavior modeling, and want to fundamentally influence how Amazon tests and improves customer experiences, this role offers a great opportunity to make your mark.
Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement frameworks for multi-modal content handling and creating representative, diverse agents that faithfully capture real-world characteristics
- Use state-of-the-art techniques in user modeling and behavioral simulation to build robust agentic frameworks
- Research and implement novel algorithms and modeling techniques.
- Acquire and curate diverse datasets while ensuring user privacy.
- Create robust evaluation metrics and test sets to assess language model performance.
- Innovate in data representation and model training techniques.
- Apply responsible AI practices throughout the development process.
- Write clear, scientific documentation describing methodologies, solutions, and design choices 
A day in the life
Our team is dedicated to improving Amazon's products and services through evaluation of the end-to-end customer experience using both internal and external processes and technology. Our mission is to deeply understand our customers' experiences, challenge the status quo, and provide insights that drive innovation to improve that experience. Through our analysis and insights, we inform business decisions that directly impact customer experience as customers of new GenAI and LLM technologies.
About the team
CXBT is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).
Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- PhD or equivalent research experience
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
Preferred Qualifications
- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl
- Deep expertise in multimodal AI systems combining vision and language models and designing and building LLM-based agent systems

Job ID: 10576886 | Amazon Development Centre Ireland Limited
Apply now
Description
Are you strong in network automation? then this might be a great opportunity for you. 
Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.
Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.
You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.
No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.
Key job responsibilities
- Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
- Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
- Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
- Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.
- Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering, field operations, network operations, and program management teams to develop solutions that balance performance, cost, and operational simplicity while validating new device types and configurations.
About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.
We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.
Basic Qualifications
- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or other related discipline
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 4+ years experience developing engineering, deployment, or operations mechanisms to support IP network and/or networking systems
- 4+ years experience in a network focused hands-on technical role working with IP routing protocols/technologies and platforms in large scale enterprise wireless network environments
- 4+ years of experience in network engineering, with deep expertise in wireless (802.11ac/ax/be) and wired (802.1X, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS) access technologies
Preferred Qualifications
- Thorough understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP routing, Server Load Balancing, and Network Security architecture and core technologies such as IP, TCP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Server Load Balancers, Firewalls, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, LDAP, NFS, etc.
- Experience with one or more of the following wireless access points/controllers, switches, routers, server load balancer, and firewall vendor platforms: Cisco, Juniper, Alcatel-Lucent, Arista, Brocade, Extreme, Citrix, F5, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.
- Hands-on experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Juniper MIST, or similar) including controller-based and cloud-managed architectures
- Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, site survey methodologies, and wireless capacity planning

Description
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.
An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.
Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Hindi
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Job ID: 10576814 | ADCI - Karnataka - A66
Apply now
Description
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.
An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.
Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Hindi
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.
Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Hindi
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Description
ADP is hiring a Client Support Consultant-Tax. 
 Are you ready to join a company offering career advancement opportunities throughout your career journey? 
Do you want to join a company with award-winning training and world-class service guidelines to help you achieve success, growth, and continued learning? 
Are you looking for an inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging? 
If so, this may be an opportunity for you. Read on and decide for yourself. 
In this role, you will serve as ADP's front-line for solving clients' challenges, including issue resolution, answering questions, helping clients, training their users on ADP technology, and more. You carry the weight of ADP's service reputation and client satisfaction in your hands.
The nature of what you do every day will not change -- your #1 goal is to help clients who have between 1- 49 employees. Still, every day will be different because the questions you receive will vary, as will the solutions you provide each client. There will be no shortage of new questions you'll receive, which will keep things interesting, and our top-ranked training will help to set you up for success! 
To thrive in this role, you must be comfortable working in a metrics-driven call center environment as part of a structured day. You have a way with clients that builds rapport, establishes trust, and shines with professionalism. Over the phone and in writing, your communication style is clear and easy for our clients to understand and take action on. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. Pace should not scare you. We also have a healthy dose of fun. Not only can you find a career here but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now! 
To learn more about Client Services at ADP, watch here: https://adp.careers/Client_Services_Videos 
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities 
What you can expect on a typical day: 
Client Support. You will help our clients manage their business using our solutions, which could include troubleshooting and probing to resolve payroll issues. Support might also involve partnering with multiple business units and teams for troubleshooting and delivering a seamless client experience.
You will continually upgrade your knowledge and skills on payroll, including federal and state compliance, standard operating procedures, administrative practices, other products, and desktop support tools to develop and maintain your ability to support our clients.
You adhere to a daily schedule and organize yourself to deal with a high volume of inbound calls. Daily phone time may increase during peak seasons, like at the close of the year.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
At least 7 years of experience in a customer service environment, with proven ability to produce positive results.
A strong focus on Client Satisfaction in a relevant industry or as an HR/HRIS practitioner with systems experience is required.
At least 5 years of professional consulting experience or equivalent experience as a practitioner in a systems-related organization.
You can work overtime hours during peak seasons.
 A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include: 
Experience noted above, OR 
Military experience where skills including teamwork, adaptability, organization, and follow-through will help you build team and client relationships, identify solutions, and achieve success. 
 YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN: 
 Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights. 
 Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups to connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences. 
 Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress. 
 Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities. 
 Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones. 
 Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another. 
 Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live. 
 Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about. 
What are you waiting for? Apply now!

About the group:
Cognizant’s Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security Services Practice (CIS), is all about accepting digital transformation by driving core modernization holistically across layers. We help customers transform infrastructure and workplace to meet the constantly evolving needs of the digital era. Our broad approach delivers key results for our customers by achieving cloud driven modernization and workplace and operational transformation to own the business in a secure environment.
*Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future*
Role: Python-Data Engineer
Location: Toronto , ON
Mandatory skills: Python (Expert), Docker & Kubernetes (Medium), CI/CD pipeline (Medium), Pandas & Polars (Expert)
 Job Description
We are seeking a skilled Python Developer to join our data engineering team. You will design, develop, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using modern Python frameworks and tools. In this role, you'll work with large-scale datasets, containerized systems, and distributed computing platforms to deliver robust data solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and optimize data manipulation workflows using pandas and polars to handle large datasets efficiently. Design and implement containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes to ensure scalable, reliable deployments. Build and maintain data pipelines integrating with ClickHouse columnar databases for analytical workloads. Develop event-driven architectures using NATS messaging systems for asynchronous data processing. Write comprehensive unit tests using pytest to ensure code quality and reliability. Implement distributed computing solutions with Dask for processing data beyond single-machine memory constraints. Manage version control using Git and collaborate on code repositories following best practices.
Required Skills and Experience
· Python & Data Processing: Advanced proficiency in pandas and polars for data manipulation, transformation, and analysis. Experience optimizing code performance for large datasets.
· Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker for building container images and composing multi-container applications. Knowledge of Kubernetes for container orchestration and deployment management.
· Data Infrastructure: Working knowledge of ClickHouse or similar columnar databases for OLAP workloads and analytical queries.
· Messaging & Streaming: Familiarity with NATS.io for building message-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
· Testing & Quality Assurance: Proficiency with pytest for writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining code coverage standards.
· Distributed Computing: Experience with Dask for parallel processing and handling out-of-core computations.
· Version Control: Strong command of Git workflows, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with additional Python libraries for data science and machine learning. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Background in financial services or capital markets data systems.
 Key Responsibilities
Develop and optimize data manipulation workflows using pandas and polars to handle large datasets efficiently. Design and implement containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes to ensure scalable, reliable deployments. Build and maintain data pipelines integrating with ClickHouse columnar databases for analytical workloads. Develop event-driven architectures using NATS messaging systems for asynchronous data processing. Write comprehensive unit tests using pytest to ensure code quality and reliability. Implement distributed computing solutions with Dask for processing data beyond single-machine memory constraints. Manage version control using Git and collaborate on code repositories following best practices.

Careium | Emergency Call Handler
Emergency Call Handler
Blackburn
Location: Blackburn, Lancashire
Salary: £26,200 per annum
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference?
As an Emergency Call Handler at Careium UK, you'll play an important role in helping vulnerable and elderly people stay safe and independent. Whether you're responding to an emergency alarm or making a welfare call, you'll be providing support, reassurance, and practical help when it matters most.
Some jobs are just jobs.
This isn't one of them.
Every day, our team helps thousands of people stay safe, independent, and confident in their own homes. Whether you're responding to an emergency alarm, arranging support for a client, or making a welfare call to check someone is okay, you'll play a vital role in supporting people when they need it most.
Why Join Careium?
At Careium UK, you'll be joining one of Europe's leading telecare providers, supporting more than 250,000 clients across the UK. We help vulnerable and elderly people maintain their independence through innovative telecare solutions and our dedicated 24/7 Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC).
But what really makes Careium different is our people.
You'll be part of a supportive team that genuinely cares about the work we do and the people we support. Every day brings the opportunity to make a positive difference to someone's life whilst developing your own skills and building a rewarding career.
From our Blackburn-based ARC, you'll receive full training, ongoing support, and opportunities to grow within a business committed to helping people live safer, more independent lives.
About the Role
We're looking for compassionate, resilient, and customer-focused people to join our Emergency Call Handling Team in Blackburn.
This is far more than a traditional call centre role. You'll be supporting real people, often during some of their most vulnerable moments. You'll need to be calm under pressure, a great listener, and able to make decisions confidently and professionally.
Full training will be provided, so previous telecare experience isn't essential. What matters most is your ability to communicate effectively, show empathy, and genuinely care about helping others.
What You'll Be Doing
Responding to Emergency Calls
Receiving and managing incoming emergency alarm activations and support calls.
Assessing situations quickly and calmly to determine the most appropriate response.
Contacting next of kin, emergency services, healthcare professionals, or support networks when required.
Providing reassurance and support to clients during difficult or distressing situations.
Making Outbound Welfare Calls
Proactively contacting clients to check on their wellbeing and safety.
Carrying out welfare and wellbeing calls where concerns have been identified.
Providing reassurance and escalating concerns where further support may be required.
Helping ensure vulnerable clients remain safe, supported, and connected.
Supporting Our Clients
Delivering an outstanding customer experience during every interaction.
Helping customers with basic troubleshooting of telecare equipment and devices.
Signposting queries to other departments where appropriate.
Building positive relationships with clients, families, carers, and partner organisations.
Monitoring Telecare Systems
Monitoring alarm and monitoring system notifications.
Responding to equipment, power, or battery-related alerts.
Taking appropriate action to ensure service continuity and client safety.
Maintaining Accurate Records
Recording call details accurately using company systems.
Ensuring client information is updated and maintained correctly.
Following company procedures and regulatory requirements at all times.
Working Pattern
Average 37.5 hours per week.
You'll work a variety of shifts between 6:00am and 11:00pm, Monday to Sunday, on a rolling 6 to 8-week rota. As part of the rota, you'll work every other weekend.
We do ask for some flexibility from time to time, as shift patterns may occasionally change to meet the needs of the service.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for people who genuinely enjoy helping others and can remain calm under pressure.
You'll ideally have:
Excellent communication and listening skills.
A caring, professional, and empathetic approach.
Confidence using computers and multiple systems.
Strong attention to detail and accurate record-keeping skills.
The ability to multitask and make decisions confidently.
A flexible and adaptable approach to work.
A positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Experience within customer service, care, healthcare, emergency response, hospitality, retail, contact centres, or similar people-focused environments would be beneficial but is not essential.
What You'll Get in Return
Flexible working opportunities
Annual leave that increases with length of service
Cash Health Care Plan, including dental and optical benefits
Life Assurance worth three times your annual salary
Pension contributions of up to 6%
Free on-site parking
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
Career progression within a growing organisation
The opportunity to do meaningful work that genuinely matters
Join Our Team
If you're the sort of person who stays calm in a crisis, enjoys helping others, and wants a role with real purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

Atea | It-arkitekt
It-arkitekt
Mälardalen: Eskilstuna, Västerås, Katrineholm
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens IT-landskap? Som IT-arkitekt hos Atea Mälardalen blir du en strategisk rådgivare som hjälper våra kunder att omsätta digitala ambitioner till verklighet. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare, leder workshops och utvecklar strategier som gör skillnad. Hos oss får du frihet, ansvar och möjligheten att påverka både kundens och Ateas framtid!
Din roll
Som IT-arkitekt på Atea hjälper du våra kunder att omsätta verksamhetens mål till hållbara IT-strategier och konkreta initiativ. Du fungerar som en strategisk rådgivare och arbetar nära ledning, verksamhet och IT-organisation för att identifiera möjligheter, hantera utmaningar och skapa långsiktigt värde genom IT och digitalisering. Rollen innebär en kombination av rådgivning, analys, förändringsledning och ledarskap, där du har stor påverkan på både kundens och Ateas utveckling. Du samarbetar med kollegor lokalt och nationellt och har stor frihet att forma din vardag för att nå kundens och Ateas mål.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
Vara en strategisk rådgivare till kunder kring utveckling av IT-stöd, digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling.
Ta fram strategier, målbilder och handlingsplaner som skapar långsiktigt affärsvärde.
Analysera och utreda organisationer, processer och IT-miljöer samt rekommendera förbättringar och prioriteringar.
Hjälpa kunder att förstå hur IT och digitalisering kan bidra till att nå verksamhets- och affärsmål.
Driva och stödja förändringsinitiativ genom att inspirera, utmana och skapa engagemang hos kunder och kollegor.
Samarbeta nära kundteam och bidra i lokala ledningsgrupper för att utveckla både kundrelationer och erbjudanden.
Fungera som mentor och erfaren rådgivare för andra konsulter och bidra till kompetensutveckling inom teamet.
Bidra till Ateas fortsatta förflyttning mot att vara en ännu starkare och mer värdeskapande partner för våra kunder.
Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med att arbeta på strategisk nivå, men som också motiveras av att se idéer och planer bli verklighet. Du kombinerar verksamhetsförståelse med IT-kunskap och har förmågan att skapa förtroende hos såväl ledningsgrupper som operativa team.
Vem är du?
För att lyckas i rollen som IT-arkitekt kommer dina personliga egenskaper att vara viktiga. Du har ett strategiskt förhållningssätt och trivs med att analysera komplexa frågor ur ett helhetsperspektiv. Du ser långsiktiga möjligheter och konsekvenser och kan omsätta dessa till tydliga rekommendationer och genomförbara planer. Samtidigt är du kvalitetsmedveten och arbetar strukturerat med höga krav på kvalitet i både analys, rådgivning och leverans. Rollen ställer också krav på ett starkt ledarskap där du bygger förtroende, engagerar olika intressenter och skapar förutsättningar för team att tillsammans nå gemensamma mål. Du är en skicklig kommunikatör som kan presentera strategiska vägval och komplexa resonemang på ett tydligt och inspirerande sätt för både verksamhet och ledning.
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har följande erfarenhet:
Gedigen erfarenhet inom IT-sfären i olika roller
Erfarenhet av ledande roller med stort ansvar inom IT
Bred kunskap & förståelse inom IT (snarare än specialist på ett område). Med andra ord ser vi att du är ”specialist på helheten”
Förmåga att upprätthålla och etablera en IT-strategi och arkitektur
Kunskap att etablera Portföljstyrning och skapa strategiska styrmodeller för initiativ, samt följa dessa på en hög nivå
Tala och skriva flytande svenska & engelsk
B-körkort
Det anses vara meriterande om du har:
Branschkompetens från en eller flera branscher
Tidigare roll som seniorkonsult, lösningsarkitekt, it-arkitekt eller enterprisearkitekt
Erfarenhet från såväl offentlig- som privat sektor
Du är van vid analys och målbildsarbete
DF Kompetens Certifierad IT-arkitekt Master eller motsvarande
CITA-P – Internationellt certfierad it-arkitekt
Arkitekturmodeller, t ex TOGAF, COBIT
ITIL
PM3
Projektmodeller, typ PRINCE2, PPS etc
Om Atea
Visste du att Atea är den ledande leverantören av it-infrastruktur i Norden och Baltikum? I Sverige är vi runt 2700 medarbetare fördelade på 35 kontor runt om i hela landet. Vår styrka ligger i vår kombination av lokal närvaro, vårt omfattande och heltäckande erbjudande samt alla våra specialister. Tillsammans med våra kunder och partners bygger vi Sverige med it och förbättra vardagen för skolbarn, lärare, äldre, sjukvård och näringslivet. Hos oss får du vara en del av världens mest hållbara it-servicebolag, där vi är med och påskyndar omställningen mot en mer hållbar it-värld.   
På Atea blir du en del av en vardag och en kultur som präglas av framåtanda, laganda och humor. Vi har en vision om att vara "The Place to Be" – en plats där alla växer och trivs, med kollegor som bryr sig om dig, om kunderna och om samhället.  
Läs mer om våra förmåner: Ateas förmåner | Atea
Kontakt & mer information
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Fredrik Vikström, Konsultchef, via fredrik.vikstrom@atea.se. Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen så kan du höra av dig till Alexandra Engman, Talent Acquisiton Partner, via alexandra.engman@atea.se. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum, ansök därmed redan idag!
I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska tester användas som en del av urvalsprocessen. Som en kvalitativ del i vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll för vissa av våra tjänster, detta för att öka kännedomen om dig som vår framtida medarbetare.
Vår arbetssätt är flexibelt - Vi tror på att ge möjlighet till flexibilitet i vardagen men merparten av arbetstiden som vi inte spenderar hos en kund eller på resande fot utgår vi från kontoret, som är vår primära arbetsplats.
Atea vill vara The Place To Be, den självklara platsen, för alla människor då vi värdesätter och jobbar aktivt med mångfald och inkludering.
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
Den här rekryteringen hanteras av oss på Atea och vi undanber oss därför samtal och mail från rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA) to join our enterprise infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the administration, performance optimization, security, availability, and modernization of mission-critical Microsoft SQL Server environments. This role requires deep expertise in SQL Server administration, High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) technologies, performance tuning, automation, and cloud-based database services.
The successful candidate will support large-scale production environments, collaborate with development and infrastructure teams, and drive database modernization initiatives within a highly available, enterprise-grade ecosystem.

Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server environments across production, development, test, and disaster recovery platforms.

Implement and maintain database monitoring solutions, dashboards, operational documentation, standards, and runbooks.
Administer and support Azure-based database platforms, including Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs, and Azure Storage services.
Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to support incidents, audits, deployments, compliance requirements, and enterprise projects.
Provide expert production support, participate in on-call rotations, and serve as a trusted advisor for database performance, security, availability, and operational excellence.

Analysere markedstrender for å tilpasse Arrives tjenester til kundenes behov.
Presentere og pitche innovative parkerings- og mobilitetsløsninger for relevante beslutningstakere og nøkkelinteressenter.

Svært robust og kommersielt drevet tankesett.

Flytende i norsk og engelsk; sterke muntlige og skriftlige ferdigheter er essensielle.
Denne rollen er basert på kontoret vårt i Oslo, Norge.

En spennende rolle i et innovativt, internasjonalt selskap i vekst.

Proactively embrace and leverage AI and other emerging technologies to drive operational efficiency and enablement across our commercial legal workflows.
Help create, refine, and maintain internal commercial playbooks, template libraries, and guidelines to empower cross-functional business partners and accelerate deal velocity.

Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable advice that aligns with business objectives and supports deal-making and sales acceleration.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with senior executives and cross-functional teams globally.
Strong curiosity, competence, and willingness to embrace AI and emerging technologies to elevate the quality, speed, and efficiency of legal work in a fast-moving and dynamic environment.

Knowit gör en nationell satsning på Databricks med verksamhet i Malmö, Göteborg och Stockholm. Som Data Engineer arbetar du med att designa, bygga och vidareutveckla moderna dataplattformar i molnet. Du utvecklar och produktionssätter datapipelines och bidrar till arkitektur och tekniska vägval i uppdrag där Databricks ofta är en central del av lösningen.

Du är tekniskt trygg och tar ansvar för kvaliteten i det du levererar. Du trivs i samarbeten med andra utvecklare och arkitekter och har förmåga att omsätta krav till strukturerade och hållbara implementationer. Du drivs av att fortsätta utvecklas inom moderna dataplattformar.

Minst fyra års erfarenhet i rollen som Data Engineer
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i molnmiljöer som AWS, Azure eller GCP
Erfarenhet av att bygga och produktionssätta datapipelines med ETL och ELT
Stark kompetens inom SQL samt Python och PySpark
Gärna med erfarenhet av orkestrering, exempelvis Airflow eller liknande verktyg

Hos Knowit Solutions Lakehouse får du arbeta i tekniskt utmanande uppdrag där du kan påverka arkitektur och tekniska vägval. Du blir en del av ett nationellt specialistbolag med tydlig teknisk riktning och höga ambitioner inom lakehouse och Databricks.

Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens dataplattformar tillsammans med oss på Knowit är du varmt välkommen att ansöka.
Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!
As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. As a Functional Product Manager within the Transport Business Unit, you are the technical and functional backbone of our product-led transformation. Your overarching mission is to champion a "Product-Driven" mindset.
In your specific capacity as the Data Product Manager, you will own the vision, backlog, and execution for all data-centric products. You will be responsible for turning raw transport business unit data into actionable insights. This includes feeding the overarching Arrive Group Data Lake, developing Business Intelligence (BI) SaaS offerings for public transit authorities (B2G), and exploring AI capabilities to drive quality and operational efficiency.
Core Responsibilities
Generic Responsibilities 
Backlog & Roadmap Ownership: Translate high-level strategic visions (from the Head of Experience) into a prioritized, actionable product backlog. Ensure the backlog is always "Ready" for developers.
The "Standardization" Guardian: Strictly enforce the 70% Standard / 30% Specific ratio. Resist custom developments that create technical debt and champion reusable, scalable features to stop the "redo" cycle.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the decisive pivot between Engineering, Quality Assurance, UX/UI, and Business Analysts. Resolve conflicts and ensure the Squad reaches its Sprint goals.
Gap Analysis Validation: Work closely with Business Analysts and Market PMs to review client tenders. Define how to configure existing standard tools to meet client needs without rewriting core code.
Quality & Acceptance: Define clear "Definition of Done" criteria. Validate that the delivered software meets the functional goal before handing it over to the Delivery Managers for rollout.
 Data engineering: ability to translate complex data engineering concepts into clear business value for stakeholders.
Domain-Specific Responsibilities (Data Expertise)
Dashboard Building & Visualization: Define, design, and actively build intuitive data dashboards (using tools like PowerBI, Tableau, or embedded BI solutions). You will create operational dashboards for internal monitoring and client-facing dashboards that translate complex transit data into actionable insights.
Data Lake Integration: Lead the integration of the BU Transport's data streams into the global Arrive Group Data Lake, ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance (GDPR).
BI & Analytics SaaS Offerings: Design and manage standard Business Intelligence dashboards and reporting tools to city and transit operators.
AI/ML Readiness: Monitor and evaluate practical AI use cases (e.g., predictive maintenance for hardware, anomaly detection) to be integrated into the roadmap, value-add features once the core BI and Data Lake foundations are fully established.
Data Governance & APIs: Define the data models and ensure our APIs allow seamless, secure data sharing across the Ticketing, Pay As You Go, and Digital pillars.
Your Role in the Organization
You will operate in a highly matrixed environment to ensure the Data product serves the entire ecosystem:
With the product team: You align your Data roadmap with the broader business model.
With Technology: You define the Functional Data Need (the "What" and "Why"), while relying on the Technology team to provide the underlying infrastructure and architecture (the "How").
With Market PMs & Sales : You gather feedback on local market data requirements (e.g., specific transit reporting standards in the UK vs. US) and abstract them into global, standard BI features.
With Delivery Managers: You package data releases and ensure that Ops and Support teams are trained on new BI tools or AI features before they hit the market.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Standardization Rate: Ratio of "Standard Data/BI" features deployed vs. custom reporting requests developed for specific clients.
Data Product ROI & Adoption: Profitability of the Data Offering and the adoption rate of these dashboards by our B2G clients.
Time-to-Market: Efficiency from the conception of a new data feature/AI model to its "Ready for Rollout" status.
Data Quality & Reliability: Uptime of data pipelines, accuracy of reporting, and successful integration metrics with the Group Data Lake.
Candidate Profile
Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, with a proven track record of managing Data, Business Intelligence, or Analytics products (ideally in B2B/B2G SaaS or Mobility/Transport sectors).
Strategic Mindset: Deep understanding of how to monetize data and transition legacy reporting into modern, scalable SaaS products.
Technical Literacy: Strong understanding of data architecture, Data Lakes, APIs (REST/JSON), and hands-on experience building with BI tools. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and data privacy regulations (GDPR, PCI-DSS context) is a plus.
Execution & Agile: Mastery of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Proven ability to say "No" to specific client requests to protect the standard product vision.
Communication: Professional working proficiency in English (Level C1/C2) is required to collaborate with our international teams and document features. 
Mobility: Willingness and ability to travel occasionally between our hubs and to client sites as required for strategic alignments or major rollouts.

Uppdragsbeskrivning
Vi söker en erfaren Test Maintenance Engineer till ett uppdrag med fokus på underhåll och utveckling av testutrustningar i produktionsmiljö. Rollen kombinerar praktiskt underhållsarbete med utveckling av teknik, metodik och arbetssätt för både nya och befintliga underhållsprocesser.
Du kommer att arbeta nära produktionen och bidra till att testutrustningar är driftsäkra, väl dokumenterade och uppfyller relevanta krav inom bland annat arbetsmiljö och elsäkerhet.
Arbetsuppgifter
Ansvara för underhåll av testutrustningar i produktion.
Utveckla plattform och arbetssätt för förebyggande underhåll.
Genomföra underhållsarbete tillsammans med produktionspersonal.
Genomföra underhållstekniska aktiviteter vid implementation av nya och befintliga testutrustningar.
Ta fram underhållsdokumentation för nya och befintliga testutrustningar.
Säkerställa att testutrustningar överlämnas till produktionen enligt gällande rutiner.
Arbeta för att testutrustningar uppfyller grundläggande krav inom arbetsmiljö och elsäkerhet.
Samverka i projekt där ny testutrustning ska implementeras i produktionen.
Hantera avvikelser och fel kopplade till testutrustning.
Bevaka utvecklingen inom området och upprätthålla en hög kompetens inom test och testinfrastruktur.
Krav
3–8 års relevant erfarenhet inom området på heltid.
Djup och hög kompetens inom underhåll av testutrustningar och testinfrastruktur.
Erfarenhet av förebyggande underhåll och utveckling av underhållsprocesser.
Erfarenhet av praktiskt underhållsarbete i produktionsmiljö.
Erfarenhet av implementation av nya eller befintliga testutrustningar.
Erfarenhet av att ta fram underhållsdokumentation.
Förståelse för arbetsmiljö- och elsäkerhetskrav kopplade till testutrustningar.
Erfarenhet av felsökning och hantering av avvikelser på testutrustning.
Förmåga att samarbeta med produktion och delta i projekt kopplade till ny testutrustning.

Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
We're looking for a Content Trends, Associate Producer to join our Content team at Snap Inc! 
What you'll do: 
Play a key role in identifying timely, trending, culturally relevant public content and creators on Snapchat
Collaborate with fellow Trend Curators and Producers to help Snapchatters stay connected with their local and global communities through fresh, exciting, and informative Snaps. 
Identify trends emerging creators,  tentpoles moments and culturally relevant topics that our community cares about most on a daily basis while also being hyper reactive to new unexpected moments that arise during your shift
Identify and work with emerging content creators
Surface timely, trending and fresh publicly submitted content
Work collaboratively with a group of Trend Curators tasked with searching through thousands of snaps to identify tentpole moments, trends, timely conversations and culturally relevant themes
Review and moderate submitted Snaps in real time
Engage in ongoing conversations with engineering, moderation, and product teams to communicate and resolve any issues that arise during your shift
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
An expert in US short from video trends, major pop culture moments and timely tentpole events
Deep understanding of Gen Alpha, Gen Z and Millennials
A highly motivated teammate who is hyper reactive, proactive and a skilled communicator
Outstanding research and organizational skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a sharp attention to detail
Strong editorial eye and understanding of what makes an engaging piece of content
Someone up-to-date on pop culture, trends, and current events
Teamplayer who is kind and respectful of other’s opinions
Minimum Qualifications:
BA or BS degree in relevant field
1+ years of experience working in digital media, social, or content driven environments (i.e. internet trends, pop culture and hyper timely moments) 
Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, as needed
Preferred Qualifications:
BA or BS degree in relevant field
Preferred previous experience at Snap
Someone who has a flexible schedule and the ability to work during nights and weekends, as needed
Experience navigating multiple social platforms and demonstrated interest in short form content

Ability to work independently and manage internal and external resources

Bachelor’s degree in optics, physics, electrical engineering, computer science or related field
2+ years of experience in computational imaging for computer vision applications
Experience with computational imaging, computer vision, and machine learning for image processing
Experience developing and optimizing ISP and machine learning algorithms for camera products
Experience with non-traditional image sensors including: single photon detectors (e.g. SPADs, jots, SiPMs, etc.), event sensors, neuromorphic sensors, etc.

PhD or master’s degree in optics, physics, electrical engineering, computer science or related field
4+ years of experience in designing robust computer vision algorithms for consumer electronics platforms
Experience building camera systems for AR/VR, wearables, or mobile platforms
Experience developing end-to-end camera ISP pipelines designed for edge and/or distributed compute platforms
Experience developing for event based processing
Experience with depth mapping and direct time of flight (dTOF) depth measurement systems
Experience designing algorithms for pixel and sensor level logic

The Product Design team is a small but influential team that steers the future of the core Snapchat application. Our Design Engineers work closely with the CEO and various cross functional leaders to create a design led roadmap to build products and experiences that bring our community together in new and special ways.
We’re looking for a Design Engineer to join the Design team at Snap Inc!  
What you’ll do:
Conceive, prototype, and iterate new products
Quickly bring new ideas to life through functional prototypes
Build creative tooling and internal systems that change and improve how teams across Snap work
Occasionally prototype on other platforms, including web, AR, and AI
Help drive the design process with engineering teams to ship these new products to users
Invent new products by leveraging your technical background and passion for design
Deliver outsized impact on products used by hundreds of millions of people every day
Learn new skills and collaborate within a multi-functional design studio
Work with product designers and user researchers to test new ideas and iterate on feedback
Present and pitch your ideas and work directly to the CEO and company leadership
Be a lead in cross-functional teams with product managers and engineering to polish and refine the end products we ship
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Knowledge and understanding of iOS software engineering principles
Ability to know when it’s fine to abandon first principles for a quick proof-of-concept
Ability to rapidly prototype fully functional mobile experiences
Ability to think at a high level about product strategy
Creative problem solving and the ability to iterate on solutions for challenging problems
Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of design and engineering trends
Minimum Qualifications: 
BS/BA in a technical field such as Computer Science or equivalent years of experience 
6+ years of post-Bachelor’s software development experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 5+ year of post-grad software development experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field + 2+ years of post-grad software development experience
Experience with iOS application development (Objective-C and/or Swift)
3+ years of experience driving product strategy and/or design decisions
Preferred Qualifications:
Proficiency with design and rapid prototyping software (e.g. AI, Figma, Sketch, Framer, Origami, Principle)
Bringing something new to the table: whether that’s a new perspective on our product, a unique understanding of a particular field, or expertise in something like hardware, AI, 3D graphics, HCI, etc.
A portfolio showcasing your work and strong mobile design skills

Knowledge of layout strategies and tradeoffs for linear and switching power supply circuits, EMI mitigation, high-speed signal integrity and power delivery networks
Experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, battery simulators, logic analyzers and thermal chambers
Great interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate across groups through written, verbal and visual formats
Familiarity with PDN/SI simulation tools such as Sigrity, ADS, HFSS, etc
Minimum Qualifications: 
BS/BA degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related field or equivalent years of experience
3+ years of experience in electrical or hardware engineering 
Ability to travel internationally 10% of the time.
Preferred Qualifications:
MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field or equivalent years of experience
Experience defining integrated circuit design power delivery specifications such as impedance masks and DCR targets
Experience working cross functionally to resolve problematic signal integrity issues including with mechanical, electrical, and firmware teams.
Great interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate across groups
Excellent process development and documentation skills
A passion for Snapchat and creativity!

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
Position
Deine Abteilung 
Als Referendar der Rechtswissenschaft (m/w/d) unterstützt und begleitest Du die Roche-Datenschutzorganisation bei allen Anliegen innerhalb des Datenschutzrechts und angrenzender rechtlicher Themenfelder. Du gewinnst so Einblicke in ein global tätiges Healthcare-Unternehmen und erhältst die Möglichkeit, Deine rechtlichen Kenntnisse in spannenden Projekten und im Austausch mit Deinen Kolleg:innen der Rechtsabteilungen anzuwenden und auszubauen. Die Tätigkeit kann nach Absprache ganz oder teilweise im Home Office sowie an den Standorten Mannheim, Penzberg (Großraum München) oder Grenzach erfolgen.
Deine Aufgaben 
Du bearbeitest Fragestellungen aus dem Bereich des Datenschutzrechts und unterstützt den Datenschutzbeauftragten der deutschen Roche-Gesellschaften
Du hilfst bei der Ausgestaltung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Datenschutzprozesse
Du beteiligst Dich an der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Reviews/-Audits
Du berätst Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in datenschutzrechtlichen Themen 
Du arbeitest selbstständig in Teilprojekten mit Bezug zum Datenschutz und Datenschutz-Management
Dein Profil 
Du bist Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft und möchtest Deine Wahlstation in einem global agierenden Unternehmen absolvieren
Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung hast Du mit überdurchschnittlichem Erfolg bestanden
Du hast idealerweise erste Kenntnisse im und ein gesteigertes Interesse am Datenschutzrecht
Deine Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit und Kreativität aus
Du handelst selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich und bist aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege
Deine Vorteile 
Flexible Zeiteinteilung und Home-Office
Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine
Attraktive Standorte mit zahlreichen Benefits
Moderne IT-Ausstattung und Teilnahme an Team-Events
Vernetzung mit anderen Rechtsreferendaren (online/offline)

Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben online hoch.
Bitte gib an, für welchen Zeitraum Du Deine Referendariatsstation vorgesehen hast.
Zeitraum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von mind. 3 Monaten

Ansök nu
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
What you’ll do
As a Human Factors Specialist, you will develop and apply human-centered research methods, objective measurement systems, and rapid prototyping techniques to improve the comfort, fit, wearability, and user experience of next-generation Augmented Reality devices. Working closely with Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, and User Research, you will translate human insights into measurable engineering requirements and product improvements.
Design and execute quantitative and qualitative human-subject studies to evaluate comfort, fit, wearability, thermal comfort, and overall user experience using lab instruments, surveys, and user assessments.
Collect, analyze, and interpret ergonomic, anthropometric, and biomechanical data—including IPD, head shape, ear-to-forehead geometry, hinge forces, and other wearability metrics—to generate actionable product insights.
Develop novel measurement methods, instrumentation, and experimental protocols to objectively characterize wearability and human-device interactions.
Design, fabricate, and validate instrumented prototypes, wearable devices, laboratory fixtures, and custom measurement systems.
Integrate sensing technologies—including pressure, force, temperature, motion, eye tracking, and physiological sensors—into research prototypes and experimental platforms.
Support rapid product iteration through CAD modifications, prototype development, engineering characterization, and experimental validation.
Collaborate with Industrial Design, Engineering, Product Design, and User Research to translate human factors insights into product requirements and design decisions, balancing user needs with technical and product constraints.
Build and maintain human factors datasets, engineering guidelines, and standardized research methods that enable future product development.
Document experimental methods, calibration procedures, and research findings to improve measurement quality, repeatability, and organizational knowledge.
Knowledge, skills, and abilities
Strong grounding in human factors, ergonomics, biomechanics, wearability, anthropometry, and human-centered research methods.
Expertise in designing and executing quantitative and qualitative human-subject studies, including experimental design, protocol development, and data interpretation.
Strong analytical and statistical skills with the ability to process, visualize, interpret, and communicate complex experimental datasets.
Strong understanding of engineering characterization, measurement systems, laboratory instrumentation, and objective evaluation techniques for physical products.
Demonstrated ability to develop, calibrate, and validate novel experimental methods, custom measurement systems, and engineering test protocols.
Hands-on experience designing, fabricating, instrumenting, and troubleshooting wearable prototypes, laboratory fixtures, and research hardware.
Proficiency integrating sensors and data acquisition systems, including pressure, force, temperature, motion, eye tracking, and physiological sensing technologies.
Strong mechanical aptitude with experience in CAD, rapid prototyping, mechanical assembly, and iterative hardware development.
Experience developing calibration procedures, validation methods, and standardized research workflows to improve measurement quality, repeatability, and scalability.
Excellent technical writing, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable engineering recommendations.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent projects, and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary product development teams.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Biomechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Kinesiology, or a related technical discipline.
3+ years of experience conducting human-subject research and supporting product development, engineering validation, or applied research for wearable devices, consumer electronics, medical devices, or related physical products.
Experience designing and executing quantitative and qualitative human-subject studies, including experimental design, data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
Experience developing and applying quantitative and qualitative evaluation methods, laboratory instrumentation, and engineering characterization techniques for wearable devices and physical products.
Hands-on experience designing, fabricating, instrumenting, and validating research prototypes, laboratory fixtures, or custom measurement systems.
Experience analyzing experimental data using MATLAB, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
Demonstrated ability to translate human factors research into engineering requirements, product decisions, and design improvements.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree or PhD in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Biomechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Kinesiology, or a related technical discipline.
Experience developing novel measurement methods to characterize physical interactions between wearable devices and the human body.
Experience with pressure mapping, force sensing, thermal characterization, eye tracking, motion capture, physiological sensing, or other human factors measurement technologies.
Experience designing and developing instrumented wearable prototypes, custom laboratory fixtures, and engineering test systems.
Experience with embedded systems, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, or custom data acquisition systems.
Experience using 3D scanning, anthropometric datasets, digital human models, or other human-centered design and evaluation tools.
Experience supporting multidisciplinary hardware product development from concept through product launch.

Work on state of the art generative pipelines for image, video, language or audio generation
Deliver generative machine learning experiences on device
Build cutting-edge augmented reality experiences using generative and diffusion models
Partner with cross-functional Snap teams to explore and prototype new products
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
A proven passion for machine learning; you stay up-to-date with research and are excited about prototyping new ideas quickly 
Strong software development skills in Python or C++
Proficiency working with major deep learning frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow
Knowledge of mathematics and deep learning foundations 
Desire to solve open ambiguous problems
Desire to grow professionally, learn and help others
Ability to effectively collaborate with internal teams and external partners
Ability to work independently
Minimum Qualifications: 
Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
5+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 4+ year of post-grad machine learning experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field + 1 years of post-grad machine learning experience
Research or engineering experience in one or more of the following: generative models, efficient models, diffusion models, language models, or other related applications of machine learning 
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's degree or PhD in a related technical field 
Experience developing real-time software for mobile applications 
Knowledge of GenAI, especially image, video, language and audio generation foundations
Knowledge of efficient model foundations
Track record of successful projects in GenAI field
Examples of your work such as open source projects, blog posts, Kaggle contests, top conference or journal publications, etc.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week. 
At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).
Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

 JOB DESCRIPTION
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Opportunity:
Provide expert scientific guidance and strategic input to project teams and leadership within our Analytical R&D department.
Act as a senior mentor for NDA authoring and drive due diligence processes, providing expert scientific input that shapes key decisions.
Lead the resolution of complex CMC issues, overseeing root cause analyses and ensuring timely, collaborative solutions.
Leverage your extensive experience in pharmaceutical research and development to shape our scientific strategies and roadmaps.
Serve as a critical link between different teams, collaborating with cross-functional partners to tackle scientific challenges and identify new opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement by analyzing common risks across our portfolio and designing innovative, portfolio-wide solutions.
Spearhead and implement strategic cross-functional projects, such as R&D Excellence initiatives, to enhance our operational effectiveness.
Contribute to the future of our team by training, mentoring, and guiding other scientific staff, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and growth.
Who you are:
You have an advanced degree (Ph.D. preferred) in a relevant scientific discipline such as Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry or a related field.
You bring extensive experience in pharmaceutical research and development, with deep scientific knowledge in the analytical development of parenterals and combination products with devices ideally including experience with various synthetic molecule modalities like oligonucleotides, peptides or classical small molecules.
You possess a proven track record of success in NDA preparation and the transfer of projects to commercial manufacturing.
You are a strategic problem-solver with strong analytical skills, capable of identifying and mitigating scientific risks and opportunities.
You are a highly effective communicator with excellent interpersonal skills, able to influence and collaborate across diverse teams.
You thrive in a collaborative team environment, actively participating in scientific discussions and decision-making processes.
You stay abreast of the latest scientific advancements and trends, continuously applying new knowledge to drive innovation.
You are a natural mentor, passionate about training and guiding other scientific professionals.
Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
