Description
ADP is hiring a Bilingual Relationship Life Cycle Consultant in Los Angeles / San Diego area.
Do you love being in front of a crowd?
Are you a strategic thinker?
Do you think benefits are fun?
Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?
As a Relationship Life Cycle Consultant, you will work to strengthen the connection with our Key Account clients through service and consultation around benefit education strategies. For your assigned book of business, you will understand clients' needs regarding benefits and strategically drive results to increase benefit participation, client experience, employee retention, and employee engagement.
Your day-to-day will be spent building relationships with key internal and external stakeholders for each client and their employees to drive year-round benefit education. In this position, you will ensure service excellence and improve client relationships, including client satisfaction and experience. You must effectively maintain, build, and manage client relationships at all levels to ensure clients achieve their benefit strategies utilizing ADP's Human Capital Management tools and services. You will work closely with clients and their employees to optimize the utilization of their plan benefits and bring consultation to complex benefit strategies and initiatives.
You will need strong partnerships with Sales, Brokers, Implementation, HR, and the Operations organization to resolve escalated and complex benefit issues. You will implement your benefit strategies through virtual, onsite, or recorded benefit presentations to each client. Travel will be required to support client visits and strengthen relationships.
To thrive in this role, you must build rapport, establish trust, develop strategies and shine with professionalism. Through onsite and virtual connections, you will help analyze benefit trends within each client and develop education strategies to assist employees in maximizing their plan and carrier resources. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. While our team's culture promotes a healthy dose of fun and high engagement, a fast-paced environment should not scare you. Not only can you find a career here, but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Client Services at ADP, watch here:
https://adp.careers/Client_Services_Videos
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities
What you can expect on a typical day: 
You will design and execute benefit strategies and communication year-round to an assigned client base, reviewing strategies to drive plan participation and retention.
You will conduct worksite benefit meetings for groups of new hires, quarterly wellness meetings to review carrier value-add information and resources, spending accounts education, year-end onboarding meetings, open enrollment meetings, and more.
You will manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders, focusing on benefit strategies related to worksite employee enrollment in the plan.
You will continually upgrade your knowledge and skills in benefits, including attending training sessions and becoming a benefit subject matter expert.
You adhere to a daily schedule to manage your meetings, calls, partner connections, etc.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Requirements
You have five years of client service or client relationship management experience in a fast-paced service environment.
You have experience in benefits.
You excel at presentations -- keeping large audiences engaged and attentive as you present.
You're a strategic thinker and have demonstrated the ability to assess needs and provide innovative solutions to assist clients in meeting their business objectives.
You can travel to support client visits and strengthen relationships.
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
Experience noted above OR
Military Experience. We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
BONUS POINTS FOR THESE: Preferred Qualifications
Progressive management experience in consulting or large corporate environments.
Experience with multiple larger complex clients or advisor relationships and dealing with a broad range of benefits or HR equivalent-related areas at senior levels of organizations.
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.
What are you waiting for? Apply today!
Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days & Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $69,300.00 - USD $129,200.00 / Year*
*Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage or minimum exempt salary requirement under federal, state and local laws.

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
As a Network Provisioning & Delivery Engineer, you will be responsible for configuring and delivering transmission services across Colt’s global network infrastructure. The role involves validating service designs, analysing routing and bandwidth requirements, configuring network elements, and performing pre-delivery testing to ensure high-quality service activation.Working closely with field engineers and cross-functional teams, you will support end-to-end service delivery, customer circuit migrations, and network testing activities. You will also develop deep expertise in Colt’s transport and optical platforms, act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex technical issues, lead escalations, and contribute to continuous improvements in service quality and operational excellence.
Coltのグローバルネットワーク上で提供される伝送回線サービスの構築・導入を担当するポジションです。回線種別や帯域要件に基づき、サービス設計の妥当性確認、ルート検証、ネットワーク機器の設定およびテストを実施し、高品質なサービスデリバリーを支えます。また、フィールドエンジニアや関連部門と連携しながらエンドツーエンドのサービス開通試験や回線移行プロジェクトを推進します。将来的にはチーム内の技術エキスパート（SME）として、複雑な案件対応、エスカレーション管理、技術支援、品質向上活動をリードし、安定したネットワークサービスの提供に貢献いただきます。
What you will do
As a Service Delivery Engineer, you will be responsible for configuring, testing, and delivering customer network services across Colt’s Carrier Ethernet, DWDM, OTN, Optical, and Packet platforms. Working closely with field engineers and cross-functional teams, you will ensure successful end-to-end service activation, network testing, and timely delivery of customer solutions while maintaining the highest levels of quality and accuracy.
The role also involves leading complex delivery and migration projects, managing escalations, driving process and quality improvements, and acting as a technical and operational Subject Matter Expert (SME). You will collaborate with global stakeholders, support knowledge transfer initiatives, and help optimize service delivery operations to ensure an exceptional customer experience.
Coltのグローバルネットワーク（Carrier Ethernet、DWDM、OTN、Optical Network等）におけるサービスデリバリーエンジニアとして、回線設定、テスト、導入、および顧客向けサービス開通までのプロセスを担当いただきます。フィールドエンジニアや国内外の関連チームと連携しながら、高品質かつ期限内でのサービス提供を実現する重要な役割です。
また、複雑なネットワークソリューションや顧客プロジェクトのリード、エスカレーション対応、品質改善活動、業務プロセス改善にも携わっていただきます。技術面・業務面のSubject Matter Expert（SME）として、チームメンバーの育成やナレッジ共有を推進し、サービスデリバリーの品質向上と業務効率化に貢献いただきます。
What we're looking for
Must haves:
The ideal candidate with 7+ years of relevant industry experience in Planning / Provisioning (Access and Core Network).
Good understanding/Knowledge on installations & commissioning / testing / NOC environment (on Optical / Packet / SDH/SONET, DWDM and EoSDH / IP), and have practical experience of Bandwidth provisioning and testing. 
Good knowledge on various testers (like SUNRISE, ACTERNA, ANT-5, ANT-20 etc.) used for testing of transmission links. 
Good knowledge of various vendor based hardware’s used to deliver Data, Voice and IP services. 
Business level Japanese 
At least Conversational English 
通信業界において、ネットワークプランニングまたはプロビジョニング（アクセスネットワークおよびコアネットワーク）に関する実務経験を7年以上有する方
光伝送、パケットネットワーク、SDH/SONET、DWDM、EoSDH、IPネットワークにおける導入・構築、試験、NOC（Network Operations Center）業務に関する十分な知識・理解を有し、帯域（Bandwidth）のプロビジョニングおよびテストの実務経験をお持ちの方
各種伝送回線試験機器（SUNRISE、ACTERNA、ANT-5、ANT-20など）の使用経験および知識
データ、音声、IPサービス提供に使用される各種ベンダー製ネットワーク機器に関する知識
日本語：Businessレベル
英語：日常会話レベル以上

CCNP/CCIE would be plus 
Knowledge on MSP, DWDM & NGN technologies

Short Description
Function: Finance - Procurement
Reports to: Procurement Business Partner Head
Location; Spain, Portugal or United Kingdom
Why we need this role
Procurement Business Partners are responsible for delivering commercial value across key spend categories through effective sourcing, supplier management, and commercial negotiation. The role partners closely with business stakeholders to secure optimal commercial outcomes, manage supplier and contractual risk, and support the delivery of operational and financial objectives.Acting as a trusted procurement adviser, the role provides market insight, procurement expertise, and commercial guidance to enable informed business decisions and sustainable value creation.
What you will do
Manage assigned procurement categories and supplier portfolios to maximise value, optimise spend, and support business objectives.
Maximizes the use of tools, processes, policy setting and enforcement in alignment with the Category strategy to support the control of the spend
Negotiate commercial, contractual, and service arrangements that deliver favourable business outcomes and manage risk.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business requirements and provide pragmatic procurement solutions.Identify and deliver cost-saving and value-enhancement opportunities across assigned categories.
Manage supplier performance and relationships to support service quality, continuity, and business requirements.
Assess commercial and supply risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures in partnership with stakeholders.
Provide expert procurement advice and market insight to support business planning and decision-making.
Ensure procurement activities are conducted in accordance with company policies, governance requirements, and relevant legislation.
Key performance indicators:
Effective and collaborative stakeholder engagement
Opex, Capex and CoS savings
Sustainability metrics
Successful opportunity analysis
Effective category management 
Relationships and key contacts:
You will be working in an international environment with stakeholders across the business in various geographies
Key stakeholders include our O&E colleagues, Engineering, Finance Business Partners, and Legal
You will also be working with a variety of suppliers in multiple countries 
What we're looking for
Significant years of experience in procurement within a complex multinational environment, ideally within the Telecoms, Tech or Data Centre sectors
Experience in electricity, sub-sea, critical infrastructure or network infrastructure would be beneficial, but is not required
Demonstrated success in leading complex RFPs, commercial negotiations, and contract discussions that deliver measurable business value
Experience managing supplier portfolios and supporting business-critical operational or technology-related categories
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate cost, value, risk, and business outcomes when making recommendations and decisions.
Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions and levels, balancing business priorities with procurement and governance requirements
Experience operating independently in ambiguous situations and exercising sound judgement on commercial and supplier-related matters
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including the interpretation of commercial, financial, and supplier performance data
Familiarity with procurement, sourcing, contract management and supplier management processes and tools
Fluent English required; additional European languages beneficial
BSc degree in procurement, supply chain management, logistics or business administration

 36913

 London, GB
Why we need this role
Following the successful overhaul of Colt.net and a major brand refresh, an exciting opportunity has opened up within our Brand & Content team for a Digital Manager to lead, manage and optimise Colt's digital estate.
This is a high-impact role at the heart of Colt's digital presence. You'll be responsible for delivering a seamless, engaging and discoverable online experience that supports our brand and business goals. 
What you will do
You'll own Colt's website strategy end-to-end, shaping performance, user experience and future direction. Working closely with colleagues across Brand, Content, Design and Digital, you'll ensure our digital platforms continue to evolve and deliver measurable business value. 
Key responsibilities include: 
Owning Colt's websites and associated digital properties, including content, functionality, UX, performance and roadmap planning. 
Managing CMS updates, page creation and content publishing schedules. 
Monitoring and optimising website performance, including speed, uptime, SEO, AEO, user engagement and conversion rates. 
Identifying opportunities to improve user journeys, discoverability and overall digital experience. 
Collaborating with brand designers, content specialists, and agency partners to deliver new features and enhancements when required. 
Managing web technology platforms, budgets, tools and vendor relationships. 
Defining, tracking and reporting key performance indicators including traffic, engagement, customer journeys and conversion metrics. 
Translating business and stakeholder needs into a clear website development roadmap. 
What we're looking for
Technical Skills & Experience 
Web Platforms: Hands-on experience with Webflow and/or Framer is essential. As the primary technical owner of Colt's websites, you'll be confident designing, building and deploying new components independently.
Design & UX: Strong understanding of user-centred design principles, UX best practices and digital / Figma experience is highly desirable. 
Technical Performance: Proven knowledge of website performance optimisation, including Google Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, image optimisation.
Governance & Compliance: Experience managing tag management, cookie consent platforms, accessibility standards (WCAG) and website governance. 
Digital Strategy & Project Management 
Digital Experience Strategy: Experience defining and delivering website strategies that improve user journeys, content discoverability, navigation and conversion performance. 
Content Architecture: Ability to create scalable content structures, information architecture standards and governance models that support growth. 
Optimisation & Personalisation: Experience delivering experimentation, optimisation and personalisation initiatives that improve outcomes.  
AI & Marketing Workflows: Strong understanding of emerging AI-powered and agentic workflows, marketing automation ecosystems. 
Discoverability & Search Optimisation 
SEO, AEO & GEO Leadership: Deep understanding of the evolving search landscape, including Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO). 
Content Optimisation: Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to create structured, discoverable content.
Structured Content & AI Search: Experience developing content strategies that improve brand visibility across traditional search, AI-powered search experiences and answer engines through discoverability. 
Analytics, Reporting & Insights 
Digital Analytics: Strong experience using Google Analytics and/or PostHog to monitor website performance. 
Performance Measurement: Ability to define KPIs, analyse trends and identify opportunities for improvement across traffic, engagement, discoverability and conversion metrics. 
Stakeholder Reporting: Confident presenting performance insights and recommendations to a range of stakeholders, translating complex data into clear actions and business outcomes.

 User Experience, Manager, Project Manager, Technology, Management

Operating as the executive owner of these relationships, you will develop and execute global account strategies that align Colt's solutions with customers' international business priorities.

Success requires building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, identifying new opportunities across global business units, and coordinating internal teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
What you will do
Own and develop a portfolio of 6-8 strategic global enterprise customers, serving as the primary commercial relationship lead.
Create and execute multi-year global account plans focused on revenue growth, customer retention, and strategic expansion.
Achieve and exceed annual revenue, cross-sell and upsell targets across assigned accounts.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key stakeholders across multiple geographies, business units and functions.
Identify and drive new business opportunities by aligning Colt's solutions to customers' evolving global connectivity, cloud, security and digital transformation requirements.
Coordinate internal resources across sales, solution engineering, service delivery and product teams to execute account strategies.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, contract renewals and global framework agreements.
Develop a deep understanding of customer business objectives, industry trends and competitive dynamics to position Colt as a strategic partner.
Leverage customer insights and data to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks and strengthen long-term account value.
Accurately forecast revenue performance and maintain account plans, pipelines and opportunities within CRM systems.
What we're looking for
Significant B2B enterprise sales experience, ideally within telecommunications, digital infrastructure, networking, cloud, managed services, IT services or SaaS.
Proven success managing and growing a portfolio of large global enterprise accounts with responsibility for revenue growth and retention.
Demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding quota through cross-sell, upsell and strategic account development.
Experience navigating complex multinational organisations and building relationships with executive and C-suite stakeholders.
Strong commercial acumen with experience leading large, strategic opportunities and contract negotiations.
Ability to develop and execute global account strategies across multiple regions and stakeholder groups.
Strong consultative selling skills and familiarity with methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN or similar.

AXIELL GROUP AB 
JUNIOR ACCOUNT MANAGER
Are you eager to start your career in sales and develop into a successful Account Manager? Do you enjoy building relationships, learning about technology, and working with organizations that preserve culture and history? If so, we would love to hear from you! 
About Axiell 
At Axiell, we provide industry-leading software solutions to museums, archives, libraries, and other cultural heritage organizations. Our platforms help institutions manage, preserve, and share valuable collections, making knowledge and culture accessible to future generations.  
As part of an international organization, you will collaborate with colleagues across the Netherlands, Germany, France, Scandinavia, the UK, and Australia.  
The Role 
We are looking for a motivated Junior Account Manager to join our Dutch commercial team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build a career in SaaS sales and develop into a future Account Manager or Business Development Manager. 
In this role, you will support a range of commercial activities while gaining hands-on experience in consultative selling, customer relationship management, and SaaS solutions. You will work closely with customers, support sales processes, and gradually take on greater responsibility for managing customer relationships and business opportunities. 
Alongside the commercial aspects of the role, approximately 25% of your time will be focused on administrative and operational responsibilities, including CRM management, sales administration, reporting, and office coordination. We're therefore looking for someone who enjoys combining customer-facing activities with a structured, organized approach, understanding that strong sales results are built on excellent administration and attention to detail.  
What You'll Do 
Support the sales team with quotations, proposals, and customer communication 
Act as the first point of contact for incoming leads and customer inquiries 
Participating in customer meetings and product discussions 
Maintain CRM records and sales administration 
Help identify, qualify, and follow up on new business opportunities 
Gradually build and manage your own sales pipeline 
Assist with office administration when required 
What We're Looking For 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (commercial/business-related studies preferred) 
Strong interest in sales and business development 
Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English 
Customer-focused, proactive, and eager to learn 
Strong interest in SaaS solutions and technology 
Experience or interest in museums, archives, libraries, cultural heritage, or collection management is an advantage  
What We Offer 
The opportunity to work in an international organization within a unique and meaningful industry.  
Enjoy international collaboration with colleagues across multiple countries and regions.
Extensive coaching and training in SaaS sales, CRM systems, and account management.  
Hybrid working opportunities.  
Salary range of €3,000-€3,500 gross per month, depending on experience. 
Competitive commission plan with the opportunity to earn up to 20% additional compensation based on performance. 
25 vacation days plus 3 additional company holidays, a competitive pension scheme, ample opportunities for personal and professional development, and the option to work partly from home 
Strong opportunities for personal and professional development.  
Apply today and start your career journey with Axiell.

 Business development manager - UK Public Sector
 Job id: 
 36756
 Job location: 
 London, GB
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
Why we need this role
The Business Development Manager will be responsible for leading, developing and executing the UK Public Sector growth strategy for Colt. The role holder will have a deep understanding of the UK public procurement landscape, strong executive-level relationship management skills, and experience selling complex telecoms, connectivity, cloud, managed services, security, or digital transformation solutions.
The Business Development Manager will play a critical role in driving bookings and revenue growth, expanding framework presence, and positioning the company as a trusted strategic partner to UK Public Sector customers.
What you will do
Business Development & Sales Leadership
Develop and execute a strategic growth plan for the UK Public Sector market.
Identify and qualify new business opportunities across government departments, NHS trusts, local authorities, blue-light services, and education institutions.
Create a strong pipeline of opportunities aligned to bookings and revenue targets.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers including CIOs, CTOs, Procurement Directors, Digital Transformation Leads, and Commercial Managers.
Act as a strategic advisor to customers on telecoms, connectivity, cloud, cyber security, collaboration, and digital infrastructure solutions.
Represent Colt at industry events, public sector forums, and networking engagements.
Public Sector Procurement & Frameworks
Maintain strong knowledge of UK public procurement regulations and routes to market.
Drive engagement through frameworks such as Government Commercial Agency (GCA), G-Cloud, Network Services, RM-series frameworks, and other procurement vehicles.
Support framework applications, renewals, and compliance activities.
Market & Competitive Intelligence
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and government digital transformation initiatives.
Identify emerging opportunities in areas including smart cities, AI, cloud migration, cyber resilience, unified communications, IoT, and network transformation.
Provide market feedback to product and leadership teams to support proposition development.
What we're looking for
10-15 yrs experience in UK Public Sector business development within the telecommunications or technology sector.
Proven track record selling into the UK Public Sector.
Experience with public sector procurement frameworks and tendering processes.
Strong understanding of telecoms and digital infrastructure solutions including:
WAN/LAN Connectivity
SD-WAN
Unified Communications
Cloud & Hosting
Managed Services
Cyber Security
Mobile & IoT Solutions
What we offer you:
Looking to make a mark?
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
Diversity and inclusion
Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.
Most recently we have:
Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.
Benefits
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
Global Family Leave Policy.
Employee Assistance Program.
Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.
A global network
When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.
Job Segment: 
 Cyber Security, Network, Data Center, Procurement, Work from Home, Security, Technology, Operations, Contract

Description
FP&A Analyst (with Dutch)
ADP is hiring an Analyst of Financial Planning & Analysis with 3 years of experience in Finance. The Analyst of Financial Planning & Analysis is responsible for planning, forecasting and analysis activities including running/assisting in building financial models, and incorporating guidance received on validated assumptions; as well as challenging data and information integrity. Participating in financial close activities, the Analyst prepares variance analyses on actual versus plan/forecast. In addition, the Analyst assists in managing selected KPI's, management reporting and communication to senior management.
Insightful Expertise is a core value at ADP and in Corporate Finance, our colleagues around the world depend on us for that. Whether it's a new product in development, a new technology under consideration, a new business acquisition or a new office opening - Corporate Finance plays a critical role in ADP's growth. We are a passionate partner committed to ADP's success - and are looking for like-minded individuals who want to be part of our winning team.
At ADP we are driven by your success. We engage your unique talents and perspectives. We welcome your ideas on how to do things differently and better. In your efforts to achieve, learn and grow, we support you all the way. If success motivates you, you belong at ADP.
We strive for every interaction to be driven by our CORE values: Insightful Expertise, Integrity is Everything, Service Excellence, Inspiring Innovation, Each Person Counts, Results-Driven, & Social Responsibility.
Responsibilities: 
Operating Planning and Forecasting: Supports management to create an annual operating plan that is aligned to the strategic plan and performs forecasting to provide visibility into business results to enable business decisions.
Runs operating plan models and incorporates guidance received on validated assumptions; assists in the preparation of the operating plan presentation/deliverables
Assists in building forecast models using key drivers, trend analysis, economic and external factors, etc.
Assists in creation of analytical tools and models for expenses driving process efficiencies.
Management Reporting and Financial Close Activities: Produces and distributes recurring and ad hoc management reports. Responsible for financial reporting accuracy; partners with shared services organizations and ensures adequate control environment to mitigate financial and business risks in collaboration with process owners.
Prepares variance analysis on actual results versus plan/forecast.
Assists in presentation on results, forecasts, and plans to senior management.
Business Analysis: Uses deep understanding of objectives, issues and root causes and provides insightful, fact-based data analysis to help solve complex problems.
Assists in managing KPI's such as backlog reporting, staffing requirements, starts, no starts, labor productivity, and analysis of implementation, survey scores and client satisfaction.
Strategic Planning and Initiatives: Supports management to develop strategies and initiatives to drive growth and margin improvements. Executes on strategic initiatives such as M&A support, product launches, market entry, and process improvement efforts
Provides analytical support; conducts research as required
Business Partnering: Partners with Key Stakeholders and Business Partners to align on business priorities and drive effective solutions/execution. Constructively communicates compelling arguments based on facts and data, and obtains necessary buy-in to deliver on business objectives
Builds working relationships with management and other partners by working collaboratively to achieve a common goal.
Financial Operational Policy: Establishes and maintains consistent financial operational policies and procedures to govern related practices.
Complies with all departmental/ financial operations policies and practices.
Qualifications Required: 
BS or MS - Finance, Accounting, Economics or equivalent
MBA or credits toward MBA preferred
3 Years of Experience in Finance or Accounting. In FP&A is preferred.
Fluent English and Dutch are mandatory. Spanish is a plus.
High level of Excel skills
Reporting Oracle Smartview and usage of Power BI, Alteryx and AI assistants is a plus. 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Preference will be given to candidates who have the following:
Business Analysis and Acumen: Uses an organized and disciplined problem solving methodology; can conduct complex analyses and synthesize and simplify information for others, using experience, business knowledge and judgment to offer insight.
Influential Business Partner: Builds working relationships with business partners; demonstrates ability to tailor communication to the audience -- can simplify and clarify, will redirect poor assumptions or clear up misinformation; can negotiate and doesn't avoid conflict.
Information Management Acumen: Has advanced desktop application skills and understanding of systems including but not limited to Hyperion, ESDB, Oracle; creates reports of moderate to high complexity, looks to improve processes, reporting formats and capabilities and partners with others to make improvements. Demonstrates the ability to transfer knowledge to others and assist them with building relevant skills.
Results Accountability: Is results oriented, sets high standards for self and team members, and holds self and others accountable for delivering quality, timely results; and takes responsibility for own actions.
Impactful Communication: Demonstrates flexible communications based on the setting and purpose of a situation, demonstrates strong listening skills; is a proactive communicator who is effective at including all associates regardless of culture, geographic and language differences.
Building Talent: Shares knowledge with colleagues; gives feedback effectively; is accountable for own career displaying a willingness and strong desire to learn new skills; and demonstrates resilience, persistence and curiosity.
Relationship Building: Builds trust, is collaborative, actively participates and works well with others, shares information and knowledge.
Bias for Growth: Initiates opportunities to enhance operational efficiencies, shares constructive input that results in innovative solutions, demonstrates creative thinking and measured risk taking within and beyond the scope of position.

GNUTTI CARLO GROUP
VERKTYGSTEKNIKER
Har du god teknisk kompetens och vill ta nästa steg och fördjupa dig i tekniskt och praktiskt kunnande gällande gjutverktyg? Då kanske du är den vi söker! Gnutti Carlo Group i Södra Vi är ett av Europas ledande företag inom pressgjutning och det största pressgjuteriet i Sverige. Vi söker nu en verktygstekniker till vår underhållsavdelning!
Gnutti Carlo Group i Södra Vi verktygsavdelning söker nu en tekniskt duktig person. I det här jobbet så består dina arbetsuppgifter huvudsakligen av service, reparation och underhållsarbete på gjutverktyg och klippverktyg. Även en del jobb med maskiner kan förekomma. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med övrig personal på underhållsavdelningen, samt i produktionen. Även en del jobb med gjutverktyg och maskiner kommer att kunna förekomma. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med övrig personal på underhållsavdelningen, samt i produktionen.
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, med inledande 6 månaders visstidsanställning. Det är en heltidstjänst, skiftformen är dagtid. Placering är på Gnutti Carlo Group i Södra Vi, tidigare Ljunghäll AB.
Vi söker dig som…
…har erfarenhet av arbete som verktygsmakare eller verktygstekniker, eller har annan verkstadserfarenhet som bedöms relevant. Du har gått en verkstadsteknisk/fordonsteknisk gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande och har praktisk erfarenhet av montering/demontering. Har du även erfarenhet av svetsning (TIG) är det ett plus. Även kunskaper i maskinteknik och mekanisk bearbetning är meriterande. Goda svenska kunskaper i tal och skrift är ett krav.
Som person…
…är du serviceinriktad och har en positiv inställning. Vi utgår från att du är en lagspelare och att du har känsla för hög kvalitet och effektivitet. Du är också van att arbeta självständigt utifrån givna instruktioner och har förmågan att hitta lösningar på praktiska problem som kan uppstå i det dagliga arbetet.
Vid urvalet kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och ditt engagemang.
Möjligheterna är många hos på Gnutti Carlo Group.
Om vi är rätt för varandra erbjuds du att bli en del av vår utvecklingsinriktade verksamhet där du möts av kamratlig och hjälpsam atmosfär. Du får jobba med en högautomatiserad produktion och väl investerad maskinpark. Hos oss är varierande erfarenheter, kompetenser och personligheter en av de främsta styrkorna för att vi ska kunna utmana och utveckla verksamheten – din roll blir ett viktigt bidrag i detta arbete. Vi ser till att du får den kompetensutveckling du behöver för att stärka din kompetens och därmed även verksamheten. Om du är motiverad och tar personligt ansvar har vi möjligheterna för dig!
Vi erbjuder dig...
· en utvecklande och ansvarfull tjänst
· ett jobb med frihet under ansvar i ett team bestående av driftiga och kompetenta kollegor med god kamratanda
· möjlighet till att utvecklas inom arbetet och på sikt få större ansvar
Låter detta som något för dig?
Skicka in din ansökan redan idag via länken. Vi vill ha din ansökan senast den 22/11.
Frågor om tjänsten kan ställas till Arbetsledare Johan Karlsson på 0492-162 58 eller HR, michaela.johansson@gnutticarlo.com.

Description
ADP is hiring an Upmarket Account Executive (25-49 Employee Market).
Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.
Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success?
Are you looking to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.
In this role, you will drive new business growth within a defined geographic territory targeting organizations with 25-49 employees. You'll build relationships with business owners and decision-makers while helping them address payroll, HR, benefits, compliance, and workforce management challenges through ADP's industry-leading Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions.
Daily, you'll prospect for new business, cultivate relationships, leverage established business partnerships, assess client and prospect needs, present tailored recommendations, and guide organizations through the buying process. You'll manage a complete sales cycle while helping growing businesses leverage technology and strategic workforce solutions to achieve their goals.
This opportunity is designed for sales professionals who have already built a foundation in business-to-business sales and are ready to take the next step in their careers. ADP provides industry-leading sales training, coaching, and technology to help you maximize your success and earnings potential.
Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse-to-lose attitude are must-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment, all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
What You'll Do: Responsibilities
Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.
You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win new business, and achieve sales goals. You'll manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.
Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.
You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business. You will utilize multi-channel prospecting techniques, including networking, referrals, social selling, and business partnerships to engage decision-makers and secure qualified opportunities. You are comfortable leveraging modern digital tools and platforms--including AI--to work smarter and more efficiently. You adopt new technologies quickly, use data to inform decisions, and continuously explore ways to enhance productivity and results through innovation.
Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family.
In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts.
Collaborate Daily.
You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications
Two or more years of quota-carrying business-to-business sales experience or business development
Proven New Business Hunter
Consultative Sales Professional
Positive Self-Starter
 Agile Solution Seeker
Continuous Learner
Technology & Digital Acumen
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job.
Bonus Points for These: Preferred Qualifications
Prior quota-carrying outside business-to-business sales experience.
Experience selling HCM, payroll, SaaS, technology, business services, insurance, uniform services, or related solutions.
Proven success in consultative selling and new business development.
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.
What are you waiting for? Apply today!
#LI-PL1
Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days & Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $40,200.00 - USD $79,800.00 / Year*
*Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage or minimum exempt salary requirement under federal, state and local laws.

We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down-to-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition.

Finansiell Planerare Kredit
Vill du kombinera affärsmannaskap, kreditkompetens och långsiktigt kundansvar? 
På Ålandsbanken bygger vi kundrelationer som varar. Vi kombinerar storbankens tjänsteutbud med den mindre bankens närhet, förnuft och kompetens. Nu söker vi en affärsorienterad Finansiell Planerare Kredit till vårt Private Banking-team i Malmö, med ansvar för kunder och affärsmöjligheter i södra Sverige. 
Om rollen 
Tjänsten tillhör affärsområde Sverige, och där vi inom Private Banking arbetar med större och mer komplexa kunder. Som Finansiell Planerare Kredit ansvarar du för en egen kundbas av privat- och företagskunder med fokus på finansiering och krediter. Du följer kundernas utveckling, identifierar nya affärsmöjligheter och säkerställer att varje engagemang utvecklas lönsamt, långsiktigt och med en ansvarsfull risknivå. Du arbetar aktivt med nykundsbearbetning och nätverk samt samarbetar nära våra Private Bankers, Finansiella Planerare Skatt och kollegor inom Personlig Service & Banking. 
Ditt uppdrag 
• Ansvara för och utveckla en egen kundbas. 
• Analysera kreditpropåer och ta fram beslutsunderlag. 
• Följa upp lönsamhet, risk och kreditengagemang. 
• Attrahera nya kunder genom nätverk och aktiviteter. 
• Stärka Ålandsbankens närvaro på den lokala marknaden. 
• Samverka med kollegor för att skapa kompletta kundlösningar. 
Vem är du? 
• Minst fem års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. 
• Erfarenhet av självständig kreditbedömning och företagsfinansiering. 
• Gärna erfarenhet av kreditgivning inom fastighetsbranschen. 
• Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, juridik eller motsvarande. 
• Swedsec-licens och bolånelicens. 
• Affärsdriven, analytisk, strukturerad och relationsskapande. 
Att arbeta på Ålandsbanken 
Hos oss blir du en del av en arbetsplats som präglas av dialog, korta beslutsvägar och personligt engagemang. Våra värdeord är ambitiös, personlig och ansvarsfull. Du får möjlighet att utvecklas professionellt och bidra till en bank som bryr sig om kunder, medarbetare och miljön. 
Här kan du läsa mer om vad vi erbjuder dig som blir en del av laget Ålandsbanken: Arbeta på Ålandsbanken 
Vill du veta mer? 
Närmare upplysningar kring tjänsten får du av David Lundqvist, Kontorschef, Tfn: +46 (0)40 600 21 12, David.Lundqvist@alandsbanken.se. 
Välkommen in med din ansökan och CV senast den 25 oktober 2026. 
Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Projektledare Kundevent
Skapa mötesplatser som leder till nya kundrelationer 
På Ålandsbanken tror vi att de bästa affärerna börjar med personliga möten. Nu söker vi en Projektledare Kundevent som vill planera, leda och genomföra event som stärker vårt varumärke och skapar nya kundrelationer. 
I rollen blir du en viktig del av vårt arbete med att attrahera nya kunder inom Private Banking och andra prioriterade segment. Du skapar inspirerande mötesplatser där entreprenörer, företagsledare och privatpersoner får möjlighet att lära känna Ålandsbanken och vårt erbjudande. 
Din profil 
Du har några års erfarenhet från event- eller mötesbranschen och är redo att ta nästa steg i karriären. Du trivs med att ta ett helhetsansvar och drivs av att skapa professionella event där både detaljer och helhet håller hög kvalitet. 
Du är strukturerad, självgående och van att koordinera många aktiviteter och kontaktytor samtidigt. Dessutom är du en skicklig relationsbyggare som får energi av att möta människor och skapa samarbeten. 
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du: 
Har erfarenhet av att projektleda event, konferenser eller kundaktiviteter 
Är redo att ta ett större strategiskt och operativt ansvar 
Har erfarenhet av Aspis eller liknande system för deltagarhantering 
Har god förståelse för ljud, ljus och eventteknik 
Har erfarenhet av budgetarbete och uppföljning 
Är van att skapa professionella presentationer i PowerPoint 
Har ett intresse för AI och ny teknik 
Har god administrativ och organisatorisk förmåga 
Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift 
Kan resa frekvent inom Sverige och vid behov internationellt 
Din roll 
Som Projektledare Kundevent utgår du från vårt kontor i Stockholm, och ansvarar du för cirka 80 event per år runt om i Sverige. Du driver projekten från idé till genomförande i nära samarbete med interna stakeholders och ansvarar för planering, budget, produktion och uppföljning. 
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att: 
Planera och genomföra kundevent, seminarier och nätverksträffar 
Ansvara för projektbudget, tidsplaner och uppföljning 
Koordinera interna beställare, leverantörer och samarbetspartners 
Hantera deltagaradministration och eventkommunikation i Aspis 
Säkerställa hög kvalitet inom teknik, produktion och genomförande 
Utvärdera aktiviteter och identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter 
Utveckla nya koncept som stärker Ålandsbankens varumärke och attraherar nya kunder 
Resultatet av ditt arbete blir mötesplatser som skapar affärsmöjligheter och långsiktiga kundrelationer för Ålandsbanken. 
Erfarenhet från Private Banking, kapitalförvaltning eller andra finansiella tjänster är meriterande. 
Därför ska du välja Ålandsbanken 
Ålandsbanken har i över 100 år byggt sin verksamhet på långsiktiga relationer, hög kompetens och personligt engagemang. Hos oss får du kombinera kreativitet, affärsmannaskap och projektledning i en roll som bidrar direkt till bankens tillväxt. 
Du blir en del av en organisation med korta beslutsvägar där idéer uppmuntras och där vi arbetar utifrån våra värderingar: Ambitiösa, Personliga och Ansvarsfulla. 
Att arbeta på Ålandsbanken 
Här kan du läsa mer om vad vi erbjuder dig som blir en del av laget Ålandsbanken: 
https://www.alandsbanken.fi/sv/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken 
Vill du veta mer? 
Närmare upplysningar kring tjänsten lämnas av: 
Matilda Granat, Relationship Manager – Affärsområde Sverige 
 Matilda.Granat@alandsbanken.se 
eller 
John Boman, Rekryterare 
 john.boman@alandsbanken.fi 
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 1 november 2026. 
Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Description
ADP is hiring a NextGen Implementation Specialist.
Are you looking to grow your career in an agile, dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to progress?
Are you a continuous learner who embraces ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities?
Are you looking to be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights?
If so, this may be an opportunity for you. Read on and decide for yourself.
As a Client Onboarding Specialist, you will carry the ADP relationship forward after a sale and enable the first interaction between mid-sized business clients and ADP's industry-leading payroll and HR solutions. You will build relationships with clients and seamlessly implement ADP's technologies to ensure your clients achieve long-term success. Once ADP services are delivered, your efforts will have a direct impact on the day-to-day lives of your clients' employees -- from paychecks to health benefits and beyond.
You will spend your day ensuring your clients are comfortable using ADP's products and services. Every day, you will partner with clients to learn and understand their business needs; analyze existing systems, interface requirements, and business processes; and then guide and drive clients towards the best solution for their unique business needs. Still, every day will be different because the new clients you meet span geographies and industries, requiring different solutions to satisfy their specific needs. That will keep things interesting, and our top-ranked training will help set you up for success!
To thrive in this role, you must be comfortable working in a metrics-driven environment as part of a structured day. You have a way with clients that builds rapport, establishes trust, and shines with professionalism. Over the phone and in writing, your communication style is clear and easy for our clients to understand and take action on. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. Pace should not scare you. We also have a healthy dose of fun. Not only can you find a career here, but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Implementation at ADP, watch here: https://adp.careers/Client_Services_Videos
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities
What you can expect on a typical day:
Onboard Clients. You'll create exceptional onboarding experiences for each product or service implementation. You'll help clients develop the skills and confidence to use our products with ease through your expertise and relationship-building.
Implement ADP Technologies. You will consult with clients and analyze existing systems, interface requirements, and business processes to deliver a comprehensive ADP solution. You will incorporate new processes, tools, and approaches when recommending and implementing the ADP solution.
Partner Internally.You will collaborate with ADP associates in sales and customer service and exchange routine information with members of the client project team, including priorities, timeliness, and issues as they arise.
Multi-Task - Communicate.You will work on multiple time-sensitive projects and follow-up items at the same time. You will share essential information with clients and the teams you work with at ADP.
Organize. You adhere to a daily schedule and organize yourself to deal with a high volume of inbound calls. Daily phone time may increase during peak seasons, like at the close of the calendar year.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications
High School Diploma
Basic project management skills
You can work overtime hours during peak seasons
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
Experience noted above OR
Military Experience. We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
YOU'LL ALSO LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
 Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups to connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
 Be your healthiest.Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones. 
 Focus on your mental health and well-being.We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another. 
 Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live. 
 Get paid to pay it forward.Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about. 
What are you waiting for? Apply now!

We are looking for talented engineers with backgrounds in Electrical and Computer Engineering for such roles as Vehicle Systems Engineering, Electrical Design and Release, High Voltage Wire Harness Design and Packaging, Embedded Software Development and Algorithm Research, AUTOSAR Model Based System Design, Validation, Hardware in the Loop Integration, Functional Safety, Vehicle Triage, SWAT and Launch Support, etc.

Responsibilities include:
· Rapid troubleshooting / triage of vehicle electrical systems including
o Wiring issues
o Electrical component issues
o Assembly plant issues
o Vehicle networking issues
o Vehicle System issues
· Provide Plant support for tvehicle launches, durability fleets, and prototype vehicles
· Drive identified issues to closure

· Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
· Knowledge of CAN based communication and tools
· Experience with multimeters and oscilloscopes
· Outstanding communication and organization skills
· Self-starter with ability to work independently
Preferred Qualifications:
· Knowledge of CAN-FD 
· Knowledge of Ethernet protocol

Description
ADP is hiring a Digital Sales Associate. 
 Are you ready for your next best job where you can control your financial future -- and achieve that perfect work-life balance you've been searching for? 
 Does access to the latest tools and technology to assist with sales excite you? 
 Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
Yes? We had a feeling this could be a perfect match. Don't just take our word for it... read on and see for yourself! 
As a Digital Sales Associate, you will sell ADP solutions, including payroll, tax, human resources, and benefits to new and existing clients using the latest digital technology. You will serve as a consultative business partner introducing ADP's leading solutions to Chief Financial Officers, Human Resources and Payroll Administrators, Small Business Owners, and more at companies ranging from Fortune 100 organizations to small, innovative businesses. You'll provide expert guidance and use your entrepreneurial spirit to build your book of business. In addition, we are known for our high-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest technology to set you up for success. 
To start, your leader will provide daily goals around the number of dials, talk time, and appointments set -- all to get you off to the best start possible. As you prove yourself and settle into the role, you'll find autonomy, flexibility within your daily schedule, work-life balance (a set schedule Monday -- Friday, no weekends!), and virtual appointments in a role that does not require travel. Let's also not forget the uncapped commission, incentive trips, and promotional opportunities in a fun and friendly environment -- all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and a highly respected tech company. 
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Sales at ADP, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales_Videos 
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities 
 Grow Our Business While Growing Yours. You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
 Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans. You will implement a sales strategy targeted at decision- makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
 Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family. In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts.
 Collaborate Daily. You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards. 
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
 Acumen Using New Tools. You are a quick learner when it comes to learning new tools and technology. You believe in the power of leveraging insights and real-time data to assist clients and prospects throughout their buying journey.
 Positive Self-Starter. You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to make a proactive, strategic outreach without fear of rejection. Ability to manage your time and present your ideas in a clear professional manner while leveraging go-to-market technology throughout the sales process. 
 Continuous Learner. You're always learning, growing, and questioning what was done in the past to make things better. 
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. If you don't have a college degree, other acceptable experience includes: 
Two or more years of previous sales experience or completion of a sales internship 
Military experience -- skills including teamwork, resilience, negotiation, trust-building, and a never lose mentality will help you build team and client relationships, identify solutions, and achieve success. 
BONUS POINTS FOR THESE: Preferred Qualifications 
Prior quota-carrying experience
Demonstrated ability to successfully build a network via social platforms
Experience with video platforms

Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn. Ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities for even the most insatiable learner.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

Description
ADP is hiring a Relationship Life Cycle Consultant in the San Francisco, CA area/surrounding area to manage a book of business. .
Do you love being in front of a crowd?
Are you a strategic thinker?
Do you think benefits are fun?
Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?
As a Relationship Life Cycle Consultant, you will work to strengthen the connection with our key account clients through service and consultation around benefit education strategies. For your assigned book of business, you will understand clients' needs regarding benefits and strategically drive results to increase benefit participation, client experience, employee retention, and employee engagement.
Your day-to-day will be spent building relationships with key internal and external stakeholders for each client and their employees to drive year-round benefit education. In this position, you will ensure service excellence and improve client relationships, including client satisfaction and experience. You must effectively maintain, build, and manage client relationships at all levels to ensure clients achieve their benefit strategies utilizing ADP's Human Capital Management tools and services. You will work closely with clients and their employees to optimize the utilization of their plan benefits and bring consultation to complex benefit strategies and initiatives.
You will need strong partnerships with Sales, Brokers, Implementation, HR, and the Operations organization to resolve escalated and complex benefit issues. You will implement your benefit strategies through virtual, onsite, or recorded benefit presentations to each client. Travel will be required to support client visits and strengthen relationships.
To thrive in this role, you must build rapport, establish trust, develop strategies and shine with professionalism. Through onsite and virtual connections, you will help analyze benefit trends within each client and develop education strategies to assist employees in maximizing their plan and carrier resources. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. While our team's culture promotes a healthy dose of fun and high engagement, a fast-paced environment should not scare you. Not only can you find a career here, but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Client Services at ADP, watch here:
https://adp.careers/Client_Services_Videos
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities
What you can expect on a typical day: 
You will design and execute benefit strategies and communication year-round to an assigned client base, reviewing strategies to drive plan participation and retention.
You will conduct worksite benefit meetings for groups of new hires, quarterly wellness meetings to review carrier value-add information and resources, spending accounts education, year-end onboarding meetings, open enrollment meetings, and more.
You will manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders, focusing on benefit strategies related to worksite employee enrollment in the plan.
You will continually upgrade your knowledge and skills in benefits, including attending training sessions and becoming a benefit subject matter expert.
You adhere to a daily schedule to manage your meetings, calls, partner connections, etc.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Requirements
You have five years of client service or client relationship management experience in a fast-paced service environment.
You have experience in benefits.
You excel at presentations -- keeping large audiences engaged and attentive as you present.
You're a strategic thinker and have demonstrated the ability to assess needs and provide innovative solutions to assist clients in meeting their business objectives.
You can travel to support client visits and strengthen relationships.
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
Experience noted above OR
Military Experience. We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
BONUS POINTS FOR THESE: Preferred Qualifications
Progressive management experience in consulting or large corporate environments.
Experience with multiple larger complex clients or advisor relationships and dealing with a broad range of benefits or HR equivalent-related areas at senior levels of organizations.
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.
What are you waiting for? Apply today!

Job Summary
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in insurance claims focuses on delivering accurate and timely support for customer service and domain driven activities within a multinational organization. The professional will analyze claims guide stakeholders on process nuances and ensure consistent adherence to standards while working in rotational shifts without travel. Their work will help enhance customer trust and operational excellence in the insurance services portfolio.
Responsibilities
Analyze incoming insurance claims and related customer service requests to validate coverage identify documentation gaps and ensure that each case is processed accurately in line with internal guidelines and domain standards.
Handle customer service interactions across multiple channels to provide clear explanations on claims status required next steps and resolution timelines while maintaining a calm and empathetic communication style.
Coordinate with internal operations teams to streamline claim intake and assessment workflows and contribute to improved turnaround time and reduced rework through detailed case reviews.
Perform end to end documentation checks on claims files to confirm that information is complete consistent and compliant with process rules thereby reducing downstream processing issues.
Investigate claim details using available systems and tools to highlight potential inconsistencies and escalate complex or ambiguous cases according to defined escalation paths.
Provide structured feedback on recurring customer service issues and claim processing pain points helping product and process owners refine procedures and service scripts.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by tracking key performance metrics related to claim resolution accuracy customer satisfaction scores and cycle time and by suggesting practical enhancements.
Collaborate with training and quality teams by sharing real world case scenarios and insights from daily work to shape more effective learning materials and quality checklists.
Contribute to knowledge base updates by drafting clear process notes and frequently asked questions that help colleagues resolve claims and customer queries more efficiently.
Adapt to a rotational shift environment by managing workload intelligently and maintaining a consistent level of responsiveness and quality regardless of shift timing.
Utilize hybrid work arrangements effectively by maintaining secure and confidential handling of sensitive claim information both on site and remotely in accordance with company policies.
Support the company purpose by helping customers navigate stressful claim situations with clarity and fairness thereby strengthening trust in the organization and its insurance service offerings.
Participate in cross functional discussions to represent claims and customer service perspectives ensuring that operational changes positively impact end customers and broader society through reliable risk protection.
Qualifications
Demonstrate solid experience in insurance claims domain activities with two to four years of hands on involvement in processing or supporting claims operations in a professional setting.
Show strong customer service skills including active listening precise communication and issue resolution capabilities that drive high satisfaction and minimize repeated contacts.
Apply foundational knowledge of property and casualty insurance concepts such as policy coverage limits deductibles exclusions and claim life cycle to interpret case details effectively.
Exhibit proficiency in working with standard office productivity tools and claims related applications to log cases update records and generate simple reports for stakeholders.
Display adaptability in hybrid work and rotational shifts by organizing tasks efficiently managing time constraints and maintaining consistent performance levels.
Demonstrate analytical thinking and attention to detail when reviewing claim facts and customer information which supports accurate decisions and fair outcomes for all parties.
Show openness to learn new processes regulatory updates and system enhancements in the insurance domain and translate that learning into better daily execution.
Certifications Required
Preferred certifications include insurance claims or customer service credentials such as INS or AIC or equivalent industry specific training.
Additional employment information
Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Description
ADP is hiring an Associate Account Manager. 
Are you ready to join a company offering career advancement opportunities throughout your career journey? 
Do you want to join a company with award-winning training and world-class service guidelines to help you achieve success, growth, and continued learning? 
Are you looking for an inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging? 
If so, this may be an opportunity for you. Read on and decide for yourself. 
In this role, you will serve as ADP's front-line for solving clients' challenges, including issue resolution, answering questions, helping clients, training their users on ADP technology, and more. You carry the weight of ADP’s service reputation and client satisfaction in your hands. 
The nature of what you do every day will not change – your #1 goal is to help clients who have between 50 - 999 employees. Still, every day will be different because the questions you receive will vary, as will the solutions you provide each client. There will be no shortage of new questions you'll receive, which will keep things interesting, and our top-ranked training will help to set you up for success! 
To thrive in this role, you must be comfortable working in a metrics-driven call center environment as part of a structured day. You have a way with clients that builds rapport, establishes trust, and shines with professionalism. Over the phone and in writing, your communication style is clear and easy for our clients to understand and take action on. As a result, your client satisfaction scores make you proud. Pace should not scare you. We also have a healthy dose of fun. Not only can you find a career here but friendships that last in a company that values inclusion. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities 
What you can expect on a typical day: 
Be a Trusted Advisor and Problem Solver. You will use your wide breadth of expertise to help ADP's clients solve problems for time-sensitive issues by taking a broad perspective to identify solutions, resolve issues, and provide solutions. You will take the initiative to seek answers, solutions, and positive outcomes. 
Build Relationships. You will build relationships with clients using the phone, email, and/or chat, where you will strive to exceed client expectations in every interaction. You hold yourself to the highest ethical standards and live ADP's core value of "Integrity is Everything." 
Educate and Provide Recommendations. You will leverage your ADP product and services knowledge to help clients understand our products' value. You will take client input and turn it into recommendations for your leaders on best practices and solutions training. 
Organize. You adhere to a daily schedule and organize yourself to deal with a high volume of inbound calls. Daily phone time may increase during peak seasons, like at the close of the year. 
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
You have at least one year of experience in a customer service environment. 
You can work overtime hours during peak seasons. 
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include: 
Experience noted above OR
Military experience where skills including teamwork, adaptability, organization, and follow-through will help you build team and client relationships, identify solutions, and achieve success
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN: 
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights. 
Belongby joining one of our Business Resource Groups to connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences. 
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities. 
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones. 
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another. 
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live. 
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about. 
Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days & Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $18.56 - USD $34.66 / Hour*
*Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage or minimum exempt salary requirement under federal, state and local laws.

Job Description
Maintain and develop the infrastructure behind global public DNS, public certificates and code signing services. In this third-line role, you will manage certificate lifecycles and service operations across datacentre, cloud and SaaS environments. You will also contribute to international DNS cleanup initiatives, develop service functionality and build ITSM processes, documentation and SLAs that support reliable global delivery.
You need a solid understanding of public PKI, cryptography, key management and related technologies such as ADCS. Practical scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell and Python are required, alongside proven experience with OpenSSL, ACME and network diagnostic tools such as nslookup and dig. Strong knowledge of global IT operations and security, familiarity with ITSM processes and proficiency in English are essential.
As a subject matter expert, you will troubleshoot complex issues, advise stakeholders and collaborate with networking, load balancing, reverse proxy and web services teams. The assignment is full-time.

Cognizant Mobility is the premier automotive engineering services division of Cognizant that is focused on smart connected vehicle engineering and software delivery. We are looking for talented engineers with backgrounds in Electrical and Computer Engineering for such roles as Vehicle Systems Engineering, Electrical Design and Release, High Voltage Wire Harness Design and Packaging, Embedded Software Development and Algorithm Research, AUTOSAR Model Based System Design, Validation, Hardware in the Loop Integration, Functional Safety, Vehicle Triage, SWAT and Launch Support, etc.

Responsibilities include:
· Rapid troubleshooting / triage of vehicle electrical systems including
o Wiring issues
o Electrical component issues
o Assembly plant issues
o Vehicle networking issues
o Vehicle System issues
· Provide Plant support for tvehicle launches, durability fleets, and prototype vehicles
· Drive identified issues to closure
