Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.
The Role
Your role
As a Presentation Designer, you will shape clear, compelling presentations that communicate complex ideas with precision and impact. This role focuses on transforming content into structured narratives and visuals that align to Kyndryl and customer brand guidelines. The work emphasizes storytelling, information hierarchy, and visual clarity, primarily at the skeleton and surface levels of design.
You will spend most of your time designing and refining presentation materials, collaborating with stakeholders to understand intent, and ensuring consistency, accessibility, and usability across deliverables.
What you will do
•Design and develop presentations that translate complex information into clear, structured visual stories
•Apply Kyndryl and customer brand guidelines consistently across all presentation materials
•Partner with content owners to clarify objectives, audience needs, and key messages
•Create layouts, charts, diagrams, and visual systems that improve comprehension and decision making
•Edit and refine existing presentations to improve flow, hierarchy, and visual consistency
•Manage multiple presentation requests while meeting defined timelines and quality standards
•Ensure presentations are accessible, easy to navigate, and ready for live or distributed use
Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.
Who You Are
Why Kyndryl:
We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.
Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
Required skills and experience
•Experience designing professional presentations for enterprise or customer-facing audiences
•Ability to structure content into clear narratives using visual hierarchy and layout
•Proficiency in presentation and visual design tools such as PowerPoint or equivalent platforms
•Working knowledge of brand guidelines and applying them accurately and consistently
•Experience combining language and visuals to communicate ideas clearly and concisely
•Attention to detail in layout, typography, spacing, and visual consistency
Preferred skills and experience
•Background in graphic design, visual communication, or information design
•Experience supporting executive, sales, or customer presentations
•Familiarity with accessibility principles for presentations
•Ability to interpret rough content or outlines and turn them into polished materials
The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is -
$63,360 to $114,120 based on a full-time schedule.  
Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience.  For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.
There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:
California (San Francisco Bay Area):$76,080 to $137,040
California (All Other):$69,720 to $125,640
Colorado: $63,360 to $114,120
Massachusetts $63,360 to $125,640
New York City: $76,080 to $137,040
Washington: $69,720 to $125,640
Washington DC:$69,720 to $125,640
This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off.  Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.
Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.
Get Referred!
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.
The Role
Your role
As a Presentation Designer, you will shape clear, compelling presentations that communicate complex ideas with precision and impact. This role focuses on transforming content into structured narratives and visuals that align to Kyndryl and customer brand guidelines. The work emphasizes storytelling, information hierarchy, and visual clarity, primarily at the skeleton and surface levels of design.
You will spend most of your time designing and refining presentation materials, collaborating with stakeholders to understand intent, and ensuring consistency, accessibility, and usability across deliverables.
What you will do
•Design and develop presentations that translate complex information into clear, structured visual stories
•Apply Kyndryl and customer brand guidelines consistently across all presentation materials
•Partner with content owners to clarify objectives, audience needs, and key messages
•Create layouts, charts, diagrams, and visual systems that improve comprehension and decision making
•Edit and refine existing presentations to improve flow, hierarchy, and visual consistency
•Manage multiple presentation requests while meeting defined timelines and quality standards
•Ensure presentations are accessible, easy to navigate, and ready for live or distributed use
Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.
Who You Are
Why Kyndryl:
We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.
Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
Required skills and experience
•Experience designing professional presentations for enterprise or customer-facing audiences
•Ability to structure content into clear narratives using visual hierarchy and layout
•Proficiency in presentation and visual design tools such as PowerPoint or equivalent platforms
•Working knowledge of brand guidelines and applying them accurately and consistently
•Experience combining language and visuals to communicate ideas clearly and concisely
•Attention to detail in layout, typography, spacing, and visual consistency
Preferred skills and experience
•Background in graphic design, visual communication, or information design
•Experience supporting executive, sales, or customer presentations
•Familiarity with accessibility principles for presentations
•Ability to interpret rough content or outlines and turn them into polished materials
The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is -
$63,360 to $114,120 based on a full-time schedule.  
Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience.  For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.
There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:
California (San Francisco Bay Area):$76,080 to $137,040
California (All Other):$69,720 to $125,640
Colorado: $63,360 to $114,120
Massachusetts $63,360 to $125,640
New York City: $76,080 to $137,040
Washington: $69,720 to $125,640
Washington DC:$69,720 to $125,640
This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off.  Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.
Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.
Get Referred!
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your Role
You will play a key part in driving our identity modernization efforts, building custom extensions, and securing seamless access across our core enterprise applications and modern cloud systems.
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
We are seeking an experienced Senior IAM Engineer specializing in PingFederate and PingAccess to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and supporting robust, secure authentication and authorization solutions within a complex enterprise environment. 
Key Responsibilities
IAM Architecture & Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain secure enterprise authentication, federation, and authorization solutions centered on PingFederate and PingAccess.
Custom Development & Integrations: Utilize solid Java skills and the Ping SDK to develop, optimize, and maintain custom Ping adapters, plugins, and custom integrations tailored to enterprise needs.
Protocol & Standards Management: Drive implementation and best practices for modern identity protocols including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), FIDO2, and Single Sign-On (SSO).
CI/CD & DevOps Automation: Integrate IAM configurations and deployment workflows into continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Azure DevOps.
System Support & Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis, advanced troubleshooting, and issue resolution for complex identity, access, and federation flows across systems.
Proactive Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional security, infrastructure, and development teams to advocate for secure, solution-oriented identity practices.
Your future at Kyndryl 
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Qualification
Total Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM).
Ping Identity Suite: Deep hands-on experience with PingFederate and PingAccess.
IAM Protocols: Strong, foundational understanding of enterprise IAM concepts, standards, and protocols—including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, FIDO2, and SSO.
Java Development & SDK: Solid Java development capabilities, specifically in building, extending, and maintaining custom Ping adapters, plugins, and integrations using the Ping SDK.
DevOps & Delivery: Practical experience working with Azure DevOps and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Domain Focus: Proven, demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), and federation solutions in complex environments.
Preferred Qualification
Groovy scripting experience.
Exposure to or experience with broader Ping products and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred! 
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

 BambooHR
Integritetspolicy
Lediga jobb
Software Engineer
Ljubljana
Power the future of public mobility. 
Ridango builds account-based ticketing and mobility platforms used by public transport authorities and operators worldwide. Our systems span backend services, web applications, hardware devices, and real-time integrations — all working together to keep people moving at scale. 
We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our team in Slovenia for a project-based role. You should already be based in Slovenia, write clean, reliable code, and take real ownership of what you ship. Do you spot problems before they happen — and speak up when you do? If so, we'd love to talk.
What you'll be doing:
Designing and developing features across UI, services, APIs and data layers.
Maintaining and improving existing system components.
Writing and maintaining automated tests and technical documentation.
Participating actively in code reviews and contributing to engineering standards.
Collaborating with QA, Product and Design to clarify requirements and flag technical risks early.
What we're looking for:
Solid backend, frontend or full-stack development experience.
Understanding of system integration patterns and component design.
Familiarity with testing, CI/CD and deployment practices.
Ability to independently work through medium complexity technical problems.
Clear communicator who works well in a team. 
What we offer:
Work that matters — our systems move millions of people daily across multiple continents.
A collaborative engineering culture where your input is heard and valued.
Experienced team leads and senior engineers to learn from and work alongside.
Room to grow in a company expanding internationally.
Competitive compensation package.
Ready to build something that people actually use? Apply now.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your role
At Kyndryl, Forward Deployed Engineers work where enterprise AI becomes real. This is not a traditional consulting role or a back office engineering position. Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI solutions that operate in complex, regulated, production environments.
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will own defined delivery workstreams within customer engagements—prototyping, deploying, and optimizing AI systems that create measurable business outcomes. You will operate with growing independence in customer environments, bridging deep engineering expertise with business context, and translating ambiguous problems into production ready solutions.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering, consulting, and delivery accountability. You will use modern AI development tools to accelerate solution design, code generation, testing, and deployment, while building the customer trust that sustains long term impact and referenceable success.
What you will do
•Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one
•Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks
•Ownership, Deployment & Partnership: Own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. Work as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes.
•Optimization: Troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability
•Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks
•Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development
•Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl’s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams
Who You Are
Required skills and experience 
•Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus
•Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark
•Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures
Preferred skills and experience 
•Open-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories
•T-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting
•Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms
•Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions
•Performance & Security: Knowledge of system-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems
•Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences
•Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required
•Education: Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred! 
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Drive progress with purpose
At Kyndryl, we achieve progress the world depends on, with purpose. Beginning with the purpose that matters to you. Because here, you will be part of a culture designed with purpose. One that is restless, empathetic and devoted. Where we are committed to sustainable progress for our customers and supporting the communities where we work and live. All of you is what we want. And what we need. Join us, and together, we can advance the vital systems that power human progress.

Workplace Manager, Espoo/Otaniemi HQ
About RELEX
RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 600+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t spoil in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.
We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s still accelerating. The first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
In March 2027 we will open our new headquarters in Otaniemi, Espoo, and we are looking for the person who will make it work for everyone who walks through the door.
About the role
As our Workplace Manager, you are the single, on-the-ground owner of the new Otaniemi HQ. You run day-to-day facilities operations, make sure our space is used well, manage the subleasing arrangement, and shape the office experience for our employees. You report to the Director of Workplace Services and work closely with the Workplace team, BIT (business and information technology), Internal Events, HR and Sustainability.
This is a completely new role. You will build the ways of working for our new home from the ground up.
Due to the nature of the role, on-site presence is essential to succeed in this position, with flexibility to work remotely 1–2 days per week. Ideally, you would start in January or early February 2027, so that you have time to take ownership of the space before we open our doors.
What you’ll do
Run the Otaniemi HQ
Own operational effectiveness of the office after the opening in March 2027
Make sure processes and documentation are in place, followed and updated when needed
Plan and carry out communication with the relevant stakeholders
Act as a main point of contact for our facility partner (lobby, facility manager, cleaning, security)
Act as a team lead for the Otaniemi HQ office team
Manage facilities and space
Own daily facilities operations, including maintenance, cleaning, security, and health and safety
Track space and hybrid desk and seat utilization against agreed targets
Manage moves, adds and changes, and the room and desk-booking system together with BIT
Be the main contact for the property owner or manager on communication and development needs
Own physical security at the office
Create a great workplace experience
Manage the workday experience at the office together with the team, and react quickly to employees’ needs
Work closely with the events team (sales, marketing and internal) to ensure smooth event experiences
Manage surveys
Manage vendors, budget and sustainability
Own facility management (FM) vendor relationships and the operating budget of the site
Manage the partner sublease
Report utilization and facilities KPIs, supporting Sustainability’s building-level environmental, social and governance (ESG) targets
Govern workplace data
Own data governance for HQ digital systems, including data flows, reporting and integrations across booking, IoT and sensors, access and workplace apps
Maintain data quality, security and compliance in line with RELEX’s data governance policy
Build and maintain utilization and performance dashboards for Workplace Services and BIT
What you bring
Experience managing facilities or workplace operations for a large office (500+ employees)
Strong FM vendor management and budget ownership skills
Confident stakeholder management across Real Estate, IT, HR, Internal Events and leadership
Comfort using space and desk-booking and occupancy-analytics tools to interpret utilization data
Fluent English and good working proficiency in Finnish, so you can work day to day with our facility partner, property owner and local vendors
Experience working with workplace or building data, reporting and dashboards, with attention to data quality, security and compliance
Nice to have
Direct experience with a Nordic or European tech-sector office
Familiarity with hybrid-work policy design and desk-ratio and adoption tracking
Experience with health and indoor air quality monitoring
Background in sustainability or ESG reporting for real estate or facilities
Experience using AI in your day-to-day work to automate tasks
What we offer in return
You’ll be supported and given the space to thrive. We offer meaningful work, flexibility, and a culture that backs you to share your voice and be authentic.
An international career and learning opportunities
A rapidly growing and financially robust software company with exciting opportunities for career growth, also in the future
Room to thrive in a fast-growing global company with a good market position
Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
Annual leave
Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability, end to end across our customers’ supply chains
Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
Two paid volunteering days each year
How to apply
If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your CV and cover letter through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that to be considered for this position you must hold a valid work permit. We’re excited to connect with applicants who share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what’s next for the product, the planet, and the people.
Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.
Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

Testingenjör inom elektronik och kraftelektronik
  Helsingborg       Ansök senast 2026-11-20
Uppdragsbeskrivning
Vill du arbeta praktiskt med test och verifiering av avancerade elektriska produkter för industriella applikationer?
Vi söker nu en testingenjör till ett spännande utvecklingsuppdrag hos ett teknikföretag i Helsingborg. Du kommer att arbeta nära produktutvecklingen med test och verifiering av elektriska och elektroniska produkter som används i krävande industriella miljöer.
Rollen passar dig som gillar att kombinera praktiskt laboratoriearbete, mätteknik, felsökning och analys.
Om rollen
Som testingenjör kommer du att planera, genomföra och dokumentera tester för att säkerställa att produkter uppfyller tekniska krav och fungerar under olika elektriska, mekaniska och miljömässiga förhållanden.
Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat innebära:
EMC-testning och felsökning
Vibrations- och mekaniska tester
Temperaturcykling samt klimat- och miljötester
Elektriska tester och verifiering
Framtagning och genomförande av testplaner och testfall
Uppbyggnad av testuppställningar och genomförande av mätningar
Analys av testresultat och identifiering av avvikelser
Felsökning tillsammans med utvecklingsingenjörer
Dokumentation och rapportering av testresultat
Koordinering och uppföljning av tester som genomförs hos externa testlaboratorier
Det här är en hands-on roll där du förväntas kunna arbeta självständigt med testutrustning och testuppställningar, men samtidigt ha ett nära samarbete med utvecklingsteamet.
Grundläggande kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som har:
Ingenjörsutbildning inom elektronik, elektroteknik, mekatronik eller motsvarande
Erfarenhet av test, verifiering eller validering av elektriska eller elektroniska produkter
God förståelse för elektriska system och elsäkerhet
Praktisk erfarenhet av elektrisk mätutrustning och testuppställningar
Erfarenhet av felsökning av elektriska och elektroniska system
Förmåga att analysera och dokumentera testresultat på ett strukturerat sätt
Förståelse för elektriska produkter från traditionella spänningsnivåer upp till högre spänningar för industriella applikationer
Meriterande
Vi ser det som extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av:
EMC-testning
Temperatur- och klimatprovning
Vibrations- och mekanisk provning
Miljöprovning
Kraftelektronik
Motorstyrning eller industriell automation
Trefassystem
Arbete med högre spänningar och effekter
Externa eller ackrediterade testlaboratorier
Verifiering inför certifiering eller produktrelease
Meriterande färdigheter, egenskaper och erfarenheter
Vem är du?
Du är praktiskt lagd, strukturerad och analytisk och tycker om att förstå varför en produkt beter sig som den gör.
Du är bekväm med att arbeta nära fysisk hårdvara och trivs med kombinationen av testning, felsökning och problemlösning. Eftersom arbetet innefattar elektrisk utrustning är ett säkerhetsmedvetet och metodiskt arbetssätt en självklarhet.
Du tar ansvar för dina tester från planering och uppkoppling till analys och dokumentation och kommunicerar resultaten tydligt till övriga i utvecklingsteamet.
Vi erbjuder
Därför väljer ingenjörer Sigma Industry Evolution
Vi tror att de bästa lösningarna skapas av människor som trivs och utvecklas.
Hos oss får du:
Spännande uppdrag hos ledande teknikföretag
Möjlighet att bredda din kompetens inom flera teknikområden
Kompetensutveckling och erfarenhetsutbyte med engagerade kollegor
Stor frihet att påverka din egen karriär
En kultur präglad av entreprenörskap, omtanke och gemenskap
Balans mellan arbete och privatliv
Många av våra medarbetare stannar länge hos oss, något vi är väldigt stolta över.
Låter det intressant?
Vi rekryterar inte bara till ett specifikt uppdrag, utan till en långsiktig karriär där du får möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med några av regionens mest engagerade ingenjörer.
Välkommen till Sigma Industry Evolution. En förändring börjar ofta med ett samtal.

#LI-CD1

Sigma Group består av ledande konsultföretag med målsättningen att göra sina kunder mer konkurrenskraftiga. Vi är över 5000 yrkesverksamma i 13 länder, som utnyttjar djup teknisk expertis och banbrytande lösningar för att hantera komplexa ingenjörsutmaningar. Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your Role:
Join Kyndryl as a Service Delivery Coordinator (Band 6) to drive operational excellence, ensure ITIL compliance, and maintain exceptional customer satisfaction. You will oversee end-to-end service delivery, manage client escalations, and lead process improvements to guarantee service stability.
What you will do:
Service Operations & SLA Management: Drive Incident, Problem, Change, and Request processes to meet SLAs/KPIs, minimize major incident impact, and submit RCAs.
Governance & Client Relations: Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly service reviews, present performance dashboards, and act as the primary escalation point.
ITIL Governance: Oversee Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Configuration, and Service Level Management in line with compliance standards.
Risk & Audit Management: Identify operational risks, ensure audit readiness, track observations, and support security/vulnerability remediation.
Continuous Service Improvement (CSI): Analyze service trends, implement automation, address recurring issues, and establish preventive measures.
Vendor & Team Coordination: Align third-party vendor performance with contracts and drive cross-functional collaboration.
Your Future at Kyndryl:
This is a true “start here, go anywhere” opportunity. As you get a close-up look at a wide variety of Kyndryl job roles, you can choose your career path. Many have moved up to the 2nd or 3rd level escalation team. Others go on to further education/certifications and more senior or technical roles. Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career—including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify across major enterprise platforms.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Technical and Professional Expertise :
Experience & Domain: 6+ years of application support experience; strong background in Banking & Financial Services preferred.
Application Monitoring: Health checks (SOD/EOD), alert tracking, and batch/interface monitoring across Core Banking (Finacle), Payments, Trade, and LOS.
ITIL & ITSM: Incident logging, SLA tracking, and ticket creation for minor, major, and critical Changes in ITSM tools.
Troubleshooting: Resolving login failures, data mismatches, batch errors, and interface issues using scripts, queries, and SOPs.
Operational Execution: Executing batch restarts, file transfers, data validation, and deployment support during maintenance windows.
Escalation & Documentation: Gathering logs and analysis for L2/L3 escalations; maintaining incident logs, SOPs, and knowledge base updates.
User Support: Professional communication with business/ops teams via email, calls, and tickets regarding status updates and resolutions.
Experience & Qualification
Graduate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related
Mandatory 6+ years of Banking domain experience.
ITIL Foundation certification (mandatory).
ITIL Intermediate/Managing Professional certifications (preferred).
Preferred Banking Knowledge .
Preferred Banking Knowledge
Finacle Core Banking Solution
CBS Operations
Branch Banking Processes
Digital Banking Channels
Regulatory and Information Security Compliance
Incident, Problem, and Change Management in Banking Environment
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred! 
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Vill du växa med oss på Sigma Industry South i Kronoberg?
  Växjö       Ansök senast 2026-11-30
Uppdragsbeskrivning
Är du ingenjör inom Maskin, Produktion, El-/elkraft, Automation, Embedded eller liknande och vill arbeta i en miljö där du får utvecklas, trivas och känna att ditt arbete gör skillnad?
Sigma Industry South i Växjö söker efter fler kompetenta kollegor. Som anställd hos oss blir du en del av ett team där gemenskap, engagemang och glädje är viktiga delar av vardagen. Vi tror på långsiktighet och vill att du ska trivas hos oss, länge.
Vi är stolta över att Sigma-koncernen år efter år rankas som en av Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare, och vi arbetar för att du ska känna samma stolthet.
Grundläggande kvalifikationer
Vi letar efter dig med högskole- eller universitetsutbildning eller besitter motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Vi har öppningar både för dig som är helt nyutexaminerad och för dig som har samlat på dig erfarenhet inom yrket.
Du är en nyfiken och engagerad person som trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa problem och leverera arbete med hög kvalitet. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du representerar Sigma Industry South på ett professionellt sätt ute hos våra kunder och har en flexibel inställning till olika typer av uppdrag. Vissa uppdrag sträcker sig över längre tid hos samma kund, medan andra erbjuder större variation och nya miljöer. Vår ambition är alltid att hitta uppdrag som passar dina styrkor, intressen och mål, samtidigt som de ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt.
Teknisk utbildning på högskole- eller civilingenjörsnivå
Genuint teknikintresse med ett öppet sinne och en social personlighet
Goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska krävs, i såväl tal som skrift.
Meriterande färdigheter, egenskaper och erfarenheter
Vi jobbar med kunder som ställer varierande säkerhetskrav så det kan bli aktuellt med någon form av bakgrundskontroll, drogtest eller visst medborgarskap.
Vi erbjuder
Hos oss handlar det inte bara om vad du arbetar med utan också om vilka du arbetar tillsammans med. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas i uppdrag hos några av Sveriges mest innovativa industriföretag, samtidigt som du blir en del av en stark gemenskap med engagerade och kunniga kollegor.
Vi tror på frihet under ansvar, korta beslutsvägar och ett entreprenöriellt driv där idéer uppmuntras och initiativ välkomnas. Genom samarbeten över bolagsgränserna inom Sigma och en mix av kunduppdrag, kompetensutveckling och sociala aktiviteter skapar vi en miljö där du får växa både som ingenjör och människa.
Känner du igen dig? Då tror vi att du kommer trivas hos oss.

As an ambitious graduate, you want to reach the top – that’s clear. But there are many challenges on the way. That’s why it’s incredibly important to identify your own strengths and weaknesses and know that you have the right partners at your side. That’s exactly what our Siemens Graduate Program is for. In two years and three different assignments, it offers everything you need to launch a successful career at Siemens. We’re looking for people who want to face the challenges of tomorrow. Do you think you have what it takes? Then we look forward to receiving your application.
24 months
Program duration – two years that will change your life
3 assignments
Each of 8 months – one of them abroad at one of our 190 locations globally
1 unique community
Your career network – with 100 active participants of 20 nationalities
The challenge: tough. The reward: huge.
There are some things you have to experience yourself to understand. That’s why we asked people who have been through the Siemens Graduate Program (SGP) to tell us about their experience. Find out what our successful participants have to say.
For me, the characteristics that are most prominent in successful SGP participants are ambition, drive, and ownership. Ambition pushes us to set high goals and fully leverage the learning opportunities provided by the program. Drive is the fuel that keeps participants actively engaged, persistent, and resilient in the face of challenges. The SGP is a self-driven program that requires participants to take ownership of their career development.Enzo, SGP Alum
The SGP has been a tremendous accelerator for my professional development. I've had the opportunity to experience various positions, work with diverse teams and managers, and explore different locations. The extensive training program and community with other trainees served as the perfect counterpart, enabling me to reflect on my experiences and grow not only professionally but also on a personal level.Liam, SGP Alum
The changing environment during the SGP makes me feel excited and invigorated. Each shift—whether it's a rotation to a new department, a novel project, or a change in team dynamics—presents fresh learning opportunities. These changes push me to adapt, develop new skills, and continually redefine my role as a professional. It's a process of ongoing discovery that keeps me engaged and motivated.Irene, SGP Participant
The incredible support and mentorship within this network have enabled me to take on challenging projects with confidence and grow in my role. The continuous learning environment promotes the sharing of knowledge and expertise, enabling me to stay ahead of industry trends and developments.João, SGP Participant
It is very humbling to see and meet people from so many different countries and cultures. I believe the exchange that happens when people come from diverse cultural backgrounds is enriching and enlightening. I met so many great people, experienced different work and leadership styles, and got to see many things from a new perspective.Shrija, SGP Alum
Upptäck vad du kan förvänta dig under din resa.
Growth
Our trainee program will equip you with all the fundamentals you need to succeed. In addition to developing your leadership skills, you’ll learn to communicate more effectively and perform with greater confidence.
Teamwork
You’ll be assigned a personal mentor from the start. You’ll also be involved in the day-to-day work of our project teams and assume responsibility for your tasks from then on.
Ambition
Together with your development manager, you design your individual program. Whatever your path looks like – you’ll build up deep knowledge, gain experience, and make contacts for the future.
What would your assignment look like? 
See an example. Abiola was a SGP participant at Siemens Mobility from 2020 to 2022. 
I was born and raised in Nigeria. After my bachelor’s degree in Akure, Nigeria, I obtained a master’s degree at the prestigious Technical University of Munich, Germany.
In my first assignment, my task was to create a Business Intelligence pipeline to understand the market and competition for a new Siemens business area. This required strategic thinking, strong communication skills, and the ability to create well-considered content. It was very exciting to know that I was part of a team working on future technology. Besides my assignment, I really enjoy participating in and organizing events for SGP participants.
My light-bulb moment during the SGP? Realising that I can leverage on such a huge ecosystem to do what I love in my career. Abiola, SGP Participant, Siemens Mobility since November 2020
Ready to start?
While talent and good starting conditions help, what really makes a difference is willpower and perseverance. The Siemens Graduate Program is no different. If you think you meet our requirements and want to accept the challenge, we’d be delighted to receive your application. 
Educational background
You have completed or are about to complete your master’s studies (or equivalent) with above-average grades in engineering, business or other related disciplines.
Work experience & ambition
You have gained work experience during your studies or between your bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Also, you demonstrate willingness to take responsibility at early career stages.
International mindset
You have gained profound intercultural experience by working or studying in a foreign cultural area – our requirement is at least four months abroad. Generally, you have a global perspective and a desire to work abroad.
Locations to start your journey
What makes the Siemens Graduate Program truly unique is our international community and our global setup.
Start your journey at one of our SGP locations - from Americas via Europe to Asia. 
See locations
What to expect from our interview process?
At the SGP team, we believe in a thorough and holistic assessment – for us but also for you. This is an important step in your career and we want to give you ample opportunity to understand if the program is the right choice for you. We, on the other hand, want to get to know you, your personality, experience and capabilities. The process has three major steps, with slight country variations, but they all follow the same flow and logic.
CV Screening
A careful review of your resume and supporting documents based on the criteria detailed in the qualification section above. If you meet our basic requirements, you will be invited to the next step.
Initial interview
This initial interview will either take place in person, telephone or live meeting or as a video interview. In some countries we will also invite to an psychometric assessment.
Assessment center
In the last step - the assessment center (virtual or onsite) we can get to know each other. SGP decision-makers will be present, so this is the time for you to show us in various modules that you want to make a difference.
Frequently asked questions
When will the SGP start? When should I apply? 
The individual start depends on your availability as well as the demand in the respective country. We recommend that you check vacancies on a quarterly basis. These will be published as soon as they are available. In principle, applications and recruitments are possible during the whole year.
What is the role of the mentor? 
The mentor plays an important role in making the program successful and a good and valuable experience for you. To support you personally and to develop your potential, the mentor offers regular touchpoints with the SGP Participant. Furthermore, the assignment planning is coordinated by the development manager taking into consideration the business demand and competencies that need to be established while the mentor shares personal expertise and experience by reflecting on opportunities and growth goals with you.
Is the assignment abroad mandatory?
In general, at least one assignment abroad is planned. Being a global company, the assignment abroad will prepare you for an important aspect of our culture. We will support you in selecting the best destination for your assignment abroad so you can get the most out of it. We try to ensure this also during the pandemic, but of course we need to adapt to the current requirements and the international travel restrictions.
What should I do if my selected country does not offer a position for the SGP?
If the SGP is not available in your selected country, or if there are no open positions, it is possible to apply in other countries. Please check the country requirements above and please note, you should only apply in a different country if this meets your career aspirations and you can get work authorization. You can also view your local careers page for other development programs or entry-level opportunities.
What is my employment status as a member of the SGP Program?
Being part of the Siemens Graduate Program means you’re a real Siemens employee with a regular permanent employment contract. The conditions of this contract depend on local requirements and regulations. It’s important to point out that the SGP is not an internship program.
Which areas will I be working in?
You’ll directly work within our divisions and experience different areas, such as product development and distribution, product management and marketing, manufacturing, project management or procurement and logistics. Ultimately these are decided by your interests and qualifications as well as our business requirements.
What are the career prospects at Siemens after such a program?

Sigma Industry South i Växjö söker efter fler kompetenta kollegor. Som anställd hos oss blir du en del av ett team där gemenskap, engagemang och glädje är viktiga delar av vardagen. Vi tror på långsiktighet och vill att du ska trivas hos oss, länge.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
The Role
Join Kyndryl as an A Consultant and become a catalyst for innovation and transformation. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs. 
As a trusted advisor, you'll forge strong relationships with our customers, gaining deep insights into their business objectives and long-term aspirations. Armed with this understanding, you'll provide expert guidance on how technology can be leveraged to propel them towards unprecedented success. From aligning processes to technology to developing and deploying bespoke solutions, you'll be the visionary architect behind their digital transformation journey. Your expertise in application development and deployment best practices will ensure seamless integration and optimized performance.
What you will do
Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
Own shift‑level triage for device migration failures (Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
Validate pre‑req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Automated Device Enrolment (ADE)  profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce “go/no‑go” criteria.
 Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re‑registration timing, end‑user reset/re‑provision coordination).
Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; priortize work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
 Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three‑shift model.
 Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Automated Device Enrolment (ADE) / Kandji/IRU / Jamf escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
Lead post‑migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.
In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.
Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.
Your Future at Kyndryl
As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Technical and Professional Expertise 
Minimum 7 years exp.
M365 tenant-to-tenant device migration experience, specifically macOS.
Strong hands-on experience with Jamf/Kandji, macOS provisioning, ADE, PSSO, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
Strong PowerShell and macOS scripting/automation skills.
Experience troubleshooting device enrollment and migration issues.
Experience with runbook-based 24x7 migration/factory operations, shift handovers, and documentation.
Strong stakeholder communication, troubleshooting, and ownership skills.
Preferred Technical and Professional Experience
Experience with profile/workstation migration tools such as Jamf, Kandji/IRU, or equivalent.
Knowledge of Conditional Access and Microsoft device security controls.
Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or SC-300.
Experience with global/remote user migrations.
Understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change management.
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred! 
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Uppdragsbeskrivning
Vill du arbeta praktiskt med test och verifiering av avancerade elektriska produkter för industriella applikationer?
Vi söker nu en testingenjör till ett spännande utvecklingsuppdrag hos ett teknikföretag i Helsingborg. Du kommer att arbeta nära produktutvecklingen med test och verifiering av elektriska och elektroniska produkter som används i krävande industriella miljöer.
Rollen passar dig som gillar att kombinera praktiskt laboratoriearbete, mätteknik, felsökning och analys.
Om rollen
Som testingenjör kommer du att planera, genomföra och dokumentera tester för att säkerställa att produkter uppfyller tekniska krav och fungerar under olika elektriska, mekaniska och miljömässiga förhållanden.
Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat innebära:
EMC-testning och felsökning
Vibrations- och mekaniska tester
Temperaturcykling samt klimat- och miljötester
Elektriska tester och verifiering
Framtagning och genomförande av testplaner och testfall
Uppbyggnad av testuppställningar och genomförande av mätningar
Analys av testresultat och identifiering av avvikelser
Felsökning tillsammans med utvecklingsingenjörer
Dokumentation och rapportering av testresultat
Koordinering och uppföljning av tester som genomförs hos externa testlaboratorier
Det här är en hands-on roll där du förväntas kunna arbeta självständigt med testutrustning och testuppställningar, men samtidigt ha ett nära samarbete med utvecklingsteamet.

God förståelse för elektriska system och elsäkerhet

Vem är du?
Du är praktiskt lagd, strukturerad och analytisk och tycker om att förstå varför en produkt beter sig som den gör.
Du är bekväm med att arbeta nära fysisk hårdvara och trivs med kombinationen av testning, felsökning och problemlösning. Eftersom arbetet innefattar elektrisk utrustning är ett säkerhetsmedvetet och metodiskt arbetssätt en självklarhet.
Du tar ansvar för dina tester från planering och uppkoppling till analys och dokumentation och kommunicerar resultaten tydligt till övriga i utvecklingsteamet.

Balans mellan arbete och privatliv

Vi rekryterar inte bara till ett specifikt uppdrag, utan till en långsiktig karriär där du får möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med några av regionens mest engagerade ingenjörer.

Test Engineer in Electronics and Power Electronics
  Helsingborg       Apply by 2026-11-20
Description
Do you want to work hands-on with testing and verification of advanced electrical products for industrial applications?
We are looking for a test engineer for an exciting development assignment at a technology company in Helsingborg. You will work closely with product development with testing and verification of electrical and electronic products used in demanding industrial environments.
The role is suitable for those who like to combine practical laboratory work, measurement technology, troubleshooting and analysis.
About the role
As a Test Engineer, you will plan, conduct and document tests to ensure that products meet technical requirements and operate under various electrical, mechanical and environmental conditions.
Your tasks may include:
EMC Testing and Troubleshooting
Vibration and mechanical tests
Temperature cycling and climate and environmental tests
Electrical Tests and Verification
Development and implementation of test plans and test cases
Construction of test setups and implementation of measurements
Analysis of test results and identification of deviations
Troubleshooting together with development engineers
Documentation and reporting of test results
Coordination and follow-up of tests carried out at external test laboratories
This is a hands-on role where you are expected to be able to work independently with test equipment and test setups, but at the same time have a close collaboration with the development team.
Basic qualifications
We are looking for someone who has:
Engineering education in electronics, electrical engineering, mechatronics or equivalent
Experience in testing, verifying or validating electrical or electronic equipment
Good understanding of electrical systems and electrical safety
Practical experience with electrical measuring equipment and test setups
Experience in troubleshooting electrical and electronic systems
Ability to analyze and document test results in a structured manner
Understanding of electrical products from traditional voltage levels up to higher voltages for industrial applications
Meritorious
We see it as extra interesting if you have experience of:
EMC Testing
Temperature and climate testing
Vibration and mechanical testing
Environmental testing
Power Electronics
Motor control or industrial automation
Three-phase system
Working with higher voltages and effects
External or accredited testing laboratories
Verification prior to certification or product release
Meritorious skills, characteristics and experience
Who are you?
You are practical, structured and analytical and enjoy understanding why a product behaves the way it does.
You are comfortable working in close proximity to physical hardware and thrive on the combination of testing, troubleshooting and problem solving. Since the work involves electrical equipment, a safety-conscious and methodical approach is a matter of course.
You take responsibility for your tests from planning and connection to analysis and documentation and communicate the results clearly to the rest of the development team.
What we offer
Why engineers choose Sigma Industry Evolution
We believe that the best solutions are created by people who thrive and develop.
With us you get:
Exciting assignments at leading technology companies
Opportunity to broaden your skills in several areas of technology
Skills development and exchange of experience with committed colleagues
Great freedom to influence your own career
A culture of entrepreneurship, care and community
Work-life balance
Many of our employees stay with us for a long time, something we are very proud of.
Sounds interesting?
We are not only recruiting for a specific assignment, but for a long-term career where you will have the opportunity to develop together with some of the region's most committed engineers.
Welcome to Sigma Industry Evolution. A change often starts with a conversation.

Finans Excellence-program
Finans Excellence-program
Välkommen till din startplattform för en karriär inom finans. Vi söker drivna och ambitiösa finansexperter som vill utvecklas i en dynamisk, internationell miljö. Är du en av dem? Gå med i vårt globala finansnätverk och börja forma din framtid redan idag.
Ansök nu
Du klättrar uppför berget
Om du vill överträffa dig själv måste du fokusera på det väsentliga: ett tydligt mål, rätt verktyg – och naturligtvis rätt människor vid din sida. Vårt Finance Excellence Program (FEP) delar din passion och erbjuder allt du behöver för en karriär som CFO. Vi söker de mest begåvade och ambitiösa finansexperterna som har det som krävs för att bli morgondagens finansdirektörer.
24
24 månader
Programvaraktighet - två år som kommer att förändra ditt liv
3
3 uppgifter
Varje period är 8 månader – en av dem genomförs utomlands på någon av våra 190 globala verksamhetsorter.
1
1 unik gemenskap
Ditt karriärnätverk — med 80 aktiva deltagare från 15 nationaliteter
Här är ett exempel på vad du kan förvänta dig
”Finance Excellence Program var en unik möjlighet för mig att interagera med C-level-chefer på sätt som jag aldrig hade kunnat föreställa mig innan jag började på Siemens. Det var mycket viktigt för mig att använda min Finance Excellence-resa som en lärplattform för att fördjupa min förståelse för Siemens samtidigt som jag utvecklade min kompetens.
Som projektledare stödde jag den internationella expansionen av en SaaS-plattform för workplace intelligence. Därefter anslöt jag till Corporate M&A-teamet och stöttade en avyttring på 950 miljoner euro, och avslutade min resa inom det centrala Controlling-teamet med ansvar för kvartalsrapporteringen till koncernens lednings- och tillsynsstyrelser.
Denna breda erfarenhet var avgörande för att förbereda mig för min slutroll som Finance Head inom affärsområdet Smart" Infrastructure.. 
- Yanis,2023
Upptäck vad du kan förvänta dig under din resa.
all
Tillväxt
Vårt traineeprogram kommer att utrusta dig med alla grunder du behöver för att lyckas. Förutom att utveckla dina ledarskapsförmågor lär du dig att kommunicera mer effektivt och prestera med större självförtroende.
all
Lagarbete
Det kommer att tilldelas dig en personlig mentor från början. Du kommer också att vara involverad i det dagliga arbetet i våra projektteam och ta ansvar för dina uppgifter från och med då.
all
Ambition
Tillsammans med din utvecklingschef utformar du ditt individuella program. Oavsett hur din väg ser ut - kommer du att din kunskap, få erfarenhet och skapa kontakter för framtiden.
Redo att börja? 
Inom sport hjälper talang och gynnsamma förutsättningar, men det som verkligen avgör är vilja och uthållighet. Finance Excellence Program (FEP) är inget undantag. Om du anser att du uppfyller våra krav och vill anta utmaningen ser vi fram emot din ansökan.
Stark akademisk meriter
Framgångsrikt genomförd MBA-examen eller doktorsexamen (PhD).
Utmärkt examen, masterexamen i finans/redovisning eller motsvarande kvalifikation inom ett finansinriktat utbildningsområde
En framgångsrik karriär
Fem till tio års yrkeserfarenhet inom en ekonomifunktion med fokus på digitalisering
Erfarenhet av att leda team och genomföra komplexa projekt, t.ex. i transformationssammanhang
Minst tolv månaders internationell arbetslivserfarenhet.
Engagemang
Utmärkta ledaregenskaper och förmåga att driva förändring.
SStarka analytiska färdigheter, inklusive uppföljning av prestation och finansiell modellering.
Affärsengelska på flytande nivå samt god kommunikativ förmåga.
Geografisk flexibilitet, både under och efter programmet.
Vad kan vi förvänta oss av vår ansökningsprocess?
Ansökningsprocessen för Finance Excellence Program är utformad för att ge dig gott om möjligheter att visa oss ditt bästa. Vi har förkortat processen till fyra steg. Detta gör att vi kan ge dig en optimal upplevelse som kvalificerad kandidat.
