Votre quotidien
Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques.
Au sein du Département Ingénierie Solutions Guerre Électronique (GE), vous intégrez l’équipe Support Industriel engagée dans un projet majeur de GE aéroportée. Basé à Elancourt, en lien étroit avec le site d’intégration avion de Mérignac, vous découvrez le domaine de l’ingénierie industrielle appliquée à l’avionnage. 
Votre mission est de participer activement au suivi et à l’amélioration du processus d’avionnage (Final Assembly Line – FAL) multi-sites. Vous contribuerez au prototypage et au déploiement d’outils de suivi, notamment pour les Arrêts d’Utilisation (AU) en production et pour la progression de l’intégration des équipements embarqués. 
Missions
Prototyper un outil de suivi des Arrêts d’Utilisation, puis le déployer 
Prototyper un outil de suivi de la progression de l’intégration des équipements embarqués, puis le déployer 
Analyser les données collectées pour identifier des pistes d’amélioration 
Collaborer avec les équipes multi-sites pour assurer la cohérence des suivis 
Proposer et documenter des optimisations du processus d’avionnage 
Votre profil 
Vous êtes curieux(se) et souhaitez-vous investir dans la gestion et l’amélioration de processus industriels complexes ? Vous avez une appétence pour l’analyse de données et le pilotage des processus ? 
Vous préparez un diplôme d’ingénieur, êtes à la recherche de votre stage de fin d'étude de 6 mois et vous avez déjà une expérience ou un intérêt marqué pour : 
L’ingénierie industrielle et le pilotage des processus 
L’analyse de métriques et de données de production 
Les outils bureautiques avancés (Excel, Access, PowerBI) 
Le travail en équipe et la gestion de projets multi-sites 
L’initiative, la rigueur, la capacité à travailler en équipe et la force de proposition sont des qualités reconnues chez vous ? 
Alors ce stage est fait pour vous !

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
Nos engagements, vos avantages
Notre savoir-faire technologique
Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
Votre quotidien
Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.
Vous rejoignez le département PDHT (Payload Data Handling & Transmission) au sein d’une équipe de 5 à 10 ingénieurs. Votre mission consiste à contribuer au développement et à la validation d’un simulateur innovant dédié à l’optimisation de la gestion des données embarquées sur les satellites d’observation de la Terre.
Développé en Python avec une interface graphique, cet outil permet de modéliser les processus d’acquisition, de traitement et de transmission des données afin d’identifier les points de limitation, d’évaluer les performances du système et de tester différentes architectures matérielles et logicielles.
À travers ce stage, vous participez à un projet stratégique pour les futures missions spatiales et contribuez à renforcer la compétitivité de Thales Alenia Space dans le cadre des appels d’offres internationaux.
Vos missions sont les suivantes :
Valider et intégrer le simulateur PDHT de bout en bout
Finaliser les campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux cas d'usage.
Identifier et corriger les anomalies afin de garantir la fiabilité de l'outil.
Développer et améliorer les fonctionnalités clés du simulateur
Optimiser les modules de propagation d'orbite, de simulation fonctionnelle et de bilan de liaison.
Développer une IHM paramétrable et des fonctions de génération automatique de rapports.
Automatiser les tests et la validation
Concevoir des scénarios de test représentatifs.
Développer et automatiser les tests unitaires, fonctionnels et de non-régression.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la solution
Rédiger la documentation utilisateur et technique.
Optimiser les performances du simulateur et proposer des axes d'amélioration.
Votre profil
Votre priorité est d'effectuer un stage de 6 mois ?
Vous avez l’ambition de perfectionner vos connaissances en développement logiciel ?
Vous êtes en dernière année d'école d’ingénieur ou équivalent à dominante informatique et génie logiciel ?
Vous avez de l'expérience en :
langage Python (maîtrise avancée)
développement logiciel
tests unitaires et fonctionnels (outils comme pytest, unittest)
Git pour la gestion de version et le travail collaboratif
analyse et compréhension d'un code existant pour le faire évoluer
ordonnancement de tâches logicielles
outils de visualisation de données (ex. : Matplotlib, Plotly)
rédaction d'une documentation technique claire
Rigueur, proactivité, pédagogie et curiosité  sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Le mot de l'équipe
« Rejoignez une équipe d’architectes systèmes où votre autonomie et votre créativité seront mises à l’honneur !
Nous comptons sur vous pour proposer des solutions techniques et les expliquer clairement à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance du secteur spatial n’est requise : en échange de votre expertise informatique, nous vous ferons découvrir un univers passionnant. Vous aurez l’opportunité de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant à un outil stratégique, dans un environnement où votre créativité et votre rigueur seront valorisées.»
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Location: Austin - Arboretum Plaza, United States of America
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.
This is for a hybrid role in Austin, TX.
Position Summary
We are looking for an experienced SRE - Site Reliability Engineer to work with our North American Team. Your responsibility will be to help design and build tools and infrastructure that we use to support our teams and our customers. These tools will have to scale with our growing platform and customer base, and will drive operational excellence for the company’s globally distributed network. The person taking this role will have input in decisions that will have a major impact on the infrastructure and how we serve our customers. As an SRE in the ICO organization, you will work with your team solving problems, supporting and optimizing the infrastructure programmatically. You will work with your team to improve the overall availability, reliability, performance, and security of the infrastructure under control.
Special Position Requirements
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday with on-call work over some weekends
Work Travel: Domestic and international travel will be required from time to time to meet with colleagues, attend conferences etc etc.
While we have some flexibility about our working locations it is important that we meet face to face from time to time to properly build relationships and get to know each other. Therefore you may be required to travel internationally up to 5 times a year for department conferences, team meetings or group working sessions. You will also be required to attend your registered Thales / Imperva office. A few times a week to work directly with colleagues.
Key Areas of Responsibilities
● Work with other teams across the company to build and deploy infrastructure that supports our platforms.
● Apply SRE core tenets of measurement (SLI/SLO/SLA), eliminate toil, and reliability modelling
● Establish metrics for data-driven decisions to increase availability, reliability, and velocity
● Build and maintain, and evolve SLO and SLI network/system/application baselines
● Assist with go/no go preplanning, verification/validation, and review of existing and new product/services
● Proactively analyse data and test the integrity of network/systems to ensure production applications and services are operating optimally
● Work with internal customers as needed to troubleshoot and resolve business affecting issues
● Participate in escalations, incident response, RCA’s, and postmortems
● Participate in 24x7 on-call rotation
Basic Qualifications
● At least 5 years of professional experience within a cloud/web/CDN scale infrastructure
● Experience with Python and Go. C/C++ a plus
● Expert knowledge of Linux systems, network programming and protocols TCP, UDP, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP
● Experience with BGP and Anycast routing is a plus
● Experience with DevOps principles and concepts such as Infrastructure as Code (Ansible/Saltstack), CI/CD (Gitlab, Jenkins, Git), monitoring 
and visualization (Prometheus, Grafana)
● Experience with big data technologies such as NoSQL/RDBMS, Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka
● Experience with containers and container management (Docker, Kubernetes)
● Experience analyzing and building data telemetry, modeling, pipelines, UI visualization
● Experience in developing software, troubleshooting, and monitoring large scale distributed systems
● Implement software engineering best practices/standards and software development life cycle
● Working knowledge and experience of Agile software development methodologies
● Outstanding collaboration and communication, and documentation skills with a proven ability to work cross-functionally
● BS/MS in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline or equivalent experience

 JOB DESCRIPTION
Location: Singapore, Singapore
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.
Responsibilities:
Elicit, analyses, specify, and manage system and software requirements across the lifecycle, following ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 (requirements engineering) and the INCOSE Guide to Writing Requirements (GtWR) — every requirement necessary, unambiguous, singular, feasible, and verifiable, and every requirement set complete, consistent, and able to be validated.
Maintain bidirectional traceability: stakeholder need → system requirement → architectural element → implementation → verification evidence. This is the artefact an auditor asks for, and it must exist as a living structure, not a retrofit.
Operate the requirements process within an ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 lifecycle-process frame (as codified in the INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook, 5th edition): stakeholder needs & requirements definition, system requirements definition, architecture definition, verification, validation, transition, operation.
Run a digital requirements engineering toolchain rather than documents-in-a-folder: requirements held in a managed repository with change control, baselines, and query-able trace links (e.g. Jama Connect, Polarion, DOORS or an equivalent the organisation standardises on.
Author and own verification & validation strategy: define acceptance criteria at requirement-authoring time (not after the fact), and map each requirement to its verification method — inspection, analysis, demonstration, or test.
Following Thales processes and practises and contribute to their improvement
Contribute production code across the stack — able to read, review, and where needed write both service-side and client-side code well enough to keep requirements honest against implementation reality.
Design and review APIs and service contracts as first-class interfaces (a system interface is a requirements artefact, not just a coding detail).
Work fluently with the platform's delivery mechanics: version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and the review gates that make changes auditable.
Translate abstract non-functional requirements (latency, availability, recoverability, security posture) into concrete, testable engineering targets and confirm they are met.
Architect and review solutions on cloud infrastructure with an emphasis on security, data residency, resilience, and cost — and record those decisions as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) with the trade-offs made explicit.
Design for the platform's operating constraints: identity and access, secrets management, encryption with organization-controlled keys, network segmentation, and infrastructure-as-code as the source of truth.
Own or contribute to non-functional architecture: availability and recovery targets, capacity and scaling models, and observability — and ensure they trace back to stated requirements rather than being asserted.
Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform-component decisions on evidence (supportability, licence terms, security maintenance status), not vendor narrative
Requirements:
Education
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related discipline
Essential Skills/Experience
Demonstrable experience across at least two of the three core stacks (systems/requirements engineering, full stack, cloud) at depth, with working competence in the third and a credible path to depth.
Requirements engineering competence evidenced by real artefacts: requirement specifications, trace matrices, verification plans — ideally under a recognized standard (INCOSE GtWR, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148).
Hands-on software engineering experience: has written and shipped production code, understands testing, CI/CD, and code review as engineering controls.
Cloud architecture experience on at least one major cloud, with security and resilience as design drivers rather than afterthoughts.
Fluency with traceability and evidence as a working practice — comfortable being asked "how do you know this requirement is met?" and having an answer that points to an artefact.
Clear technical writing. In a regulated context, the specification is the deliverable.
Demonstrated experience in working in a multi-cultural and multi-disciplinary environment.
Good communication skills.
Essential / Desirable Traits
Possess learning agility, flexibility and pro-activity
Comfortable with agile teamwork and user engagement
At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Vill du vara den som får våra system att fungera stabilt hos kund, från första installation till löpande drift?
På Icebound utvecklar vi digitala GIS-lösningar som ligger i framkant och gör skillnad för våra kunder. Nu söker vi en Leveranskonsult som vill vara med och se till att våra system kommer på plats och rullar stabilt, tillsammans med vårt engagerade team i Lycksele.
Om rollen
Som Leveranskonsult hos Icebound är du den som installerar, sätter upp och tar hand om AddSpatials system, både i vår egen driftmiljö och hos våra kunder. Du får arbeta brett och praktiskt med servrar, nätverk och behörigheter, och lär dig snabbt hur olika kunders tekniska miljöer ser ut.
Du planerar och genomför installationer och driftsättningar hos kund, både on-prem och i molnet, och hanterar nätverk, AD-integration och behörigheter i leveranserna. Hos kundens IT-avdelning är du kompetensstödet som beskriver behov, vägleder i tekniska val och ger rekommendationer, utan att äga eller drifta deras miljö. 
Internt håller du koll på våra egna servrar och molntjänster, felsöker när något krånglar och kommer med idéer på hur vi kan göra installationer smidigare. Du arbetar nära utvecklare, systemarkitekt och övrigt leveransteam, och dokumenterar det du gör så att hela teamet kan ta del av kunskapen.
Tjänsten är placerad i Lycksele.
Vi tror att du har
En utbildning inom IT, nätverk eller liknande, alternativt motsvarande kunskap genom erfarenhet. Du har jobbat några år med drift, support, servrar eller nätverk och känner dig hemma i Windows eller Linux. Har du arbetat med Azure, Active Directory eller med kunder inom skog, gruva, energi eller offentlig sektor ser vi det som ett plus, inget krav.
Som person kombinerar du tekniskt djup med praktiskt problemlösande. Du är självgående, strukturerad och noggrann med dokumentation, och du kan förklara tekniska lösningar så att både kollegor och kundens IT-avdelning förstår. Ärlighet, engagemang och ansvar är självklart för dig, och du talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska.
Vad vi erbjuder
Hos Icebound får du arbeta i en platt, snabbrörlig organisation där idéer får ta plats. Du får arbeta nära både kund och teknik, i ett sammanhang där dina insikter och din rådgivning spelar roll. Vi kombinerar teknik, hållbarhet och affär i en bransch där digitalisering skapar verklig nytta varje dag.
Frihet och flexibilitet – med kontor i Lycksele, Umeå, Rättvik och Lund samt möjlighet till hybridarbete
Engagerade kollegor med djup branschkunskap
Möjlighet att påverka både erbjudande och arbetssätt
En del av ett innovationsdrivet bolag med stabil grund – Icebound ingår i Addnode Group, noterade på Nasdaq Stockholm

Vi rekryterar löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag. Har du frågor om rollen? Hör av dig till Hanna Grahn på [email protected] eller ring 076-414 83 30.

Teknisk Supporthandläggare
Vill du arbeta med teknik och problemlösning i en roll där du gör skillnad för våra kunder varje dag? Är du serviceinriktad, nyfiken och har förmågan att omsätta tekniska utmaningar till konkreta lösningar? Då kan rollen som Teknisk supportshandläggare hos oss på Sokigo vara något för dig.
Vi söker nu en ny kollega till vår tekniska support, där du blir en del av ett engagerat team som hjälper kommuner över hela Sverige att få största möjliga nytta av våra produkter. Hos oss får du kombinera ditt tekniska intresse med kundkontakt och problemlösning i en verksamhet där kvalitet, samarbete och kundnöjdhet står i centrum.
Om rollen
Som Teknisk supporthandläggare arbetar du nära våra kunder och hjälper dem med frågor kring användning och felsökning av våra produkter. Du blir en del av ett team där vi delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och tillsammans arbetar för att skapa en riktigt bra kundupplevelse. Genom den dagliga dialogen med våra kunder får du också värdefulla insikter om deras behov och utmaningar, som bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra produkter och tjänster.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
Ge teknisk support och vägledning kring våra produkter.
Felsöka och analysera tekniska problem för att hitta effektiva och långsiktiga lösningar.
Hjälpa kunder att använda våra system på bästa sätt utifrån deras verksamhetsbehov.
Dokumentera och följa upp supportärenden för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveransen.
Samarbeta med kollegor inom support, utveckling och övriga delar av organisationen.
Bidra med kundinsikter och förbättringsförslag som utvecklar våra produkter och arbetssätt.
Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för teknik och som trivs i en roll där kundkontakt och problemlösning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du är nyfiken på hur system fungerar, har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya frågeställningar och motiveras av att hjälpa andra.
Du uppskattar att arbeta i ett team där kunskapsutbyte och samarbete är viktigt, samtidigt som du är trygg i att ta eget ansvar och driva dina ärenden framåt.
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:
Är serviceinriktad och kommunikativ med en god förmåga att förstå kundens behov.
Är analytisk och lösningsorienterad och trivs med att lösa tekniska utmaningar.
Arbetar strukturerat och noggrant med fokus på kvalitet och resultat.
Är pedagogisk och kan förklara tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt och begripligt sätt.
Är en lagspelare som gärna delar med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till teamets utveckling.
Kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som har:
Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning med inriktning mot GIS, Gaturummet eller VA, eller:
Arbetslivserfarenhet som bedöms som motsvarande
Ett stort tekniskt intresse och en god förmåga att sätta dig in i olika system och programvaror.
God kommunikativ förmåga och ett genuint intresse för kundservice.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.
Det är meriterande om du har:
Erfarenhet av GIS-baserade verksamhetssystem, exempelvis ArcGIS, GEOSECMA eller Gaida.
Erfarenhet från kommunal verksamhet inom Gaturummet eller VA.
Tidigare erfarenhet av teknisk support, systemförvaltning eller liknande kundnära arbete.
Om Sokigo
Sokigo är Sveriges största leverantör av systemlösningar för den kommunala marknaden. Vi är ett ambitiöst företag som brinner för långvariga relationer och att skapa lönsamhet för våra kunder. Som anställd hos oss får du kompetensutveckling, fast lön, pensionsförsäkring, friskvårdsbidrag och andra förmåner. Du får arbeta med över 250 trevliga och engagerade kollegor runt om i landet. Sokigo är en del av koncernen Addnode Group.
Vi är en del av det moderna och hållbara arbetslivet – Sokigo har en positiv inställning till möjligheten att arbeta hemifrån och strävar efter att hitta rätt balans utifrån respektive roll och person.
Bra att veta
Tjänsten är på heltid och vi tillämpar provanställning. Placeringsort är initialt Karlskrona, med möjlighet till placering i Malmö efter introduktionsperioden. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
För att skapa en rättvis och träffsäker rekryteringsprocess använder vi oss av personlighets- och kapacitetstester vid vårt urval. Som rutin genomför vi även bakgrundskontroll på tilltänkta kandidater. Arbetsprov kan förekomma.
Vill du veta mer?
Kontakta Tony Wilsson, Teamchef Support, på tony.wilsson@sokigo.com eller 0736-84 56 15.
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Job Description
Are you a recent graduate or about to graduate from university? Are you interested in helping organizations solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful change?
Accenture's Consulting graduate track is designed for graduates who want to build a career at the intersection of business transformation, industry expertise and technology. From day one, you'll work alongside experienced consultants on real client challenges, helping organizations improve how they operate, adapt to change and create lasting business value.
As part of the graduate track, you'll gain hands-on experience, continuous coaching and mentorship, and develop the consulting, analytical and leadership skills needed to thrive in a rapidly changing business environment. You'll also learn how organizations are applying AI, data and technology to improve decision-making, enhance performance and create new sources of value.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping organizations reinvent through strategy, consulting, technology and operations. We combine industry, functional and technology expertise to help clients turn ambition into measurable business outcomes.
Accenture offers graduate opportunities across Technology, AI & Data, Strategy and Consulting.
About the Consulting Graduate Track
The Consulting graduate track focuses on helping organizations translate business ambitions into practical action and sustainable business outcomes.
Depending on your team and project assignments, you may work on challenges with either an industry or functional focus, such as supply chain, finance, customer transformation, workforce transformation and AI-enabled enterprise transformation.
Consulting focuses primarily on helping organizations improve performance, redesign how work gets done and translate strategic ambitions into operational results.
Consulting helps organizations answer questions such as:
How can we improve performance and efficiency?
How can we create more value through better processes and operations?
How can we simplify and improve the way we work?
How can we adapt our organization to changing business needs?
How can we leverage AI, data and technology to enhance business performance?
What operating models, processes or capabilities are needed to achieve our ambitions?
How can we successfully implement change and realize business value?
Consulting Topics and Focus Areas
Depending on your team and area of specialization, you may work with topics such as:
Business Transformation
Process Excellence & Optimization
Supply Chain & Operations
Finance Transformation
Customer & Commercial Transformation
Workforce & Talent Transformation
Digital Core Transformation
AI-enabled Enterprise Transformation
Over time, you'll build broad consulting capabilities while developing deeper expertise in selected transformation areas.
What You Will Do
As part of project teams, you'll help clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
Examples of work may include:
Supporting business transformation programs
Analyzing challenges across people, processes, technology and data
Conducting stakeholder interviews, workshops and research
Identifying opportunities to improve performance and create value
Supporting organizational change and adoption initiatives
Helping redesign business processes and operating models
Defining and documenting business requirements
Applying data, analytics and AI-enabled approaches to support decision-making
Developing recommendations, business cases and presentations for client stakeholders
Helping turn recommendations into implementation roadmaps and action plans
You will work closely with experienced consulting teams while receiving ongoing coaching to support your development.
What's In It for You?
Joining the Consulting graduate track provides:
A dedicated consulting-focused graduate track
Early exposure to complex business challenges
Extensive training, coaching and mentorship
Opportunities to develop AI capabilities and understand how AI is reshaping business operations and decision-making
Exposure to senior stakeholders and high-impact transformation programs
Access to Accenture's global expertise and knowledge networks
A strong foundation for a long-term career in consulting and business transformation
Qualification
Who We Are Looking For
We're looking for curious, ambitious and analytically minded graduates who enjoy solving complex problems and working with others.
You:
Have a master's degree or will receive your degree before September 2027
Can start at Accenture in early autumn 2027
Have strong academic results in a relevant field
Are an analytical problem-solver with strong business acumen
Have an interest in consulting, transformation, operations or business development
Are curious about how organizations operate and create value
Are interested in how AI, data and technology are transforming business performance
Have strong written and verbal communication skills
Are collaborative, proactive and eager to learn
Are fluent in English and Swedish, both verbally and in writing
Relevant educational backgrounds may include Business & Economics, Industrial Engineering & Management, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Human Resources and related disciplines.
Office and Start Date
We are recruiting graduates to our offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö, with a start date in early autumn 2027. Depending on the assignment, work may take place from an Accenture office, a client location or remotely as part of multidisciplinary teams. Flexibility and mobility are therefore expected.
Application Process
Please submit:
CV including GPA on a five-grade scale
Cover Letter
University Transcripts/Grades
Please upload all documents under Upload Resume/CV.
Only complete applications will be reviewed.
In your cover letter, we would like to learn:
Why you are interested in Consulting
Which transformation topics interest you most
Relevant academic, professional, extracurricular or leadership experiences
Which office location you are applying to
The screening and selection process is conducted on an ongoing basis. 
Candidates progressing to the next stage will be invited to complete assessments designed to evaluate analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming the next generation of consulting professionals to Accenture.

We work with one shared purpose: to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Every day, more than 775,000 of us help our stakeholders continuously reinvent. Together, we drive positive change and deliver value to our clients, partners, shareholders, communities, and each other.
We believe that delivering value requires innovation, and innovation thrives in an inclusive and diverse environment. We actively foster a workplace free from bias, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is respected and empowered to do their best work.
At Accenture, we see well-being holistically, supporting our people’s physical, mental, and financial health. We also provide opportunities to keep skills relevant through certifications, learning, and diverse work experiences. We’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the World’s Best Workplaces™.

Business Developer OSS and BSS, Telco GTMS 
Job ID: 10586211 | Amazon Web Services, Inc.
Apply now
Description
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for a world class candidate to manage an elite portfolio of strategic AWS technology partners focused on the Operation support System (OSS) and Business Support System (BSS) applications within telecommunications segment. Your job will be to use these strategic partners to develop OSS and BSS applications on AWS infrastructure and platform and use the subject matter expertise to sell OSS and BSS within CSP market segments.
Key job responsibilities
• Work with multiple sales and technical teams within both AWS and global technology solution providers for OSS and BSS applications and solutions to define and execute joint technology, marketing and sales initiatives.
• Serve as a key member of the AWS Go to Market Solutions team focused on Telecommunications segment, to define and deliver the overall go-to-market strategy.
• Engage each technology solution provider’s field sales organizations, channels and end customers to create and drive revenue opportunities for AWS.
• Ensure that there is a strategic business development plan for target markets and ensure it's in line with the AWS strategic direction. This includes the creation of detailed account plans to track partner progress and achievement to goals.
• Set and manage revenue targets and work with your team, each partner and AWS sales organizations to achieve/exceed goals.
• Create and execute the team's business plan with key internal stakeholders (e.g. service teams, marketing, PR, legal, support, etc.).
• Identify joint customer segments and industry verticals to approach with a joint value proposition for using AWS. 
• Understand the technical/business requirements of each telco service provider’s Telco IT strategy and work closely with the internal AWS development team to guide the direction of our product offerings with individual technology solution providers.
• Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
• Manage complex negotiations and serve as a liaison to the legal group.
• Create and execute operational rigor including territory management, account management, segment plans, and business reviews (internal/external).
Basic Qualifications
- 7+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience
- 7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- 7+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience as a founder or executive focused on related segments, or as a practice leader or business unit owner
- Experience selling to Fortune 1000 or Global 2000 organizations

Business Intelligence Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery Tooling
Job ID: 10587820 | Amazon Data Services, Inc.
Apply now
Description
As a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE), you will drive data excellence, provide data reporting, visualizations, automations, and insights for the Data Center Capacity Delivery Team. Candidates will be customer obsessed in their pursuit of data clarity and reporting. Successful candidates have track records of partnering with cross functional teams to create data alignment and visibility of data to enable businesses to make optimal resourcing decisions.
We are looking for someone with a broad background of data automation, strong business acumen, who takes ownership of their work, and is focused on customer needs. The successful candidate will communicate crisply to management. They will have an ability to make data-driven conclusions and will be comfortable with ambiguity while working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. 
You’ll join a diverse team of project managers, construction managers, controls engineers, commissioning engineers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Key job responsibilities
* Design, implement and support an analytical data infrastructure
* Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self-service support for customers
* Work closely with business partners and recruiting to support ongoing efforts
* Build automated data solutions in QuickSight
* Deep dive data to understand and resolve discrepancies
* Communicate actions/recommendations to customers/stakeholders in both written and verbal formats
* Create reports highlighting key insights and trends
*Create source-of-truth datasets using SQL; you leverage scripting language i.e. Python to create automation and reduce manual processes
* Partner with Data Engineering to enhance data infrastructure, data availability, and broad access to customer insights
About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 
Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
- 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
- 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
- 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience
- 1+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Sr. Applied Scientist, Frontier AI Assets
Job ID: 10564138 | Amazon.com Services LLC
Apply now
Description
The Foundational AI (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning background, to build industry-leading Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) technology with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist with the FAI team, you will support the development of RL Gyms, assess their usefulness for the frontier model advancement and build techniques to advance the state of the art with LLMs. You will support the foundational model development in an applied research role. Your work will directly impact our customers in the form of products and services that make use of GenAI technology. You will leverage Amazon’s heterogeneous data sources and large-scale computing resources to accelerate advances in LLMs.
A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing experimental results from a model training run you kicked off the previous afternoon, analyzing metrics and refining your approach. By mid-morning, you are whiteboarding a new algorithmic design with engineering partners, working through system integration details. After lunch, you lead a science review where you present findings and gather feedback from peers. Later, you pair with a junior scientist to debug a data pipeline issue, turning it into a coaching moment. Your day wraps up drafting a section of a research paper capturing your team's latest results.
About the team
The FAI team has a mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers.
Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

Description
The Foundational AI Assets (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Senior Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning background, to build industry-leading Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) technology with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement novel machine learning and deep learning models to address scientifically complex problems, taking solutions from research through production deployment while maintaining high standards for code quality and system scalability.
- Drive the scientific agenda for your team by identifying new opportunities, proposing research initiatives, and securing alignment with technical leadership on strategic priorities.
- Evaluate and improve model performance using rigorous experimental methodologies, applying techniques such as feature engineering, hyperparameter optimization, and advanced neural network architectures (e.g., Transformers, CNNs) built with frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Mentor and coach scientists and engineers across the organization, conduct thorough code and design reviews, and contribute to the professional growth of your peers while raising the technical bar for the team.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing experiment results and refining a model architecture before joining a design review where you provide guidance on a colleague's approach to a new problem. After lunch, you dive into writing production-quality code for a critical component of your system, then shift to drafting a scientific document that outlines your team's next research direction. Throughout, you engage with engineers and scientists across teams, sharing your expertise and learning from theirs.
About the team
The FAI team has the mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers.

- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience

Why pursue an internship with Airbus?
We are the allies of your academic success.
In addition to getting a recognisable company on your CV, you get to learn alongside valued experts, recognized in their fields of expertise. An internship at Airbus helps to shape a brilliant career.
Nationwide opportunities
We have opportunities on our main sites in Toulouse, Marseille, Elancourt, Paris le Bourget, and many other sites, within Commercial Aircraft, Helicopters and Defence & Space.
An internship tailored to your needs
We have opportunities from 1 to 6 months in Production, Engineering, IT, Cyber, Procurement and Finance to Strategy, Customer Support, Marketing and Sales.
 Find my internship in France
Are you excited about interning at Airbus in France?
Airbus offers internship opportunities at different sites in France, each offering a unique experience:
Toulouse
From developing new aircraft models to implementing revolutionary technologies, Toulouse with its 35,000 employees working in many central functions - finance, marketing, engineering, customer services - is the Airbus headquarters. 
The FALs (Final Assembly Line) in Blagnac include the entire range of commercial airliners (A320, A330, A350 and A380 families) and aircraft painting.
In the south, the Space Systems teams are responsible for the design, development and production of satellites and space services, as well as certain activities of the Connected Intelligence and Air Power departments.
Marignane
You can immerse yourself in engineering applied to helicopters and other rotary-wing aircraft at Marignane. From design to maintenance, apprentices acquire invaluable skills on these exciting aircraft, which are at the heart of safety and personal assistance issues. 
Marignane is home to the headquarters of Airbus Helicopters. Nearly 9,000 employees at the site are involved in almost every aspect of the helicopter industry, and offer a broad view of the product range for civil, government, military, police and parapublic use aircraft.
Élancourt
Discover interns opportunities in the defence and space sectors near the French capital. 
Located in the south-west suburbs of Paris, the Elancourt site focuses on intelligence, secure and satellite communications, C4ISR, maritime and cyber security, as well as on-board space and defence electronics, all of which contribute to making Airbus the European leader in defence, space and security and the No. 1 defence supplier in France. 
Paris Le Bourget
Around 650 people work on the Paris-Le Bourget site in Dugny (next to Le Bourget airport, near Paris), within this Center of Excellence specializing in the production of rotor blades and research on materials composites. Interns on site have the unique opportunity to have access to all services, thus being able to quickly acquire knowledge about the division's activities and projects.
Manufacturing some 3,000 blades per year and repairing almost half of them, the site is an essential link in the Airbus helicopter production chain, whose ambition is to become the world reference in blades.
A smooth application process
Let’s get you on board
Easy online application
Applications are open from September to December for 4 to 6-month placements. 
For summer placements of 4 to 8 weeks, applications open in January. You can apply directly online.
A short round of interviews
After your application assessment, you get to demonstrate your motivation during a video interview that will be reviewed by a recruiter. Then, you will have an interview with your future manager. 
Fostering diversity
We keep inclusion at heart. If you are a French resident with a disability and need support, reach out to our team at: emploi.handicap@airbus.com
FAQs
We gathered the most frequently asked questions about internships in France to help you apply.
Am I eligible for an internship programme in Airbus France? 
You must be looking for an internship that lasts between 1 and 6 months, and be comfortable working in an international environment. 
In addition, you must be a French/EU citizen or have authorization to live and work in France with an appropriate Visa.
Finally, to qualify for an internship in France, you must be enrolled at a university that is willing to sign the French Airbus training agreement (i.e. Convention de Stage).
In what fields can I do an internship at Airbus?
Depending on your field of study, you can find an internship in Business Management and Development, Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, IT and Cyber, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials and Processes, Maths, Physics, Robotics and Supply Chain.
What benefits do interns in France get?
You can get financial compensation for your work depending on the duration of your internship. Bank holidays and days of leave are given, according to the length of your internship and the applicable law related to it.

At Airbus our people work with passion and determination to build and create incredible products – perhaps an aircraft you may already have flown on, or the satellites that help keep you connected! We look for people who have a passion for learning and want to work in an industry that is always looking to the future.
The highly technical nature of the aerospace industry has created a huge demand for skilled and qualified specialists in the UK. That is why, at Airbus, we have carefully designed our apprenticeship programmes to give you valuable practical training while you complete your studies.
Our programmes provide a clear route for you to make your career fly.
Applications for apprenticeships at Airbus Aircraft and Airbus Defence & Space are now open. Any closing dates are estimates; roles may close sooner, so please apply early to avoid disappointment.

Develop your future
Secure your future

Professional development and career growth
You won't just get a qualification; you'll get ongoing professional development and mentoring. We give you the tools to build your career growth from day one.

More than engineering and manufacturing
Pioneers in every role
It takes more than engineers to pioneer sustainable aerospace. Our business is built by a world-class team of apprentices in Facilities Management, Human Resources, Procurement, and Business Administration.
These roles are your launchpad to a secure, long-term career, and they are the best examples of our modern, flexible culture. Many of these apprenticeships offer:
Hybrid and flexible working: Get the autonomy you need to balance your studies and personal life.  
Incredible career growth: We're investing in your future, with clear paths for internal mobility and professional development.
A supportive culture: You'll be part of a friendly, inclusive team, giving you the space to belong and thrive.
 Apply now
Our sites
Find your future with us
We welcome apprentices across the UK, offering a wide range of experiences.
 Apply now
Belfast
At our site in Belfast our team of over 1,700 people are responsible for building the wings, part of the fuselage of the A220 and the engineering of part of the A350. Apprenticeships in Belfast are focused on the manufacturing of components and major assemblies of the A220. Find out more about Airbus in Belfast here.
Broughton (near Chester)
As our largest UK site, Broughton is our centre of excellence for wing production, offering extensive apprenticeship programmes. Here, you can get hands-on experience with Craft Apprenticeships, such as the Craft Plant Apprenticeship in Aerostructures, Aerosystems, Machining, and Surface Finishing, focusing on manufacturing and assembling the world's wings. Additionally, Degree Apprenticeships are available in areas such as business management, facilities management, and engineering, providing a comprehensive range of opportunities to join our team. Find out more about our Broughton site here.
Chippenham
At our Chippenham site, Airbus offers apprenticeship opportunities in Support Solutions Engineering, at Level 6.
Filton (Bristol)
Our Filton site is renowned as a hub for wings, fuel systems, and landing gear engineering. It offers a comprehensive range of apprenticeship programmes, including Craft Apprenticeships at Level 3, such as the Structures Test Craft Apprenticeship and the Craft Apprenticeship in Mechanical and Electrical, providing hands-on experience in critical areas. Additionally, Degree Apprenticeships are available in vital fields such as digital and technology solutions, supply chain and procurement, and a broad spectrum of engineering disciplines, enabling apprentices to contribute to critical aerospace projects.
Newcastle-upon-Tyne
Our Newcastle intelligence systems team offer a Degree Apprenticeship in geospatial data science. This opportunity allows individuals to gain expertise in a cutting-edge field while working towards their degree.
Newport
Newport is home to our cyber security business, offering apprenticeships that cover software and cybersecurity engineering, as well as data analytics. At our Newport site, apprentices will gain practical experience while simultaneously working towards their degree.
Portsmouth
Portsmouth is a key centre for engineering in space and intelligence systems. With our team in Portsmouth, you can complete a Degree or Technical Apprenticeship in fields such as systems and software engineering, project management, and electromechanical engineering. These opportunities offer a chance to contribute to advanced projects within the space industry.
Stevenage
Our Stevenage site provides a variety of apprenticeship programmes, covering fields across engineering and business administration, offering clear pathways into the aerospace industry. These opportunities are available across multiple qualification levels ranging from the Level 2 Panels Manufacturing Technician Craft Apprenticeship, to multiple degree apprenticeships.
Oxford & Shawbury
Our Oxford and Shawbury sites support out helicopter customers with their customisation, maintenance, and servicing needs. Apprentices at these work across all kinds of departments, from helicopter maintenance to human resources and administration.
A smooth application process
Let’s get you on board
Find your perfect match
Applications are open from October until February - you must apply online. Please note that applications may close earlier than expected - apply early to avoid disappointment.
Initial online assessment
You'll be invited to complete an online assessment - this helps us to understand you and check your suitability for the role you have applied for.
Interview or assessment centre
If you're selected for the next stage, you will be invited to participate online or in-person. Our programmes are assessed in various ways, so we'll send you specific instructions.
Offer
Offers will be extended by phone and by email, your offer may be conditional pending results of your qualifications. We will confirm conditional offers after results day.
Frequently asked questions
You might wonder
We've gathered the most common questions for you here.
 Other FAQ
Who is allowed to do an apprenticeship in the UK?
Should you be offered a role you will be  required to:
Provide evidence of your right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme;
Be subject to a background check in line with our security requirements;
Achieve the grades required (if not already achieved at the time of your application); and,
For apprenticeships in England, you must be eligible for apprenticeship levy funding.
Our apprenticeship roles do not meet the minimum requirements set by UK Visas & Immigration to enable sponsorship of migrant workers. You can review the available options to come to the UK on the Home Office website.
What are the entry requirements to do an apprenticeship?
Entry requirements vary depending on the specific programme you are applying for. Typically, for our Craft and Technician apprenticeships, you will need a minimum of five GCSEs at Grade 4 or C (or equivalent), which must include maths, English language, and a science. For our Degree apprenticeships, you will also need A-Levels or a BTEC (or equivalents). Please check the individual vacancy descriptions for the specific requirements for each role.
If you are currently working towards your qualifications please include your predicted grades on your application; if you are made an offer it will be conditional on achieving the required grades.
How do I apply, what does the process involve and what are the timelines?
All applications must be made through our careers website, applications are not accepted by any other method.
The process begins with an online application form where you can tell us about your skills and motivation. As guidance we expect that:

Job Information
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, building software, and finding innovative ways to improve quality across complex systems, we'd love to hear from you.
We're growing our engineering teams and recruiting Software Developers in Test (SDETs) at all experience levels to help deliver technology that supports mission-critical services.
As an SDET, you'll combine software engineering and quality engineering skills to build the tools, frameworks and automation capabilities that help teams deliver secure, resilient and reliable technology. You'll work closely with software engineers, architects, delivery teams and customers to ensure quality is designed into solutions from the very beginning of the development lifecycle.
Whether you're developing automated test frameworks, improving CI/CD pipelines, validating complex integrations, analysing system behaviour or creating tooling that helps teams move faster with confidence, you'll be helping deliver technology that genuinely matters.
With a background is in software engineering, automation, test engineering, DevOps, platform engineering or site reliability, you'll have opportunities to grow your career within a broad engineering community.
We don't see quality as something that's added at the end of development. We believe quality is engineered into products from the start.
Every engineering team wants to move quickly. The challenge is doing so without compromising trust, resilience or reliability. Our Software Developers in Test help teams achieve exactly that, building the automation, tooling and engineering practices that enable mission-critical services to evolve with confidence.
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Above all, we're looking for engineers who are naturally curious, enjoy solving difficult problems and are passionate about improving quality through software engineering.
Depending on your skills, interests and experience, you may:
Software Engineering
Develop resilient, maintainable and well-tested software that supports both products and quality engineering capabilities.
Design, build and maintain tools, frameworks and services that improve automation and delivery confidence.
Participate in peer reviews and contribute to engineering standards, best practices and continuous improvement.
Quality Engineering
Design and implement automated approaches that validate functionality, performance, reliability and resilience.
Help identify quality risks early and support teams in delivering trusted software solutions.
Investigate defects, analyse system behaviour and contribute to root-cause analysis activities.
Support testing activities across the software delivery lifecycle, from development through to release
Automation & Platform Engineering
Build and enhance CI/CD capabilities that enable reliable and repeatable software delivery.
Develop automation that improves efficiency, reduces manual effort and increases engineering confidence.
Contribute to test environments, infrastructure and supporting platforms used across engineering teams.
Collaboration & Growth
Work closely with software engineers, solution architects and operational stakeholders to solve complex technical challenges.
Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and help develop modern quality engineering practices.
Identify opportunities to improve ways of working and contribute to a culture of continuous learning.
No two careers in this space look identical, and that's part of what makes it interesting.
You might be a good fit if you're naturally curious about questions such as:
•    How do you build confidence into software before it reaches production? 
•    How can automation help engineering teams move faster without sacrificing quality? 
•    How do you prove that a mission-critical service is ready for the real world? 
•    What hidden risks exist inside complex technology environments? 
•    How do modern engineering teams balance quality, reliability and delivery speed? 
•    How can software engineering and quality engineering work together to improve outcomes? 
•    What does great quality engineering look like in the age of AI? 
•    How can I continue developing my technical skills while working on technology that genuinely matters?
You don't need to have all the answers already. We're looking for people with curiosity, enthusiasm, strong engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn
Essential Skills / Experience
We know great engineers don't always fit neatly into a checklist. If your experience aligns with many of the areas below, we'd encourage you to apply.
•    Experience developing software, automation, tooling or engineering solutions.
•    Understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices.
•    Experience working within Agile software delivery environments.
•    Ability to analyse complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.
•    Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes.
•    Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
•    Commitment to continuous learning and engineering excellence.
•    Ability to obtain and maintain UK Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance.
Desirable Skills / Experience
We're particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
•    Test automation and quality engineering.
•    Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD).
•    Performance, reliability or resilience engineering.
•    Platform engineering and developer tooling.
•    Cloud-native or distributed systems.
•    Infrastructure and environment automation.
•    Observability, monitoring and diagnostics.
•    Secure or highly assured technology environments.
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
•    A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
•    Competitive DV market aligned salaries
•    Tiered role based DV allowance
•    World-class training and development opportunities
•    10% on target bonus 
•    Equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
•    Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
•    BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
•    New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
•    Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
•    On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
•    Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
•    24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
•    Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
•    25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
•    2 weeks paid carer’s leave 
•    Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
•    Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary

Let’s get you on board
Apply online, it’s easy!
You will find all opportunities on our jobs board, find the one you are most interested in and apply by uploading your CV, a cover letter, and answering some questions.

You might wonder
FAQ
We gathered additional information regarding placements in the UK to help you apply.
 More FAQ
How long does a placement at Airbus last, and when do they start?
Our placements are designed to fit into the sandwich courses offered by most UK universities. The duration is usually between 12 and 13 months long, starting in the summer and concluding before your next academic year begins.
Who is eligible for Industry Placements?
You need to be enrolled as an undergraduate student within a relevant degree field, you must remain a student for the duration of the placement which is usually between 12 and 13 months.
When do applications open and close for placements at Airbus?
Applications open in September each year for start dates in July/August of the following year. Applications close when there are enough candidates, apply as early as possible to avoid disappointment.
What opportunities can an Industry Placement open for me?
Whether an Industry Placement with Airbus would be your first corporate job or your seventh, you’ll gain a year's experience in your chosen area with a multinational company. You will work closely with our teams to pioneer the future of aerospace, whether designing aircraft or supporting the business operations.
You’ll be able to use your experience to join our Airbus Global Graduate Programme after you graduate.
Can I use AI to help me in my application?
Using AI in applications has become common in recent years, before you start your application we recommend that you read our guidelines on use of AI for candidates.
Do I have to be an engineering student for a year in industry at Airbus?
Absolutely not! While we are famous for our aircraft, helicopters and space systems, some of our most critical placements are in our Finance, HR, Marketing and Procurement teams. These roles are the heart of our business and are the best place to experience our hybrid and flexible working culture.

Description
ADP is hiring a Sales Representative, Small Business Services.
Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways. 
Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success?
Are you looking to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.
In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.
Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment -- all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Sales at ADP, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales_Videos
What you'll do: Responsibilities
Grow Our Business While Growing Yours. You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans. You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family. In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life-long friendships here.
Collaborate Daily. You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications
Positive Self-Starter. You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone.
Agile Solution Seeker. You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast-paced change.
Continuous Learner. You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR
Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
Bonus points for these: Preferred Qualifications
Prior quota-carrying experience
Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.
What are you waiting for? Apply today!

Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels). An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.
Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses.   We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.
Why this job matters
Our Engineering mantra is “Technical Excellence in Engineering” and we deliver some amazing technical capabilities for our customers which can only happen if we recruit, train and support our people.
This is an exciting opportunity to join one of our software delivery teams, working alongside our customers and partners to work on key customer services. The team develop and maintain bespoke, highly complex, specialist capabilities that are critical to the success of our customers, who we work very closely with. We work across a wide variety of platforms and technology stacks and we utilise a range of programming languages.
What you’ll be doing
Delivers on the engineering strategy through delivery of high quality, and well-tested, software solutions, on time and on budget. Creatively applies a wide range of technical and/management principles.
Has defined authority and personal responsibility for the delivery of a broad range of complex technical work.
Works closely with customers to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
Influences customers and internal organization at a project level.
Performs technical coaching and mentoring, continuously developing and improving team knowledge and capability
Essential Skills
Experience in delivering software engineering projects
Experience in software development using at least one of the following languages: Python, C++, Objective–C, Java, C#, C.
Ability to take personal responsibility, autonomy and ownership
Required to hold and maintain Security (DV) clearance.
Required to work from our office locations, with occasional travel to customer sites. There is no option for home working.
Desirable Skills
Experience in additional software engineering technologies such as Javascript, MEAN stack, Jenkins, docker, git, Kubernetes, AWS.
Experience in agile project methods.
Our Package
Competitive salary
BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
Huge range of flexible benefits including cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan
World-class training and development opportunities
From January 2025, equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.​
Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.​
24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues​
2 weeks paid carer’s leave ​
World-class training and development opportunities​
Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes.
Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
#LI-Onsite 
Security is one of the fastest growing parts of our global organisation. We are protecting our networks from more than 6,500 cyber attacks each day, investing over £40m in research each year - and in employing nearly 3,000 people, we’re also the largest private cyber employer in the UK.  With incredible opportunities to learn, develop and grow your skills, we’ll invest in you, nurture your potential and shape your future – whatever your background or experience. 
In today’s world, safe and secure digital connections have never been more vital. You’ll be joining a global company operating at the forefront of the information age: BT employs 90,000 people in 180 countries. With huge scale, we’re capable of achieving great things, striving to be personal, simple, and brilliant for our customers whilst creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. Play your part. Make a difference. We are the Protectors.
A FEW POINTS TO NOTE:
Although these roles are listed as full-time, if you’re a job share partnership, work reduced hours, or any other way of working flexibly, please still get in touch.
We will also offer reasonable adjustments for the selection process if required, so please do not hesitate to inform us.
DON'T MEET EVERY SINGLE REQUIREMENT?
Studies have shown that women and people who are disabled, LGBTQ+, neurodiverse or from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification and criteria. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone can be their best, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement on the Job Description, please apply anyway - you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles in our wider team.

 UK Business
