 GBR Cheltenham TE, GBR Ipswich - Orion Building, GBR-London-BTHQ One Braham, GBR-Manchester-Deansgate
 Advertised Salary: 
 Competitive DV market aligned salaries
Job Information
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
About the role
If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems and building software that has real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you.
We're growing our engineering teams and recruiting Software Developers at all experience levels to help tackle some of the most interesting challenges in cyber security. Whether you're designing intuitive user interfaces, developing cloud-native applications, building scalable backend services, processing large volumes of data, or working close to the operating system, you'll be creating technology that protects critical systems and makes a genuine difference. 
You'll work closely with customers, stakeholders and experienced engineers to turn complex problems into elegant solutions, while helping shape the technology, architecture and direction of our products. Along the way, you'll have opportunities to learn new skills, deepen your expertise, and grow your career in a collaborative environment that values curiosity, innovation and continuous learning.
Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. 
What you’ll be doing
Above all, we're looking for engineers who are naturally curious, enjoy solving difficult problems, and are excited by the opportunity to work across multiple areas of software engineering. You don't need to tick every box. If you're passionate about technology, enjoy learning, and have experience in some of the technologies or disciplines we've described, we encourage you to apply. We're interested in people with strong fundamentals, an appetite for solving challenging problems, and the ambition to continually develop their skills. If you're equally excited by the prospect of building a polished user interface, designing backend services, analysing system performance, working with cloud-native platforms, or exploring how software works under the hood, you'll fit right in. 
Examples of what we expect from our developers include:
Software development 
Develop resilient, well tested code 
Perform code reviews & work with team members to ensure code quality standards are met
Keep up to date with the latest best practices 
Frontend Development
Create powerful, flexible user interfaces for a technical user base
Engage with end users to understand their needs and design user interfaces 
Backend Development
Ensure the platform meets performance, availability, and reliability SLAs 
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and risks in production environments.
Maintain and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks to detect and prevent incidents. 
Automation and Efficiency
Build and maintain tools to automate routine tasks, such as deployments, scaling, and failover. 
Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements for faster and more reliable software delivery. 
Team
Identify and contribute to the improvement of inefficient ways of working 
Actively contribute and engage in knowledge sharing activities
Essential Skills / Experience
If you have experience in one or more of these areas, we'd encourage you to apply:
•    Software Development, Programming or Scripting
•    Software Testing and Dev Ops
•    Using collaboration tools like Jira and Confluence
•    Source code management using Git-based platforms such as GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket
•    Experience working within Agile software development teams
•    Experience of test and infrastructure automation using associated frameworks 
Desirable Skills / Experience
We'd particularly love to hear from candidates interested in one or more of the following:
•    Mobile Development
•    Reverse engineering
•    Vulnerability research
•    Software security
•    Distributed and resilient data processing systems
•    High-performance computing
•    Operating systems and software internals
•    Designing accessible, efficient and intuitive user interfaces
•    Automation and platform engineering
•    Containerisation and cloud-native technologies
Programming Languages:
•    C, C++
•    C# or Java
•    JavaScript / TypeScript
•    Objective-C
•    Python
•    Scala
We're not looking for expertise in every language listed above. Strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to learn are more important than experience with any specific technology. If you've worked extensively with one or more of these languages and are excited to expand your skillset, we'd love to hear from you.
Platforms & Operating Systems:
•    Linux
•    Windows
•    macOS, iOS
•    Kubernetes
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
•    A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
•    Competitive DV market aligned salaries
•    Tiered role based DV allowance
•    World-class training and development opportunities
•    10% on target bonus 
•    Equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
•    Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
•    BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
•    New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
•    Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
•    On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
•    Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
•    24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
•    Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
•    25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
•    2 weeks paid carer’s leave 
•    Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
•    Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary

 Req ID: 
 62580
 Job Function: 
 Security
 Posting Start Date: 
 22/09/2026
 Posting End Date: 
 Division: 
 UK Business
 Job Location: 
 GBR-London-BTHQ One Braham, GBR-Manchester-New Bailey
 Advertised Salary: 
 Competitive with great benefits
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
Hiring Manager: Benedict Forster 
Career Grade: D
Internal Closing Date: 29th September 2026
Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels). An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.
Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses.   We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.
About the role
Our Engineering mantra is “Technical Excellence in Engineering” and we deliver some amazing technical capabilities for our customers which can only happen if we recruit, train and support our people.
This is an exciting opportunity to join one of our software delivery teams, working alongside our customers and partners to work on key customer services.
The team develop and maintain bespoke, highly complex, specialist capabilities that are critical to the success of our customers, who we work very closely with. We work across a wide variety of platforms and technology stacks and we utilise a range of programming languages.
This job role is based in Manchester. Onsite (Office based 5 days per week). Monday-Friday 37.5 hours per week. You will need to be eligible to obtain DV Security Clearance before starting this role. You will need to have lived in the UK for 10+ years to be eligible.
What you’ll be doing
Delivers on the engineering strategy through delivery of high quality, and well-tested, software solutions, on time and on budget.
Has defined authority and responsibility for a significant area of work covering technical responsibilities.
Works closely with customers to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
Establishes technical objectives, defines technical roadmaps and delegates responsibilities.
Influences a significant part of own organisation and influences customers/suppliers and industry at a senior management level (e.g. around resourcing of delivery teams and technical direction of work).
Line managing a team of software developers
Essential Skills / Experience
Agile development
Programming
Software testing
Application development
Software development lifecycle
Coaching and mentoring software developers
Line management and inspiring leadership
Desirable Skills / Experience
Evidence of creatively applying a wide range of technical and/management principles.
Performance of highly complex work activities covering technical, financial and quality aspects.
Object-oriented programming experience, and supporting technologies, including: C#, Python, C++, low-level mobile development (Objective-C, C++), elastic, ansible, docker, Jenkins, git, MEAN stack.
Our Package
When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.
•    A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
•    Competitive DV market aligned salaries
•    Tiered role based DV allowance of up to £5k per annum paid annually
•    World-class training and development opportunities
•    10% on target bonus 
•    Equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
•    Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
•    BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
•    New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
•    Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
•    On-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
•    Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
•    24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
•    Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
•    25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
•    2 weeks paid carer’s leave 
•    Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
•    Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary
Security is one of the fastest growing parts of our global organisation. We are protecting our networks from more than 6,500 cyber attacks each day, investing over £40m in research each year - and in employing nearly 3,000 people, we’re also the largest private cyber employer in the UK.  With incredible opportunities to learn, develop and grow your skills, we’ll invest in you, nurture your potential and shape your future – whatever your background or experience. 
In today’s world, safe and secure digital connections have never been more vital. You’ll be joining a global company operating at the forefront of the information age: BT employs 90,000 people in 180 countries. With huge scale, we’re capable of achieving great things, striving to be personal, simple, and brilliant for our customers whilst creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. Play your part. Make a difference. We are the Protectors.
A FEW POINTS TO NOTE:
Although these roles are listed as full-time, if you’re a job share partnership, work reduced hours, or any other way of working flexibly, please still get in touch.
We will also offer reasonable adjustments for the selection process if required, so please do not hesitate to inform us.
DON'T MEET EVERY SINGLE REQUIREMENT?
Studies have shown that women and people who are disabled, LGBTQ+, neurodiverse or from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification and criteria. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone can be their best, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement on the Job Description, please apply anyway - you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles in our wider team.

About the role
The role will lead on all Tax activities for countries Such as Uruguay, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Costa Rica and supporting Finance activities: monthly and annual closing, review of income, costs, and margin. Processing of Journals.
Co-defines and leads the tax strategy for the Americas, partnering with Regional Sales and Finance leadership to ensure alignment with business objectives while optimizing tax efficiency and compliance across jurisdictions.
Ensures full compliance and governance over all tax matters, maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, integrity, and timeliness in tax reporting, statutory filings, and regulatory obligations across the region.
Acts as a steward of BT Global’s tax position and risk management, safeguarding the organization through proactive identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax risks while supporting sustainable financial outcomes.
Drives collaboration and consistency in tax practices, serving as a key stakeholder across Country Finance teams in the Americas, global tax functions, business units, and shared service centers (GBS/GFSS) to promote standardization, innovation, and best practices.
What you’ll be doing
Supports the delivery of   a range of tax activities that are covered by existing guidelines in accordance with internal and external regulatory requirements, such as preparing and reviewing, supporting tax calculations and annual corporate tax returns, ensuring its accuracy and completeness upon submission and payment
Analyses and researches the complex tax implications of legislative changes or business decisions and activities and reflects these in tax returns and other tax-related documents as required by law and regulations.
Prepares transfer pricing supporting documents to comply with tax requirements
Supports the building of relationships with external tax authorities and advisers and assists independent auditors and the financial control team on tax and financial audits
Supports the identification and management of risk through regular assessment and diligent execution of controls and mitigations, raising any concerns as appropriate
Supports in the implementation of ways to improve working processes within area of responsibility and communication issues and areas for improvement to business unit/area managers such as through supporting resolution of any data issues impacting productivity or compliance
Keeps knowledge up to date on emerging trends and changes in tax principles and practices, sharing with team members
Supporting annual and monthly closing, take care of Revenue-Cost-Margin, Supporting on external audits.
Essential Skills / Experience
Skills & Experience:
A broad background in corporate tax, indirect tax, withholding tax. Local and international tax regulations. Tax compliance and statutory reporting.
Qualified accountant and Audit background with depth knowledge
Identify tax risk and opportunities
Soft Skills:
Leadership
Hight level of precision to ensure accuracy in tax calculations, filings and reports.
Strong ability to interpret complex tax regulations and financials data
Effective managements of multiple deadlines, strong planning and prioritization capabilities, works effectively with cross-functional temas.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Tax & Finance Control Experience
Experience working in a complex, matrix, commercial and international organisation
Setting and executing on tax and financial control strategy
At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running.  With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI.  If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

Job Description:
Die Faszination fürs Fliegen ist das, was unsere Mitarbeiter bei der Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH verbindet. Mit aktuell mehr als 570 Mitarbeitern am Standort Kassel/Calden davon 24 Auszubildenden in den Bereichen Industriemechanik, Zerspanung sowie Oberflächenbeschichtung, sind wir dabei, unsere Belegschaft von morgen aufzubauen.
Was ist schöner als fliegen? Es möglich zu machen!
Unsere Ausbildung teilt sich auf in einer Grundausbildung im Berufsbildungswerk Nordhessen in Kassel mit Präsenztagen bei uns, ab dem zweiten Lehrjahr wirst du am Standort in den Fachabteilungen Fertigung, Montage, Qualitätssicherung, Instandhaltung, Kundendienst, Prüfstände und technisch-logistische Betreuung eingesetzt. Dort erlangst du ein umfangreiches Wissen und Fähigkeiten für die Ausübung der Tätigkeit als Industriemechaniker (all genders). Da uns auch das soziale Miteinander sehr am Herzen liegt, gehören Veranstaltungen wie Familientage, gemeinsame Fachexkursionen und Messebesuche sowie Flugstunden mit einem Ultraleichtflugzeug fest zu unserem Terminplan.
Wir wachsen und bauen unser Team weiter auf. Bist du dabei? Hebe mit uns ab und verstärke uns als
Auszubildender zum Industriemechaniker – Fachrichtung Instandhaltung (all genders) 
Dein Arbeitsort Calden (Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH):
Die Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH mit Sitz in Kassel-Calden ist ein weltweit agierendes High-Tech-Unternehmen für die Entwicklung, Herstellung und Wartung luftfahrttechnischer Systeme, Komponenten und Präzisionsteile. Wir begeistern uns für hochwertige Technik und arbeiten mit Leidenschaft für Sicherheit und faszinierende Innovationen in der Luftfahrt. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Arbeit und teilen unsere Fachkenntnisse gepaart mit langjähriger Erfahrung für die gemeinsame Erfüllung zukunftsorientierter Spitzenleistungen. Wir sind der Ansprechpartner für internationale zivile sowie militärische Programme und Entwickler neuer Schlüsseltechnologien.
Deine Vorteile bei Airbus:
Spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben rund um die Getriebe- und Antriebskomponenten des Helicopters
Eine sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die von unseren Produkten begeistert sind
Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen nach Tarif der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Hessen
30 Tage Urlaub, 35 Stunden/Woche sowie Gleitzeit (außer im Schichtbetrieb) geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Job und Privatleben ideal mit einander zu vereinbaren
Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie interne und konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven für unseren gemeinsamen Blick in die Zukunft
Weitere Benefits wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Fahrradleasing, Airbus Aktien, Gesundheitsangebote sowie ein werkseigenes, bezuschusstes Betriebsrestaurant runden unser Angebot ab.
Deine zusätzlichen Vorteile in der Ausbildung:
Anfallende Parkkosten sowie Kosten aller Lehrmittel und Unterlagen übernehmen wir für dich
Nach der Ausbildung hast du die Aussicht auf einen sicheren und langfristig geplanten Arbeitsplatz
Du lernst in deiner Ausbildung bei uns…
…das Lesen und Handhaben von technischen Unterlagen
…das Herstellen und Instandhalten von Bauteilen und Baugruppen
…die fachgerechte Demontage und Montage gemäß technischen Zeichnungen und Spezifikationen, sowie die anschließende Prüfung ihrer Funktionen
…das Einrichten und Umrüstungen sowie das Programmieren von CNC-Werkzeugmaschinen
…Probleme und deren Ursachen in technischen Systemen zu erkennen und diese zu beheben
…die Verwendung von speziellen Werkzeugen und Geräten zur Montage und Instandhaltung
…das Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards gemäß Luftfahrtrichtlinien
…die Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten und die Pflege der Wartungsprotokolle
…diverse Rissprüfungsverfahren kennen
…hydraulisch-pneumatische Grundlagen
…und vieles mehr!
Es besteht die Möglichkeit zur internen Nachhilfe.
Das bringst du mit:
Du hast mindestens einen guten Haupt- bzw. mittleren Bildungsabschluss oder ein (Fach-)Abitur
Dein handwerkliches Geschick und dein Interesse an Technik zeichnen dich aus
Du besitzt ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen
Du bist mit den gängigen MS-Office Programmen vertraut
Als Teamplayer kann sich dein Team auf dich verlassen
Deine Arbeit verrichtest du zuverlässig und sorgfältig
Deine sehr guten Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens Grundkenntnisse in Englisch und die Bereitschaft, diese zu vertiefen runden dein Profil ab
Nach der Ausbildung hast du vielfältige Weitebildungsmöglichkeiten, z.B. als
Meister, Techniker oder Bachelor of Engineering (all genders)
Certifying Staff (all genders), also Prüfpersonal in der Luftfahrt
NDT-Prüfer (all genders), also Prüfer für zerstörungsfreie Werkstoffprüfung
Die reguläre Ausbildungsdauer beträgt 3,5 Jahre. Durch sehr gute Leistungen oder aufgrund entsprechender Schulbildung kann die vorzeitige Zulassung zur Abschlussprüfung bei der IHK nach 3 Jahren erfolgen.
Hinweise zur Bewerbung:
Wir möchten dich bitten, folgende Unterlagen im Bewerbungsportal hochzuladen:
Anschreiben,
Lebenslauf sowie
die letzten drei Schulzeugnisse sowie Praktikumsbeurteilungen soweit vorhanden

Job Description:
Die Faszination fürs Fliegen ist das, was unsere Mitarbeiter bei der Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH verbindet. Mit aktuell mehr als 570 Mitarbeitern am Standort Kassel/Calden davon 24 Auszubildenden in den Bereichen Industriemechanik, Zerspanung sowie Oberflächenbeschichtung, sind wir dabei, unsere Belegschaft von morgen aufzubauen.
Was ist schöner als fliegen? Es möglich zu machen!
Unsere Ausbildung teilt sich auf in einer Grundausbildung im Berufsbildungswerk Nordhessen in Kassel mit Präsenztagen bei uns. Ab dem zweiten Lehrjahr wirst du im 2-Schicht-System am Standort in den Fachabteilungen Fertigung, Montage, Messraum und Qualitätssicherung eingesetzt. Dort erlangst du ein umfangreiches Wissen und Fähigkeiten für die Ausübung der Tätigkeit als Zerspanungsmechaniker. Da uns auch das soziale Miteinander sehr am Herzen liegt, gehören Veranstaltungen wie Familientage, gemeinsame Fachexkursionen und Messebesuche sowie Flugstunden mit einem Ultraleichtflugzeug fest zu unserem Terminplan.
Wir wachsen und bauen unser Team weiter auf. Bist du dabei? Hebe mit uns ab und verstärke uns als
Auszubildender zum Zerspanungsmechaniker (all genders) 
Dein Arbeitsort in Calden (Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH):
Die Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH mit Sitz in Kassel-Calden ist ein weltweit agierendes High-Tech-Unternehmen für die Entwicklung, Herstellung und Wartung luftfahrttechnischer Systeme, Komponenten und Präzisionsteile. Wir begeistern uns für hochwertige Technik und arbeiten mit Leidenschaft für Sicherheit und faszinierende Innovationen in der Luftfahrt. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Arbeit und teilen unsere Fachkenntnisse gepaart mit langjähriger Erfahrung für die gemeinsame Erfüllung zukunftsorientierter Spitzenleistungen. Wir sind der Ansprechpartner für internationale zivile sowie militärische Programme und Entwickler neuer Schlüsseltechnologien.
Deine Vorteile bei Airbus:
Spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben rund um die Getriebe- und Antriebskomponenten des Helicopters
Eine sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die von unseren Produkten begeistert sind
Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen nach Tarif der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Hessen
30 Tage Urlaub, 35 Stunden/Woche sowie Gleitzeit (außer im Schichtbetrieb) geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Job und Privatleben ideal mit einander zu vereinbaren
Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie interne und konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven für unseren gemeinsamen Blick in die Zukunft
Weitere Benefits wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Fahrradleasing, Airbus Aktien, Gesundheitsangebote sowie ein werkseigenes, bezuschusstes Betriebsrestaurant runden unser Angebot ab.
Deine zusätzlichen Vorteile in der Ausbildung:
Anfallende Parkkosten sowie Kosten aller Lehrmittel und Unterlagen übernehmen wir für dich
Nach der Ausbildung hast du die Aussicht auf einen sicheren und langfristig geplanten Arbeitsplatz
Du lernst in deiner Ausbildung bei uns…
…das Lesen und Handhaben von technischen Unterlagen
…das Herstellen und Instandhalten von Bauteilen und Baugruppen
…das Einrichten und Umrüstungen sowie das Programmieren von CNC-Werkzeugmaschinen
…Probleme und deren Ursachen in technischen Systemen zu erkennen und diese zu beheben
…die Verwendung von speziellem Werkzeug zur Fertigung
…das Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards gemäß Luftfahrtrichtlinien
…die Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten und das Erstellen von Messprotokollen
…und vieles mehr!
Es besteht die Möglichkeit zur internen Nachhilfe.
Das bringst du mit:
Du hast mindestens einen guten Haupt- bzw. mittleren Bildungsabschluss oder ein (Fach-)Abitur
Dein handwerkliches Geschick und dein Interesse an Technik zeichnen dich aus
Du besitzt ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen
Du bist mit den gängigen MS-Office Programmen vertraut
Als Teamplayer kann sich dein Team auf dich verlassen
Deine Arbeit verrichtest du zuverlässig und sorgfältig
Deine sehr guten Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens Grundkenntnisse in Englisch und die Bereitschaft, diese zu vertiefen runden dein Profil ab
Nach der Ausbildung hast du vielfältige Weitebildungsmöglichkeiten, z.B. als
Meister, Techniker oder Bachelor of Engineering (all genders)
Certifying Staff (all genders), also Prüfpersonal in der Luftfahrt
NDT-Prüfer (all genders), also Prüfer für zerstörungsfreie Werkstoffprüfung
Programmierer (all genders)
Die reguläre Ausbildungsdauer beträgt 3,5 Jahre. Durch sehr gute Leistungen oder aufgrund entsprechender Schulbildung kann die vorzeitige Zulassung zur Abschlussprüfung bei der IHK nach 3 Jahren erfolgen.
Hinweise zur Bewerbung:
Wir möchten dich bitten, folgende Unterlagen im Bewerbungsportal hochzuladen:
Anschreiben,
Lebenslauf sowie
die letzten drei Schulzeugnisse sowie Praktikumsbeurteilungen soweit vorhanden

Heltid
Azets är en internationell koncern med 9 000 experter på över 200 kontor i åtta länder. Med vår kombination av lokal specialistkompetens och modern teknik stöttar vi över 100 000 kunder, i en kultur präglad av samarbete, innovation och ett starkt kundfokus. 
Vi söker nu en driven och affärsorienterad Sales Executive som vill vara med och skapa tillväxt genom att bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och vinna strategiskt viktiga affärer. Är du en erfaren säljare som trivs med att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter, bygga nätverk och arbeta mot större företag? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig. 
Om rollen
Som Sales Executive har du en central roll i att driva och utveckla nya affärer inom Azets tjänsteområden Accounting och Payroll. Du arbetar mot större företag med komplexa behov och ansvarar för hela säljprocessen, från första kontakt till signerat avtal.
Du blir en del av vårt engagerade säljteam bestående av sju personer och arbetar nära marknad, leveransorganisation och interna specialister för att skapa värde för både nya och befintliga kunder.
Vi söker dig som trivs med att själv skapa affärsmöjligheter genom nätverkande, prospektering och relationsbyggande. Rollen passar dig som motiveras av att driva större affärer med flera beslutsfattare och långa försäljningscykler.
Dina ansvarsområden 
Identifiera, utveckla och vinna nya affärer på den svenska och nordiska marknaden. 
Arbeta med konsultativ, värdebaserad och lösningsorienterad försäljning. 
Bygga och utveckla relationer med beslutsfattare såsom VD, CFO och andra nyckelpersoner. 
Driva hela försäljningsprocessen från prospektering och behovsanalys till förhandling och avtal. 
Arbeta med både inkommande leads och proaktiv nykundsbearbetning. 
Aktivt skapa nya affärsmöjligheter genom nätverk, marknadsevent, kundmöten och andra affärsdrivande aktiviteter. 
Samarbeta med marknadsavdelningen kring kampanjer, leadsgenerering och affärsutvecklande initiativ. 
Delta i kundevent, seminarier och branschaktiviteter för att stärka Azets marknadsposition. 
Arbeta strukturerat i Salesforce CRM och följa upp aktiviteter och resultat mot uppsatta mål och KPI:er.
Vi söker dig som har
Flera års erfarenhet av komplex B2B-försäljning, gärna 8-10 år eller mer.
Erfarenhet av att självständigt driva affärer från första kontakt till avslut.
Erfarenhet av försäljning mot större företag och koncerner.
Förmåga att bygga förtroende hos beslutsfattare på ledningsnivå.
God förståelse för redovisning, ekonomiska processer, payroll eller andra affärskritiska tjänster.
Erfarenhet från outsourcingbranschen eller försäljning av långsiktiga tjänstelösningar är meriterande.
Dokumenterad erfarenhet av nykundsbearbetning, outbound-försäljning och nätverksbaserad försäljning.
Erfarenhet av Salesforce eller liknande CRM-system.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
Meriterande om du har arbetat enligt etablerade försäljningsmetoder som SPIN Selling eller Challenger Sales.
Vem är du?
Du är en affärsdriven, självgående och resultatorienterad person som trivs med att skapa nya möjligheter. Du har en naturlig förmåga att bygga relationer och känner dig bekväm i dialogen med företagsledare och ekonomichefer.
För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara nyfiken, uthållig och proaktiv. Du tar ansvar för din egen pipeline, arbetar strukturerat och motiveras av att vinna större affärer som gör verklig skillnad för kunden.
Det här erbjuder vi dig
En nyckelroll i ett internationellt bolag med stark tillväxtagenda.
Möjlighet att arbeta med några av marknadens mest attraktiva tjänsteerbjudanden inom Accounting och Payroll.
Ett erfaret och engagerat säljteam med hög kompetens och stark laganda.
Nära samarbete med marknad, specialister och leveransorganisation.
En dynamisk arbetsmiljö där innovation, utveckling och kundfokus står i centrum.
Goda möjligheter till professionell och personlig utveckling.
Hybridarbete och flexibla arbetsformer.
Marknadsmässiga förmåner inom pension, försäkring och hälsa.
Bli en del av Amazing Azets!
På Azets strävar vi efter att vara förstahandsvalet för både kunder och medarbetare. Vi tror på kraften i samarbete, entreprenörskap och långsiktiga relationer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och vara med och skapa framtidens affärslösningar.
Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! 
Vid frågor om tjänsten, hör av dig till Sandi Malki, sandi.malki@azets.com

AXIELL GROUP AB 
JUNIOR ACCOUNT MANAGER
Ben jij enthousiast om je carrière in sales te starten en jezelf te ontwikkelen tot een succesvolle Accountmanager? Houd je ervan relaties op te bouwen, meer te leren over technologie en samen te werken met organisaties die cultuur en geschiedenis bewaren? Dan horen we graag van je!  
Over Axiell  
Axiell levert toonaangevende softwareoplossingen voor musea, archieven, bibliotheken en andere erfgoedinstellingen. Onze platforms helpen instellingen bij het beheren, behouden en delen van waardevolle collecties.  
De Functie  
Voor ons Nederlandse team zoeken wij een Junior Sales medewerker met de ambitie om door te groeien naar een volwaardige sales rol. Je werkt nauw samen met het Nederlandse commerciële team bestaande uit accountmanagement en professional services. Je begint met het ondersteunen van het commerciële team en bouwt gaandeweg mee aan klantcontact van eerste telefonische of Teams-gesprekken tot uiteindelijk het zelfstandig begeleiden van salestrajecten. Daarnaast bestaat ongeveer  25% van je tijd uit administratieve en operationele werkzaamheden, waaronder CRM-beheer, salesadministratie, rapportages en kantoorcoördinatie.  
Wat ga je doen?  
Ondersteunen van het salesteam met offertes, voorstellen en klantcommunicatie  
Eerste aanspreekpunt voor binnenkomende leads en vragen (telefonisch, e-mail, Teams) 
Meedraaien in klantgesprekken, met als doel dit zelfstandig te gaan doen

Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change?
We have an exciting opportunity where you can be part of defining the next generation of aircraft!
In Aircraft Aerodynamics, we master the complex aerodynamics of our aircraft to understand how they perform across the entire envelope of their missions. Through the generation and analysis of aerodynamic data, our work has a direct impact on aircraft operations, safety and fuel burn, meaning we play a pivotal role in securing the sustainable aviation of the future.
We are looking for a highly motivated Aerodynamic Icing Engineer, to join our team as we grow to prepare for the next generation of Airbus aircraft!
With primary stakeholders in Future Projects and R&D departments, you will be contributing directly to the development of our future aircraft programmes.  
HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM
State of the art computer modelling and simulation of aerodynamic icing accretion and its effects on aircraft performance, handling qualities and safety
Participating and steering the aerodynamic icing certification of future aircraft, and using data- and engineering-driven methods for influencing future icing certification requirements
Defining, attending and analysing results of wind tunnel tests at world leading facilities across the globe
Defining, attending and analysing results of flight tests, including steering flight test decisions in real-time based on live telemetry data 
ABOUT YOU
Knowledge of aerodynamics, including the factors that influence the generation of aircraft lift and drag
The ability to communicate complex messages simply and adapt those messages to your audience
The ability to lead other team members technically or subcontractors operationally on a given project in an international environment
Experience in Python coding (or similar) for data analysis
Additionally, any of the below would be of benefit for this role:
Knowledge of aerodynamic icing phenomena, the conditions and factors that influence this, its effect on the aircraft performance, handling qualities, and safety, and the associated certification requirements
Knowledge or experience of aircraft flight operations and performance, for example the factors that influence take off and landing performance, aerodynamic safety limitations, and the flight phases of a commercial aircraft. 
Knowledge of CS-25 or FAR25 icing certification standards
A solid understanding or practical experience of modelling the aerodynamics of 2D or 3D geometries in CFD, including the suitability and effect of different mesh types and turbulence models, the appropriate use of time-averaged modelling, convergence criteria, and interpreting results
A solid understanding or practical experience of planning, supporting and analysing wind tunnel tests and/or flight tests, including the measurement techniques, practical limitations, and common aerodynamic considerations and corrections 
Aerodynamics has a wide and varied exposure to the full Airbus Commercial product range, with many opportunities to get hands-on testing and aircraft experience. This is an exciting time to be part of Airbus, as we fly towards the next generation of sustainable aviation.
Come and join us pioneering sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world!
Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions.
HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU
Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request. 
Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments for the selection process – you can share this with your Talent Acquisition Partner if you are invited to interview. Examples may include (but not exclusive to) accessible facilities; auxiliary aids; room layout, etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Description
ADP is hiring a Sales Representative, Human Resources Outsourcing (HRO).
Are you ready for your next best job where you can elevate your financial future?
Are you looking to grow your career with a formal career path at an established, respected, global leader?
Do you want to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?
If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.
In this role, you will close sales and win new business within a defined territory. You'll attend our award-winning training program and join a sales team that works with both new and existing clients to sell human resources solutions, making employees' lives better with high-quality benefits offerings across the hire-to-retire spectrum. Daily, you will cultivate relationships with Human Resources and executive decision-makers, set appointments, gather leads from established internal partners, and assess buyer needs to present the best ADP solutions.
You will use your ability to manage multiple sales processes at the same time through various stages in the sales process, as well as document them, sticking with the process through implementation until your new business is up and running on the solutions you sell. As you see more and more deals cross the finish line, you'll reap the rewards with industry-leading compensation, benefits, luxurious incentive trips, and awards. As you strive to grow your career, leaders will back your desire to pursue advancement and provide continual sales training.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Sales at ADP, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales_Videos
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities
Grow Our Business While Growing Yours: You will work within a defined, protected territory to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals by implementing a top-down sales strategy. 
Turn Prospects into Loyal and Referring Clients: You will close sales by recommending the right solutions to help our clients understand and solve their real business needs. Plus, you'll earn referral business by networking with existing and soon-to-be clients and forging partnerships in-person and over the phone with decision-makers.
Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family: In addition to cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cross-sell with other ADP associates to cultivate additional business within existing accounts; you will make life-long friendships here.
Collaborate Daily. You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE: Required Qualifications 
Positive Self-Starter. You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection. You can manage your time well, prioritize deliverables, and multi-task with the best of them. In addition, you can present your ideas in a clear, professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone. 
Strategic Closer. You have an established network and experience carrying a quota in outside business-to-business sales. You have an impressive track record of closing sales, winning clients, and managing a territory and relationships. 
Proven Winner. You have an ambitious spirit and thrive under pressure, motivating you to not only hit sales quotas but exceed them.
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. If you don't have a college degree, other acceptable experience could include:
Three years of business-to-business sales experience (preferably field sales) within a results-driven environment.
Military experience -- We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
Bonus points for these: Preferred Qualifications
Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn. Ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities for even the most insatiable learner.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impactupon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

Emergency Call Handler
 Blackburn
 Careium UK
 Apply before: 2026-11-06
Location: Blackburn, Lancashire
Salary: £26,200 per annum
Looking for a job that actually makes a difference?
As an Emergency Call Handler at Careium UK, you'll play an important role in helping vulnerable and elderly people stay safe and independent. Whether you're responding to an emergency alarm or making a welfare call, you'll be providing support, reassurance, and practical help when it matters most.
Some jobs are just jobs.
This isn't one of them.
Every day, our team helps thousands of people stay safe, independent, and confident in their own homes. Whether you're responding to an emergency alarm, arranging support for a client, or making a welfare call to check someone is okay, you'll play a vital role in supporting people when they need it most.
Why Join Careium?
At Careium UK, you'll be joining one of Europe's leading telecare providers, supporting more than 250,000 clients across the UK. We help vulnerable and elderly people maintain their independence through innovative telecare solutions and our dedicated 24/7 Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC).
But what really makes Careium different is our people.
You'll be part of a supportive team that genuinely cares about the work we do and the people we support. Every day brings the opportunity to make a positive difference to someone's life whilst developing your own skills and building a rewarding career.
From our Blackburn-based ARC, you'll receive full training, ongoing support, and opportunities to grow within a business committed to helping people live safer, more independent lives.
About the Role
We're looking for compassionate, resilient, and customer-focused people to join our Emergency Call Handling Team in Blackburn.
This is far more than a traditional call centre role. You'll be supporting real people, often during some of their most vulnerable moments. You'll need to be calm under pressure, a great listener, and able to make decisions confidently and professionally.
Full training will be provided, so previous telecare experience isn't essential. What matters most is your ability to communicate effectively, show empathy, and genuinely care about helping others.
What You'll Be Doing
Responding to Emergency Calls
Receiving and managing incoming emergency alarm activations and support calls.
Assessing situations quickly and calmly to determine the most appropriate response.
Contacting next of kin, emergency services, healthcare professionals, or support networks when required.
Providing reassurance and support to clients during difficult or distressing situations.
Making Outbound Welfare Calls
Proactively contacting clients to check on their wellbeing and safety.
Carrying out welfare and wellbeing calls where concerns have been identified.
Providing reassurance and escalating concerns where further support may be required.
Helping ensure vulnerable clients remain safe, supported, and connected.
Supporting Our Clients
Delivering an outstanding customer experience during every interaction.
Helping customers with basic troubleshooting of telecare equipment and devices.
Signposting queries to other departments where appropriate.
Building positive relationships with clients, families, carers, and partner organisations.
Monitoring Telecare Systems
Monitoring alarm and monitoring system notifications.
Responding to equipment, power, or battery-related alerts.
Taking appropriate action to ensure service continuity and client safety.
Maintaining Accurate Records
Recording call details accurately using company systems.
Ensuring client information is updated and maintained correctly.
Following company procedures and regulatory requirements at all times.
Working Pattern
Average 37.5 hours per week.
You'll work a variety of shifts between 6:00am and 11:00pm, Monday to Sunday, on a rolling 6 to 8-week rota. As part of the rota, you'll work every other weekend.
We do ask for some flexibility from time to time, as shift patterns may occasionally change to meet the needs of the service.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for people who genuinely enjoy helping others and can remain calm under pressure.
You'll ideally have:
Excellent communication and listening skills.
A caring, professional, and empathetic approach.
Confidence using computers and multiple systems.
Strong attention to detail and accurate record-keeping skills.
The ability to multitask and make decisions confidently.
A flexible and adaptable approach to work.
A positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Experience within customer service, care, healthcare, emergency response, hospitality, retail, contact centres, or similar people-focused environments would be beneficial but is not essential.
What You'll Get in Return
Flexible working opportunities
Annual leave that increases with length of service
Cash Health Care Plan, including dental and optical benefits
Life Assurance worth three times your annual salary
Pension contributions of up to 6%
Free on-site parking
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
Career progression within a growing organisation
The opportunity to do meaningful work that genuinely matters
Join Our Team
If you're the sort of person who stays calm in a crisis, enjoys helping others, and wants a role with real purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

The Professional Services Team is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support the planning, execution, and governance of customer implementation projects within our Professional Services organization and successful delivery of Basware software solutions and services for our global customers. This role supports Project Managers (PMs), Solution Consultants, Architects, and cross-functional teams in ensuring predictable delivery of B2B SaaS implementation projects.

In this capacity, you will help maintain project health, streamline communication, and uphold delivery discipline aligned with our Professional Services methodology
*Flexible shift timings*
Key Responsibilities
Assist Project Managers in executing end-to-end SaaS implementation projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and delivery methodology
Create and maintain detailed project schedules, calendars, action item lists, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and project documentation

Maintain accurate project data in project management systems (e.g., Jira, Salesforce, MS Project, Kantata)
Prepare weekly project status reports, dashboards, metrics (milestones, effort consumption, resource utilization).

Make a Difference Every Day
At Careium, we help people live safely, independently and with greater confidence in their own homes. By combining smart technology with compassionate support, we provide peace of mind to thousands of people across the UK.
We're looking for a reliable, customer-focused Telecare Field Technician to join our team in the Gloucestershire area. This is a rewarding role where you'll use your technical skills and people skills to support vulnerable adults and help make a real difference in their daily lives.
If you enjoy working independently, solving problems and helping others, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Role
As a Telecare Field Technician, you'll be responsible for installing, maintaining, repairing and replacing telecare equipment in customers' homes and supported living environments.
This is a field-based role involving regular travel throughout the local area and lone working. You'll work Monday to Friday, with additional on-call duties during evenings, weekends and bank holidays on a rotating basis.
What You'll Be Doing
Installing, servicing, repairing and replacing telecare equipment.
Travelling to customer locations across Gloucestershire and surrounding areas.
Providing clear, friendly guidance on how equipment works.
Supporting customers professionally and compassionately, particularly in vulnerable situations.
Diagnosing basic technical faults and resolving issues where possible.
Ensuring accurate completion of service records and documentation using company systems.
Following safeguarding, health and safety, data protection and lone-working procedures.
Participating in the on-call rota to support customers outside normal working hours.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who is dependable, practical and committed to delivering excellent customer service.
You'll ideally have:
A caring, patient and professional approach.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Confidence working independently in a field-based role.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Basic IT skills and experience using mobile devices or computer systems.
Flexibility to participate in an evening and weekend on-call rota.
A full UK driving licence.
The ability to pass an Enhanced DBS check.
A company vehicle, tools and equipment will be provided.
Desirable Experience
While not essential, applications are welcomed from individuals with experience in:
Telecare, healthcare technology or assistive technology.
Field service, installation or maintenance roles.
Emergency response or community-based support services.
Working with older or vulnerable adults.
Safeguarding and lone-working environments.
Full training will be provided for the right candidate.
What We Offer
Competitive salary.
Company vehicle.
On-call payments and enhanced rates where applicable.
Comprehensive training and ongoing development.
Employee assistance and wellbeing support.
Opportunities for career progression.
The chance to work for an organisation that genuinely changes lives.
Why Join Careium?
Every day, our colleagues help people remain safe, connected and independent. Whether you're installing equipment, resolving a technical issue or reassuring a customer, you'll play an important role in supporting those who need us most.
At Careium, we don't just provide technology. We provide confidence, reassurance and peace of mind.
Equality, Safeguarding & Compliance
Careium is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and will provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and employment in line with the Equality Act 2010.
This role is subject to an Enhanced DBS check due to working with vulnerable adults.
In line with UK immigration legislation, successful applicants must provide valid Right to Work documentation on their first day of employment.
Careium is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults at risk, and all colleagues are expected to share this commitment.
Apply Today
If you're looking for a role where you can combine practical skills with meaningful work that has a genuine impact on people's lives, we'd love to hear from you. Join Careium and help us support independence when it matters most.

We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. Careium | Telecare Field Technician
Telecare Field Technician
Carlisle / Eden
Cumbria and Surrounding Areas
£26,227.00 + Company Vehicle + On-Call Allowance
Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm, plus evening and weekend on-call rota
Make a Difference Every Day
At Careium, we help people live safely, independently and with greater confidence in their own homes. By combining smart technology with compassionate support, we provide peace of mind to thousands of people across the UK.
We're looking for a reliable, customer-focused Telecare Field Technician to join our team in the Cumbria area. This is a rewarding role where you'll use your technical skills and people skills to support vulnerable adults and help make a real difference in their daily lives.
If you enjoy working independently, solving problems and helping others, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Role
As a Telecare Field Technician, you'll be responsible for installing, maintaining, repairing and replacing telecare equipment in customers' homes and supported living environments.
This is a field-based role involving regular travel throughout the local area and lone working. You'll work Monday to Friday, with additional on-call duties during evenings, weekends and bank holidays on a rotating basis.
What You'll Be Doing
Installing, servicing, repairing and replacing telecare equipment.
Travelling to customer locations across Cumbria and surrounding areas.
Providing clear, friendly guidance on how equipment works.
Supporting customers professionally and compassionately, particularly in vulnerable situations.
Diagnosing basic technical faults and resolving issues where possible.
Ensuring accurate completion of service records and documentation using company systems.
Following safeguarding, health and safety, data protection and lone-working procedures.
Participating in the on-call rota to support customers outside normal working hours.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who is dependable, practical and committed to delivering excellent customer service.
You'll ideally have:
A caring, patient and professional approach.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Confidence working independently in a field-based role.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Basic IT skills and experience using mobile devices or computer systems.
Flexibility to participate in an evening and weekend on-call rota.
A full UK driving licence.
The ability to pass an Enhanced DBS check.
A company vehicle, tools and equipment will be provided.
Desirable Experience
While not essential, applications are welcomed from individuals with experience in:
Telecare, healthcare technology or assistive technology.
Field service, installation or maintenance roles.
Emergency response or community-based support services.
Working with older or vulnerable adults.
Safeguarding and lone-working environments.
Full training will be provided for the right candidate.
What We Offer
Competitive salary.
Company vehicle.
On-call payments and enhanced rates where applicable.
Comprehensive training and ongoing development.
Employee assistance and wellbeing support.

Careium is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults at risk, and all colleagues are expected to share this commitment.

Description
ADP is hiring a Client Success Executive for Lyric HCM.
Are you ready to manage a book of large, complex global client accounts?
Do you enjoy working through client challenges and providing creative solutions?
Do you have a knack in building relationships, working through contract negotiations and retaining clients?
Are you ready to lead clients on an HCM journey leveraging Lyric technology?
Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?
In this role, the Client Success Executive (CSE) is responsible for driving satisfaction and client outcomes by relentlessly monitoring and managing client's success throughout the Lyric HCM client journey. The CSE in partnership with Product, Implementation, and Project Managers from other workstreams will define and implement Launch Readiness for all phases of the rollout of the Lyric HCM solution. The CSE will align with Client Stakeholders to gain a deep knowledge of the clients desired outcomes, developing and executing client success plans focused on achieving a client's desired outcomes at every stage in the client journey. The CSE manages at all levels of the ADP and Client Organization to drive accountability for delivering the end-to-end client experience in order to achieve a long term and valued added partnership. The CSE will initiate interventions to address any areas of concern in overall client health; including client satisfaction, client experience and product adoption across the client's ADP portfolio. The CSE identifies customer risk and acts as an integrator with ADP and client resources to deliver on Client Success milestones and to ultimately drive long term retention and expansion of the client partnership with ADP.
Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!
To learn more about Client Services at ADP, watch here: https://adp.careers/Client_Services_Videos
WHAT YOU'LL DO: Responsibilities
What you can expect on a typical day:
Client Focus:
The CSE is a trusted advisor who builds and strengthens client partnerships by creating and operationalizing a Client Success plan in conjunction with the Client's Decision Makers, influencers, and Executives.
The CSE will execute on this plan, marshaling the power of the organization to deliver on the client's Success Milestone and desired outcomes. This consists of establishing the client relationship and building their loyalty, consulting with the client to define appropriate desired outcomes based on the client's suite of products and stage in the adoption journey, ensuring the client's optimal use and solution adoption of products and services, advocating for our mutual best interests, and driving engagement through data insights and other unique ADP assets.
Possesses strong presentation skills, Executive Presence, business acumen and deep knowledge of the client and ability to articulate and manage to clients' desired outcomes.
Relationship Management:
The CSE drives total client satisfaction by delivering a seamless and unified experience in partnership with internal Associates.
Effectively manage across national and global business units within ADP to understand the hidden elements within the organization that impact the client and the business.
Effectively position ADP Executive Sponsor and execute effectively against the Client Playbook, including Success Plan and Executive Business Reviews to ensure the client holistically realizes the value in the ADP relationship.
The CSE is the clients' ADP advocate focused on total client satisfaction, with the responsibility to ensure a positive end-to-end ADP experience. The CSE partners with internal partners to ensure a unified experience and monitors and manages Client Health.
The CSE knows their clients by becoming a mutual partner of the client's company and industry in order to accurately provide an overview of their clients' business, their performance in the industry, critical business issues and strategic goals, in order to proactively identify and act on Risks and Opportunities. The CSE is a proactive partner who helps clients think through the marketplace implications, how that affects client strategy and provides best practices of similar verticals.
Ability to identify who the critical decision-makers are within the disciplines we generally support (HR, IT, Operations and Finance).
Responsible for maintaining and updating Success Plan and driving internal and client accountability to Success Milestones.
Sharing HCM industry updates and information relevant to a particular client's needs in a manner that supports and helps their business.
Establish and manage an expectation of reference-ability and client engagement opportunities relevant and beneficial to both the client and to ADP including driving participation in key events (MOTM, Rethink, CAB, Online Forums, Ambassador Program, etc.).
The CSE is able to manage difficult situations effectively and with the highest standard of integrity. Includes proactively handling issues with transparency and accountability, setting reasonable expectations for the client and de-escalating difficult situations.
Contract Management and Success Measurements:
The CSE understands all components of their clients' contracts, including pricing components, service level agreements and the clients' service history so as to manage and drive the contract renewal process and positively impact retention.
The CSE reports on key business activities and ROI in Success Plan and Executive Business Reviews, monitoring and managing client success, while being able to effectively use data to provide actionable insights.
Execution of contract renewal - Internal coordination with all ADP partners to deliver a smooth renewal process for the client. Partnership with Sales on revenue expansion opportunities with the CSE's book of business and leveraging all available resources necessary to defeat a competitive threat.
Effectively present a cohesive business renewal plan of action to ADP leadership.
Operational Execution:
The CSE coordinates and collaborates, within a highly matrixed global organization, including Sales, operational, service and product management partners to drive issues to closure, oversee completion of complex projects, improve efficiency and quality of end-to-end experience, and influence the product roadmap to enhance the overall client experience and deliver on the client's success milestones.
TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:
At least 3-5 years of managing and consulting with large, matrixed, and global clients, focused on strategic client enterprise account management
At least 3-5 years of General Management, Sales or Management Consulting Experience, Client Success Management
Demonstrated skills in analytics and research, client relations, executive presentations and cross-functional project management
Experience with ADP Products, HCM Solutions and Standout Technology.
Experience with Client Lifecycle Management from development to implementation and ongoing account management and support
Travel Required
A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. If you don't have a college degree, other acceptable experience could include the skills above.
BONUS POINTS FOR THESE: Preferred Qualifications
Large, complex client contract negotiations
Growth and Revenue
Bilingual proficiency in English and Canadian French (French-Canadian)
YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:
Be yourself in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
Belong by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
Grow your career in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
Continuously learn. Ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities for even the most insatiable learner.
Be your healthiest. Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
Balance work and life. Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
Focus on your mental health and well-being. We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
Join a company committed to giving back and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
Get paid to pay it forward. Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.
What are you waiting for? Apply today
Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days & Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $69,300.00 - USD $129,200.00 / Year*

LULEÅ LOKALTRAFIK AB
ARBETSLEDARE/VERKMÄSTARE
Vill du leda det dagliga arbetet i en verksamhet där säkerhet, kvalitet och tillgänglighet står i centrum?
Om Luleå Lokaltrafik 
Luleå lokaltrafik AB (LLT) har av Luleå kommun uppdraget att planera, marknadsföra och utföra stadstrafik med buss i Luleå tätortsområde. LLT är ett helägt kommunalt bolag som ingår i Luleå Kommunföretag och är ett miljöcertifierat företag enligt ISO 14001. LLT kör varje år 3 300 000 km inom linjenätet, vilket motsvarar 80 varv runt jordklotet. Under ett år har vi 3,4 miljoner kundresor och en vanlig vinterdag reser ca 25 000 resenärer med oss. För mer information se http://llt.lulea.se.
Om tjänsten 
Vi söker en arbetsledare/verkmästare till Luleå Lokaltrafiks bussverkstad. Här får du en central roll där du kombinerar ledarskap, planering, teknik och samarbete i en verksamhet där säkerhet, kvalitet och tillgänglighet står i centrum. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Arbetstiden är huvudsakligen förlagd till dagtid.
Som arbetsledare/verkmästare arbetar du nära våra fordonstekniker och är samtidigt en viktig länk mellan verkstaden och övriga delar av LLT. Rollen passar dig som trivs med många kontaktytor, gillar att lösa problem och tycker om att få människor och verksamhet att utvecklas tillsammans.
Om rollen
Som arbetsledare rapporterar du till verkstadschefen och leder och stöttar teknikerna i det dagliga arbetet. Du skapar struktur, prioriterar arbeten och ser till att verkstadens resurser används på bästa sätt. 
Du kommer bland annat att:
Leda och stötta tekniker i det dagliga arbetet.
Leda verkstadens dagliga styrning.
Planera, prioritera och fördela arbeten.
Samordna personal, verkstadsplatser och andra resurser.
Säkerställa tillgång till reservdelar och reparationsobjekt.
Samordna och följa upp externa arbeten.
Ha kontakt med leverantörer, entreprenörer, externa verkstäder och teknisk support.
Bidra till säkerhet, kvalitet och kontinuerliga förbättringar.
Du är även delaktig i arbetet med planerat underhåll, akuta reparationer, reservdelsförsörjning, skadehantering och miljöarbete. Arbetet är huvudsakligen förlagd till dagtid.
En roll med många kontaktytor
En viktig del av arbetet är det tvärfunktionella samarbetet inom LLT. Verkstaden är en del av en större helhet och för att kollektivtrafiken ska fungera behöver flera funktioner arbeta tillsammans.
Du kommer därför att ha ett nära samarbete med övriga avdelningar där det kan handla om allt från den dagliga fordonsdriften och planering av underhåll till tekniska frågor, förbättringsarbete, nya arbetssätt och införande av ny teknik.
Du blir en viktig kontakt mellan den operativa verkstaden och andra funktioner och bidrar till att information, behov och prioriteringar når rätt personer.
Vi söker dig som:
Vi söker dig som tycker om att leda människor, skapa struktur och lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är trygg i att fatta beslut och prioritera, men är samtidigt lyhörd och skapar delaktighet i teamet. Rollen innebär inte formellt personalansvar men ett operativt ledarskap för verkstadens tekniker.
Din erfarenhet kan komma från exempelvis verkstad, fordon, industri, transport, underhåll eller annan teknisk verksamhet. Du behöver alltså inte ha en traditionell bakgrund från bussverkstad. Erfarenhet av arbetsledning är meriterande. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper, ledarskap och relevant erfarenhet. Individuell lönesättning tillämpas och lönen fastställs utifrån relevant kompetens, erfarenhet och förmåga att uppfylla tjänstens krav. För tjänsten är det preliminära lönespannet 40 000-44 000 kr/månad beroende på erfarenhet, kompetens och ansvar.
Vi tror att du:
Är tydlig, lyhörd och lösningsorienterad.
Trivs med att leda och stötta andra.
Har lätt för att samarbeta över olika yrkes- och verksamhetsområden.
Kan skapa struktur när förutsättningarna snabbt förändras.
Har ett tydligt säkerhets- och kvalitetstänk.
Är bekväm med digitala arbetssätt och IT-system.
Är nyfiken på teknik och verksamhetsutveckling.
B-körkort.
Bli en del av LLT
Hos oss får du en roll nära den dagliga verksamheten samtidigt som du får möjlighet att påverka och utveckla hur vi arbetar framåt.
Vi tror på samarbete och på styrkan i olika erfarenheter och perspektiv. Därför välkomnar vi sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och vägar in i arbetslivet.

Job Description
Vidareutveckla och stödja en etablerad OneTrust-plattform inom försäkringsverksamhet. Du genomför en hälsokontroll av lösningen, identifierar åtgärdsbehov och ger rekommendationer för fortsatt utveckling. Arbetet omfattar flöden och formulär främst inom dataskydd, men även inom leverantörsriskhantering vid behov.
Du behöver grundläggande kompetens i OneTrust och förmåga att genomföra en strukturerad hälsokontroll. Uppdraget kräver specifik kunskap om TPDD, TPRM och Privacy-modulerna ROPA och Automation samt förståelse för integrationer, behörigheter, roller och konfigurationer. Du samarbetar nära verksamhet och IT och behöver kunna kommunicera på svenska.
Du bidrar även med rekommendationer för plattformens långsiktiga förvaltning, inklusive framtida bemanning, kompetensbehov och möjliga leveransupplägg. Rollen kombinerar därmed praktiskt utvecklings- och supportarbete med rådgivning om hur lösningen ska förvaltas över tid. Grundläggande processförståelse kopplad till de enskilda modulerna är meriterande.

Description
Consultant, Technical
Responsibilities
Obtain and maintain certification in WFS Product Suite applications required to perform the role.
Continue to learn WFS product configuration requirements (i.e., naming conventions, importing templates, database structure, customizations, proper sequencing).
Responsible for configuring WFS Suite according to customer business requirements using JavaScript, HTML, SQL, or other scripting tools.
Handle complex issues including administrative and configuration challenges with minimal assistance.
Communicate roadblocks and seek out guidance in a timely manner.
Write complex formulas that leverage mathematical and/or programming skills.
Perform unit and system testing of configured applications to ensure test cases pass as described by customer requirements.
Identify and escalate out-of-scope requirements to key stakeholders.
Support the confirmation and refinement of customer business requirements with key stakeholders.
Participate in, and eventually lead, the gathering and identification of customer business requirements from users, customers, and other stakeholders.
Create and maintain business requirement documents, use cases, and process diagrams.
Understand project scope and implementation approach for assigned projects.
Learn how to estimate work effort and communicate with key stakeholders on the project.
Participate in facilitation of client workshops, either onsite or remotely, demonstrating understanding of best practices during Workforce Management software implementations.
Deliver projects and tasks on time and within budget by effectively managing workload.
Attend and participate in team meetings.
Follow established processes and best practices to continuously improve skills.
Provide project status updates to key stakeholders, both internally and externally.
Partner with internal teams during project phases to ensure successful customer implementation.
Collaborate with the WFS team to ensure thorough testing of customer requirements.
Assist with roll-out and go-live activities, including data migration and system setup.
Become familiar with aspects of labor laws as they pertain to time and attendance rules, scheduling, and leaves of absence.
Proactively participate in training courses and engage in self-directed learning to acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to achieve success and contribute to team objectives.
Understand customer needs in the development of strategic plans.
Troubleshoot issues and escalate problems to appropriate team members.
Maintain accurate and timely records of billable and non-billable hours to ensure project profitability and meet utilization targets.
Ensure adherence to WorkForce Software documentation standards and methodologies.
Identify opportunities to improve product offerings based on customer feedback.
Manage customer expectations through effective communication during key phases of the project lifecycle.
Document and communicate out-of-scope requirements and project delays to the appropriate team members.
Estimate work effort and communicate with Project Managers, customers, and other stakeholders regarding project status.
Investigate issues reported during customer testing phases, including tracking and reporting defects.
Mentor junior team members.
 ##LI-DNI 
Requirements
2 to 4 years of experience in software implementations.
Minimum 2 years of experience with programming languages, preferably JavaScript and/or SQL.
Demonstrated knowledge of SQL, JavaScript, HTML, or other scripting tools.
Experience implementing or training on a packaged software system or highly complex internally developed application.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, with a strong emphasis on Excel.
Understanding of waterfall and agile methodologies, frameworks, and practices in a services delivery environment.
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to rapidly shift focus and respond to changing conditions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Basic problem-solving skills.
Experience or ability to read/write SQL and develop simple queries.
Knowledge of common implementation principles and lifecycle methodologies.
Ability to exercise mature judgment.
Demonstrated technical aptitude and ability to adapt quickly to new circumstances.
Ability to work within a dynamic, customer-focused team and establish effective working relationships.
Strong desire to grow both functionally and technically as a professional consultant.
Familiarity with HR, Payroll, or Workforce Management is considered a plus.
Logical and technical mindset capable of analyzing problems and identifying root causes.
Awareness of HCM applications and business processes.
Experience providing application support for complex software systems is preferred.
Programming experience utilizing JavaScript, C#, C++, or 4GL.
Familiarity with reporting tools such as Crystal Reports, Cognos, Actuate, or similar platforms.
SQL report creation experience preferred.
Ability to work flexible hours.
Perform all other duties as assigned.

 by Daniel Fransson 
Gothenburg
 Apply Now
 Apply for this job
 Apply Job
 Shortlist
Job Description
Build physical concept models and functional prototypes that combine precision craftsmanship with electronics and programmable features. As a technical specialist, you will resolve complex fabrication challenges and collaborate with designers and engineers to deliver high-quality models. Your work spans surface preparation, component fitting, final finishing and functional lighting prototypes.
You bring several years of documented experience in advanced model making, prototype manufacturing or an equivalent skilled craft discipline. Strong metalworking and woodworking skills are required, alongside practical experience in low-voltage electronics, soldering, wiring, fault diagnosis and basic PCB design and assembly. You must also be able to program simple control systems and apply safe workshop practices. Professional Swedish and English are mandatory.
Experience operating laser-cutting equipment and adapting digital cutting data to materials and tolerances is advantageous. The specified toolset includes LightBurn, Adobe Illustrator, KiCad, Raspberry Pi, Visual Studio Code and Microsoft 365.
