Job Description:
WE’RE LOOKING FOR A QUALITY ASSURANCE COMPOSITE INSPECTOR (ASSEMBLY)
POSITION LOCATION: FORT ERIE 
The Quality Assurance Composites Inspector reports to the Supervisor, Composites Quality Assurance and is responsible for the inspection of all composite parts and kits. This includes performing assembly/ paint, trim, shipping, layup and core inspections of all parts to verify the high quality of the parts.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
Assembly Inspection/Paint Inspection
Visual Inspection
Verify potting material shelf life
Verify that inserts, components, etc. are installed as per drawing.
Visual Inspection for improper or insufficient coverage, rough surfaces, pitting.
Dust inclusions, orange peel, tears, sagging or blistering.
Inspecting parts  to planned MIDs and Inspection documents , drawings etc.
Recording of nonconformities and quarantining non conforming parts with red tags.
Create and maintain inspection plans and procedures.
Participate and lead  root cause and corrective action process using Rapid 5 Whys, 8D tools etc..
Perform First Article Inspections to AS9102 requirements.
Execute inspections to planned weekly and daily KPIs to Assembly Inspection Plans.
Serve as a guide to Assembly technicians by sharing requirements and acceptance criteria for Inspection.
Participate in all initial and recurrent training to maintain certifying staff authorities.
Trim Inspection
Verification of tool validity
Visual Inspection
Inspection of parts  to planned MIDs and Inspection documents , drawings etc.
Participate and lead  root cause and corrective action process using Rapid 5 Whys, 8D tools etc.
Recording of nonconformities & quarantining non conforming parts with red tags. 
Shipping Inspection
Verify that all inspection stages have been completed.
Inspecting parts to planned MIDs and Inspection documents , drawings etc.
Recording of nonconformities & quarantining non conforming parts with red tags.
Preparation of shipping documentation including Form Ones and C of Cs.
Execute inspections to planned weekly and daily KPIs to Assembly Inspection Plans.
Participate in all initial and recurrent training to maintain certifying staff authorities.
Participate and lead  root cause and corrective action process using Rapid 5 Whys, 8D tools etc.
Lay-up Inspection
Review all materials in kits for shelf life & out life remaining
Verification that all materials have been cut & identified with ply number & orientation
Verification that Material Identification Sheets are complete.
Verification validity of tooling.
Visual Inspection to planned MIDs and Inspection documents , drawings etc.
Execute inspections to planned weekly and daily KPIs to Assembly Inspection Plans.
Participate and lead  root cause and corrective action process using Rapid 5 Whys, 8D tools etc.
Serve as a guide to Layup  technicians by sharing requirements and acceptance criteria for Inspection.
Recording of nonconformities &  quarantining non conforming parts with red tags.
Core Inspection
Verification validity of tooling
Verification of conformity to templates and drawings
Visual Inspection for damage, cell ruptures, contamination dust /oil
Inspection of parts  to planned MIDs and Inspection documents , drawings etc.
Recording of nonconformities & quarantining non conforming parts with red tags.
Execute inspections to planned weekly and daily KPIs to Assembly Inspection Plans.
Participate and lead  root cause and corrective action process using Rapid 5 Whys, 8D tools etc.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS
Education
College Diploma (Mechanical Engineering Technician or Technologist) or relevant experience
Experience:
5 years of composite experience (Manufacturing/Assembly Inspection), specifically with a Quality Assurance System (ISO 9001, AS 9100)
NDT/Ultrasonic Inspection experience an asset 
Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities:
Ability to work under broad supervision
Independent and able to work with a team
Attention to detail
Able to manage time effectively and prioritize work
Professional working relationships with internal and external sources, including regulatory and quality certified agencies
Able to work under pressure to meet demanding work schedules
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Excellent problem solving skills
Able to write accurate technical reports
Ability to read various Blueprints
Able to use measurement tools

Summary The Electromechanical Field Service Technician (Bahamas) is responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and testing of electromechanical equipment at customer locations. The Technician provides timely and professional service while ensuring compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and applicable health and safety standards. The position requires the ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and electronic issues, maintain service records, manage assigned inventory, and deliver a high level of customer support. The Technician works independently or as part of a service team and receives guidance from senior technicians, team leaders or management. 
Duties and Responsibilities
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, repairs, installations, and equipment upgrades at customer facilities.
Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and electronic equipment failures using approved troubleshooting methods.
Respond promptly to service calls and customer requests in accordance with established service requirements.
Accurately document service activities, equipment conditions, parts usage, and corrective actions taken.
Follow company procedures for reporting technical issues and escalating unresolved problems.
Maintain assigned tools, test equipment, and service vehicle in a safe and serviceable condition.
Manage assigned parts inventory and assist with ordering and replenishment of replacement components.
Provide professional customer service and maintain positive working relationships with customers and site personnel.
Adhere to all company safety rules, customer site requirements, and applicable Bahamian occupational health and safety standards.
Participate in technical training programs to maintain and improve job knowledge and skills.
Assist senior technicians and Team Leads with equipment installations, audits, and site projects as required.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and recommend practical solutions to improve service efficiency.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Required Skills and Abilities:
Working knowledge of electromechanical systems, electrical circuits, motors, sensors, and related equipment.
Ability to troubleshoot and repair equipment using technical manuals, wiring diagrams, and schematics.
Basic computer skills include Microsoft Office applications and service reporting systems.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, coworkers, and management.
Ability to work independently.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Willingness to submit personal information and obtain Gaming Licenses where required for customer sites and jurisdictions.

Physical Requirements
 The employee must be able to:
Lift and carry equipment and parts up to 50 pounds.
Frequently bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and climb as required.
Work in confined spaces and varying environmental conditions.
Distinguish colors when working with wiring and electrical components.
Safely operate hand tools, power tools, and testing equipment.
Travel Requirement
Yes. Travel within The Bahamas may be required to support customer locations and operational requirements. The ability to travel outside of The Bahamas may be required for training. Short-term travel may be necessary for training.

Employees are expected to observe all health, safety, and security procedures.
Overtime, shift work, weekend work, and public holiday work may be required based on operational needs and will be administered in accordance with applicable employment laws and company policy.

HMS | Product Engineer
Product Engineer
Halmstad
HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.
Want to work with hardware products used worldwide and help ensure they remain reliable, manufacturable, and competitive throughout their lifecycle? If you enjoy combining technical problem-solving with real product impact, this could be your next step.
What you'll do
Do you enjoy working hands-on with electronics and finding ways to make products better? As a Product Engineer at HMS Networks, you'll play an important role in keeping our hardware products reliable, cost-efficient, and competitive throughout their lifecycle.
You'll work with real engineering challenges, from finding solutions when components become obsolete to improving product design, manufacturability, and performance. Working closely with colleagues across engineering, production, quality, and sourcing, you'll turn technical challenges into practical improvements that make a lasting difference to our products.
Join our Hardware team within the Industrial Network Technology (INT) Division in Halmstad and contribute to products used around the world in industrial communication and automation.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Managing component lifecycle challenges, including obsolete components and second sourcing.
Driving Design for Manufacturing (DFM) in product updates and improvements.
Leading cost-reduction initiatives and identifying technical improvements.
Troubleshooting hardware issues and supporting root cause analysis.
Evaluating component changes and their impact on product performance and manufacturability.
Supporting production test specifications and manufacturing readiness.
Maintaining technical documentation.
You'll use Jira for project and issue tracking and work with electronics design tools such as Altium Designer and OrCAD.
About you
You enjoy understanding how electronic products work and finding practical solutions to technical challenges. You are curious, methodical, and take ownership of your work. You pay attention to detail and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different functions to improve products and solve problems.
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:
A university degree in electronics, mechatronics, or a related engineering field.
Practical experience working with electronics, for example in electronics design, component engineering, hardware development, testing, or maintenance.
Experience troubleshooting electronic products or contributing to technical improvements.
Good communication skills in English.
It is a plus if you also have experience with:
Component lifecycle management and second sourcing.
Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and electronics production.
Cost-reduction initiatives and technical product improvements.
Electronics design tools such as Altium Designer or OrCAD.
Working in international or cross-functional environments.
Knowledge of Swedish is also an advantage.
About us
At HMS, we put Heart, Mind & Soul into everything we do. These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success.
We are an innovative growth company headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden, with approximately 1,100 employees in more than 20 countries. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning.
HMS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered.
Visit hms-networks.com and learn more about life at HMS in our Working at HMS video.

Summary
A Level III Field Service Technician will utilize their technical expertise and independent judgment to provide on-site servicing, installation, and repair of complex electromechanical equipment. This role is crucial in maintaining high customer satisfaction through data-driven tools, proactive attention to customer needs, and positive interactions. Responsibilities include supporting customers with operational or maintenance issues, addressing escalated technical and service-related concerns, diagnosing failures in mechanical, hardware, software, and systems, implementing effective repairs to minimize downtime, and preparing reports for analyzing product failure trends and serviceability issues. Additionally, this role will also assist with the on-site training and development of less experienced field service technicians and acts as a key communication link between technical support, management, and the customer on technical matters and projects. Flexibility for long hours and travel is required.
Duties/Responsibilities
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
Apply company policies and procedures to complete routine tasks effectively.
Respond promptly to service calls, perform equipment maintenance at customer sites, and assist operators with operational issues.
Represent the company professionally at all times.
Handle administrative tasks, including record-keeping, reporting, and inventory management, with accuracy and timeliness.
Develop and maintain technical competence through formal training programs, on-site training, and hands-on experience.
Comply with company policies regarding confidentiality and customer procedures, including Custody and Control Procedures.
Manage parts inventory, coordinate shipments for repair and replenishment, and oversee the inventory of tools and test equipment.
Record maintenance activities using approved methods and procedures.
Follow escalation procedures to resolve issues promptly and ensure timely communication with designated company personnel and customer management.
Promote high customer satisfaction by maintaining open communication and providing proactive attention to customer needs.
Assist with the on-site training of less experienced field service technicians.
Show flexibility to travel as required to support business needs, including providing coverage for other Field Engineers during vacations or illnesses. Travel may be within the home territory or to other areas.
Perform all activities safely and adhere to company safety policies and procedures.
Complete other duties as assigned.
Required Skills/Knowledge
Hands-on experience with electromechanical equipment is preferred.
Proficiency in electromechanical troubleshooting, understanding electronic principles, and working knowledge of computer systems, PCs, and networking is required.
Experience with solenoids, belts, rollers, bearings, pneumatics, and guides is a plus.
Strong oral and written communication skills are essential.
Ability to use a laptop/tablet for administrative and diagnostic tasks.
Willingness to provide personal information and obtain Gaming Licenses in required jurisdictions (for Commercial Field Service Technicians).
Work may be home office-based or customer site-based.
Personal vehicle use may be required depending on business needs.
Potential responsibility for a company fleet vehicle may be required depending on business needs.
Shift work may be required.
Required Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED required.
An Associate degree or trade/technical school certificate/diploma preferred.
Minimum of four (4) years of relevant work experience, including at least two years in a field service environment.
Hands-on experience with electromechanical equipment is essential.
Previous experience in customer-facing roles is required.
Salary
$65,000

Job Summary
The Canadian Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for employees across multiple provinces utilizing Dayforce HCM and ADP Workforce Now (WFN). This role ensures compliance with federal and provincial payroll legislation, company policies, and internal controls while providing exceptional service to employees, managers, and stakeholders. The Payroll Specialist partners closely with People+, Benefits, Finance, and third-party vendors to ensure payroll accuracy and compliance. This position plays a critical role in ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with all applicable Canadian payroll regulations and company policies. 
Primary Responsibilities
Payroll Processing
Process bi-weekly payrolls through Dayforce HCM and ADP Workforce Now (WFN).
Review and audit payroll data, including new hires, terminations, pay rate changes, promotions, bonuses, commissions, and deductions.
Validate time and attendance data, ensuring accuracy and completeness before payroll processing.
Analyze payroll registers and exception reports to identify and correct discrepancies.
Process off-cycle payrolls, manual checks, and payroll adjustments as required.
Process Records of Employment (ROEs), employee status changes, and off-cycle payments.
Balance payroll prior to final management review 
Compliance & Tax Administration
Ensure compliance with the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA), provincial employment standards, and payroll legislation. 
Administer statutory deductions, including CPP/QPP, EI, income tax, EHT, and provincial payroll taxes. 
Assist in year-end processing, including T4, T4A, RL-1, and related reconciliations. 
Process garnishments, support orders, and other legislated deductions. 
Maintain payroll records in accordance with legislative and company requirements.
Employee Support & Manager Support
Respond to employee and management inquiries regarding pay, taxes, deductions, time reporting, and payroll policies.
Research and resolve payroll discrepancies in a timely and professional manner.
Educate employees on self-service payroll functionality within Dayforce HCM and ADP Workforce Now (WFN)
Perform onboarding orientation and ongoing training to employees and managers
Payroll Administration
Maintain employee payroll records and ensure data integrity within Dayforce HCM and ADP Workforce Now (WFN).
Review and process benefit deductions, retirement plan contributions, and other voluntary deductions as per direction of the Benefits department.
Support payroll audits, internal controls, and compliance requirements.
Document payroll procedures and participate in process improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with People+ to provide payroll communications to the organization as needed
Perform other duties as required
Reporting & Reconciliation
Generate and analyze payroll reports and audit reports from Dayforce HCM and ADP Workforce Now (WFN).
Provide supporting documentation and reporting to Finance with bi-weekly payrolls.
Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual payroll reporting requirements.
Support external and internal audits by gathering payroll documentation and evidence.
Qualifications, Experience and Educational Requirements
Work Experience:
2-5 years of Canadian payroll processing experience.
Experience processing multi-provincial payrolls; including Quebec.
Hands-on experience with Dayforce HCM, ADP Workforce Now or other multi-module HRIS payroll system required.
Experience with time and attendance systems preferred.
Experience with payroll reconciliations and audits.
Experience supporting payrolls in multiple provinces and jurisdictions.
Experience with payroll audits, and compliance testing.
Experience working in a shared services or high-volume payroll environment.
Skills and Competencies:
Strong knowledge of Canadian payroll legislation and employment standards.
Knowledge of garnishments, benefit deductions, ROEs, taxable benefits and time & attendance.
Proficiency in Dayforce HCM, ADP Workforce Now or similar HRIS.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs, PivotTables, and data analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
Ability to manage high volumes of requests from various sources.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Self-motivated professional with the ability to effectively collaborate and communicate with employees, managers, and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Payroll accuracy rate.
On-time payroll processing.
Number of payroll corrections required post-payroll.
Timely resolution of employee inquiries.
Compliance with payroll deadlines and regulatory requirements.
Education:
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Payroll, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred;
PCP (Payroll Compliance Practitioner) designation or working toward certification preferred.
Working Conditions
Hybrid™ work arrangement of WFH & In Office requirements.
Regular collaboration with with team members, regionally (Canada and U.S.)
High degree of data confidentiality and compliance responsibility.
Physical Requirements
Ability to work primarily in an office environment.
Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
Ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Job Description:
A vacancy for a  B2 Aircraft Maintenance Technician has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, AD&S, in Getafe, Madrid. The successful applicant will join AD&S Final Assembly Line team.
Position details: 
Getafe area
Double shift_doble turno Spain
RESPONSIBILITIES
Working as part of Final Assembly Line FAL A330 MRTT Flight Line Centre - AG2 team, the role shall be:
Prepare, perform and certify base and line maintenance works as a B2 certifying staff, working with a very small group of non-licensed technicians, when needed.
Aircraft preparation for flight by implementing on A/C the items recorded in the Test Preparation Sheet, TPS, issued by FlightOps organization for every flight.
Carry out production works on the aircraft to prepare it for ground test managed by MRTT Design Office and supervised by FAL- Quality as well as the required support during tests execution.
Carry out retrofit electrical works and tests on the aircraft in accordance with applicable retrofit service bulletin or applicable Job Cards.
Perform aircraft discrepancy fixing, trouble-shooting, handling and servicing.
The position is based in Getafe but the candidate must be willing to work abroad at ADS customer’s sites during aircraft delivery, to support ground & flight tests campaigns in other sites.
This is a challenging position combining a desirable military background, EASA Part 66 license as well as EMAR/FR 66 and working in an environment which planning charges almost in a daily basis.
The candidate shall be willing to obtain National and NATO clearance, HPS Habilitación Personal de Seguridad.
SKILLS
We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:
Aircraft maintenance EASA PART 66 category B2 without limitations.
Being in possession of a valid EASA PART 66 category B2 aircraft maintenance license will be recomended.
Candidates shall have previous experience in Airbus aircraft maintenance environment working in A330 (RR TRENT 700) and/or (GE CF6).
B1 license will be also desirable.
English: fluent level
Spanish: negotiation level.
Candidate MUST have a wide experience in test execution and troubleshoutings to solve problems detected after the test execution.
Holding of national and NATO security clearance (SC) will by highly appreciated.
The candidates shall have experience of working to high quality standards and have an understanding of work recording and job traceability.  They will have experience in reading and understanding detailed technical data and manufacturer’s maintenance manuals and instructions in English.  A high knowledge of Aircraft Health and Safety procedures and a good standard of computer literacy are required. 
WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:
Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
Attractive salary.
Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance.
Collective transport service in some sites.
Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility  initiatives.
Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
Special rates in products & benefits.

Job Summary
The System Application Support Engineer is responsible for providing technical support, maintenance, monitoring, and continuous improvement for business-critical applications and associated infrastructure. This role serves as a key liaison between business users, development teams, infrastructure teams, and third-party vendors to ensure application availability, performance, and reliability. The engineer will investigate and resolve complex application issues, support production environments, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to automation and operational excellence initiatives. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to work across multiple technology domains. This position requires effective communication, a customer-service mindset, and the ability to support critical business operations in a fast-paced environment.
Duties & Essential Responsibilities
Application Support
Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for enterprise applications and business systems. The applications include commercial and proprietary applications.
Configuration of applications and monitoring application health, performance, and availability.
Applications include data communication (MFT), Webservices, databases, monitoring, printing, shipping system, and production related proprietary applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, service interruptions, and application errors.
Work closely with business users to understand issues and deliver timely resolutions.
Installation of Applications as per the Company standards and business needs
Upgrading and installation of application patches
User and data management within applications with proper security permissions.
Proper change management of applications from configuration to upgrades
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, networking, and vendor teams to resolve complex technical problems.
Support application deployments, upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities.
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and problem management processes.
Create and maintain operational documentation, support procedures, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in on-call support and after-hours maintenance activities as required.
 Systems & Infrastructure Support
Support application environments hosted on Windows and Linux platforms.
Administer and support Active Directory accounts, permissions, security groups, and service accounts.
Work with networking teams to troubleshoot routing, DNS, firewall, VPN, and connectivity issues.
Support certificate lifecycle management.
Assist with backup and disaster recovery testing.
Participate in the maintenance of windows and infrastructure changes.
Assist with system integrations, data interfaces, and secure data exchange processes.
Collaborate with networking teams to troubleshoot connectivity, DNS, firewall, VPN, and routing issues.
Support certificate management and authentication services.
Monitor application and infrastructure resources to proactively identify and resolve issues.
 Operational Excellence
Develop and implement automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
Analyze recurring incidents and recommend permanent corrective actions.
Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resiliency initiatives.
Ensure adherence to organizational security, compliance, and audit requirements.
Contribute to process improvements and service optimization efforts.
Technical Skills & Qualifications
Required Technical Skills
Familiarity with SQL and database querying for troubleshooting, reporting, and data validation.
Experience performing log analysis and interpretation across applications, operating systems, and integration platforms.
Strong understanding of data communication concepts and secure data exchange methodologies.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Experience administering and supporting Active Directory (AD), including service accounts, permissions, and group management.
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools used to monitor infrastructure, applications, and file transfer services.
Basic scripting and automation experience using languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
Ability to analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues across multiple technology domains.

 Job Description
Good decisions need good data. If you want to go deep into data and see your work shape real business decisions, this is the place for you!
Who this role is for
This is a graduate or junior role. You have a relevant education in data or analytics, or up to two years of relevant experience. If you studied something else but moved into data analytics work, your experience counts. What matters is a solid base you can build on.
What we hope you bring
A relevant education in data or analytics, or 1–2 years of relevant experience
Solid SQL, with an understanding of databases and data handling
Excel and Power BI, for analysis, dashboards and reporting
Meaningful experience using AI tools in your work or studies, with at least one concrete example you can talk about
Where you add value, and how you grow
You join a team of three analysts, two in Oslo and one in Copenhagen, reporting directly to the Head of Customer Portfolio Management. The team covers the Nordic B2B market and works across countries on shared B2B projects. Our analysts also work closely with the AI team, a group of about 15 specialists, so you are never the only one with the answer. You start by working alongside the team and your mentor, supporting the Swedish B2B business. Over time, you will take on more responsibility for it. The team is also responsible for how our analyst data is built and organised, and you will get the opportunity to learn and contribute to that as well
A mentor who is part of the picture
You will not be left to figure it out alone. Your mentor is an experienced analyst located in Oslo, Fornebu. You work closely together every day on method, data quality and the hard technical questions. This role offers substantial responsibility along with guidance from someone highly skilled in the work.
Build, measure, learn
We work in a build, measure, learn cycle. Your analysis is put to use quickly, evaluated and improved based on what happens. You see the effect of your work, not just the report, in real business life.
What you'll do
Analyse customer, product and commercial performance in the B2B business to find trends and opportunities.
Dig into the data to find out why numbers move, and identify the root causes.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports and KPIs in SQL and Power BI.
Develop customer segmentation and underlying logic, then validate it with the end users.
Work with technical colleagues to understand the data, then explain results to sales and account managers in plain language.
Use AI tools and automation to make analysis faster and more reliable.
Help improve data quality and share what you learn across the team.
Who you are
You enjoy spending time in the data. You can explain a technical finding simply to someone who is not technical, and you take initiative to pick up new things quickly. This is the role for you if you see yourself making a career as a data analyst and want a great start.
Does this sound like you? We really want to hear from you.
Our recruitment process
First step will be a logical ability test and personality test
First interview will be a Teams interview with TA partner Jessica, in English
Technical interview with a case will be performed with the mentor Tuyen
Final interview with the hiring manager Thomas
References
Practical information
Location: Oslo, Norway. Working language: business English. At least 3 days per week in the office, per company policy.
GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this position.
No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Accountabilities
The jobholder is responsible for creation; monitoring and management of Aircraft Embodiment preparation & tooling projects, including day to day management of the AEE project Engineers. Main accountabilities of the job holder:
 Create & manage the Setup of the WP Preparation dossiers ensuring that they are provided in accordance with Airbus Maintenance Organization procedures and EASA Part / FAR /CCAR 145 regulations, in due time, featuring all technical data and detailed work instructions to enable a smooth and efficient embodiment of maintenance, repair and retrofit tasks as requested by Airbus aircraft operator (customers).
Coordinates technical support to operational departments on working party site during embodiment, of repair, retrofit campaign or maintenance tasks.
 Manages main base & on-site working party tooling requests, ensuring correct tools are supplied on time, and meet all quality requirements
Ensure feedback of in-service experience, maintenance activities and reports significant issues to management, project management teams and contributing to continuous improvement throughout the business.
Manage continuous improvement, innovations, challenges supplier costs, monitor and reports on  capex expenditures, monitors work load, simplify tasks, and coordinates warehouse activities
Identifies and manages the necessary means to raise  work instructions related to the tasks ordered by the customer (modification, major repair an retrofits): in accordance with the appropriate airworthiness regulations (EASA Part 145 / FAR 145 regulations)
 In preparation for creation of work instructions, ensures all concessions for specific aircraft MSN’s are identified and mitigated with appropriate tooling and work processes. This activity is also necessary to ensure correct replacement fasteners and parts are ordered and available on site without delay to the scheduled repair time.
Participates to manage the Part 145 warehouse. Consolidates standard tool list (cutting tools, drilling machines etc.), consumable material list and manages the required tooling to be dispatched to the working party site (worldwide).
Interfaces with the project management team, design and also provides technical support to working party teams.
Manages and monitors the set up the working party preparation dossiers. Prepares and provides working party file documentation to Certifying staff in due time
Ensures quality and on time delivery of all aspects of the preparation project including implementation of actions from working party kick of meetings, post project reviews and applicable return of experience (ROE, SMS, Feedback sheets etc.).
 Participates and supports internal and external audits at home base and at working party locations worldwide.
Main activities
Project lead the Aircraft Embodiment Engineering & tooling activities ensuring quality and on-time delivery.
 Manage the local working party support office and Aircraft Embodiment Engineers on site activities for technical support tasks while Airbus working party teams are providing support to customers
 Manage reporting and relations with aircraft operators, MRO’s, programs and project management teams - monitor feedback and implement actions of improvement throughout ‘S’
Be accountable for identifying local suitably approved machine shop and tool suppliers on ad hoc basis for unforeseen additional work ensuring quality, time and cost targets are not compromised.
Be the focal point for working party related matters towards projects, tooling innovation, customers, maintenance centres and all stakeholders in applicable interface departments
Contribute to digitalization projects (eg.  e-workcards, QR code project, site internet, 3DMU)
Outputs
Ensure customer satisfaction on all Aircraft Embodiment Engineer project and tooling topics related to working parties.
On time and quality delivery of embodiment projects in compliance with EASA Part / FAR /CAAC145 regulations during preparation phase and embodiment phase, contribute to consistent on-site support when technical assistance is required
Ensure adherence to working party planning and budgets, whilst ensuring Aircraft Embodiment Engineer deliverables conform to strategy and targets.
Provide onsite support and be the Airbus advisory focal point to customers during modifications, retrofits or major modifications/repairs.
Evolve and promote a feedback culture though SBC in order to simplify & improve working methods for all working parties.
Inputs
Personal and interpersonal skills
Strong customer minded with intercultural understanding
Flexible: able to cope with unexpected changes in a demanding environment,
Strong mindset of problem solving and silos breaking
Collaborative and supportive
Professional skills
Engineering degree in university of Aeronautics and astronautics. 
5+ years of experience in aircraft maintenance operation and engineering
Familiarised with Airbus technical documentation.
Negotiation level in English
Organisation structure
The jobholder has a sole reporting line to the HO ABEC customer services ACO1S

IGT, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale!  From the casino floor to your mobile screen, we deliver thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences—powered by world‑class content, strong technical and commercial capabilities and nurtured by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and ownership.
Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. With a team of over 6,000 employees across 30+ countries and products delivered in more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide, we operate at scale while staying closely connected to costumers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here - www.igt.com.
Overview
IGT is seeking an Application Support Engineer to support our casino customers throughout the United States on IGT's Table Manager (TM), Cage & Table Accounting (CTA), Table Drop, and related casino operations products. This role supports critical casino business functions including table games management, cage operations, revenue accounting, audits, reporting, regulatory compliance, table drop processing, chip inventory controls, and operational integrations with other IGT Advantage systems.
The ideal candidate will possess a combination of casino operational knowledge, technical troubleshooting skills, and customer service expertise. Experience supporting table games, cage operations, accounting processes, casino management systems, auditing functions, or enterprise applications is highly desirable.
Responsibilities
Provide technical support to field engineers, technicians, product specialists, and customers diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing, and resolving issues involving Table Manager, Cage & Table Accounting, Table Drop, and related integrated systems.
Manage incidents, service requests, enhancements, and problem records using approved support tools and processes.
Ensure customer systems remain operational and that service disruptions are restored in a timely and efficient manner.
Deliver exceptional customer support while adhering to established SLA response and restoration commitments.
Analyze application issues, identify root causes, provide workarounds, and drive permanent resolutions through problem management processes.
Support daily casino operations involving table games accounting, cage transactions, table ratings, table drop processes, revenue reconciliation, audits, and reporting activities.
Troubleshoot application functionality, configuration issues, data discrepancies, integration failures, and reporting concerns across TM and CTA environments.
Identify and provide resolutions ranging from moderate to highly complex technical and application-related issues.
Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, Database Administration, Delivery Services, Regulatory Compliance teams, and Customer Support organizations to resolve customer issues.
Participate in major incident management activities and assist in service restoration efforts for critical customer-facing outages.
Maintain and improve support documentation, troubleshooting guides, known issue repositories, and operational procedures.
Assist customers with application configuration, validation, upgrades, testing, and implementation activities.
Ability to travel domestically and potentially internationally up to 25% of the time.
Qualifications
Heavily analytical with the ability to understand and develop complex process and analysis
Extensive experience of system architecture, integrations and networking
Able to easily communicate complex ideas and systems.
Experience in documenting process and knowledge.
Typically, has 2- to 5-years of casino operations experience plus a bias toward system knowledge
Advanced Knowledge/Experience/Understanding of integration processes from the point of implementation/development phases to production roll-out
Knowledge of desktop/mobile browser debugging and systems networking
Knowledge and understanding of API (SOAP and REST Technologies) data exchange and XML reading highly desirable
Able to communicate complex ideas in a logical and audience appropriate manner
Able to pass a Security Background Investigation
Other Responsibilities
Assist with support of internal applications, environments, and infrastructure utilized by the TM and CTA product teams.
Create, maintain, and distribute technical knowledge and operational information throughout the support organization.
Provide assistance and coverage for other team members and product groups when required.
Learn and maintain proficiency in employer-specific applications, tools, and casino management systems.
Participate in customer installations, upgrades, training events, and go-live support activities.
Obtain and maintain gaming licenses in numerous gaming jurisdictions, including state and tribal regulatory environments.
Create, update, and maintain Knowledge Base Articles related to TM, CTA, Table Drop, and associated integrations.
Participate in an on-call rotation supporting customers outside of standard business hours.
Assist with audit reviews, compliance requests, data validation efforts, and regulatory inquiries related to supported applications.
Support monitoring activities and proactive identification of application health issues impacting customer operations.
Required Skills
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong understanding of application support methodologies and customer service principles.
Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative support team.
Excellent customer service and relationship management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced support environment.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Flexibility to support evening, weekend, and on-call activities as required.
Desirable Skills
Previous experience supporting casino management systems, table games systems, cage systems, accounting systems, or enterprise business applications.
Experience supporting Table Manager, Cage & Table Accounting, Table Drop, Advantage, Patron Management, or related gaming platforms.
Strong understanding of casino table games operations, cage operations, auditing processes, and accounting workflows.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server databases and network configuration concepts.
Experience analyzing database-driven applications and diagnosing data-related issues.
Ability to understand application logic and troubleshoot through review of T-SQL code and database structures.
SQL Server administration and troubleshooting experience.
Ability to write and execute T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and SQL jobs for troubleshooting, reporting, and workaround development.
Experience with report creation, modification, and troubleshooting.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, change management, release management, and problem management processes.
Experience supporting integration between multiple applications and third-party systems.
Knowledge of ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request processes.
Familiarity with Windows Server environments, application services, scheduled jobs, and system monitoring tools.
Experience supporting high-availability production systems in regulated gaming environments
Keys to Success
• Building collaborative relationships
• Decision making
• Drive results
• Foster innovation
• Personal energy
• Self-leadership

IGT, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale!  From the casino floor to your mobile screen, we deliver thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences—powered by world‑class content, strong technical and commercial capabilities and nurtured by a culture of collaboration, accountability, and ownership.
Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. With a team of over 6,000 employees across 30+ countries and products delivered in more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide, we operate at scale while staying closely connected to customers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here - www.igt.com.
Responsibilities
The Computer Operator I is an entry-level position responsible for the continuous monitoring and basic troubleshooting of operating systems and equipment within a 24x7x365 Video Lottery Terminal (VLT) Operations Center. This role ensures strict adherence to operational procedures, checklists, policies, and national IT best practices to maintain system integrity and uptime. The operator will support the secure and efficient functioning of gaming systems by identifying issues, escalating incidents appropriately, and maintaining accurate logs and reports.
Standard shift hours are 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM (12-hour shifts).
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
Conducts entry-level troubleshooting of host systems, middleware, applications, and tools by following established procedures under supervision.
Monitors network operations by verifying tool availability, using diagnostic tools to confirm service status, and identifying, documenting, escalating, and reporting anomalies as needed.
Oversees logical security using approved tools and procedures to ensure compliance and system integrity.
Performs routine system and server monitoring to verify operational health, detect issues, and escalate incidents in accordance with standard protocols.
Troubleshoots basic network technologies, including IP-based devices and backbone transport systems, using existing tools and under guidance.
Executes operational checklists with precision to support draw processing, day-end processing, system balancing, file maintenance, change requests, report and file transfers, messaging, jackpot tracking, and customer service requests.
Coordinates and fulfills internal and external customer requests, ensuring proper validation, tracking, escalation, and follow-up in line with established guidelines.
Communicates regularly with gaming venues and regulatory agencies via telephone and email to address operational issues, ensure compliance, and maintain effective working relationships. These interactions are frequent and carry moderate to high operational impact.
Recommends updates or improvements to operational procedures and checklists to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
Complies with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) by meeting defined performance standards and timelines.
Adheres to IT best practices and audit requirements to maintain operational excellence and compliance.
Supports local testing efforts by following defined testing policies and procedures.
Monitors and troubleshoots automated functions, ensuring tool availability and accurate issue detection, documentation, and escalation.
Engages in professional development by completing assigned learning plans, participating in mentoring, tracking progress, and communicating career goals.
Qualifications
Education & Experience:
Associate degree in a technical field (or equivalent) or 1–2 years of relevant experience in IT operations or a similar environment.
Technical Proficiency:
Basic command-line navigation and operations in Unix, Linux, AIX, VMS, and DOS environments.
Working knowledge of FTP/SFTP protocols for secure file transfers.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, MS Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc…) and familiar with PC operating systems.
Communication & Interpersonal Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including professional phone etiquette.
Customer service experience is a plus.
Work Ethic & Personal Attributes:
Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and initiative.
Excellent listening, organizational, and planning skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Work Schedule & Environment:
Must be available to work 12-hour shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
Physical & Other Requirements:
Ability to sit or remain in a stationary position for extended periods (up to 12 hours).
Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate computer systems, keyboards, computer mouse and monitoring tools.
Visual acuity to view multiple monitors and detect system alerts or anomalies.
Occasional bending, reaching, or lifting of items up to 20 pounds (e.g., equipment, reports).
Ability to work in a secure, climate-controlled operations center environment with low to moderate noise levels.
Must successfully complete a company-administered criminal background check and obtain a Gaming License, which includes passing a comprehensive background investigation comparable to FBI standards.

OverviewApplication
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!
As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.
Role Overview
As the Digital Growth & Content Lead, you will own the end-to-end digital ecosystem for the Automotive & Data (A&D) business unit. As a highly autonomous individual contributor, you will act as a strategic doer - responsible for both setting the digital and content agenda and hands-on executing it, ensuring our technical innovations translate into market-leading authority and measurable commercial impact. Your mission is to drive the "why" behind our digital presence, shaping brand narrative while optimising our channels and content to drive pipeline and audience scale.
In this role, you will define and execute a sophisticated content and digital strategy that positions Arrive as the essential platform for in-car payments and a leader in connected services. You will balance long-term brand building with short-term commercial objectives, owning the strategy for lead generation contribution, SEO, and multi-channel engagement. By leveraging data-driven insights and cross-functional leadership, you will scale our digital footprint and build a narrative that consistently generates demand, engagement and high-authority market positioning.
Key Responsibilities
Digital Channel Strategy & Growth
Ecosystem Ownership: Lead the strategic development and implementation of the A&D digital ecosystem, including website, CRM, and social channels to maximise reach and conversion.
Growth Optimisation: Drive direct growth strategies across LinkedIn and other professional channels, leveraging content to expand our influence within the automotive sector.
Subscriber Acquisition: Shape and execute global newsletters and database growth strategies, focusing on high-value lead acquisition and retention.
Innovation: Identify and implement emerging digital marketing technologies and AI-driven workflows to increase operational efficiency and content performance.
Content Strategy & Brand Authority
Strategic Narrative: Own the content roadmap, ensuring all messaging aligns with Arrive’s global brand vision while specifically addressing A&D’s products and complex technical audience.
Authority Building: Hands-on creation and production of high-impact newsletters, media, whitepapers, case studies, and thought-leadership pieces.
Brand Guardianship: Govern and apply the visual and verbal identity of the business unit, ensuring absolute consistency across all external media, video, and event assets you create and manage.
Performance & Commercial Impact
Pipeline Generation & Expansion: Optimise the lead-to-opportunity funnel, ensuring digital activities contribute directly to both net-new qualified inbound sales pipeline and cross-sell/upsell opportunities within existing accounts.
Customer Retention & Affinity: Own digital lifecycle initiatives aimed at existing customers, utilising targeted content and channel strategies to keep them highly engaged, maximise lifetime value, and build lasting brand loyalty.
Analytics & ROI: Own the reporting suite for digital performance, translating complex metrics into actionable insights for the Senior Leadership Team.
Skills & Requirements
Proven experience leading digital growth and executing content strategy and creation within the B2B tech, automotive, or SaaS sectors.
Proven track record of managing and optimising full-stack marketing ecosystems (HubSpot or Salesforce CRM/CMS proficiency is essential).
Expertise in SEO, data analytics, and performance marketing, with the ability to link digital activity to commercial revenue.
Strong leadership skills with experience managing external agencies, vendors and cross-functional internal stakeholders.
Strategic thinker capable of balancing brand-led authority with commercial growth targets.
About Arrive
Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

Test och verifiering – HiQ Mälardalen
Vill du vara med och kvalitetssäkra framtidens teknik?
På HiQ Mälardalen tror vi att riktigt bra teknik börjar med människor som är nyfikna, engagerade och vill göra skillnad. Nu söker vi dig som brinner för test och verifiering och vill bidra till att utveckla kvalitetssäkra och tillförlitliga tekniska lösningar. Som konsult hos oss får du arbeta med spännande utmaningar i komplexa tekniska miljöer, tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor och kunder som värdesätter din erfarenhet.
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av:
Test och verifiering, både hands-on testning och testautomation.
Systemtest, integrationstest och kravbaserad verifiering.
Testning i komplexa tekniska miljöer, gärna inom embedded systems eller systemnära utveckling.
Olika testverktyg och testramverk samt samarbete med utvecklings-, krav- och systemteam.
Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
Embedded systems och systemnära testning.
HIL/SIL, CI/CD och automatiserade testflöden.
Testcertifieringar, exempelvis ISTQB.
Vad kan vi erbjuda?
På HiQ Mälardalen kombinerar vi spännande uppdrag med bra förmåner och en arbetsmiljö där människor trivs och utvecklas. Vi är en kulturdriven organisation som värdesätter människor före titlar och som tror på att mjuka värden gör skillnad i en ibland hård bransch.
För dig som senior konsult erbjuder vår 70/30-modell en attraktiv kombination av frihet, ansvar och goda möjligheter att dra nytta av din erfarenhet.
Våra förmåner
Lön och pension: Konkurrenskraftig lön, flextid, övertidsersättning, ITP1, flexpension och löneväxling.
Hälsa och välmående: 5 000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag per år, massage, företagshälsovård och gemensamma aktiviteter.
Trygghet: Försäkringar och föräldralön som kompletterar Försäkringskassans ersättning upp till cirka 90 % av lönen.
Semester och ledighet: 27 semesterdagar, ledighet i anslutning till nationaldagen och en extra dag arbetstidsförkortning.
Utveckling och gemenskap: Utbildningar, roliga AW-events, teknikevent, CV-coaching, härliga kontor och nära ledarskap.
Förmånscykel: Möjlighet att skaffa cykel via bruttolöneavdrag.
Rekryteringsbonus: 30 000 kr när du tipsar om en person som vi anställer.

Sedan 1995 har HiQ hjälpt kunder att förenkla världen med teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi drivs av ansvar, enkelhet, resultat och glädje – och av övertygelsen att riktigt bra teknik skapas av människor som trivs tillsammans.

Utvecklande och inspirerande uppdrag
Vill du jobba med kunder som är ute efter techlösningar som förenklar vardagen och formar vår framtid? På HiQ förenas riktigt duktiga konsulter med målinriktade kunder. I din roll kommer du att samarbeta med fantastiska människor från en rad branscher. Visst kommer det vara dagar av vardaglig konsultverksamhet. Men det kommer också vara magiska stunder där nya möjligheter öppnas upp med kunder som är ivriga att leda utvecklingen inom sin bransch.
Personlig och professionell utveckling 
Vi vet att även de bästa konsulterna behöver utmanande projekt och ständig utbildning för att behålla sin spetskompetens. På HiQ är din utveckling en viktig del av vår framgång. Marknaden förändras hela tiden, och därför investerar vi i intern utveckling genom kompetensgrupper där konsulter lär sig av varandra. Vi uppmuntrar till kurser, certifieringar och att man är med på våra interna föreläsningar för att stärka din roll som konsult hos oss.
Nära ledarskap
Som konsult hos oss är du aldrig ensam. Våra engagerade konsultchefer stöttar dig och matchar din profil med rätt uppdrag, alltid med fokus på din utveckling. Vi vill att HiQ ska kännas som hemma, oavsett var du är placerad. Du är en del av ett konsultteam inom ditt expertområde och har regelbunden kontakt med kollegor och chefer för stöd och som bollplank under din konsultresa.
Bra lön och förmånspaket
Vi förstår att det finns mycket att överväga när man väljer ett konsultbolag. Uppdrag, kollegor och utvecklingsmöjligheter är viktiga, men det är även ersättning och välmående. Därför ser vi regelbundet över vårt förmånspaket för att säkerställa att de bästa konsulterna väljer HiQ. Hos oss har du fast lön, övertidsersättning och flexibla arbetstider. Vi erbjuder också tjänstepension, föräldralön, hälsoersättning och tillgång till ett brett utbud av försäkringar och hälsovårdstjänster.
Unik kultur och gemenskap
När man väljer jobb är kulturen på arbetsplatsen viktig för att man ska trivas och kunna utvecklas. En bra kultur skapar gemenskap och gör att man känner sig motiverad och sedd. På HiQ är kulturen något alldeles speciellt – här möts en brokig skara tech-experter i gemenskapen om att alla är välkomna precis som dom är. På HiQ bejakar vi våra intressen, både professionellt och vid sidan av - alltid med målet att utvecklas och ha roligt på vägen.
Ett starkt varumärke
Med 30 års historia av att leverera banbrytande lösningar i alla branscher har HiQ utvecklat ett starkt, omtyckt och välkänt varumärke. Varumärket utgörs av de 2000 fantastiska medarbetarna som tillsammans skapat bolaget de alltid velat jobba på. En unik, inkluderande kultur och stora möjligheter till utveckling har i sin tur bidragit till HiQ's starka arbetsgivarvarumärke.

Från smarta agenter till samhällsnytta
 Skicka ansökan
Vill du bygga AI lösningar som fungerar i verkligheten, inte bara i demos? På HiQ får du kombinera agentisk AI, modern mjukvaruutveckling och kreativ problemlösning tillsammans med kollegor som vill skapa teknik som gör skillnad.
Om rollen:
Som AI Engineer på HiQ arbetar du i uppdrag där LLM:er, agentisk AI, data och modern mjukvaruutveckling möts. Du hjälper kunder att förstå vilka problem som är värda att lösa, designar lösningar som håller tekniskt och bygger AI system som skapar konkret nytta. Rollen passar dig som gillar att skriva kod, testa snabbt och samtidigt bygga robusta lösningar som kan leva vidare i produktion. Du arbetar nära kunder, produktägare, utvecklare, data engineers och verksamhetsexperter för att ta idéer från utforskning och MVP till säkra, skalbara och användbara system.
Du kommer att:
Designa, utveckla och produktionssätta lösningar inom agentisk AI, data och mjukvara
Bygga AI agenter, RAG lösningar, LLM baserade workflows, rekommendationsflöden och smarta automationer
Integrera AI funktioner i moderna webb, moln och SaaS lösningar
Utveckla backendtjänster, API:er, datadrivna system och integrationer mot kunders befintliga miljöer
Arbeta med evaluation, guardrails, testning, observability och uppföljning
Optimera lösningar för kvalitet, prestanda, kostnad, säkerhet och användarvärde
Vi tror att du har:
Minst tre års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna i Python, TypeScript, Go, Java eller liknande
Praktisk erfarenhet av LLM baserade lösningar, AI, ML eller datadrivna system
Förståelse för embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering, vector search, model evaluation och inference
Vana att bygga API:er, backendtjänster, integrationer och lösningar i molnmiljöer som AWS, Azure eller GCP
Erfarenhet av tool use, function calling, structured outputs eller LLM orchestration
Förmåga att förstå teknik, produkt, processer och affärsnytta, och omsätta det till fungerande lösningar
God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska, med trygghet i dialogen med både tekniska och icke tekniska personer
Varför HiQ?
Hos oss får du vara nära tekniken, nära besluten och nära människorna som lösningarna skapas för. Du får utforska nya möjligheter inom AI, dela kunskap med nyfikna kollegor och vara med i team där idéer snabbt kan bli fungerande lösningar.
Här finns energi, bredd och teknisk spets, men också utrymme att växa, påverka och hitta nästa steg i din egen utveckling. Du får vara med och forma hur AI används på riktigt hos kunder som vill skapa effekt, inte bara följa en trend.
Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

DOGMAN
ÄR DU VÅR NYA HUNDFRISÖR PÅ DOGMAN AND FRIENDS PÅ VÄLA?
Är du vår nya Hundfrisör till Dogman and friends på Väla?
Vi söker dig som är hundfrisör och brinner för att vårda djuren på bästa sätt. Du ska vara självgående och varje dag kunna bemöta kunderna med bästa tänkbara service. Du älskar djur och djurvård.
Vem är du?
Vi ser gärna att du som söker har längre erfarenhet av att klippa hundar. Det viktigaste är att du kan vardags klippning och följa kundens önskemål. Kunskap om ras klippning är meriterande och du ska också vara bekväm med klo klippning. För att trivas hos oss är det viktigt att du är en positiv lagspelare som gillar när det är mycket att göra. Du tycker om att ge människor service och gillar när det är högt tempo. Som person är du öppen, framåt, ordningsam och disciplinerad med en egen drivkraft. Att klippa och vårda djur i vår salong är din huvudsakliga uppgift men i tjänsten ingår även butiks skötsel, påfyllning av varor och försäljning i de dagliga arbetsuppgifterna.
Profil & Bakgrund
Dina egenskaper och sätt att vara är viktigare för oss än en imponerande meritförteckning eller dokumenterad erfarenhet. Du ska behärska svenska i tal och skrift.
Innehar en hög kundservice
Har en teamorienterad stil
Arbetar metodiskt, målinriktat och självständigt
En vilja att utvecklas och att göra ditt absolut bästa
Djurvårdsutbildning från gymnasium, djurpark eller Zoorf-utbildning är meriterande.
Vad erbjuder Dogman?
Vi erbjuder en helt nyrenoverat trimmlokal med en spännande tjänst i ett växande bolag med nästan lika många hundar som människor, vilket enligt forskning gör oss både lyckligare och mer avslappnade. Vi firar våra framgångar mycket och gärna. Vi erbjuder ett roligt arbete med stor teamkänsla och en härlig Dogman anda med möjligheter till utveckling.
Det här beskriver några av våra medarbetare att de uppskattar med Dogman.
”Jag tycker att man i organisationen hela tiden jobbar för utveckling och förbättring. En arbetsplats som inte bara anställer folk för att arbeta utan för att utvecklas och få vara med att bidra. Och inte nog med det, fantastiska och extremt kunniga människor på alla olika positioner. En RIKTIGT bra arbetsplats."
”Mina kollegor. Eventen. Hjälpa kunder till ett bättre djursamspel. Hålla kampanjer. Att vi får utvecklas. När vi får vara med och bestämma, att vår röst räknas grundad utifrån erfarenheter och upplevelsen i butiken.”
Anställningsform: Vikariat, ca 14 h i veckan med eventuell möjlighet till mer.
Rapportering sker till: Butikschef
Placering: Väla
Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
Ansökan
Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Då är du varmt välkommen med din ansökan som vi vill ha senast 2026-11-15. Du ansöker genom att klicka på ”Sök tjänst” och bifogar ditt CV och personliga brev. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post. Frågor om tjänsten besvaras av Butikschef petra.odahl@dogman.se
Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningstiden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut.
Om Dogman
AB Dogman är idag Nordens ledande aktör inom husdjurstillbehör och importerar, distribuerar och marknadsför produkter inom husdjurssegmentet samt häst och ryttare. Vi utvecklar vårt sortiment inom våra varumärken Dogman, Jacson och Kennel Equip med visionen om att skapa ”Det bästa valet för bästa vännen”. Dogman finns idag representerade med bolag i Sverige, Norge, Danmark och Finland och omsätter 500 MSEK med god lönsamhet. Dogman är grundat 1965 och ägs av BrA Invest.
I september 2017 förvärvade Dogman sina första butiker för att starta en egen butikskedja. Idag är vi 33 butiker i Sverige och Norge och under 2022 etablerar vi oss också i Finland. Under sommaren 2019 lanserades e-handel under eget varumärke.

Job Description:
Zur Unterstützung des Bereichs "MRO A400M" sucht Airbus Defence and Space in Wunstorf und Langenhagen
A400M - Certifying Staff / Support Staff CAT B2 (d/m/w)
Als Certifying Staff CAT B2 arbeiten Sie im Team gemeinsam mit Ihren Kollegen am modernsten militärischen Transportflugzeug, dem A400M. Zusätzlich werden Sie fallweise A400M Kunden (national und international) bei geplanten und ungeplanten Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen sowie bei Retrofits unterstützen.
Dein Standort
Wunstorf und Langenhagen liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe von Hannover, der Landeshauptstadt Niedersachsens, und das Steinhuder Meer ist schnell zu erreichen. Ob Kite-Surfen, Wandern oder Theaterbesuche – diese Region bietet einen hohen Erholungswert, das volle Spektrum an kulturellen Möglichkeiten sowie eine exzellente medizinische Versorgung. Je nach Schwerpunkt Ihrer Rolle befindet sich Ihr Arbeitsplatz in Langenhagen oder auf dem Fliegerhorst der Luftwaffe in Wunstorf mit direktem Kontakt zum Kunden und Produkt.
Unsere Benefits für dich
Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten
Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird
Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
Wartungs- und Instandsetzungsarbeiten an militärischen Luftfahrzeugen gemäß der gültigen Instandhaltungsdokumentation
Ein- und Nachrüstungsarbeiten sowie Modifikationen und der damit verbundenen Nachweisführung
Bewertung von Mängeln am Luftfahrzeug auf Auswirkungen bezüglich der Flugsicherheit (z.B. MEL, MOSEL, LTA, DEMAR PART M) und deren Behebung
Bewertung nicht ausgeführter Arbeiten inkl. Abstellung bzw. Abstimmung mit der CAMO (z.B. deferments)
Überblick/Überwachung hinsichtlich der Einhaltung der Qualitätsnormen und luftrechtlicher Vorschriften am Luftfahrzeug
Arbeiten als Unterstützungspersonal bei Base Maintenance und als freigabeberechtigtes Personal bei Line Maintenance
Durchführung von luftrechtlichen Abnahmen und der damit verbundenen Nachweisführung (z.B. Release to Service)
Mitwirken beim Handover/Handback von Luftfahrzeugen
Erstellen von Konformitätserklärungen (z.B. DEMAR Form One)
Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen
Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Fluggerätmechaniker, Fluggerätelektroniker oder vergleichbar
EASA/DEMAR PART 66 CAT B2 Lizenz mit Mustereinträgen ist Voraussetzung
Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der zivilen Luftfahrzeuginstandhaltung und/oder A400M Programm ist Voraussetzung
Mehrjährige Erfahrung als EASA/DEMAR PART 145 CAT B2 ist von Vorteil
Hohes Maß an Teamgeist und Belastbarkeit
Sehr gute Serviceorientierung und Problemlösungsfähigkeit
Sehr hohes Maß an Selbständigkeit und Verantwortungs- und Qualitätsbewusstsein
Bereitschaft und Erfahrung zum Arbeiten in beengten Räumen und großen Höhen
Sie verfügen über fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Job Description:
Zur Unterstützung des Bereichs "MRO A400M" sucht Airbus Defence and Space in Wunstorf und Langenhagen
A400M - Certifying Staff / Support Staff CAT B1 (d/m/w)
Als Certifying Staff CAT B1 arbeiten Sie im Team gemeinsam mit Ihren Kollegen am modernsten militärischen Transportflugzeug, dem A400M. Zusätzlich werden Sie fallweise A400M Kunden (national und international) bei geplanten und ungeplanten Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen sowie bei Retrofits unterstützen.
Dein Standort
Wunstorf und Langenhagen liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe von Hannover, der Landeshauptstadt Niedersachsens, und das Steinhuder Meer ist schnell zu erreichen. Ob Kite-Surfen, Wandern oder Theaterbesuche – diese Region bietet einen hohen Erholungswert, das volle Spektrum an kulturellen Möglichkeiten sowie eine exzellente medizinische Versorgung. Je nach Schwerpunkt Ihrer Rolle befindet sich Ihr Arbeitsplatz in Langenhagen oder auf dem Fliegerhorst der Luftwaffe in Wunstorf mit direktem Kontakt zum Kunden und Produkt.
Unsere Benefits für dich
Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.

Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten
Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird
Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
Durchführung von Wartungs- und Instandsetzungsarbeiten an militärischen Luftfahrzeugen gemäß der gültigen Instandhaltungsdokumentation
Durchführen von Ein- und Nachrüstungsarbeiten sowie Modifikationen und der damit verbundenen Nachweisführung
Bewertung von Mängeln am Luftfahrzeug auf Auswirkungen bezüglich der Flugsicherheit (z.B. MEL, MOSEL, LTA, DEMAR PART M) und deren Behebung
Bewertung nicht ausgeführter Arbeiten inkl. Abstellung bzw. Abstimmung mit der CAMO (z.B. deferments)
Überblick/Überwachung hinsichtlich der Einhaltung der Qualitätsnormen und luftrechtlicher Vorschriften am Luftfahrzeug
Arbeiten als Unterstützungspersonal bei Base Maintenance und als freigabeberechtigtes Personal bei Line Maintenance
Durchführung von luftrechtlichen Abnahmen und der damit verbundenen Nachweisführung (z.B. Release to Service)
Mitwirken beim Handover/Handback von Luftfahrzeugen
Erstellen von Konformitätserklärungen (z.B. DEMAR Form1)
Treffen von eigenständigen und verbindlichen Entscheidungen auf Grundlage gültiger Vorschriften

Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Fluggerätmechaniker oder vergleichbar
EASA/DEMAR PART 66 CAT B1 Lizenz mit Mustereinträgen ist Voraussetzung

Hohes Maß an Teamgeist und Belastbarkeit
