 JOB DESCRIPTION
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology  we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.  
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.
As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.
Job Responsibilities
Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation. 
Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.  
Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications. 
Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.
Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction
Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management
Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve
Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours
Occasional international travel is required
Qualifications
Education / Experience
Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.
4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory 
Robust  experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry
Technical Skills
Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.
Powershell Scripting skills will be required
Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios
Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance
Additional Qualifications
Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures
Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position
Committing to operational excellence, with a willingness to cross-train and to learn additional technical expertise
Taking a proactive, collaborative and supportive approach when interacting with colleagues
Strong customer focus and a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic
Adaptable to change in a large organization
Excellent communication  negotiation and documentation skills
Strong spoken and written English
Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills to identify discrepancies, challenge assumptions, and confidently present solutions

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Job Description
JOB PURPOSE:
The SCMS Testing Engineer will be responsible to perform testing, verification, validation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of SCMS systems in electrical substations, ensuring reliable operation of substation automation, monitoring, control, and communication systems in compliance with project specifications and utility standards.
INTERFACES:
External Interfaces:
Utilities
Client
Project Consultants
Sub-contractors & Suppliers
Internal Interfaces:
Project Engineering and Management Team
Toshiba Manufacturing Units
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Review SCMS architecture, database, signal lists, SLDs, and engineering documents.
Develop and execute Method Statements, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) and Site Acceptance Test (SAT) procedures.
Verify SCMS database configuration, HMI graphics, alarms, events, logs, and reports.
Validate IEC 61850, IEC60870-5-103, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus, DNP3, and other communication protocols.
Perform end-to-end signal testing between:
Protection Relays
Bay Control Units (BCUs), Bays Control and Protection Units (BCPU), Merging Units (MU) etc.
RTUs, station controllers
SCADA/LDC systems – Point to Point tests
Gateways, Ethernet switches, firewalls, IDS etc.
Able to conduct patch management, vulnerability tests, system hardening etc.
Conduct preventive, corrective and emergency maintenance activities, fault diagnostic and corrective actions.
Conduct pre-commissioning and commissioning activities for new and modified SCMS systems.
Perform point-to-point checks and I/O verification.
Execute sequence of operation and interlocking tests.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for system failures and communication problems and prepare the reports.
Restore and verify system functionality after modifications.
Investigate hardware and software issues within SCMS equipment.
Attend client witness tests and technical inspections.
Prepare minimum following document:
FAT Procedures and Reports
SAT Procedures and Reports
Signal Verification Procedure and Reports
Interlocking Test procedures and Reports
SCMS database backups
Site Red marked drawings
Commissioning Completion Reports including check lists
Configuration backup files as per utilities standards
Maintain testing and commissioning records according to project quality procedures
Reports related to preventive, corrective and emergency maintenance
Prepare weekly site works reporting the site works progress to concern project manager and Group P&C Manager
Support energization activities.
Prepare weekly site works reporting the site works progress to concerned project manager and Group P&C Manager for Sr. P&C Engineers assigned for Site testing and commissioning works.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:
Educational Qualification:
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering
Experience:
A minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience as an SCMS engineer from the energy & power industry in the GCC/UAE.
Preferred Certifications:
CISSP (Certified Information System Security Professional) or equivalent.
Factory training certificates from OEM.
SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:
SCMS / SCADA systems
Familiar in substation automation data communication protocols; IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-103 & IEC 60870-5-104
Knowledge of legacy protocols
Protection Control Systems
Bay Control Units (BCU), Merging Units (MU)
RTU Configuration and Testing
Ethernet Switch Configuration
HMI Development and Verification
Network Troubleshooting
Cybersecurity Awareness for Substation Systems and Knowledge of IEC62443 latest standards
Having hands-on experience with the following would be an added advantage:
Toshiba SCMS / GSC1000
Siemens SICAM PAS / SICAM SCC
ABB Micro SCADA
Hitachi Energy MACH Systems
RTU Configuration Tools
Wireshark, RedHat
Relay Test Equipment (OMICRON, FREJA, CMC)
Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability.
Ability to work independently at site.
Client-facing and commissioning experience.
Demonstrable understanding of power system operation.
Knowledge of utility standards and HSE requirements.

Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your role
We are looking for a Data Analyst with expertise in Risk Analytics, Credit Risk, Data Analytics, and Automation. The role involves analyzing large datasets, developing risk controls, supporting regulatory reporting, automating workflows, and generating actionable insights using SQL, PL/SQL, Python, SAS, PySpark, and cloud-based data platforms.
What will you do
Participate in functional requirements analysis and provide precise knowledge on data modeling.
Explore data sources, compare them with business requirement and iterate to ensure requirements are fully covering all specific case with real data when needed. 
Find meaningful insights while exploring Data Sources. Work with Business, find convergence. 
Ensure functional and technical support to our internal clients. Basic understanding of data visualization tools (e.g., Microstrategy, Power BI). 
Strong knowledge of Data Analytics, Data Visualisation, Data Modelling & Design, Business Intelligence, Functional Requirements Definition & Management, BIL Products & Services, Synthesis & Clarity, and Stakeholder Relationship Management. 
Effective and structured communication skills, both oral and written. Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find yourated with 
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Technical and Professional Experience
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, risks, anomalies, and business opportunities.
Perform Risk Analytics, Credit Risk Analytics, and Fraud Analytics to support business decisions.
5+ Years of experience into Develop analytical solutions using Python, SQL,PL/SQL, SAS, and PySpark.
Design and implement risk control frameworks and monitoring mechanisms.
Support regulatory reporting and compliance-related data analysis activities.
Build and automate workflows using Jira, Confluence, Atlassian APIs, and REST APIs.
Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present actionable insights.
DATA ANALYTICS Enabling data-driven decision making by extracting, analysing and communicating insights from structured and unstructured data. 
DATA VISUALISATION Facilitating understanding of data by displaying concepts, ideas and facts using graphical representations.
 DATA MODELLING & DESIGN BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE Developing models and diagrams to represent, communicate and manage data requirements and data assets. Developing, producing and delivering regular and one-off management information to provide insights and aid decision-making. 
FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS DEFINITION & MANAGEMENT  Managing requirements through the entire delivery and operational lifecycle. 
PRODUCTS & SERVICES - Comprehensive understanding of the range of BIL products and services offering for retail banking, wealth management, corporate and institutional banking solutions, meeting the diverse needs and specificities of local and international 
clients. 
Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise
Conduct customer segmentation, credit underwriting, and behavioral analytics.
Implement data quality checks, exception reporting, and validation controls.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Product, Risk, and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions.
Support banking and financial services analytics, including lending and risk management functions.
Ensure data accuracy, governance, and compliance while driving continuous process improvements
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred! 
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

MyCall Shop Brugata søker Sales Advisor (20%)
Flerspråklig Sales Advisor  – Norsk, Engelsk, Polsk
Vi er et team med engasjerte selgere og rådgivere som hver dag jobber for å skape gode kundeopplevelser og hjelpe mennesker med å holde kontakten med familie og venner, både i Norge og internasjonalt. Nå søker vi en ny kollega som ønsker å bli en del av vårt team. Er det deg?
Er dette din neste mulighet?
I 20 år har vi ønsket mennesker velkommen til Norge og hjulpet dem med å holde kontakten med sine nærmeste i utlandet. Vi er en ledende aktør innen internasjonal telekommunikasjon som er kjent for vårt engasjement i å levere innovative og pålitelige mobiltjenester til kundene.
MyCall Shop er en viktig møteplass for våre kunder, og hver dag jobber vi for å levere gode kundeopplevelser gjennom personlig service, rådgivning og salg. I dag har vi kunder fra over 100 nasjonaliteter, og vi er veldig stolte av å kunne tilby kundeservice på flere språk. Derfor ser vi etter deg som snakker flytende norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig. Har du i tillegg polsk språkkompetanse, vil dette være en stor fordel og bli vektlagt positivt i rekrutteringsprosessen.
Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av å finne de beste løsningene for kundene våre. Du vil være en aktiv del av butikkens daglige drift, gjennomføring av kampanjer og kundeaktiviteter. Du inngår i butikkens ordinære turnus, som innebærer arbeid på ettermiddager/kvelder, i helger og i ferier.
Er dette deg?
Vårt mål er å ha de mest fornøyde kundene i bransjen, og vi søker deg som ønsker å bidra til nettopp dette. Du er nysgjerrig på mennesker, flink til å lytte og opptatt av å forstå kundens behov.
Du trives med salg og kundekontakt, bygger gode relasjoner og tar ansvar for å skape positive opplevelser hver eneste dag. Samtidig bidrar du med initiativ og idéer som gjør teamet enda bedre.
Dine personlige egenskaper:
Lærevillig
Resultatorientert
Ansvarsfull og initiativrik
Entusiastisk og serviceinnstilt
En lagspiller som bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
Du snakker flytende norsk og engelsk – både muntlig og skriftlig
Polsk språkkompetanse er spesielt ønskelig og vil bli vektlagt positivt
Dine erfaringer
Tidligere salgserfaring er en fordel, gjerne fra butikk eller servicebransjen, men det er ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er hvem du er som person og hva du ønsker å oppnå.
Vi ser spesielt etter deg som:
Er interessert i mobiltelefoni, teknologi og digitale tjenester
Motiveres av å jobbe mot mål og oppnå gode resultater
Snakker flere språk enn norsk og engelsk (polsk)

Credit Controller - Camberley
Are you an experienced Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity? We're looking for someone who can seamlessly step into the Credit Controller role working alongside our existing team to ensure efficient cash collection across our large portfolio of SME clients.

Arbetsbeskrivning
JOB PURPOSE:
The SCMS Testing Engineer will be responsible to perform testing, verification, validation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of SCMS systems in electrical substations, ensuring reliable operation of substation automation, monitoring, control, and communication systems in compliance with project specifications and utility standards.
INTERFACES:
External Interfaces:
Utilities
Client
Project Consultants
Sub-contractors & Suppliers
Internal Interfaces:
Project Engineering and Management Team
Toshiba Manufacturing Units
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Review SCMS architecture, database, signal lists, SLDs, and engineering documents.
Develop and execute Method Statements, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) and Site Acceptance Test (SAT) procedures.
Verify SCMS database configuration, HMI graphics, alarms, events, logs, and reports.
Validate IEC 61850, IEC60870-5-103, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus, DNP3, and other communication protocols.
Perform end-to-end signal testing between:
Protection Relays
Bay Control Units (BCUs), Bays Control and Protection Units (BCPU), Merging Units (MU) etc.
RTUs, station controllers
SCADA/LDC systems – Point to Point tests
Gateways, Ethernet switches, firewalls, IDS etc.
Able to conduct patch management, vulnerability tests, system hardening etc.
Conduct preventive, corrective and emergency maintenance activities, fault diagnostic and corrective actions.
Conduct pre-commissioning and commissioning activities for new and modified SCMS systems.
Perform point-to-point checks and I/O verification.
Execute sequence of operation and interlocking tests.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for system failures and communication problems and prepare the reports.
Restore and verify system functionality after modifications.
Investigate hardware and software issues within SCMS equipment.
Attend client witness tests and technical inspections.
Prepare minimum following document:
FAT Procedures and Reports
SAT Procedures and Reports
Signal Verification Procedure and Reports
Interlocking Test procedures and Reports
SCMS database backups
Site Red marked drawings
Commissioning Completion Reports including check lists
Configuration backup files as per utilities standards
Maintain testing and commissioning records according to project quality procedures
Reports related to preventive, corrective and emergency maintenance
Prepare weekly site works reporting the site works progress to concern project manager and Group P&C Manager
Support energization activities.
Prepare weekly site works reporting the site works progress to concerned project manager and Group P&C Manager for Sr. P&C Engineers assigned for Site testing and commissioning works.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:
Educational Qualification:
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering
Experience:
A minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience as an SCMS engineer from the energy & power industry in the GCC/UAE.
Preferred Certifications:
CISSP (Certified Information System Security Professional) or equivalent.
Factory training certificates from OEM.
SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:
SCMS / SCADA systems
Familiar in substation automation data communication protocols; IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-103 & IEC 60870-5-104
Knowledge of legacy protocols
Protection Control Systems
Bay Control Units (BCU), Merging Units (MU)
RTU Configuration and Testing
Ethernet Switch Configuration
HMI Development and Verification
Network Troubleshooting
Cybersecurity Awareness for Substation Systems and Knowledge of IEC62443 latest standards
Having hands-on experience with the following would be an added advantage:
Toshiba SCMS / GSC1000
Siemens SICAM PAS / SICAM SCC
ABB Micro SCADA
Hitachi Energy MACH Systems
RTU Configuration Tools
Wireshark, RedHat
Relay Test Equipment (OMICRON, FREJA, CMC)
Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability.
Ability to work independently at site.
Client-facing and commissioning experience.
Demonstrable understanding of power system operation.
Knowledge of utility standards and HSE requirements.

 Arbetsuppgifter
Vill du utvecklas inom försäljning i en miljö där gemenskap, driv och möjligheter står i fokus? 💫
Vi söker nu en ny kollega på heltid till vår butik i Uddevalla Torp. 
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 får du chansen att växa inom professionell rådgivning och försäljning. Du får en roll där du både utmanas och har riktigt roligt på jobbet, samtidigt som du utvecklas varje dag.
Det här får du hos oss
Hos oss får du mer än ett jobb - du får en miljö där du kan utvecklas, prestera och trivas på riktigt.
Fast lön + provision: En trygg grundlön kombinerat med en rörlig del som belönar dina resultat.
Utbildning och coachning: Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - hos oss får du en gedigen introduktion och det stöd du behöver för att utvecklas och lyckas i rollen.
Teamkultur med energi: Ett team där vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och firar framgångar tillsammans.
Tävlingar och gemensamma aktiviteter: Vi skapar energi i vardagen genom roliga tävlingar, aktiviteter och gemensamma firanden.
Karriärmöjligheter: Möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken.
Det här kommer du att göra
Som Butikssäljare på Tele2 är du aktiv på butiksgolvet - du skapar själv möjligheter genom möten, initiativ och kundkontakt. Du spelar en viktig roll i att skapa både positiva kundupplevelser och framgångsrika affärer.
I rollen kommer du att:
Möta våra kunder i butik och hjälpa dem hitta rätt helhetslösningar.
Ta kontakt med både nya och befintliga kunder i butik och via telefon.
Arbeta rådgivande genom att förstå kundens behov och guida dem till rätt beslut.
Arbeta mot både individuella och gemensamma mål tillsammans med teamet.
Bidra till butikens dagliga drift, kampanjer och kundupplevelse.
Bidra till en positiv och energifylld arbetsmiljö.
Hur det är att jobba hos oss
Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de trivs, känner stöd och får möjlighet att lyckas tillsammans med andra. Därför har vi byggt butiker där gemenskap, energi och utveckling är centralt i det vi gör. Dagen börjar ofta tillsammans med teamet där vi går igenom dagens mål & fokus, delar erfarenheter och peppar varandra inför dagen. Under dagen varierar arbetet mellan kundmöten i butik, telefonsamtal med kunder och egna initiativ för att skapa affärsmöjligheter. Det som gör våra butiker speciella är människorna - både våra fantastiska kunder och kollegor. Här hjälper vi varandra, delar kunskap, firar framgångar och bidrar till en miljö där det är riktigt roligt att gå till jobbet. 💫

För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är…
Vi tror att rätt inställning och personliga kompetenser är viktigare än en lång meritlista. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början - det viktigaste är att du är driven och vill utvecklas.
Relationsskapande: Du trivs i mötet med människor, är nyfiken på kundens behov och bygger förtroende genom ett tryggt och professionellt bemötande.
Målmedveten: Du motiveras av att arbeta mot mål och tycker det är roligt att se resultat av ditt arbete.
Initiativtagande: Du tar ansvar, är proaktiv i ditt arbete och tar egna initiativ till att bidra och skapa resultat.
Driven: Du gillar att utvecklas, tar till dig feedback och vill bli bättre över tid.
Samarbetsinriktad: Du trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.
Flexibel: Du anpassar dig till nya situationer och har en positiv inställning till förändring och nya arbetssätt.

Goda kunskaper i engelska, ytterligare språkkunskaper är ett plus.
Vill du vara med? Tveka inte att söka redan idag! 💫
Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande, och som ett steg i rekryteringsprocessen utför Tele2 en bakgrundskontroll på aktuella slutkandidater. Eftersom vi eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning ser vi gärna kvinnliga sökande till den här tjänsten.

Tele2 är en nordisk och baltisk telekomoperatör byggd på en stark utmanarkultur. Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Sales team.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
Today, we employ around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference. 
The Role
At Truesec Norway, we’re on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Norway to start with. You will also: 
• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met. 
• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Norwegian team perform even better than today. 
• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general. 
• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling. 
• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations. 
• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team. 
• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.  
Your Potential Background
• You have solid experience within the cybersecurity industry. 
• You have minimum 5–10 years of proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within cybersecurity. 
• You are a strong communicator, capable of building and maintaining long-lasting, trusting relationships. 
• You are proactive, results-oriented, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 
• You are organized and can manage multiple tasks simultaneously. 
• You approach challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remain composed under pressure. 
• You have experience with CRM systems (preferably Hubspot).
• You are fluent in both Norwegian and English at a business level. 
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Norwegian or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Otsime disainisüsteemi disainerit.
Kas soovid kujundada disainisüsteemi, mis ei ole kasutamiseks üksnes disaineritele, vaid loob eelduse ka AI-toega tootearenduseks? Mõistad hästi struktureeritud komponentide, tokenite, disainimustrite ja dokumentatsiooni mõju sellele, kuidas digitaalseid tooteid luuakse, arendatakse ja skaleeritakse ning kuidas ühtlane kasutajakogemus tugevdab brändikuvandit? Kui jah, siis ootame sind Telia Tootedisaini tiimi disainisüsteemi disaineriks (Design System Designer).
Sinu mõju
Sinu töö keskmes on Telia multibrand disainisüsteem (komponendid, mustrid, juhised), mis aitab luua ühtset ja kvaliteetset kasutajakogemust üle kõigi Telia, Diili ja Superi brändide digitaalsete keskkondade. Arendad süsteemi nii, et tootearendus toimiks tõhusalt ning keskenduks kasutajatele väärtuse loomisele. Seejuures kujundad disainisüsteemi vastavaks AI-ajastu vajadustele – ühtviisi arusaadav ja kasutatav nii inimestele kui ka AI-põhistele tööriistadele.
Sinu peamised ülesanded:
Kujundad Telia disainisüsteemi, sealhulgas komponente, mustreid, disainitokeneid ja dokumentatsiooni. Läbi selle võimaldad Telia teenuste intuitiivset ja ligipääsetavat kasutajakogemust.
Arendad disainisüsteemi edasi viisil, mis toetab AI-toega disaini ja tootearendust, luues selged seosed komponentide, mustrite ja nende kasutuskonteksti vahel.
Vastutad selle eest, et disainisüsteem oleks disaineritele ja arendajatele lihtsasti kasutatav.
Tagad, et süsteemis kasutatavad komponendid ja mustrid peegeldaksid järjepidevalt Telia brändi ja visuaalset identiteeti ning toetaks ühtset kasutajakogemust.
Teed tihedat koostööd tootedisainerite, arendajate ja brändimeeskonnaga, et mõista vajadusi ning seada süsteemi järgmisi arengusuundi.
Hindad regulaarselt olemasolevaid komponente ja mustreid, parandad nende järjepidevust, ligipääsetavust ja kasutatavust ning eemaldad või ühendad lahendusi, mis enam väärtust ei loo.
Mis aitab sul selles rollis edu saavutada
Sinu tugevuseks on arusaam, et hea lahendus vastab kasutaja vajadustele, on äriliselt mõistlik ja tehnoloogiliselt teostatav. Mõistad, et kiireks prototüüpimiseks, testimiseks ning toote turule toomiseks on vajalik hästi toimiv ja AI-lahendusi toetav disainisüsteem. Näed disaini- ja arendusprotsessi tervikuna ning kujundad disainisüsteemi selliselt, et see töö sujuvust kõige paremini toetaks.
Oled hea suhtleja ja teed tõhusat koostööd nii disainerite kui arendajatega. Sind iseloomustab süsteemne mõtlemine, algatusvõime ja püstitatud eesmärkide lõpuni viimine.
Oled edukas kandidaat, kui:
sul on kogemus disainisüsteemide loomise, arendamise ja skaleerimisega digitaalseid tooteid loovas organisatsioonis;
mõtled süsteemselt ja seostad disainisüsteemi arhitektuuri ning komponendid ja nende tehnilise teostatavuse koodis;
soovid panustada AI-toega disaini ja tootearenduse võimaldamisse ning mõistad, et hästi struktureeritud ja dokumenteeritud disainisüsteem on selle oluline eeldus. Oskad kirjeldada AI-le vajalikud reeglid ja juhised;
oled professionaalne Figma kasutaja ja omad varasemat kogemust generatiivse AI kasutamisega disainis sh mõistad, kuidas LLM-id tõlgendavad disaini semantikat ja visuaalseid reegleid;
omad head arusaama nii kasutajakogemuse- kui visuaalsest disainist ning märkad järjepidevuse olulisust tervikliku süsteemi loomisel;
sul on väga hea eesti ja inglise keele oskus kõnes ja kirjas;
naudid koostööd erinevate osapooltega ning oskad kujundada kokkuleppeid ja tööviise, mis aitavad organisatsioonil ühtselt edasi liikuda. Oled meeskonnamängija ja hea kaaslane.
Mida me pakume
Meiega liitudes ootab sind hoolikalt kokku pandud hüvede pakett, paindlik hübriidtöö võimalus ja palju muud, mis aitab sul hoida head tasakaalu töö ja eraelu vahel. Lisaks on sul võimalus teenida lisaboonust, mis peegeldab sinu panust ja Telia tulemusi.
Ready to make better happen?
Et meie tiimiga liituda, anna endast märku! Kui soovid rohkem teada, võta ühendust LinkedIn’is Merilin Matsik | LinkedIn
Ootame sinu kandideerimist hiljemalt 08.11. Soovitame kandideerida siiski esimesel võimalusel, sest sobiva kandidaadi leidmisel võime konkursi varem sulgeda.
Palun kandideeri meie ametliku värbamisplatvormi Workday kaudu, sest me ei käsitle CV-sid, mis laekuvad emaili või mõne muu kanali kaudu. Niimoodi saame tagada, et sinu isikuandmed on turvaliselt hoitud.
Taustakontroll ja soovituste kontrollimine on osa värbamisprotsessist.
Võrdsete võimaluste tagamine
Telias hindame inimesi nende professionaalsete oskuste ja arengupotentsiaali põhjal. Toetame mitmekesisust ning tagame, et iga inimese vajadused oleksid arvestatud sõltumata tema taustast, isikuomadustest või elukogemusest. Koos loome kaasava töökeskkonna, kus sinu erilisus on meie tugevus.

Arbetsbeskrivning
Would you like to work for an internationally renowned Company, who can provide internal training support and development as well as a great benefits package and the opportunity to grow within the business? Our Service division are looking for a dedicated problem solver to work within our field-based team; to provide support and proactive maintenance for our customers.
We are part of the IT and Document Solutions segment of Toshiba and cover the whole of the UK. To find out more about us, please visit www.toshibatec.co.uk.
What to Expect
Once trained on our products, you will be out in the field relatively quickly, utilising your current knowledge of MFPs and/ or Printers.
You will be responsible for providing post-sales/ implementation and technical support services to customers including installation, troubleshooting, problem resolution and maintenance.
You will be required to respond to customer questions regarding operation and malfunctions and advise customers on preventative maintenance and configuration adjustments to improve product performance and customer satisfaction.
As part of your role, you will cover the Sheffield and surrounding areas, with the expectation that on occasion you may be required to travel slightly further afield including Wales to cover holidays or other absences.
Responsibilities and Duties
Installing, maintaining and diagnosis of machine faults as per Company Guidelines and SLA’s on specified Toshiba MFP equipment.
Escalating issues to a Senior Technician / Manager when required.
Work proactively to achieve individual, team and Company SLAs and productivity levels.
Monitor and maintain adequate stock levels.
Regular contact with call centre to maintain accurate reporting.
Develop and maintain a good rapport with the call centre, making regular contact with established call opening and closing procedures with accurately reported work/travel times.
Ensure all relevant paperwork is completed and submitted in a timely manner.
Training customers to be proficient in the use of their equipment.
To observe and maintain a professional company approach to all customers in developing and building a good rapport.
Develop and maintain a high level of product knowledge and skills.
Comply with Group Policies, Procedures and Objectives.
Perform other such reasonable tasks and responsibilities which may from time to time be required.
Qualifications and Skills Required
A full UK driver’s licence and the flexibility to travel with the role.
Professional written and verbal communication skills across all levels.
Strong customer service skills.
Ability to display tact and diplomacy when dealing with difficult situations and people.
Good working knowledge of Health & Safety procedures both within Toshiba and customer premises.
Effective workload scheduling and prioritising.
Proven Electromechanical Skills.
Ability to support department with networking of machines to client systems.
Good time management and organising skills.
Computer literacy (Microsoft Office).
The ideal candidate will have past experience of supporting MFDs in a comparable role and any Toshiba product knowledge would of course be ideal, however, we are open to considering individuals who can demonstrate experience of supporting MFDs as part of a wider IT support role, and/ or candidates who have supported a comparable hardware product, with transferrable skills.
For those candidates with more to learn technically, we will invest in the necessary training and development opportunities, provided they demonstrate suitable attributes to take on the role, including the drive and motivation to learn and succeed.
We operate Monday to Friday and our engineers are on customer sites attending calls during business hours. There may be occasional overtime.
Your region will cover the North of the UK, and will vary depending on the needs of the business, customer locations and at times, covering absences/ holidays in the team. It would suit someone in the Sheffield area, but will cover a wider region depending on the needs of the business,.

Incident Manager (CSIRT)
Join our mission towards a safe digital future
 Apply for this job 
Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.
About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company
Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact. 
Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover. 
Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.
CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)
Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.
The Role
As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities. 
You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle. 
Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.
Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.
Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.
Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.
Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.
Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.
Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.
Your Potential Background
We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.
You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.
Required Skills
Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.
Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.
Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.
Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.
Meritorious Experience
Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.
Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.
Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.
Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.
Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.
Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.
Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future
If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.
So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your role
We are looking for a Data Analyst with expertise in Risk Analytics, Credit Risk, Data Analytics, and Automation. The role involves analyzing large datasets, developing risk controls, supporting regulatory reporting, automating workflows, and generating actionable insights using SQL, PL/SQL,Python, SAS, PySpark, and cloud-based data platforms.
What will you do
Participate in functional requirements analysis and provide precise knowledge on data modeling.
Explore data sources, compare them with business requirement and iterate to ensure requirements are fully covering all specific case with real data when needed. 
Find meaningful insights while exploring Data Sources. Work with Business, find convergence. 
Ensure functional and technical support to our internal clients. Basic understanding of data visualization tools (e.g., Microstrategy, Power BI). 
Strong knowledge of Data Analytics, Data Visualisation, Data Modelling & Design, Business Intelligence, Functional Requirements Definition & Management, BIL Products & Services, Synthesis & Clarity, and Stakeholder Relationship Management. 
Effective and structured communication skills, both oral and written. Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find yourated with 
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Technical and Professional Experience
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, risks, anomalies, and business opportunities.
Perform Risk Analytics, Credit Risk Analytics, and Fraud Analytics to support business decisions.
5+ Years of experience into Develop analytical solutions using Python, SQL,PL/SQL, SAS, and PySpark.
Design and implement risk control frameworks and monitoring mechanisms.
Support regulatory reporting and compliance-related data analysis activities.
Build and automate workflows using Jira, Confluence, Atlassian APIs, and REST APIs.
Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present actionable insights.
DATA ANALYTICS Enabling data-driven decision making by extracting, analysing and communicating insights from structured and unstructured data. 
DATA VISUALISATION Facilitating understanding of data by displaying concepts, ideas and facts using graphical representations.
 DATA MODELLING & DESIGN BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE Developing models and diagrams to represent, communicate and manage data requirements and data assets. Developing, producing and delivering regular and one-off management information to provide insights and aid decision-making. 
FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS DEFINITION & MANAGEMENT  Managing requirements through the entire delivery and operational lifecycle. 
PRODUCTS & SERVICES - Comprehensive understanding of the range of BIL products and services offering for retail banking, wealth management, corporate and institutional banking solutions, meeting the diverse needs and specificities of local and international 
clients. 
Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise
Conduct customer segmentation, credit underwriting, and behavioral analytics.
Implement data quality checks, exception reporting, and validation controls.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Product, Risk, and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions.
Support banking and financial services analytics, including lending and risk management functions.
Ensure data accuracy, governance, and compliance while driving continuous process improvements
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Hiring: Accounts Receivable Accountant 
We are currently looking for an Accounts Receivable Accountant to join the Volume Accounts Receivable team in Vilnius. The position focuses on executing accounts receivable activities, including payment allocation, invoicing, inquiry management, dunning, reporting, and process optimization, while ensuring compliance with internal controls and service standards. 
What you’ll do: 
Process incoming and outgoing payments accurately and timely
Investigate and resolve customer queries and payment discrepancies
Conduct account reconciliations and support period-end closing activities
Prepare documentation and reports required for audits and year-end closing
Support continuous improvement initiatives within the AR function
What will help you thrive in this role: 
The suitable candidate is analytical, structured, and detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving skills. They are proactive, and solutions-focused while demonstrating good communication and teamwork abilities. 
1+ years of experience in accounts receivable
Proven ability to manage high volumes of transactions through automated systems and complex reconciliations
Proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP, IF functions)
Fluency in English and Lithuanian (written and spoken)
Degree in accounting or a related field is considered an advantage
Experience with SAP ERP and involvement in transitions is also considered an advantage
Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet 
At Telia, we’re a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Top Employer and Sustainability Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world. 
Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact. 
What we offer: 
At Telia, we care about your well-being, growth, and sense of belonging: 
Additional health insurance and pension plans. 
Workation: work from anywhere in the EU for up to 30 days per year. 
Extra vacation days based on tenure (up to 5 additional days). 
Discounts on Telia services, including free home internet. 
Partner offers and discounts (SPA, cafes, events). 
Telia Kids Club: summer camps for employees’ children. 
Company-supported sports activities (yoga, basketball, running). 
Internal training, leadership programs and job shadowing to explore new roles. 
…and more. 
​Monthly salary range for this position – 2120 - 2650 (gross) + annual performance bonuses. Although it may vary depending on your skills and experience. 
Ready to make better happen? 
We look forward to receiving your application by 2026/11/22. Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply! 
If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process. 
Equal opportunities 
At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength. 
Join us and let’s make better happen - together!

About TMEIC Europe
TMEIC drives industry around the world through a comprehensive offering of unique systems solutions including variable frequency drives, motors, generators, flywheels, photovoltaic inverters, BESS inverters and advanced automation systems for a wide range of industrial and energy applications. TMEIC was established in 2003 through the integration of the industrial systems divisions of Toshiba Corporation and Mitsubishi Electric Corporation.
General Role Description
The Field Service Engineer will be responsible for supporting the engineering teams during the planning, design, development, construction, installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting and post warranty services of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) & Photovoltaic (PV) systems. This role also covers Application Engineering responsibilities, involving hands-on technical work, customer support, and project management to ensure the optimal performance of renewable energy systems.
Role Accountabilities
Post Commissioning Operations (Work for the site under Operation)
Analyse, investigate, and implement corrective actions at sites in EMEA based on troubleshooting results.
Execute corrective actions at sites under the guidance of engineers from outside the EU, such as those in Japan or India.
Manage and coordinate scheduled periodic maintenance, including the necessary documentation for internal use and clients.
Coordinate with local service partners to ensure personnel are on-site when needed and support their activities.
Facilitate communication and coordination among stakeholders (clients, vendors, local service partners, etc.) for troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
Negotiate and coordinate with vendors when problems arise and prepare work schedules.
Coordinate the logistics to ensure materials, welfare facilities (e.g., portable toilets), and spare parts available on-site as required.
Perform remote monitoring and data collection at operational sites.
Be available “on call” in case an emergency arises.
Summarise troubleshooting activities, document the results, and report to the client in a timely manner.
Project Commissioning
Be present at the site during commissioning of the system.
Coordinate, manage, and monitor the site activities performed by various suppliers, local service partners, the primary EPC contractor, and the Balance of Plant (BoP) supplier during and prior to the commissioning of the battery energy storage system.
Organise logistics to ensure materials and spare parts available at site as needed.
Application Engineering support (During periods when Post Commissioning Operations or Project Commissioning are not occurring)
Support system design and evaluation of BESS or related renewable projects in collaboration with local engineers and engineers outside of UK.
Engage in discussions with clients and vendors, including direct communication at overseas offices, factories, sites, etc., on technical matters.
Assist in BESS design in collaboration with local engineers and engineers outside of UK.
Support negotiations on technical and cost matters with vendors.
General Employee Accountabilities
Bring full effort to complete tasks assigned by manager.
Give manager best advice.
Give earliest notice when work cannot be delivered as specified.
Cooperate and collaborate with peers and interact cross-organisationally as specified by manager.
Exemplify Company Core Values: Integrity, Client Focus, Team Orientation, and Personal Commitment
Comply with all Company policies, practices, and procedures and all regulations and laws.
Formulate recommendations for improvement proactively.
Ensure effective utilisation of business tools and processes
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy or a related field.
Minimum 3 years’ experience in commissioning and/or servicing of electrical equipment of more than DC 1000V.
Understanding of BESS projects from the development stage through to post-warranty service.
Proven ability to read and understand electrical system drawings and documents.
Demonstrated ability to handle electrical equipment and adhere to safety requirements.
Proven capability in managing large volumes of data, analysing systems and implementing corrective actions based on troubleshooting results.
Demonstrated experience in parts replacement work on-site for inverters and control systems, including safety considerations.
Strong knowledge of health and safety regulations and guidelines, with relevant certifications and training.
Proficiency in Microsoft Windows, Excel, Word, Outlook, and an ERP systems.
Frequent travel to customer sites is required, often needing adaptability to various environments and schedules.
Availability to travel in the UK and EMEA regions.
Must hold a valid driver’s license for driving in the UK and EU.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy or a related field.
Experience in testing and commissioning of control and relay systems for substations.
Technical engineering experience in Wind, Solar, Energy Plants.
Technical engineering experience in other power plants such as Waste-to-Energy (WTE) and Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plants.

 JOB DESCRIPTION
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.
Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz,  Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet. 
Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:
Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.
Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.
Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.
Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.
Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.
Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.
Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:
Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.
Umfangreiche  Führungserfahrungen  in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.
Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.
Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Ieškai darbo, kur gali pradėti be patirties ir greitai įsivažiuoti? Tapk „Telia“ klientų aptarnavimo specialistu (-e).
Per pirmas 3 savaites išmoksi klientų aptarnavimo pagrindus, pradėsi dirbti ir už gerus rezultatus mokymuose dar gausi 520 Eur. (neatskaičius mokesčių) premiją.
Prisijunk prie „Telia“ klientų aptarnavimo komandos Šiauliuose – bendrausi su klientais, padėsi spręsti jų klausimus ir ugdysi įgūdžius, kurie pravers bet kurioje karjeroje. 
Ką veiksi?
• Bendrausi su klientais telefonu ir padėsi spręsti jų klausimus
• Konsultuosi apie „Telia“ paslaugas ir padėsi jas suprasti bei išnaudoti
• Analizuosi klientų poreikius ir pasiūlysi jiems tinkamiausius sprendimus
• Pristatysi papildomas paslaugas ar įrangą
• Kursi sklandžią ir pozityvią klientų patirtį
Kas tau padės šioje pozicijoje augti:
Svarbiausia – tavo požiūris: nori bendrauti, mokytis ir nebijai siekti rezultato
• Mėgsti bendrauti ir tau įdomu dirbti su žmonėmis
• Domiesi technologijomis arba esi smalsus (-i) jas suprasti
• Nori siekti rezultatų (ir uždirbti daugiau nei tik fiksą)
• Sklandžiai kalbi lietuviškai (kitos kalbos – pliusas)
• Gali dirbti pilnu etatu
Patirtis padės, bet nėra būtina – visko išmokysime per kelias savaites.
Ką siūlome: 
Nuolat investuojame į darbuotojų gerovę – nuo profesinio tobulėjimo iki emocinės sveikatos stiprinimo:
• Papildomas sveikatos draudimas ir pensijų kaupimas
• Papildomos atostogų dienos (iki 5 d. pagal stažą)
• Nuolaidos „Telia“ paslaugoms (nemokamas internetas, Telia Play + Netflix, telefonas, planai)
• Perks.lt partnerių pasiūlymai
• „Telia vaikų klubas“ ir vasaros stovyklos
• Įmonės finansuojamos sporto veiklos
• Vidiniai mokymai, lyderystės programos ir karjeros galimybės
• Komandiniai renginiai ir vasaros festivalis
…ir dar daugiau naudų kasdienybėje 
Mėnesinis atlygis – 1275–1420 € (neatskaičius mokesčių) + mėnesiniai priedai.
Vidutiniškai uždirbama apie 600 € (neatskaičius mokesčių) papildomai (viršutinės ribos nėra).
Prisijunk 
Jei pateksi į kitą etapą, su tavimi susisieks mūsų komanda. Finaliniams kandidatams atliksime papildomą patikrą. 
Apie vietą – Šiauliai
Prisijungsi prie Šiaulių skambučių centro komandos, kur naujokai nepaliekami vieni. 
Čia visada turėsi kolegas, kurie padės, patars ir palaikys.
📍 Darbo vieta –Dvaro g. 88, Šiauliai
Darbo grafikas:
Slenkantis grafikas: I–V 8–19 val., VI 9–16 val.
Per mėnesį dirbsi 1–2 šeštadienius.
Pirmą mėnesį dirbsi I–V 8–17 val.
Lygios galimybės visiems 
Telia vertiname žmones pagal jų kompetencijas ir augimo potencialą. Skatiname įvairovę ir užtikriname, kad kiekvienas jaustųsi saugiai, nepriklausomai nuo negalios, lyties, amžiaus, tautybės, seksualinės orientacijos ar socialinio statuso. Kartu kuriame įtraukią darbo aplinką, kur tavo unikalumas yra mūsų stiprybė. 
Rinkis karjerą kuriančią pažangą 
Plačiau apie skambučių centro komandą

 Job Description
Tele2 IoT has been recognized as one of the top 15 companies worldwide and one of the top 10 in Europe in this year’s Gartner Magic Quadrant for Managed IoT Connectivity Services Worldwide. We are trying to simplify and democratize access to high quality IoT Services globally. If you are ready to share our passion for IoT and would like to contribute directly to Tele2’s mission to provide high quality connectivity to as many customers as possible in the world, this job is for you.
About the job
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Tele2 IoT, you will be the first point of contact for potential customers - identifying, engaging, and qualifying leads across various IoT verticals before handing them over to our regional acquisition sales team. You will split your time between managing inbound interest, proactively hunting for new prospects, and representing Tele2 IoT at key industry events.
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of sales, marketing, and technology - perfect for someone who loves connecting with people and has a genuine curiosity about the IoT-connected world. 
Location & Travel: The position is based in France or Spain. Depending on where you live, the setup can be either remote or hybrid. The role also includes international travel, roughly once a month, mainly to attend industry events and meet the team.
Responsibilities include
Inbound Lead Management
Act as the first point of contact for inbound leads from the Tele2 IoT website.
Introduce prospects to our cellular connectivity services and IoT portfolio. & qualify inbound leads and distribute opportunities to the regional acquisition sales team.
Outbound Lead Generation
Proactively identify and research potential B2B prospects across IoT verticals using lead hunting tools, including AI-powered solutions.
Set up and manage automated outreach sequences to engage prospects at scale.
Conduct market research, review industry reports, and perform look-alike business searches to identify new target segments.
Events & Field Engagement
Work closely with the marketing team and regional sales managers to plan and execute exhibiting at industry exhibitions and trade events, generating a strong InBound and OutBound lead generation model for Tele2 IoT.
Drive lead generation activities before, during, and after events -including pre-event outreach and post-event lead nurture campaigns.
Travel to attend exhibitions and represent Tele2 IoT as a knowledgeable and engaging brand ambassador.
Who are you?
You are self driven, energetic, curious, and motivated by results. You enjoy talking to people, are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and thrive when given the freedom to find new and creative ways to connect with prospects. You understand that every conversation is the start of a relationship. You promotes a strong sense of urgency for reaching goals and key deliverables, acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas to the company.
To thrive and succeed in this role we believe that you have:
Prior experience in B2B sales (IoT specific are a strong plus)
Excellent English language skills, combined with professional proficiency in French and/or Spanish, are required. (Additional skills in German or Italian are a strong plus)
Experience with or strong interest in IoT, cellular connectivity, or technology products.
Familiarity with automated email marketing flows and outreach tooling - a strong benefit, and, in general very familiar with digital tools and AI passioned.
Strong communication skills and the ability to engage confidently across channels (email, phone, events).
A passion for technology and excitement about being part of one of the fastest-growing industries in the world.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally, approximately once a month, for exhibitions and team meetings.
A few words from the manager
“Tele2 IoT is growing fast, and our SDRs plays a key role in that journey. In this role, every conversation you start helps build our business. I value colleagues who are self-driven, positive, and not afraid to try new ways to connect with clients. If you want to work in an international team and help connect the world, I look forward to working with you.”
/David Lozano Bravo, Head of IoT Sales, Hiring Manager

 Skills & Requirements
Why Tele2
A culture of natural born challengers – At Tele2 we don’t just do things the traditional way. We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to create smarter and more valuable solutions for our customers. You will be part of a culture that values curiosity, initiative and collaboration, where new ideas are welcomed and everyone’s contribution matters. 
Inclusive and supportive environment – We believe in fostering a creative and flexible workplace where people can bring their whole selves to work. Diversity and inclusion are important to us, and we strive to create an environment where people feel welcome, respected and supported in growing both personally and professionally. 
 A sustainability challenger – We are proud that Tele2 has been recognised as Europe’s Climate Leader by the Financial Times and named as Sweden’s most sustainable company by Time Magazine and Statista, reflecting our strong commitment to reduce emissions, transparency and long-term climate goals. Our efforts focus on three areas where we can make the biggest difference: advancing a circular economy, combating climate change, and protecting children online. By embedding these focus areas into how we operate and innovate, we aim to create positive impact for people, planet and profit.
Interest and application
Would you like to be a part of the Tele2s value-driven and including culture? Then hit the “apply now” button and let’s find out if we’re a match! 
If you have any specific questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact TA specialist: annelie.sjogren@tele2.com
Please note that in compliance with personal data management regulations (GDPR), we are unable to accept CVs via email.

Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.
